jobs.title: Data Engineer (Software Asset Management)
jobs.descriptionHtml: Location: Jakarta, Indonesia Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust. Thales has been present in the Republic of Indonesia for 45 years in the defence, aerospace and space domains, delivering a wide range of civil and defence solutions that highlight our strong commitment to working with the Indonesian government and local stakeholders. In recent years, our innovative solutions in air traffic management systems and telecom satellites have further strengthened our presence in the country alongside our digital portfolio of solutions such as biometrics, data protection and cybersecurity now serving the needs of diverse customers in civil sectors. Data Engineering CANDIDATES THAT WOULD IMPRESS US PROFILE: * Bachelor's degree in computer science or related fields * Fluent in English COMPETENCIES: **Professional Experience** * Experience in gathering prescriber requirements and writing the corresponding low-level requirements * Experience in designing, developing and deploying analytics / PKI solutions **Technical Skills** * Advanced knowledge in algorithms, development in Python, Visual Basic, M language (Power Query in Power BI ) as well as ETL * Advanced proficiency in an analytics tool (e.g., Power BI) è design and build reports with UX considerations **Soft Skills** * Autonomy in a time-zone-shifted management (while staying within the guidelines). * Ability to interact with counterparts remotely and produce concise reporting * Ability to escalate appropriately (strong analytical and problem-solving skills). * Strong verbal and written communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. * Ability to effectively manage relationships with prescribers and end-user of the application **LIFE AS A THALES DATA ENGINEERING ROLE** As a Data Engineering Role within Thales, you will: * Write / consolidate detailed specifications in collaboration with the Service Owner (IS-IT SwAM team) * Identify and design the underlying data model * Identify the relevant data sources, coordination with the teams responsible for the data sources (data lake/warehouse) * Establish a development / delivery schedule, keeping it updated, report on progress, and raise alerts if necessary * Implement / develop the monitoring / KPI solutions (applying internal guidelines, development best practices) Document the implementation and operating procedures / user guide YOUR CAREER AT THALES Future opportunities will allow you to discover other domains or sites. You will be able to evolve and grow your competences in different areas: Room and attention to personal development Build your talents in another domain of Thales Group, discovering new products, new customers, new country or go to a more complex Solution Choose between a technical expertise or a leadership path Build an international career within a leading Engineering Group At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Responsibilities** **PT Ukirama Solusi Indonesia, established in 2016, offers comprehensive ERP software solutions for various industries. We help local & international clients to automate businesses and integrate operations.** **Job Responsibilities** * Assist in the design, development, and enhancement of ERP software applications, participating in the implementation of new features and modules under the guidance of senior developers. * Engage in both front-end and back-end development tasks, gradually taking on more independent coding and problem-solving responsibilities as experience is gained. * Collaborate with developers, UI/UX designers, and analysts to translate requirements into technical solutions. * Engage in manual and automated testing under senior guidance, learning to ensure software quality and reliability. Participate in code reviews, gradually contributing improvement suggestions. * Assist in identifying and resolving software defects and participate in debugging in both development and production environments. * Contribute to technical documentation, including user manuals and API docs, with guidance from senior team members. * Stay updated with the latest industry trends and emerging technologies in software engineering. **Requirements** **Requirements** * Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or equivalent (Fresh graduates with a portfolio or 0-1 year of experience are welcome). * Passionate in Web and Application Development. * Understanding of basic programming fundamentals (Object Oriented Programming, Algorithms, Data structures, Database Design). * Familiarity with frontend development fundamentals, including HTML5, CSS, and at least one framework such as Next.js, AngularJS, Vue.js, or React. * Strong programming logic and basic familiarity with Go/Java/Ruby (experience in at least one is a major plus). * Tech-savvy and AI-forward: Excited about learning and utilizing AI tools to improve coding efficiency. * High curiosity, fast learner, and a proactive attitude toward feedback. * Willing to be full WFO in Jakarta (Sudirman). **About Ukirama** **Ukirama: Empowering Business Growth Since 2016 – Where Your Growth Matters.** Established in 2016, Ukirama provides cloud-based Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) solutions to a diverse portfolio of clients, ranging from prominent international corporations such as Ducati, Auntie Anne's, and Pierre Cardin, to numerous small and medium-sized enterprises (UMKM). Our comprehensive and user-friendly platform enables businesses to streamline operations and achieve sustainable growth through integrated tools for finance, inventory management, manufacturing, and more. Ukirama is committed to making robust ERP technology accessible to businesses of all scales, contributing to the digitalization of Indonesia's economy. At Ukirama, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented environment. We value continuous learning and provide opportunities for team members to develop their expertise through mentorship and engagement with experienced leaders. Individuals are encouraged to contribute their ideas and play a meaningful role in building solutions that directly impact our clients' success. Join Ukirama to be part of a dynamic team that is dedicated to empowering businesses and driving technological advancement across Indonesia.

jobs.descriptionHtml: At Snowflake, we are powering the era of the agentic enterprise. To usher in this new era, we seek AI-native thinkers across every function who are energized by the opportunity to reinvent how they work. You don’t just use tools; you possess an innate curiosity, treating AI as a high-trust collaborator that is core to how you solve problems and accelerate your impact. We look for low-ego individuals who thrive in dynamic and fast-moving environments and move with an experimental mindset — who rapidly test emerging capabilities to discover simpler, more powerful ways to deliver results. At Snowflake, your role isn't just to execute a function, but to help redefine the future of how work gets done. Indonesia is one of Snowflake's top-priority markets and a key new business growth engine for the ASEAN region. We are looking for an Enterprise Account Executive in Jakarta who is energised by winning brand-new customers. This is a dedicated new logo role: you will inherit an early-stage pipeline across a set of active opportunities and build your own pipeline from the ground up across a portfolio of 30+ target enterprise organisations, with a supported ramp as you establish your territory. **AS AN ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE AT SNOWFLAKE, YOU WILL:** * Own a greenfield territory focused entirely on new business, driving net-new ACV growth by bringing the Snowflake AI Data Cloud to organisations that are new to Snowflake. * Progress and close an inherited set of active, early-stage opportunities while building a healthy, self-generated pipeline. * Lead consistent, high-quality outbound prospecting into Government and State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN), Healthcare and Pharmaceuticals, Manufacturing and Consumer Goods, and Oil and Gas organisations. * Partner closely with Snowflake's local partner and systems integrator ecosystem to co-prospect, co-sell and accelerate greenfield opportunities. * Work hand in hand with Sales Development Representatives to plan account strategies, sequence outreach and convert early interest into qualified pipeline. * Use AI tools, including Snowflake Cortex AI capabilities, to research accounts, prioritise effort and manage your pipeline with discipline and accuracy. * Navigate complex enterprise and public sector buying cycles, including formal BUMN and government procurement processes, from first meeting to signed contract. * Collaborate with Solution Engineers to position Snowflake's platform, including Snowpark, Cortex AI, Snowflake Marketplace and data sharing, against customers' data, analytics and AI priorities. **OUR IDEAL ENTERPRISE ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE WILL HAVE:** * 6+ years of enterprise sales experience in software, cloud or SaaS. We also welcome applicants from strong Commercial or mid-market sales backgrounds who are ready for enterprise scale. * A proven track record of consistently opening multiple net-new enterprise logos each year, with quota achievement driven primarily by new business * Experience selling into Public Sector or State-Owned Enterprises (BUMN) in Indonesia, ideally including hands-on experience with BUMN procurement processes. * Strong, self-sustained outbound prospecting skills, with the ability to create pipeline without relying on inbound lead flow. * The organisation and focus to manage a broad portfolio of 30+ accounts at once. * Resilience and drive to build a territory from the ground up. * Professional fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and English. **BONUS POINTS FOR THE FOLLOWING:** * Sales experience in other complex industries such as Telecommunications or Banking and Financial Services. * Established relationships with local partners, systems integrators or resellers in Indonesia. * Experience selling data platforms, analytics, cloud infrastructure or AI solutions. * Familiarity with structured sales methodologies such as MEDDPICC. **WHY JOIN OUR TEAM AT SNOWFLAKE?** This is a rare opportunity to help shape Snowflake's growth in one of our most important markets. jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Accept Payment
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Accept Payment Job Description We’re hiring Junior Software Engineers (Backend) to join the Accept Payment team at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. We also use AI tools to improve engineering productivity across the development lifecycle. As a junior engineer, you will learn how to collaborate with AI tools while maintaining strong engineering fundamentals such as code quality, testing, and debugging. **About the Accept Payment team** When you shop on an e-commerce platform and proceed to payment, the seamless payment page with multiple payment options is the work of our **Accept Payment team**. Join us to play a pivotal role in building and enhancing our **payment gateway** and **payment page solutions**. These essential features empower merchants and partners to integrate payment flows effortlessly into their applications, ensuring a smooth and efficient experience for their customers. Our work not only simplifies transactions for users but also helps businesses scale with confidence. As a member of this team, you will collaborate with skilled professionals to design, develop, and optimize the payment experience—shaping the future of digital commerce. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia, and our mission is simple: to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Leverage AI-assisted tools (e.g., code assistants, AI copilots) to accelerate development while validating correctness and quality. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language **(Go experience is a strong plus)**. * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Experience using AI tools to assist coding, debugging, or documentation, such as ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar tools. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-1 Job Title Junior Software Engineer (Backend) - Core Job Description We’re hiring **Junior Software Engineers (Backend)** to join the **Core Payment Platform team** at Flip. If you’re passionate about building reliable systems, eager to learn, and excited to work on products that impact millions of Indonesians, this is your chance. **About Core Payment Platform** As part of the Payment Platform group, our team builds and maintains the critical services that power Flip’s ecosystem. We run over 20 projects that are essential for all business verticals, from money transfers to financial products. Our current mission is to break down Flip’s monolith service and set new engineering standards across the company. This is a rare opportunity to work on systems at scale, while learning modern backend practices in a supportive environment. We primarily use **Go** for our backend services, with **PostgreSQL** and **Redis** as our main data stores. Depending on the project, we use a mix of in-house tools and **Google Cloud Platform** services. **About Flip** Flip was founded in 2015 by three friends from Universitas Indonesia — Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar — with the goal of making money transfers fairer for Indonesians. Today, millions of individuals and businesses trust Flip to send trillions of rupiah across banks every year. We’re backed by leading investors such as **Sequoia India, Insight Partners, and Insignia**, and our mission is simple: **to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world.** At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you’ll do** * Work with senior engineers to build and maintain backend services used across Flip’s ecosystem. * Write clear, tested, and efficient code, mainly in Go. * Review and learn from code written by peers and provide constructive feedback. * Collaborate cross-functionally with product managers, designers, and other engineers to deliver reliable features. * Help troubleshoot and resolve production issues under guidance. **What you’ll need** * Basic programming experience in any backend language (Go experience is a strong plus). * Understanding of core computer science concepts: data structures, algorithms, OOP, and clean code principles. * Willingness to learn new tools and technologies quickly. * Good problem-solving mindset and eagerness to grow. * Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate in a team. * Alignment with Flip’s values of fairness, respect, and continuous learning. **Why join Flip?** * Learn directly from experienced engineers working on large-scale systems. * Be part of a mission-driven company making finance fairer in Indonesia. * Grow your career in a supportive and collaborative environment. * Enjoy fair rewards, clear goals, and recognition for your contributions.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java]
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - E-Money [Go/Java] Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About E-Money** As part of Flip's Consumer Solutions group, you will be the go-to person to work on our e-money part, mainly the Flip Saldo feature. You will be working with a cross-functional team to answer various business questions e.g. increasing the number of transacting users with Flip Saldo. You will be utilizing different tech stacks for various use cases, such as Java (for E-Money core system), Go (cash top-up feature in one of the top Indonesian retailers), and PHP to a certain use case (integration with monolithic system). **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Design, Operations, and Backend teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, concise, performant, tested, and easily understood by others. * Partner with the product management team to execute the feature roadmap. * Work with the overall backend teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Help debug production issues across services and levels of the stack. **What you'll need** * Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions. * Experience working with payment and/or accounting system is preferrable. * Knowledge and experience in Java and Go, PHP Yii2 experience is a plus. * Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability. * Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Kualifikasi:** 1. Pendidikan & Pengalaman minimal lulusan D3/S1 di bidang Informatika, Sistem Informasi, atau terkait. 2. Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1–2 tahun di bidang Frontend Development (fresh graduate dengan portofolio akan dipertimbangkan). 3. Menguasai HTML5, CSS3, dan JavaScript (ES6+). 4. Memahami framework/library modern seperti React.js, Vue.js, atau Angular (lebih diprioritaskan). 5. Terbiasa menggunakan CSS framework (Tailwind, Bootstrap, Material UI). 6. Memahami responsive design dan cross-browser compatibility. 7. Familiar dengan REST API / GraphQL. 8. Memiliki pengetahuan dasar tentang version control (Git/GitHub/GitLab). 9. Kemampuan problem solving dan detail-oriented. 10. Mampu bekerja dalam tim maupun individu. 11. Komunikasi yang baik dengan tim backend, UI/UX, dan QA. 12. Adaptif dengan teknologi baru. 13. Bekerja sama dengan tim desain untuk menerjemahkan mockup/wireframe menjadi tampilan nyata. 6. Melakukan testing & debugging pada bagian frontend. 7. Mengikuti perkembangan teknologi frontend terbaru dan menerapkannya sesuai kebutuhan. 8. Membuat dokumentasi teknis terkait pengembangan frontend. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Senior Front-End Engineer (React)
jobs.descriptionHtml: At Provido, we’re more than a technology company. We are a global hub of innovation, creativity, and engineering excellence. Our teams design and deliver intelligent, secure, and high-performance digital solutions that help organizations modernize operations, scale their platforms, and succeed in an increasingly digital world. As part of a dynamic international ecosystem, we bring together forward-thinking engineers, technology specialists, designers, and delivery professionals who transform ideas into scalable, real-world solutions with measurable business impact. If you are motivated by challenge, inspired by technology, and ready to grow with a company that truly invests in its people, your journey starts here. **Why We Need You** We are looking for a talented and experienced English speaking Senior Front-End Developer to join our Jakarta team in a hybrid work arrangement. You will lead and develop high-performance, visually polished, and accessible web experiences. You will be a technical leader within our development team, making architecture decisions, driving code quality, and mentoring junior developers while delivering complex features across our digital products, and play a key role in driving the adoption of AI-assisted development practices, leading the effective use of AI-enabled engineering tool solutions to improve developer productivity, code quality, test coverage, and delivery velocity. **What You’ll Be Doing** * Front-End Development - Architect and build scalable, maintainable, responsive front-end solutions using React and TypeScript, following modern React architecture, coding standards, and development best practices. * Performance Optimization - Optimize for Core Web Vitals, lazy loading, code splitting, and fast load times to deliver a smooth user experience at scale. * Component Libraries - Design and maintain reusable component libraries and contribute to the front-end design system, ensuring consistency and efficiency across products. * API Integration - Integrate with RESTful APIs and backend services; handle real-time data via WebSockets or Server-Sent Events. * Code Quality - Write clean, testable code; conduct code reviews and uphold engineering standards using ESLint, Prettier, and automated testing frameworks. * AI-Enabled Development Practices - Lead effective use of AI-assisted development tools to improve team productivity, code quality, test coverage, and delivery velocity while ensuring security, maintainability, and architectural standards are upheld. * Mentorship - Guide and mentor junior and mid-level front-end developers; contribute to technical decisions and front-end strategy. * Collaboration - Work closely with UX/UI designers, back-end developers, QAs, and product managers in an Agile environment to deliver features end-to-end. **What You Bring to the Team** * 5+ years of front-end development experience, including 2+ years in a senior role * Expert proficiency in React and TypeScript, with proven experience designing and developing scalable, enterprise-grade applications * Strong understanding of browser rendering, performance optimisation, and Core Web Vitals * Strong knowledge of modern react state management (Context API, Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query/TanStack Query), HTML5, CSS3/SCSS, responsive design, accessibility (WCAG), and modern CSS architecture. * Strong knowledge of SCSS/Sass, MaterialUI and Tailwind * Experience with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and modern front-end build tooling (Vite, Webpack, npm, esbuild) * Experience working with modern React ecosystem tools such as React Router, Storybook, and Playwright. * Excellent problem-solving skills and strong communication with cross-functional teams * Experience working with AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor, ChatGPT, Claude or similar platforms is highly desirable. * Professional proficiency in English is required. **Preferred Skills** * Experience in Agency and Credit ...

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Backend) - International Transfer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer-2 Job Title Software Engineer (Backend) - International Transfer Job Description We are looking for Software Engineer (Backend). As a software engineer, you'll be the brain behind crafting, developing, testing, going live, and maintaining the system. You are passionate in understanding the business context for features built to drive better customer experience and adoption. **About International Transfer** In the International Transfer team at Flip.id, you will be part of a dedicated group responsible for building and scaling our cross-border transfer products. While it may look similar to domestic money transfers, international transfers are a completely different business—requiring us to navigate diverse regulatory landscapes, integrate with partners across multiple countries, and handle complex technical requirements to ensure secure, fast, and reliable services. Our mission is to make sending money across borders as simple and trustworthy as sending it domestically. The team is currently undergoing a major transition to a service-oriented architecture, enabling faster development, greater scalability, easier maintainability in delivering new features. **About Flip** Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After nine years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. **What you'll do** * Work cross-functionally with the Product, Business and Engineering teams across the squads to ship world-class products and features. * Write code that's clear, performant, correct, automated tested, and easily understood by others. Develop skills around code modularity and abstraction. * Work with the overall engineering teams to execute the engineering roadmap. * Troubleshoot production issues across services under the team. **What you'll need** * Strong experience in Go. Have experience in PHP (Yii2) is a plus. * Strong coding and problem solving fundamental (includes data structures, algorithms, design patterns, and clean code. * Experience in working with PostgreSQL. Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency system is a plus. * Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with clarity of approach. * Ability to scope, review and refine task for technical completeness and to reduce dependency risk.

jobs.title: Lead (Backend) Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About the GEO Team** ---------------------- GEO stands for Generative Engine Optimization. The GEO team builds products that help multi-location brands understand and improve how they are represented, cited, and recommended across AI-powered search and answer engines such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. We are building backend capabilities that collect and analyse signals from rapidly evolving AI platforms, measure brand visibility, and turn complex data into actionable recommendations for our customers. **About the Role** ------------------ As Backend Engineering Lead for Uberall’s GEO team, you will combine hands-on technical leadership with responsibility for the growth and effectiveness of the engineering team. You will shape the architecture behind our AI-search products, lead the delivery of new capabilities, and help the team navigate a fast-moving and technically ambiguous domain. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and other stakeholders, you will translate customer needs and emerging developments in generative AI into reliable, scalable, and maintainable backend solutions. Historically, our backend has been built on Groovy and Kotlin. Today we work AI-first, and much of our engineering work runs through AI-assisted development. As a result, we place far less weight on a specific stack than we used to. jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/ **About the role** ================== We are looking for a disciplined, highly autonomous Middle Next.js Developer to build and ship product features for one of our core D2C subscription products. You will own features end to end across a TypeScript monorepo — a Next.js App Router client, a Fastify + Payload CMS API on PostgreSQL, and Cloudflare Workers at the edge — from the moment you receive a task, through breaking it down, estimating, implementing, testing, and observability, to a clean release to production and confirmation that it works for real users. This is a hands-on engineering role suited for someone who treats production as the standard, not the finish line. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack Query, Zustand, React Hook Form + Zod, Tailwind CSS, and a React component library such as HeroUI, ...

jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** ============ Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Half-tested code, silent failures, and unverified AI-generated output are not acceptable. The codebase is convention-heavy — a layered Feature-Sliced Design structure with strict import rules — and you are expected to work inside those conventions rather than around them. You are accountable for every task you take on and for every area of the product you touch: if it breaks, regresses, or stays half-finished, that is yours to see through. We expect maximum autonomy and real involvement in the product — you work independently within a sprint, communicate risks before they become blockers, and escalate architectural decisions to senior engineers rather than guessing. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== ### **Feature Development** * Build features across the Next.js client and the Fastify + Payload CMS backend according to product requirements * Write code that follows the team's Feature-Sliced Design layering, naming, and import conventions * Ship changes behind feature flags and A/B experiments, fully localized across every supported locale * Integrate third-party providers — billing, email/CRM, analytics — over REST APIs and webhooks ### **Quality & Reliability** * Cover functionality with unit, integration, and e2e tests at the level the team expects * Run a thorough self-review before code review, and review teammates' code with the same rigour * Fix bugs and perform root-cause analysis for recurring issues * Optimize page and endpoint performance — rendering and caching strategy, database queries, bundle size ### **Security & Observability** * Apply secure development practices: schema validation, access control, safe handling of secrets * Follow observability practices — structured logging, metrics, and alerts — using existing tooling ### **Collaboration** * Break down, estimate, and ship your own tasks to production within the sprint — and stay accountable for them after release * Own the areas of the product you work in: their stability, performance, and follow-up fixes * Surface requirement clarifications, estimate changes, and risks early and in writing * Escalate complex architectural decisions and critical risks to senior engineers **Qualifications** ================== ### **Must-Have Experience** * 2+ years of commercial React experience, including 1+ year with Next.js (App Router, Server Components, route handlers, rendering and caching strategies) and solid TypeScript * Node.js backend experience on a typed HTTP framework (Fastify, Nest, or Express) with PostgreSQL — REST API design, schema migrations, integrations over REST and webhooks (signature verification, idempotency, retries) — plus a working understanding of HTTP/REST, auth mechanisms, and web security fundamentals * Hands-on with the modern client stack: TanStack jobs.descriptionHtml: Surya Digital Teknologi is a digital agency based on Indonesia. We specialise in creating mobile apps, websites, and software solutions including recruitment solution for large, medium, and small businesses. We aim to automate your tasks and help you achieve better results, giving you more time to focus on what matters the most. We take pride in being responsive and reliable. Di peran ini, Anda adalah garda terdepan yang memastikan sistem kami beroperasi secara stabil, aman, dan *high-availability*. Hasil kerja Anda—mulai dari *pipeline* CI/CD, otomatisasi GitOps, hingga *observability stack*—akan menjadi fondasi utama yang diandalkan oleh seluruh tim pengembang kami. **Apa yang akan Anda lakukan:** * Membangun, mengotomatiskan, dan memelihara *pipeline* CI/CD yang cepat, andal, dan terintegrasi dengan kontrol keamanan. * Mengelola dan mengoptimalkan infrastruktur *container* serta orkestrasinya menggunakan Kubernetes dan Helm. * Menerapkan pengelolaan kredensial (*secret management*) dan *security policy* pada jalur rilis untuk mencegah kebocoran data. * Membangun dan mengelola sistem pemantauan (*observability*), pencatatan *log*, serta *distributed tracing* (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, OpenTelemetry). * Mengonfigurasi API Gateway, menyusun kebijakan akses (*access policy*), serta menetapkan *rate limiting* untuk menjaga keamanan dan beban server. **Yang kami cari (Kualifikasi):** * Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun di bidang DevOps, DevSecOps, atau *Site Reliability Engineering* (SRE). * Penguasaan mendalam dalam orkestrasi **Kubernetes** dan pengelolaan **Helm** *charts*. * Menguasai *tooling* CI/CD (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, atau setara) dan pendekatan **GitOps** (ArgoCD atau setara). * *Hands-on* dalam *Secret Management* menggunakan **HashiCorp Vault** (atau setara). * Menguasai *observability stack*: **Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, dan OpenTelemetry**. * Mahir dalam **Docker** beserta penerapan praktik *container security hardening*. **Soft Skill unggulan:** Memiliki kesadaran tinggi bahwa infrastruktur yang dibangun adalah fondasi bagi tim pengembang lain, **tetap tenang dan taktis saat menangani insiden di bawah tekanan**, serta memiliki dorongan alami untuk selalu mendokumentasikan dan mengotomatiskan pekerjaan yang berulang. Snyk) ke dalam *pipeline*. * Pengalaman kerja di lingkungan IT Consulting atau *System Integrator*. **Skema Bekerja:** **On-Site** **(Work From Office)** -- Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Bogor Regency. **Kenapa MCD?** Kami adalah tim berbudaya kinerja tinggi **GROWTH** — *Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony*. Di sini, tim didorong untuk bereksperimen, selalu mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital adalah pemberi kerja yang berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan. Seluruh kandidat dinilai berdasarkan kompetensi dan kesesuaian dengan peran. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **OWM Group** **Ltd** is a forward-thinking technology group comprising several innovative companies, including **OpenWeather Ltd** and **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, all headquartered in the iconic Gherkin, one of London’s most recognised business centres. **OpenWeather** is a technologically innovative company that specialises in the development of intelligent environmental data products. The UK-based company has been operating on the market for a decade, adhering to its mission to provide high-quality data and analytical products that assist customers in transforming their businesses for the better. The organisation is proficient in the practical applications of artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and information technology (IT) in the context of environmental data. We are currently providing services to over 9 million consumers worldwide, with over 2 billion forecasts generated daily, and 5 PB of environmental data. **Ulla** **Technology Ltd**, our AI-powered assistant platform, is the latest addition to the group and is experiencing rapid growth. Ulla represents the future of AI-led business support, and we are just getting started. Both products run on infrastructure we build and operate ourselves, mostly on bare metal. That’s where you come in. We’re growing and looking for a DevOps Engineer who enjoys running real infrastructure on real hardware. You’ll have genuine ownership and a real say in how we work, and you’ll join a team that values automation over manual work. **What you’ll do** * Run the fleet: deploy, maintain and operate Linux servers, mostly bare-metal, with automation and security built in from the start. * Keep services up: own internal and external services from deployment through day-to-day uptime. * Share on-call: take part in a rotating on-call schedule. * Handle incidents: join incident response and lead root cause analysis. * Work across teams: partner with engineering teams to deliver infrastructure and keep services available. * Build what’s next: contribute to infrastructure and security projects. **What you bring** * 3+ years of Linux administration. * A solid understanding of network services (DNS, VPN, firewalls) and the TCP/IP stack. * Confidence with Docker / docker-compose, Ansible and GitLab CI. * An automation-first mindset and the scripting skills to back it up. **Nice to have experience** * Running Kubernetes in production. * Applying SRE practices. * Operating high-load systems. **Why Join OWM Group** **Ltd?** ● Be part of a global company providing weather services to millions of customers. ● Collaborate with a team of talented professionals dedicated to pushing the boundaries of weather prediction. ● Opportunities for professional growth and development. ● Flexible working schedule ● Annual performance bonus. ● 25 days of annual leave + 8 UK bank holidays. **OWM Group** **Ltd** is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **This role is open only to candidates currently based in Thailand or Indonesia, with a hybrid arrangement in Bangkok and a remote arrangement in Indonesia.** Cube is looking for a DevOps Engineer / Cloud Engineer who is keen to learn and help us maintain and operate the cloud infrastructure and delivery pipelines behind our products. You will work closely with the Senior Infrastructure team, Software Engineering and Data Engineering teams to support secure, reliable, and cost-efficient infrastructure while helping our engineering teams deliver software, data pipelines smoothly and improve operational practices. jobs.title: Commercial Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Overview: The Commercial Data Engineer is responsible for building and maintaining scalable data pipelines and platforms that enable commercial reporting, analytics, forecasting, and business decision-making. This role integrates data from multiple sources to deliver reliable, high-quality datasets for Sales, Commercial Analytics, Revenue Management, Category Management, and Supply Chain teams. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the role ensures data availability, quality, and performance to support commercial growth and data-driven initiatives. Responsibilities: * Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines to support commercial reporting, analytics, forecasting, and business intelligence. * Integrate data from multiple sources, including distributor systems, point-of-sale (POS), ERP systems such as SAP, CRM platforms, shipment records, customer master data, and syndicated market data. * Build and maintain ETL/ELT workflows, data models, and datasets to support sales performance reporting, market share analysis, revenue growth management, trade promotion analytics, customer performance, and demand forecasting. * Implement automated data validation, monitoring, reconciliation, and alerting processes to ensure data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and reliability. * Develop and optimize data warehouse and data lake solutions to support scalable data processing and analytics requirements. * Deliver reliable and optimized datasets for Power BI, Tableau, and other reporting and visualization tools. Qualifications: * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, Analytics, or a related field. * 3–5 years of experience in Data Engineering, Analytics Engineering, or Business Intelligence, with hands-on experience in data pipeline development. * Strong SQL development skills and experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines. * Solid understanding of data warehousing, data modeling, and data integration concepts. * Experience with cloud-based data platforms and modern data infrastructure. * Familiarity with data visualization tools such as Power BI or Tableau and the ability to support analytics and reporting requirements. * Experience implementing data quality checks, monitoring, and governance practices.

jobs.title: Data Center Engineer Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml: The Lead Engineer is responsible for supervising daily engineering operations and maintenance activities within the data center facility. This role ensures the reliability, availability, and efficiency of critical infrastructure systems, including electrical, mechanical, HVAC, and fire protection systems. The Lead Engineer also leads engineering technicians, coordinates preventive and corrective maintenance, and ensures compliance with safety standards, operational procedures, and service-level requirements. **Key Responsibilities** 1. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Tiered Approach** In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby: * **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026. * **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments * **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers * **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply. **Background** UNDP is the United Nations’ lead agency on international development, working in 170 countries and territories to help people build better lives while protecting the planet. For 60 years, UNDP has supported countries to make progress on the issues that matter most, with human development at the core of its mandate. Our work is built on trust and long-term partnerships with governments, communities and organizations at every level. UNDP Indonesia works with Indonesian partners to deliver an ambitious programme, fully aligned to the national priorities of Indonesia. The strategic priorities of UNDP Indonesia through its Country Programme 2026 -2030 are encapsulated under three outcome areas: * Human Development * Nature, Decarbonization and Resilience * Economic and Digital Transformation Operating in a Middle-Income Country brings its own set of complexities and opportunities. With 70% of the Indonesian economy directly or indirectly reliant on its natural resources, the link between nature, climate, jobs, and economic empowerment become critical. UNDP’s past experiences and support include innovative sustainable financing, digital health, energy transition and climate policies, improved service delivery that leaves no one behind. Enablers and multipliers such as digitalization and Artificial Intelligence are at the core of its efforts. Building on its vast and long experiences, and the knowledge of its entire team of professionals, UNDP Indonesia demonstrate its thought leadership and translate knowledge into policy advice, investment opportunities and scalable solutions for Indonesia’s critical development priorities Indonesia is one of the world's largest producers of agricultural commodities such as palm oil and cocoa, which are vital to both the national economy and the livelihoods of millions of smallholders. However, unsustainable production practices present challenges related to deforestation, biodiversity loss, and climate change. In response, the Government of Indonesia (GoI) is implementing systemic reforms to transition toward a green economy, promoting agricultural sustainability, landscape restoration, and enhanced smallholder welfare. To support these goals, UNDP Indonesia’s Nature and Low Carbon Development (NLCD) unit manages a growing, interconnected portfolio of sustainable landscape and commodity initiatives, including: * The Forest Agriculture and Sustainable Trade (FAST) Project: The project aims to strengthen sustainable agricultural commodity governance, with a particular focus on palm oil and cocoa, by supporting policy and regulatory improvements, institutional capacity development, sustainability standards and certification systems, and market and trade-related cooperation. jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** Ingin berkarier di dunia **business development, partnership, dan teknologi pendidikan**? Di SEVIMA, kamu akan berperan dalam mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis, membangun strategic partnership, serta mengembangkan relasi dengan institusi pendidikan dan berbagai stakeholder untuk mendukung pertumbuhan bisnis SEVIMA. Posisi ini cocok untuk kamu yang memiliki **business acumen, kemampuan komunikasi yang kuat, analytical thinking, dan ownership tinggi** dalam mengembangkan peluang baru. * Melakukan **market research dan market mapping** untuk mengidentifikasi tren, kebutuhan, kompetitor, serta peluang bisnis baru di sektor pendidikan. * Mengidentifikasi dan melakukan **prospecting** terhadap calon institusi, partner, dan strategic accounts yang potensial. * Membangun dan mengelola **business development pipeline**, mulai dari prospecting, qualification, outreach, pitching, hingga proses negosiasi. * Mengembangkan dan menjaga hubungan dengan **decision maker dan stakeholder** dari institusi pendidikan maupun calon strategic partner. * Menggali kebutuhan dan pain points calon partner untuk mengidentifikasi **business opportunity dan potential value** yang dapat ditawarkan SEVIMA. * Menyusun **business proposal, commercial proposal, partnership deck, dan materi pitching** sesuai kebutuhan calon partner. * Melakukan pendekatan, presentasi, pitching, dan **negosiasi awal** dengan calon partner. * Berkolaborasi dengan tim Product, Marketing, Customer Success, dan tim terkait untuk memastikan peluang partnership dapat dieksekusi dengan baik. * Mengumpulkan dan menganalisis **market feedback, customer insight, dan competitive intelligence** sebagai dasar pengembangan strategi bisnis. * Memantau dan melakukan reporting terhadap **pipeline, conversion, partnership progress, dan pencapaian target bisnis**. * Mengembangkan strategi untuk meningkatkan **akuisisi institusi dan perluasan market SEVIMA**. * Memberikan rekomendasi bisnis berdasarkan hasil analisis market, data pipeline, dan perkembangan industri. * Berkontribusi secara langsung terhadap pencapaian **business growth, partnership, dan/atau revenue target** yang ditetapkan. **Kualifikasi:** ---------------- * Minimal **S1** dari jurusan Manajemen, Bisnis, Marketing, Komunikasi, atau **business acumen** dan mampu mengidentifikasi peluang bisnis dari kebutuhan market. * Terbiasa melakukan **prospecting, lead generation, pitching, negotiation, dan stakeholder management**. * Memiliki kemampuan **analytical thinking** dan market research yang baik. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, presentasi, dan negosiasi yang kuat. * Terbiasa bekerja dengan **target, pipeline, dan KPI**. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Make an impact with NTT DATA** Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive. **Your day at NTT DATA** The HR Administrator has basic administration experience and is required to learn the skills required to support all aspects of human resources operations. maintaining a compliant and efficient HR department. **Key responsibilities:** * Acts as point of contact for HR related queries from employees and external partners. * Organizes and maintains employee records and HR databases. * Provides administrative support for the full recruitment process including sending and draft regret letters. * Liaises with recruitment agencies to set up learnership and graduate programs. * Assists with payroll preparation by providing relevant data, like absences, bonus, and leaves. * Performs any other related task as required. **Knowledge, Skills processes, and documentation. * Time management skills to prioritize tasks, meet deadlines, and handle multiple responsibilities. * Thoroughness in managing HR processes, ensuring data accuracy, documentation quality, and compliance. * Developing written and verbal communication skills to effectively convey HR concepts to diverse audiences. * Ability to support HR projects from inception to completion. **Academic qualifications and certifications:** * High School Certification or related qualification preferred. * Completion or working towards completion of a diploma or degree in a Human Resources field or similar is highly beneficial. **Required experience:** * Basic work experience as an HR administrative assistant or HR administrator. * Basic administrative support experience. * As an independent agent on the ShyftOff platform, you'll have opportunities to help customers answer questions, resolve issues, and deliver exceptional service, all from the comfort of your home.

Compensation: $14–$20 per hour, depending on the program and applicable compensation structure.

 

Why Join ShyftOff?

  • Choose your own schedule: Select available shifts in 30-minute increments. Accept opportunities that fit your life, with no minimum hour commitments.

  • Comfortable navigating multiple computer systems and learning new technology.
  • Modern computer, USB headset, and reliable hard-wired internet connection (25 Mbps minimum).
  • Quiet, professional workspace suitable for customer calls.
  • Ability to complete program-specific qualifications, certifications, and onboarding requirements.

Location: Remote, United States only. Eligibility is limited to ShyftOff-approved states.

 

How to Get Started

  1. Sign up: Create your free ShyftOff account, complete your application, and submit your video interview.

  3. Get qualified: Complete any required program-specific certifications or onboarding.
  4. Choose your shifts: Select available 30-minute shifts that work for your schedule.
  5. Get paid weekly: Earn money by delivering great customer service.

Join 26,000+ agents who have discovered a more flexible way to work. Sign up today at https://app.shyftoff.com/r/QPFQWH

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lemon.io helps companies in the US and Europe hire experienced engineers, from funded startups to teams like Klarna, Retool, and Pinterest. We’ve been doing this since 2015, and more than 1,500 companies have hired engineers through us.

 

New roles for Senior React Full-stack Engineers come in all the time, and several are open right now.

 

Two ways to work with clients

  • Contract: most roles are contract-based. You join the client’s team and work as part of it.
  • Direct hire: some clients hire engineers full-time, and we support you through the process.

 

Because companies trust our vetting, applying through Lemon.io is often a shortcut. You get to the client faster than going through their full hiring process on your own.

 

What you get

  • Competitive rate, based on your seniority and skills
  • We find the projects. No client hunting or rate negotiations. We match you manually based on your skills and preferences.
  • Flexible schedule. Work async or with a small overlap with the team’s hours.
  • No micromanagement, no screen trackers
  • Direct work with clients, most of them with technical backgrounds
  • Ongoing support from your application through every project, plus a community of engineers from 75+ countries

 

Who we’re looking for

Senior React & Python Developers with:

 

  • 5+ years of software development experience.

Commercial experience:

  • React.js 3+ years & Python 3+ years

    OR
    React.js 2+ years & Python 5+ years
    OR
    React.js 5+ years & Python 2+ years

  • Experience with AWS, GCP, or Azure is required.

 

Other requirements:

  • You own problems end-to-end: you spot the issue, design and build the solution, and ship it to production
  • You can show the business impact of your work with concrete results (e.g., faster processing, lower costs, more users, fewer incidents)
  • Advanced English: you discuss business tasks, explain your decisions, raise issues early, and present yourself and your results well on client calls
  • You work full-time remotely and deliver without supervision
  • You onboard quickly and start shipping in your first weeks

 

How it works

  1. Apply and complete your profile
  2. Verify your role
  3. Once approved, we match you with a project. Typical time to first project: 3 weeks

 

Ready? Apply!

CT Marketing Agency is seeking skilled Freelance Copywriters to write high-quality, SEO-driven content for eCommerce and lead generation websites. This is a freelance, project-based writing role.

 

The ideal candidate has excellent English writing skills, strong research ability, and experience writing content that follows detailed, client-specific guidelines. Projects commonly include category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, SEO landing pages, and website copy.

 

About the Role

Our client base is constantly evolving, and writers may create content across a wide range of industries, including:

  • Fashion, including mass-market and luxury brands
  • Skincare and beauty
  • Tech and software
  • Finance and investing
  • Law, including family law, divorce, and product liability
  • Education
  • Home improvement
  • Automobiles and motorcycles
  • Health and wellness
  • Medical and clinical fields
  • Digital marketing
  • SEO, PR, advertising, and marketing

Writers with experience in highly specialized industries such as tech, finance, law, health, medical, SEO, PR, advertising, or marketing are strongly encouraged to apply.

Responsibilities
  • Write clear, engaging, SEO-friendly content for eCommerce and lead generation websites
  • Create category pages, product descriptions, blog posts, landing pages, and website copy
  • Research client industries, products, services, audiences, and competitors
  • Follow detailed client guidelines and adapt to different brand voices
  • Blend SEO best practices with brand priorities and conversion-focused writing
  • Complete assignments by deadline and communicate professionally with the team

Qualifications
  • Excellent English writing, grammar, editing, and proofreading skills
  • 2 to 4 years of professional, non-academic writing experience preferred
  • Strong understanding of SEO writing best practices
  • Ability to research unfamiliar industries and technical topics
  • Ability to write creative, engaging, accurate, and ROI-focused content
  • Portfolio featuring published work preferred
  • Experience in specialized industries strongly preferred

Compensation

Writers are paid on a per-word basis. Rates are assessed according to our KPI rubric.

Initial compensation is up to $0.06 per word, with $0.034 per word being the most typical rate

This equals approximately $30 or $17 per 500-word page

After 400 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.064 per word, with $0.038 per word being the most typical rate

After 800 live pages, the top rate increases to $0.07 per word, with $0.044 per word being the most typical rate

 

Application Process

Candidates should be prepared to provide a portfolio featuring published work. Once an offer is extended, writers will complete a brief training course.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, AI Coding Tasks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're looking for experienced software engineers to build AI coding tasks from a codebase they know well. US$1,000 per task, and you can do as many tasks as you want.

 

You turn a real change from a repository you know into a task that today's best AI coding models struggle with: hard for the models, but fair for a skilled engineer. Your tasks are used to measure and train AI coding models.

 

Remote, any location. US$1,000 per task that passes review. Minimum of one task a week, about 10 hours a week.

 

How it works

 

  1. Apply. Complete a short screener interview and upload your resume.
  2. Propose. Once you're selected, pick a change from a repository you know and submit a short proposal. We approve it or suggest a better candidate.
  3. Build. In our platform, set up the repository as it was before the change, then write the brief, the correct solution and the grading checks.
  4. Stress-test. Try lazy, incorrect and shortcut solutions and make sure your checks catch them.
  5. Model testing. Run your task against leading AI models until strong models often fail but a skilled engineer can clearly solve it.
  6. Review. A reviewer checks your task and you revise it. Most tasks take more than one round.
  7. Next task. Once your task is accepted, start another.

 

Requirements

 

  • 2+ years of professional software engineering
  • Code merged into a public open-source repository, ideally one you know well. A private codebase you own may also qualify (not employer or client code)
  • Strong in at least one of Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, Java or C++
  • Solid with Docker, Linux, Git and automated testing
  • Regular use of an AI coding tool
  • Experience writing tests, rubrics or evaluation criteria, ideally for AI models
  • You can explain a change clearly and concisely, in your own words
  • At least 10 hours a week, starting now
  • A secure personal or work computer (no public or shared machines)

 

Nice to have

 

  • Deep expertise in one area, such as databases, compilers, distributed systems, security or infrastructure
  • Experience building agent tasks or RL environments

 

Terms

 

  • US$1,000 for each task that passes our quality review, paid directly to you
  • Once your proposal is qualified, you sign Askable's contract and accept its terms
  • The work is used for AI training. The change and your solution must be your own, and you must be free to license them to us
  • Don't publish the work anywhere: no public pull request or public fork

 

Apply at https://www.askable.com/experts/roles/senior-software-engineer

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Inference Performance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Tensordyne 

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

The role

You'll build the software stack that takes a model from code down to the hardware: the abstractions, kernels, libraries, and tools that engineers and agents use to reach peak performance. Help optimize the latest AI models on our silicon.

Our hardware is designed to be straightforward to program, so the goal is not to hide it. The goal is to expose the right level of control at each layer, from our compiler-driven Python SDK to our low-level Rust programming stack, and to make every performance gap measurable and every fix permanent.

We're looking for a builder who understands hardware deeply and develops with agents by default. You'll own substantial parts of one of these layers and work closely with engineers across models, compilers, runtime, and hardware. Your focus is performance: where cycles, bandwidth, and communication go, and how to win them back. Number formats and model accuracy are owned by our conversion and emulation team; you'll partner with them where precision and speed meet.

What you'll do

  • Build the stack. Design APIs, kernel abstractions, and libraries in our Python SDK or Rust stack so model engineers and agents can reach high performance at the layer that fits their problem.
  • Make models fast. Take priority workloads, from LLMs to multimodal models, to peak performance on real silicon. Profile, find the bottleneck across kernels, compiler, runtime, and parallelism, and fix it at the right layer.
  • Close the gap between model and measurement. Compare measured performance against analytical models and simulation. Explain every material gap, and turn the explanation into a fix or a better model.
  • Build the agentic performance loop. Give agents the profilers, traces, counters, and benchmark harnesses to form a hypothesis, change code, and measure the result in minutes. Make the results trustworthy enough to act on.
  • Set the bar for performance. Define how we measure, track regressions, and report results.
  • Build for the next chip. Design abstractions that carry forward to future hardware generations. Work with hardware architects to test how architectural choices affect real workloads.

What we need from you

  • You understand hardware performance. You've optimized AI workloads on GPUs or custom accelerators and can reason about compute utilization, memory hierarchy, latency hiding, synchronizatio...

- Team Culture: We believe work should be enjoyable, fostering a spirit of inspiration, celebration, and teamwork across the globe.

- Entrepreneurial Spirit: We embrace change, think big, and push limits with passion.

Über Munich Electrification

Munich Electrification ist ein innovatives Unternehmen, das mit dem Ziel gegründet wurde, den Übergang zur elektrischen und vernetzten Mobilität zu beschleunigen. Wir entwickeln innovative elektronische Steuergeräte für Elektrofahrzeuge und stationäre Speichersysteme für unsere Kunden weltweit. jobs.title: Data Analyst Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
HEY THERE!

Ready to put our brand in front of millions of people worldwide? We’re looking for a Data Analyst, Marketing to turn raw campaign and engagement data into decisions — telling us which channels, markets, and customers to target next.

This isn’t a dashboard-building role. You’ll build robust data products, of course — but the real impact comes from the reporting and insight you deliver, and the incremental value that creates for the marketing team.

Let’s shape the future of nutrition together and make Yazio the most successful nutrition app worldwide!

This role is 100% remote and open to candidates based in Germany, Spain, Portugal, or the U.K.

YOUR MISSION

  • Show our Performance Marketing team which campaigns to double down on — and which to scale back.

  • Partner with our CRM team to learn what messaging resonates with each user segment, then run experiments to measure the uplift.

  • Own the data transformation process, from raw channel and MMP data to curated, ready-to-use datasets in our self-service BI tool.

  • Define requirements with Data Engineering to ingest new data sources.

  • Work with the Analytics team to build a data-driven culture across Yazio.

YOUR PROFILE

  • Hands-on experience with performance marketing data for a native mobile app, covering channel-level or MMP data (ideally both).

  • Solid grasp of attribution, incrementality, funnel and cohort analysis, plus marketing performance metrics like iROAS and CAC.

  • High proficiency in SQL and working knowledge of Python.

  • Solid experience in either analytics engineering (e.g., using dbt to transform data) or data science (e.g., geo-lift tests, holdout tests, A/B tests, media mix modeling). You don’t need both, but you should be strong in one.

OUR CORE TECH STACK

We use:

  • Snowflake as our core Analytics data warehouse.

  • dbt & Dagster to transform & orchestrate our data.

  • Growthbook to power experimentation.

  • Omni to provide self-service analytics.

  • Prefect to handle our ML workflows.

WHY US?

  • An exciting product with millions of users in over 150 countries, driven by our mission to transform the world through healthy eating

  • A remote-first setup: work 100% from home, join a co-working space or work abroad for several weeks per year

  • 30 vacation days to relax and recharge, plus 5 child sick days if your little one needs you

  • A focus-driven culture that values efficiency over long hours — no overtime expectations, and if it happens, you get that time back!

  • A high-impact environment where your work drives real change — short decision-making processes and no micromanagement

jobs.descriptionHtml:
HEY THERE

Yazio is one of the most popular nutrition apps in the world, helping millions of people lead healthier lives through intuitive calorie tracking, thousands of delicious recipes, personalized fasting plans and seamless integration with popular fitness trackers.

We’re looking for a Senior Mobile Platform Engineer (iOS) to join our Mobile Platform Team. If you’re an experienced iOS engineer who wants to enable others by tackling tooling challenges, architectural improvements, optimizing CI/CD pipelines and collaborating across squads—this is your chance to make a big impact.

This is a full-time, 100% remote position. You can be based in Germany, Spain, Portugal or the U.K.

  • You have a strong quality mindset and are committed to engineering excellence, both in your own work and across the teams you support

jobs.title: Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) – Python & IoT Edge
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Parking without barriers, tickets or queues. Wemolo builds its own hardware and its own AI to make that happen. More than 7,000 of our scanners run on around 4,000 parking sites across Europe and have processed over 1.3 billion parking events: unattended, outdoors, around the clock.

As Senior Linux Application Engineer (all genders) in our IoT team, you build the software foundation for all our Linux-based devices, on ARM and x86. At its core is a platform layer that unifies shared components such as health monitoring and logging. Every device type then works the same way, and product features build on one solid base.

The role combines architecture and hands-on engineering: clean, object-oriented software, plus ownership of how it is built, deployed, updated and monitored across the fleet. Your code sits close to the hardware but runs on top of Linux.

Kernel development and microcontroller firmware are not part of the job. If well-designed software for Linux devices is your thing, you’ll feel at home here.

As we are looking for a hands-on developer, a live coding session is an integral part of our interview process.

What to expect

  • Unified platform layer: Design and build a platform layer that covers all our device types, both ARM and x86. It provides shared components such as health monitoring, logging, configuration, OTA updates and hardware abstraction.

  • Software architecture: Define clear interfaces between the platform and the applications on top of it. Consolidate the codebase so that new device types and components plug in easily.

  • Application development: Build Python services on top of the platform, inside our dockerized main application.

  • Device integration: Connect peripherals such as modems, watchdogs, cameras and AI accelerators through existing drivers, SDKs and Linux interfaces, behind a clean hardware abstraction.

  • Reliability and observability: Make our fleet secure, resilient and transparent through OTA updates, networking, inter-process communication and fleet-wide monitoring of device health.

  • Debugging: Analyze and solve complex issues at application and system level, such as memory leaks, network instability or service failures.

  • Ownership and mentoring: Take end-to-end responsibility, guide other engineers technically, and raise our engineering standards.

Inspire us by

  • Senior software engineering experience: 5+ years of professional software development, with a strong part of it on Linux-based devices or edge systems.

  • Strong OOP skills: Deep experience with object-oriented design in (preferably) Python. Experience in another OOP language such as C++, Java or Rust is a plus.

  • Architecture know-how: You have designed and evolved software architectures, applied design patterns, and made trade-off decisions you can explain clearly. Ideally you have built a platform, framework or shared library that other teams or services build on.
