Technical Skills:
  • Experience in preparing high-quality policy briefs, research papers, and concept notes is required.
  • Experience working with government orders, budgets, and policies is required.
  • Experience with quantitative and qualitative research methodologies, data analysis, and interpretation is required.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools is required.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our client is looking for a Recruiter to identify, attract and qualify talent for their U.S. staffing clients. Their staffing and workforce practice has supported more than 2,000 open positions and has served more than 60 million people since 2001.

This is a full-time, 100% remote role working U.S. business hours (Eastern Time). The Recruiter works the front end of hiring: after submission, the firm's Demand team manages client interviews, feedback, offers and onboarding.

Responsibilities

  • Source and engage candidates on client requisitions, using job boards, LinkedIn, the firm's database, referrals and creative outreach.
  • Interview candidates by phone or video, assessing both soft skills and technical skill alignment.
  • Evaluate technical skills, tools, certifications and functional expertise against each requirement.
  • Advance qualified candidates to client interviews with complete, accurate and compelling submissions.
  • Hold two-way conversations with candidates by text, email or phone, and keep the team informed.
  • Keep candidate records accurate and current in the ATS, working within the firm's internal platform and tools such as Deel, TNS ATS, LinkedIn and Indeed.
  • Work toward weekly targets of about 20 interviews, 15 submissions and 50 two-way candidate conversations.

Requirements

  • Staffing industry experience in a production-driven recruiting environment.
  • At least 2 years supporting U.S. clients in the current or most recent role.
  • Experience recruiting IT, engineering or professional services talent.
  • Fluent English, with strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Confident using ATS platforms, sourcing tools and AI.

Qualifications

  • Recent staffing agency recruiting experience, ideally with alignment in healthcare, IT, engineering or professional services staffing.
  • Technical recruiting and strong Boolean sourcing skills (strongly preferred).

Soft skills

  • Proactive go-getter who thrives in a fast-paced, performance-driven environment.
  • Warm and personable, with the ability to build trust with candidates quickly.
  • Highly goal driven, and energized by performance tracking that is highly visible.

Benefits

  • Full time, 100% remote.
  • Protected recruiting time, focused on sourcing, attracting and interviewing.
  • Transparent scorecards, so success is always clear.
  • Specialized desks that build deep expertise and strong talent networks.

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.

Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.

Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.2B from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.

We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

Position Summary

MAG Aerospace is recruiting for a Senior Network Engineer who will Architect and manage secure, scalable enterprise network infrastructure that connects business operations across cloud and on-premises environments. You'll design robust network solutions that ensure seamless connectivity, security, and performance while supporting digital transformation initiatives and multi-tenant secure environments.

Secondary Responsibilities

  • 7+ years of progressive experience in enterprise network engineering

  • Hands-on experience with enterprise firewalls and security appliances (Fortinet, Cisco ASA/FTD, Palo Alto,etc.)
  • Experience with FortiGate SD-WAN implementation
  • Experience with Cisco Identity Service Engine (ISE)
  • Experience troubleshooting network security protocols (IPSec, SSL/TLS, 802.1X)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field
  • Experience with Cisco enterprise equipment (Catalyst switches, ISR/ASR routers, Wireless LAN Controllers)

  • Understanding of container networking (Kubernetes, Docker)
  • Experience with SD-WAN solutions (Cisco Viptela, Silver Peak, VeloCloud)
  • Familiarity with network monitoring tools (FortiManager, PRTG, Nagios)
  • Experience with secure remote access solutions (VPN, ZTNA)
  • CCNA/CCNP, Azure certifications, or Fortinet NSE certifications

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overall objective: to strengthen the quality, consistency, accessibilityand visibility of the GCF Knuckles Project’s knowledge products andcommunication outputs, so that Project evidence and results reach and areunderstood by their intended audiences.

Specific objectives:

  • Ensure that written outputs of the Project team and partners are clear,accurate, consistent and of publishable standard through technical review,language editing and proofreading.
  • Produce and edit timely, high-quality news, media, technical content andstorytelling content for the ICRAF Sri Lanka country office and Projectchannels.
  • Uphold the Project’s house style, terminology and ethical standards inall written communication.

The Consultant will confirmacceptance and feasibility of the deadline within [one (1)] working day.Products vary in size and complexity; the scope, effort and fee for each areagreed before work starts, using the unit rates in the Consultant’s financialproposal.

  • Country-office media and news: maintain a content calendar for ICRAF SriLanka news; prepare media advisories and releases for approval; compile mediacoverage and clippings; and support engagement with English, Sinhala and Tamilmedia as directed.
  • Translation quality review: where applicable, review Sinhala and Tamiltranslations for accuracy, terminology and consistency with the English source,and coordinate corrections with translators.
  • Fact-checking and verification: verify names, titles, dates, figures,place names, institutional names and quotations, and confirm that necessarypermissions and approvals are obtained.
  • Ethical and inclusive storytelling: ensure informed consent for quotesand images, dignified and non-stereotyped portrayal of communities, andgender-responsive and socially inclusive language.
  • Quality assurance: maintain an editing log, style sheet and glossary;use tracked changes and version control; and provide brief editorial notes toauthors to build writing capacity.
  • Corporate standards and quality: apply the latest Landscape Allianceeditorial and publication guidelines and standards to every deliverable.

jobs.title: Analista de Processos / Projetos e Documentação de TI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Na Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.

Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

Principais responsabilidades

  • Mapear, analisar e documentar processos operacionais e técnicos.
  • Criar e manter fluxogramas, fluxos de trabalho e modelos de processos.
  • Elaborar e atualizar topologias e diagramas técnicos de infraestrutura e soluções de TI.
  • Organizar e manter a documentação técnica das diferentes disciplinas da área.
  • Apoiar a estruturação e o acompanhamento de projetos e iniciativas estratégicas.
  • Transformar conhecimentos técnicos em documentação clara, padronizada e institucional.
  • identificar lacunas, redundâncias, riscos e oportunidades de melhoria nos processos.
  • Elaborar e manter a Matriz RACI, registrando responsabilidades, interfaces e pontos de controle.
  • Estruturar indicadores, evidências e informações para apoiar Governança, Auditoria e Compliance.
  • Apoiar a elaboração e o acompanhamento de planos de ação para problemas e não conformidades.
  • Garantir a atualização, organização e gestão de versões das documentações.
  • Trabalhar com especialistas técnicos no registro de arquiteturas, dependências, procedimentos e fluxos.
  • Preparar materiais técnicos e executivos para diversos públicos.

Requisitos e conhecimentos

  • Experiência com mapeamento, análise e documentação de processos.
  • Conhecimento em modelagem de processos e notação BPMN.
  • Habilidade para organizar informações técnicas e convertê-las em documentação objetiva e compreensível.
  • Familiaridade com fluxogramas, fluxos de trabalho e diagramas.
  • Conhecimento ou experiência em ambientes de TI e interação com equipes multidisciplinares.
  • Facilidade para elaborar materiais, registros e apresentações técnicas e executivas.

Ferramentas

  • Jira
  • Microsoft Visio
  • BPMN
  • Bizagi
  • Ferramenta ITSM

Informações adicionais

🍛 Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição;

👨🏼‍🎓 Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

📚 Academia Stefanini — plataforma com cursos on-line, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

🗣 Mentoring;

💉 Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

🏥 Assistência médica;

🦷 Assistência odontológica;

💰 Clube de vantagens e descontos nos melhores estabelecimentos;

🛫 Clube de viagens;

🐶 Convênio para pets.

jobs.title: Engenheiro de Dados e Plataforma de Agentes Sênior (GCP)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A Leega é uma empresa focada no atendimento eficiente e inovador em seus clientes.

Isso não poderia ser diferente com o nosso principal combustível: as pessoas!

Nossa cultura é inspiradora e nossos valores estão presentes no dia a dia: ética e transparência, excelência de qualidade, trabalho em equipe, responsabilidade econômica, social e ambiental, relações humanas e credibilidade.

Buscamos profissionais inovadores que sejam movidos por desafios e focados em resultados.

Se você busca uma empresa dinâmica e parceira e que investe em seus colaboradores através de capacitação constante, a Leega é o lugar para você!

>> A LEEGA É PARA TODOS, ficaremos muito felizes em ter você em nosso time. Venha fazer parte da nossa história e da construção do nosso futuro.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

  • Construir e manter pipelines de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados em batch e streaming com BigQuery, Dataflow, Dataproc, Pub/Sub e Cloud Storage.
  • Modelar e organizar o Data Lake/Lakehouse em BigQuery e BigLake, com camadas, particionamento e otimização de custo e performance.
  • Definir contratos de dados (schemas, freshness e SLAs) e monitorar a qualidade e a linhagem das fontes.
  • Preparar dados para IA: limpeza, anonimização, chunking e geração de embeddings para Vertex AI RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search e vector stores.
  • Garantir conformidade com a LGPD no tratamento de dados sensíveis de saúde, aplicando mascaramento, anonimização (Sensitive Data Protection), policy tags e residência de dados antes que esses dados cheguem aos ambientes de IA.
  • Desenhar acesso a dados entre projetos (Cloud IAM, Dataplex, BigLake, Analytics Hub) evitando cópias, com menor privilégio e trilha de auditoria.
  • Disponibilizar dados e sistemas internos como ferramentas para agentes via servidores MCP e MCP Toolbox, apoiando o time de IA na integração com Vertex AI Agent Engine e Agent Development Kit (ADK).
  • Manter pipelines de MLOps/LLMOps com Vertex AI Pipelines, incluindo avaliação, guardrails (Model Armor) e monitoramento de drift e qualidade das respostas.
  • Provisionar a infraestrutura de dados e IA como código com Terraform e CI/CD, e acompanhar custos por área, projeto e modelo (FinOps) com billing export para BigQuery e labels.
  • Implementar observabilidade ponta a ponta (OpenTelemetry, Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Cloud Trace) e apoiar estratégias de resiliência e disaster recovery.

    Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Domínio de Python e SQL.
  • Experiência sólida em engenharia de dados no GCP: BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow ou Dataproc e Pub/Sub.
  • Experiência com orquestração de pipelines (Cloud Composer/Airflow, Cloud Workflows ou similares).
  • Conhecimento em governança e segurança de dados no GCP: Cloud IAM, Dataplex, policy tags e Cloud KMS.
  • Terraform e CI/CD (Cloud Build, GitHub Actions ou similares).
  • Experiência prática em ambientes GCP com múltiplos projetos, organização e folders.
  • Vivência com sistemas distribuídos e orientados a eventos (filas, retries, idempotência e consistência).
  • Experiência preparando dados para ao menos uma aplicação com LLM em produção (RAG ou agentes com uso de ferramentas).
  • Conhecimento de LGPD aplicada a dados sensíveis, incluindo técnicas de anonimização e mascaramento.

    Diferenciais

  • Vertex AI (RAG Engine, Vertex AI Search, Agent Engine, Pipelines), Gemini e Model Armor.
  • Frameworks de agentes (ADK, LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI) e desenvolvimento de servidores MCP.
  • Vector stores (Vertex AI Vector Search, AlloyDB com pgvector, BigQuery Vector Search); GraphRAG é um plus.
  • Experiência no setor de saúde ou com padrões de dados clínicos (HL7, FHIR, Cloud Healthcare API).
  • Data Mesh, arquitetura hub-and-spoke e FinOps ...

Crum & Forster (C&F) provides market leading property & casualty, accident & health, specialty and standard commercial lines insurance solutions. A true underwriting company, we have a 200-year history of helping our customers manage risk with laser-focused expertise, integrity and discipline. Our people are empowered to make decisions and problem-solve with you smartly and swiftly. Our annual gross written premium is 6.2 billion. C&F enjoys a financial strength rating of "A+" (Superior) by AM Best.

Our most valuable asset is our people. We have 3000 employees, and locations throughout the United States and India. C&F is part of Fairfax Financial Holdings. For more information about C&F, please visit our website: www.cfins.com

jobs.title: AI Product Manager - Gen AI | Produtos Core
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Se você tem paixão por inovação e busca trabalhar em um ambiente ágil, colaborativo e desafiador, esta pode ser a sua oportunidade!

O Product Manager no Asaas desempenha um papel fundamental ao alinhar as necessidades dos clientes com os objetivos estratégicos do negócio e do mercado. Sua principal missão será liderar a squad responsável por soluções de Inteligência Artificial aplicadas ao nosso time de Produto, em especial aos produtos core do Asaas, com foco em automação, personalização e eficiência operacional.

Essa posição oferece um alto nível de impacto e inovação, pois você estará à frente da exploração e aplicação de IA generativa e preditiva para melhorar a experiência do cliente, aumentar a escalabilidade das operações e desenvolver novos recursos de valor agregado na nossa plataforma.

Você trabalhará de forma cross e em estreita colaboração com os times de Produto, Engenharia, Dados, Design e Riscos, em um ambiente orientado à experimentação e entrega contínua.

Se interessou pela oportunidade mas não reside em Joinville? Não tem problema, possibilitamos o trabalho remoto/home office.

  • Identificar e gerir oportunidades para uso de IA Generativa que tragam valor real aos nossos clientes e ao negócio, como automações, insights, personalização de jornada ou aumento de eficiência;
  • Liderar iniciativas de alto impacto na experiência final do cliente;
  • Evoluir, junto com time de Engenharia e Data&AI, a plataforma de IA Generativa para que produtos financeiros core possam evoluir seus casos de uso;
  • Realizar o Enablement (Awareness & Education) de PMs pares e squad cross jornada para a evolução de casos de uso dos produtos core da plataforma;
  • Definir e evoluir a visão de produto em IA Generativa nos produtos financeiros core da plataforma, em sinergia com outras squads e áreas da empresa;
  • Trabalhar com dados e métricas para tomar decisões, validar hipóteses e medir o impacto de soluções baseadas em IA;
  • Garantir que soluções baseadas em IA sigam os princípios de ética, segurança, transparência e conformidade regulatória;
  • Comunicar de forma clara os objetivos, aprendizados e resultados das iniciativas para stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Ser guiado pelo desenvolvimento constante, saindo da zona de conforto;
  • Retirar obstáculos e entregar grandes projetos em pequenas partes coerentes e de alto valor;
  • Ser capaz de identificar oportunidades para impulsionar o engajamento e conversão por meio de melhorias estratégicas nas jornadas do produto;
  • Assegurar que todas as áreas da empresa sejam consultadas ou informadas quando necessário, sobre alterações no produto e também atuar em conjunto com a equipe de marketing na comunicação com o cliente, gerando engajamento.
  • Experiência prévia como Product Manager em produtos digitais (preferencialmente em fintechs ou produtos financeiros);
  • Ter atuado ativamente em produtos em estágios iniciais, “movendo do 0 para 1”;
  • Vivência com produtos, soluções envolvendo Inteligência Artificial, especialmente voltadas à automação, risco, atendimento ou personalização;
  • Vivência com fundamentos de machine learning, IA generativa, LLMs ou modelos preditivos aplicados ao contexto de negócio, permitindo diálogo aprofundado com times de engenharia;
  • Conhecimento em análise de dados e métricas fundamentais de produto;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação verbal e escrita, com capacidade de apresentar informações de maneira clara e concisa para diferentes públicos;
  • Excelentes habilidades de gestão de stakeholders, com capacidade de antecipação de necessidades, gestão de expectativas e governança de ações cross.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Get to know us better

CodiLime is a software and network engineering industry expert and the first-choice service partner for top global networking hardware providers, software providers and telecoms. We create proofs-of-concept, help our clients build new products, nurture existing ones and provide services in production environments. Our clients include both tech startups and big players in various industries and geographic locations (US, Japan, Israel, Europe).

While no longer a startup - we have 250+ people on board and have been operating since 2011 we’ve kept our people-oriented culture. Our values are simple:

  • Act to deliver.

  • Disrupt to grow.

  • Team up to win.

The project and the team

You will join the team behind a leading network source-of-truth (NSoT) platform, used by thousands of organizations - from fast-growing tech companies to Fortune 500 enterprises - to model, document, and automate their network infrastructure.

CodiLime engineers work within the platform's Observability team, which connects the network source of truth with what is actually running on the network. The team builds products for network discovery, network assurance (detecting drift between the intended and the actual state of the network), management of the agents that collect discovery and telemetry data, and a reliable pipeline that ingests this data into the platform.

The platform is built AI-first, with its own Claude Code agent skills and MCP server, and that mindset carries over to how the team works: Claude Code is used heavily day to day to help the team move fast and consistently deliver high-quality results.

In this role, you will build and run the infrastructure and tooling behind the platform's products - from AWS and Kubernetes environments, through CI/CD pipelines, to the observability stack - for both the SaaS and on-premise versions of the platform. The scale is significant: some of the platform's largest customers manage hundreds of thousands of devices across globally distributed environments.

As the observability offering keeps growing, the team is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer who manages infrastructure through code and automation, owns the reliability of what they deploy, and works closely with developers to get code to production.

Technology stack:

  • Cloud: AWS (EC2, VPC, IAM, RDS, EKS)

  • Containerization & orchestration: Kubernetes (EKS), Docker, Docker Compose

  • Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Helm

  • CI/CD: GitHub Actions

  • Observability: Prometheus, Grafana, Mimir, Loki, OpenTelemetry

  • Programming & scripting: Python, Go, shell scripting

  • Data & messaging: PostgreSQL (RDS), event streaming and CDC, RabbitMQ, MQTT

  • Security & compliance: IAM, SOC 2 controls, OAuth2

  • APIs: REST, gRPC

  • AI tooling: Claude Code, MCP servers, Anthropic tooling

What else you should know:

  • Small, cross-functional team with strong ownership of reliability, security and automation

  • The team is distributed across Europe and the US, and we are looking for someone whose working hours can overlap with the US East Coast

  • AI tools are part of the daily workflow - Claude Code is used heavily across the team

  • This is an infrastructure-focused role, working closely with the product teams to connect code to production

  • Startup-like vibe: proactive, ownership-driven, fast-paced

We work on multiple interesting projects at a time, so it may happen that we’ll invite you to an interview for another project...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
For 30 years, Surgical Information Systems (SIS) has empowered surgical providers to Operate Smart™ by delivering innovative software and services that drive clinical, financial, and operational success.

SIS provides comprehensive technology and services for ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs), including practice management software, electronic health records (EHRs), patient engagement solutions, compliance technology, and revenue cycle management services. SIS also supports hospital perioperative teams with specialized software solutions.

Trusted by more than 2,900 surgical facilities, SIS is committed to helping healthcare organizations improve efficiency, optimize financial performance, and focus on delivering exceptional patient care.

At SIS, we believe our people drive our success. We foster a culture built on respect, integrity, accountability, client focus, bias for action, and continuous improvement. As a nationally recognized Top Workplace, we strive to provide an environment where employees can contribute, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

The Business Development Representative (BDR) is responsible for generating new business opportunities through targeted outbound sales campaigns and proactive prospect engagement. This role focuses on identifying prospective customers, connecting with key decision-makers, qualifying leads, and developing a consistent pipeline of sales opportunities for SIS software and revenue cycle services.

The BDR will collaborate closely with Sales and Marketing to execute outreach strategies, engage prospective customers, and schedule qualified sales meetings. Success requires strong communication skills, persistence, organization, and the ability to effectively communicate the value of SIS solutions.

Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation

  • Research and identify prospective customers, key decision-makers, and target accounts within the ambulatory surgery center market.
  • Develop personalized messaging that communicates the value of SIS software and revenue cycle services.
  • Conduct consistent follow-up with prospects to build relationships, generate interest, and advance sales conversations.
  • Identify potential customer needs and opportunities aligned with SIS solutions.

Sales Pipeline Development

  • Collaborate with the Sales team to ensure effective handoffs and continued engagement with qualified prospects.
  • Maintain accurate prospect information, activity records, lead status, and pipeline information in Salesforce CRM.
  • Consistently work toward established outbound activity, qualified meeting, and pipeline generation goals.

Campaign Execution & Collaboration

  • Partner with Sales and Marketing to execute outbound campaigns targeting priority customer segments and accounts.
  • Track campaign results and identify opportunities to improve prospect engagement and conversion rates.
  • Develop knowledge of SIS products, services, competitive positioning, and the challenges facing healthcare providers.
  • Share market insights and prospect feedback to support improvements in sales messaging and campaign effectiveness.

Required Qualifications

jobs.title: Closing Specialist - Grid 151
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Summary:

The Closing Specialist is responsible for coordinating real estate closings and managing the full lifecycle of closing transactions. This includes assembling, preparing, reviewing, and verifying loan closing documents while ensuring compliance with all applicable state, federal, and regulatory requirements. This role manages an active pipeline of transactions to ensure files are completed accurately, on time, and in accordance with established service level agreements while delivering high-quality support to clients, lenders, and settlement partners.

Essential Functions:

  • Assemble, prepare, review, and verify all documents required for loan closings, including contracts, settlement statements, closing disclosures, mortgages, deeds, and title policies, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
  • Prepare preliminary and final settlement statements, including Closing Disclosures (CD) and ALTA statements, and manage revisions and approvals as needed.
  • Review and revise closing documents to meet lender requirements, ensuring full compliance with regulatory, investor, and company guidelines prior to transmitting finalized packages to settlement agents.
  • Coordinate the closing process, including scheduling and execution of document signings, while ensuring all required documentation is complete prior to closing.
  • Perform final pre-closing reviews of title fees, taxes, premiums, endorsements, vesting, and all checklist items to ensure readiness for closing.
  • Serve as a liaison between lenders, title companies, borrowers, and settlement agents, maintaining clear and timely communication to ensure expectations and deadlines are met.
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including disbursement and post-closing, to ensure a seamless transition from closing through funding and recording.
  • Support post-closing activities, including revisions to CDs or ALTA statements and overall file completion.
  • Manage an active pipeline of files, prioritizing tasks to meet deadlines and established service level agreements.
  • Provide operational support across all workflow stages, including back-office functions, and assist with coverage needs such as on-call, alternate shifts, and weekend support as required.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned.

Competencies:

  • Capacity to work under pressure and tight deadlines.
  • Capable of generating a high degree of respect and trust to develop, maintain strong relationships with business partners across all levels of stakeholders.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly and concisely present issues, ideas and recommendations in verbal, written and presentation formats.
  • Highly motivated, inquisitive, self-started with the ability to multi-task and effectively manage priorities to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

Education, Formal Training, and Experience:

  • High school diploma or GED required, Baccalaureate degree preferred.
  • 2+ years’ experience with title or closing company preferred.
  • Strong customer service skills required.
  • National title closing experience preferable.

Physical Demands:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to talk or hear, is frequently required to sit, is occasionally required to stand; walk; use hands and fingers to type & reach with hands and arms. FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

Our VIP Corporate Travel Consultants will need to provide a high level of consultation and accuracy during all aspects of the travel experience, including pre-booking consultation, and the reservation process from beginning to end. Candidate must have in-depth travel industry knowledge, exceptional problem-solving skills, while maintaining the highest degree of professionalism and courtesy.

Job Type: Full-time

Location: Remote

The Role

We’re looking for a highly technical, hands-on Director of Engineering to lead the architecture, development, and scalability of the internal platforms powering our operations, data workflows, and business ecosystem.

You’ll own the engineering direction of mission-critical systems while overseeing quality engineering, ensuring our platforms are reliable, scalable, and built for automation.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
At LifeNet Health, as the Donation Coordinator, you will make an impact by leveraging your expertise, collaboration, and commitment to excellence to help advance our mission of Saving Lives, Restoring Health, and Giving Hope. Through your daily work, you will contribute to innovative solutions, operational excellence, and meaningful outcomes that support donors, patients, healthcare providers, and our communities. Whether driving strategic initiatives, improving processes, supporting customers, advancing research, developing talent, or ensuring quality and compliance, your contributions will help strengthen our ability to transform lives and shape the future of regenerative medicine.

WHAT YOU WILL DO
The role evaluates preliminary donor eligibility by reviewing medical records, clinical information, hemodilution assessments, and behavioral risk factors, while coordinating transportation logistics with courier services to ensure timely and accurate tissue shipment and maintaining strong stakeholder communication. It also identifies and processes organ, tissue, and eye referrals to maximize donation opportunities, assesses and triages incoming communications to route urgent needs appropriately, and provides compassionate support to families by advocating for donation, completing authorization documents, and conducting thorough Donor Risk Assessment Interviews.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 3 years work experience as an EMT, Corpsman, ER, RRT, ICU tech or equivalent health care experience or dispatch for emergency services

Pay Transparency Statement
$20.36 - $33.94/hourly

The salary range displayed represents the national base salary range for this position and is provided in good faith to support pay transparency. For positions located in designated higher-cost labor markets, a geographic pay adjustment may apply above the posted range for eligible positions according to LifeNet Health's current policy. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as work location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Total compensation may also include bonuses, benefits, and other rewards that are not reflected in the posted salary range.

LifeNet Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
PcDs são sempre bem-vindas.

Buscamos pessoas apaixonadas por tecnologia. Alguém que se motive por desafios e atue com autonomia. Precisa gostar de trabalhar em equipe e possuir espírito colaborativo.

  • Colaborar com equipes multiculturais para transmitir necessidades técnicas, gerenciar cronogramas e desenvolver e auxiliar na criação de planos de teste para funcionalidades end to end;
  • Criar, implementar e automatizar testes para aplicativos frontend, middle e backend usando arquiteturas e tecnologias avançadas;
  • Testar sistemas no nível do usuário por meios manuais e automatizados;
  • Realizar testes com capacidade de compreender os componentes internos do software, solucionar problemas usando arquivos de log e criar testes automatizados com scripts ou ferramentas de nível de usuário;
  • Comunicar-se frequentemente com os engenheiros de desenvolvimento de software e proprietários de negócios/produtos para compreender as implementações técnicas de recursos;
  • Colaborar com partes interessadas, designers e equipes de atendimento ao cliente para compreender os padrões de uso do cliente e elaborar planos de teste que simulem cenários do mundo real;

  • Experiência com testes manuais para produtos Web;

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

This is a remote role that may be hired in several markets across the US. With preferred locations in New York, NY, San Francisco, CA or Charlotte, NC where the role would be hybrid coming in the office 3 days a week.

The Senior Compliance Officer plays a critical role in supporting and advancing the firm's commercial broker-dealer and investment adviser compliance programs. This position provides compliance leadership across risk assessments, policies and procedures, controls and monitoring, testing, audits, and strategic compliance initiatives. The role serves as a trusted advisor to business leaders, helping the organization navigate complex regulatory requirements while supporting growth, innovation, and new business initiatives.

The successful candidate will bring strong expertise in investment banking compliance, private investment compliance, and/or commercial broker-dealer and investment adviser compliance programs. This individual must possess exceptional analytical and problem-solving capabilities, sound judgment, and the ability to deliver practical, risk-based compliance guidance in a fast-paced and evolving environment.


Responsibilities & Qualifications

Duties & Responsibilities:

Compliance Advisory and Business Partnership

  • Serve as the primary compliance advisor for private investments, private placement engagements, capital raising activities, and related strategic initiatives.
  • Partner closely with business leaders and key stakeholders to support strategic growth opportunities while ensuring activities remain aligned with regulatory obligations and firm standards.
  • Deliver timely, practical, and risk-based compliance guidance that enables informed business decisions and effective resolution of complex compliance matters.
  • Act as a trusted advisor by balancing regulatory expectations with business objectives and operational realities.

Regulatory Risk Management and Transaction Oversight

  • Identify, assess, and escalate conflicts of interest, confidentiality concerns, nonpublic information risks, and other transaction-related compliance issues to the Chief Compliance Officer as appropriate.
  • Review pitchbooks, teasers, management presentations, and other transaction or marketing materials to ensure compliance with applicable regulations and firm policies.
  • Provide compliance oversight of portfolio management activities to help ensure consistency with client mandates, disclosed objectives, contractual requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Oversee compliance reviews involving best execution, trade allocation and aggregation practices, and conflict-of-interest management.

Compliance Program Leadership and Enhancement

  • Maintain and strengthen compliance program policies, procedures, Written Supervisory Procedures, and Codes of Ethics.
  • Evaluate regulatory developments and implement appropriate program enhancements.
  • Assess existing compliance frameworks, identify gaps, and implement scalable control solutions.
  • Lead corrective action initiatives designed to address complex compliance issues and strengthen program effectiveness.

Monitoring, Testing, and Regulatory Examinations

  • Participate in compliance risk assessments and lead monitoring, surveillance, and testing activities.
  • Lead internal compliance testing and audit activities.
  • Support the CCO in regulatory examinations, inquiries, investigations, and other complex regulatory matters.

Strategic Initiatives

  • Contribute to new product and service initiatives and other strategic programs that support organizational growth.
  • Participate in special projects and perform additional responsibilities as assigned.

Job Summary

Create Music Group is seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Legal Intern to join its M&A Legal Group. This unique internship offers a chance to gain hands-on experience in music-related transactions and corporate legal work. The intern will work directly under the guidance of the VP and the Director of M&A Legal Affairs, contributing to a range of strategic initiatives. The role primarily focuses on acquisitions, intellectual property, and corporate compliance, with a particular emphasis on music catalog acquisitions.

This is a part-time, fully remote internship specifically designed for current graduate students for Spring 2027. Candidates must be eligible to work in the U.S. and be available for 15-20 hours per week over a 3-month period.

Responsibilities

  • Assisting in the drafting and review of asset purchase agreements, letters of direction, and other related transactional documents.
  • Conducting legal research and due diligence on potential acquisition targets.
  • Supporting the preparation and submission of copyright registrations with the U.S. Copyright Office.
  • Aiding in the management and maintenance of corporate organizational documents and ensuring ongoing compliance (e.g., filings, entity records, debt compliance).
  • Reviewing and revising non-disclosure agreements (NDAs) with prospective partners and counterparties.
  • Organizing and tracking deal documents and legal correspondence.
  • Collaborating cross-functionally with finance, operations, and A&R teams on various transaction-related tasks.
  • Providing administrative support for ongoing legal projects as assigned by the VP and the Director of M&A Legal Affairs.
  • Opportunities to support additional tasks based on the intern’s interest and availability.

Qualifications

  • Possess a strong interest in M&A, intellectual property, and the music/media industry.
  • Demonstrate excellent legal writing, organizational, and communication skills.
  • Ability to handle confidential information with the utmost discretion.
  • Exhibit a detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative mindset.
  • Prior experience in transactional, corporate, or entertainment law, including previous internships, is considered a plus.

Pay Scale

  • The pay scale for this position is designated as the local hourly minimum wage depending on the candidate’s work location.

Program Details

  • Start Date: Spring 2027 Term
  • Length: 3-4 months
  • Schedule: 10–23 hours per week

jobs.descriptionHtml:
No Grupo Stefanini, acreditamos no poder da colaboração. Co-criamos soluções inovadoras em parceria com nossos clientes, combinando tecnologia de ponta, inteligência artificial e a criatividade humana. Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!

Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!

  • Atuar com processamento e integração de dados utilizando Kafka;
  • Garantir a qualidade, legibilidade, organização e manutenibilidade do código;
  • Participar de revisões de código e contribuir com as boas práticas de engenharia de software.

  • Ensino Superior completo em áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência profissional com desenvolvimento Full Stack;
  • Conhecimento e experiência com Java e Spring Boot;
  • Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST e microsserviços;
  • Conhecimento em Angular, TypeScript, HTML e CSS;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e linguagem SQL;

🐶 Convênio para pets.

Tailored to adventure seekers! Ever thought about combining your interest in working for a global brand and your love for cars with a touch of Mediterranean sunshine? Well, heres your chance! Join our client team in Athens and dive into the world of customer service for a top car manufacturer. As a Norwegian speaker, youll be the hero helping customers with their car-related inquiries and ensuring they have a smooth ride. No worries if you havent done this before well give you all the training you need to succeed. Plus, youll get to explore the stunning beaches and vibrant culture of Athens or Waha after work, no need to be in the office as this is a remote position. Dont wait any longerseize the opportunity today and broaden your horizons in Greece!

And after hours? Picture yourself unwinding on sun-kissed beaches, savoring Mediterranean delights, and basking in endless sunshine! Its no wonder Greece ranks among Europes most sought-after vacation spots.

Whether youre just looking to gain international work experience for a gap year or go further and aim to build a lasting career overseas)

Why not relocate together with some of your friends? We can also assist you with this possibility!

This company is one of the world's leading providers of information and communications technology (ICT) infrastructure, enterprise digital solutions, cloud computing platforms, and smart devices. Established in the late 1980s and headquartered in China, the organization operates across more than 170 countries and is globally recognized for its leadership in telecommunications technology, 5G innovation, artificial intelligence, and enterprise digital transformation.

The company maintains a strong international reputation through continuous investment in advanced technologies including cloud computing, networking infrastructure, enterprise storage, optical transmission, cybersecurity, and intelligent collaboration platforms. Its large-scale R&D ecosystem and commitment to technological innovation position the organization as a strategic technology partner for governments, telecommunications operators, financial institutions, and enterprise clients worldwide.

The Account Manager – FSI is responsible for managing overall business performance, revenue growth, and market penetration across assigned financial institution accounts, including leading private banks and state-owned banks in Indonesia. This role carries full accountability for account strategy development, customer relationship management, project execution, channel collaboration, and achievement of commercial targets across the enterprise ICT portfolio.

jobs.title: Salesforce Solutions Consultant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Salesforce Solutions Consultant

Solutions | United States (Remote) | Full-Time | NAM

Who We Are

Bluprintx (BPX) is a global, AI-powered consultancy built to design and deliver the intelligent front office for CMO and CRO executives. We are private equity-backed and scaling fast, with 300 active customers across 10 countries and more than 1,750 implementations. We connect people, technology, and AI to turn fragmentation into performance, partnering with global leaders to modernize how marketing, CRM, content, AI & Data connect. At BPX, we hire operators and specialists who thrive at the intersection of commercial strategy and technical execution.

What We Do

We help the world's most ambitious companies, including Uber Eats, BNY, and Xerox, untangle the operational complexity that slows enterprise growth. As a Gold Adobe Solution Partner and Salesforce Summit Partner, we deliver strategy and implementation across the full front office. Our proprietary methodology builds sustainable enabled ecosystems that maximize ROI and accelerate speed to market. By embedding AI into commercial workflows, we help clients move faster and stay ahead.

The Role

You'll be the person prospects watch when they want to see Salesforce solve their problem in a live org. In this presales seat you design, build and deliver tailored demonstrations across the Salesforce Core platform, turning what you learn in discovery into a working story inside a live org. A typical week mixes discovery calls, demo builds, RFP responses and deal strategy sessions with our Account Executives. You'll field the hard product, architecture and integration questions in the room, then work with our delivery team so what gets sold is scoped to land. It's a hands-on role for someone who would rather configure the product than talk about it, with occasional travel for customer meetings, demos and team events.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Freight Dispatcher — Freight Evaluation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Learn to Evaluate Freight, Not Just Find It

We are hiring Entry-Level Freight Dispatchers to support U.S. transportation operations with a focus on freight evaluation, load selection, mileage calculations, and operational planning.

This position is entry-level specifically in professional freight dispatching. Previous employment as a freight dispatcher is not required. Applicants must, however, have relevant exposure to U.S. trucking or transportation operations and a working understanding of freight load boards.

The right candidate should understand that a load cannot be evaluated by rate alone. Deadhead, loaded miles, equipment, appointments, driver availability, Hours of Service, and operating requirements all affect whether freight makes sense for a truck.

What You'll Evaluate

  • Search DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable freight load boards.
  • Compare available freight by lane, equipment type, mileage, rate, and appointment requirements.
  • Calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total trip miles, and rate per mile.
  • Identify excessive deadhead and inefficient freight options.
  • Review pickup and delivery schedules for operational feasibility.
  • Consider available driver Hours of Service when evaluating loads.
  • Determine whether available equipment is appropriate for the freight.
  • Identify potential delays, accessorial considerations, and unusual load requirements.
  • Organize suitable freight options for authorized review and booking.

Understanding Freight Economics

Freight evaluation requires looking beyond the advertised load rate.

You will be expected to understand how factors such as:

  • Loaded mileage
  • Deadhead mileage
  • Rate per mile
  • Equipment type
  • Pickup and delivery appointments
  • Driver Hours of Service
  • Freight lanes
  • Driver location and availability
  • Potential detention or other accessorial situations

affect the operational value of a load.

Applicants should be comfortable working with mileage calculations, spreadsheets, freight information, and basic trip economics.

Relevant Transportation Background

Prior professional freight-dispatch employment is not required.

Relevant experience or knowledge may come from:

  • CDL-A truck driving
  • Owner-operator or fleet operations
  • Transportation coordination
  • Truck-driver recruiting with practical trucking knowledge
  • Freight brokerage support
  • Carrier operations
  • Load planning
  • Logistics or transportation operations

Applicants must have enough U.S. trucking knowledge to understand basic freight terminology, equipment, mileage, lanes, and load-board information.

Essential Qualifications

  • Working knowledge of U.S. trucking and transportation operations.
  • Familiarity with freight load boards such as DAT One, Truckstop, or comparable systems.
  • Understanding of common equipment types including Dry Van, Reefer, Flatbed, and Step Deck.
  • Ability to calculate loaded miles, deadhead miles, total miles, and rate per mile.
  • Basic understanding of U.S. freight lanes.
  • Working understanding of driver Hours-of-Service considerations.
  • Strong spoken and written English communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate professionally with drivers, brokers, carriers, and transportation personnel.
  • Strong attention to detail and accurate recordkeeping.
  • Computer proficiency and reliable internet access.
  • Ability to work independently in a remote environment.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Verify freight information before presenting loads for review.
  • Communicate load information accurately...

About Us

Cooper Norcross Health, formerly Cooper University Health Care, is a leading academic health system affiliated with Cooper Medical School of Rowan University. Headquartered in Camden, New Jersey, Cooper Norcross Health has revenues of more than $3 billion and an A+ credit rating from both S&P and Fitch Ratings.

Cooper Norcross Health has nearly 14,000 team members, including more than 2,200 nurses, more than 1,200 employed physicians representing 95 specialties and subspecialties, and more than 700 advanced practice providers.

The health system operates MD Anderson Cancer Center at Cooper as well as four hospitals – its 663-bed flagship Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden, its 229-bed Cooper Norcross University Hospital Cape Regional in Cape May Court House, Children’s Hospital at Cooper Norcross Health in Camden, and The Recovery Village Cherry Hill at Cooper, a substance abuse rehabilitation and inpatient treatment facility, in partnership with Advanced Recovery Systems.

Cooper Norcross University Hospital in Camden is the only Level 1 Trauma Center in South Jersey and the busiest in the region. The hospital has been recognized as a top-performing regional hospital by U.S. News & World Report’s Best Hospitals annual survey for eight years.

More than 2.54 million patients visit Cooper Norcross Health facilities annually. Its ambulatory network encompasses three outpatient surgery centers, seven urgent care centers, a wound care center, and more than 130 physician, physical therapy, and radiology offices extending from the Delaware River to the New Jersey shore.

Cooper Norcross Health, a not-for-profit health system, was named one of America’s Best Large Employers for 2026 by Forbes, ranking among the top 200 in the nation. Visit CooperHealth.org(opens in new window) to learn more.

jobs.title: Communications Lead, Wikimedia Enterprise (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>COMMUNICATIONS LEAD, WIKIMEDIA ENTERPRISE (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Contract terms:</strong> 40 hours/week, initial 6-month contract, with potential to extend based on organizational needs</p> <p><strong>Reports to: </strong>Communications Manager (dotted line to President of Wikimedia Enterprise)</p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is the nonprofit that operates Wikipedia and the other Wikimedia free knowledge projects. Our mission is to bring free educational content to the world.</p> <p>Wikimedia Enterprise is the Wikimedia Foundation's commercial product for large-scale reusers and distributors of Wikimedia content. Through Enterprise agreements, companies gain improved, commercial-grade access to Wikimedia content at a volume and scale they need,  while directly supporting the Wikimedia Foundation's free knowledge mission. As AI systems increasingly scrape Wikipedia at scale, Wikimedia Enterprise has become critical to a sustainable model for Wikimedia projects and the open knowledge ecosystem.</p> <p>We're looking for an experienced communications lead to serve as the primary communications partner to the Wikimedia Enterprise team — shaping external messaging, media relations, and thought leadership to drive organic demand for Wikimedia Enterprise services, while ensuring narrative and strategic alignment with the Foundation's broader communications priorities.  This role sits in the Media Relations team, within the Foundation’s <a href="https://meta.wikimedia.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Foundation/Communications">Communications Department</a>, with a dotted line to the President of Wikimedia Enterprise.</p> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and own the external communications strategy for Wikimedia Enterprise across media/trade press, speaking engagements, and other channels that build visibility and organic demand for Enterprise offerings.</li> <li>Build relationships with reporters (mainstream and B2B tech trade press) and conference organizers to secure speaking opportunities and position Wikimedia Enterprise as the go-to product for commercial content reusers.</li> <li>Serve as a primary media liaison for Wikimedia Enterprise, working with the wider media relations team to manage daily press inquiries, prepping spokespeople/staffing interviews, information requests, and speaking engagement requests in a timely manner. This includes leading rapid response media efforts — triaging sensitive, fast-moving situations with sound judgment.</li> <li>Partner with internal teams to develop narratives and thought leadership that strengthens Wikimedia Enterprise's brand relevance and positioning.</li> <li>Guide, produce, and review marketing and communications materials — press statements, blogs, pitch notes and lists, briefing docs, and more — ensuring key messages about Wikimedia Enterprise are shaped consistently and clearly for public audiences.</li> <li>Coordinate  the end-to-end communications workflow for major external launches and announcements together with the Enterprise Growth team, from drafting through internal review, stakeholder approvals, and release.</li> <li>Ensure alignment between the Wikimedia Enterprise growth plan and the Foundation's annual communications calendar.</li> <li>Build relationships and lead cooperative efforts with internal and external stakeholders — Wikimedia Foundation colleagues, Wikimedia volunteers and affiliates, and external partners — to enable the successful delivery of communications plans.</li> <li>Manage relationships with external vendors (such as PR agencies) as directed to deliver...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>Wikipedia and its sister projects are among the most popular media properties in the world, visited by over 1 billion people a month across over 300 different languages. These sites generate a tremendous amount of data on how people learn and collaborate.  The Wikimedia Foundation is looking for a group product manager to guide the development and evolution of our <a href="https://wikitech.wikimedia.org/wiki/Data_Platform">data platforms</a>, the collection of technologies we use to understand how Wikipedia works, improve its experiences, and spread free knowledge.</p> <p>The group product manager is a leader in the strategic decision-making and tactical execution for the Data Engineering, Experimentation, Search, and Data Platform Site Reliability teams. This role shares leadership responsibility with the Director of Engineering for Data Platform Engineering, and works in collaboration with data analysts, researchers, and product teams building user-facing features for reading and editing Wikipedia on the web and mobile apps. This is a people management role, managing two individually-contributing product managers.</p> <p>In this role, you and your group of product managers will guide the evolution of our data pipelines, data lake, experiment platform, and analytics tools.  This includes ingestion, orchestration, computation, and serving data using a variety of technologies such as Kafka, Flink, Hadoop, Spark, Airflow, Iceberg, Kubernetes, Superset, dbt, and OpenSearch. A strong candidate will have deep experience building a data platform to serve product analytics and production needs, and be technically conversant in the relevant technologies.</p> <p>This position will report to the Senior Director of Product, Core Experiences.</p> <p><strong>Candidates must be available for critical meetings and synchronous work between 15:00 UTC and 18:00 UTC, and open to traveling internationally up to four times per year.</strong></p> <h4>This role is accountable for:</h4> <ul> <li>Ensuring the accuracy, usefulness, reliability, and accessibility of our data products</li> <li>Defining and setting priorities and roadmaps for Data Platform Engineering teams across four domains: data engineering, search, experimentation, and site reliability</li> <li>Product managing product managers</li> <li>Success delivering data and analytical products and services depended on by multiple product teams</li> <li>Expertise in data analytics, A/B testing, search, and jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">The Wikimedia Foundation is seeking a <strong>Lead Learning Experience Designer</strong> to create innovative, engaging, and accessible learning experiences that strengthen the capacity of volunteers and communities across the Wikimedia movement. You’ll think like a learning product designer, finding the right approach for each challenge, whether that means creating an online course on Wikimedia’s learning management system (LMS), WikiLearn, producing multimedia content, experimenting with emerging technologies, or embedding learning into existing experiences and workflows. You will do all this while ensuring the experiences you create are culturally responsive, accessible, and relevant to a global audience. This role is intended for an experienced individual who is comfortable operating with a high degree of autonomy and making decisions in complex, evolving environments.</span></p> <p><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Success in this role means being a curious, resourceful problem solver who understands how people learn, grow, and participate. You can think big about how learning can strengthen the Wikimedia movement, while also rolling up your sleeves to build, experiment, and iterate on solutions that make a meaningful difference. </span></p> <h4><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><strong>Responsibilities</strong></span></h4> <ul> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Design and develop innovative digital learning experiences, capacity-strengthening resources, and performance support solutions for contributors across the Wikimedia movement.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Partner with product teams, community groups, researchers, and subject matter experts to identify learning needs, contributor challenges, and opportunities to strengthen participation.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Determine the right learning approach for each opportunity, whether that be a self-paced course, video, interactive experience, AI-enabled support, workshop, or embedded guidance. </span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Develop learning experiences that support contributors in understanding new tools, workflows, policies, governance processes, and community practices across Wikimedia projects.</span></li> <li style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;"><span style="font-family: helvetica, arial, sans-serif;">Rapidly prototype, test and iterate on learning experiences, using modern authoring tools, mult...

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist, Safety & Security
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>Wikipedia is a trusted source of knowledge the world over, read by over a billion people a month in over 300 languages. It’s offered for free and operated independently by the non-profit Wikimedia Foundation (that’s us), powered mainly by small donations.</p> <p>We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist to help guide Wikipedia’s anti-abuse and security strategy as a member of our <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Analytics">Product Analytics</a> team. In this role, you will inform our product development strategy by collaborating with product managers, engineers, and others to help our features and interventions make the impact they should. </p> <p>As the Senior Data Scientist, Safety & Security, you will partner closely with the <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Safety_and_Integrity">Product Safety and Integrity team</a>, whose strategy is built around bringing <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Product_Safety_and_Integrity/Detecting_abusive_content">cutting-edge AI</a> and <a href="https://diff.wikimedia.org/2026/05/04/better-detecting-bots-and-replacing-our-captcha-part-2/">machine learning</a> techniques to bear on difficult problems in the field of safety and security. You will amplify the impact of the safety and security roadmap through creative data analysis, identifying the right metrics for the job, and developing data strategies that advance our product decisions.</p> <p>This role is an opportunity to be at the center of a pivotal time for Wikipedia, as AI changes how people access knowledge and presents new risks and opportunities in online safety and security.</p> <p>Examples of the kinds of projects you may work on include:</p> <ul> <li>Setting the strategy for how we measure the success of efforts to detect bots and inauthentic account activity (<a href="https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Wikipedia:Sockpuppetry">sockpuppetry</a>, in wiki terms).</li> <li>Providing analysis to inform the development of new heuristics and approaches to detect potentially abusive activity on the platform.</li> <li>Collaborating with research scientists and security engineers to develop and evaluate AI models to find malicious user-authored code.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Please note that this role requires availability for critical meetings and synchronous collaboration between 13:00 and 19:00 UTC.</strong></p> <p><strong>You are responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Serving as a strategic partner for product managers, engineers, designers, and other colleagues in product development teams.</li> <li>Proactively making recommendations on product direction and data strategy, surfacing insights and interpreting results.</li> <li>Timely delivery of accurate quantitative data and insights to inform strategy, guide product decisions, and assess the impact of product development work – balancing the need to operate in a fast-changing environment with appropriate rigor.</li> <li>Clearly communicating results and data-backed recommendations to stakeholders across different functions, ensuring understanding and guiding decision-making.</li> <li>Building and executing measurement strategy, evaluating experiments using Bayesian & Frequentist approaches, and performing quantitative research to inform product decisions.</li> <li>Developing queries & code to work with large-scale internal and external data jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, Mobile Apps (Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>SENIOR PRODUCT MANAGER, MOBILE APPS (CONTRACT)</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: Remote,</strong><strong> 6-month contract</strong></p> <p><strong>Hours: 40 hrs/week, available for synchronous collaboration between 14:00-19:00 UTC</strong></p> <p><strong>Summary</strong></p> <p>Wikimedia is looking for an experienced product manager (contract) for the <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Apps">Mobile Apps</a> team in our <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Product">Product department</a>. The Product department builds the wiki experiences that enable our communities to achieve our vision: a world in which every single human being can freely share in the sum of all knowledge. This is an opportunity to have a tremendous impact with one of the most beloved parts of the internet.</p> <p>Wikipedia is one of the most popular media properties in the world, visited by over 1 billion people a month across over 300 different languages. All this knowledge is created and managed by more than 200,000 volunteer editors. The <a href="https://www.mediawiki.org/wiki/Wikimedia_Apps">Wikipedia mobile apps </a>are a fast and fun way to read Wikipedia. The Wikipedia apps for Android and iOS are ad-free and available in more than 300 languages. They are the best place to be a fan of Wikipedia and to learning.</p> <p>As a product manager with the Mobile Apps team (contract), you will work with engineers, designers, community members, other product managers, and our volunteer community to deliver on <a href="https://diff.wikimedia.org/2026/03/10/engaging-and-reengaging-wikipedia-readers/">the reader strategy</a>, with a focus on improving the experience of our most committed app users. This is a contract position to cover a parental leave January through the end of July.  Candidates must be available for critical meetings and synchronous work between 14:00-19:00 UTC. This role will report to the Readers Group Product Manager.  </p> <p><strong>About this role</strong></p> <p>This is a hands-on, individual contributor role. You will personally write the requirements, file tasks, create measurement plans, and provide community updates for your workstreams, and you will own each step from ideation through release, analysis and reporting. </p> <p>Because this role covers a leave, the product manager who normally leads the App Growth team will not be available for day-to-day guidance for most of the contract. We’re looking for someone self-directed and entrepreneurial: someone who ramps up quickly, takes an ambiguous problem, scopes it into something the team can ship in a matter of weeks, and makes sound decisions without waiting to be told. You will have a strong cross-functional team, a lot of documentation for context, and a manager to escalate to, but you should expect to pull together data, research and documentation to set your own direction within the team’s OKRs and established roadmap.</p> <p>Success in this role is measured by what ships and what we learn from it.</p> <p><strong>You are responsible for:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Leading the product development process from ideation and discovery in a defined project area, through scoping, requirements, release and analysis, for features that convert web readers to retained app readers, and sustained app donors, within the guardrails of our OKRs, roadmap and strategic direction. </li> <li>Scoping work realistically: breaking ambitious ideas into MVPs and phased releases that fit team capacity and the contract timeline, and making trade-offs explicit.</li> <...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong>Senior Program Officer, Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA)</strong></p> <p><strong>Location: </strong>Remote and must be based in a country within our <a href="https://wikimediafoundation.org/jobs/#section-13">current hiring locations</a> in the Sub-Saharan Africa region</p> <h3><strong>Summary</strong></h3> <p>The Wikimedia Foundation is a non-profit organization supporting Wikipedia and other Wikimedia projects. The Foundation operates one of the world’s top five websites and has global reach and impact. At the core of the projects are volunteers who curate the knowledge that the world has come to rely on.  </p> <p>The Community Resources team is the primary funding function of the Wikimedia Foundation ensuring that we support the Affiliates and volunteer contributors of the Wikimedia Movement by offering institutional and individual funding to help achieve the Movement’s goals. To support the movement’s commitment to Knowledge Equity, the team prioritizes proactive outreach to communities that structures of power and privilege have left out.</p> <p>The Senior Program Officer will implement the regional funding programs serving Wikimedian communities in Sub-Saharan Africa. </p> <p><strong>Roles and Responsibilities</strong></p> <p><strong>Funding Strategy & Portfolio Management</strong></p> <ul> <li>Implement the Community Resources grantmaking strategy while taking into consideration community needs, opportunities, movement trends, and the regional geopolitical and cultural context.</li> <li>Analyze regional and global patterns to shape funding rationales and priorities.</li> <li>Design program activities with colleagues to achieve significant, scalable impact.</li> <li>Manage, implement and monitor the regional grant portfolio to ensure alignment with strategy, criteria, and impact goals.</li> <li>Lead annual grant planning: identify and support prospective and returning grantees, review proposals, co-develop funding rationales with the regional funding committee. This also includes conducting organizational assessments (financial and narrative) to inform funding rationales. </li> <li>Work collaboratively across Foundation teams to support implementation of funding program and team objectives.</li> <li>Represent the Foundation internally and externally as an ambassador for regional knowledge, priorities and insights.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Committee Development</strong> </p> <ul> <li>Build, onboard, and develop regional funding committees aligned with regional needs and opportunities to enable transparent decision-making as part of participatory grantmaking approaches.</li> <li>Set agendas for committee discussions (priorities, financial analysis, partner and regional insights) and facilitate inclusive funding deliberations.</li> <li>Provide context, analysis, and synthesis of committee feedback into funding recommendations and decisions.</li> <li>Provide constructive feedback to applicants and grantees on outcomes and expectations linked to funding decisions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Community & Funding Partner Management </strong></p> <ul> <li>Build and sustain trust-based relationships with communities, grantees, and applicants across the region; act as primary liaison between WMF and partners.</li> <li>Understand community needs, dynamics, and challenges; support conflict resolution or sensitive discussions when required.</li> <li>Support community, organizational/institutional strengthening of grantee partners; connect them with relevant a...

jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><strong><a href="https://foundation.mozilla.org/en/">Mozilla Foundation</a></strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"><strong> </strong>is a non-profit building a better technology future — powered by people, open by design, fueled by imagination.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">We deliver people-first alternatives to today’s extractive systems. jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Gecko platform is the core engine of our product experience. To maintain competitiveness and user satisfaction, we must move beyond surface-level metrics to understand the deep correlations between engine performance and real-world user behavior. We currently face challenges with data quality, such as bot contamination in nightly telemetry, which obscures our understanding of true performance trends. and technical budgets.</span></p> <h3><strong>Engineering Deliverables</strong></h3> <ul> <li style="font-weight: 400;"><strong>Automated Dashboards:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Create 400;"><strong>Telemetry Gap Analysis:</strong><span style="font-weight: 400;"> Audit the Gecko codebase to identify missing collection points or "probes" necessary for a complete understanding of the jobs.title: Creative Designer (Fixed Term Contract)
jobs.descriptionHtml: <p><span style="font-weight: 600;">Why Mozilla?</span></p> <div class="gmail_default" style="font-size: small;"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Mozilla Corporation is the non-profit-backed technology company that has shaped the internet for the better over the last 25 years. We make pioneering brands like Firefox, the privacy-minded web browser. Now, with more than 225 million people around the world using our products each month, we’re shaping the next 25 years of technology and helping to reclaim an internet built for people, not companies. Our work focuses on diverse areas including AI, social media, security and more. And we’re doing this while never losing our focus on our core mission – to make the internet better for people. </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">The Mozilla Corporation is wholly owned by the non-profit 501(c) Mozilla Foundation. This means we aren’t beholden to any shareholders — only to our mission. Along with thousands of volunteer contributors and collaborators all over the world, Mozillians design, build and distribute open-source software that enables people to enjoy the internet on their terms.</span> <p><span style="font-weight: 600;">About this team and role:</span></p> <span style="font-weight: 400;">Mozilla Marketing Team is looking for an organized and detail-oriented Production Designer to join our team. In this role, you’ll deliver features and improvements in well-scoped areas, learn the broader architecture, and contribute to reliability, observability, and operational readiness.</p> <p>In your first year, you’ll take clear ownership of specific components or features (for example, parts of the SDLC indexing pipeline or query paths). This is a backend-focused role for an engineer with full-stack experience who enjoys balancing work on existing systems with new product development.</p> <p>That work happens in one of GitLab’s oldest and most complex product areas, where you’ll use Ruby on Rails to improve a critical system serving GitLab.com, self-managed instances, and GitLab Dedicated. Our Commercial segment includes businesses typically processing $20M–$50M in annual payment volume. Stripe’s payments and financial infrastructure unlocks new revenue streams and growth opportunities for these businesses. The Commercial Grower team supports our users to increase their domestic presence whilst expanding into new territories and unlocking new revenue streams. This is a role that can be based out of our Dublin or Berlin office or Germany remote. </p> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>As an Account Executive (Existing Business), you will deepen and expand partnerships between Stripe and the most innovative and fastest-growing companies in EMEA by helping them to understand how Stripe’s online commerce infrastructure can make payments a competitive advantage for their businesses.</p> <p> </p> <h3><strong>Responsibilities</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Directly manage and nurture a named account list and develop territory and account plans for winning and expanding business with the Commercial segment.</li> <li>Own the renewal and retention strategy for your territory, proactively identifying and mitigating churn risk.</li> <li>Build and maintain key relationships with C-level executives, while orchestrating the right executive touch points as well.</li> <li>Work with company leaders from multiple functions (e.g., Engineering, Product, and Finance) to lead complex product workshops and financial analyses</li> <li>Orchestrate cross-functional teams including Solutions Architects, Customer Success, and Product Specialists to deliver technical value and drive activation</li> <li>Contribute to shaping our Commercial strategy and building repeatable processes and scaled engagement models.</li> <li>Develop strategies for growing wallet share, driving multi-product adoption, and defending/expanding existing revenue for your named account list.</li> <li>Lead and contribute to team projects to develop and refine our sales process</li> <li>Engage with internal Product and Engineering teams to help drive product and DACH market strategy.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>Who you are</strong></h2> <p>You are a top class salesperson and relationship manager capable of engaging in business and technical conversations at multiple levels of the organization, including the CTO, COO, and CFO. We partner closely with growth, creative, analytics, and regional marketing to drive revenue through self-serve and sales motions. We work globally, across all Stripe offerings and with all company segments - from startups to the largest enterprises.</p> <ul> <li>In this role, you’d be joining a global, cross-functional team dedicated to testing and scaling cutting-edge acquisition channels</li> <li>Our team helps Stripe increase the GDP of the internet by ensuring our web presence is perfectly optimized for the next generation of artificial intelligence and search technologies</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What you’ll do</strong></h2> <p>Stripe is seeking an AEO and GEO Marketing Manager to lead the channel. This individual will play a critical role in growing new user acquisition from platforms including ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Google AI Overviews. The scope of the role includes Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), also known as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or Large Language Model (LLM) Search Optimization, improving AI agent experience, and integrating AI capabilities to improve the performance and efficiency of search and answer engine channels.</p> <p>This individual will spearhead efforts by developing and executing a roadmap of activities and experiments to improve answer engine performance.
