jobs.title: Head of Ecosystem
jobs.descriptionHtml: Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We aim to empower developers by providing a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth. We're looking for a Head of Ecosystem to lead the teams that make Supabase the backend for the platforms and tools developers already use. That covers AI app builders and coding agents, integrations with the developer tools teams rely on, and the Supabase Marketplace. You'll build this org from the ground up and shape how Supabase extends beyond its own platform. You'll also drive hiring, onboarding, and career development while maintaining high engineering standards. What you'll own: Build and lead a new engineering org across platform partners, integrations, and Marketplace, hiring EMs and engineers as it grows Own the technical relationship with the platforms building on Supabase, from integration health to escalations Set and maintain clear roadmaps that balance partner needs with platform priorities Partner with Product, Partnerships, and Sales to define and execute our ecosystem strategy Ship a unified, self-serve surface for integrations and Marketplace Maintain high engineering standards: roadmap hygiene, issue tracking, on-call, incident response, and responsiveness to partners What you bring: Proven experience leading multiple engineering teams, including managing other managers Experience building and running platform, API, or integration surfaces that third parties depend on in production Technical credibility with partner engineering teams, and the judgment to say no Experience building teams or an org from a small base, including hiring and developing engineering managers Strong organizational and execution skills: setting roadmaps, driving accountability, and keeping teams moving under uncertainty Experience managing remote, globally distributed teams Excellent cross-functional communication skills, especially with Product and commercial teams Collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable Bonus points if you: Have experience with OAuth, platform APIs, or app marketplaces Have worked on a developer platform's partner or app ecosystem Have worked with AI app builders or coding agents What We Offer Fully Remote We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world. ESOP Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together. Tech Allowance Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work. Health Benefits Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us. Annual Off-Sites Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year. Flexible Work We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when. Professional Development Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth. About the Team Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love. ~400 team members 60+ countries 20+ languages spoken Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F) 540,000+ community members We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.descriptionHtml: About ElevenLabs ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology. We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always. We have expanded from voice into three main platforms: ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale. ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages. ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models. Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you. How we work High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy. Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you. AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations. Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models. Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location. What we offer Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible. Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities. Learning & development : ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend. Social travel : We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose. Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún Co-working : If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend. About the role This role partners directly with enterprise customers building and deploying conversational agents on the ElevenLabs Agents Platform. The focus is hands-on execution - advising on agent design, personas, conversation flows, tool integrations, and voice customisation to deliver clear business outcomes in production environments. You will guide customers through best practices for deploying and scaling agents across web, mobile, and telephony, and for integrating agents with existing data sources and systems. You will analyze agent performance data and conversational logs to identify friction points and optimization opportunities that improve accuracy, user experience, and reliability at scale. In parallel, you will own expansion outcomes across a defined portfolio of enterprise accounts. Success is measured by net revenue retention and sustained multi-product adoption. You will identify expansion opportunities, drive cross-sell through deeper agent usage, and partner with Sales, Engineering, and Account Managers to convert technical success into durable revenue growth and long-term customer commitment. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Ramp

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

About the Role

Our world-class sales organization is looking for self-motivated teammates with high social intelligence and a natural inclination for selling and partnering to accelerate our growth as we scale rapidly! Individuals who are eager to learn, embrace challenges, and passionate about succeeding will thrive at Ramp. Our Partner Development Representatives act as the initial point of contact and are responsible for hunting and qualifying partners to build new partnerships that drive sales opportunities for Ramp.

What You’ll Do

  • Identify and source new partner opportunities with the accounting sector through inbound qualification and direct outreach

  • Engage and qualify prospective partners via a variety of methods, including but not limited to: emails, calls, social channels, conferences and events

  • Conduct in-depth primary and secondary research to understand service offerings, firmographics, organizational structure and key stakeholders to assess potential fit

  • Collarboate cross-functionally with Channel partner Managers, Marketing, Operations and Direct Sales to strategically grow Ramp’s Partner ecosystem

  • Educate accounting leaders and firm stakeholders on Ramp’s partnership program and convey the value Ramp can provide to the prospective partner firm and their clients 

  • Ideate on new and unique ways to build and develop partner relationships

  • Maintain accurate partner relationship data within Salesforce

What You Need

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills

  • Excellent listening skills and energetic and professional phone and Zoom presence

  • High level of comfort with sales, prospecting and both virtual and in-person

  • Dedication to tracking and improving performance and efficiency on a daily basis

  • Deep interest in understanding specific business challenges with the different verticals

  • Sense of entrepreneurship: a self-starter with a high sense of urgency, ability to work within undefined processes and a will to find a way

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Sentry Software runs the world and the pace is faster than ever. Sentry helps developers fix errors and performance issues before users notice, so teams can spend less time firefighting and more time building. Trusted by 200,000+ organizations, Sentry is today’s application monitoring standard and our team is building its AI-native future. About the role Sentry already sees the moment software breaks: the error, the trace, the replay, the commit that caused it. Seer, our AI debugger, uses all of that to figure out what went wrong and how to fix it. We're looking for a Staff engineer to help decide how that system should evolve as models improve every few months. Some of what we build today will be obsolete by next spring. Part of the job is knowing which parts, and building the rest to last. In this role you will Build state-of-the-art agentic AI systems to triage, debug, and solve real production issues Set technical direction for how our agents get context, use tools, and decide when they're done Build the evals that tell us whether a new model or prompt actually helped, fast enough that people use them Decide when to use a frontier model, a smaller one, or one we trained, and revisit that as cost and capability shift Leverage Sentry’s novel (and massive) dataset of errors, spans, and profiles Own major AI initiatives end to end, alongside the developers and product teams shipping them Run what you ship in production and debug it with Sentry You'll love this job if you Are driven by impact and enjoy working on high-stakes, high-visibility projects Enjoy building things. You will have the opportunity to join the AI/ML team as one of its foundational members Thrive in cross-functional teams and enjoy building features alongside developers and product teams Qualifications You've shipped an LLM-backed system people depended on, and can tell us what broke You have strong opinions on agent design and have changed at least one in the last year You've trained or fine-tuned models when it was the right call, and you know when it isn't You write solid production Python You've owned a system or component and led work across multiple engineers and teams, with a design doc people actually read You write clear technical documentation, mentor other engineers, and present to technical audiences The base salary range (or hourly wage range, if applicable) that Sentry reasonably expects to pay for this position is $240,000 to $400,000. A successful candidate’s actual base salary (or hourly wage) amount will be determined by a variety of relevant factors including, without limitation, the candidate’s work location, education, work and other relevant experience, skills, and job-related knowledge. A successful candidate will be eligible to participate in Sentry’s employee benefit plans/programs applicable to the candidate’s position (including incentive compensation, equity grants, paid time off, and group health insurance coverage). See Sentry Benefits for more details about the Company’s benefit plans/programs. Equal Opportunity at Sentry Sentry is committed to providing equal employment opportunities to its employees and candidates for employment regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or other legally-protected characteristic. This commitment includes the provision of reasonable accommodations to employees and candidates for employment with physical or mental disabilities who require such accommodations in order to (a) perform the essential functions of their jobs, or (b) seek employment with Sentry. We strive to build a diverse team, with an inclusive culture where every teammate can thrive. Sentry is an open-source company because we believe that everyone, everywhere, should have the ability and tools to make great software. Software should be accessible. That starts with making our industry accessible. If...

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About PostHog

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

  • A suite of analytics and observability tools, including product analytics, replay vision, AI observability, and error tracking

  • PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

  • Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

  1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

 

Things we care about

  • Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

  • Autonomy: We don’t tell anyone what to do. Everyone chooses what to work on next based on what's going to have the biggest impact on our customers, and what they find interesting and motivating to work on. Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Compute Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role: 

We are seeking talented distributed systems engineers who are passionate about building innovative solutions for application deployment. Your mission will be to enhance the capabilities of Replit Infrastructure, optimize performance across global regions, and drive efficiency while delivering an exceptional user experience. If you have a strong foundation in software development, a deep understanding of cloud technologies, and a track record of delivering high-quality code, we want to hear from you. 

In this role you will:

  • Expand Replit's cloud infrastructure offerings: Launch new cloud products to be used by Replit Agent to build complex apps. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and implement these features, empowering developers with a comprehensive suite of tools to build and deploy their applications efficiently.

  • Enhance reliability and scalability: Identify bottlenecks, optimize critical paths, and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems. Work closely with the SRE team to ensure high availability and minimal downtime. Enable our customers to seamlessly scale their applications to meet the demands of their growing user base.

  • Improve utilization of cloud infrastructure: Analyze our infrastructure costs and identify opportunities for optimization. Implement strategies to reduce cloud expenses without compromising performance or reliability. This could involve techniques such as resource provisioning, auto-scaling, cost-aware scheduling, and data lifecycle management. Your efforts will directly contribute to the financial efficiency of our cloud services.

Required skills and experience:

  • Distributed systems: Track record of working with platform-as-a-service, distributed storage, or information retrieval systems. Experience in designing scalable architectures and optimizing systems for latency or cost. 

  • Problem-solving mindset: Ability to approach complex challenges pragmatically and devise effective solutions. You think radically but ship incrementally.

  • Self-directed and autonomous: Able to work independently, set priorities, and drive projects forward. You take ownership and initiative.

  • Versatility and flexibility: Able to wear multiple hats and tackle a wide range of challenges. You are comfortable working across different layers of the stack and adapting to the needs of the project.

  • Continuous learning and adaptability: Passionate about staying up-to-date with industry trends and expanding your skill set. You embrace change and adapt quickly.

Nice to have:

  • Experience working on cloud infrastructure or platform products, particularly in the areas of application deployment, serverless computing, or container orchestration.

  • Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services and tools, such as GCE, GKE,, Cloud Run, or Cloud Storage.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Mobile
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the role:

We're seeking an Engineering Manager, Mobile to lead the future of our mobile experiences at Replit. In this role, you'll build and manage a team that bridges design and engineering to create intuitive, performant mobile interfaces that make software creation accessible on any device. You'll guide your team in building production-ready frameworks and patterns that enable high-quality in-product experiences, ensuring users can create apps from their phones or tablets with the same power as desktop.

You will:

  • Build, mentor, and grow a team of mobile design engineers, fostering a culture of technical excellence and design craftsmanship

  • Define the technical vision and strategy for mobile design systems, establishing frameworks and patterns that ship to production and scale across iOS, Android, and responsive web

  • Partner closely with design, product, and engineering leadership to prioritize mobile initiatives and ensure seamless collaboration between design and development teams

  • Drive best practices for mobile-first development, ensuring your team builds production-grade patterns that deliver consistent, high-quality experiences while optimizing for performance

  • Oversee the architecture of complex mobile UI components and systems, providing technical guidance and code review to maintain high standards

  • Champion accessible, responsive interfaces through well-architected frameworks, and establish processes that improve mobile design-to-development workflow

  • Balance hands-on technical contribution with people management, staying close enough to the code to guide architectural decisions

Required skills and experience:

  • 3+ years of engineering management experience with a track record of building and scaling high-performing teams, plus proven experience building production frameworks and component systems that scale across products

  • Deep technical background with mobile development, including experience with some of the following: mobile-specific web APIs, native mobile development (Swift/Kotlin), React and React Native (or similar cross-platform frameworks), PWAs, mobile design patterns, and complex UI animations and gesture-based interactions

  • Excellent communication skills to balance technical leadership with people management, including mentoring, performance management, and career development

Bonus Qualifications:

  • Active Replit mobile user passionate about accessible software creation, with experience building or leading mobile design or developer tools teams

  • Interest in AI on mobile devices and contributions to open-source mobile design systems or UI libraries

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

Join us at the forefront of AI and cloud-native security as we work to secure one of the most innovative developer platforms in the world. As the Cloud Security Lead, you will shape the cloud and infrastructure security program that protects millions of developers, enables safe AI-assisted development, and ensures organizations can confidently bring our platform into enterprise environments.

In this role, you will own cloud security across GCP (primary) and supplemental environments in AWS and Azure, as well as containerized systems, SaaS platforms, and our multi-tenant AI infrastructure. You’ll improve our security posture through strong architecture, posture management, secure-by-default development practices, and close partnership with Engineering, Compliance, Security Architecture, and Platform teams.

This is a highly impactful, hands-on leadership role—perfect for someone who wants to solve complex security challenges at scale while influencing product, engineering, and go-to-market teams.

What You’ll Do:

Cloud Security Engineering

  • Lead configuration hardening across GCP, with additional oversight of workloads and integrations running in AWS and Azure.

  • Own and optimize CSPM platforms across multi-cloud environments—establishing configuration baselines, guardrails, and remediation workflows.

  • Secure critical SaaS platforms, ensuring proper configurations, access controls, and engineering integrations.

  • Lead infrastructure vulnerability management across multi-cloud systems, containers, registries, and platform services.

  • Enhance security across containerized and Kubernetes (GKE/EKS/AKS) workloads, including runtime protections, network policies, and workload identity.

  • Assess secure logging configurations across cloud/SaaS providers, ensuring audit logs, retention, and routing meet monitoring and architecture needs.

Secure Development & Architecture Enablement

  • Partner with engineering teams to make services secure by default, embedding security into development workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native deployments.

Cross-Functional Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with Security Monitoring, Compliance/GRC, Architecture, DevOps, Platform Engineering, and ML Infrastructure.

  • Participate in communicating security advisories, best practices, and updates to Replit’s customers.

  • Support incident investigations as a cloud security subject-matter expert.

Required Skills & Experience:

jobs.descriptionHtml: Resend is building the most accessible email platform for developers. As we’ve grown to 4M+ users and continue to onboard thousands of new users every day, the pressure of maintaining a safe place for good senders continues to build. This role is fully remote-based in Americas or European time zones, with some expected travel for team off-sites, conferences, meetups, and more. Read more about how we work, how we hire, and what we value here . In this role, you will… Build and operate Resend’s email transport infrastructure Work on SMTP delivery, MTA systems, routing, retries, backoff strategies, and delivery controls Design systems for domain-level, provider-level, customer-level, and IP-level throttling Build infrastructure for shared IP pools, dedicated IPs, warmup execution, and reputation-aware routing Improve how Resend classifies bounces, deferrals, transient failures, hard failures, and delivery outcomes Build tools that help the team debug delivery issues by customer, domain, mailbox provider, route, IP, message type, and event Help design systems that make sending behavior safer, more observable, and easier to operate Translate reputation strategy into backend systems Partner with Trust & Safety and Core Sending to build controls that protect Resend’s sending network from abuse Participate in incident response for sending, provider, and deliverability-sensitive issues Be on-call for critical services You will be a great fit if you... jobs.descriptionHtml: **Moodle with us!** We're the world's most popular learning platform, and we’re on a mission to empower educators and learners worldwide with open, flexible, and innovative digital learning solutions. As the world’s most customisable and trusted open-source LMS, we partner with schools, universities, and organisations to create better learning experiences for millions. If you’re ready to make a real impact, and be part of a global movement shaping the future of learning, join us. Let's transform education together! **About the role..** Are you passionate about technology, already building things in your career as a developer? We’re looking for a motivated and curious **Developer** with 2 to 3 years of experience to join our **Platform Solutions team**. The team builds, improves and maintains Moodle LMS, the open-source platform all of Moodle’s products are built on. You’ll work on the core LMS alongside experienced developers, and your changes go through Moodle’s open contribution process. We're building a team that works with AI, not around it. If you've been teaching yourself to build with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot or the OpenAI/Anthropic APIs, and you can show us what you've made, we want to hear from you. It matters far more to us what you've built than where (or whether) you studied. This is a fully remote role and can be offered as a permanent role in India, Indonesia, Vietnam or the Philippines. **At Moodle, no two days will ever be the same, but will involve a mix of:** * Collaborating with experienced developers on designing, developing, and implementing software solutions. * Using AI coding agents as part of your everyday workflow: scoping the task, writing a clear spec or prompt, then reviewing, testing and refining what comes back. * Writing clean, well-tested PHP and JavaScript, and being able to explain and defend every line of it, whether you or an agent wrote it first. * Building small automations and internal tools that make the wider team faster. * Participating in code reviews, learning best practices and improving code quality. * Contributing to the full software development lifecycle from concept to deployment and maintenance. * Learning new technologies and tools while solving real-world problems. * Contributing to projects that impact millions of users globally. **What we’re looking for..** * Experience with or knowledge of PHP and JavaScript. * Hands-on experience with agentic AI development tools (for example Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or agents you've built yourself with an LLM API). Self-taught absolutely counts: side projects, hackathons, open-source contributions and things you built for fun are all evidence. * Working understanding of how to get good results from these tools: giving an agent the right context, breaking work into verifiable steps, and knowing when the output is wrong. * Judgement about where AI helps and where it doesn't, and a healthy scepticism about code you didn't reason through yourself. * Passion for problem-solving, keen attention to detail and an eagerness to keep learning. * An approachable, collaborative way of working in a global team. * Strong communication and collaboration skills: increasingly, being a strong developer means being able to describe a problem precisely, to people and to machines. **Nice to have, not required:** familiarity with MCP (Model Context Protocol), retrieval-augmented generation, prompt/context engineering, agent evaluation or testing, or having published a tool, plugin or agent of your own. You don't need a certification or a formal AI qualification for this role. A GitHub repo, a demo video or a blog post explaining something you built will tell us more than any course certificate. **What life at Moodle is like..** Moodle has a globally diverse team with over 280 team members in more than 25 countries around the world. We’ve built a passionate team of hard-working, driven and diverse people from all over the world, ...

In this role, you will play a crucial part in developing, scaling, and maintaining our core digital platforms and internal systems. You will bridge the gap between robust server-side architecture and modern, responsive user interfaces—building efficient REST APIs and backend logic with **Laravel/PHP**, while crafting seamless, high-performance user experiences on the frontend using **React and TypeScript**. If you thrive in a collaborative environment and want to take ownership of end-to-end product development, we want to hear from you. **Key Responsibilities** * **Full Stack Development:** Design, develop, test, and maintain modern web applications across both client-side and server-side architectures. * **Backend & API Engineering:** Build, optimize, and maintain scalable backend systems and RESTful APIs using **Laravel and PHP**. * **Frontend Development:** Create responsive, user-friendly, and clean web interfaces using **React, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS3**. * **Database Management:** Manage, query, and optimize relational databases (**MySQL / SQL**) for high performance and data security. * **System Integration:** Collaborate closely with backend, frontend, and UX/UI design teams to ensure smooth API integration and a seamless user experience. * **Performance & Security:** Monitor application performance, troubleshoot and debug issues, ensure backend security, and improve web accessibility and load times. * **Deployment & Maintenance:** Assist with server management, code reviews, Git version control workflows, and application deployment Proficiency:** Strong core PHP skills and hands-on experience building production-ready applications using the **Laravel** framework, Object-Oriented Programming (OOP), and REST APIs. * **Frontend Proficiency:** Solid understanding of **React** (including hooks and component-based development), **TypeScript**, JavaScript, HTML5, and CSS3. * **Database & Tools:** Proficiency with **MySQL / SQL**, Git/version control, and state management/API integration tools (e.g., Axios, React Query, Redux, Zustand). * **UI & Styling:** Familiarity with modern UI frameworks and component libraries (e.g., Tailwind CSS, Material UI, Chakra UI). * **Infrastructure Basics:** Understanding of Linux/Unix server environments and basic server management. * **Communication:** Good communication skills in both written and spoken English. * **Mindset:** Proactive problem solver, eager to learn, and capable of working both independently and collaboratively within a team. **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience using cloud services (e.g., AWS) or Virtual Private Servers (VPS). * Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, containerization, or advanced application security concepts. * Experience working in jobs.title: Operations Intern - Power BI & Manufacturing Improvement (Karawang)
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Power BI & Manufacturing Improvement Intern** =============================================== **Location:** Karawang, Indonesia **Working Pattern:** Onsite **Target Join Date:** 15 December 2026 At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’ve transformed our business and are building our future on one clear purpose—to deliver a smoke-free future. With huge change comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions. Join our SPP Production team and support the transformation of operational data into practical insights. During this four-month internship, you will assist with dashboard development, production-loss analysis, and a structured changeover improvement study. **Impact You’ll Own** --------------------- * Support a standardized Power BI view of uptime, losses, changeovers, and key production indicators. * Help identify uptime opportunities using baseline data, trends, and Pareto analysis. * Contribute to a Single-Minute Exchange of Die study for selected machine changeovers. * Support production teams in using reliable data during performance reviews. * Help document changeover improvements and potential uptime gains. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * Support the consolidation, cleaning, validation, and standardization of production data. * Assist with Power BI data models, Power Query transformations, DAX measures, and dashboards. * Support the analysis of uptime, production losses, and changeover performance. * Assist with shop-floor time and motion studies on selected equipment. * Help document changeover activities and update standard procedures. * Support the preparation of user guides and training materials. * Assist with summarizing findings and recommendations for stakeholder presentations. **Skills & Capabilities** ------------------------- **Must-haves** * Final-year bachelor’s student in Industrial, Mechanical, Electrical, Chemical, or another relevant engineering discipline. * Familiarity with Power BI, including Power Query, data modelling, DAX, and dashboard design. * Strong Microsoft Excel skills, including formulas, pivot tables, charts, and data consolidation. * Analytical problem-solving skills and basic statistical knowledge. * A structured and detail-oriented approach to data and documentation. * Clear communication and stakeholder collaboration skills. * Willingness to support activities on the manufacturing shop floor. **Nice-to-haves** * Knowledge of Lean methods such as SMED, standard work, time and motion studies, or basic value-stream mapping. * Interest in manufacturing operations, continuous improvement, and equipment uptime. **Rewards & Benefits** ---------------------- Internship allowance, benefits, facilities, and applicable support will be shared during the recruitment process. **Application Process** ----------------------- * Digital interview and online assessment * HR interview * User interview **Equal Opportunities Statement** --------------------------------- We believe that diverse perspectives and experiences make us stronger. As an equal opportunity employer, we are committed to creating a workplace where every individual feels welcomed, respected, valued, and empowered to reach their full potential. We encourage applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and provide reasonable accommodations to ensure an accessible recruitment process. If you need support or adjustments during your application, let us know—we’re here to help you succeed. #sampoerna

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Firmus Technologies** Firmus Technologies is a global leader pioneering the development and operation of efficient AI infrastructure across Asia Pacific. Founded in Australia in 2019, our mission is to create the most efficient AI infrastructure by combining cutting-edge technology with a steadfast commitment to sustainability. At Firmus, we are unique in our approach. We design, build, and operate a new class of digital infrastructure – the AI Factory. Through our model-to-grid technology approach, we have pushed the boundaries of multi-generational liquid cooling systems, energy management, AI software orchestration, and construction. For our customers, this approach allows us to make every watt count and deliver low-cost AI tokens globally. **Firmus AI Cloud** Our large-scale GPU cloud platform, Firmus AI Cloud, is purpose-built to deliver energy-efficient AI compute at scale to customers. It empowers developers, enterprises, educational institutions, and government users to train and deploy AI models with unmatched efficiency and cost savings. With an ever-growing suite of services and applications, we are committed to delivering a cloud experience that is market-leading, proprietary, and built to scale. **ROLE SUMMARY** Reporting to the Senior Operations Manager, Batam, the Team Leader of Field Service Operations oversees a team of Field Service Technicians (FSTs) to ensure efficient delivery of various services. This is a unique opportunity to take on a founding leadership role at our Batam Data Centers. You will play a pivotal role in helping the Senior Operations Managers to build and develop the local operations team from day one, including assisting with the transition from commissioning and operational acceptance into steady-state operations, ensuring operational documentation, processes, and team readiness are in place, and driving operational excellence. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** **Leadership & Team Management** * Provide day-to-day leadership and direction for FSTs and site-based engineers, fostering a supportive and engaged team environment. * Provide onsite training and supervision of FST staff as required to ensure they are well engaged, trained and capable of maintaining the equipment at the highest of standards. * Ensure that all new FSTs entering the business feel engaged and supported whilst making sure they are properly trained and mentored such that they can safely undertake required tasks to the quality we expect. **Supervise and ensure timely completion of tasks by FST and site-based engineers** * Fault response and troubleshooting * Routine and corrective maintenance * Equipment installation (racking) * Communication cable installation * Computer hardware repair * Remote hands support as required * Coordinate and participate in mechanical and electrical equipment repair * Oversee contractor works * Conduct facility inspections and audits as required, ensuring our sites are always impeccably maintained and operating as efficiently as possible. **Operational Efficiency** * Contribute to maintaining a safe, reliable, efficient, and customer-focused AI Factory environment that meets agreed service levels and supports positive customer outcomes. * Assist to develop and embed processes to optimise field service operations and ensure high-quality service delivery. This includes developing and fostering ongoing use of site-based inspection checklists, permits, safety documents etc. * Collaborate with other teams (project delivery, commissioning, Technology Operations and Technology & Engineering ) to provide support and resources as needed. * Assist in project works as required and where it does not impact upon operations. **SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE** * Diploma, Advanced Diploma, Bachelor's degree or higher qualification in Engineering, Facilities Management, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Information Technology, Data Centre Operations, or a related technical discipline * More than 5 years o...

jobs.title: Data & AI Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: We’re on a mission to help people discover the real value of travel — to inspire, to give more reasons, to make it easy — for you to go. Our company was founded back in 2005, and since then, we’ve imagined and created some of the most well-loved products for travelers all around the world. Today, Wego is used by millions of people every month — people who travel for adventure, work, family, and for many other reasons. That’s why we work tirelessly to make your experience of planning & booking flights, hotels, and trips as seamless as possible. **Team Description:** You'll join Wego's Data Analytics & Data Science team, which powers analytics, data science and AI tooling across our Flights and Hotels products, from the metasearch marketplace to our OTA business, in markets worldwide. Our roadmap has more high-impact projects than ever, and we're growing the team to deliver the data ingestion, platform and AI tooling work behind them. **The Role:** You will build and operate the ingestion systems and runtime infrastructure that support analytics, data science and AI tools across Wego. Your focus is reliable data movement from source systems and dependable operation of the services that consume it, and you will own pipelines and services through development, deployment and operation. You'll work closely with analysts, data scientists and engineering teams to find bottlenecks and build practical solutions, and you'll connect AI tools to data and services with clear access boundaries, evaluations and operational ownership. **What you will be working on:** * Building reliable batch and streaming pipelines so data moves from source systems without being silently lost or duplicated * Running pipelines and services on Kubernetes and cloud infrastructure, with repeatable environments and safe release and rollback paths * Building the systems that let AI assistants and agents use Wego data and APIs reliably, with evaluations built alongside data scientists * Improving reliability and cloud cost against agreed service goals * Finding sources of data loss, operational toil and slow delivery, validating their impact with users and owning the fix end to end **Core Responsibilities:** * Data ingestion: Build pipelines from APIs, databases and event sources; handle schema changes, incremental loads and change data capture where needed * Recovery & data quality: Design retries, deduplication, backfills and replay; monitor freshness and completeness from source to consumer * Kubernetes & runtime: Deploy and operate containerized pipelines and services; manage resources, configuration, scaling and recovery with platform teams * DevOps & delivery: Use infrastructure as code and automated delivery pipelines; test changes and manage secrets and access * Observability & operations: Define metrics, logs and alerts; diagnose incidents and fix recurring failures * AI tooling & model services: Build tool and API integrations, agent loops, context and memory, retrieval, prompts and guardrails; support model serving where needed * Evaluations: Build test sets, regression checks and monitoring of AI outputs with data scientists **Skills and experience:** * 3–8 years of experience in data engineering, platform engineering or related infrastructure work * Experience owning ingestion systems in production, including failures, recovery and source schema changes * Hands-on experience operating Kubernetes workloads and cloud infrastructure * Experience with DevOps practices, automated deployments and infrastructure as code * Fluency in Python and SQL, with practical Linux, networking and container skills * Experience with APIs, databases and event systems, including batch or streaming ingestion * Understanding of delivery guarantees, idempotency and schema compatibility, and how they affect downstream data * Experience with Kubernetes and container tooling such as Docker and Helm * Experience with a cloud platform such as Google Cloud Platform or AWS, and infr...

jobs.descriptionHtml: At Eramet, we are convinced that the world needs metals produced by a responsible mining industry. We are facing the greatest challenge in our history: to make a success of the energy and ecological transition and re-establish the conditions for lasting harmony between man and the Earth. We share this conviction with our Group's 10,700 employees around the world, who are committed to making Eramet a benchmark in the responsible transformation of the Earth's mineral resources, for the benefit of all. **Join Eramet and become the new face of mining!** **Control Room Project Leader (FMS) W/M** ========================================= Position Reference: 45238 Location: Halmahera, ID Contract type: Permanent Job posting start date: Oct 19, 2026 Weda Bay, a strategic source of ore and a major focus of the energy transition. Weda Bay Nickel, in which Eramet is a co-shareholder, is an integral part of the Group’s strategy to support the energy transition in a sustainable way by providing leading-edge solutions to meet the needs of the new metals era. The Weda Bay Nickel mine, located on the island of Halmahera in northeast Indonesia, recently went into production in 2019. As part of a partnership with the Chinese steel group Tsingshan, the world’s leading producer of stainless steel and the majority shareholder of PT Weda Bay Nickel, Eramet brings its technical and operational expertise on the mining operations. **Control Room Project Leader (FMS) W/M** **Responsibilities :** * Control Room Development & Systems * Lead the design, deployment and operationalisation of the WBN Central Control Room at KM17 and the four area control rooms. * Coordinate implementation and optimisation of the Fleet Management System across all contractor equipment and all operational areas. * Integrate production monitoring, safety monitoring (speed, fatigue, CCTV) and environmental monitoring into a unified operational platform. * Define and implement control room operational standards, governance processes and data quality protocols. * Operational Monitoring & Performance * Ensure real-time visibility of mining extraction, hauling, crushing and stockpile activities across all four operational areas. * Track production KPIs at area level and consolidate data for management reporting to VP Mining, KTT and Area Managers. * Coordinate operational information flows between Area Managers, the Op Performance Manager and central technical teams. * Support decision-making through timely, accurate data provision; identify bottlenecks and escalate abnormal operational trends. * Safety & Compliance Monitoring * Deploy and manage speed and gradient monitoring systems; establish and enforce escalation protocols for non-compliant equipment movements. * Integrate fatigue monitoring data streams into operational supervision workflows across all areas. * Support equipment commissioning compliance tracking; flag non-compliant or expired units for operational intervention. * Provide reliable data inputs for HSE reporting, incident investigations and weekly safety reviews. * Digital Transformation Leadership * Lead the WBN digitalisation agenda within the control room and FMS scope, in coordination with the Supply, Planning and FMS Manager. * Build the integrated digital data pipeline from field data capture to centralised analysis and management reporting. * Coordinate with Eramet Group digital and IT teams on system deployment, integration and support. * Identify and deploy digital tools that improve operational safety, efficiency and compliance. * Mission * Deliver a fully operational, integrated WBN Mining Control Room that gives Area Managers and central management real-time visibility of all operational and safety-critical activities. * Build the FMS and digital monitoring infrastructure that underpins both production accountability and safety compliance in the new decentralised WBN organisation. * Reduce operational blind spots — particularly around haulage road s...

jobs.title: Accenture Indonesia Internship Program – Technology & Consulting
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Your role** At Accenture, we are making sustainability our greatest responsibility with the mission to embed sustainability in everything that we do internally and for our clients. As an intern, you will have the opportunity to experience life at Accenture, expand your professional network and build transferrable skills in the broad topics of sustainability that you will be able to apply anywhere. * You will be assigned to real-life projects and responsibilities in sustainability * Gain experience and exposure to emerging technologies and sustainability topics * Have the opportunity to learn and strengthen your Sustainability Quotient * Be part of a fast-paced and dynamic team Your role assignment will be based on business needs, your personal strengths, and it may be in any of the following industries: * Communications, Media and Technology * Financial Services * Health and Public Service * Resources * Products **Key responsibilities** Your responsibilities may include addressing key business problems and developing best-practice technology solutions for business improvement. The scope may include but is not limited to: * Understand and translate requirements into business and technology solutions * Design, build and configure applications to meet business process and application requirements * Analyze and deliver quality functional/application designs and ensure technology solutions represent current and future business requirements * Support data collection, processing, transformation, and validation from various data sources * Assist in developing and maintaining **data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes** * Work with **SQL, databases, and basic programming languages such as Python** to support data-related requirements * Assist in analyzing, troubleshooting, and improving **data quality and data workflows** * Collaborate with team members to understand data requirements and translate them into technology solutions **Requirements:** * Pursuing a bachelor’s degree from a recognized university * Available for at least 2 months period * Track record of outstanding academic performance and co-curricular activities * Willingness to learn and an interest in sustainability * Basic knowledge or skills in programming languages would be an advantage * Basic knowledge of **SQL, databases, or data processing** would be an advantage * Basic knowledge of **Python or other programming languages** would be an advantage * Exposure to **data engineering, data analytics, ETL/ELT, data pipelines, or cloud technologies** through academic or personal projects would be an advantage * Strong analytical skills and problem-solving skills * Flexibility and willingness to work on different projects if required **Primary Locations:** * Jakarta * Semarang **Documents and Information Required** * Resume (in PDF format) * Latest academic transcript (indicating the completion of a sustainability related module) * Indicate your availability (start and end date) and expected graduation date in your resume Please note that only shortlisted candidates will be contacted. You will also have opportunities to hone your functional skills and expertise in an area of specialization. We offer a variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you acquire and build specialized skills faster. Learning takes place both on the job and through formal training conducted online, in the classroom, or in collaboration with teammates. The sheer variety of work we do, and the experience it offers, provide an unbeatable platform from which to build a career. Accenture is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes applications from all sections of society and does not discriminate on grounds of race, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, citizenship, marital, domestic or civil partnership status, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other basis as protected by applicable law.

Work closely with leadership and cross-functional teams. Be part of a growing digital insurance company that's transforming the insurance industry. Work Location: In person

Making sure that our 50+ million users have the best experience in crafting their own adventure. **Your Main Duties in Flying with Us:** * Own the cross-sell and recommendation experience across tiket.com. * Identify cross-sell opportunities across the customer journey (search, checkout, and post-purchase), and turn opportunities into prioritized roadmap. * Gather and build clear, exhaustive, growth, conversion, or personalization products is a strong plus * Strong analytical skills: comfortable with SQL and product analytics tools, and with designing and interpreting A/B tests * Good understanding of how recommendation systems work and ability to work closely with Data Science teams * Strong problem-solving skills and structured, pyramid-principles thinking * Ability to manage skills, with strong listening skills In the event that you haven’t received any updates after 3 weeks, your data will be kept and we may contact you for another career destination. jobs.descriptionHtml: **Tiered Approach** In line with the commitment to safeguard capacity and support personnel already in the Organization, a majority of UNDP UNCDF/UNV vacancies are advertised using a tiered application process whereby: * **Tier 0** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV IP staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments, whose posts will be abolished, or contracts will be terminated or not renewed during 2026. * **Tier 1** : Other UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding permanent (PA) and fixed-term (FTA) appointments * **Tier 2** : UNDP/UNCDF/UNV staff holding temporary appointments (TA), personnel on regular PSA contracts, and Expert and Specialist UN Volunteers * **Tier 3 or no tier indicated** : All other contract types from UNDP/UNCDF/UNV and other agencies, and other external candidates Please make note of the Tier(s) indicated in the vacancy title, if any, and ensure that you satisfy the eligibility to apply. **Background** UNDP is the United Nations’ lead agency on international development, working in 170 countries and territories to help people build better lives while protecting the planet. For 60 years, UNDP has supported countries to make progress on the issues that matter most, with human development at the core of its mandate. Our work is built on trust and long-term partnerships with governments, communities and organizations at every level. Operating in a Middle-Income Country brings its own set of complexities and opportunities. With 70% of the Indonesian economy directly or indirectly reliant on its natural resources, the link between nature, climate, jobs, and economic empowerment become critical. UNDP Indonesia works with Indonesian partners to deliver an ambitious programme, fully aligned to the national priorities of Indonesia. UNDP’s past experiences and support include innovative sustainable financing, digital health, energy transition and climate policies, improved service delivery that leaves no one behind. Enablers and multipliers such as digitalization and Artificial Intelligence are at the core of its efforts. Building on its vast and long experiences, and the knowledge of its entire team of professionals, UNDP Indonesia demonstrate its thought-leadership and translate knowledge into policy advice, investment opportunities and scalable solutions for Indonesia’s critical development priorities. The strategic priorities of UNDP Indonesia for its current Country Programme 2026 -2030 are encapsulated under three outcome areas: (1) Human Development (2) Nature, Decarbonisation and Resilience (3) Economic and Digital Transformation To support programme implementation, UNDP Indonesia requires a Talent and People Development Associate to strengthen workforce planning, employer branding and the employee value proposition (EVP), talent pipelines and onboarding, learning and career management, manager capability and personnel engagement, and strategic partnerships and outreach. **Duties and Responsibilities** 1. jobs.descriptionHtml: **The Opportunity** **About the Digital Team** Beca Digital is moving into a significant stage of growth, working with our internal teams and clients to solve real-world problems. Our stakeholders work with us to develop creative platforms, products and solutions that leverage cloud-based infrastructure. We are developing a platform-based approach to delivering exciting and cost-effective software solutions that overcome some of the challenges of purely bespoke software. You will be working across our key digital offerings, including our cutting-edge digital twin platform (BEYON) for asset intensive organizations to have one lens across their asset data, our earthquake risk analysis and early alert system (Beacon) and a capital portfolio management software product (CAPEXinsights) that is used globally by some of the world’s largest FMCG companies. There are also several new initiatives and opportunities that have just been launched so you could help to define and architect the testing frameworks used there. **About you** You are a proponent of shift left test driven development and believe that Quality Assurance must be a fully integrated function of the software delivery lifecycle. You have a proven technical testing background and a desire to influence and shape how testing must evolve to meet the demands of the future. You are dynamic and innovative and enjoy coming up with new ways to deliver. You are passionate about growing your knowledge and experience and looking for an organization that will support those aspirations. **Qualifications** At Beca Digital, we believe in innovation and encourage diversity of thought. We invite applicants from a range of backgrounds with the following experience, skills, and attributes: * 4+ years of software testing experience with a foundation in **Playwright** , **API testing** and **Azure DevOps test automation** * Experience using source control in **Git** repositories and managing test environment configurations * Experience developing, using and maintaining **test automation frameworks** and planning for automated test maintenance. Ensuring the automations run effectively within **CI/CD build and release pipelines** * Hands-on experience testing **RESTful APIs** using tools such as Bruno or Postman, Playwright API testing, Swagger, or equivalent frameworks, including validation of requests, responses, authentication, and error handling. * Thorough knowledge of the principles of functional and non-functional testing, test planning and reporting, test design, test case writing and maintenance and manual exploratory testing * Experience in reporting, investigating, triage and tracking bugs * An Agile and open mindset, able to consider new ideas and approaches to complex situations * Be a quick learner and detail orientated * A focus on outcomes and a proven problem-solving ability * Proactive, flexible, and comfortable with ambiguity Great communication skills with the ability to build meaningful and collaborative relationships across various levels of a business In addition, knowledge and experience across the following is not critical, however would be beneficial: • Microsoft Azure platform, Microsoft .NET, SQL, React and JavaScript, Power BI • Using AI to help with test plans and test cases **What we offer** A career with Beca will provide you with: * Professional development opportunities. * A supportive and caring work environment where you can bring your whole self to work. * Opportunities to learn from our industry experts and technical gurus across the Asia Pacific. **Apply now** Belong at Beca and make everyday better. jobs.title: Forward Deployed Creative [Germany]
jobs.descriptionHtml:
You'll be Luma's creative lead on the ground with major brands and agencies, turning what our models can do into production workflows they actually use. Sitting between the technology and the craft, you'll shape how top creators work with generative video, and produce high-craft work in Luma yourself as the proof.

These are foundational Forward Deployed Creative roles in the region, so you'll be defining how partner engagement works here rather than following a set playbook. It fits a senior creative who's comfortable shaping the approach as they go and consulting directly with senior partners. If you'd rather execute an established process, this isn't the fit.

What You'll Own

  • Partner directly with leading brands and creative agencies as their creative and strategic guide to generative AI.

  • Architect and prototype AI-accelerated production workflows that help partners move faster and raise their storytelling.

  • Create hands-on, high-craft content in Luma that sets the bar and becomes inspirational case studies.

  • Consult with partner leadership, translating technical capability into concrete creative and business opportunities.

  • Work as an on-the-ground extension of Product, Partnership, and Sales, bringing real-world insight back into the roadmap.

  • Set the tone and the playbook for how the Forward Deployed Creative function engages partners in the region.

First 90 Days

One way the first 90 could unfold.

  • Days 1–30 — Immerse & Diagnose:Learn Luma and the models deeply, meet priority partners, and understand their pipelines and where generative AI helps most.

  • Days 30–60 — Ship & Validate:Build a real AI-accelerated workflow with a partner and produce a high-craft case study from it.

  • Days 60–90 — Scale & Systemize:Turn what works into repeatable boards and playbooks other FDCs and partners can use.

What You Bring

  • Senior client-facing creative experience (Creative Director, Creative Technologist, Technical Director, or similar) at a top agency, studio, or tech company.

  • An outstanding portfolio of shipped, high-craft work showing taste, technical skill, and storytelling. A portfolio is required.

  • Deep expertise in creative production pipelines (VFX, animation, motion graphics, or production) and designing new workflows using generative AI

  • A track record of building new things in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation, able to act as a strategic consultant to senior creative and business leaders.

  • Genuine enthusiasm for the creative potential of AI.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with generative AI creative tools (Luma, Midjourney, Runway, Pika, Stable Diffusion).

  • A public profile as a creator or thought leader in emerging tech or generative art.

jobs.title: Founding AE - DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location: Munich / Frankfurt – hybrid

Type: Full-time

Level: Senior

Reporting to: Co-founder & CRO


About Nebuly

Nebuly is a fast-growing, VC-backed startup building the platform that proves the ROI of enterprise AI.

Every enterprise function — sales, customer support, HR, finance — is deploying AI agents at scale, and budgets are following fast. But most companies can't answer a basic question: is this spend actually working? Every enterprise deploying AI agents is asking the same question: is this actually delivering value? Today, almost none of them can answer it. The signal that could answer it is right there — millions of conversations happening every day between employees, customers, and these agents — but it's unstructured, high-volume, and invisible without the right infrastructure. So the ROI question stays unanswered, not because the answer doesn't exist, but because no one can see it. Nebuly makes that signal visible. It sits on top of any enterprise AI deployment, turns those conversations into a clear answer — is this working, and where — and connects the dots back to ROI. Think of it as the accountability layer for enterprise AI: connect once, see the impact, prove the value — with no data ever leaving your environment.

Every new data category has created a new software category. CRM turned customer interactions into pipeline accountability. Product analytics turned user behavior into growth accountability. Nebuly is building that same layer for AI — turning millions of invisible conversations into a clear answer on value.

Our customers include Oura, CNH Industrial, Vodafone, and Moncler. Demand is accelerating fast, and we're building the team to match.


Your Role

We have a product that works, customers that prove it, and a market that is moving fast. DACH is one of the core regions we are pushing alongside the US, UK, and Italy — it is not an experiment, it is a strategic priority. In DACH we have early presence but huge white space. No one owns this market yet - not us, not a competitor. The person who takes this role has the opportunity to build a book of business from scratch in a category that every large enterprise will need to buy into over the next three years.

If you have spent the last decade building the right relationships in DACH and you are ready to put them to work in a market that is genuinely early, this is your moment. You will report directly to the Co-founder, have a sales engineer to handle technical discovery, and a channel person alongside you to build the partner ecosystem. Your job is to generate pipeline, navigate deals, and close.

No VP of Sales between you and the decision maker. No committee to approve your approach. Just a big market, a working product, and room to run.

What You’ll Do

  • Generate pipeline fast - primarily through your existing network. There is no inbound engine, no SDR handing you leads. You eat what you kill.

  • Own the full sales cycle end to end: sourcing → pilot → business case → negotiation → close

  • Target mid-market and enterprise accounts with €100K+ ACV potential, navigating multi-stakeholder deals across product, AI, IT, legal, and procurement

  • Be the face of Nebuly in DACH - at events, in conversations, in the market

Who You Are

jobs.descriptionHtml:
about us

Every 10 minutes, 18 million conversations happen between businesses and consumers around the world.

For decades, the consumer side of those conversations sucked: long queues, robotic menus, repeated explanations, and advice that is often unhelpful. Most people today still cannot simply say what their problem is in natural language when communicating with businesses.

AI changes that. For the first time, companies can have natural conversations with customers at massive scale. Every B2C company - from energy providers to telcos to insurers - will use AI agents to talk to their customers. The number of conversations businesses will handle is going to explode in the coming years.

At telli, we are solving the challenges that come with that shift. Today, leading B2C companies like Sky are already using telli to deploy thousands of voice agents to provide their customers with a new experience. But building a first voice agent is easy, getting it to drive real outcomes for customers and businesses is the hard part. telli helps companies build, deploy, and improve consumer-facing AI voice agents at scale. This will become one of the most important software categories of the next decade, and we intend to win it.

We are a small, AI-pilled team that likes to solve hard problems. Be it engineering, product, or GTM - we build, experiment, and move fast, while heavily leveraging the capabilities of AI models. All of us like to challenge ourselves and take real ownership over what we do, all while still staying humble and keeping a low-ego culture.

Check out our principles to see how we work.

jobs.title: Senior Sensor Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About TACTILIA

At TACTILIA, we are building the industry-ready robotic hand that closes one of the biggest gaps in Physical AI. Spun out of Schunk, the global market leader in gripping technology, we combine a decade of robotic-hand expertise and real industrial access with the speed and ambition of a deep-tech startup.

This isn't a research project waiting for its first customer. We already have a product, customers are ready to use it, and we are launching now. Your work will directly shape the electronics, actuators, and embedded systems that make that possible.

You will join at the moment when the hard engineering questions become real product decisions: how do we make a highly capable robotic hand reliable, manufacturable, serviceable, and simple enough to deploy on a real shop floor?

The Role

As a Senior Sensor Engineer (Tactile & Proprioception) at TACTILIA Robotics, you will build the neural architecture of physical touch and spatial awareness that gives our robotic hands human-like dexterity.

You will own the complete sensing architecture—from evaluating tactile technologies and proprioceptive layouts to designing readout electronics, calibration matrix algorithms, and real-time sensor pipelines.

Fitting high-density sensing skins, force feedback, and position tracking into a tight hand envelope means balancing signal integrity, low latency, and mechanical durability under high cyclic wear. You will work closely with Mechanics, Electronics, and Software to turn raw physical contact into clean, reliable data for real-time robotic control.

What you will do:

  • Own the sensing architecture. Lead the evaluation, selection, and overall design of tactile and proprioceptive sensing systems across fingers, palm, and joints—built for modularity across product variants, not a one-off prototype.

  • Develop tactile array hardware. Design and prototype high-resolution tactile sensors (optical, capacitive, piezoresistive, or magnetic) tailored for space-constrained, contact-rich finger pads and palm surfaces.

  • Engineer proprioceptive feedback. Implement joint- and drive-level feedback mechanisms, including high-precision position/angle sensing, strain gauge force bridges, load cells, and tendinous tension tracking.

  • Design readout electronics & AFEs. Build low-noise analog front-ends (AFEs), signal conditioning circuits, and local readout hardware optimized for minimal latency, wide dynamic range, and high immunity to electromagnetic interference (EMI).

  • Build calibration & processing pipelines. Implement automated calibration protocols, thermal/drift compensation matrix algorithms, and feature extraction (e.g., slip detection, contact point estimation) to feed clean telemetry to the software stack.

  • Characterize & validate on real hardware. Own sensor testing on custom rigs—evaluating dynamic response, force linearity, hysteresis, spatial resolution, and long-term mechanical wear over hundreds of thousands of cycles.

  • Drive sensor manufacturing & yield. Partner with specialized suppliers on Design for Manufacturing (DFM) for flexible/rigid-flex PCBs, molded tactile skins, and elastomeric components, ensuring high assembly yield and second-sourcing.

jobs.title: QA Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Transforming 50M+ daily events into real-time actionable dashboard insights

The Dashboards team is responsible for the systems and interfaces that define our partners' daily operations. We build the campaign management APIs, analytics engines, and high-throughput tools that allow advertisers and publishers to configure, monitor, and optimize their activity on our platform.

This is not about simple CRUD interfaces, it is about building high-performance data surfaces that drive massive business decisions. Using Go, Kafka, and Druid, we process and render real-time analytics across 50+ million daily events, ensuring accuracy and complex campaign performance reporting at scale. On the frontend, we tackle genuine engineering constraints: utilizing TypeScript and React, we have moved beyond standard library limitations to build highly optimized graph-rendering with Recharts capable of visualizing datasets that would overload conventional solutions.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • QA with 3 years+ hands on automation experience, alongside a strong manual testing foundation. You design and execute structured and exploratory test cases, validate complex user journeys across frontend and backend, and perform regression testing before releases. You identify edge cases and risk areas early and document clear, reproducible bug reports in Jira.

  • You contribute to UI and API test automation using Playwright, identify critical regression flows worth automating, and maintain existing test suites. CI/CD integration experience is a plus.

  • API and data testing is part of your toolkit. You test APIs and data-driven dashboard features, and have basic SQL knowledge for backend data validation. You understand what correct looks like at the data layer, not just the UI.

  • Quality ownership from day one. You participate in refinement and sprint planning from a QA perspective, help define acceptance criteria and test strategies, and proactively flag quality risks before they reach release.

  • Plus: Experience in SaaS, AdTech, or performance marketing environments.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (.NET Ecosystem)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the team

The Integrations Ecosystem org builds the drivers, SDKs, connectors and BI integrations that make ClickHouse feel native in any stack. The Language Clients team maintains the official clients for Python, JavaScript, Java, Go, Rust, C++ and C#, plus the ODBC, JDBC and ADBC drivers. We're small, senior and remote across North America and EMEA. Each client has a primary owner, but no client belongs to one person: we review and co-maintain across languages and decide cross-client questions together.

The role

We're looking for a product-minded engineer to own the ClickHouse .NET client. You'll decide what the client should do by talking to the developers who use it, reading the issues and the telemetry, and listening to the community. Then you'll build it, with deep .NET expertise, and measure whether it worked. Your scope is the SDK and what builds on it: ADO.NET, Dapper and Entity Framework Core users, and the tools and integrations that depend on your client.

What you'll do

  • Know who uses the client and what they're trying to do. Define what good looks like (time to first query, error clarity, adoption by key integrations), measure it, and let that drive the roadmap.

  • Be the voice of ClickHouse for .NET developers. Speak at .NET conferences and meet-ups, and write the posts, tutorials and samples that developers and AI assistants find when they search for how to use ClickHouse from .NET (SEO and GEO). Answer questions where the community asks them.

  • Own the .NET client and its ecosystem: the client, the EF Core provider and ORM integrations, NuGet releases and support. Evolve it without breaking the people who depend on it.

  • Review and co-maintain other clients, and take part in cross-client decisions on types, errors and protocol features.

  • Bring what .NET and Windows users need to the ODBC driver, since that's how many Windows and BI tools reach ClickHouse. If you write C++, contribute to it directly.

  • Bring written proposals about where we invest next. You set direction rather than wait for it.

  • Make the client enterprise-ready: TLS and certificate handling, authentication including Microsoft Entra ID, safe credential handling, signed and reproducible packages, and the audit and compliance questions large .NET shops ask before they adopt.

  • Shape the client for agents as users: an API, docs and error messages an AI coding agent can use correctly on the first try.

  • Extend our AI development platform, with new workflows for maintaining the clients: consistency checks across languages, issue triage, release checks.

About you

  • Product-minded. You decide what to build from user evidence, measure whether it worked, and can explain what you chose not to build.

  • 5+ years in software, much of it on data-intensive systems: drivers, SDKs, data access, ingestion or analytics.

  • Deep C# and .NET expertise: memory management, async and the TPL, Span and pooling, profiling and benchmarking. You reason about throughput and latency down to allocations and bytes on the wire, and you prove it with tests and benchmarks.

  • Fluent in C#, and productive in at least one more of our client languages (Python, JavaScript...
