jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mit über 650 Kolleg:innen an 19 Standorten in ganz Deutschland gestalten wir bei teccle die Zukunft der IT. Seit 2020 bringen wir starke IT-Unternehmen mit unterschiedlichsten Schwerpunkten unter einem Dach zusammen - und entwickeln uns so zu einem der führenden IT-Dienstleister im Land. Unser Ziel: IT-Lösungen schaffen, die wirklich weiterhelfen - verständlich, flexibel und zukunftsfähig. Für unsere Kund:innen und gemeinsam mit einem Team, das Technik genauso liebt wie neue Ideen.

 

Als Teil der teccle group steht die teccle motion für ganzheitliche IT-Lösungen und technische Exzellenz im Mittelstand. Zur Verstärkung unseres vierköpfigen Team Server in Ratingen suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt engagierte Unterstützung.

 

Was du bei uns bewegst

Bei uns zählt nicht nur, was du kannst - sondern auch, was du bewirkst. In dieser Rolle trägst du zu folgenden Punkten bei:

  • Entwicklung und Umsetzung moderner Server- und Cloud-Infrastrukturen auf Basis von Microsoft- und Azure-Technologien, die den Anforderungen unserer Kund:innen nachhaltig gerecht werden

  • Erfolgreiche Planung und Durchführung von Migrationsprojekten in On-Premises-, Hybrid- und Cloud-Umgebungen mit hohem Qualitäts- und Serviceanspruch

  • Gewährleistung eines stabilen, sicheren und leistungsfähigen Betriebs von Microsoft Server- und Infrastrukturplattformen über den gesamten Lebenszyklus hinweg

  • Sicherstellung hoher Verfügbarkeit und Betriebssicherheit durch proaktives Monitoring, Wartung und kontinuierliche Optimierung bestehender Umgebungen

  • Schnelle und nachhaltige Lösung technischer Herausforderungen im Infrastruktur- und Serverumfeld zur Minimierung von Ausfallzeiten und Betriebsrisiken

  • Steuerung und Umsetzung von Kundenprojekten von der technischen Konzeption über die Realisierung bis zur vollständigen Dokumentation

  • Beitrag zum nachhaltigen Erfolg der teccle group durch die erfolgreiche Umsetzung von Infrastrukturprojekten und die Sicherstellung einer hohen Kundenzufriedenheit

 

Womit du bei uns glänzt

Niemand erfüllt jede Anforderung. Wenn du neugierig bist und Lust auf die Aufgabe hast, freuen wir uns auch dann auf deine Bewerbung, wenn nicht alles zu 100% passt.

jobs.title: Sales Operations Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Sales Operations Intern (m/w/d), you will keep the engine behind our sales teams running cleanly: you own recurring CRM hygiene, accurate user set-up and reliable bonus data so reps can spend their time selling. Supporting the Head of Sales Operations and the GTM Engineer, you will work across a global, multi-market and two-tier sales organisation, partnering with Sales Leads, Customer Service and the Data team to turn messy inputs into decisions people can trust. From your first month you take real ownership of the processes that keep user management, bonus calculations and reporting accurate.

PERGOLUX designs and sells premium, Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from aluminium pergolas to awnings and garden furniture, direct to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue and operations across our core markets, and Sales Operations sits at the centre of how that growth is planned, measured and paid.

What You'll Do

- Onboard and offboard sales users across HubSpot, Aircall and our messaging tools (seats, permissions, teams and task queues), keep the set-up aligned to the org chart, and run a monthly seat and licence check.

- Prepare the monthly data for bonus calculations for Sales Leads, Tier 2 reps and the Tier 1 partner, check inputs against source data (orders, attribution, owner changes, returns), and flag exceptions before payout.

- Run recurring CRM hygiene programmes (duplicates, missing or wrong fields, wrong owners, stale deals and tasks, inactive workflows), track data quality per market, and follow up with Sales Leads where logging standards slip.

- Pull and prepare weekly and monthly sales reports from HubSpot, Looker and spreadsheets, and answer ad hoc questions such as conversion by market, speed to lead, task backlog or rep activity.

- Support the GTM Engineer with data checks and analysis for capacity planning and productivity projects, and act as first point of contact when reps are stuck with access or tool issues.

What You'll Bring

- Enrolled or recently graduated with Bachelor's or Master's degree in business, economics, information systems, data or a related field.

- Strong spreadsheet skills (lookups, pivots, clean formulas) and an eye for numbers that do not add up.

- Structured and reliable: you finish recurring tasks on time, every time, and document what you do.

- Fluent English.

- Nice to have: first experience with a CRM (HubSpot or Salesforce) or a BI tool (Looker, Tableau, Power BI), basic SQL, German or another market language, and an interest in sales, operations and AI tools.

💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch

🚀 Growth and Career Development — You get real ownership of recurring processes from the start with direct impact on how a multi-market sales organisation is run, you learn hands-on HubSpot administration, CRM data governance, Looker reporting and how incentive schemes are designed and tested, and you work alongside an international, collaborative team with fast-track opportunities to grow as PERGOLUX scales.

⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK

🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Specialist - Meta
jobs.descriptionHtml:
You will own and scale our Meta advertising ecosystem, acting as the driving force behind demand generation and revenue growth across Facebook and Instagram. Your mission is to maximize conversion volume while maintaining a strong Marketing Efficiency Ratio (MER), ensuring every euro invested delivers measurable business impact. At PERGOLUX, we combine data-driven performance with a premium, design-led brand experience, supported by a collaborative and ambitious international team.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the end-to-end management of Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram), including campaign structure, scaling strategy, and performance optimization

  • Manage and optimize budget allocation and pacing to ensure efficient spend and consistent contribution to MER targets

  • Analyze campaign performance to generate actionable insights, proactively identifying growth opportunities and areas for improvement

  • Lead testing initiatives across audiences, creatives, and formats to continuously improve performance and unlock new scaling opportunities

  • Act as the key link between performance and creative by translating data into clear feedback for the Global Creative Team

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience managing Meta Ads accounts, ideally in an e-commerce or D2C environment

  • Strong analytical mindset with proven ability to optimize toward profitability metrics such as MER, ROAS, and CPA

  • Deep understanding of Meta’s advertising ecosystem, including campaign structures, audience strategies, and conversion tracking

  • Experience working closely with creative teams, with the ability to guide creative production based on performance data

  • High ownership mentality with a proactive, solution-oriented approach to scaling paid social performance

Benefits

  • Competitive Salary – Your contribution is rewarded with strong, market-aligned compensation.

  • Company Pension Scheme – Benefit from a company-supported pension plan to help secure your long-term financial future.

  • Real Ownership – Take meaningful responsibility in your role and directly influence key business outcomes.

  • International Team – Collaborate with passionate colleagues across Europe, gaining exposure to diverse perspectives and ideas.

  • Outdoor Lifestyle Discounts – Enjoy exclusive discounts on PERGOLUX products.

  • Fast-Track Career Opportunities – As we scale quickly, you’ll have significant opportunities to grow into senior leadership roles.

  • Team Culture – Be part of regular team events, retreats, and a culture that celebrates wins—big and small.

  • Bike Leasing Program – Benefit from a sustainable and cost-effective bike leasing option to support commuting and an active lifestyle.

How to Apply

Ready to scale performance through paid social? Apply via our PERGOLUX LinkedIn or explore more opportunities on our .

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

We’re building out our founding Germany BDR team to generate leads and fill the top of our sales funnel as we launch the go-to-market function from the ground up. This is a unique opportunity to shape the sales function in a hyper-growth environment and work closely with senior leadership to drive revenue and impact. This role will support both inbound and outbound sales motions — engaging with dental practices who express interest in Dandy while also proactively generating new opportunities through outbound prospecting.

What You’ll Do

  • Be the first point of contact for a wide range of dental practice prospects.

  • Generate new business through outbound channels including email, phone, and creative outreach tactics.

  • Track sales activity using Salesforce and other tools, and continuously improve your processes.

  • Pitch the Dandy value proposition, handle objections, and move prospects through the funnel.

  • Collaborate closely with Account Executives for seamless client handoffs.

  • Contribute ideas to build the FR BDR function from scratch — your feedback will shape our processes, tools, and strategy.

What We're Looking For

  • 1-2+ years of professional sales experience in a high-growth environment

  • Language requirements: Fluent English and native-level German

  • Experience with cold calling (SMB targets are a big plus)

  • Commitment to continuous improvement and desire to learn new sales concepts via rigorous trainings

  • Ability to punch through ambiguity and ramp up quickly

  • Experience with standard sales tools and a desire to explore and implement new tools to further streamline the sales process

  • Overall track record of professional and academic success

  • With the above stated, we are open to candidates of all backgrounds and encourage you to apply if interested!

Nice to Have

  • Experience with marketplace models

  • Relentlessly positive attitude, strong sense of humor, and the ability to have fun at work

  • A history of high achievement: We value non-traditional backgrounds if you've shown deep discipline and excelled at something outside of work (e.g., competitive sports, music, or a major personal project).

Req ID: J-1200

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mechanical Engineering / Composite Structures Intern

We are looking for a Mechanical Engineering / Composite Structures Intern to support the design, manufacture, testing, and improvement of the composite structures used in our launch vehicles.

This is a hands-on opportunity to work closely with structural engineers, composite manufacturing engineers, technicians, and the workshop team. You will contribute to real hardware while developing practical experience across CAD, composite materials, manufacturing processes, structural testing, and engineering analysis.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

  • Support the design and modelling of primary and secondary composite structures, components, joints, and interfaces.

  • Prepare and support structural tests, material characterisation, inspections, and data collection.

  • Document work clearly and contribute to process improvements across design, manufacturing, and testing.

What we are looking for

  • Currently studying mechanical engineering, aerospace engineering, materials science, composite engineering, or a related subject.

As Procurement Specialist, you will take a hands-on role in managing purchasing activities, developing supplier relationships, supporting negotiations, and coordinating contracts across the business.

Desirable experience

  • Experience with procurement process improvement, ERP implementation, or structured procurement controls.

Chemical Engineer

jobs.title: Propulsion Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Propulsion Engineer - Solid Rocket Motors

We are looking for a Propulsion Engineer to support the design, development, manufacture, testing, and qualification of the solid rocket motors used on our orbital launch vehicle. This is a hands-on role covering the full motor development cycle, from preliminary design through static-fire testing and flight qualification.

 

You will work as part of the project team delivering an orbital-class launch vehicle, contributing to the development of propulsion hardware, engineering analysis, test campaigns, and the tools required to support motor and vehicle-level design.

 

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

 

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

 

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

 

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

 

Key responsibilities

  • Contribute to the design and development of solid rocket motors from preliminary design through detailed design, manufacturing readiness, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Perform engineering analysis covering relevant aspects of internal ballistics, grain geometry, motor performance, nozzle design, motor cases, and structural sizing.

  • Develop or extend Python-based analysis and simulation tools for ballistic simulation, performance prediction, structural sizing, and related design activities.

  • Translate vehicle-level performance requirements—including total impulse, burn time, thrust profile, and mass fraction—into motor-level design specifications.

  • Feed measured motor performance data back into vehicle-level design and sizing tools.

  • Support the definition and execution of verification and validation activities, including analysis, subscale and component testing, static-fire testing, and flight qualification.

  • Support the planning and execution of static-fire test campaigns, including instrumentation requirements, test preparation, and post-test data analysis.

  • Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, test plans, analysis reports, and clear records of design assumptions and results.

  • Work closely with structures, manufacturing, chemistry, systems, and vehicle engineering teams to manage interfaces and cross-disciplinary design impacts.

  • Contribute to the development of engineering methods, tools, and processes as the propulsion team and company scale.

Senior Propulsion Engineer

We are looking for a Senior Propulsion Engineer to own solid rocket motor propulsion projects from requirements through design, manufacture, testing, iteration, and production readiness. This is an end-to-end role for an engineer who wants to see a product through to a working result rather than owning only one isolated part of the design process.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching suborbital and ballistic rockets on a regular basis, generating significant revenue and applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

  • Own small-to-medium propulsion projects from requirements definition to tested and production-ready hardware.

  • Perform and review design and analysis covering relevant aspects of internal ballistics, grain geometry, performance, nozzles, structures, and motor cases.

  • Coordinate design, manufacture, assembly, instrumentation, static-fire testing, post-test analysis, and redesign.

  • Work with chemistry and manufacturing teams to select materials and propellant solutions that meet performance and production requirements.

  • Prepare technical documentation, design reviews, test plans, and analysis reports.

  • Support qualification, customer demonstrations, productionisation, and the development of junior engineers.

What we are looking for

  • A degree in aerospace, mechanical, chemical engineering, or a related discipline.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Als Senior Strategy & Project Manager im Management Office verantwortest du eigenständig strategische Projekte mit hohem Business Impact und unterstützt primär unsere Geschäftsführung als analytischer Sparringspartner bei zentralen unternehmerischen Fragestellungen. Du treibst High-Impact-Initiativen voran, behältst die relevanten KPIs im Blick und trägst so unmittelbar zur erfolgreichen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung von LIQID bei.

Diese Position bietet eine einzigartige Gelegenheit, tiefgehende Einblicke in das Management und die verschiedensten Bereiche eines der innovativsten Scale-Ups im Bereich Financial Services zu gewinnen und direkten Einfluss auf die Weiterentwicklung von LIQID zu nehmen.

Die Stelle ist ab sofort zu besetzen. Aufgrund der Nähe zum Senior Management ist eine hohe Präsenz im Berliner Büro Voraussetzung.


Was machst du dabei konkret?

  • Strategische Projekte: Du leitest High-Impact-Initiativen end-to-end, treibst deren Umsetzung voran und bist dabei inhaltlich tief in den Themen involviert, um die bestmöglichen Lösungen zu erarbeiten.

  • Datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung: Du hast einen Blick auf alle relevanten KPIs, leitest fundierte Empfehlungen ab und trägst dazu bei, datengetriebene Entscheidungen zu treffen. Für unsere Geschäftsführung bist du dabei ein Key Sparrings Partner.

  • Business Impact & strategische Analysen: Du erstellst Entscheidungsgrundlagen, Business Cases und Analysen zu zentralen strategischen Fragestellungen und stellst sicher, dass strategische Prioritäten effizient umgesetzt werden.

  • Business Transformation: Du identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale in Prozessen und Strukturen innerhalb eines oder über Teams hinweg und treibst die kontinuierliche organisatorische Weiterentwicklung.

  • Cross-funktionale Zusammenarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit den Executive und Leadership Teams sowie den Fachbereichen zusammen, koordinierst über Teamgrenzen hinweg und sorgst für eine reibungslose Umsetzung.

  • Stakeholder Management: Du bist eine zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen unserem CEO, der Geschäftsführung und externen Stakeholdern. Du pflegst du den Kontakt zu Partnern und Investoren, bereitest Updates und Unterlagen vor und unterstützt den CEO und die Geschäftsführung bei strategischen Diskussionen.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
tonies is the world’s leading interactive audio platform for children, with over 12 million Tonieboxes and 173 million Tonies sold globally. Our intuitive, screen-free system empowers children to learn and play independently in a safe and engaging way.

With a presence in over 100 countries and a diverse portfolio of ~1,500 Tonies across multiple languages, we continue to redefine how children experience storytelling and learning. Since our IPO in 2021, our global team of 630+ colleagues is united by a shared mission: shaping the future of play, learning, and imagination.

Senior Indirect Tax Manager (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

As Senior Indirect Tax Manager in our Global Tax function, you are the go-to person for European VAT and a trusted sparring partner for our growing international business. You give pragmatic, business-minded advice on VAT, sales tax and GST across our markets. You also build the structures and processes behind it: VAT set-ups in SAP Public Cloud, well-documented indirect tax processes and smart automation using modern tools, including AI.

What you'll do

  • Lead & Advise: Drive our European VAT agenda, manage global sales tax/GST, and advise internal teams on cross-border trade, e-commerce, and marketplace taxation.

  • System & Process: Build and maintain VAT logic in SAP Public Cloud, translating complex tax requirements into actionable guidelines for daily accounting operations.

  • Risk & Compliance: Document tax processes to audit-ready standards, conduct local risk assessments (e.g., VAT, plastic taxes), and implement consistent tax frameworks across projects.

  • Business Partnering: Collaborate with Finance, Operations, E-commerce, and Supply Chain to embed VAT compliance across the value chain and proactively address commercial shifts.

  • Regulatory Monitoring: Track global regulatory changes (e.g., digital reporting, ViDA, platform rules) and ensure timely organizational compliance.

  • Filing & Reporting: Oversee and be capable of preparing the accurate and timely preparation, review, and filing of VAT returns, EC sales lists, Intrastat, and other statutory filings.

  • Digital Transformation: Drive the automation of tax workflows using Alteryx for data analytics and AI tools (Gemini, Claude) to boost efficiency and consistency.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Challenge advice from external tax consultants and translate their findings into plain English for non-tax colleagues.

  • Project Management: Own end-to-end tax projects—from scoping to execution—while independently aligning internal and external stakeholders.

  • Strategic Impact: Report to the Global Tax Lead, ensuring tax considerations are fully integrated into broader business strategies and decision-making.

What You Bring

  • Degree in Business, Tax, Law, or a related field with a strong focus on taxation.

jobs.title: Head of Growth // AI Music Video Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Neural Frames is a leading AI music video generator, turning any song into a fully produced music video in minutes. We're bootstrapped, profitable, and generating more than $7M in annualized revenue. Our ambition is to build a category-defining company that helps tens of millions of audio creators visualize and promote their work. Our next target is a $15M run rate.

We grew around 3x in the last year with a small team and a founder who ran most of growth himself. We now have specialists across content, creators, design, paid, SEO and growth engineering, and we need the person who leads them: someone who owns the numbers, sets the direction and still does the work.

As our Head of Growth, you'll work directly beside the founder. You'll own new top of funnel traffic, paying customers, and acquisition cost, decide where the team spends its time, approve what goes out, and personally work on whatever is the biggest bottleneck. You'll also build the rest of the marketing team.

Tasks

  • Own our growth numbers: top of funnel traffic, new paying customers, acquisition cost by channel

  • Set quarterly goals, run the weekly growth meeting, and make sure every person on the team owns one number

  • Work hands-on on the biggest bottleneck, from landing page tests and onboarding emails to paid campaigns and creator deals

  • Approve paid creatives and content, and raise the creative and messaging bar across the team

  • Come up with the big messaging ideas, test them across landing pages, ads, social and email, and keep what wins

  • Build AI workflows and automations that make the whole team faster

  • Lead and grow the marketing team, including hiring the next roles

  • Plan and run campaigns such as product launches and seasonal offers together with product

Requirements

  • You have owned growth numbers at a B2C or self-serve product, ideally a consumer subscription or creator tool, and can show what you changed in paying customers, conversion or acquisition cost

  • You are hands-on. You still build campaigns, tests and ads yourself, and you're happy doing it

  • You have deep expertise in at least one of SEO/GEO, performance marketing or social media growth, and a good working knowledge of the others

  • You have a strong eye for creative and messaging, and you know how to improve an ad based on its numbers

  • AI is fully part of how you work. You build your own automations, agents and bots, and can show us some

  • You are analytical and comfortable in tools like PostHog, SQL and ad managers

  • You have built something on your own, whether a company, a side project, music or a sport, and you bring that drive to work

  • You communicate clearly, challenge directly and take ownership without waiting for instructions

  • You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • You have led people before, and you make the people around you better

jobs.title: Executive Assistant - AI & Business Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fully remote | Working directly with the CEO | Monthly compensation in USD

About Us

We are a startup where priorities can change quickly, processes are still developing and several important initiatives often run in parallel. We are looking for someone who enjoys this environment and can bring structure, calm and reliable execution to a busy working day. Our work spans HR, finance, IT and marketing, with AI playing a practical role in how we organise information, coordinate work and improve processes.

Job Description

As Executive Assistant to the CEO, you will be a trusted right hand who turns priorities into clear actions and follows them through to completion. You will anticipate needs, organise competing demands, coordinate people and maintain a reliable overview of what requires attention across the business.

Inbox and calendar management form part of the role, alongside broader responsibility for organising projects, improving workflows, preparing decisions and keeping commitments on track.

You should bring practical experience using AI to accomplish meaningful work. This includes creating and using reusable AI skills: structured instructions, relevant context and tools that help an AI assistant perform recurring tasks consistently. You should be comfortable adapting these workflows, checking their outputs and recognising when human judgement or specialist input is needed.

You should be comfortable with the pace, uncertainty and pressure that can come with building a startup. This means adapting when plans change, handling competing requests and maintaining sound judgement under time pressure. You will help the CEO and team set realistic priorities, make trade-offs and identify when workload or deadlines need to be adjusted.

Key Responsibilities

  • Translate the CEO's priorities into actionable plans with clear owners, deadlines and follow-up.
  • Maintain an overview of ongoing initiatives, identify dependencies and flag delays or decisions early.
  • Coordinate work across the startup team, external partners and service providers.
  • Prepare concise research, meeting briefs, comparisons and recommendations that support decisions.
  • Organise meetings, correspondence and schedules, capturing decisions and ensuring agreed actions are completed.
  • Support HR operations through recruitment coordination, onboarding, documentation and follow-up.
  • Support finance operations by organising invoices, expenses, payment schedules and information needed by accounting specialists.
  • Support marketing initiatives by organising briefs, assets, deadlines and collaboration with internal and external contributors.
  • Coordinate IT requests, access requirements, software subscriptions and communication with technical colleagues.
  • Organise and improve how the CEO and startup team use Microsoft 365, keeping communication, documents, tasks and shared information structured and accessible.
  • Connect Microsoft tools with suitable AI skills and workflows, respecting permissions and confidentiality.

This role blends deep Epic front-end expertise with strategic thinking, creative problem-solving, and strong cross-functional collaboration to deliver integrated solutions that streamline the patient experience and advance how Revenue Cycle operates.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Assima is a global software company helping enterprise organizations achieve faster digital adoption and greater value from their technology investments. Trusted by many of the world's largest companies, Assima's award-winning platform enables organizations to deliver hyper-realistic training and performance support for complex business applications. As the company continues to expand across Europe, this is an opportunity to play a highly visible role, reporting directly to the CEO and shaping strategic partnerships with some of the world's most influential consulting and transformation firms.

We are hiring a Business Development Representative (BDR) based in the Benelux region to manage the entire sales cycle — from generating new meetings to running opportunities through to closing. This is a commercial role, focused on revenue generation, with SaaS or technology experience considered a strong advantage.

The role is home‑based, with very limited travel. Most prospecting, discovery calls, demos, and sales cycles are delivered via Microsoft Teams.

This position reports directly to the CEO.

Fluency in English and Dutch are mandatory.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities across the Benelux region through outbound outreach, inbound follow‑up, and targeted prospecting.
  • Manage the full sales cycle: qualification, discovery, demos, proposals, negotiation, and closure.
  • Deliver high‑quality virtual demos and presentations via Teams.
  • Build strong relationships with prospects at all levels, including senior stakeholders.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasting, and CRM discipline.
  • Work closely with Marketing and Partner teams to maximize lead flow and opportunity creation.
  • Represent the company professionally in all customer interactions.

Requirements

  • 3–7+ years in business development, inside sales, or full‑cycle B2B sales.
  • Proven success generating meetings and closing deals.
  • Experience in SaaS, enterprise software, or technology sales is a strong advantage.
  • Confident running virtual sales cycles end‑to‑end.
  • Fluency in English and Dutch (written and spoken) are essential.

Personal Attributes

  • Hungry, ambitious, and target‑driven.
  • Strong communicator with excellent relationship‑building skills.
  • Confident presenting and selling virtually.
  • Organized, disciplined, and able to manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
  • Resilient, proactive, and comfortable in a fast‑moving environment.

jobs.title: Project Manager, Finance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Project Manager, Finance is responsible for leading complex, cross-functional finance and financial systems initiatives that support Brightspeed’s strategic and operational objectives. This role plans, executes, and delivers projects that improve financial processes, system performance, data integrity, and business outcomes across Finance, IT, and the broader enterprise.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead end-to-end delivery of Finance and financial systems projects, including scope, timelines, milestones, and resource planning.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, ensuring alignment with business priorities, budgets, and delivery commitments.
  • Facilitate project kickoff, stakeholder alignment, and ongoing governance to ensure clarity of objectives and accountability.
  • Manage day-to-day execution of projects, ensuring deliverables are completed on schedule and within scope.
  • Partner with Finance, IT, FP&A, Operations, Consumer, Business, and external vendors to ensure seamless project execution and system integration.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, providing clear, timely communication on progress, risks, and issues.
  • Manage User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for Finance initiatives, including test planning, coordination, defect tracking, and resolution.
  • Identify, assess, and mitigate project risks; escalate issues as needed to protect timelines, budgets, and outcomes.
  • Manage change control processes when scope, timelines, or requirements evolve.
  • Track project budgets, forecasts, and resource utilization to ensure strong financial stewardship.
  • Ensure data accuracy, integrity, and compliance through strong governance, documentation, and control processes.
  • Drive continuous improvement by identifying process gaps, system inefficiencies, and opportunities for automation and optimization.
  • Conduct post-implementation reviews and lessons-learned sessions to strengthen future project delivery.

Education & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field required.
  • 5–10 years of experience in project management supporting Finance, financial systems, or enterprise technology initiatives.
  • Experience managing cross-functional programs involving IT, Finance, and business operations.
  • Experience developing project plans, business requirements, test plans, and release readiness artifacts.

Skills & Competencies

  • Strong project leadership, organization, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to translate business needs into actionable project plans and delivery roadmaps.
  • Proficiency in Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.
  • Experience using project and delivery tools such as Jira, Confluence, Microsoft Project, Smartsheet, Zephyr, QTest, or similar platforms.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and risk management skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience working with financial and enterprise platforms such as SAP S/4HANA, BRIM, RAR, ARIBA, Salesforce, billing, cash applications, and reporting tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Accounting, Business, Finance, Information Systems, or a related field.
  • PMP, ScrumMaster, or other project management or Agile certifications.
  • Experience in telecommunications, subscription-based, or high-volume transaction environments.
  • Experience with analytics and reporting tools such as Looker, Power BI, or SQL.

Physical Demands & Work Conditions

  • Primarily office-based or remote work environment with prolonged use of a computer and standard office equipment.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Welcome to Epos Now - we're a leading fintech business, with a mission to help small businesses grow and thrive using our cloud-based software. We are rapidly developing (with offices across the world), and want to expand our US sales teams to support further growth this year. As a sales consultant, you will be the first interaction for many prospective customers looking for a tech-led solution to their challenges. As a driven, confident and resilient sales professional, you will take accountability for nurturing your leads, building your pipelines and exceeding your targets month on month. In return, we have a brilliant commission rate (with no upper limit!), so your earning potential is as good as your sales ability. Plus we offer a great career progression plan, fully-paid training for the role, and fun, supportive teams.

What will you do?

Sales are where the action is! You will…

  • Sell the benefits of our products
  • Listen to customer needs and identify opportunities
  • Deliver first class service

What do you need to apply?

  • Direct sales experience
  • A passion for providing an exceptional customer experience
  • Outstanding communication skills, with a great phone manner
  • The drive to meet and exceed your set KPIs
  • Resilience and the ability to have challenging conversations and overcome objections
  • Adaptability and willingness to learn
  • Confidence and a positive attitude

What might help your application stand out?

  • Phone-based sales experience
  • Previous experience exceeding targets/KPIs
  • Demonstrated ability to problem-solve with customers
  • Being tech-savvy and knowledgeable about current tech/software products

What will you get in return?

  • Work from home - fully remote
  • Uncapped commission on top of your salary
  • Career progression opportunities – our philosophy is to promote internally
  • One month of fully paid induction training and ongoing training opportunities
  • Loads of employee benefits through our award-winning program!

Why EposNow?

Epos Now is a market-leading fintech business. We proudly deliver a top inbound sales service to our customers across the world, with offices in the UK, Australia, and the USA. And our success is evident.

As part of our development, we also want to ensure our staff get the best from us too. Every employee at Epos Now has a personalised progression plan to identify a clear, achievable career path for success. It's an exciting time to join!

What are the next steps?

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote (Worldwide)

Job Summary: In this role, you’ll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design, evaluate, and critique chemistry and computational chemistry problems, workflows, and reasoning chains to support AI benchmarking initiatives.

  5. Computational chemistry & molecular dynamics
  6. Cheminformatics & drug discovery
  7. Materials science & polymer chemistry

Preferred Qualifications:

  1. Academic experience (postdoc, research scientist, faculty, or equivalent), strongly preferred.
  2. Peer-reviewed publications, patents, or contributions to open-source scientific software.
  3. Experience with AI/ML-assisted chemistry workflows or benchmarking.
  4. Background in drug discovery, reaction prediction, or retrosynthesis.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Title: Music & Sound Annotation Expert

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Music & Sound Annotation Experts to contribute to a customer's project at the forefront of music and audio technology.

Your ears are the ground truth. You'll listen to short field recordings and document exactly what's audible — instruments, tempo, key, background sounds, crowd reactions — through a structured web platform built for this project. Later phases involve grading AI model answers against what you actually heard.

What you'll do

  1. Listen to 30–90 second field recordings (headphones, your own quiet workspace) and complete structured annotations: which instruments are present, tempo and key, timestamps of background events (traffic, sirens, applause), scene details
  2. Compare paired recordings of the same song captured at different locations and judge what stayed the same and what changed
  3. In later phases: review AI model descriptions of clips and mark what's correct, wrong, or invented, with a brief written explanation
  4. Attend a paid onboarding/calibration session and a short weekly sync

Who we're looking for (any of these backgrounds)

  1. Working or gigging musicians, session players, producers, or mixing engineers
  2. Music educators, ear-training instructors, band/choir directors, conservatory students or graduates
  3. Location sound recordists, sound designers, foley artists, or podcast/documentary audio editors

Requirements

  1. 3+ years of hands-on music or audio experience
  2. Strong analytical listening: you can pick individual instruments out of a busy, noisy, real-world mix — not just studio recordings
  3. Can identify tempo (within a few BPM) and musical key (relative pitch with a reference is fine)
  4. Comfortable with detail-oriented, repetitive annotation work in a web platform — dropdowns, timestamps, short structured notes
  5. Clear written English for brief, evidence-based notes (e.g., "accordion enters around 0:12")
  6. Quality headphones, quiet workspace, reliable internet
  7. Available 20–25 hrs/week for the engagement window

jobs.title: Palkkahallinnon asiantuntija
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Tartutko rohkeasti toimeen uusien haasteiden edessä? Onko erinomainen asiakaspalvelu sinulle luontaista? Jos vastasit kyllä, hae meille palkanlaskijaksi Hoivatiimiimme!

Palkkahallinnon asiantuntijana Talenomilla

Tehtävässä huolehdit itsenäisesti sinulle nimettyjen asiakkaiden palkanlaskentaprosessista ja sen kehittämisestä toimien asiakkaiden luottohenkilönä palkka-asioissa. Toivomme, että sinulla on vähintään 2-3 vuoden kokemus palkanlaskennasta ja olet ehtinyt kartuttaa varmuutta itsenäiseen asiakasvastuuseen. Eduksesi katsotaan myös aiempi kokemus hoiva-alalta.

Arvostamme sitä, että hallitset palkanlaskennan prosessit kokonaisuutena, työskentelet järjestelmällisesti myös kiireen keskellä ja pystyt tuottamaan asiakkaalle lisäarvoa konsultoivalla otteella.

Nautit vuorovaikutuksesta, uskallat tarttua haasteisiin ja viet asiat loppuun saakka laadukkaasti sekä täsmällisesti. Lähestyt uusia asioita avoimesti ja innolla ja kehitätkin osaamistasi aktiivisesti. Osaat johtaa omaa työtäsi, priorisoida ja pitää useat kokonaisuudet hallinnassa samanaikaisesti. 

Työskentely tapahtuu pääasiassa suomeksi, mutta englannin kielen osaamisesta on etua tehtävässä. Katsomme eduksesi myös kokemuksen Mepco-järjestelmistä. Hoivatiimi ja sen esihenkilö työskentelevät pääasiallisesti Oulussa, mutta sinä voit työskennellä myös etänä toiselta paikkakunnalta.

Miksi valitsisit meidät?

Vaikka etsimme itsenäistä, oma-aloitteista ja vastuullista ihmistä, saat seuraksesi parhaat työkaverit ja heidän tukensa. Tiimisi auttaa sinua matkan varrella ja luo yhteenkuuluvuuden tunnetta. Yhteishenki onkin yksi tärkeimmistä voimavaroistamme ja arjessamme on tilaa naurulle sekä rennolle, positiiviselle hengelle. Talenomille jokainen on myös tervetullut omana itsenään. 

Meille henkilökohtainen kehitys on strateginen valinta. Tarjoamme monenlaisia koulutuksia, joiden avulla voit viedä osaamisesi seuraavalle tasolle. Jotta kehitys on mahdollista myös käytännössä, huolehdimme myös työntekijöidemme hyvinvoinnista ja jaksamisesta. Voit tutustua palkanlaskentaamme tarkemminurasivuillamme.


Liity joukkoomme ja nouse kanssamme palkkahallinnon huipulle!

Tehtävän palkkahaitari on 2300–3450 euroa määräytyen tehtävään valittujen aiemman kokemuksen sekä osaamisen perusteella. Hakuaika päättyy 29.11.2026, mutta haastattelut voidaan osittain aloittaa jo hakuaikana. Työn aloitusajankohta sovitaan valitun henkilön kanssa, mutta toivomme että pystyt aloittamaan tammikuun aikana.

Jäikö jokin vielä askarruttamaan? Voit olla yhteydessä Hanna-Leena Lauroseen, p. 0207 52 5164, tai Tiia-Maria Kreiviin, p. 0293 722131

Tehtävään valittavalta henkilöltä tarkastetaan luottotiedot.

Tietoa meistä

Talenom on ketterä taloushallinnon palvelutalo sekä yksi Suomen suurimmista tilitoimistoista. Mikä on salaisuutemme? Talenomilaiset ovat oman alansa ammattilaisia, tekijöistä parhaimpia. Meidät tunnetaan aktiivisesta otteestamme sekä ainutlaatuisesta palveluvalikoimastamme. Meillä on myös maan parhaimmat asiakkaat, joille voimme tarjota markkinoiden edistyksellisimpiä taloushallinnon ratkaisuja.

Työntekijät ovat meidän tärkein voimavaramme ja yksi tärkeimmistä tavoitteistamme on työntekijöiden hyvinvointi. Haluamme jatkuvasti kehittää toimintatapojamme saavuttaaksemme luottamuksen, ylpeyden ja yhteishengen työntekijöiden keskuudessa. Meille on myös myönnetty Great Place to Work –sertifikaatti osoituksena hyvästä työpaikasta ja suomalaisen työelämän suunnannäyttämisestä.

jobs.title: Project Manager - Employee Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Net at Work

Founded in 1996, Net at Work is one of North America’s largest technology advisors and solution providers for small and mid-size businesses. Our award-winning consultancy offers a rich portfolio of next-generation technology, industry expertise, implementation and managed services to help organizations derive value from the transformative benefits of technology.

Through the integration of ERP, HCM and/or CRM solutions, Net at Work offers unique, industry-specific solutions and operation platforms that enable companies to compete more effectively in today’s digital economy. For more information, visit www.netatwork.com.

About this Position

The Employee Experience Project Manager (PM) is responsible for the successful planning, coordination, and delivery of Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions for Net at Work clients. This role centers around client excellence—building trusted partnerships, maintaining high satisfaction levels, and driving long-term value. The PM works directly with clients to clarify business requirements, propose scalable solutions, and ensure smooth implementation. They serve as the key liaison between clients and internal teams, leveraging strong communication, leadership, and problem-solving skills. The PM also supports the sales team by contributing to project scoping and helping to expand client relationships through ongoing service opportunities.

Job Responsibilities

🔹 Client Relationship Management & Client Excellence

  • Serve as the trusted advisor and primary contact for clients throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Build strong, lasting relationships with client stakeholders, ensuring satisfaction and long-term engagement.
  • Maintain a proactive approach to client communications, providing strategic updates and anticipating needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to align project execution with client goals and desired outcomes.
  • Ensure a seamless handoff to post-implementation support teams, maintaining continuity and trust.
  • Identify opportunities for additional services or support, contributing to account growth and retention.

🔹 Project Planning & Initiation

  • Define detailed project plans, including timelines, milestones, budgets, and resource requirements.
  • Coordinate team onboarding and ensure readiness for project execution.
  • Share pre-kickoff materials (e.g., questionnaires, onboarding materials) with clients.
  • Lead internal and external project kickoff meetings.

🔹 Project Execution & Coordination

  • Direct project execution in alignment with defined schedules, budgets, and scope.
  • Coordinate and assign tasks across the project team to ensure timely delivery.
  • Monitor progress and make necessary adjustments to meet client expectations.
  • Track milestones and timelines, adjusting workflows and resources as needed.
  • Ensure smaller projects are progressing appropriately, even if formal meetings are not required.
  • Monitor third-party project status and follow up on closure timelines.

🔹 Client & Stakeholder Communication

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all project stakeholders internally and externally.
  • Conduct regular project status calls based on project size and complexity.
  • Send project status summary emails and post meeting recaps/status reports to the project folder.
  • Maintain an up-to-date project plan and communicate changes proactively internally and with the client.
  • Provide timely updates to clients and executive leadership.

🔹 Issue Management & Risk Mitigation

About the Company
Cytovale is a leading innovator in early sepsis detection, revolutionizing emergency care with its advanced IntelliSep technology. This system provides rapid, actionable insights into a patient's likelihood of having or developing sepsis through a quick 8-minute blood test. IntelliSep's unique capability to assess immune dysregulation enhances the triage and treatment of sepsis, promoting patient-centered care, operational efficiencies, and provider satisfaction. Cytovale is committed to successful implementation, clinical adoption, and continual improvement of healthcare outcomes.

Position Overview:
The Customer Success Executive (CSE) plays a critical leadership role in leading enterprise implementations of IntelliSep across health systems. As the overall implementation leader and program owner, the CSE orchestrates cross-functional implementation activities, drives implementation governance, aligns customer and internal stakeholders, manages implementation risks, and maintains accountability for successful implementation outcomes.

The CSE provides implementation leadership by orchestrating cross-functional execution across Medical Affairs, Field Application Scientists, Data Science, Sales, Customer Service, and other internal functions. While accountable for overall implementation success, the CSE leverages the expertise of functional teams responsible for technical, clinical, operational, and commercial execution within their respective areas of ownership.

Our team is redefining the industry – and creating a culture of excellence.

Founded in 2011, Atlantic Coast Mortgage embodies a people-first culture rooted in commitment, character, and innovation. What began as a small team has grown into a thriving organization where our people remain the driving force behind our mission to redefine the mortgage industry. We believe individuals do their best work in an environment designed for success—and we’re proud to be recognized by The Washington Post as a Top Workplace. As we continue to grow, we’re not just hiring employees—we’re looking for driven, energetic, and creative problem-solvers. If that sounds like you, and you're ready to build your career with a company committed to making meaningful change in our industry, we’d love to connect.

Atlantic Coast Mortgageisseeking an experienced Loan Officer Assistant to work alongside a designated Loan Officer to drive a positive client experience throughout the mortgage process. This position involves supporting a team in the loan origination process as well as performing daily administrative tasks.

This position requires registration with the national Mortgage Licensing System and Registry (NMLS), as created under the federal S.A.F.E. Act.

  • Experience with Encompass LOS
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Exceptional time management and organizational skills
  • Ability to learn quickly and multitask with high attention to detail
  • Knowledge of loan products and compliance requirements

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

The Senior Analyst will be a strategic and hands-on analytics partner supporting CenterWell's latest Hub business. You will work directly with Hub leaders to translate complex and often ambiguous needs into scalable analytics, reporting, self-service, and data solutions.
The role combines hands-on analytical development with strategic consulting and is intended for someone equally comfortable building a Power BI or Databricks solution, analyzing business performance, and advising business partners on how data can be structured and used to support decision-making.
As the Hub business grows, you will also help establish the data foundation needed to support future internal and external analytics capabilities. The Senior Analyst may serve as a data steward for important Hub data domains and will partner with Technology and other team members to establish trusted, scalable data assets and analytical capabilities.

  • Measure business performance. Help establish KPIs, business definitions, measurement methodologies, and reporting that provide clear visibility into Hub performance and opportunities.
  • Support data governance and stewardship. Assist in data stewardship for designated Hub data assets to establish clear definitions, ownership, quality expectations, documentation, and appropriate usage.

Use your skills to make an impact

North Wind Site Services is comprised of scientists and technical experts focused on providing program management and environmental remediation services including investigation and characterization, environmental restoration, remedial action, regulatory public involvement services, environmental compliance, logistics, and records and facility management.

The purpose of this position is to support projects in all aspects of analytical data collection and reporting as well as the review of information generated by subcontract analytical laboratories to ensure that environmental analytical data were generated in accordance with EPA, DOE and DOD guidelines, project plans, and industry standard methods to satisfy contract requirements.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Validate analytical chemistry data following national standards and company procedures, including project-specific criteria.
  • Prepare comprehensive written data validation reports and checklists with findings, including application of relevant data qualifications to affected data sets.
  • Quickly and accurately operate databases and spreadsheets.
  • Monitor individual workloads for incoming client validation requests and manage backlog to achieve due dates.

  • Consult with project team, including clients, on data quality and usability.
  • Prepare technical report sections describing precision, accuracy, representativeness, comparability, sensitivity and overall data usability.
  • Assist project managers with procuring appropriate analytical laboratory services.
  • Serve as the point of contact for laboratory coordination, including ordering bottle kits, communicating field schedules, and conveying issues or questions to and from the field team.
  • Track sample shipments during field events to ensure samples are received and logged in correctly.
  • Review reported data deliverables for accuracy and request corrections from lab.
  • Organize large amounts of data for multiple projects.
  • Update multiple project teams on status of sample data.
  • Write and review reports for federal clients based on sampling activities and results.
  • Be the client interface for large external contracts.
  • Provide quotes and proposal text for data validation, data management, sampling, and laboratory analysis.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
deine aufgaben

In dieser Rolle machst du metergrid operativ skalierbar.

Du sorgst für klare Prozesse, saubere Schnittstellen, belastbare KPIs und Transparenz über unsere gesamte Wertschöpfung – von Sales bis Abrechnung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit der Geschäftsführung und den Team Leads zusammen.

Dein Fokus liegt dabei auf Enablement: Du befähigst Project Management, Project Support und Customer Support durch klare Prozesse, saubere Schnittstellen und funktionierende Quality Gates.

Du wirkst dort, wo echter Hebel entsteht: Du gestaltest und optimierst die Systematik, nach der Projekte umgesetzt werden, und entwickelst unsere Prozesse, Schnittstellen und Standards kontinuierlich weiter. Gleichzeitig arbeitest du gezielt in ausgewählten Projekten mit, um Abläufe aus erster Hand zu durchdringen, Optimierungspotenziale zu identifizieren und diese strukturiert in nachhaltige Verbesserungen zu überführen. So verbindest du operative Nähe mit strategischem Weitblick und stärkst die Effizienz und Skalierbarkeit unserer gesamten Projektorganisation.

Deine Arbeitsaufteilung:

  • ca. 80 % Prozessoptimierung, Schnittstellenmanagement und Integration
  • ca. 20 % operative Mitarbeit in Projekten
Deine konkreten Aufgaben:

End-to-End-Prozessverantwortung & Systemdesign
  • Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung der Operations-Systematik entlang des gesamten Projekt-Lifecycles (von Signing bis Abrechnung & Customer Success)
  • Analyse und Optimierung von End-to-End-Prozessen
  • Definition klarer Prozessstrukturen, Quality Gates, Übergabepunkte sowie Rollen- und Eskalationslogiken
  • Modellierung und Dokumentation der Zielprozesse in Systemen und Tools zur Sicherstellung skalierbarer Abläufe
Operative Nähe als Hebel für Verbesserung
  • Gezielte Mitarbeit in ausgewählten Projekten zur Analyse realer Durchlaufzeiten, Engpässe und Qualitätsabweichungen
  • Identifikation von Standardisierungs- und Automatisierungspotenzialen
  • Ableitung und Umsetzung konkreter Verbesserungsmaßnahmen auf Basis operativer Erfahrung
Schnittstellen- & Governance-Management
  • Strukturierung der Zusammenarbeit zwischen Sales, Project Management, Project Support und Customer Success
  • Definition klarer Übergaben und interner SLAs
  • Reduktion von Reibungsverlusten und Doppelarbeit
  • Aufbau transparenter Entscheidungs- und Dokumentationsstrukturen
KPI-System & Transparenz
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung eines KPI-Frameworks zur datenbasierten Steuerung (u. a. Durchlaufzeiten, Quality-Gate-Performance, SLA-Compliance, Forecast-Qualität)
  • Etablierung strukturierter Weekly- und Monthly-Reviews
  • Verbesserung von Planbarkeit und Transparenz für nachhaltiges Wachstum
Tooling, Automatisierung & Skalierung
  • Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung der operativen Systemlandschaft (CRM, Projektmanagement, Billing etc.)
  • Reduktion manueller Prozesse und Einführung neuer Standards
  • Aufbau einer skalierbaren Infrastruktur zur Unterstützung weiteren Unternehmenswachstums und erhöhter Stakeholder-Transparenz

dein profil

Das passt besonders gut zu dir, wenn du …

  • Organisationen nicht nur managst, sondern strukturell weiterentwickelst
  • komplexe Abläufe schnell durchdringst und systemisch verbesserst
  • Verantwortung für Integration und Umsetzung übernimmst – nicht nur für Konzepte
  • auch ohne disziplinarische Führung Wirkung entfaltest und Veränderungen vorantreibst
  • sowohl mit Management als auch mit operativen Teams auf Augenhöhe arbeitest

jobs.title: Director of eCommerce & Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Build the DTC growth engine for Protein Candy and Pulp & Press

We're looking for the person who turns our brands into a growth engine online: our Shopify sites, Amazon, TikTok Shop, and whatever channel comes next. You'll set the DTC strategy, own the P&L, and decide where the next dollar of growth comes from.

Protein Candy is redefining the $40B candy category with functional, better-for-you products. Since launching in mid-2024, we've grown into 4,000+ retail doors, including Kroger, Walmart Canada, and Circle K, with thousands more coming online by the end of the year.

Pulp & Press is a legacy cold-pressed juice brand being reinvented. You'll build its direct and marketplace business alongside Protein Candy.

The Role

This is a commercial leadership role with an operator's hands. You'll own DTC revenue and the P&L for both brands, run our Shopify sites and marketplace business, steer our agency partners, and build the team as we scale.

As part of our Marketing team, you'll work closely with our leadership team and with partners across retail, operations, lifecycle, and social. If you can read a P&L and a conversion funnel with equal ease, love finding growth others miss, and know when to say no to a shiny new channel, this is your role.

What You'll Own

1. Set and lead the DTC channel strategy

  • Own the DTC strategy and roadmap across eCommerce, marketplaces, social shopping, and new channels for both brands
  • Decide the channel mix and where to invest for each brand, based on performance and growth expectations. Decide how channels work together and where the next dollar of growth comes from
  • Judge whether new marketplaces are worth it. Build the business case as they come up, and know when to say no
  • Grow and lead the DTC team as we scale

2. Drive growth marketing and experimentation

  • Own acquisition and retention strategy across paid media, SEO, and CRO, working alongside our Lifecycle marketer who owns Klaviyo and customer lifetime value
  • Test new ad channels, formats, and audiences (TikTok, YouTube, CTV, affiliate, retail media, and whatever is next) and scale what works
  • Use DTC as the launchpad for new products, flavours, and bundles, and feed what you learn back into innovation

3. Own the Shopify sites

  • Own both brand sites end to end: eCommerce, UX, performance, MarTech, and analytics
  • Run CRO and A/B testing across the funnel, from landing page to checkout, on an always-on testing calendar
  • Keep the tech stack and sites lean and working

4. Build our marketplace business

  • Own Amazon (US and Canada) for both brands: listings, A+ content, storefronts, ads, reviews, account health, and FBA inbound
  • Own TikTok Shop as a sales channel: setup, listings, affiliate commission structure, Shop ads, and GMV. Our Social team owns content and creators
  • Own expansion into new marketplaces
  • Protect our brand presence online, including pricing strategy and unauthorized resellers

5. Own DTC revenue, P&L, and reporting

  • Own DTC revenue targets by brand and channel, driven by traffic, conversion, and AOV
  • Manage the DTC P&L through contribution margin: media, agency fees, promotions, marketplace fees, and fulfillment
  • Own pricing, promotions, and the offer calendar (launches, BFCM, bundles), aligned with Retail to avoid channel conflict
  • Own performance data strategy: set marketing KPIs and goals, make sure data capture and attribution are right, and run weekly and monthly reports and dashboards

6. Manage agency partnerships

  • Set clear strategy, scopes, KPIs, and fees for paid media, marketplace, and site agency partners
  • Run weekly performance check-ins and quarterly business reviews, and hold partners acco...

  • Troubleshoot Windows desktops and laptops, including operating system issues, software installation, updates, and performance-related problems

  • Be familiar with PowerShell commands and basic scripting

  • Familiarity with virtualisation technologies such as VMware and Hyper-V will be considered an added advantage

About Oasis Solutions

Oasis Solutions is your local NetSuite, Sage 100 and Sage Intacct partner providing business management software solutions to small and mid-sized businesses throughout America. We have offices located in Louisville and Lexington, KY, TN, and NC, and serve clients throughout the United States.

Oasis offers the leading software solutions (on-premise and cloud) for accounting and business management (ERP), human resources, payroll, and time & attendance, CRM (Customer Relationship Management), Job Management, Document Management, Warehouse management, and more.

Oasis Solutions is seeking a driven, consultative Account Executive to help organizations improve operational performance, financial visibility, and scalability through Sage Intacct solutions. This is not a transactional software sales role. We are looking for a business-minded hunter who can prospect aggressively, communicate confidently with executives, and drive complex opportunities through a disciplined sales process.

  • Mental toughness and emotional endurance
  • Ability to prospect consistently without external pressure
  • Strong strategic thinking and organizational discipline

This Role Is For Someone Who

  • Prefers building new business over maintaining existing accounts

Core Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities through strategic prospecting
  • Lead executive discovery and assessment conversations
  • Navigate complex buying committees and decision structures
  • Develop and manage a high-value opportunity pipeline
  • Position ROI and business impact effectively
  • Collaborate internally to build solutions and proposals

Compensation & Environment

· Expected Year 1 earnings: $120K–$180K

· Expected Year 2+ earnings: $200K+

  • Opportunity to sell best-in-class ERP solutions
  • Culture of mutual respect, collaboration, and high standards
  • Executive-level expectations with strong support infrastructure

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Managing modern technology has become increasingly complex. As organizations scale across clouds, endpoints, and hybrid environments, IT operations and cybersecurity often remain fragmented, creating gaps in visibility, slowing response times, and increasing risk.

Logically closes that gap.

We unify IT operations and cybersecurity into a single, accountable operating model that reduces risk, accelerates response, and strengthens resilience across the systems businesses depend on. With shared visibility, integrated workflows, and clear ownership, organizations gain greater control, fewer blind spots, and more confidence in their technology.

Our approach is cyber-first by design, embedding protection into every layer, from end user to edge to cloud. By combining AI-assisted monitoring with human-led expertise, we deliver faster insight, smarter decisions, and more effective outcomes without the complexity of siloed tools.

For more than 20 years, Logically has partnered with mid-market and enterprise organizations to simplify complexity, reduce risk, and improve resilience, acting as a true extension of their teams with clear accountability and measurable outcomes.

Logically. Cyber-First. Future-Ready.

Why Work for Us

  • A culture built on doing the right thing
  • Work at the forefront of cybersecurity and emerging technologies
  • Collaborative, growth-oriented environment
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional development and advancement
  • Make a real impact by helping organizations reduce risk and build resilience

As a resourceful, creative, and strategic Brand Marketing Manager you will drive brand growth and engagement across our target markets. Reporting to the CMO, this role is ideal for someone with 3–5 years of hands-on brand and social marketing experience who thrives in a fast-paced environment, can juggle multiple priorities with ease, and knows how to balance data-driven decision-making with creative storytelling.

You’ll own the voice, visual identity, and digital presence of Logically’s brand. From shaping our positioning to developing high-impact content and campaigns, you’ll play a central role in strengthening Logically’s reputation, driving audience engagement, and cultivating a loyal, informed community.

  • Strategically create a digital presence that embodies Logically’s core values, expertise, and long-term vision.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Would you like to work in a dynamic sales-growth role?

Do you love collaborating across teams to deliver customer success?

Join our Enterprise Security Team!

Our Enterprise Division is responsible for selling Enterprise Security, Application Access products and Host based Network segmentation. Our goal is to navigate an evolution within customers to a more secure, dynamic and agile infrastructure. This relates to our Zero Trust architectures. Collaborating with our enterprise sales, internal teams and our external Channel Partners is key for our Go-to-Market in the Gulf Region

About the Team

Our Enterprise Security team focuses on the development and selling of our Host based Network segmentation solution. Host based Network segmentation is key to protect customers against Ransomware threats in a changing hybrid I.T. environment. Our goal is to secure Enterprise environments with our agile solution.

As a Security Sales Specialist, you will be responsible for:

  • Driving the Enterprise Security agenda internally and externally.
  • Being a leader in driving the Enterprise Security agenda internally and externally

Do what you love

To be successful in this role you will:

  • Have experience leading high performance sales teams within a matrixed organization.
  • Have direct sales experience and be able to demonstrate C level access and engagement.
  • Able to work with our Channel Partners and continue successful collaboration.
  • Demonstrate excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Have knowledge in: Micro-Segmentation (ex. Cisco Tetration, VMware NSX), Firewall, Data Center Technology, Zero Trust / SASE Technology area.
  • Be fluent in both Arabic and English.

About us

At Akamai, we make life better for billions of people, trillions of times a day.
Whether you're streaming live events, scrolling social media, watching your favorite series, or managing your savings, we're the engine behind the scenes. We provide the world's most distributed platform from Cloud to Edge to help the giants of the digital world work faster and stay more secure, making the internet a better experience for everyone.

Our focus is simple:

Cloud and Edge: Running apps closer to users for instant performance.
Security: Neutralizing threats before they ever reach your data.
Content Delivery: Scaling the world's biggest moments without a glitch.
AI: Enabling our customers to build, secure, and scale AI apps on the world's most distributed cloud platform.

At Akamai, we don't just support the internet; we power and protect it, because behind every great digital experience is a massive hidden challenge. And we're the ones who solve it. When millions of people hit play or pay, Akamai ensures it just works.

Benefits at Akamai: We support your health, well-being, finances, and life beyond work. See our benefits.

FlexBase adapts to your job's needs

Akamai's FlexBase program is yet another way we show our commitment to providing employees with an exceptional workplace experience. It's not about telling employees where to work; it's about supporting employees to do their best work.

We trust our incredible employees to work in ways that suit them best: at home, in an office, or a combination of both.

Connect with us on social and see what life at Akamai is like!

jobs.title: SDR Recursos Humanos
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Quiénes somos

En Tessera acompañamos a compañías en su crecimiento desde una visión integral de personas, negocio y estructura. Trabajamos como partners en la construcción de equipos y en la toma de decisiones importantes, combinando talento y estrategia para profesionalizar procesos críticos allí donde más impacto se genera.

Creemos en construir better decisions, together. Por eso trabajamos de forma cercana tanto con compañías como con profesionales, conectando personas, equipos y proyectos en momentos críticos de crecimiento.

Somos una consultora boutique con base en Madrid. Trabajamos cerca, con criterio y con honestidad. Nada de procesos en cadena ni promesas inflables.

El reto

Como Sales Development Representative freelance, te encargarás de:

Prospección y captación de empresas que necesiten servicios de selección. Contacto con decision makers: CEO, COO, Head of People, founders. Detección de necesidades reales de talento y posicionamiento de Tessera como partner. Demo y presentación de nuestra propuesta de valor. Cierre del primer proceso de selección con el cliente. Handover limpio al equipo de delivery de Tessera.

Modelo de comisiones

  • Trabajo 100% a éxito. Cobras un porcentaje sobre la facturación que generes para Tessera, en escala progresiva sobre el total del mes. Sin tope.
  • Hasta 5.000€ facturados al mes: 30% de comisión. A partir de 5.000€: 35% de comisión sobre el tramo que supera esos 5.000€.
  • Ejemplo con 8.000€ facturados en el mes: 5.000€ × 30% = 1.500€ 3.000€ × 35% = 1.050€ Comisión total: 2.550€
  • Ejemplo con 15.000€ facturados en el mes: 5.000€ × 30% = 1.500€ 10.000€ × 35% = 3.500€ Comisión total: 5.000€

Mientras gestiones activamente al cliente (presentas el proceso, haces de puente, mantienes la relación), cobras la escala completa. Si el cliente vuelve directamente a Tessera en futuros procesos sin que tú intervengas, recibes un 10% sobre esa facturación recurrente mientras sigas activo como colaborador.

Requisitos

Experiencia en ventas B2B, idealmente servicios profesionales, RRHH, SaaS o consultoría. Mentalidad hunter: te mueve abrir mercado, no gestionar lo que ya está. Autonomía real y orientación a resultados. Capacidad de hablar de tú a tú con founders y C-levels. Cero alergia a un CRM y a la disciplina de pipeline.

Será un plus si

Ya tienes red en founders, decision makers de RRHH o C-levels de PYMEs y scale-ups. Has vendido antes servicios de selección, headhunting o consultoría de personas. Conoces el mercado madrileño y nacional de talento.

Qué ofrecemos

Marca diferencial en un mercado saturado de consultoras genéricas Acceso a nuestra metodología, materiales de venta y casos de éxito Soporte directo del equipo fundador y del Head of Recruitment Trabajo 100% remoto y autónomo, tú gestionas tu agenda Posibilidad real de evolucionar a un rol interno si hay encaje Comisiones sin tope, escalado progresivo y revenue share sobre facturación recurrente

Importante

Esto no es para todo el mundo. Si buscas estabilidad y un fijo a fin de mes, este rol no es el tuyo. Si quieres construir tu propia cartera de clientes, generar ingresos en función de tu rendimiento y trabajar con una boutique con criterio, hablamos.

Igualdad de oportunidades

En Tessera defendemos la igualdad de oportunidades y la diversidad como parte fundamental de nuestra cultura. Valoramos a las personas por su talento, experiencia y potencial, independientemente de su género, edad, origen, orientación sexual, identidad de género, religión, discapacidad o cualquier otra condición personal. Nos comprometemos a ofrecer un proceso de selección justo, transparente y accesible, y a crear un entorno de trabajo respetuoso e inclusivo.

Job title: Area Business Manager, Pulmonology, Nashville, TN

  • Location: Remote, US

About the Job:

Sanofi focuses on developing specialty treatments for debilitating diseases that are often difficult to diagnose and treat, providing hope to patients and their families. Sanofi has pioneered the development and delivery of transformative therapies for patients affected by rare and debilitating diseases for over 30 years. We accomplish our goals through world-class research, collaboration with the global patient community, and with the compassion and commitment of our employees.  With a focus on rare diseases, oncology, immunology, and multiple sclerosis, we are dedicated to making a positive impact on the lives of the patients and families we serve. 


Sanofi’s portfolio of transformative therapies, which are marketed in countries around the world, represent groundbreaking and life-saving advances in medicine. At Sanofi, we are committed to the growth of our people, connected in purpose by career, life, and health.

Join the team transforming care for people with immune challenges, rare diseases, cancers, and neurological conditions. In Specialty Care, you’ll help deliver breakthrough treatments that bring hope to patients with some of the highest unmet needs.

About Sanofi:

We’re an R&D-driven, AI-powered biopharma company committed to improving people’s lives and delivering compelling growth. Our deep understanding of the immune system – and innovative pipeline – enables us to invent medicines and vaccines that treat and protect millions of people around the world. Together, we chase the miracles of science to improve people’s lives.

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Category: Human Resources

Location:


SUMMARY
We are seeking an experienced Human Resources Generalist based in South Africa to manage and support day-to-day HR operations across the employee lifecycle.
This role is heavily focused on HR operations, employee records, onboarding, offboarding, HR administration, employee relations, employment contract administration, and HR compliance in South Africa.
The successful candidate must have practical, hands-on experience applying South African labor laws, employment regulations, and statutory compliance requirements in an HR environment.
Experience with compensation and benefits administration is preferred but not required. Recruitment experience is not required for this role.

HR Operations & Administration

South African Labor Law & Compliance
