jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

Bulmann Dock & Lift is a leading manufacturer of docks, boat lifts, and waterfront systems, proudly building our products in Northern Michigan for over 25 years. We partner with a network of marine dealers and distributors to bring our products to market — and we’ve grown steadily through every economic climate.

Position Overview

We’re seeking an experienced Dealer Sales Representative / Territory Manager to develop and maintain strong relationships with our marine dealer network. This role focuses on B2B sales — supporting existing dealers, onboarding new ones, and ensuring they have the tools, training, and resources to sell and install our products successfully.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage and grow a defined dealer sales territory.
  • Build long-term relationships with current and prospective dealers.
  • Conduct on-site dealer visits, product demos, and training sessions.
  • Present and negotiate wholesale pricing, programs, and promotional opportunities.
  • Monitor dealer performance and identify growth opportunities.
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth order fulfillment and installation support.
  • Maintain accurate CRM records for all dealer interactions.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years in B2B sales, preferably in the marine, outdoor recreation, or equipment manufacturing industries.
  • Experience with dealer/distributor account management.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and relationship-building skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook, Teams, PowerPoint).
  • Highly organized with excellent time-management skills.
  • Mechanical aptitude and familiarity with dock/boat lift systems a plus.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Competitive base salary + commission
  • 3 health plan options (2 FREE for employees) plus dental, vision, life, disability, EAP, and supplemental coverage.
  • Paid vacation and company holidays.
  • Retirement plan with 3% company match.
  • Annual stake-in-the-outcome bonus program based on company performance.

Apply Today

Join a manufacturer that values long-term dealer partnerships and rewards its team for driving collective success.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description

A bit about this role:


Devoted Health is seeking a strategic, influential leader with a strong operational track record to serve as Director, Health Systems Management. This role is designed for an operator who can effectively de-escalate issues with our most critical provider partners, build processes that make our escalation response more scalable and effective, and drive cross-functional initiatives that prevent escalations in the first place.


Reporting directly to the Head of Provider Escalations & Education, you will work closely with cross-functional partners to build tooling that helps us diagnose escalation issues quickly and at scale, prepare executive briefings that equip leadership to decide on next steps, and charter initiatives that address the root causes of escalations through improvements to our operational processes and policies.


The best candidate will combine operational excellence, systems thinking, obsession with detail, pace-setting execution, and the ability to create confidence through change. This role is ideal for someone who organizes around metrics and outcomes, runs to hard problems, has a strong track record of achieving results, and thrives in ambiguity while building durable systems that outlast any one leader.


Your Responsibilities and Impact will include:

  • Ownership of Devoted’s Health System Escalation function, including escalation response time, quality, and time to resolution
  • Influential Leadership: Drive alignment and change across a broad set of cross-functional stakeholders, including Devoted’s executive team, Network, Claims, Payment Integrity, Clinical, Product, and Engineering teams, to achieve goals
  • Managing the function through rigorous metrics, KPIs, scorecards, and performance dashboards, with clear accountability for outcomes
  • Leading through significant evolution while creating confidence, momentum, stability, and strong culture through change
  • Running the current operation while designing, implementing, and owning the future-state process
  • Raising the talent bar across the organization by setting the pace and modeling high standards
  • Building and operationalizing AI-enabled and human-in-the-loop workflows that improve quality, and speed of our response resolution
  • Establishing clear visibility into units of work, productivity, quality, cost, workforce planning, and performance metrics
  • Defining and executing the roadmap for scaling our Health System Escalations function through workflow automation, and self-service

Required skills and experience:

  • At least 10 years of leadership experience with a track record of delivering measurable outcomes in complex operational environments
  • Outstanding operational rigor with the ability to deploy technology to solve complex business challenges
  • Proven experience driving end-to-end initiatives from strategy through execution that materially improve quality, service levels, cost, compliance, or operational efficiency
  • Strong systems thinking and product mindset, with experience owning roadmaps, KPIs, and cross-functional execution
  • Demonstrated ability to manage through metrics, establish ambitious targets, and drive teams to results with clear accountability
  • Exceptional attention to detail and precision, with a reputation for sweating the details and getting the hardest operational last mile right
  • Strong people leadership skills, with the ability to lead through managers, distributed teams, and external vendors

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Court Reporter Onboarding Specialist, Provider Operations

Full-Time, Remote / Hourly, Non-Exempt/ Includes Benefits, PTO, Flexible Schedule, Equity

Steno is growing! We're looking for a Court Reporter Onboarding Specialist to join our Provider Operations team and own the journey that turns a reporter's "yes" into their first completed job. Every reporter you guide across the finish line expands Steno's network and capacity, so your impact is immediate and measurable. We're a diverse team from all over the country (and beyond) and we're crazy about redefining the boundaries of an outdated industry.

Who are you?

You're the person who catches people before they fall. You're highly organized and warm in your communication, and you know how to keep someone motivated when the process feels tedious. You treat your inbox as a core part of the job: you respond promptly, follow up without being asked, and close every loop. You're not just processing paperwork, you're the reason reporters activate, and you'll surface patterns in where they drop off so the whole team can improve the process. You'll work closely with Recruiting and the broader Provider Operations team to make sure every reporter lands well.

If you're looking for a company that offers support, guidance, an abundance of killer GIFs, and unlimited potential to grow into your best self, you can bet we'd love to have you too.

The AVP, Consultant Relations is responsible for building, activating, and expanding Castlight / Vera’s broker and consultant ecosystem across assigned geographies. jobs.descriptionHtml: <h2 id="who-we-are">Who we are</h2> <h3 id="about-stripe">About Stripe</h3> <p>Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.</p> <h3 id="about-the-team">About the team</h3> <p>The administrative business partner (ABP) team works with Stripe's executive leaders to strategically manage their day-to-day administrative and operational needs, while also contributing significantly to projects and initiatives that help drive the company's strategic priorities</p> <h2 id="what-youll-do">What you’ll do</h2> <p>This coverage ABP role is focused on covering critical gaps in administrative support to Stripe’s most senior leaders and requires someone who is flexible, agile, and eager to learn. You will be required to support multiple leaders on a temporary basis. You will have the unique opportunity to learn the ins and outs of different areas of the business, build relationships with various leaders, and contribute to the overall health of the global ABP team.</p> <h3 id="responsibilities">Responsibilities</h3> <ul> <li>Provide temporary administrative support to Stripe’s most senior leaders to uphold business continuity and core support</li> <li>Provide complex and proactive calendar support for multiple leaders concurrently</li> <li>Make recommendations to leaders with regard to their time management, prioritization, delegation, and organization</li> <li>Coordinate domestic and international travel and manage all related details</li> <li>Prepare and submit expense reports on behalf of leaders</li> <li>Own programmatic work that supports the global ABP program</li> <li>Assist with ad hoc projects for the ABP coverage program</li> </ul> <h2 id="who-you-are">Who you are</h2> <p>We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.</p> <h3 id="minimum-requirements">Minimum requirements</h3> <ul> <li>7+ years of administrative experience at a quickly scaling or large company, plus experience in a high-growth technology startup</li> <li>You are incredibly organized, with superb attention to detail and a strong ability to execute. You are excellent with time management and able to quickly shift tasks and priorities as needed.</li> <li>You have a knack for working across various roles and teams in a fast-paced, changing environment while remaining flexible, proactive, resourceful, and efficient. You communicate, perform, and react well under pressure or ambiguity.</li> <li>You enjoy optimizing processes to make them more efficient.</li> <li>You are adept at handling sensitive information and situations with care and confidence. You are able to anticipate and respond to the needs of others before those needs arise.</li> </ul>

jobs.title: Developer - Backend
jobs.descriptionHtml: **[PT Mitra Cakra Digital — Tech Team]** **Kami mencari Developer Backend - Java / Spring untuk bergabung dalam tim engineering kami.** Di peran ini, Anda akan bertanggung jawab membangun layanan backend berbasis Java/Spring yang tangguh, teruji, dan sesuai standar arsitektur enterprise. Tidak hanya mengembangkan API biasa, Anda juga akan merancang komponen berbasis event (Event-Driven Architecture), membuat pustaka (SDK) internal untuk tim developer lain, serta menjaga alur pertukaran data agar tetap high-throughput, andal, dan fault-tolerant. Jika Anda peduli pada kualitas kode, menguasai ekosistem Java, serta memiliki ketertarikan pada Apache Kafka dan Developer Experience (DevEx), posisi ini sangat tepat untuk Anda. Apa yang akan Anda lakukan: Mengembangkan layanan backend dan komponen berbasis event menggunakan Java, Spring Boot, serta message broker (Apache Kafka). Membangun, mendokumentasikan, dan memelihara pustaka (library) atau SDK internal untuk digunakan oleh squad developer lain. Mengembangkan jalur integrasi yang andal antara sistem legacy dengan layanan baru sesuai rancangan sistem dan kontrak API. Menerapkan mekanisme penanganan kegagalan (fault tolerance) tingkat lanjut (retry, exponential backoff, Dead Letter Queue). Menulis pengujian otomatis (unit & integration testing) yang komprehensif sesuai standar test coverage tim. Melakukan code review secara aktif, menindaklanjuti temuan tim QA, serta melakukan perbaikan bug secara responsif. Memantau (monitoring) serta menjaga keandalan (reliability) dan performa alur pertukaran data antar layanan secara berkelanjutan. Kualifikasi Utama: Pengalaman minimal 4 tahun dalam pengembangan backend. Menguasai Java 17 (atau lebih baru) dan framework **Spring Boot 3 / 4** (termasuk Spring Kafka, REST API, dan JPA/Hibernate). Menguasai basis data relasional, khususnya **PostgreSQL**. Pengalaman hands-on dengan **Apache Kafka** beserta konsep intinya: producer, consumer group, partition, offset management, dan rebalancing. Menguasai serialisasi data menggunakan **Avro** serta pengelolaan **Schema Registry**. Memahami dan berpengalaman menerapkan pola arsitektur **event-driven** (idempotency, exactly-once processing, dan Outbox Pattern). Terbiasa dengan praktik automated testing (JUnit, Mockito). Memiliki pemahaman baik dan pengalaman hands-on dengan Git, Docker, serta pemahaman dasar Kubernetes. Soft Skill: Disiplin tinggi terhadap standar kode (no cowboy coding), teliti, komunikatif lintas peran (Frontend, QA, PM), serta memiliki sudut pandang "developer-as-a-customer" dalam menyusun dokumentasi teknis dan sample code. Nilai Tambah: Pengalaman membangun internal tools / SDK / open-source library. Familiar dengan Debezium / CDC atau pengelolaan Kafka di platform Cloud (AWS MSK, Confluent Cloud, dll). Memiliki pengalaman bekerja dengan metodologi Agile/Scrum dan tools CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins). Pengalaman di industri IT Consulting. Informasi Tambahan: Skema Bekerja: On-Site (Work From Office) – Kota Wisata, Gunung Putri, Kabupaten Bogor. Budaya Perusahaan: PT Mitra Cakra Digital menerapkan budaya kerja GROWTH (Grit, Results-Oriented, Ownership, World-Class, Techie, Harmony). Kami mendorong tim untuk bereksperimen, mencari solusi berbasis teknologi, dan tumbuh bersama. PT Mitra Cakra Digital berkomitmen pada kesetaraan kesempatan kerja. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Web Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About us** VTL Travel is a Singapore-based travel company that operates as the parent brand for a family of niche travel sites, each targeting a distinct segment of the travel market. Under the VTL Travel umbrella sit three focused brands: Holidays From Singapore, which handles leisure travel, nearby getaways, cruises, visa-related services, and corporate trips; Tour Mount Bromo, which specializes in East Java tours covering Mount Bromo, Ijen, waterfalls, and private tour packages; and Batam Ferry Tickets, which focuses on Singapore-to-Batam ferry ticket bookings and promotions. **About the role** We're looking for a hands-on web developer to maintain and grow batamferrytickets.com — a custom built site — and to build and manage the API integrations that power our booking, payment, and ferry booking API features. This is a practical, execution-focused role: keeping the site fast, secure, and bug-free, while connecting it reliably to the third-party systems our bookings depend on. **Key responsibilities** * Maintain and troubleshoot website, including API Updates and theme updates, performance tuning, and uptime/security monitoring * Fix bugs, broken forms, layout issues, and mobile responsiveness problems as they arise * Implement design and content changes from the marketing team without breaking page speed or SEO structure * Manage staging-to-live deployment workflow to avoid downtime on a revenue-generating site * Build and maintain the integration between the site and the ferry ticketing/booking system (availability, pricing, seat/ticket confirmation) * Develop and maintain the hotel-booking module integration for combined ferry+hotel packages (hotel supplier or OTA API/feed) * Maintain the payment gateway integration (HitPay or Airwallex) and troubleshoot failed or stuck transactions * Connect and maintain WhatsApp Business API or click-to-WhatsApp flows for enquiry handling * Set up and maintain GA4 and Google Ads conversion tracking (events, server-side tagging where needed) so booking data flows correctly for marketing reporting * Handle webhook endpoints and scheduled sync jobs (e.g. inventory/price sync) reliably, with logging and error alerts **About you** * 2+ years of experience Web Developer (PHP, custom functions, child themes, Payment Gateway Integration) * Proven experience integrating REST/SOAP APIs, handling JSON, authentication (API keys, OAuth), and webhooks * Good Practical skillset in API integration * Experience with payment gateway integrations (HitPay, Stripe, PayNow, or similar) * Comfortable working with GA4, Google Tag Manager, and Google Ads conversion tracking * Solid understanding of website security (SSL, backups, firewall rules, malware cleanup) * Familiar with git-based deployment workflows and staging environments * Able to debug independently and document fixes clearly Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Sales - Technology Strategist, Strategic Accounts, Indonesia
jobs.descriptionHtml: Summary The people here don’t just build products — they create the kind of technology and experiences that can change entire industries. It is the diversity of our people and their ideas that drives the innovation behind everything we do. Join us and help leave the world better than we found it. At Apple we work with some of the most ambitious organizations in the world. We help customers rethink how their people work, how technology can improve their business, and how our platforms and ecosystem can become part of that journey. The Technology Strategist is a trusted technical advisor to some of Apple’s most strategic enterprise customers in Southeast Asia. You will work with business and technology leaders to turn organizational ambition into a clear technical vision, architecture, and adoption roadmap. The role combines enterprise architecture, executive advisory, and hands-on technical leadership. You will help customers understand emerging technologies, simplify complex decisions, modernize their technology environments, and create secure, scalable experiences with Apple at their core. Description Build trusted relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, enterprise architects, and senior business leaders, becoming a strategic advisor on technology and innovation. Help customers define a multi-year technical vision that connects their business ambition with their enterprise architecture, operating model, workforce strategy, and investment priorities. Assess the customer’s current technology landscape across identity, security, device management, networking, cloud services, applications, data, AI, and support operations. Translate that assessment into a practical roadmap, identifying architectural dependencies, integration requirements, technical debt, security considerations, and opportunities for simplification. Develop reference architectures and integration patterns for Apple platforms within complex, heterogeneous enterprise environments. Apply well-architected principles across security and privacy, reliability and resilience, operational excellence, performance efficiency, cost optimization, and sustainability. Help customers rationalize their technology and application portfolios, understand architectural trade-offs, and make informed decisions based on business value, risk, user experience, and total cost of ownership. Lead executive briefings, technical discovery sessions, architecture workshops, demonstrations, proofs of concept, pilots, and design reviews. Demystify complex and emerging technologies—including AI—and explain their implications clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Partner with Apple sales, engineering, product, security, services, and partner teams to remove technical barriers and move customers from vision to scaled adoption. Maintain a clear technical account plan with agreed priorities, milestones, success measures, risks, and owners. Represent the voice of the customer within Apple, providing insight into enterprise requirements, technology trends, and opportunities for innovation. What success looks like: - Customers have an agreed technical vision and a practical roadmap connected to their business priorities. - Executive ambition is translated into secure, scalable, and well-architected technical decisions. - Technical barriers are identified early and resolved through clear ownership and cross-functional collaboration. - Demonstrations and pilots lead to measurable adoption at scale. - Apple becomes a trusted part of the customer’s broader enterprise technology strategy. jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are building Germany's leading tax advisory firm. Many business owners want a tax advisor who acts as a true sparring partner: proactive, responsive and strategic. What they often get is a service provider that books receipts and files returns, with little real advice. We're building the alternative.

Founded in 2025, Taxforce rethinks tax advisory from the ground up: AI-powered and highly automated, yet personal. We're starting with healthcare professionals, a complex and underserved segment, and we grow both organically and through M&A.

This is a €40B market in Germany alone, with processes that have barely changed in decades. AI now enables a fundamental shift, and there are no playbooks yet. We're writing them. We're a small, highly ambitious team in Berlin, backed by €5M from Tenet VC and founded by alumni of Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company, Y Combinator and the former Klarna Head of Engineering.

The role

You join the team that finds, evaluates, finances and integrates the tax firms that join Taxforce. You work directly with our founders on live deals and own your workstreams from first screening to closing and beyond.

Tasks

  • Deal sourcing. Build and maintain a pipeline of tax firms that fit our focus, from research and screening to first outreach.

  • Firm analysis. Turn DATEV reports, business analyses, annual accounts and payroll data into a clear picture of revenue, clients, team capacity and profitability.

  • Models and valuation. Build and maintain valuation and financing models in Excel.

  • Due diligence. Prepare and run due diligence workstreams, from data room to question lists.

  • Financing. Prepare materials for banks and financing partners and keep the process on track.

  • Decision papers. Write investment memos and presentations for founders and investors.

  • Post-merger integration. Support the onboarding of acquired firms, from process documentation to cross-firm coordination.

Requirements

  • Strong academic background. You have a very good Bachelor’s degree or are enrolled in a Master’s in business, economics, finance or a related field.

  • First deal experience. You’ve interned in M&A, transaction services, private equity, investment banking, corporate finance or consulting.

  • Financial fluency. You understand P&Ls, balance sheets and cash flows and quickly spot what doesn’t add up.

  • Analytical mindset. You turn incomplete information into a clear recommendation.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools to build analyses and models faster.

  • German language skills. Sellers and banks speak German, so we require fluent German (C2) and English.

Benefits

  • Work directly with experienced founders. Learn first-hand from a team with backgrounds at Goldman Sachs, Harvard Business School, Bain & Company and Klarna, and from a former Y Combinator founder.

  • Buy-and-build from the inside. See how a group of tax firms is built at an early stage.

  • At the table. Meet sellers, banks and investors and present your own analysis.

  • Ownership from day one. Take on real responsibility early, on live clients, deals and projects.

  • Front-row seat to AI in the real world. See how AI transforms a traditional industry and help build it.

  • Steep learning curve. Work on real problems, ship quickly and build skills that prepare you to start your own company.

  • A path to stay.<...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Product Architecture and Safety Teams

Our Product Architecture and Safety teams connect Wayve’s core AI Driver with the vehicle platforms that bring autonomous driving technology to customers. Working across Engineering, Product, Safety, Validation and customer programs, we define how our software integrates with OEM and Tier 1 systems, supporting safe, reliable deployment while maintaining a consistent core product architecture.

🧠 Your day-to-day

As a Principal Software Architect, you’ll lead the technical architecture for integrating Wayve’s autonomous driving technology with automotive OEM vehicle platforms. You’ll work at the boundary between our core AI Driver and external vehicle systems, translating product ambitions and customer needs into clear interfaces, requirements and technical decisions.

Your work will span high-level architecture and implementation details, from sensors and middleware to ECU constraints, timing, diagnostics, safety assumptions, data logging and validation. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous problems, guide architecture work across teams and own key decisions across customer programs. Along the way, you’ll build alignment with engineering, product, safety, validation, program and commercial leaders.

🧩 What you’ll be working on

  • Defining integration architecture: Shape how Wayve software interfaces with OEM and Tier 1 vehicle systems, balancing customer program needs with the evolution and reusability of our core architecture.

  • Making ownership explicit: Turn customer and partner discussions into clear interface contracts, ownership boundaries, assumptions, dependencies and open technical decisions, including what is Wayve-owned, partner-owned, jointly defined or out of scope.

  • Translating needs into requirements: Partner with Product and Engineering to develop actionable technical specifications. Establish a consistent approach to decomposing customer requirements into system and software requirements, including allocation, traceability and change control.

  • Owning architecture decisions: Lead architecture reviews, maintain decision records and make the final technical call within your scope when consensus cannot be reached.

  • Planning for successful delivery: Assess feasibility, integration complexity, technical gaps and risks. Identify dependencies and required partner deliverables to support customer program planning.

  • Building verifiable solutions: Work with Safety and Validation teams to define safety assumptions, integration test requirements and clear evidence that customer requirements have been met.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Opportunity

  • ZeitMind is an autonomous data engineer for mid-market businesses. Agents and people work the same company data: ingest, pipeline, clean, analyse, build operational apps

  • we are growing fast and will be onboarding multiple enterprise customers a week. The backend isn't ready yet, your impact will decide the speed at which we can grow

  • load growth is compounding: more customers, multiple users per customer, many agent interactions per user and multiple agent artifacts (data pipelines, schedules, analyses) coming out of the interactions

  • you own the platform

What you'll do

  • scale a multi-tenant Postgres under unpredictable load: query and I/O optimisation, read/write separation, horizontal scaling

  • make agent-driven workloads survivable: one user can spin up 30 table syncs, some running hours, while others query large sources

  • manage the sandbox layer: Docker containers where agents run queries and reverse-engineer files, with compute and memory budgets

  • own connectivity into customer networks: SOCKS5 over WebSockets, authentication, routing

  • scope the architecture and build it

  • staff or principal level, still hands-on, writing production code

  • deep Postgres or database knowledge: query plans, locking, I/O, caching, replication, sharding

  • understands startup pace and ownership without specs

  • pragmatic over ideal, wants to build foundations right without overengineering

  • strong TypeScript

  • English C1, German a plus

Nice to have

  • experience at a data platform or warehouse company (Snowflake, Databricks, Cloudflare or similar)

  • networking depth: proxies, VPN, routing

Location

  • preferred: Munich, on-site. We support relocation within Europe

  • already in London? We can make that work. We have people here and are opening a small office, and we'd expect regular Munich travel. In-person culture is important to us

Tech stack

  • TypeScript end to end. Bun, tRPC, Postgres, Supabase. React frontend (Mantine, TanStack Query). Docker, job/process management, VPN/routing, agentic frameworks

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

We are building Physics AI for hardware design. Our software platform helps hardware designers and physics simulation engineers explore, analyze, and optimize hardware systems, leveraging cutting-edge AI to deliver ultrafast, accurate physics intelligence within the realities of engineering design workflows.

Our first product bridges the gap between the accuracy & determinism of traditional simulation and the speed & scaling of AI, and is redefining how the world’s most advanced semiconductors are designed, verified, built, brought to market and integrated in complex systems.

Role Overview

As a pivotal leader within our European Forward Deployment team, you will drive the adoption of Vinci’s platform among the region's top engineering organizations. In this strategic role, you will build, mentor, and guide a high-performing team of thermal engineers dedicated to engaging prospective customers and demonstrating our software's transformative value.

As trusted technical advisors, you and your team will use deep simulation expertise to help enterprise customers validate and optimize complex, real-world designs. Through these collaborative engagements, you will champion Vinci's value proposition by showing how our platform delivers systemic improvements in thermal performance, product reliability, and time-to-market.

Leveraging strong fundamentals in continuum mechanics, you will guide analyses of complex physical phenomena, including linear, geometric and material nonlinearities, and contact interactions. Your team will evaluate critical factors such as warpage, stress evolution, thermal cycling, and reliability across advanced semiconductor devices, electronics packages, and wafer-scale systems.

You will work closely with customer engineering teams to understand their technical challenges, provide expert guidance, and clearly articulate Vinci’s capabilities in solving real-world problems. You will also serve as a key feedback channel to product and engineering teams, translating customer insights into actionable inputs that shape product direction and drive continuous improvement.

At Artificial, we’re building the next generation of technology for the specialty (re)insurance market. Our mission is to transform how brokers and carriers operate in complex markets by removing operational barriers and enabling smarter, faster decision-making.

We use modern technology to solve real challenges for some of the world’s leading brokers and insurers. By automating the repetitive and structuring the complex, we help our partners unlock new opportunities for innovation and growth.

You’ll be joining a collaborative team that values curiosity, ownership, and continuous learning. We work in an environment where ideas are heard, support is built-in, and outcomes matter. Everyone here has the chance to make a tangible impact on our products, our customers, and the industry.

We've just raised $45M (£33M) in Series B funding from lead investor CommerzVentures, new investor Move Capital, as well as all existing shareholders. This investment round gives us the room to grow with confidence, continue to innovate, and ensure that Artificial remains the first choice for brokers and carriers seeking a smarter way to trade digitally.

Join us, and take the chance to be a part of something that will change the landscape of insurance for generations.

About the role

As Sales Manager at Artificial, you'll own new business growth across specialty (re)insurance carriers, MGAs, and brokers in Germany and the broader DACH region. This is a full-cycle sales role: you'll build pipeline, run the sales process end to end, and close deals with senior stakeholders who are rethinking how their underwriting and claims operations run.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About accilium

accilium is an award-winning strategy and management consultancy shaping the future of mobility and energy. We work with industry leaders in Automotive & Transport, Energy & Environment, and Public & Infrastructure. Founded in 2017, we've grown to 110+ people across 7 offices: Berlin, Munich, Vienna, Cologne, Hamburg, Bucharest and Warsaw. Our software subsidiary &amp (50+ developers) lets us deliver end-to-end. We've been ranked Top 10 in the brand eins/Statista "Best Consultants" list five years running and were named "Hidden Champion 2026/2027".

The role

As Forward Deployed Engineer, you work with our clients to turn breakthroughs in AI technology and research into production systems. Working at the intersection of bleeding edge technologies and the transformation of leading enterprises' core value chains, you will drive organizational transformation and help our clients re-architect work. 

You'll also help build accilium itself into an AI-native company. Through Project aIQ, our internal transformation program, we ship weekly builds of "acciliumOS", the agents and tools our own consultants work with.

You join the FDE team in our Technology Practice, and you'll help shape how it grows.

What you'll do 

  • Build agentic systems with our clients and embed them in their core processes, from first prototype to production. 

  • Ship concrete artifacts: agents, MCP servers, agent skills and integrations used in real workflows. 

  • Turn what works into reusable patterns, for accilium and, where we can, for the open-source community. 

  • Work on-site with client teams, explain what you built, and spot the next use case. 

  • Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities, implementation patterns, and AI development stacks. 

  • Expand accilium’s build capabilities for agentic systems and deploy solutions for our internal value chains 

 

What you bring 

  • A Master's or Bachelor's degree in computer science, mathematics, physics, data science, engineering or similar. 

  • Hands-on coding in Python and/or TypeScript; you're comfortable with APIs, git and the command line. 

  • Things you've built and can show us: a GitHub profile, a side project, a thesis, a hackathon entry. Shipped is better than polished. 

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs: you've built with an agent framework, written a prompt or eval pipeline, or connected a model to real data.

Bei virtual7 verbinden wir unsere technologische Expertise mit einem tiefen Verständnis für die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden. Aktuell suchen wir für einen unserer Kunden einen Senior Network Engineer (m/w/d).

  • Projektstandort: Bonn

  • Zeitraum: 7. Dezember 2026 bis 30. Juni 2027

  • Arbeitsmix: 105 Tage Remote/ 20 Tage vor Ort (davon1-2 Tage Ausland)

  • Wichtig: Remote Einsätze nur im Bundesgebiet möglich

  • Prüfung: SÜ2 nach § 9 SÜG Geheim/Sabotageschutz

DEINE MISSION

Die Aufgaben im Detail:

  • Unterstützung der Cloud für eine Bereich

  • Übungsunterstützung, darunter Konzeptionierung, Weiterentwicklung und Absicherung der Cloud Infrastruktur

  • Konfiguration von Routern, Switches und Firewalls

  • Kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung der Netzwerklandschaft

  • Unterstützung in der Entwicklung von anspruchsvollen Konzepten für die Servicequalität, Netzwerksicherheit und deren Verfügbarkeit

  • Projektierung, Inbetriebnahme und Betrieb komplexer Systemlandschaften im Bereich der Übungsunterstützung

  • Erstellung und Fortschreibung von Konzepten sowie Dokumentationen

  • Linux Knowhow mehr als 3 Jahre

  • Kubernetes mehr als 3 Jahre

  • Network Fabric Konfiguration (präferiert Cisco)

  • Linux-basierte Router

  • Skripting / Automatisierung Ansible

NICE-TO-HAVES FÜR DIESE POSITION

  • OVN oder vergleichbare Technologien

  • Bare-Metal Erfahrung (BMC/OOB, Serial, Netzwerktopologien)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Cluster Environment, Transportation & Energy.

DEINE MISSION

Als AI Solution Architect (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die KI-/ML-Gesamtarchitektur für komplexe Enterprise-Umgebungen in der Cloud mit Schwerpunkt Microsoft Azure. Du verbindest fundiertes Know-how in ML Engineering, RAG-Architekturen und MLOps, um KI-Lösungen produktionsreif, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit technischen Expert:innen, Fachbereichen und Entscheidungsträgern zusammen und trägst maßgeblich dazu bei, innovative KI-Lösungen erfolgreich zu etablieren.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit MLOps-Konzepten und entsprechenden Werkzeugen wie MLflow, Kubeflow oder Azure ML Pipelines.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von RAG-Architekturen, Prompt Engineering und im Umgang mit Vektordatenbanken.

  • Kenntnisse in der Integration und Orchestrierung von Sprachmodellen, idealerweise mit Frameworks wie LangChain oder LlamaIndex.

  • Erfahrung mit CI/CD für ML-Anwendungen sowie sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens zwei gängigen Machine-Learning-Frameworks, beispielsweise scikit-learn, PyTorch oder TensorFlow.

  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Enterprise-Architekturen in Cloud-Umgebungen.

  • Kenntnisse in angrenzenden Bereichen wie Datenplattformen, Containerisierung, Container-Orchestrierung, Infrastructure as Code und Observability sind von Vorteil, beispielsweise mit Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Data Lake, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, Prometheus, Grafana oder Application Insights.

  • Erfahrung in einer technischen Leitungs- oder Architekturrolle ist wünschenswert.

  • Azure-, AWS- oder Google-Cloud-Zertifizierungen sind ein Plus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer - Berlin
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About RA

Resident Advisor has been a home for electronic music culture since 2001. Event discovery, ticketing, news and long-form editorial, artist profiles, original films, and a weekly mix series two decades deep. Around 7 million people use the web platform every month, with a wider audience across our apps and other channels. Underneath the platform sits a network of contributors and city managers across dozens of cities, which is how we stay connected to the scenes we cover rather than reporting on them from a distance. RA is 25 years old, independent, B.Corp certified and intent on being indispensable to the artists, promoters and audiences who make this culture.

Resident Advisor helps users explore the world of electronic music, from finding their next night out and buying tickets to discovering the artists, clubs and scenes behind it.

The mandate

We're looking for a senior product designer to join our design team and set the design direction for our consumer products: ra.co and the RA Guide app, used by millions of ticket buyers, readers and electronic music fans annually. The role also encompasses RA PRO, our B2B offering for promoters listing events and tickets on RA.

You'll work closely with Product Managers, Engineers, Data, Commercial and Growth teams to design experiences that help users stay engaged with the electronic music community via RA while contributing to the future development of the platform.

This is a senior role for a designer who combines strong product thinking and exceptional craft with hands-on experience of AI-assisted design. You'll lead projects from discovery through delivery, set the standard for design quality across the team, and own the evolution of the RA Design System so it works as well for AI tools and agents as it does for designers and engineers.

Responsibilities

Product design and leadership

  • Lead design for Resident Advisor's consumer products end to end, across web and native app touchpoints.
  • Set design direction and quality standards, and partner with Product, Engineering and Data leads to shape strategy, roadmaps and prioritisation.
  • Mentor and coach other designers through critique, pairing and feedback, raising the bar for craft across the team.
  • Lead discovery activities including user research, workshops and analysis of customer feedback and data.
  • Work closely with engineers throughout implementation to ensure quality execution and close the gap between design and code.

Design systems and AI

  • Own the RA Design System: maintain, evolve and govern tokens, components and patterns so they stay consistent across Figma and code.
  • Structure and document the design system so developers and AI can use it reliably and efficiently.
  • Bring AI into the design workflow, using it for research synthesis, ideation, prototyping and production, and helping the wider team adopt it thoughtfully.
  • Document design decisions, patterns and best practices in a way both people and AI tools can use.

Who we are looking for

  • A portfolio demonstrating strong product design thinking, visual craft and impact on products shipped at scale.
  • 4+ years of Product Design experience, including time in a senior or lead role setting design direction for a product area.
  • Experience mentoring designers and influencing product and engineering stakeholders.
  • Hands-on experience using AI in your design practice, from ideation and prototyping to working with AI coding tools, and a considered point of view on where it helps and where it doesn't.

The mandate

RA is looking for a Chief Content Officer to lead our media team and shape how we tell the story of electronic music and club culture. The role covers every place our voice shows up: editorial, films, audio formats and social output. You'll bring these together as one multimedia strategy, not separate channels.

Content is central to how people discover music and events on RA. You'll make sure it serves the business as well as the culture: driving discovery, supporting promoters and our network, and building RA's long-term relevance.

You'll set the creative vision and empower the team to deliver it with autonomy. You'll bring strong editorial judgement and a clear sense of what RA stands for, thinking quarters and years ahead without losing sight of what goes out this week. You'll own how the team works: formats, frequency, planning and process. A Managing Editor runs this day to day, and section leads report to you. Your job is to set the direction, standards and rhythm, including how AI changes the way the team works.

Responsibilities

Direction

  • Set RA's editorial strategy across all media formats, grounded in RA's scope of coverage and tied to company goals.
  • Build a unified multimedia approach, planning stories across formats and choosing the right outlet, frequency and context for each.
  • Own RA's editorial judgement, point of view and tone. Decide what we cover, how we cover it and where we draw the line.
  • Stay close to the scenes, first-hand and through RA's network around the world, and turn what you see and hear into what RA covers next.
  • Make the final call on sensitive or high-profile content, resolve competing priorities and keep work moving.
  • Work closely with Growth, Product and the network so content drives discovery across RA's platforms and supports the wider business.

Oversight

  • Oversee the execution and efficiency of editorial, films, podcasts, mixes and social, including ambitious flagship and long-form projects.
  • Keep RA's coverage genuinely global, ensuring strong local stories reach a wider audience beyond the usual cities.
  • Shape the editorial direction of content from RA's global network, including Mix of the Day, RA Picks and local coverage, while giving contributors the autonomy and support to do their best work.
  • Bring RA's creative vision to events and live programming, working with the events team on curation.

Standards

  • Hold a high bar on accuracy, cultural ethics and integrity.
  • Work with 23:59, RA's brand studio, so commercial work feels native to RA while protecting editorial independence.

Team

  • Lead and grow a multidisciplinary team of editors, writers, producers, video and audio makers, and social specialists.
  • Work with and develop strong section leads, giving them clear ownership and authority over their areas and offering constructive feedback.

Operations

  • Own the team's operating rhythm with the Managing Editor, so planning, commissioning, production and publishing hold up at pace, seven days a week.

jobs.title: Product Manager PRINCE2
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you interested in working with a leading education technology player, the global leader in the assessment and certification of professional skills industry with presence in more than 200 countries worldwide? If so, this is the chance to apply now! 📥

Shape the future of PRINCE2. The home of modern projects, programme, and portfolio management.

PeopleCert is looking for a Product Manager to help take our PRINCE2 portfolio of Best Practice to the next level of success - developing compelling propositions for globally recognised PRINCE2 products that ensure wide adoption among senior audiences, new sectors and markets. You will be responsible for the day-to-day management of key products in the PRINCE2 portfolio – including certifications, official publications and learning materials – making sure they remain high quality, relevant and well supported in market.

As Product Manager for the PRINCE2 portfolio, you will work closely with teams across the business in order to support delivery of the overall roadmap and enable commercial success for your product set within the PRINCE2 portfolio.

As Product Manager PRINCE2 your tasks will be the following:

Product strategy and vision

  • Contribute to the product vision and strategy, and develop and maintain the roadmap for your product set.
  • Conduct market research and analysis to identify trends, customer needs, and competitive landscape that will inform the product strategy.
  • Track agreed product goals and KPIs, and recommend actions to improve performance.

Product management

  • Monitor and analyze product performance, making data-driven recommendations to optimize and enhance your products.
  • Prioritise maintenance and improvement activities for your in-market products, to ensure continued relevance and positive customer experience.

New product development

  • Work proactively and collaboratively with teams across the business to ensure all aspects of product development, launch and in-market support are considered early in the business case and product design phase
  • Support the successful development and launch of new or updated products
  • Participate in all aspects of Product design, including: persona development; full end-to-end user journeys; service blueprints; key content and technical specifications
  • Design and manage the testing strategy for all products in development, to ensure they are consistently meeting the needs of our target audiences

Stakeholder collaboration

  • Contribute key elements to the go-to-market plans developed by Marketing, including positioning, key messaging and more.
  • Contribute to pricing proposals for your product set by providing market, competitor and partner insight, and supporting the relevant internal teams in pricing decisions.
  • Engage with internal and external stakeholders to secure buy-in and understanding of the product vision.

What we look for:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, or related field.
  • Minimum of 3 years’ experience in a Product Manager or Product Owner role in one of the following sectors: education, training, professional qualifications (e.g. ACA / CIPD etc.)
  • Knowledge of PeopleCert best practices and ideally familiar with PRINCE2 or other similar PPM (project, programme and portfolio) certification products.
  • Proven track record of managing multiple products and delivering successful outcomes.
  • Demonstrable experience of managing products through their whole lifecycle
  • Familiarity with all elements of product development, from discovery to delivery
  • Proven ability to evaluate product feedback objectively, and propose solutions to address business needs

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Stellenbeschreibung:

Rügamer & Steiner ist die führende E-Mail Marketing Agentur hinter den erfolgreichsten E-Commerce Unternehmen in DE, AU & CH.

Über 150 Online Shops vertrauen uns bereits und erreichen mit uns die Herzen & Geldbeutel ihrer Kunden.

Da immer mehr Kunden ihr Vertrauen in Rügamer & Steiner setzen suchen wir Dich als Projektmanager CRM & E-Mail Marketing (m/w/d).

Du bist die zentrale operative Schnittstelle zwischen Strategie, Kunden und Umsetzung.

Als Projektmanager stellst du sicher, dass Kampagnen schnell, sauber und effizient umgesetzt werden – ohne Reibungsverluste.

Perfekt für dich, wenn du bereits Agenturerfahrung hast und weißt, wie wichtig Tempo, Struktur und saubere Prozesse sind.

Aufgaben

Deine Aufgaben

  • Operative Umsetzung: Eigenständige Durchführung und technische Umsetzung von Marketing-Aufgaben und Kampagnen im Tagesgeschäft.
  • Daily Management & Ticketing: Strukturierte Erfassung, Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung aller eingehenden Aufgaben und Kundenanfragen.
  • Schnelle Kundenkommunikation: Sicherstellung extrem kurzer Reaktionszeiten. Kunden erhalten zeitnah (z. B. innerhalb von 30 bis 60 Minuten) eine erste Rückmeldung oder Zwischenantwort bei Anfragen.
  • Koordination: Steuerung der Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams (z. B. Grafik und Copy). Du erstellst Briefings, definierst klare Deadlines und nutzt Projektmanagement-Tools (z. B. ClickUp) für reibungslose Abläufe.
  • Qualitätssicherung: Einleitung, Koordination und konsequente Nachverfolgung von Korrekturschleifen bis zur finalen Freigabe.
  • Problemlösung: Schnelles und pragmatisches Lösen von technischen oder organisatorischen Hürden im laufenden Betrieb.

Du trägst die Verantwortung für eine zuverlässige operative Umsetzung und die konsequente Einhaltung aller Deadlines. Gleichzeitig stellst du sicher, dass alle Prozesse technisch sauber, fehlerfrei und mit hoher Reaktionsgeschwindigkeit in der Kundenbetreuung umgesetzt werden.

Qualifikation

Das solltest du sein:

➜ Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Projektmanagement und Marketing

➜ Du arbeitest strukturiert, extrem organisiert und proaktiv

➜ Du bist zuverlässig und kannst viele parallele Aufgaben (Tickets) effizient managen

➜ Du denkst lösungsorientiert und bringst technisches Verständnis mit

➜ Du kommunizierst klar, präzise und schnell – sowohl schriftlich als auch mündlich

Benefits

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.
  • Tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang und motivieren uns gegenseitig Bestleistungen zu erzielen und persönlich zu wachsen. Es gibt zudem ein monatliches Team-Lunch auf Kosten der Firma.
  • Gute Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter: innen erhalten eine faire Vergütung und vermögenswirksame Leistungen. Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter wachsen und expandieren. Daher benötigen wir weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte

  • Zusammenhalt in einem dynamischen und kollegialen Team

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We're building the future of urban stays. One city at a time.

Homaris widmet sich einer der drängendsten Herausforderungen moderner Städte: Menschen aus aller Welt brauchen Orte, an denen sie leben, arbeiten und sich zuhause fühlen können. Wir entwickeln und betreiben vollständig digitalisierte Serviced Apartments in den großen Städten Deutschlands. Unser nächster Schritt: Europa und darüber hinaus.

Mit dem nanopartment® verfolgen wir eine Produktvision, die modernes Wohnen auf Zeit neu denkt – auf kleinstmöglichem Raum.

Unser Umsatz verdreifacht sich innerhalb von zwei Jahren – organisch und aus eigener Kraft. Ohne Venture Capital. Ohne Exit-Strategie. Wir denken langfristig und bauen unser Unternehmen konsequent danach auf.

Außergewöhnliche Menschen machen diese Entwicklung möglich. Jetzt suchen wir eine weitere Person, die diesen Weg mit uns gestaltet.

Your Role

Du führst die operativen Fäden unserer digitalen Gästebetreuung. Aus dem Headoffice in Berlin arbeitest du mit dem Guest Service Supervisor Team und bist die zentrale Ansprechperson für unsere weltweiten Guest Service Agents. Du sorgst dafür, dass Gäste eine verlässliche Betreuung erleben, und hältst den Rücken frei für Teams, die täglich mit ihnen sprechen. Am Steuer unserer digitalen Rezeption schaffst du im Hintergrund den reibungslosen Ablauf jedes Aufenthalts.

What You'll Do

Betrieb. Du unterstützt das Guest Service Team im Tagesgeschäft und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Apartments aus dem Hintergrund reibungslos laufen.

Qualität. Du entwickelst neue Qualitätskonzepte, kontrollierst die Einhaltung unserer Standards in der Gästekommunikation und schulst die Agents fortlaufend.

Kommunikation. Du entwirfst Nachrichtenvorlagen, mit denen Gäste verlässlich, persönlich und im richtigen Ton erreicht werden.

Second Level. Du bist die Ansprechperson für Agents, wenn es komplex wird, und übernimmst die Lösung, wenn es darauf ankommt.

Onboarding. Du begleitest die Einarbeitung neuer Kolleg:innen und die Weiterbildung bestehender Teammitglieder.

Vertretung. Du vertrittst die Teamlead Guest Service bei Abwesenheit und behältst dann das gesamte Team im Blick.

Schnittstelle. Du stimmst dich eng mit internen Abteilungen und externen Dienstleistern ab, als verlässlicher Partner, der Lösungen zu Ende denkt.

What Makes You a Fit

Service mit Haltung. Du hast einen starken Dienstleistungsgedanken und dich stört es nicht, zu unterschiedlichen Tageszeiten sowie in geregelten Abständen am Wochenende im Dienst zu sein.

Erfahrung. Du bringst Berufserfahrung als Reservierungsmitarbeiter:in, Reservation Agent oder Manager:in, Call Center Agent, Rezeptionist:in oder aus einer anderen serviceorientierten Branche mit.

Organisation. Du organisierst und koordinierst souverän und denkst lösungsorientiert.

Kommunikationsstärke. Du findest schnell Zugang zu unterschiedlichen Persönlichkeiten und vermittelst Standpunkte, Ideen und Lösungen klar.

Digitale Werkzeuge. Du kommst mit Software und digitalen Lösungen im Alltag mühelos zurecht. Erfahrung mit Buchungsplattformen sowie den Property-Management-Systemen Apaleo oder Guesty ist ein Plus.

Sprachen. Du beherrschst Deutsch und Englisch fließend in Wort und Schrift (jeweils C1).

Digitale Neugier. Du erkennst Potenziale in neuen Tools und bist begeistert davon, wie KI deinen Arbeitsalltag effizienter macht.

The Environment

Homaris ist konsequent langfristig ausgerichtet. Wir investieren nicht in kurzfristiges Wachstum mit dem Ziel, schnell zu verkaufen. Wir bauen etwas Nachhaltiges und Substanzielles auf – und suchen M...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Software Fullstack Engineer Kasse & Support (m/w/d)

Hey du,

Freizeitparks, Trampolinhallen und Bäder verkaufen ihre Tickets über ticketbro. Seit Mitte Oktober 2026 läuft bei uns die ticketbro Kasse im Echtbetrieb, mit Stripe Terminal direkt am Tresen. Weitere Betreiber folgen. Für die Kasse suchen wir jemanden, der sie komplett übernimmt: Code, Rollout und die Betreuung der Anwender.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist verantwortlich für die ticketbro Kasse, vom Cloud-Backend bis zur Oberfläche am Terminal.

  • Du entwickelst neue Features und behebst Fehler, idealerweise basierend auf deinen eigenen Beobachtungen vor Ort.

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für Betreiber bei technischen Rückfragen, gelegentlich auch am Wochenende.

  • Du richtest die Kasse bei Bedarf direkt beim Betreiber ein und schulst das Team vor Ort.

  • Du bringst eigene Ideen ein, um die Kasse im Alltag effizienter und benutzerfreundlicher zu gestalten.

Dein Profil

  • Deutsch auf C1-Niveau, gute Englischkenntnisse.

  • Erfahrung mit React oder React Native und TypeScript sowie Grundkenntnisse in Node.js und AWS Lambda (Projekte aus Studium, Praktikum oder eigene Arbeiten sind ausreichend).

  • Du kannst komplexe Technik verständlich erklären und behältst auch in stressigen Situationen einen kühlen Kopf.

  • Von Vorteil: Kenntnisse in GraphQL, AWS CDK, Erfahrung mit Payment- oder Kassensystemen sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B.

  • Du wohnst idealerweise in München, dies ist jedoch keine zwingende Voraussetzung.

Was wir bieten

  • Echte Verantwortung für ein Produkt, das bei Betreibern live im Einsatz ist.

  • Anstellung als Werkstudent mit flexiblen Arbeitszeiten oder in Vollzeit, unbefristet.

  • Wettbewerbsfähiges Gehalt und bei Vollzeit 30 Tage Urlaub.

  • Hochwertiges Equipment.

  • Flache Hierarchien und direkter Austausch mit dem Management.

  • Büro in München.

Bewerbung

Schick uns ein kurzes Motivationsschreiben, einen Link zu GitHub oder zu einem Projekt, dein frühestmögliches Startdatum und deine Gehaltsvorstellung (als Werkstudent: Stunden pro Woche). Beantworte außerdem in zwei Sätzen: Ein Parkbetreiber ruft an, das Terminal verbindet sich nicht. Was fragst du als Erstes?

jobs.title: Founding Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About GlassFlow

GlassFlow builds data infrastructure for AI agents in production, featuring two core products: GlassFlow Tares, which feeds agents correlated data across systems, and GlassFlow Rius, which traces and debugs agent behavior. Operating as a Berlin startup backed by Upfront Ventures, the CEO of GitHub, and the ex-CTO of Aiven, the team comprises serial entrepreneurs with over 10 years of experience.

What you will do

As a Founding Engineer, you will shape the platform's technical foundation in a hybrid role based in Berlin. You will collaborate directly with the founders to build and scale the infrastructure supporting AI agents.

  • Product Integration for Client Use Cases

  • Go-to Person for technical questions for the internal sales and marketing team

  • Building and developing the connector and ingestion layer

  • Part of the core development team

  • Creation of product tutorials and guides

What the role requires

This permanent position is offered at 40 hours per week with a 6-month probation period. You will work within a small, fast-paced team environment.

You are:

  • Fluent in Python

  • Knowledge of frontend frameworks like TypeScript and React is a plus

  • Experience with public or private clouds (AWS / GCP / Azure)

  • Experience with DevOps (Kubernetes, Docker, GitHub Actions)

  • Worked in fast-growing environments and/or early-stage startups

  • Willing to work once a week in our Berlin office

Your first months at GlassFlow

You will dive straight into the core architecture, collaborating on initial feature rollouts for GlassFlow Tares and GlassFlow Rius. During your first months, you will establish foundational engineering workflows and contribute directly to the production codebase.

Working environment and perks

You will receive company stock options and flexible working hours to manage your schedule. The role includes public transportation benefits, home office options, and complete home office equipment alongside a company laptop and travel expenses compensation. Additional provisions include 28 vacation days per year, free beverages and snacks, team events, social activities, and a casual dress code.

  • Competitive salary with Stock Option Grant

  • Ticket for public transportation in Berlin

  • Company credit card with a monthly allowance

  • Newest tech of your choosing

  • Annual Learning budget for personal development

  • Generous WFH policy and a budget for home office setup

GlassFlow is an equal opportunity employer that values diversity in the workplace. We encourage applications from all qualified individuals, including those with diverse backgrounds and disabilities.

jobs.title: Founding Robotics Engineer Navigation & Autonomy
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT NAXON

Naxon Robotics deploys swarms of mobile robots, quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, for security and industrial inspection. The fleet patrols perimeters, detects anomalies and inspects assets as one coordinated system, covering more ground 24/7 , delivering more value and reaching ROI faster than a single robot or a fleet of disconnected ones.

Why now: rising threats to critical infrastructure, too few people in security and industry , cheap and reliable hardware and fast moving AI agents. Hardware is ready . Deployment is not. Every new site is still a months-long expert project, so pilots rarely turn into rollouts. We make deployment repeatable, with swarms and an agentic platform that learns from each site.

Backed by EWOR, TUM VLABs and a robotics founder who built and exited a drone swarm company . Mentored by unicorn founders and Prof. Johannes Betz (autonomous driving and robotics, TUM).

THE ROLE

You own the autonomy stack every robot in our fleet runs on: SLAM, localisation and navigation, indoors and outdoors, across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones. You take it from the lab to production at customer sites and keep it robust there.

As the fleet grows, you grow the stack into multi robot coordination. This is the core the whole company scales on. You own the stack. The Field Robotics Engineer owns what runs at the customer.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Build and own SLAM, localisation, mapping and navigation, indoor and outdoor

  • Select, combine and calibrate sensors: lidar , depth, RGB, thermal, IMU and GNSS

  • Generalise the stack across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones

  • Test and tune on real robots with benchmarks and field data, not only in simulation

  • Define what runs on the robot and what runs in the cloud, including failure and fallback

  • Take the stack to production at customer sites, then extend it to multi robot coordination

WHAT YOU BRING

  • Has taken SLAM or an autonomy stack to production at real customers, not only research demos

  • Strong in SLAM, localisation, state estimation and motion planning

  • Expert in ROS2, C++ and Python, and a heavy user of AI coding agents

  • Hands on with quadrupeds, wheeled robots or drones and their sensors on real hardware

  • MSc / PhD plus 2 to 4 years in industry, or equivalent proven experience

WHY JOIN NAXON

  • The challenge: one map shared across quadrupeds, wheeled robots and drones, task allocation across a live site, and an edge/cloud split over networks that drop

  • Full ownership of your area, from architecture to what runs at the customer , and a clear path into leading it

  • Real robots at real customer sites, from research to working reliably in real world conditions

  • Hands-on work with cutting-edge robotics, hardware and AI

  • Competitive salary and equity (VSOP / ESOP) as a founding team member

  • Backing from EWOR and robotics mentors who hav...

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Isembard

Isembard is rebuilding industrial capacity through a connected network of factories. We bring skilled people, advanced machine tools and our own software, MasonOS, together to make precision components for aerospace, defence, energy and robotics.

The role

This role sits where MasonOS meets the shop floor. Every new factory in our network adds training, adoption and support work. You will embed with factories and network sites, own their success with MasonOS end to end, ship production code, apply AI to their workflows and build the tools that make each new site easier than the last.

It is not a support role. It is a build role, deployed forward, defining a new function rather than filling a seat. You will be based at our Hamburg factory, with roughly 30 to 50 per cent of your time embedded at other sites. We are open to graduate and experienced engineers. The package includes equity.

  • Run onboarding, training and day-to-day adoption with machinists, engineers and site operators.

  • Turn repeated support questions into playbooks, training material or self-service tools. You are measured on the support burden falling, not on tickets closed.

  • Put agentic workflows into operational use: reporting, supplier follow-ups and order status.

  • Ship fixes and small features into MasonOS through the same review as every other engineer.

  • Turn patterns from the field into clear, written requirements for the roadmap.

What you bring

  • The ability to ship production code with minimal supervision.

  • Full-stack fluency across backend, frontend and integrations.

  • Hands-on experience applying LLMs to real workflows.

  • Clear communication with operators and technical leaders, and the ability to build trust on site.

  • The judgement to decide what matters without waiting for a ticket queue.

  • Useful, not essential: forward-deployed or deployment engineering experience, exposure to manufacturing, CNC, aerospace or defence, or MES or ERP systems.

jobs.title: SAP Integration Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

We are looking for an SAP Integration Architect to own how Finto connects to SAP. Some of our customers run their finance operations on SAP, and no two landscapes look alike: R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, on-premise and cloud, Business One and Business ByDesign. You'll design how master data, invoices and postings move between those systems and our AI platform, and turn what starts as a bespoke integration into a product that goes live in weeks. This is a hands-on role, working directly with our CTO and the founding team: you'll set the architecture, write code, and sit across the table from customer IT. You're the first hire dedicated to SAP at Finto and you define what the practice becomes. We're headquartered in Munich, with roots in San Francisco through Y Combinator.

What you'll do

  • Own the end-to-end architecture from a customer's SAP system into Finto: master data, invoices, postings, write-back.

  • Choose the integration path per SAP flavour - OData, IDoc, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI, file-based - and make that choice repeatable instead of re-deciding it per customer.

  • Build the connector platform: templates, validation, monitoring, and the tooling that makes every new landscape faster than the last.

  • Translate FI and MM process knowledge into specifications and field mappings our engineers build against.

  • Ship production code with the engineering team - same repo, same reviews, Node.js and TypeScript.

  • Be the SAP authority in the room: with customer IT, with their integration partners, and in our own technical conversations with prospects.

  • Set the standard for how Finto goes live on SAP, and move more of it into the product with every rollout.

What we're looking for

  • 5+ years of hands-on SAP integration work in real customer landscapes across R/3, ECC and S/4HANA, ideally more than one generation of them.

  • Deep knowledge of the accounts payable process in SAP: FI, MM, the document flow around incoming invoices, tax determination, and why the field a customer means is rarely the field the label says.

  • Fluency across SAP's integration surface - OData, IDocs, BAPI/RFC, BTP/CPI - and a clear position on clean core.

  • Strong coding skills, ideally in TypeScript/Node.js. You architect and you build; specifications alone aren't the job.

  • A product instinct: you'd rather build a pattern once than map the same fields twice.

  • Confidence in front of enterprise IT teams, and the directness to tell them when an export won't work.

  • Fluent German and English.

  • Bonus points for ABAP, for time on the consulting side of SAP rollouts, or for anything you've built that made your own job smaller.

Work at Finto

  • An environment where we enable you to have an impact and where we focus on outcomes, not time-tracking.

  • Career-defining growth: Big ambitions mean rapid progression, expanding responsibilities, and access to our San Francisco & YC network.

  • Shape your future role: As an early team member, you define what SAP at Finto looks like, and grow...

Lead Architect & Platform Engineer

Are you looking for an architecture role where you do not simply optimize existing structures within a decades old IT environment? As a Lead Architect & Platform Engineer, you will have the opportunity to build key parts of a modern cloud and platform architecture from the ground up while actively shaping standards, integration patterns, and technical guidelines. Apply now and help build the technological foundation for the company’s next stage of development. 

Your benefits as Lead Architect & Platform Engineer 

  • Creative Freedom: Help build modern cloud and platform architectures and influence which technologies and standards will be used in the long term. 

  • Flexibility: Organize your working day largely on your own and work flexibly from home or anywhere in Germany. At the same time, you should be willing to attend important workshops and meetings in person when required. 

  • Workation: Take up to four weeks of workation within the EU and, subject to agreement, potentially beyond the EU. 

  • Pension: Benefit from an occupational pension scheme with a 50% employer contribution. 

  • Development: Take advantage of individual training opportunities, language courses, and personal learning programs. 

  • Environment: Work in an international environment with flat hierarchies, short decision making processes, and a high degree of personal responsibility. 

  • Compensation: Enjoy an attractive overall package with a variable component that reflects your experience and technical expertise. 

Your tasks as Lead Architect & Platform Engineer 

  • Architecture: Develop the target cloud architecture as well as microservices, data layers, and AI services. 

  • Cloud Platform: Design landing zones, networks, identity concepts, and governance structures. 

  • DevOps: Develop standards for CI/CD, release strategies, and Infrastructure as Code. 

  • Integration: Define architecture and integration patterns for APIs, events, and batch interfaces. 

  • Security: Incorporate security, monitoring, resilience, high availability, and regulatory requirements into the architecture. 

  • Data & AI: Translate data and AI strategies into concrete architecture components and integration patterns. 

  • Technical Sparring: Support Development, Infrastructure, Security, and business teams with technical decisions.

jobs.title: Data Ingenieur (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Data Ingenieur


Du bist technisch versiert, probierst gerne neue Ansätze aus und möchtest nicht bei jeder Entscheidung durch bestehende Strukturen ausgebremst werden? Als Data Ingenieur erwartet dich eine Umgebung, in der vieles neu aufgebaut wird und du deine technischen Vorstellungen aktiv einbringen kannst. Von der Architektur über Datenpipelines bis hin zu Data Quality und AI Schnittstellen kannst du moderne Lösungen entwickeln und dabei Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung übernehmen. Bewirb dich jetzt und nutze den technischen Spielraum, den diese Position bietet. 

Deine Benefits als Data Ingenieur

  • Vergütung: Freue dich auf ein attraktives Gehalt mit zusätzlichem variablem Anteil, das deiner Erfahrung und technischen Expertise entspricht.  

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Baue eine zentrale Datenplattform von Grund auf mit auf und bringe deine eigenen technischen Ideen ein. Hier gibt es viel Raum, moderne Lösungen auszuprobieren und die technische Architektur aktiv mitzugestalten. 

  • Flexibilität: Gestalte deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbst und arbeite flexibel aus dem Homeoffice oder von deinem Wohnort in Deutschland. Für wichtige Meetings, Workshops und den persönlichen Austausch wird gleichzeitig deine Bereitschaft zur Teilnahme vor Ort erwartet. 

  • Workation: Nutze bis zu vier Wochen Workation innerhalb der EU und nach Absprache gegebenenfalls darüber hinaus. 

  • Altersvorsorge: Profitiere von einer betrieblichen Altersversorgung mit 50 % Arbeitgeberbeteiligung. 

  • Entwicklung: Nutze individuelle Weiterbildungen, Sprachkurse und persönliche Lernangebote. 

  • Internationalität: Arbeite in einem internationalen Umfeld mit Deutsch und Englisch als Geschäftssprachen. 

Deine Aufgaben als Data Ingenieur

  • Data Layer: Übernimm Betrieb und Weiterentwicklung der Databricks basierten Datenplattform inklusive Workspaces, Jobs und Berechtigungen. 

  • Datenpipelines: Entwickle robuste ETL und ELT Pipelines für Banking, Treasury, Payments, Exportfinanzierung und weitere Datenquellen. 

  • Architektur: Gestalte Data Lake und Lakehouse Strukturen sowie skalierbare und performante Datenmodelle. 

  • Data Quality: Implementiere automatisierte Qualitätsprüfungen und stelle Vollständigkeit, Aktualität und Konsistenz der Daten sicher. 

  • Monitoring: Baue Monitoring und Alerting für Pipelines, Jobs, Latenzen und Fehler auf. 

  • Governance: Dokumentiere Datenflüsse und Lineage und unterstütze bei Datenklassifizierung, Zugriffskontrollen und regulatorischen Anforderungen. 

  • AI Enablement: Stelle geeignete Daten und Schnittstellen für AI Use Cases und MLOps bereit. 

  • Zusammenarbeit: Unterstütze Fachbereiche bei Datenanalysen und arbeite eng mit Architecture, Platform, Risk und Compliance zusammen.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Intro

Bei Arvana bauen wir die erste AI-native Go-to-Market-Firma in DACH. Seit 2024 sind wir auf über 5 Mio. € ARR und mehr als 30 Leute im Team gewachsen, und wir legen gerade erst richtig los. Über 200 Unternehmen wie Swisscom, monday.com, Enpal, Talkdesk und FreeNow setzen bereits auf uns.

Als Founders Associate übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung für strategische Projekte, baust Prozesse mit Tools wie n8n und Claude auf und treibst sie eigenständig voran. Starten kannst du ab sofort.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die volle Verantwortung für die Finanzplanung, von der Budgetierung bis zum Forecast, und entwickelst skalierbare Prozesse für nachhaltiges Wachstum.
  • Du findest Optimierungspotenziale und automatisierst operative Abläufe mit KI-Tools wie Claude Code und OpenClaw und Plattformen wie n8n, Make.com und Zapier.
  • Du baust moderne Business-Intelligence-Strukturen auf, zum Beispiel mit Snowflake und Looker Studio, und schaffst so datengetriebene Entscheidungsgrundlagen.
  • Du bist Sparring für unsere Gründer bei strategischen und operativen Entscheidungen und bringst eigene Perspektiven in den Wachstumsprozess ein.
  • Du entwickelst neue Business-Ideen und Go-to-Market-Strategien und setzt sie von 0 auf 1 um.
  • Du schaffst Klarheit in komplexen Themen durch saubere Analysen, strukturierte Entscheidungsgrundlagen und klare Umsetzungspläne.

Qualifikation

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau: Du sprichst und schreibst Deutsch sicher und überzeugend, denn unsere Kunden sitzen in DACH.
  • Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Du hast deinen Bachelor oder Master abgeschlossen und 1 bis 3 Jahre relevante Erfahrung in schnellen Umfeldern wie Startups, Consulting oder VC gesammelt.
  • Führung: Du hast erste Erfahrung darin, Mitarbeitende oder Praktikanten zu führen, und gehst mit gutem Beispiel voran.
  • Unternehmergeist: Du interessierst dich für den Aufbau von Unternehmen und willst ständig Neues lernen.
  • Arbeitsweise: Du bist zielstrebig, proaktiv und übernimmst Verantwortung.
  • Anspruch: Du stellst hohe Qualitätsansprüche an dich und andere und motivierst dein Umfeld mit einer Can-do-Mentalität.
  • Englisch: Du sprichst und schreibst fließend Englisch.

Benefits

  • Coaching & Karriere: Ab Tag 1 lernst du in 1:1-Coachings von erfahrenen Leuten. Und weil wir so schnell wachsen, entstehen laufend neue Fach- und Führungsrollen.
  • Nicht mehr kochen: Jeden Abend ab 19 Uhr bestellen wir Essen fürs Team.
  • 3+2 Hybrid Work: Drei Tage arbeitest du mit dem Team im Office, bis zu zwei Tage remote.
  • Top Lage & Ausstattung: Unser modernes Office liegt in Berlin-Mitte, zwischen Hackeschem Markt und Alexanderplatz. Du arbeitest mit erstklassiger technischer Ausstattung, inklusive MacBook.
  • Deutschlandticket inklusive: Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Ticket.
  • Strategy-Offsites: Regelmäßig nehmen wir uns als ganzes Team raus und arbeiten gemeinsam an der Strategie und Zukunft von Arvana.
  • Kostenlos trainieren: Mit der Urban Sports Club M-Mitgliedschaft trainierst du ohne Zusatzkosten.
