jobs.title: Business Analyst (m/w/d) Digital Products & Apps
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Das baust du mit uns auf

Zwischen einer guten Idee und einem funktionierenden digitalen Produkt liegen viele Fragen. Was brauchen wir wirklich? Wie setzen wir es um? Und wie sorgen wir dafür, dass am Ende alles zusammenpasst?

Bei GENO Broker entwickeln wir ein neues digitales Brokerage-Angebot mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die komplexe Anforderungen verstehen, Zusammenhänge erkennen und aus unterschiedlichen Perspektiven klare Lösungen entwickeln.

Als Business Analyst arbeitest du an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereichen, Produktmanagement und IT. Du analysierst Anforderungen, strukturierst Prozesse und begleitest die Entwicklung unserer digitalen Produkte und Apps. Dabei schaffst du die Grundlage dafür, dass aus fachlichen Ideen funktionierende digitale Anwendungen werden.

Das wirst du bei uns machen

  • Du erhebst, analysierst und strukturierst fachliche Anforderungen für unsere digitalen Produkte und Apps und sorgst dafür, dass aus unterschiedlichen Bedürfnissen klare Anforderungen entstehen.

  • Du entwickelst Fachkonzepte, formulierst User Stories und übersetzt komplexe fachliche Fragestellungen gemeinsam mit den Entwicklungsteams in technisch umsetzbare Lösungen.

  • Du analysierst bestehende und neue Geschäftsprozesse, identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale und entwickelst passende Prozessmodelle und Lösungsansätze.

  • Du begleitest die Konzeption, Weiterentwicklung und Integration digitaler Produkte und Anwendungen und stellst sicher, dass fachliche Anforderungen bei der Umsetzung berücksichtigt werden.

  • Du analysierst Daten und relevante KPIs, erkennst Zusammenhänge und bereitest Ergebnisse als Grundlage für fachliche Entscheidungen auf.

  • Du planst und moderierst Workshops und Abstimmungen mit Fachbereichen, Produktmanagement und IT, um Anforderungen zu klären und gemeinsame Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Du koordinierst die fachliche Abstimmung zwischen Business, IT und externen Partnern und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Abhängigkeiten und offene Fragen transparent bleiben.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung als Business Analyst, Requirements Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle gesammelt, idealerweise im Umfeld digitaler Produkte, Apps oder E-Commerce.

  • Du kennst die Methoden des Requirements Engineering und der Business Analyse aus der Praxis und hast bereits fachliche Anforderungen strukturiert und dokumentiert.

  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Analyse und Modellierung von Geschäftsprozessen und kennst idealerweise Methoden wie BPMN.

  • Du bist mit agilen Arbeitsweisen wie Scrum oder Kanban vertraut und hast bereits mit Tools wie Jira, Confluence oder vergleichbaren Anwendungen gearbeitet.

  • Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte schnell erfassen, strukturiert aufbereiten und zwischen fachlichen und technischen Perspektiven vermitteln.

  • Du bringst analytisches Denkvermögen, eine sorgfältige Arbeitsweise und ein gutes Gespür für Zusammenhänge und Abhängigkeiten mit.

  • Du hast bereits mit unterschiedlichen Fachbereichen oder Entwicklungsteams zusammengearbeitet und kannst Anforderungen und Erwartungen klar kommunizieren.

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, stellst die richtigen Fragen und hast Lust darauf, digitale Produkte und Prozesse von Anfang an mitzugestalten.

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung im Banking-, Brokerage- oder FinTech-Umfeld.

  • Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse und KPI-Reporting.

  • Erfahrung in Digitalisierungs- oder Transformationsprojekten.

  • Zertifizierungen wi...

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unseren wichtigsten Wachstumskanal, Google. Dabei setzt du konsequent auf KI: von Performance Max über automatisierte Gebotsstrategien bis zu Creatives, die mit KI erstellt werden. Dein Ziel ist profitables Wachstum in mehreren europäischen Märkten.

  • Echte Verantwortung für einen sechs- bis siebenstelligen Werbeetat

  • Freiraum für KI-Experimente mit Zugang zu aktuellen Tools und Lizenzen

  • Ein Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen, ohne Konzernstrukturen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Design, Content und E-Commerce

  • Attraktives Gehalt und echte Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit Office und Remote-Flexibilität

  • Budget für Weiterbildungen, Konferenzen und Zertifizierungen

jobs.title: Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) Service & Modernisierung
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Für die Verstärkung unseres Vertriebsteams suchen wir im Großraum Bayern einen qualifizierten und engagierten Vertriebsmitarbeiter (m/w/d) Service & Modernisierung für Aufzüge und fördertechnische Anlagen.

Lödige Industries mit Hauptsitz in Paderborn (NRW) ist mit mehr als 1.400 Mitarbeitern und Tochterunternehmen in Europa, Asien, Amerika, Australien und dem Nahen Osten einer der weltweit führenden Anbieter von Logistiksystemen und Aufzugslösungen. Seit mehr als 75 Jahren bieten wir zuverlässige Lösungen für ein breites Branchenspektrum und sind Weltmarktführer im Bereich Flughafenlogistik.

Aufgaben

  • Akquisition und Kundenbetreuung im Vertriebsgebiet (z. B. Analyse von potenziellen Kunden, Kontaktaufnahme, Neukundenakquise sowie Betreuung der Bestandskunden, etc.)

  • Bearbeitung und Erstellung von Service-Vertragsangeboten zu Wartungen und Modernisierungen (z. B. Angebotserstellung, Kalkulation, Präsentation beim Kunden, technische Detailklärung, Zusammenarbeit mit dem Vertriebsinnendienst, etc.)

  • Ermitteln von notwendigen Modernisierungsbedarfen im Vertriebsgebiet

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Servicemeistern und Servicetechnikern, um die Anlagenverfügbarkeit unserer Kunden zu steigern

Qualifikation

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter*in Kreditsicherung / Abwicklung (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zwischen Hanse, Tradition und Zukunft gestalten wir seit vielen Jahren die finanzielle Heimat unserer Kundinnen und Kunden. Damit das auch in herausfordernden Situationen gelingt, braucht es Menschen, die mit Weitblick, Verantwortungsbewusstsein und Fingerspitzengefühl handeln.

Als Spezialist*in Kreditsicherung/Abwicklung (m/w/d) begleitest Du anspruchsvolle Engagements, erkennst Risiken frühzeitig und trägst aktiv dazu bei, nachhaltige Lösungen für unsere Kundinnen und Kunden sowie unsere Bank zu entwickeln. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit verschiedenen Fachbereichen zusammen und leistest einen wichtigen Beitrag für eine starke Region Lübeck.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du analysierst ausfallgefährdete Kreditengagements und entwickelst gemeinsam mit den Beteiligten tragfähige Sanierungs- und Lösungsansätze.

  • Du verantwortest die sach- und termingerechte Abwicklung ausgefallener Engagements und leitest geeignete Maßnahmen zur Schadenbegrenzung ein.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit Rechtsanwälten, Insolvenzverwaltern und weiteren externen Partnern zusammen und begleitest gerichtliche sowie außergerichtliche Verfahren.

  • Du steuerst die Verwertung von Sicherheiten und verfolgst Forderungen konsequent, um Ausfälle zu minimieren.

  • Du führst Analysen zu möglichen Kreditausfällen durch und unterstützt die Ermittlung von Wertberichtigungsbedarfen.

  • Du wirkst bei der Erstellung von Reportings und Kreditrisikoberichten mit und leistest damit einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Risikosteuerung der Gesamtbank.

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Eine abgeschlossene Bankausbildung sowie idealerweise eine weiterführende Qualifikation im Kreditgeschäft.

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in den Bereichen Kreditsicherung, Marktfolge Aktiv, Sanierung oder Problemkreditbearbeitung.

  • Gute Kenntnisse im privaten und gewerblichen Kreditgeschäft sowie im Risiko- und Sicherheitenmanagement.

  • Verständnis für aufsichtsrechtliche und regulatorische Anforderungen.

  • Eine analytische und lösungsorientierte Denkweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Risikobewusstsein.

  • Verhandlungsgeschick, Durchsetzungsvermögen und Fingerspitzengefühl im Umgang mit anspruchsvollen Kundensituationen.

  • Eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise.

  • Teamgeist sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.

Neben einem engagierten Team erwarten Dich:

  • Ein modernes, kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Teamarbeit und ein respektvoller Umgang großgeschrieben werden.

  • Die Möglichkeit, deine Kompetenzen weiter auszubauen und an wichtigen, zukunftsweisenden Projekten mitzuarbeiten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle und die Option auf mobiles Arbeiten – wir wissen, wie wichtig die richtige Work-Life-Balance ist.

  • Ein attraktives Gehaltspaket, weitreichende Kompetenzen und zahlreiche Benefits, die dir und deiner Familie zugutekommen.

  • Eine Unternehmenskultur, die deine Ideen und dein Engagement schätzt und fördert.

P.S.: Du möchtest einen ersten Einblick in die Volksbank Lübeck erhalten? Dann geht's hier zum Video "Hinter den Kulissen der Volksbank Lübeck eG" von der Wirtschaftsförderung Lübeck.

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt? Dann bist Du genau richtig bei uns und hoffentlich bereit den nächsten Schritt zu gehen!

Bewirb Dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres dynamischen Teams, das gemeinsam die Zukunft gestaltet.

Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich kennenzulernen!

Und wenn Du noch Fragen hast, sind Deine Ansprechpartner:

Volker Navrath, Bereichsleiter Marktfolge Aktiv: 0451 1404-610

Cihan Dilek

jobs.title: (Senior) Privacy Manager - Governance & Legal (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Support us in designing the insurance experience of the future. As our (Senior) Privacy Manager (all genders), you will further shape and build getolo's privacy organisation enabling us to further scale and expand our European business. You will take ownership of developing our privacy framework, from governance structure, processes and controls to tools and documentation, and bring it to life across the company. You will report to our Head of Governance & Legal, who will be your sparring partner and support you in implementing the relevant structures.

This is a full-time hybrid role, with 1–2 days per week in our Berlin office.

Requirements

Your Mission

Strengthening our privacy organisation

  • Taking getolo's privacy organization to the next level: furthering governance model, roles and responsibilities, policies, processes and controls
  • Define clear accountabilities between business teams, privacy and control functions (3 lines of defense), and establish the corresponding reporting and escalation lines
  • Reinforce a sustainable records of processing and data inventory that will keep pace with our products and data landscape going forward
  • Furthering privacy monitoring and controls, including KPIs and regular management reporting
  • Strengthening privacy awareness across the company through training and practical guidance

 

Privacy by design & technology

  • Embed privacy by design and by default into our product and software development lifecycle
  • Work with data and engineering teams on data architecture, retention and deletion concepts
  • Drive the implementation and automation of processes and privacy tools, e.g. DSR workflows and data mapping solutions

 

Day-to-day privacy advisory

  • Act as the first point of contact for data protection issues across business projects, ensuring compliance with the GDPR, BDSG, TDDDG and related regulations
  • Conduct and guide data protection impact assessments and risk assessments with our DPO at Zurich, and drive the mitigation of identified risks
  • Prepare, review and negotiate data processing agreements, international transfer mechanisms and privacy clauses
  • Oversee the handling of data subject requests and personal data breaches, including notification processes
  • Ensure the compliant processing of special categories of personal data, in particular health data
  • Assess AI use cases from a privacy perspective and support our AI inventory and AI risk assessments
  • Continuous Exchange with our DPO and her Privacy Team at Zurich

Governance & legal support

  • Prepare, review, and coordinate commercial contracts within established templates / frameworks, involving Group Legal where required
  • Contribute to the maintenance and accuracy of legal templates, registers, and internal guidance materials
  • Monitor and give advice on legislative and regulatory developments in data protection and digital regulation

Project Management

  • Apply structured project management methodologies to deliver governance & legal initiatives efficiently
  • Scope, plan, and execute cross-functional projects, ensuring stakeholder alignment and measurable outcomes
  • Champion process optimisation and continuous improvement in operational workflows, drawing on best practices from modern legal operations and project delivery models

What you will need to succeed

  • At least 5 years of professional experience in data protection, ideally in-house in a regulated, fast-paced or international environment

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) Elektroinstallation
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres DEA-Regler Teams suchen wir Dich als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Bereich Elektroinstallation,

Du möchtest neben Deinem Studium praktische Erfahrungen sammeln und die Elektrotechnik auch abseits von Vorlesungen und Theorie kennenlernen? Bei uns bekommst Du die Möglichkeit, direkt mit anzupacken und unser Team beim Aufbau und der Verdrahtung von Schaltschränken sowie bei elektrotechnischen Installationen zu unterstützen. Dabei lernst Du unsere technischen Abläufe kennen und kannst Dein Wissen Schritt für Schritt in der Praxis erweitern.

Über ee technik gmbh

Seit über 10 Jahren entwickeln wir smarte Automatisierungslösungen für stabile Stromnetze – überwiegend Fernwirktechnik, Einspeisemanagement und EZA-/DEA-Regler Systeme. Unser Team aus Ingenieur:innen und Techniker:innen arbeitet an der Schnittstelle von Energiewende und digitaler Infrastruktur. Die ee technik gmbh ist nach DIN ISO 9001 zertifiziert – Prozessklarheit, Qualität und Verlässlichkeit sind keine Versprechen, sondern gelebter Alltag.

Dein Versprechen:

„Ich trage mit Engagement zur Unterstützung unserer Automatisierungsprojekte bei: neugierig, lernbereit und zuverlässig. Ich nutze die Chance, praktische Erfahrungen zu sammeln, und bin bereit, mein Wissen aktiv einzubringen. Ich stelle sicher, dass unsere Aufgaben effizient und strukturiert bearbeitet werden und unterstütze das Team mit frischen Perspektiven.“

Wenn das dein Arbeitsstil ist, dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Hier kannst du wertvolle Praxiserfahrungen sammeln und in einem motivierten Team wachsen.

Du möchtest dein theoretisches Wissen in der Praxis anwenden und die Automatisierungstechnik hautnah erleben? Dann bist du bei uns richtig.

Das erwartet dich

  • Du unterstützt beim Aufbau und der Montage unserer Schaltschränke.

  • Bei der Verdrahtung und dem Anschluss elektrischer Komponenten arbeitest Du eng mit unserem Team zusammen.

  • Die Vorbereitung und Bestückung von Montageplatten und Schaltschrankgehäusen gehören ebenfalls zu Deinen Aufgaben.

  • Du wirkst bei elektrotechnischen Installationen und Montagearbeiten mit.

  • Gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Kolleg:innen unterstützt Du bei Prüfungen, Funktionstests und Inbetriebnahmen.

  • Auch die Vorbereitung von Werkzeugen und Materialien sowie die Pflege technischer Dokumentationen gehören zu Deinem Aufgabenbereich.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist in einem Studium der Elektrotechnik oder einem vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang eingeschrieben.

  • Du interessierst Dich für Schaltschrankbau, Elektroinstallation und praktische Elektrotechnik.

  • Erste elektrotechnische Kenntnisse oder praktische Erfahrungen sind von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.

  • Handwerkliches Geschick und technisches Verständnis bringst Du mit.

  • Eine sorgfältige, strukturierte und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise zeichnet Dich aus.

To join our Consumer Membership Team, we are looking for a:

Senior Product Manager Growth (f/m/d)

Cologne (hybrid) or Berlin (remote) | Permanent Contract (Full-time)

jobs.title: Finance Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About much. GmbH

much. Consulting is an ERP & automation consultancy with 120 people in Germany, Portugal and the UK. We grow fast and profitable, which gives us room to make bold moves. Next up: building a finance function that matches our size and starting to acquire competitors.

The role


You join as the first finance manager of the group and report directly to the CEO. Your job is to take our finance function to the next level and kickstart our M&A. You work with a small team and our external tax advisors (in all countries) and a lot of freedom in how you build things. Nothing is set in stone and much needs improvement. You'll build processes from scratch, fix what's broken yourself and decide what's worth doing at all.

What you will do

  • Develop and control cash plan, business plan and budgets

  • Be our treasurer, find savings in our cost base and see them through

  • Maintain transfer pricing and intercompany agreements together with our advisors

  • Support on acquisitions: financial models, due diligence and integrating new companies into group reporting

What you bring

  • 2 to 5 years in audit, transaction services or finance at a growing company

  • Deep accounting and controlling knowledge, ideally across multiple countries

  • You learn fast and enjoy taking on things you haven't done before

  • You act like it's your own money

  • You'd rather build the cash forecast yourself than write a concept for it

  • You prefer working with data in systems over manual processes; SQL or ERP experience helps

  • Fluent in English and German (both min. C1)

What we offer

  • Contribute to every major decision

  • Short decision paths. If you have a good idea on Monday, it can be live by Friday.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
BeyondTrust is a place where you can bring your purpose to life through the work that you do, creating a safer world through our cybersecurity SaaS portfolio.

Our culture of flexibility, trust, and continual learning means you will be recognized for your growth, and for the impact you make on our success. You will be surrounded by people who challenge, support, and inspire you to be the best version of yourself.

The Role

BeyondTrust’s Field Operations team sits at the center of how the company plans, forecasts, and executes revenue. We are building a team that operates with the analytic rigor of a finance org and the speed of a sales floor — and we need operators who can do both.

The Senior Sales Operations Analyst is a high-visibility individual contributor role reporting to the Director of Sales Operations. You will own the analytic backbone of our GTM motion: building the models, reports, and processes that sales leadership relies on to call the business, allocate resources, and drive execution across seven global theatres. Your work will span pipeline analytics and conversion trends, revenue planning and capacity modeling, and quota and territory design. You will be the person who turns raw Salesforce and Databricks data into forward-looking indicators that change how leaders make decisions — and you will partner closely with our GTM Engineer to operationalize AI-driven workflows that make the entire sales org faster and more precise.

This is not a back-office reporting role. Your analysis will show up in CRO forecast calls, board materials, and strategic planning sessions. If you want a seat where your work directly shapes how a high-growth cybersecurity company runs its revenue engine, this is it.

What You’ll Do

  • Pipeline Analytics & Forecasting: Deliver data-driven insights and forward-looking indicators for continuous improvement of sales forecasts, rep efficiency analytics, opportunity pipeline analysis, and conversion trends.
  • Revenue Planning & Modeling: Build bottom-up plans, capacity models, quota frameworks, and scenario analyses to improve forecast accuracy and planning confidence.
  • Process Design & Automation: Improve revenue execution by scaling reporting, reducing manual friction, and strengthening transparency across quotas, compensation, and strategic growth programs.
  • Territory & Segmentation Analysis: Build and maintain territory models that balance rep capacity, account coverage, and market opportunity — supporting annual planning and in-cycle territory realignments.
  • Standard Operating Procedures: Manage, document, and continuously improve the standard operating procedures that support the GTM motion — ensuring operational knowledge is codified and not trapped in any single person.
  • Data Integrity: Identify and lead data cleanup and enrichment projects that keep Salesforce and downstream reporting systems trustworthy and audit-ready.
  • AI Workflow Operationalization: Partner with the GTM Engineer to test, validate, and operationalize AI skills and automations — serving as the voice of the field to ensure new tooling fits real seller workflows.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead and own special initiatives and ad hoc requests from sales leadership — the kind of work that doesn’t fit in a standing process but needs to be right and fast.
  • Trends & Reporting: Surface trends, risks, and wins using both quantitative and qualitative analysis — building the narrative around the numbers, not just the numbers themselves.

jobs.title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Ferriday, LA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

The Systems Engineer - Patch Management is responsible for the execution, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of enterprise patching and vulnerability remediation activities. This role helps ensure Windows and Linux servers and workstations remain secure, compliant, and current with required operating system and security updates.

  • Execute scheduled patching for Windows and Linux servers and workstations across development, test, and production environments.
  • Deploy operating system and security updates using Microsoft Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM), Ansible, PowerShell, Bash, and related automation tools.
  • Monitor patch deployments and validate successful installation following scheduled maintenance windows.
  • Maintain patching groups, deployment schedules, maintenance windows, and device targeting.
  • Support accelerated patching and remediation of critical and internet-facing vulnerabilities requiring shortened remediation timelines.
  • Track patch compliance and remediation progress against established SLAs, security requirements, and compliance targets.

This position routes external requests to the appropriate staff member, assists with device troubleshooting, escalates unresolved issues, and follows requests through resolution. The role also includes occasional direct patient support, device returns, accessory orders, and package tracking.

  • Review and route external support requests to the appropriate RPM staff member.

  • Manage internal support requests and assist staff with device troubleshooting.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to the appropriate RPM staff member or device vendor.

  • Provide direct support to patients when needed, including Bluetooth setup, connectivity troubleshooting, and app navigation on iOS and Android devices.
  • Process device returns and provide return instructions.
  • Process accessory orders.
  • Locate and interpret package-tracking information.
  • Maintain accurate ticket notes, assignments, statuses, and resolution details in Zendesk.
  • Maintain training materials, documentation, and troubleshooting guides.

  • Experience in customer support, technical support, healthcare operations, or a related field.
  • Strong technical aptitude and ability to learn new devices, applications, and support processes.
  • Excellent attention to detail, organization, and follow-through.
  • Curiosity and a practical approach to problem-solving.
  • Clear and professional written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to explain technical information to people with different levels of technical experience.
  • Ability to manage multiple requests and determine when an issue should be routed or escalated.

  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel, including data entry, filtering, sorting, reporting, and basic data analysis.

  • Experience using Zendesk or a similar ticket-management system.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At PrizePicks, we are the fastest-growing sports company in North America, as recognized by Inc. 5000. As the leading platform for Daily Fantasy Sports, we cover a diverse range of sports leagues, including the NFL, NBA, and Esports titles like League of Legends and Counter-Strike. Our team of over 550 employees thrives in an inclusive culture that values individuals from diverse backgrounds, regardless of their level of sports fandom. Ready to reimagine the DFS industry together?

MVP Account Executives are assigned to independently manage the customer experience for the company’s most engaged players. The top valued players are assigned to Account Executives primarily based on geography. The MVP Account Executive’s purpose is to independently cultivate genuine relationships with these players to: 1) better understand their needs/preferences so that the company delivers a well-rounded product experience, 2) ensure these players receive white-glove, elevated treatment and 3) have access to an elevated level of customer care to resolve issues that could prevent an enjoyable PrizePicks experience. Do all 3 well, and the MVP user has no reason to play anywhere else.

What you’ll do:

  • Be the strategic relationship partner for our high value players, driving loyalty and increasing levels of product satisfaction & entertainment value for those valuable players.
  • Monitor our MVP Scouting reports & perform due diligence to onboard MVP users, building a book of business of up to ~500 players across multi-state territories.
  • Actively participate in improving the ongoing strategic design of PrizePicks MVP program, so the company remains at the forefront of player engagement, elevated care and responsible gaming. Further driving loyalty and increasing levels of product satisfaction and entertainment value for the MVP members.
  • Independently manage offline expense budget decisions to create personalized and memorable experiences for MVPs that generate increased brand affinity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at and follow us on LinkedIn and X.

We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.

You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.

The Opportunity:

Product Marketing at Grafana Labs lives in the Product org, not the Marketing org, and we think differently about the job. As Grafana's offering shifts from dashboards to observability agents, our team closes the gap between what our products can do and how customers understand that value. We build clear, consistent positioning, run marketing campaigns that attract new customers, and create content that helps engineering teams see why Grafana Cloud is the right choice for them.

Rather than only executing launches and campaigns, we teach Grafana’s product managers and engineers how to think about growth and demand. We also codify product marketing knowledge into AI-forward tools and processes that anyone at Grafana can use. For example, we all contribute product information to a shared knowledge base, which we use to generate enablement materials and decks.

The Operations Manager keeps the Product Marketing system running and makes it better. You'll track how our work performs and report on it to the team every week, experiment with new AI workflows, and maintain the collateral and tools the team and the field depend on, so the sales team is fully supported in positioning our products. You'll work closely with the team's software engineers: you test ideas like sales deck generators or tools for competitive analysis, script prototypes, and define what good output looks like, and they turn the best ideas into production tools. You'll also coordinate with the field, Enablement, and Marketing so we understand each other's goals and make progress on shared initiatives.

For this role you don't need to be a product marketer but you should have experience working inside a Product or Marketing organization for a software company. Since we don’t have an operations manager yet, you’ll also help to shape your own role. You should arrive with a desire to find and solve imperfectly-defined problems.

jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Viget is an independent digital agency that has been designing and building digital products and platforms since 1999. Our culture is ideal for lifelong learners seeking a variety of meaningful work, supportive collaboration with positive teammates, and a healthy work/life balance. We work from four offices (hybrid) and remote locations throughout the U.S., and enjoy a proven cadence of virtual and in-person meetings and retreats to build camaraderie and stay connected. We work with tech companies (like Robinhood and SpectrumAi), non-profits (like World Wildlife Fund and NPF), and consumer brands (like Stern Pinball and ESPN).
As a Product Manager at Viget, you’ll work on a variety of projects, including complex content and ecommerce sites, but most importantly custom software products. You’ll facilitate product design sprints, define and prioritize requirements, collaborate with our brilliant designers and developers to design and build products, lead quality assurance, and celebrate launches.
At Viget, Product Managers are experts in building digital products. They work collaboratively with clients (often startups) to understand organization goals, define solutions, answer hard questions, and ensure the overall quality of a product. They facilitate product planning and discovery, lead requirements gathering and feature definition, oversee technical delivery (working closely with our engineers), and conduct QA. They have a technical acumen and effectively collaborate with both internal teams and clients on technical matters.

Here are a few examples of the kind of work you’d lead:

  • Bringing a Series B-funded clean energy startup’s established web-based product to native mobile with a team of product designers and React Native developers;
  • Taking a founder’s idea for Optify from concept to prototype to a well-defined product equipped with a name and brand strategy;
  • Partnering with SpectrumAi to design and build Twyll, a modern clinical session-management tool that enables ABA therapists to capture real-time data, and streamline documentation.

Here's what we are looking for:

  • You have worked in a fast-paced software development environment before, either at an agency or product company, though agency experience is preferred.
  • You know how the web works and how a web app works, which means you’re aware of technical constraints when talking to clients. You don’t hesitate to ask a lot of questions in order to define the functionality of what we’re building.
  • You can break down a set of wireframes into actionable tasks for back-end and front-end developers. You’re passionate about finding innovative, efficient, and effective ways to document those tasks.
  • You can shepherd often-vague client requests and ideas through the definition process. You know when to rely on a product designer, but you’re comfortable thinking through logic and creating useful documentation of that logic.
  • You’re able to describe workflows and tasks purely from an end user’s perspective, helping developers make informed implementation decisions.
  • You’ve performed QA. You can distinguish a bug from a functional update from a new feature request. You don’t write merely good bug reports. You write better bug reports – or, at least, that’s your goal each and every time.
  • You have 2 to 10 years of professional experience in a product management role, ideally within an agency.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About XTEL

XTEL is a leader in advanced, AI-driven solutions for consumer goods companies, combining cutting- edge technology, industry expertise, and data management to accelerate profitable revenue growth and value realization.

Position Overview

XTEL is hiring a Cybersecurity Engineer to strengthen XTEL’s security posture across our platform, applications, and Microsoft environment. You’ll join a growing Security & Compliance team that already maintains a mature compliance foundation (ISO 27001:2022, SOC 2 Type 2, SOC 1 Type 2, ISAE 3402) and an established GRC function, alongside a managed SOC, an IT team, and a Cloud Operations team.

This is a very hands-on role where you’ll lead vulnerability management, work with Engineering and Product to embed security into the SDLC, partner with IT & Cloud Operations to continuously harden our Microsoft environments, and drive triage and remediation of issues surfaced by our SOC. Because you’ll work alongside existing IT, Cloud Operations, and GRC capabilities, success depends on collaboration and influence as much as technical depth.

The ideal candidate must be proactive and self-directed: actively seeking out opportunities to improve security across the organization and able to operate effectively with limited guidance and oversight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Vulnerability management. Own intake, triage, risk-based prioritization, remediation tracking, validation, SLAs, and reporting across our Azure environments (dev, test, prod, and customer-facing) and the development pipeline.

  • Secure SDLC & CI/CD. Partner with Engineering, Product, and QA to continually improve secure development practices:

  1. Pipeline security and security gates in CI/CD.

  2. SAST, DAST, IAST, dependency/software composition (SCA), and code scanning.

  3. Secure code review practices, threat modeling, and security requirements in design.

  • Microsoft environment hardening. Work continuously with IT to further secure infrastructure - identity and access management, endpoint protections, M365 controls, and configuration/hardening baselines.

  • SOC-driven remediation. Coordinate and drive triage and remediation for alerts, incidents, and vulnerabilities reported by XTEL’s SOC, including root cause follow up.

  • Penetration testing. Coordinate external penetration tests (scope, execution support, findings management, retesting and closure), and conduct internal testing.

  • Patch management. Support patch management processes and verification in partnership with IT and Cloud Operations.

  • Cloud security partnership. Partner with Cloud Operations on Azure security architecture, secure-by-design patterns, CSPM, secrets management, and network security.

  • Compliance & audit support. Support security audits and continuous compliance (ISO 27001, SOC 1, SOC 2 Type 2, ISAE 3402), including evidence collection and control improvement.

  • Cross-functional enablement. Translate security findings into clear, actionable guidance for engineers and into evidence and inputs for the GRC function.

  • Continuous improvement. Proactively identify and act on opportunities to raise the security bar across the organization.

  • Experience: 3+ years in cybersecurity engineering, security operations, DevSecOp...

jobs.title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Boston, MA (Suffolk)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

Creative & Conversion-Focused

Anyone can make a product look good. Can you make it sell?
At Zulay Kitchen, we’re looking for a creative thinker who can turn everyday kitchen products into something people actually want to buy.

Because your work doesn’t end when you export an image. You’ll see how your designs perform, learn from real results, and keep pushing your creativity further.

Your next design could help create our next bestseller.Ready for the Challenge?
Send us your CV and portfolio.

jobs.title: Junior Platform Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The role

Natterbox runs a cloud communications platform that our customers depend on every day. As a Junior Platform Engineer, you will join the Platform team to help keep it reliable, secure and well understood. You will work alongside senior engineers, learn how our platform operates, and build automation that reduces manual effort.

This is a strong step for someone with early cloud or infrastructure experience who wants to grow into a platform or site reliability career. We expect you to use AI tools in your daily work, for example to troubleshoot faster, write and review scripts, and keep runbooks current.

What you’ll do

  • Support the day-to-day running of our AWS infrastructure under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Monitor system health, investigate alerts and help resolve incidents.
  • Take part in our on-call rota, initially as secondary alongside a senior engineer, moving to primary once you are ready.
  • Own the Staging environment, keeping it representative of Production so that we catch issues before customers do.
  • Write scripts and infrastructure as code to automate repetitive operational tasks.
  • Contribute to infrastructure migration and modernisation work as the platform evolves.
  • Apply security best practice and help evidence compliance with ISO 27001 and other regulatory frameworks.
  • Document procedures, runbooks and configurations so that knowledge is shared and not held by one person.
  • Respond to requests from other teams where they relate to the platform, prioritised through the Platform team’s queue.

Requirements

What we’re looking for

Essential

  • At least 6 months of practical platform or infrastructure experience.
  • Hands-on experience with core AWS services (EC2, S3, RDS, IAM, CloudWatch, VPC), from work, study or personal projects.
  • Working knowledge of Linux, including the command line and basic troubleshooting.
  • Some scripting experience (Python or Bash).
  • Experience with Jira and Confluence.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, and a methodical approach to diagnosing issues.
  • Clear communication, especially when writing up incidents and procedures.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to learn, including how to use AI tools effectively and responsibly.
  • Available for on-call rota coverage during evenings into the night and weekends.
  • Must be in the UK.

Desirable

  • Exposure to infrastructure as code (Terraform or CloudFormation).
  • Familiarity with Git, GitHub and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Interest in telecoms or VoIP.
  • AWS certification (for example Cloud Practitioner or Solutions Architect Associate).
  • Experience supporting internal teams during incidents, platform requests, or escalations.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary of £32-£35 annually
  • 25 days holiday increasing to 30 days after 2 years
  • Private health insurance (after probationary period)
  • Enhanced Family Leave
  • Cycle to work
  • Allowance of £50 per month to cover the costs of home-working
  • Perkbox: A range of outstanding employee discounts
  • Access to EAP

A Note on Using AI in Your Application

At Natterbox, we love modern technology and actively encourage using generative AI tools like ChatGPT or GitHub Copilot in our daily engineering work to troubleshoot faster and build automation. We certainly don’t mind if you use AI to help refine your CV or check your application.

However, please don’t use AI to present yourself as someone you are not. We are hiring an authentic early-career engineer with real curiosity, honest learning stumbles, and genuine potential...

Job Details

Role: Strategic Analytics Manager (Marketing Measurement Partner)
Department: Data & Measurement
Job Location: Remote (Canada)
Role Type: Full-Time, Permanent
Hours: Monday - Friday 9AM-5PM (in your timezone, flexible hours)
Compensation: $109,000 - $147,000 CAD + Profit Sharing (after 1 year of employment) + Benefits
Role Availability: This posting is for an existing vacancy at Thrive Digital

As a company that values inclusion and diversity, Thrive seeks individuals of all backgrounds and experiences to apply for this position. We encourage anybody who is interested in this position to please apply!

About Thrive

Thrive is a leading full-funnel digital marketing agency supporting growth for some of North America’s most ambitious companies. We evolve our services through disciplined learning, continuous improvement, and close partnership with our clients - regularly assessing what works, what doesn’t, and where to raise the bar.

Our mission is to help companies grow sustainably. To do that, we’ve built deep expertise across performance marketing, brand marketing, digital design, and data and measurement, managing more than $5 billion USD in advertising spend over the past decade. Our work spans startups, scale-ups, and enterprise organizations, including Alo, Zoom, Slack, Uber, Asana, Masterclass, Snapchat, Change.org, and lululemon.

Our culture values curiosity, accountability, and thoughtful problem-solving. We challenge our teams to grow and take ownership of their work while respecting boundaries and long-term sustainability. Thrive is a place where experimentation is encouraged, learning is continuous, and people are supported to do high-quality work they’re proud of - together.

The Role

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Astrolab is The Lunar Operations Company. We design and build the systems and hardware the lunar economy will come to depend on — rovers, power, and data networks for sustained operations on the Moon. We are focused on the problems that must be solved before the next chapter of human exploration can scale. The Moon does not forgive untested assumptions. The people who work here know that, and they wouldn't have it any other way.

As a GNC engineer at Astrolab, you will be responsible for designing, analyzing, and testing Guidance, Navigation, and Control algorithms for our lunar rover fleet. You will support development and maturation of GNC for crewed, semi-autonomous, and fully autonomous rover operations. GNC engineers own hardware selection and characterization, algorithm development and tuning, algorithm and integrated performance analysis, and verification and validation for the GNC subsystem. You will work with simulated environment as well as test vehicles to design, mature, and prove GNC functionality and performance.

Note: Some travel may be required for this position

What you'll do:

  • Define GNC subsystem and algorithm requirements
  • Design, analyze, develop, tune, verify, and validate rover GNC algorithms and support conversion of algorithm prototypes into FSW
  • Contribute to the development of the GNC simulation
  • Work with avionics and other engineering teams to select GNC sensors such as IMUs, star trackers, cameras, LiDARs, etc.
  • Support GNC sensor characterization, calibration, and testing
  • Support development of integrated hardware/software GNC subsystem testbeds
  • Develop GNC algorithm documentation and work with vehicle software team to convert prototypes into flight code, including supporting unit and integrated testing of flight implementations
  • Work with vehicle software team, avionics team, mobility team, and integration and test team to verify GNC subsystem implementation and performance
  • Support field testing of GNC software using test vehicles in a variety of lighting and terrain conditions
  • Develop GNC analysis and test plans and perform GNC analysis and testing on hardware in the loop testbeds
  • Support vehicle integration and testing of GNC functions
  • Develop vehicle level calibration plans and support vehicle level calibrations

What you'll bring:

Basic Qualifications
  • Bachelor's degree in a Science, Technology, Engineering, or Mathematics (STEM) related field, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
  • 3+ years of professional experience developing Guidance, Navigation, and Control (GNC) systems
  • Experience with Python and familiarity with C++
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience developing path planning, obstacle avoidance, or similar algorithms
  • Experience designing, tuning, and testing Extended Kalman Filters for vehicle state estimation.
  • Experience designing, tuning, and testing vehicle control algorithms (e.g., high-gain antenna pointing)
  • Experience building, testing, and validating GNC simulation tools
  • Experience performing GNC performance analysis, including Monte Carlo analysis
  • Experience supporting GNC development from initial concept through flight operations
  • Experience collaborating across multidisciplinary engineering teams to mature GNC designs into flight software
  • Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills

Benefits and Perks

  • Join a team of best-in-class engineers building the foundation of planetary surface exploration

Business Financial Group | Job Description

Engagement:Part-time consulting engagement for a U.S. client

Work arrangement:Remote, with availability for scheduled U.S. business-hour meetings

Time commitment: 15-20monthly hours; additional availability may be needed during initial stabilization

Compensation:To be discussed based on experience and agreed scope

About Business Financial Group

Business Financial Group (BFG) provides accounting, tax, payroll, and financial advisory services to U.S. businesses. We are seeking an experienced Fractional CFO to support a client engagement delivered through a partner advisory firm.

Role overview

The Fractional CFO will strengthen the client’s weekly cash flow visibility, improve forecasting reliability, and provide clear financial analysis for management decisions. This hands-on advisory role requires close coordination with the partner firm, BFG’s Fractional Controller, and the client’s accounting team. The professional will progressively assume leadership of recurring cash flow meetings under the partner firm’s oversight.

Key responsibilities

Cash flow and liquidity oversight

  • Review bank balances, expected customer collections, vendor payments, debt obligations, and other near-term cash commitments; identify liquidity risks and decisions requiring management attention.

  • Prepare a concise, one-page weekly cash flow summary before the scheduled Monday review meeting, with practical recommendations and follow-up actions.

  • Participate in weekly cash flow reviews and progressively lead the discussions in line with the agreed transition plan.

Forecasting and financial data reliability

  • Review and maintain financial projections in Clockwork, perform weekly forecast-to-bank tie-outs, and investigate material differences between projected and actual cash balances.

  • Review recurring obligations, assumptions, and forecast mappings; coordinate corrections with the Fractional Controller and monitor reconciliation against agreed variance tolerances.

  • Monitor the timeliness and completeness of customer invoices and vendor bills in QuickBooks Online (QBO). Escalate material delays affecting forecasts to the partner firm on the same business day.

Financial analysis and financing support

  • Support the Fractional Controller with analytical reviews of loan balances, advances, repayments, accrued interest, and inventory balances; identify discrepancies and their reporting implications.

  • Coordinate a financing support package comprising trailing twelve-month profit and loss, current balance sheet, year-to-date financial statements, debt schedule, accounts receivable aging, and a 13-week cash flow projection.

  • Review the package for apparent inconsistencies and submit it to the partner firm for review and authorization before external distribution.

Action tracking and collaboration

  • Maintain the 90-day financial action tracker before each weekly meeting, documenting progress, overdue actions, dependencies, and decisions needed.

  • Coordinate financial findings and executive communications with the partner firm; work effectively within its branding and client communication arrangements.

  • Maintain confidentiality, document work and recommendations, track time against the agreed allocation, and promptly flag additional capacity needs.

Sponge exists to bring the world’s boldest strategies to life through the people who deliver them, specialising in unlocking the ‘human layer’ of complex transformation. We’ve been leading the industry for decades with our best-in-class digital learning capability and, combined with the emergent growth of our consulting services, we are succeeding in being the partner to our customers who are trying to bridge the critical gap between L&D and the business. This role is a rare and exciting opportunity for any passionate learning professional looking to be part of a dynamic, entrepreneurial team that gets to the heart of what L&D is truly trying to do: solve strategic business challenges through the lens of learning!

So, what exactly is a Learning Experience Consultant?
A Learning Experience Consultant (LExC) at Sponge is a learning leader who is customer-obsessed, thrives in ambiguity, and confidently crafts learning solutions that help strategically move the needle on an organisation’s goals. With strong commercial acumen, senior stakeholder management, and a track record in strategic learning consultancy, they build and maintain meaningful partnerships with our customers who are some of the world’s most prestigious brands. The role primarily holds a dual focus: on the sales side, an LExC drives our commercial momentum by supporting our strategic bids. On the execution side, LExCs are responsible for delivering our delivering our consultative engagements - the analysis, design, development, and execution of a learning strategy and experience blueprint in collaboration with senior stakeholders, SMEs and internal Sponge collaborators.

  • Successfully completed university studies in the field computer science or similar fields
  • UNIX/Linux command-line experience, simple Bash scripting
  • Familiarity with PowerShell / Azure CLI
  • Basic understanding of AWS and Azure services (Compute, Networking, Storage)
  • High interest in continuous learning and development (new tools, technologies, methodologies)

  • Experience in Networking
  • Kubernetes experience
  • Experience in ITIL processes (e.g.: Incident, Change, Problem management) and service management topics
  • Nice to have experience in CI/CD/IaaC

Why you should decide on us

  • Market Leadership: Join a global leader where our agile culture and innovative spirit allow you to shape the future of financial stability.

  • Growth & Mentorship: Access a wide range of our technical and functional training opportunities.

​To get started, we only need your CV. We look forward to meeting you in a virtual or personal interview!


Regnology is committed to equal employment opportunities regardless of gender, age, nationality, ethnic or social origin, disability, or identity.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
CareDx, Inc. is a leading precision medicine solutions company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of clinically differentiated, high-value healthcare solutions for transplant patients and caregivers. CareDx offers products, testing services, and digital healthcare solutions along the pre- and post-transplant patient journey, and is the leading provider of genomics-based information for transplant patients.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Clinical Research Associate to join our Clinical Operations team. This role is pivotal in ensuring the integrity, quality, and compliance of our clinical trials. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in clinical study management, a passion for improving patient outcomes, and the ability to lead and mentor within a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct and oversee all types of site visits (e.g., selection, initiation, interim, close-out) to ensure protocol adherence, patient safety, and data accuracy.
  • Collaborate with Principal Investigators, study coordinators, and cross-functional teams to drive study success.
  • Ensure compliance with ICH/GCP, IRB requirements, and internal monitoring plans.
  • Identify and resolve data collection issues within electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
  • Review and reconcile data queries, listings, and discrepancies.
  • Maintain accurate and complete study documentation and files.
  • Lead study team meetings and contribute to protocol development and amendments.
  • Support site recruitment and provide oversight to ensure enrollment goals are met.

jobs.company: Centre for Addiction and Mental Health
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CAMH is the lead for the coordination and administration of 9-8-8, the new national three-digit number for suicide prevention in Canada, that launched on November 30, 2023. 9-8-8 is Canada’s official three-digit national helpline for suicide prevention and emotional distress. This ground-breaking service is available 24/7/365 and accessible to everyone from coast to coast to coast.

The 9-8-8 National Hub plays a pivotal role in providing front-line service for the 9-8-8 Suicide Crisis Helpline. The 9-8-8 National Hub provides 24/7 service via phone and text modalities.

We are currently seeking a full-time, permanent 9-8-8 Hub Training Coordinator to join the National Hub training team. This role involves training new responders, implementing quality assurance measures, conducting performance assessments, offering real-time coaching, and fostering a positive and inclusive work environment. The training coordinator will collaborate with the supervision team and hub leadership to enhance service delivery and professional development opportunities for responders and supervisors.

Ce nouveau service de pointe est accessible 24 heures sur 24, 7 jours sur 7, 365 jours par an, partout au pays.

Le Centre d’appels national du 9-8-8 joue un rôle essentiel dans la prestation de services de première ligne aux personnes qui appellent ou textent la Ligne d’aide en cas de crise de suicide 9-8-8. Le Centre d’appels offre un service accessible jour et nuit, par téléphone et par textos.

Dans ce rôle, vous coordonnerez la formation des nouvelles recrues en mettant en œuvre des mesures d’assurance de la qualité, en menant des évaluations de la performance, en offrant de l’accompagnement en temps réel et en favorisant un milieu de travail positif et inclusif. Vous collaborerez avec l’équipe de supervision et la direction du Centre d’appels afin d’améliorer la prestation des services et les possibilités de perfectionnement professionnel pour le personnel d’intervention et de supervision.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

This position will offer you the ability to apply and expand your knowledge of underground transmission line engineering, including routing, duct bank configurations, manhole placement and electrical principles to:

  • Design underground transmission lines for voltages up to 500kV.
  • Responsible for cost analyses, development of design criteria, siting and routing challenges, and placement of manholes for underground transmission lines.
  • Responsible for physical design including duct bank layouts, development of trenchless designs, cable pulling calculations, development of drawing packages.
  • Responsible for cable selection studies, determining bonding scheme, performing ampacity calculations.
  • Develop riser structure configuration and structural loading.
  • Develop specifications including cable procurement, duct bank installation, trenchless installation and general construction specifications.
  • Work and coordinate with vendors and clients to specify transmission line components.
  • Direct a small project team of other engineers, designers and drafters.

Qualifications

We do not sponsor employees for work authorization in Canada for this position.

This position may require access to U.S. export-controlled information. As such, candidates must be a citizen of a country listed in Appendix A to Part 810 of the Code of Federal Regulations. Please click here to determine your eligibility.

  • This position requires a BS degree from a Canadian Engineering Accreditation Board-accredited undergraduate program or a US based ABET-accredited program.
  • Proficiency with CYMCAP modeling
  • Proficiency with cable tensioning calculations and/or software
  • 12 or more years of experience as a member of a project team in observing project schedules and budget constraints on diverse underground transmission projects
  • Design experience incorporating code requirements, EPRI recommendations, client requirements
  • Experience in cost estimate development and schedule creation and coordination
  • Experience with XLPE cable design
  • Experience in the preparation of specifications for installation and procurement of underground transmission line materials and components
  • Knowledge to verify/review right of way requirements, bonding schemes, underground transmission line plan and profile drawings and other construction documents
  • Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in the production of technical plans, drawings, and models
  • Experience in writing and providing support documentation for engineering calculations
  • Familiarity with design codes and standards such as NESC, EPRI Green Book, IEC, CSA, IEEE, ANSI, IBC, ASCE 7, AISC, and ACI 318
  • Proficiency with MS Office applications
  • Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills
  • Attention to detail

Valued but not required skills and experience:

  • Have a current P.Eng license or the ability to acquire one within one year
  • Experience with High Pressure Gas Filled or High-Pressured Fluid Filled pipe type cable systems and associated equipment
  • Experience with underground distribution or low voltage cable systems

The Product Owner maximizes value produced by the team by ensuring user stories meet the business' needs and complies with the Definition of Done. This role has significant relationships and responsibilities outside the Agile team, including working with other Product Owners, Product Managers or Operational Leaders, HGB Associates, Business Owners, and other stakeholders. Job Description:

The Senior Product Owner is responsible for having a deep understanding of how and which technology platforms and tools are used by HGB associates in the respective operational area they support. This understanding serves as the foundation for improving technology that increases the value of products and services indirectly and/or directly to HGB customers. This understanding occurs through either being a user of this technology or learning through other users. Critical thinking, problem solving, and keen listening skills are required for this role



Once this understanding is achieved, the Senior Product Owner is responsible for engaging with the Product Manager or Operational Leader to learn priorities and pressing needs of the operational team. The Senior Product Owner is then positioned to serve as a representative of the operational team to define and prioritize requirements, initiatives, and/or user stories with the Agile Team. This will require work assignments that are moderately complex to complex where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

As part of the prioritization process, the Senior Product Owner is responsible for preparing and participating in for Program Increments. This includes briefing the Product Manager and/or Operational Leader and other Clinical Operations Leaders on the recommended program vision, roadmap, and content presentations.

Once the Program Increment is complete, the Product Owner is responsible for iteration and program execution which includes, but is not limited to maintaining team backlog; iteration planning; accepting user stories; assisting with decision making related to sequencing of work; ensuring and facilitating adequate user testing prior to push to production; and coordinating with other Product Owners as needed. Included in this phase is supporting and/or producing the system demonstration of the fulfillment of the user stories for various stakeholders.

While performing in this role, the Senior Product Owner must possess excellent communication skills with all stakeholders to ensure the right product is being built, in the right order, within budget and by the deadline. The Senior Product Owner monitors progress throughout the feature life-cycle, working closely with the operational team to resolve questions and challenges, reduce risk to contract standards and minimize delays. The Senior Product Owner will serve as the Agile team's primary contact for information, work prioritization, and decision-making while also reporting back to the Product Manager and/or Operational Leader to report progress and to ensure alignment.

Goodway Group is one of AdAge's 2026's BEST PLACES TO WORK! As an independent and remote-first media and marketing services firm with a 90+ year history, Goodway Group has the security of an established company combined with a start-up feel. This role covers the full event lifecycle — from **digital marketing and content development to speaker acquisition and on-site event management**. The ideal candidate is creative, organized, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment. Key ResponsibilitiesDigital Marketing * Plan and execute digital marketing campaigns across social media, email, website, and paid advertising channels. * Create, schedule, and manage content calendars to support campaigns, brand awareness, and event promotions. * Monitor campaign performance and prepare reports with insights and recommendations for improvement. * Work with internal teams and external vendors to ensure consistent brand messaging across all platforms. * Support lead generation and audience engagement strategies for events and marketing initiatives. Content Development * Develop compelling marketing content including social media posts, EDMs, website copy, event pages, brochures, presentations, and promotional materials. * Ensure all content aligns with brand tone, campaign objectives, and target audience needs. * Coordinate the production of creative assets such as videos, visuals, and event-related materials. * Assist in storytelling and messaging strategies to enhance brand visibility and event participation. Speaker Acquisition & Stakeholder Coordination * Identify, approach, and secure relevant speakers, panelists, moderators, and industry partners for events. * Manage communication with speakers including invitations, confirmations, briefing documents, and scheduling. * Build and maintain strong relationships with industry stakeholders, sponsors, partners, and vendors. * Coordinate speaker logistics and ensure all necessary information is communicated clearly before the event. Event Planning & On-site Management * Plan and coordinate end-to-end event execution including timelines, run sheets, venue logistics, vendor coordination, registration, and attendee experience. * Support event operations such as setup, rehearsals, stage flow, speaker management, and troubleshooting on-site. * Ensure events are delivered smoothly, professionally, and within budget. * Conduct post-event evaluations, gather feedback, and prepare summary reports with key learnings and recommendations. Requirements * Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Mass Communication, Event Management, Business, or a related field. * **2–4 years** of relevant experience in marketing, events, or integrated campaign management. * Strong understanding of digital marketing platforms including social media, email marketing, and online advertising. * Excellent writing and content development skills in **English**; proficiency in **Bahasa Malaysia** and **Mandarin** is an advantage. * Experience in event planning, speaker management, and on-site coordination. * Strong project management and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple deadlines. * Good interpersonal and communication skills with confidence in dealing with stakeholders at all levels. * Proficiency in AI tools, video editing tools, CRMs, etc. * Willingness to travel and work flexible hours when required for event execution. Work Location: Hybrid remote in Jakarta

jobs.title: Key Account Executive, Injectable Aesthetic
jobs.descriptionHtml: Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story. We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee. At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact. **Purpose of The Position** To drive and grow the aesthetic business in Indonesia and to be responsible for developing and executing Injectable Aesthetic business plans to help ensure profitability of company. **Key Responsibilities** * Manage and is responsible for sales growth targets with the assigned accounts * Responsible for the profitability and growth of the assigned accounts * Manage and develop accounts through joint business planning and execution of marketing & promotional plan * Conduct negotiations with assigned accounts and implement trade promotion cycle strategies * Achieve high brand visibility and full distribution of Galderma’s portfolio of products in assigned accounts * Quarterly business review/meetings with assigned accounts to build rapport and obtain market insights Manage total trade spend in assigned accounts to target investment levels **Requirements** * Bachelor degree in any science field or equivalent. * At least 2 years of experience ideally in medical devices or pharmacy, managing customer/ account with special focus on injectables aesthetic products. * Experience in trade operations and category development or marketing is an advantage. * Strong selling demonstrated by good negotiation skills, strategic planning.

jobs.title: Product Owner (m/w/d) Brokerage & Digital Assets
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Das baust du mit uns auf

Ein neues Brokerage-Angebot entsteht nicht auf dem Papier. Sondern durch die richtigen Produktentscheidungen. Was brauchen unsere Kundinnen und Kunden wirklich? Welche Funktionen schaffen Mehrwert? Und was entwickeln wir als Nächstes?

Bei GENO Broker bauen wir ein neues digitales Brokerage-Angebot mit dem Rückhalt der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe auf. Als Product Owner gestaltest du unsere Brokerage- und Digital-Assets- Angebote von der Produktidee bis zum Marktstart und darüber hinaus.

Du verbindest Kundenbedürfnisse, Marktchancen und technologische Möglichkeiten mit den Anforderungen eines regulierten Finanzumfelds. Dabei setzt du Prioritäten, triffst Produktentscheidungen und arbeitest eng mit IT, UX/UI und weiteren Fachbereichen zusammen. Hier verwaltest du nicht einfach ein bestehendes Produkt. Du gestaltest mit, was daraus wird.

Das wirst du bei uns machen

  • Du entwickelst unsere Produktvision, Produktstrategie und Roadmap für Brokerage- und Digital-Assets-Angebote weiter und übersetzt sie in konkrete Entwicklungsschritte.

  • Du verantwortest die Weiterentwicklung deiner Produkte entlang des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus – von der ersten Idee über die Umsetzung bis zur Markteinführung und Optimierung.

  • Du analysierst Markt, Wettbewerb und Kundenbedürfnisse, erkennst relevante Entwicklungen und leitest daraus neue Produkt- und Funktionsanforderungen ab.

  • Du priorisierst Anforderungen, entwickelst User Stories und steuerst das Product Backlog, damit aus Produktideen umsetzbare Lösungen werden.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit IT, UX/UI, Operations, Compliance, Risk und weiteren Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass fachliche, technische und regulatorische Anforderungen zusammenpassen.

  • Du nutzt Kundenfeedback und Nutzungsdaten, um unsere digitalen Produkte und die Customer Journey kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln.

  • Du begleitest Produkteinführungen gemeinsam mit Marketing und Vertrieb und sorgst dafür, dass neue Funktionen erfolgreich in den Markt kommen

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner, im Produktmanagement oder in einer vergleichbaren Rolle gesammelt und digitale Produkte eigenständig weiterentwickelt.

  • Du kennst agile Produktentwicklung aus der Praxis und hast bereits mit Methoden wie Scrum oder Kanban sowie der Priorisierung und Steuerung von Product Backlogs gearbeitet.

  • Du bringst ein fundiertes Verständnis von Kapitalmärkten, Handelsplattformen oder digitalen Finanzprodukten mit und kannst dich sicher in fachliche Zusammenhänge einarbeiten.

  • Du hast Erfahrung darin, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu bewerten, Prioritäten zu setzen und Produktentscheidungen nachvollziehbar zu treffen.

  • Du denkst analytisch und unternehmerisch, hast ein gutes Gespür für Kundenbedürfnisse und verlierst auch bei komplexen Fragestellungen das Wesentliche nicht aus dem Blick.

  • Du hast bereits mit interdisziplinären Teams und unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern zusammengearbeitet und kannst fachliche und technische Perspektiven miteinander verbinden.

  • Du bringst Entscheidungsfreude, Umsetzungsstärke und Lust darauf mit, neue Produkte aktiv mitzugestalten.

  • Du hast ein Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Betriebswirtschaft oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation abgeschlossen.

Ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung im Brokerage-, Banking-, FinTech- oder Krypto-Umfeld.

  • Kenntnisse regulatorischer Anforderungen im Finanzsektor.

  • Erfahrung beim Aufbau neuer digitaler Produkte oder Geschäftsfelder.

  • Kenntnisse in UX/UI-orientierter Produktentwicklung.

  • Zertifizierungen wie PSPO, CSPO ode...

jobs.title: Consultant KI & Einkauf (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du setzt KI praktisch ein, erklärst verständlich und gehst gerne auf Menschen zu? Bei ProcuVia befähigst du Einkaufsteams, KI sinnvoll im Arbeitsalltag einzusetzen. Du leitest Workshops und erkennst im Gespräch, wo wir unsere Kunden darüber hinaus unterstützen können.

ProcuVia ist eine spezialisierte Einkaufsberatung. Wir verbinden Einkaufsexpertise mit Datenanalyse und KI und begleiten unsere Kunden bei der praktischen Umsetzung.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest KI-Workshops von der Bedarfsklärung über Vorbereitung und Durchführung bis zur Nachbereitung und trittst dabei für ProcuVia beim Kunden auf.
  • Du entwickelst verständliche Demonstrationen und Übungen für typische Einkaufsaufgaben und verbesserst unsere Workshop-Unterlagen kontinuierlich.
  • Du bereitest dich auf die jeweilige KI-Umgebung vor, auch auf kundenspezifische Lösungen, und passt die Inhalte an die Teilnehmer an.
  • Du stellst passende ProcuVia-Leistungen vor, erkennst weiterführenden Beratungsbedarf und vereinbarst den nächsten Schritt mit dem zuständigen Kollegen.
  • Du testest neue KI-Anwendungen, bildest dich laufend weiter und entwickelst unser Workshop-Angebot zwischen den Kundeneinsätzen mit.

Das bringst du mit

  • Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit mindestens einer relevanten KI-Umgebung, etwa Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude oder Perplexity. Weitere Plattformen erschließt du dir eigenständig.
  • Kommunikationsstärke, Freude am Erklären und einen sicheren, zugewandten Umgang mit neuen Menschen und kritischen Fragen.
  • Verständnis für beratenden Verkauf: Du hörst zu, stellst gute Fragen und erkennst, welche Unterstützung einem Kunden tatsächlich weiterhilft.
  • Eigeninitiative, Integrität und Teamorientierung. Du prüfst KI-Ergebnisse kritisch, benennst Grenzen offen und hältst Kundenkontakte und nächste Schritte transparent fest.
  • Bereitschaft zu regelmäßiger Weiterbildung und Kundenreisen innerhalb Deutschlands.

Langjährige Trainererfahrung ist keine Voraussetzung. Einkaufswissen und Workshop-Routine kannst du bei uns aufbauen. Erfahrene Kandidaten sind ebenso willkommen wie KI-Praktiker mit Entwicklungspotenzial. Programmierkenntnisse und eigenständige Vertriebsabschlüsse werden nicht vorausgesetzt.

Das erwartet dich

Eine Rolle mit direktem Kundenkontakt und Gestaltungsspielraum für unser KI-Workshop-Angebot. Du arbeitest hybrid und übernimmst nach Hospitation und gemeinsamer Moderation schrittweise eigene Workshops. Dabei begleiten dich fachliche Ansprechpartner aus dem ProcuVia-Team.
