jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
No industry is currently being transformed by AI as much as the legal industry.

At JUPUS – one of the fastest-growing legal tech companies in Europe – we are leading this transformation and changing the way lawyers work forever. Our AI software automates the legal workflow – from the initial inquiry to the final written submission. This is how we help law firms work faster, more efficiently, and more scalably than ever before. JUPUS is backed by a Series A.

We are now looking for a Senior Product Manager (m/f/d) who thrives in ambiguity and wants to shape one of the most transformative products in the world with a relentless focus on creating radical value for our customers.

Tasks

  • Own initiatives end to end: You take product initiatives from discovery to production, working closely with engineering, design and cross-functional partners. You work across the live product and new initiatives.

  • Ship in weeks: We typically go from discovery to solution in 2 to 3 weeks. You imagine ambitious solutions with your team, then scope them to the smallest version that fits the timeline so users benefit early.

  • Improve what is live: Live features matter as much as new launches. You improve them continuously based on lawyer feedback and usage data.

  • Design for the user: You work with design from the start and shape the user experience, including how AI outputs are presented and how users come to trust them.

  • Build customer-centric products: You work closely with lawyers through interviews, research sessions and feedback loops, many of them in German, to understand their workflows, pain points and goals. You turn these insights into clear product opportunities and features.

  • Measure impact: You track quantitative and qualitative signals during beta and after release, and use them to decide what to build or change next.

  • Unlock business value: You partner with Sales, Customer Success, Operations and other teams so the product supports adoption, retention and revenue growth.

Requirements

Experience

  • You have 3+ years of experience as a Product Manager in B2B SaaS, including shipping AI or AI-powered features end to end.

  • You have worked in a startup or scale-up and are used to short development cycles: delivery is cheap, so you scope to the timeline and get value to users fast.

  • You use AI in your daily work as part of your standard workflow, for example to prototype ideas, explore solutions and test them with users.

  • You are comfortable moving between strategic thinking, analytical problem solving, and hands-on execution.

  • You speak fluent English and German (C1 or above), as you will run customer conversations in German.

  • Bonus: You have experience in legal tech.

jobs.title: Salesforce Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

What you will own

• Roadmap and backlog: own the SF backlog end to end. Run intake across Sales, Operations, Finance, and Customer Success and translate business needs into clear requirements with acceptance criteria and priority.

• Automation delivery: design, build, and test declarative automation (Flow, validation rules, approval processes, assignment logic) but also manage the AI layer accross the org.

• Developer partnership: scope Apex-heavy and integration work with our Salesforce developers, review their output for fit and maintainability, and decide what belongs in configuration versus code.

• Administration and operations: own day-to-day administration: users and licenses, the security and sharing model, profiles and permission sets, sandbox and release management, and business-as-usual support. This is the Administrator function.

• Data quality and governance: protect the integrity of the data model, prevent one-off requests from fragmenting it, and own deduplication, validation, and reporting hygiene.

• Stakeholder management: be the single point of contact for everything Salesforce. Set expectations, communicate tradeoffs, and report progress against the automation targets.

What you bring

jobs.title: Generalist (Operations)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Take on the business and back-end operations that keep Kairos running: finances, payments, HR, compliance, and systems, plus support for our programs and Pathfinder groups.

Note: This role description is a first draft. Scope, salary, and responsibilities may evolve as our plans develop over the coming weeks, and we’ll keep you in the loop about any changes if you apply.

 

About Kairos

Kairos is a nonprofit accelerating talent into AI safety and policy. In just over two years, we’ve trained 1,200+ people through our flagship programs:

  • SPAR: The largest AI safety research fellowship, with 800+ mentees per round mentored by researchers from Anthropic, Redwood Research, RAND, MIT, the UK AI Security Institute, and others.

  • Generator Residency: In partnership with Constellation, a platform for generalist talent to pitch, build, and ship projects that build capacity and infrastructure across the AI safety ecosystem, with advisors from METR, Redwood Research, AI Futures Project, and more.

  • Global Challenges Project: A workshop series introducing promising students to careers in AI safety and biosecurity, run several times a year across Oxford, Boston, and Berkeley.

  • Pathfinder Fellowship: Helping grow the global network of AI safety university groups from a few dozen to nearly 100, with $9.5M in funding over the next two years to support their work.

We see ourselves as a portfolio of highly impactful projects in a fast-evolving field. Over the next six months, we expect to double in size and launch several new initiatives addressing critical gaps in the ecosystem.

 

The Role

We’re looking for a Generalist (Operations) to do the wide range of things that keep Kairos running in the background. The bulk of the role is core business and back-end operations: paying vendors, supervising accountants, supporting bookkeeping and our audit, figuring out how to employ and onboard people, and keeping us compliant. Alongside that, you’ll support our Pathfinder groups, process grants, build internal systems and automations, and pitch in on program ops.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Build systems and automations. Spot the operational work that shouldn’t be done by hand and automate it, so you and the team can spend time on the things that actually need judgment.

  • Run our finances and back-end operations. Pay vendors and contractors, supervise accountants, support bookkeeping and our annual audit, handle the logistics of employing people (payroll, benefits, onboarding and offboarding), and help keep us compliant. You won’t need to be an expert on day one, but you’ll learn to own these functions.

jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Gestalte das perfekte Foodji-Erlebnis

Ein großartiges Produkt allein reicht nicht – echte Kundenzufriedenheit entsteht durch starke Beziehungen und einen klaren Blick auf die Entwicklung des Kundenportfolios. Du machst den konkreten Nutzen und Mehrwert von Foodji sichtbar und schaffst damit die Grundlage für langfristige Partnerschaften.

Deine Mission bei Foodji:

  • (Enterprise-) Kund:innen begleitest du von der Testphase über den Vertragsabschluss durch die gesamte Customer Lifetime.

  • Für dein Kundenportfolio übernimmst du Verantwortung und sorgst dafür, dass Kund:innen Foodji erfolgreich nutzen, langfristig bleiben, wachsen und uns weiterempfehlen.

  • Stabile und vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu zentralen Entscheider:innen und dezentralen Stakeholdern baust du gezielt auf und entwickelst sie weiter.

  • Verantwortung für die Gesundheit und Weiterentwicklung deines Enterprise-Kundenportfolios – von der KPI-basierten Analyse der Account Health bis zur Ableitung gezielter Maßnahmen.

  • Vertragsverlängerungen bereitest du aktiv vor und erkennst Kündigungsrisiken frühzeitig – auch wenn sie zunächst nur an einem einzelnen Standort auftreten.

  • Steuerung von internen und crossfunktionalen Projekten zur Weiterentwicklung des Customer Success Bereichs.


DAS BRINGST DU MIT

  • Mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung im Customer Success Management sowie nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Steuerung von Retention-, Vertragsverlängerungs- und Churn-Kennzahlen über ein Kundenportfolio hinweg.

  • Strukturierte, datengetriebene und eigenständige Arbeitsweise mit einem guten Gespür für Kundenbeziehungen sowie der Fähigkeit, Risiken, Kundenpotenziale und nächste Schritte selbstständig zu priorisieren.

  • Erfahrung im Umgang mit CRM-Systemen, insbesondere Salesforce, sowie sehr gute Excel-Kenntnisse.

  • Kommunikationsstärke auf Entscheider:innenebene – auch in anspruchsvollen Gesprächen – sowie die Fähigkeit, komplexe Multi-Standort-Accounts mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern strategisch zu betreuen.

  • Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie fließende Englischkenntnisse.

  • Präsentations- und Argumentationsfähigkeit sowie ausgeprägte Networking-Kompetenzen.

  • Ein „Do-it“-Mindset, Teamfähigkeit, Selbstbewusstsein sowie eine lösungs- und zielorientierte Arbeitsweise.

NOCH FRAGEN?

Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter!

DAS BIETEN WIR

  • Office Foodji & Lunchit App: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office oder Remote

  • Uncapped Bonus: Deine Leistung bestimmt dein Gehalt – nach oben gibt es keine Grenze

  • bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente

jobs.title: Consultant Presales & Solutions (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du verstehst Prozesse schneller als andere und willst Kunden mit einer Lösung überzeugen, die wirklich passt? Dann verbinde bei uns Beratung, Technik und Vertrieb in einer Rolle.

Wer wir sind

docu-fix digitalisiert den sozialwirtschaftlichen Mittelstand. Wir automatisieren Prozesse rund um Dokumente: Scan-Dienstleistungen, Dokumentenmanagement (u. a. DocuWare), Workflows und E-Signatur. Unsere Kunden sind unter anderem Träger der Sozialwirtschaft, Rechenzentren und öffentliche Verkehrsbetriebe.

Unsere Kunden sparen mit uns bis zu 80 % ihrer Prozesskosten – mit einer Lösung, die EU-konform ist. Wir wachsen stark, und unser Vertrieb liefert immer mehr qualifizierte Termine. Damit aus diesen Terminen Projekte werden, suchen wir dich.

Was du machst

  • Du übernimmst die Termine, die unser Inside Sales vereinbart, und führst sie bis zum Abschluss.

  • Du nimmst Prozesse auf. Im Erstgespräch und im Workshop fragst du so lange nach, bis klar ist, wo beim Kunden Zeit und Geld liegen bleiben.

  • Du zeigst die Lösung. In der Demo sieht der Kunde seinen eigenen Rechnungseingang, seine Personalakte oder seinen Vertragsprozess – nicht eine Standardpräsentation.

  • Du entwirfst das Lösungskonzept: welche Bausteine aus Scan, DocuWare, Workflow, Schnittstellen und E-Signatur zusammenpassen und was sie bringen.

  • Du kalkulierst den Aufwand, schreibst das Angebot gemeinsam mit dem Vertrieb und vertrittst es vor Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Fachabteilung.

  • Du übergibst gewonnene Projekte sauber dokumentiert an unser Team Technischer Service & Implementierung und bleibst für den Kunden ansprechbar.

  • Du baust Wiederverwendbares auf: Demo-Umgebungen, Lösungsvorlagen und Referenzszenarien für unsere Zielbranchen.

Worauf du dich einstellst

  • Wir verkaufen kein Standardprodukt. Jeder Kunde hat andere Systeme, andere Abläufe und andere Vorgaben – du baust daraus eine Lösung, die trägt.

  • Du sprichst mit Geschäftsführung, IT-Leitung und Buchhaltung. Die eine will Zahlen, die andere Architektur, die dritte einen Alltag, der funktioniert.

  • Du stehst zwischen Vertrieb und Technik. Du versprichst nur, was unser Implementierungsteam liefern kann.

  • Du arbeitest an mehreren Kunden gleichzeitig und hältst Fristen für Angebote und Ausschreibungen.

  • Du bist bei Kunden vor Ort und online unterwegs.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du hast Erfahrung in Presales, Consulting, Business Analyse oder der Einführung von Unternehmenssoftware.

  • Du denkst in Prozessen. Du verstehst, wie ein Rechnungseingang, eine Freigabe oder eine Aktenführung abläuft, und siehst, wo es hakt.

  • Du schreibst Konzepte und Angebote, die man ohne Rückfrage versteht.

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, verbindlich und gern im Team mit Vertrieb und Technik.

  • Du sprichst verhandlungssicher Deutsch, weil Workshops, Konzepte und Angebote auf Deutsch laufen.

Hilft, ist aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder anderen DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen

  • Kenntnis der Sozialwirtschaft, des öffentlichen Sektors oder von ERP- und Finanzbuchhaltungssystemen

  • Erfahrung mit E-Rechnung, E-Signatur oder revisionssicherer Archivierung

Was dir fehlt, bringen wir dir bei.

jobs.title: Technical Support & Implementation Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du löst gern technische Probleme und willst sehen, wie deine Lösung beim Kunden läuft? Dann verbinde bei uns Support und Projektarbeit in einer Rolle.

Die docu-fix GmbH in Offenbach am Main digitalisiert dokumentenbasierte Geschäftsprozesse. Wir führen DocuWare, digitale Workflows und Schnittstellen bei unseren Kunden ein und betreuen sie im laufenden Betrieb. Für unseren Bereich Technischer Service & Implementierung suchen wir dich.

Deine Aufgaben

Du arbeitest etwa zu gleichen Teilen im Support und in der Implementierung und sicherst beides durch saubere Dokumentation ab.

Support (ca. 45 %)

  • Du betreust unsere Kunden im 1st- und 2nd-Level-Support per Telefon, E-Mail, Ticketsystem und Fernwartung.

  • Du analysierst und behebst Störungen an Kundeninstallationen, Schnittstellen und Prozessen.

  • Du eskalierst bei Bedarf an den Hersteller-Support und verfolgst den Fall bis zur Lösung.

  • Du führst Updates, Patches und Wartungsarbeiten im Rahmen bestehender Verträge durch.

Implementierung (ca. 40 %)

  • Du installierst, konfigurierst und nimmst Lösungen beim Kunden in Betrieb, on-premises und in der Cloud.

  • Du setzt die im Projekt abgestimmten Anforderungen und Workflows um.

  • Du bindest bestehende Kundensysteme über Schnittstellen und Konnektoren an.

  • Du migrierst Daten, testest gemeinsam mit dem Kunden und begleitest die Abnahme.

  • Du weist Anwenderinnen und Anwender ein und übergibst die Lösung in den laufenden Betrieb.

Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung (ca. 15 %)

  • Du pflegst die kundenbezogene System- und Konfigurationsdokumentation.

  • Du hältst Störungen und Lösungswege im Ticketsystem und in der Wissensdatenbank fest.

  • Du testest konfigurierte Prozesse und Workflows vor der Übergabe und erstellst Abnahmeprotokolle.

  • Du erstellst Anwenderleitfäden und Schulungsunterlagen.

Dein Profil

Entscheidend ist, dass du technische Probleme methodisch löst und Kunden verständlich berätst. Auch ein qualifizierter Quereinstieg mit belastbarer technischer Erfahrung ist möglich.

Das bringst du mit

  • Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung oder vergleichbare praktische Erfahrung im technischen Anwendungs- oder Softwaresupport

  • Erfahrung im IT-Support, Application Support, Software- oder DMS-Umfeld, IT-Consulting oder in einer vergleichbaren kundennahen Rolle

  • Solide Grundlagen in Windows-Client- und Windows-Server-Umgebungen sowie in webbasierten Anwendungen

  • Grundlagen in Benutzer- und Berechtigungskonzepten, Netzwerken und Cloud-Zusammenhängen

  • Methodische Fehleranalyse anhand von Fehlermeldungen, Logs, Konfigurationen und Prozessabläufen

  • Grundverständnis für dokumentenbezogene Prozesse wie Eingangsrechnungen, Freigaben, elektronische Signaturen und Archivierung

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die Kundenkommunikation und Dokumentation

  • Technisches Englisch für Dokumentationen, Fehlermeldungen und die Kommunikation mit Herstellern

  • Eine selbstständige, strukturierte und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise, Verbindlichkeit, Lernbereitschaft und Freude an der Arbeit im Team

Das ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit DocuWare oder vergleichbaren DMS-, ECM- oder Workflow-Systemen

  • DocuWare-Schulungen oder -Zertifizierungen

  • Erfahrung mit Cloud- und On-Premises-Umgebungen

  • Kenntnisse in Zammad oder anderen Ticketsystemen, SQL und Datenbanken, Microsoft 365, Schnittstellen sowie Dateiimporten und -exporten

Das bieten wir dir

  • Abwechslung: Du löst Supportfälle und setzt Kundenprojekte um, statt nur Tickets abzuarbeiten.

jobs.title: Strategic Customer Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

The Strategic Customer Success Account Manager at Spring Health builds and manages relationships with the company’s largest customers to ensure satisfaction, retention, and growth. This role oversees the full customer lifecycle, aligning Spring’s solutions with customer goals to drive engagement and revenue. Success is measured by accurate forecasting, achieving revenue targets, and fostering strong relationships across all levels of the customer organization. This is a remote, full time position on our team reporting to the Director of Strategic Customer Success. Occasional travel (10%) may be required for in-person events or meetings. 

What you’ll do:

  • Serve as a product expert and advocate for mental health, supporting a portfolio of Spring Health’s largest and most impactful partners.

  • Own forecasting projections for revenue, renewals, and upsell opportunities across your portfolio, ensuring the delivery of accurate forecasts.

  • Identify and position upsell opportunities proactively, driving revenue growth by aligning solutions with customer goals.

  • Develop and manage positive relationships with multiple customers, consultants, and key stakeholders to build trust and ensure satisfaction.

  • Manage the entire customer lifecycle, including implementations, engagement strategies, renewals, and upsells by:

    • Developing timely, actionable account plans

    • Managing census files efficiently

    • Designing and executing member engagement communications

    • Preparing and presenting business reviews to senior HR executives

    • Delivering insightful, data-driven recommendations aligned with customer success metrics

    • Developing renewals strategy and delivering proposals/contracts

    • Managing the end-to-end deal cycle (procurement process)

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to collect customer feedback and recommend process improvements across internal teams.

  • Support sales efforts by partnering on retention, upsell initiatives, and expansion opportunities as well as supporting net new business acquisition through efforts like attending finalist meetings.

  • Leverage data to drive results

At Moss, we give finance professionals the power to automate their day-to-day and make forward-thinking decisions.

Our culture is what makes that possible: we play to win, we obsess over quality, and we win as One Moss, and it works. Moss closed a €35 million Series C in August 2026, crossing a €1 billion valuation, and became one of Europe's fintech unicorns. Join us for what's next.

We are now looking for a Partnerships Associate to support our growth journey in Germany. This is a junior-level role designed for early-career professionals with a strong interest in finance, accounting, or Fintech. You’ll help identify and connect with potential partners, build a strong pipeline, and support the foundation for lasting cosmmercial relationships. Over time, you’ll have the opportunity to develop into a full-cycle Partner Manager role, taking end-to-end ownership of strategic partnerships.

Your responsibilities

Here's a bit more on what you can expect to be doing day-to-day:

  • Partner Identification & Assessment: Research and identify prospective partners aligned with Moss’ strategic priorities and ideal customer profiles. Support the initial assessment of partners through qualitative and quantitative analysis (e.g., partner fit, customer base, integration potential).

  • Outreach & Pipeline Building: Own the top of the funnel for our partnerships pipeline. Proactively reach out to prospective partners via email, LinkedIn, events, and other channels. Engage partners with a clear value proposition and qualify initial interest. First 6 months: ~80% outbound/cold calling to build your own pipeline; shifts toward strategic partner management as you progress.

  • Relationship Building & Support: Assist in building and maintaining strong working relationships with partners. Participate in partner calls and meetings, prepare follow-ups, and support ongoing communication. Help deliver value to partners by understanding their needs and coordinating with internal teams.

  • Process & Reporting: Track outreach and pipeline activity in CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce). Share regular updates on partner funnel status and help improve outreach playbooks and processes. Collaborate with Partnerships, Sales, and Marketing to ensure partner prospects are well aligned with Moss’ commercial strategy.

  • First experience (1-2 years of full-time work) in business development, partnerships, finance, accounting, or Fintech

  • Fluent in German (C2) & English (C1)

jobs.title: (Senior) Brand Media Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ZEAL Network SE is an international group shaping the future of digital lotteries and dream-driven experiences. As Germany’s leading online lottery provider through LOTTO24 and Tipp24, and a partner of Spain’s ONCE, ZEAL combines innovation, technology, and entertainment to inspire millions of customers. With ventures such as Freiheit+, Traumhausverlosung, Traumautoverlosung and ZEAL Ventures, the company also invests in new business models and emerging e-commerce brands. Driven by a diverse team of 350+ professionals, ZEAL fosters a collaborative, ambitious culture focused on turning dreams into reality.

 

We are looking for a (Senior) Brand Media Manager (f/m/d) to drive the strategic planning and operational execution of brand media campaigns across our portfolio of brands, leveraging key channels such as TV, Connected TV (CTV), and YouTube to strengthen brand awareness, maximise reach, and support overall business growth.

 

Your tasks:

  • Planning, execution, and optimization of integrated media campaigns across various brand media channels, with a focus on digital brand media (CTV, OLV and YouTube).

  • Continuous analysis and reporting of media campaign performance, including KPIs.

  • Building and maintaining relationships with media agencies, sales houses, and other partners to optimize media buying and collaborations.

  • Identifying and evaluating new media channels and opportunities to expand reach and audience targeting.

  • Close collaboration with the creative team to ensure all media content authentically reflects the brand message and values.

  • Budget management and ensuring efficient use of funds for maximum results.

  • Conducting market and competitor analyses to stay informed about current trends and developments and to derive strategic recommendations.

  • Close collaboration with other departments such as product management, data analytics, and business functions to ensure the media strategy supports the entire customer journey.

 

What you offer us:

  • 4–5 years of relevant professional experience in brand media management, ideally with a focus on operational management of CTV and YouTube.

  • Experience in operational steering of campaigns in the Google Ads Manager and on DSPs (Trade Desk, Amazon Ads Agent)

  • Solid understanding of the German media landscape and its trends, especially in the traditional media sector.

  • Strong analytical skills for evaluating campaign performance and deriving insights.

  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills in German and English.

  • Experience and knowledge of the media landscape in other European countries is an advantage.

Was du mitbringst:

  • Du hast mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung bzw. Hauptbuchhaltung.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Kenntnisse in MS Excel, sowie gängigen Buchhaltungssystemen (MS Dynamics Business Central oder MS Dynamics NAV sind ein Plus).

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, strukturiert und zuverlässig und zeichnest dich durch eine proaktive Kommunikation aus.

  • Idealerweise hast du Erfahrung mit Cash Management Software (E-Banking Treasurysysteme).

  • Erfahrungen mit FloQast oder vergleichbaren Reporting- bzw. Abschlussmanagement-Tools sind ein Plus.

  • Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

Role

As an Android Software Engineer, you own the Android client experience, how AI feels, behaves, and performs on mobile devices. This is not a thin client role. You will build a production Android application where AI interactions are core to the product, and performance, reliability, and clarity matter.

 

Focus

  • Build and maintain production Android apps using Kotlin.

  • Integrate AI-powered features (chat, vision, voice, recommendations) via backend APIs.

  • Design UX patterns for AI interactions, including streaming responses, retries, and partial results.

  • Optimize performance, memory usage, and responsiveness for AI-heavy flows.

  • Implement analytics, logging, and feedback capture to support AI evaluation and iteration.

  • Collaborate closely with backend and ML engineers on API contracts and system behavior.

  • Ensure app stability, security, and scalability in production environments.

 

Ideal Experiences

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Hands-on experience integrating AI features (e.g. LLM, vision, speech APIs).

  • Strong understanding of asynchronous programming (Coroutines, Flow).

  • Familiarity with REST or gRPC APIs and structured data formats.

  • Strong debugging and performance profiling skills.

  • Comfort building in environments with latency, partial failure, and non-deterministic behavior.

  • Experience with MLKit or light on-device inference.

  • Published production apps on the Google Play Store.

 

Outcomes

  • Stable, smooth, and reliable real-world use android applications.

  • Performance is optimized: responsive, low-latency, and efficient on memory and CPU.

  • Production issues are detected early, monitored effectively, and resolved with clear root-cause analysis.

jobs.title: Business Operations Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

jobs.title: Subcontracts Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Program: Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) Increment 1
Organization: Leidos — Army & Mission Partners
Position Type: Full-Time, Dedicated Program Support
Location: Remote, with occasional travel as required-*Please be advised that during the interview, you will be required to keep your camera on, and your interviewer will be taking your picture for identification purposes, if an offer letter is extended to you.
Reports To: AGUN Program Management Office (PMO), with functional alignment to Leidos Subcontracts
Clearance: Active Secret Clearance and must maintain the clearance required by the program.


Position Summary

Leidos is seeking an experienced Subcontracts Manager to provide dedicated, on-program subcontract management support for the Army Global Unified Network (AGUN) Increment 1 program. AGUN is a large-scale Army network modernization effort supporting geographically dispersed installations, enterprise network operations, cybersecurity, engineering, and global deployment activities.

As AGUN expands into additional theaters and increases the concurrency of technical and operational requirements, the program requires dedicated subcontract management expertise to support resource planning, subcontract execution, financial controls, and supplier performance.

The selected candidate will work directly with the AGUN Program Manager, Deputy Program Manager, Finance, Contracts, and functional leads to ensure subcontract requirements are properly planned, authorized, funded, and executed.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Serve as the dedicated subcontract management representative embedded within the AGUN PMO.
  • Manage subcontract execution across multiple teaming partners supporting engineering, migration, installation, logistics, cybersecurity, and operations.
  • Coordinate subcontract modifications, funding actions, purchase orders, tasking, and contractual deliverables.
  • Support Technical Direction Letter (TDL) and Technical Direction Plan (TDP) development by validating subcontract labor, rates, staffing, scope, and execution requirements.
  • Monitor subcontract funding, ceiling limitations, labor utilization, commitments, and forecasted requirements.
  • Coordinate subcontract staffing plans, resource changes, mobilization, and demobilization across multiple geographic theaters.
  • Identify and resolve subcontract execution risks, including funding gaps, delayed authorizations, staffing availability, and supplier performance.
  • Support subcontractor proposal evaluations, cost/price analyses, negotiations, and documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with applicable prime contract requirements, subcontract terms, Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) requirements, and Leidos procurement policies.
  • Maintain accurate subcontract status reporting and provide timely recommendations to program leadership.
  • Coordinate closely with the program Financial Analyst to reconcile subcontract commitments, actual costs, and estimates to complete.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain Management, Finance, Contracts, or related discipline, with equivalent experience considered.
  • Typically 8–12 years of relevant subcontract management or federal contracting experience.
  • Experience supporting large Department of Defense or federal government programs.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of FAR/DFARS, subcontract administration, cost-reimbursement contracts, and Time & Materials subcontract structures.
  • Experience managing multiple subcontractors, funding actions, modifications, and su...

jobs.title: HR Systems Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
In der Rolle als HR Systems Specialist übernimmst Du an unseren Standorten in Berlin, Hamburg oder deutschlandweit remote Aufgaben in der Projektumsetzung von HR System Implementierungen bei unseren Kunden oder begleitest diese interimistisch, z. B. HRIS Admin.

Mit Deiner Arbeit bist Du eine wesentliche Stütze in unserer Projektrealisierung und hilfst dabei, den Qualitätsanspruch unserer Beratung sicherzustellen. Durch fundierte Analysen, Best-Practice-Ansätze und pragmatische Maßnahmen, die Du umsetzt, begeisterst Du unsere Kunden und förderst so unser Wachstum.

DAS BRINGST DU MIT

Wir sind auf der Suche nach motivierten und Start-up affinen Profilen mit den verschiedensten Backgrounds. Wir erwarten nicht, dass Du schon alle Skills perfekt kannst. Was Du noch nicht weißt, bringen wir Dir bei!
  • Du hast relevante Berufserfahrung im Bereich People & Culture, dabei auch dezidierte Berufserfahrung im Bereich People Operations / HR Systems
  • Ein abgeschlossenes wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder eine Ausbildung ist ein Plus
  • Du bist sehr gut in allen People Operations Prozessen (vom Onboarding bis zum Offboarding)
  • Du kennst Dich sehr gut mit verschiedensten HR-Tools (z.B. HRIS, ATS, L&D-, Feedback- oder Performance Management Systeme), der Implementierung und Administration dieser Tools und der Verbesserung und Automatisierung der Prozesse in den Tools aus
  • Du hast gute Kenntnisse der Prozess-Vereinfachung, -Digitalisierung und -Automatisierung im People-(Operations-)Bereich
  • Du hattest schon Berührungspunkte mit anderen HR-Aufgabengebieten (v.a. Business Partnering oder Performance Management)
  • Du hast gute Fähigkeiten in der Problemanalyse sowie der Aufbereitung, Visualisierung und Präsentation von Lösungsmöglichkeiten
  • Erste Erfahrungen in Projektmanagementaufgaben sind ein Plus
  • Erfahrungen mit Systeme wie HiBob, Personio, Leapsome, Tellent sind ein Plus
  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch fließend (ca. B2)

DEINE ROLLE BEI UNS

  • Implementierung von Best-in-Class HR-Tools: z.B. HRIS, ATS, L&D-, Feedback- oder Performance Management Systeme, zusammen mit oder für unsere Kunden.
  • Unterstützung in und Übernahme von Beratungsprojektenzu Fragestellungen im Bereich HR Tooling sowie Prozessdigitalisierung und -Automatisierung für Start-ups, Scale-Ups und KMUs
  • Aufbau und Optimierungvon Prozessen sowie Digitalisierung und Automatisierung
  • Unterstützung von HR-Tool Auswahlprojekten
  • Knowledge Sharing & Standards:Mitarbeit an unserer unternehmensinternen Wissensdatenbank zur kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer Standards und Best Practices.

DAS ERWARTET DICH BEI UNS

  • Echte Flexibilität: Remote, Hybrid oder aus unseren Büros – du passt Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeiten an dein Leben an.
  • Maximale Lernkurve: Durch abwechslungsreiche Kundenmandate lernst du in kurzer Zeit unterschiedlichste HR-Setups, Unternehmenskulturen und Führungsmodelle kennen.
  • Interne Entwicklungspfade: Ob Fachexperte/Fachexpertin für Spezialthemen oder intern als People Lead – wir fördern deine persönliche und berufliche Entwicklung gezielt.
  • Starker Teamgeist: Kein Einzelkämpfertum – das gesamte Expert*innen-Team von Friday/Poppins hält dir als Sparringspartner den Rücken frei.
  • Fairness & Benefits: Attraktives und flexibles Total Rewards Paket, 30 Tage Urlaub, Workation-Möglichkeiten sowie transparente Karriereperspektiven.

Job Description: Director of PMO – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Director of Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for establishing, leading, and managing the organization's Project Management Office to ensure effective governance, planning, execution, monitoring, and delivery of strategic and operational projects.

The role oversees the project portfolio across insurance, investment, corporate operations, technology, digital transformation, and business development functions. The Director of PMO ensures projects are delivered within approved timelines, budgets, quality standards, and organizational objectives while maintaining effective risk management, resource allocation, and stakeholder engagement.

The successful candidate will drive project management excellence, strengthen governance frameworks, improve delivery performance, and ensure that project outcomes contribute to business growth, operational efficiency, regulatory compliance, and customer experience.

2. Key Responsibilities

A. PMO Strategy, Leadership & Governance

  • Establish, develop, and lead the organization's Project Management Office.
  • Define PMO strategy, policies, methodologies, standards, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement standardized project management processes, tools, templates, and reporting structures.
  • Establish project approval processes, stage gates, escalation procedures, and accountability frameworks.
  • Promote project management best practices across departments and business units.
  • Ensure alignment between project execution and corporate strategy.

B. Project Portfolio Management

  • Oversee the organization's project portfolio, ensuring alignment with strategic priorities.
  • Evaluate project proposals, business cases, feasibility studies, and investment requirements.
  • Prioritize projects based on business value, financial impact, risk, and resource availability.
  • Monitor project dependencies, interdepartmental coordination, and portfolio-level risks.
  • Provide recommendations to senior management regarding project prioritization and resource allocation.
  • Track portfolio performance and ensure delivery of expected business benefits.

  • Oversee the planning, scheduling, budgeting, and execution of strategic projects.
  • Ensure project managers develop comprehensive project plans, milestones, deliverables, and resource requirements.
  • Monitor project progress and identify delays, delivery challenges, and performance gaps.
  • Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to maintain project delivery commitments.
  • Ensure projects are completed within approved scope, budget, timelines, and quality standards.
  • Coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth project implementation.

  • Oversee projects related to insurance operations, underwriting, claims management, policy administration, and distribution.

jobs.title: Director, Clinical Research
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the Role

Hello Heart is seeking a Director, Clinical Research to lead the clinical and economic evidence strategy to showcase how Hello Heart products help members understand and improve their heart health through AI, hardware, and behavioral science.

Reporting into our VP, Commercial Actuary, you will set our research and publications strategy; partnering with Commercial & Product Leadership, Medical Affairs, Data Science, Product, Sales, and Marketing to drive peer reviewed publications, white papers, conference abstracts, and client facing evidence that support our commercial goals. You will apply your expertise in statistics, claims analysis, and clinical research to shape our study pipeline, build partnerships with leading research institutes and consultants, and represent Hello Heart’s evidence to technical and executive audiences.

This is a strong fit for someone who enjoys rigorous research, clear communication, cross-functional collaboration, and turning complex data into evidence that supports better heart health outcomes.

What you’ll do

  • Collaborate with leadership and cross-functional partners to prioritize clinical and economic research priorities.
  • Provide peer review and mentorship to other researchers on the team, developing their analytical and publication skills over time.
  • Generate research questions and develop analytical plans for key publication and evidence-generation priorities.
  • Develop partnerships and work alongside leading research institutes.
  • Build Hello Heart's research and evidence strategy to support future FDA-regulated capabilities, accounting for regulatory requirements and timelines.
  • Identify, organize, query, and analyze diverse datasets, including clinical, claims, electronic health record (EHR), and engagement data.
  • Apply advanced statistical methods, including multilevel modeling, causal inference methods, propensity score matching, mixed-effects modeling, longitudinal analyses, and sensitivity testing.
  • Collaborate with co-authors to incorporate feedback and finalize analyses, manuscripts, white papers, and abstracts.
  • Respond to anonymous peer reviews, including repeat analyses and manuscript revisions, to support timely resubmission.
  • Identify relevant conferences for abstract submission and present ongoing research when appropriate.
  • Stay current on scientific research related to cardiovascular health, digital health, behavioral science, chronic disease, health economics, and public health.
  • Contribute to data summaries, research protocols, institutional review board (IRB) materials,...

Fleetworthy offers the only complete technology suite for fleet readiness, uniting safety and compliance, toll management, and weigh station bypass solutions. We help fleets streamline operations, control costs, and operate with confidence.

Trusted by 75% of the top fleets in North America, Fleetworthy offers the most adopted toll management solution and largest weigh station bypass network. Going beyond regulatory requirements, our safety and compliance capabilities strengthen safety programs and enable proactive audit readiness. We support millions of vehicles and drivers and are recognized across the industry for innovation and leadership.

Fleetworthy is shaping the future of fleet readiness with AI-enabled, connected fleet technology that keeps drivers safe, fleets compliant, and operations running at peak efficiency. Learn more at .

Job Purpose

The Business Operations Coordinator is an entry-level, high-potential role built for a natural systems thinker; someone who's energized by figuring out how the pieces of a complex process connect. Using our CRM and internal data and reporting tools, the Coordinator investigates escalated customer and provider partner issues, digs past the symptom to find the root cause, and partners with toll agencies and internal teams to fix not just the individual case but the process behind it.

Deep tolling industry knowledge isn't required on day one; strong analytical instincts and a comfort with technology and data are. This role is designed to build both, developing the Coordinator into a go-to technical troubleshooter within Business Operations.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

  • Documents findings and recommendations clearly enough for teammates, managers, and product owners to act on.
  • Engages with customers on an as-needed basis.
  • Maintains broad knowledge about the company's services.

Please note this job description is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of task activities and/or duties that are required of the employee for this job. Responsibilities and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

The Team

Stability AI’s Legal team works on exciting cutting edge questions of law. You’ll join Legal as the main legal partner to our product, research, and engineering organizations. Day to day, you’ll work with product managers, engineers, researchers, release management, security and infosec, and our commercial team on products across audio, image, video, and 3D. We’re building toward a consistent, documented legal review for every data and product release, and a privacy program that keeps up with a growing global business.

The Work

  • Lead product and privacy counseling for multiple generative AI product teams. You’ll learn our models, products, and development processes well enough to spot legal, security, and ethical risks early and recommend practical ways to handle them.
  • Build and run the policies, processes, and documentation that govern data and product releases. You’ll work with product, engineering, release management, and security.
  • Advance our global privacy and data security compliance program, and partner with infosec on incident response and data security practices.
  • Advise on copyright across the model lifecycle: licensing and use of training datasets, rights in generative output, and content-hosting obligations such as the DMCA and Article 17 of the EU Copyright Directive.

Qualifications

Experience

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Swiftly is the AI platform purpose-built for retail, serving retailers, wholesalers, and brands. Swiftly's AI agents unify data, automate workflows, and power the marketing that drives measurable business growth. Swiftly AI is built on the industry's largest proprietary retail dataset: live transactions, 9 million products, and the closed-loop campaign outcomes of 33,000 stores.

Trusted by leading retailers, wholesalers, and hundreds of iconic brands, Swiftly unifies data across the retail ecosystem to accelerate growth and power the connected, personalized experiences that drive lasting shopper loyalty.

Position Summary:
Swiftly is searching for a Principal Software Engineer to lead the architecture of our ads and martech platform: the systems that author retail media campaigns, generate creatives and serve ads to shoppers through The Trade Desk. The platform spans a Go ad server built for low-latency bid requests, Python services on Azure Functions for campaign authoring and tenant configuration, Kotlin/Quarkus services we are carving apart, and a shared PostgreSQL schema managed as code. This role will set technical direction across these teams, lead a tenant-by-tenant migration off legacy services without downtime, and stay hands-on in the hardest code.

Responsibilities Include:

  • Work with and provide direction to the teams that build Swiftly's ads and martech platform, including the Go ad server, campaign authoring, the tenant and capability registry, creative generation and personalized-ad services
  • Architect, code and maintain large scale distributed systems with complex requirements
  • Lead the incremental migration of campaign authoring and The Trade Desk write path off a Kotlin/Quarkus service, one retailer at a time, using per-tenant ownership switches, database write guards and shadow-diff dry runs to cut over safely
  • Own the performance and reliability of the Go ad server against strict SLOs (p50 at or under 40 ms, p99 at or under 1 s, 2 s hard deadline), using in-process caching, circuit breakers, connection pooling and profiling
  • Design the data contracts shared between services: declarative schema-as-code with Atlas, versioned database views as serving contracts, and transactional outbox and projector patterns for side effects
  • Partner with data engineering on Databricks pipelines for personalized rankings, identity resolution and the impression data that feeds attribution and iROAS
  • Build safe, auditable integrations with The Trade Desk GraphQL API, Salesforce and creative-rendering services, with idempotent, lock-protected pushes and full write audit history
  • Utilize expertise with microservices architecture and database design
  • Operate production services, including on-call and incident management
  • Contribute to a multi-tenant platform architecture
  • Guide the platform from AKS with ArgoCD and Kustomize toward Azure Container Apps and Azure Functions, with runtime configuration in Azure App Configuration and identity through Entra ID and Key Vault
  • Set the engineering quality bar: strict typing and linting, unit, integration and end-to-end tests with Testcontainers, CodeQL and dependency scanning, release automation in GitHub Actions, and AI-assisted development
  • Working collaboratively in an ambiguous, fast-paced environment
  • Take ownership of domain from the ground up, from architectural decisions to coding to testing to operations
  • Other related duties as assigned

jobs.title: RFQ Reimagining NPS Consultant
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Request for Qualifications:

The Future of America’s National Parks Consultant

National Parks Conservation Association

Due: Wednesday, November 25, 2026

To be awarded by Friday, January 8, 2027

Timeline: January 2027 through June 30, 2027

The National Parks Conservation Association (NPCA) is seeking a contractor to complete research and interviews to inform and create a report detailing changes to the National Park System since 2016 and recommendations from key stakeholders on national legislative, administrative, and agency level policy changes to guide the future of the National Park Service (NPS) and the cultural and natural landscapes in which they are located.

Project workflow: First, the contractor will document changes at the NPS, and in policies affecting national park resources, from the 2016 NPS Centennial to the present. Second, the contractor will gather informed individual perspectives on changes that may be needed at NPS and in related law and policy. Finally, the contractor will create a report, in collaboration with a tribal contractor completing a parallel analysis, detailing findings.

Capability statements from potential contractors are due to NPCA by November 25, 2026. This is a request for qualifications, not a request for proposals (see full project award timeline below). NPCA will share a detailed scope of work with shortlisted respondents for full project applications after they sign a nondisclosure agreement (NDA).

HIRINGLEAD

John Adornato, 954-309-9307

NATIONAL PARKS CONSERVATION ASSOCIATION (NPCA)

Website:

www.npca.org

Mission:

To protect and enhance America’s National Park System for present and future generations.

Our Story:

With more than 1.6 million members and supporters beside us, we are the voice of America’s national parks since 1919, working to protect and preserve our nation’s most iconic and inspirational places for present and future generations. We celebrate the parks — and work tirelessly to defend them — whether on the ground, in the courtroom or on Capitol Hill.

From our national headquarters in Washington, D.C., and various locations nationwide, we call on our program and policy experts, committed volunteers, staff lobbyists, community organizers and communications specialists to inform and inspire the public and to influence decision makers to ensure that our national parks are well protected.

PROJECT SCOPE AND DELIVERABLES

Scope of work

The work will draw on three sources of information.

Policy change baseline: The contractor will review public records and prepare a 2016–2026 summary that details where key policy, funding, and staffing changes have occurred. Topics will include NPS staffing, congressional appropriations, deferred park maintenance, park visitation, natural and cultural resource conservation and programming, park use and access, and landscape-level conservation beyond park boundaries. This list is not exhaustive.

jobs.title: Manager, Paid Search
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT QUINCE

Quince is a destination for builders, creators, innovators, and operators who want to come together and challenge the status quo. Our mission is simple: make really high quality essentials for really low prices, fairly and sustainably. We deliver on that mission through a unique manufacturer-to-consumer (M2C) model eliminating the layers of traditional retail that add cost and result in consumers paying more than they need to. We find, build relationships with, and work directly with the manufacturing partners behind some of the world’s finest products. From there, our teams design smart, efficient operational processes and build and deploy proprietary technology, AI, and analytics to help us scale fast.

What began with a small assortment of elevated basics has quickly grown into a cross-category brand spanning apparel, accessories, home goods, and more. Today, tens of millions of people across a growing number of countries come – and return – to Quince because they trust us to deliver.

OUR CULTURE

Quince is a culture built for builders by builders. Our way of working starts with a blank sheet of paper. We question conventional thinking, use technology and data to uncover new opportunities, and move quickly to turn ideas into reality. We aren’t interested in replicating how others do retail. We’re building a better way – at a speed and scale unlike anything that’s been done before.

  • We dream big and chase the hard problems others shy away from. Rejecting long-held assumptions is part of our company's DNA. Where conventional wisdom says you have to choose – soft or durable, speed or rigor, quality or price – we ask why that trade-off has to exist in the first place.
  • Our pace is fast and the bar is high because our customers expect a lot from us and we refuse to let them down. We believe the best results come from challenging ourselves, learning from one another, and building on each other's strengths.
  • Here, responsibility is not determined by role, tenure, or seniority. Every team member - no matter their level - has the opportunity to drive our business and shape our trajectory.

If you’re someone who likes to imagine new possibilities and build better systems rather than plug-in to outdated ones, Quince is the place for you.

THE ROLE

Manager, Paid Search (PLA)

We are seeking a Manager, Paid Search to join our growing team. This role will lead and scale high-performing Shopping (PLA) and Text Ad campaigns across Google and emerging search platforms, with a strong focus on feed optimization, testing, and ecommerce growth. In this role, you will drive performance, scalability, and innovation across paid search programs, helping accelerate customer acquisition and support the company’s continued growth.

Responsibilities

  • Play a crucial role in Quince’s growth story managing one of biggest channels which has grown 400% YoY and continued growth potential.
  • Support the end-to-end Paid Search strategy across Shopping (PLA) and Text Ads, driving performance, scalability, and innovation across Google and emerging engines such as Bing and Brave.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 5+ years of managing Paid Search programs with large budgets with a focus on product listing ads
  • Strong understanding of feed-based advertising and product-level optimization
  • Proven experience with title testing, image testing, and structured experimentation
  • Experience building and managing highly granular PLA account structures
  • Experience working...

Innovación. Sostenibilidad. Productividad. jobs.title: Account Executive - Mid Market, West Coast
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Thatch

For most people, health insurance is something that happens to them: a plan chosen by someone else, with little room to fit their life. Thatch is changing that. We help companies give every employee a real healthcare budget instead of a one-size-fits-all plan, so people can choose the coverage and care that works for them, and employers get predictable costs they can control.

It’s a simple idea, but making it real means solving hard problems across healthcare, payments, and technology, and we’re just getting started. We look for people who like solving complex problems, use good judgment, and are comfortable working through ambiguity. People here care deeply about our customers, take real responsibility for what gets built, and are driven by doing work that matters.

About the role

We’re looking for a consultative, strategic Account Executive to join our Mid-Market sales team at Thatch, owning a market within our West territory. Alongside our Broker partners, you will work with HR, finance, and executive stakeholders at companies with 100+ employees to solve complex healthcare challenges. This is an ideal role for someone who can run an exceptional sales process, influence high-level decisions, and help us build a category-defining business.

Where this role is based

This role covers the West territory. You’ll own the market where you live. We’re prioritizing candidates who are based in, and well networked in, the market they’d cover. We’re hiring reps who live in, and already have broker relationships in the following markets: Los Angeles, San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, Portland, Denver, Phoenix.

Please apply to only one territory job post (East, Central, West): the one that includes your market.

What you'll do

  • Lead high-stakes consultative sales processes with companies navigating complex benefits needs across your assigned territory.
  • Act as a trusted advisor to executive-level buyers in your market, uncovering deep needs and aligning them to Thatch’s solutions.
  • Work cross functionally with product teams to refine positioning for this segment.
  • Analyze and share insights on the competitive landscape in your market, influencing go-to-market strategy.
  • Drive forecasting accuracy and pipeline health for the regional territory through disciplined sales operations.
  • Build relationships with existing and new broker partners across your market.
  • Travel within your assigned territory to build relationships and support broker partners.

Background we're looking for

  • 3+ years of experience in group benefits mid-market consulting, specifically tier 1 or tier 2 brokerage firm background, healthcare carrier field representation, payroll sales, or HR tech / SaaS sales is a requirement.
  • An established network of brokers and benefits professionals in your market, and a clear plan for where you’d prospect first.
  • Strong working knowledge of group medical plans: you can read SBCs, analyze a group’s current benefits, and support quoting. You also understand the basics of underwriting, including plan design, contribution strategies, and key cost and risk drivers.

jobs.title: Head of Product Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
YOUR MISSION

Make Nulogy's Product and Engineering organization run like a well-oiled machine, and make sure the rest of the company can see, trust, and act on what it builds. As a member of the Product Leadership Team, you will own the operating system behind how we plan, deliver, measure, and launch product. You will connect the voice of our customers and go-to-market teams to the roadmap, give leadership clear visibility into delivery and outcomes, and ensure every release lands with customers and colleagues who know exactly what changed and why it matters.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Keep the trains running on time across Product and Engineering. Build and run an effective operating rhythm, including planning, roadmap reviews, and delivery check-ins, with one trusted view of every initiative's timeline, dependencies, and risks.
  • Raise delivery predictability. Support and coach Product Managers and Engineering Managers to plan realistically, spot delivery risk early, and act on it.
  • Close the loop between go-to-market and Product. Maintain a living log of product needs from new-logo and existing-customer opportunities, tied to pipeline and ARR, and track friction points across the customer lifecycle with Customer Success and Professional Services.
  • Put the right data behind product decisions. Centralize data from our product, delivery, customer, and revenue systems so PMs and leaders can answer key questions without hunting for numbers.
  • Build trust through KPIs, reporting, and transparency. Define core product and delivery KPIs with the Product Leadership Team, and own the dashboards and reporting that feed executive, board, and all-hands updates.
  • Align the organization around what we're building. Make sure Product and Engineering plans are understood across GTM, Customer Success, Services, Finance, and leadership, and that every release lands through release notes, customer communications, and internal enablement.
  • Be present with customers. Join customer visits, calls, and reviews, and bring what you hear back into planning.
  • Be a right hand to the CPO. Drive the day-to-day of the product organization, prepare executive communication briefs, and lead special projects as they come up.

EXPERIENCE & SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  • 8+ years in product operations, program or delivery management, product management, business operations, or a chief-of-staff-style role at a B2B SaaS company, including 3+ years working across Product and Engineering.
  • A track record of running an operating rhythm and tracking delivery across multiple product and engineering teams, including coaching teams to improve predictability.
  • Hands-on experience centralizing data from multiple systems into a single view
  • Experience building KPIs and reporting that executives relied on for decisions.
  • Strong executive communication: you've written leadership briefs, executive updates, or board materials.
  • Comfortable working directly with customers, including on-site visits.
  • Experience as a trusted partner to a senior leader, owning day-to-day operations and special projects.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and follow-through.
  • AI-first operating habits: you use AI tools daily in your own work.
  • Able to travel as needed for customer visits and team offsites approximately 1-2x a quarter
  • Experience in enterprise SaaS serving supply chain, manufacturing, or logistics.
  • Hands-on experience with tools such as Jira and Confluence, Pendo, Salesforce or HubSpot.
  • Experience running release communications or launch programs for customers and internal teams.
  • Experience measuring product adoption and usage.
  • A background as a Product Manager, Engineering Manager, Program Manager, ...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

About the role:

Samsara is looking for an experienced manager to lead SOX business process compliance and help keep the trust in our financial reporting as strong as the business we’re building. As part of our SOX Compliance team, you’ll help oversee and strengthen Samsara’s global control environment, protecting the accuracy of our financial reporting and keeping us compliant as we scale. You’ll partner closely with IT and business process owners to design and implement controls, spot gaps early, and drive remediation to the finish line. We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership. You bring deep, hands-on SOX expertise, a track record of delivering projects reliably, and the confidence to run with complex work independently. If you take pride in being the person others count on to get it done right, we’d love to meet you.

This is a remote position open to candidates based in Canada.

You should apply if:

  • You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact – helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
  • You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
  • You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
  • You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. Youwill be surrounded by a high-calibre team that will encourage you to do your best.

In this role, you will:

  • Develop, lead, and execute periodic financial risk assessments, materiality calculations, and scoping of the SOX program
  • Develop and deliver training to SOX control owners, including process documentation, testing methodology, management review controls, and controls over Information Produced by the Entity (IPE).

jobs.title: Customer Onboarding Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

TripleTen is an award-winning online school among technology bootcamps. Our mission is to help people change their lives and succeed in technology. We offer flexibility in studies, career mentoring, resume and portfolio preparation, and we guarantee employment after the course. Our employability rate among graduates is 87% across our Full Stack Development, Quality Assurance (QA) and Data Analytics programs.

We are looking for an Onboarding Specialist for our Latin America team. You will guide new students from the moment they pay until they start their first sprint, keep them motivated, answer their doubts, and remove anything standing between them and the first lesson. This is not a sales role, but it needs a salesperson's skills: you listen, you handle objections and you close on a next step.

Please submit all resumes or CVs in English.

What you will do

  • Contact every new student within the agreed timeframes, run the welcome call and make sure their payment, access and tools are ready before the start.
  • Understand each student's goal and situation and connect the program to it, so they start motivated and know what to do first.
  • Handle doubts, objections and early cancellation requests yourself: offer alternatives and find the reason to continue.
  • Follow up proactively with students who go silent, miss the start or hit a blocker in the first days.
  • Record every interaction and outcome in HubSpot, and share what you learn from students with the team.

Requirements

  • 1+ years in sales, retention, account management or customer service with a commercial component, in B2C (education, fintech, subscriptions or similar).
  • You handle objections calmly and can show results in persuading customers to stay or to buy.
  • Results-oriented: you are measured by how many of your students start, not by how many calls you make.
  • Fluent Spanish and English at B1 level or above.
  • Organized and autonomous: many students in parallel, tight deadlines, accurate CRM records.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with HubSpot, Slack, Discord or similar tools.
  • EdTech or call-center background.

No technical background needed — we will teach you our programs and scripts.

What we can offer you

An IT development team is seeking a full-stack web developer with strong technical expertise and at least 8 years of experience in software development.

French or Dutch, both written and spoken, as well as English, both written and spoken.

You have experience as a confirmed full-stack developer and bring at least 8 years of professional software development experience.

  • Azure DevOps with Git
  • C# and .NET Core, including .NET 10

  • C# with ASP.NET MVC
  • Docker

  • Kubernetes

You will be part of a growing Belgian SME where initiative and personal development are encouraged. We will provide you with an enjoyable work environment with fun colleagues. We will work out a career plan with you, with attention and a budget for extra education/certification. You can count on an attractive salary, supplemented with extra-legal benefits, including a company car.

jobs.title: GPU Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About PolarGrid

PolarGrid is an early-stage Canadian company that runs managed AI inference. A customer brings a model or a serving image. We run it on dedicated GPUs behind one endpoint, serve each request from the nearest site, and move traffic to the next nearest site when one fails.

Our goal is to make AI inference fast, reliable, and secure for customers running production workloads.

The Role

This role is responsible for scaling PolarGrid's inference network from a handful of sites to a geographically distributed fleet of GPU clusters. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will own how new sites and nodes come online, from provisioning and burn-in through validation and a staged move into production. They will define when a site is ready for customer traffic, and make sure each new site joins the network without hurting latency or reliability.

A core responsibility is running the global routing layer that sends each request to the best place to serve it. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will work with live signals such as network latency, capacity and health, and tune routing against real traffic to keep latency low and predictable.

The role also owns reliability across the network. The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will set and track availability targets, build the health checks and automation that detect and route around failing hardware and models, keep recovery fast, and test failure handling regularly.

The GPU Infrastructure Engineer will build the observability, release and network systems needed to run a distributed GPU fleet without operations work growing with every new site. This includes end-to-end tracing and latency alerting, safe staged rollouts, network configuration as code, and security and DDoS protection at the edge.

Requirements

  • Experience operating distributed systems across multiple sites or regions with high availability targets
  • Strong networking fundamentals: BGP, DNS, TCP/TLS and load balancing
  • Hands-on experience running bare-metal GPU fleets: provisioning, burn-in, firmware and node lifecycle
  • InfiniBand or RDMA networking experience
  • Experience running LLM inference engines such as vLLM, SGLang or TensorRT-LLM, including multi-node serving, cold starts and TTFT
  • Deep observability skills focused on p95/p99 latency and gray failures, not just uptime
  • Experience designing failover, graceful degradation and automated recovery
  • Strong automation and infrastructure-as-code mindset, including CI/CD for infrastructure
  • Ability to plan capacity on constrained, uneven hardware supply
  • Experience building internal tooling or control planes, ideally in Go or Rust

Nice to Have

- DDoS mitigation experience

- Running DNS infrastructure at scale

  • Hardware security: TPM, measured boot or confidential computing
  • Real-time streaming inference, including voice and audio
  • Operating remote datacenter sites with on-site technicians
  • Certificate automation across many domains

- Deterministic simulation testing

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. The Role

Join Lumen Security Advisory Services as a Cloud Security Engineer, helping customers identify and reduce security risk across cloud and on-premises environments. This hands-on, early-career opportunity is designed for someone who has built a foundation in cloud security or vulnerability management and wants to deepen their expertise through customer assessments, security tooling, remediation planning, and automation.
