jobs.title: Events Hotel and Travel Coordinator
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Hotel and Travel Coordinator will arrange hotel accommodation for guests and staff at various TED Conferences and events, as well as provide support for travel logistics. You’re highly efficient and organized, have mastery of spreadsheets, work well under pressure, and are comfortable managing shifting priorities.

Note: This position is a part-time contract position (10-20 hrs/week) and ends in October 2027, with the possibility of extension.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the point of contact for all things hotel and travel, acting as the liaison between attendees, hotels and our travel agent.
  • Coordinate hotel, flight and transportation bookings and compile travel itineraries.
  • Manage room blocks for 1,000+ rooms at peak (6,000+ room nights). Build and organize multiple rooming lists, balance room inventory across hotels and mitigate attrition.
  • Oversee the flight booking process with our travel agent, ensuring all bookings comply with TED’s travel policy.
  • Research travel requirements in the destination city/country (visa, vaccination requirements, etc.) and provide support with any documentation needed.
  • Build and maintain internal tracking documents and spreadsheets. Track deadlines and ensure timely follow-up with various stakeholders.
  • Manage and reconcile hotel and travel budgets.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to understand and support their hotel and travel requirements.
  • Provide white-glove service to conference attendees via phone and email.
  • Report on attendee feedback and booking trends, and highlight potential risks.
  • Manage all booking changes leading up to the conference and troubleshoot any last-minute issues.
  • Be available for on-call requests and resolve issues throughout the conference travel dates.
  • 3+ years of reservations experience in luxury hospitality or tourism, preferably with high-profile clientele. Events experience is an asset.
  • Advanced working knowledge of Google Sheets or Microsoft Excel is required.
  • Experience with Google Workspace and CRMs preferred.
  • Highly organized, with the ability to manage competing priorities and consistently meet deadlines and budgets.
  • Exceptional customer support or relationship management experience, both in-person and online.
  • Excellent interpersonal, verbal and written communication skills.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Tech-savvy, fast learner of new tools.
  • Strong quantitative and qualitative analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Degree (preferred) or diploma in tourism, hospitality or similar.
  • This position works remotely, but must be able to commute to San Diego for occasional on-site work.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

TED is a global nonprofit dedicated to spreading ideas that matter — through talks, conferences, and experiences that connect and inspire. Our events bring together diverse voices to share ideas that shape the future.

TED is an equal opportunity employer and contractor engager committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodation throughout the hiring process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Purpose

Develop foundational Apparel Engineering capability while supporting the technical development, sample review and production readiness of assigned apparel products. Working under the guidance of experienced Apparel Engineers and managers, the role applies established standards, builds practical knowledge across product categories and supports timely, accurate physical and digital development for compressed Go-To-Market calendars. Develop effective working relationships within VF pillars, with Brand and factory partners by communicating clearly, following through on commitments, asking questions and contributing positively to shared product outcomes.


Key Accountabilities

1. Product Development Support

  • Learn and apply established Apparel Engineering standards, tools and processes to assigned products and development activities.
  • Support Brand Development, Sourcing Development and vendors with routine technical follow-up across development and commercialization stages.
  • Assist with fit, pattern, construction, measurement, material and manufacturing reviews, documenting observations and proposed actions for review by an experienced Apparel Engineer.
  • Support construction, sizing, grading and block-related activities within clearly defined instructions and scope.
  • Raise unclear, complex, high-risk or material issues promptly rather than resolving them independently.

2. Physical & Digital Sample Support

  • Support the review of physical and digital samples across relevant development stages, including Proto, SMS, POC, PPS, Counter and Size Set.
  • Check assigned samples against the Tech Pack, measurements, approved product intent and established construction and workmanship standards.
  • Prepare clear draft comments, measurements, images and supporting information for review and approval by an experienced Apparel Engineer where required.
  • Update sample records, forms and systems accurately and on time, maintaining alignment between physical and digital findings.
  • Follow up with vendor technical teams on agreed actions and escalate late, repeated or unresolved issues.

3. Risk, Testing & Production Readiness Support

  • Support product risk classification and monitoring using established RBM guidance and direction from the Manager or Senior Apparel Engineer.
  • Prepare information for Tech Pack handover, Risk Analysis handoff, PRM, PP meetings, and participate as required.
  • Identify and record Tech Pack discrepancies; update minor discrepancies only where authorized and escalate all material or unclear items.
  • Coordinate assigned testing activities and track results, failures and agreed corrective actions under guidance.
  • Support production-readiness checks by confirming that assigned actions, sample comments and technical information are complete and current.

4. Learning, Cross-Category Growth & Development Trips

  • Build technical capability through intentional learning and planned exposure across product categories, manufacturing methods and development stages.
  • Participate in technical calibration, coaching, knowledge-sharing and training, and maintain an active Individual Development Plan.

5. Factory Exposure & Partner Support

  • Travel to factories as required to gain hands-on exposure to product development and manufacturing, support sample and product reviews, and develop effective working relationships with CFT and wider factory pattern and digital specialists teams.
  • Observe factory processes, sample-room practices and production methods to strengthen practical understanding of how technical decisions affect execution.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Intro description:

Legalist is a tech-enabled alternative asset manager that uses proprietary data-driven origination to invest in uncorrelated legal and government-payment assets. Founded out of Y Combinator in 2016, Legalist manages over $1.7 billion for endowments, foundations, and family offices.

Legalist is a tech-enabled alternative asset manager that uses proprietary data-driven origination to invest in uncorrelated legal and government-payment assets. Founded out of Y Combinator in 2016, Legalist manages ~$2.0 billion for endowments, foundations, and family offices.

Summary

Legalist is looking for a GTM Engineer to join our team and build the systems, workflows, and automation that power our go-to-market motion. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone with real experience running Clay-based workflows who enjoys combining data enrichment, personalization, and outbound automation into scalable systems. Our ideal candidate can take a sales or growth problem, figure out the technical approach, build a solution, and iterate quickly.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain GTM automation workflows in Clay to power outbound prospecting, enrichment, and lead scoring
  • Build data enrichment pipelines pulling from multiple sources (e.g. Clearbit, Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to generate accurate, actionable prospect and account lists
  • Integrate Clay with our CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) and outbound sequencing tools (e.g. Instantly, Smartlead, Outreach) to keep data and workflows in sync
  • Build and refine lead scoring and segmentation logic to prioritize the highest-value accounts and contacts
  • Automate manual GTM processes using Clay's native integrations, APIs, and webhooks, supplemented with lightweight scripting (Python/JavaScript) where needed
  • Partner closely with sales and marketing to translate business requirements into working technical systems
  • Monitor data quality, deliverability, and workflow performance, and continuously test and iterate to improve conversion rates
  • Build reporting and dashboards to track pipeline generation, campaign performance, and system health
  • Stay current on new GTM tools, enrichment providers, and automation techniques

Qualifications

  • 3-5 years of experience in a GTM engineering, revenue operations, sales engineering, or growth engineering role
  • Hands-on experience building and maintaining workflows in Clay (required)
  • Experience with outbound sales tooling and data enrichment providers (e.g. Clearbit, ZoomInfo, Apollo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator)
  • Experience integrating GTM tools with a CRM (Salesforce, HubSpot) and outbound sequencing platforms
  • Working knowledge of APIs, webhooks, and basic scripting (Python, JavaScript, or similar) to automate workflows
  • Comfortable working with messy or unstructured data and building processes to clean and structure it
  • Experience working with financial, legal, or other complex datasets a plus
  • Comfortable working independently and figuring things out without a detailed set of requirements

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Regnology our greatest asset is our people. We value diversity and foster an inclusive environment that supports learning, safety, and growth. By investing in our team, listening to customers, and encouraging creativity, we drive continuous innovation and improvement.
We offer a flexible, innovative environment where your ideas matter and your career can thrive.
Regnology is a global leader in regulatory reporting, helping financial institutions, regulators, and tax authorities improve data quality, efficiency, and cost savings. Our mission: to safeguard financial markets through smarter, future-ready solutions.

About Regnology :


Regnology is a recognized leader in regulatory, risk, tax, and finance reporting technology— connecting regulators and the regulated across more than 100 countries. Our unique position enables us to span the full spectrum of industry needs, delivering solutions that address both oversight and compliance requirements to a broad range of clients, including global Tier 1 banks, local and regional institutions, corporates, insurers, and authorities.

You will act as a trusted counterpart to the Head of HR Services and provide continuity, leadership and decision-making capacity across the function. When required, you will independently represent HR Services, take ownership of critical situations and ensure that priorities continue to move forward.

CFRA’s desktop solutions software. The responsibilities include designing and implementing
tests, debugging, and defining corrective actions.

and meets client needs, while at the same time being secure, scalable, and cost-effective. We are
looking for candidates that value collaboration with colleagues and having an immediate,
tangible impact for a leading global independent financial insights and data company.

  • Test Planning: Collaborate with developers, architects, and stakeholders to understand web products and API requirements and design test plans and strategies for web products and API testing on AWS.

    coverage.
  • Test Automation: Implement automated tests for web products and APIs using tools like
    Cypress, Postman, Selenium, or tools such as Jenkins to improve testing efficiency and
    coverage.

    and APIs do not introduce new bugs or regressions, maintaining the overall quality of

    testing

jobs.title: MSK Teletherapy Physical Therapist / PTA — Overland Park, KS
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Treat PeteDME’s MSK Integrated Care patients from home. Our program pairs knee and lumbar bracing with physical therapy and remote therapeutic monitoring, delivered through a network of in-home therapists. Remote visits and monitoring are paid per visit and per call.

How you join
Every therapist on the remote caseload starts with six in-person brace fittings on patients from your own current caseload, so you know the devices you will be coaching patients on. Each fitting is a paid clinical visit — intake, fitting, and follow-up — at a flat fee agreed in writing before your first patient. We give you a one-page screening tool to identify candidates among the patients you already see, and we handle the prescription, benefit verification, and the paperwork.

This is not a sales role. We do not ask you to refer; you treat patients you already see.

After six fittings
Teletherapy patient referrals from PeteDME begin: our patients, work from home, on your schedule, paid per visit and per call.

What you get
• Free specialized training and certification in orthopedic bracing.
• AI-generated SOAP notes — no new EMR to learn.
• Keep your current job. This is additional, independent-contractor work alongside it.
• Flat fees fixed in advance; no part of your pay depends on volume or on referrals.

Requirements

    • Active physical therapist or physical therapist assistant license in the state where you practice.
    • Currently working in home health or another in-home setting.
    • You evaluate and provide treatment.

How to apply

    Complete the short questionnaire. It asks about your license, your setting, and your caseload, and it asks you to acknowledge that teletherapy referrals begin after six fittings. A clinical onboarding specialist will reach out within one business day.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
GENERAL OVERVIEW:

Education Advanced, Inc. is a rapidly growing educational technology (Ed-Tech) company in the K-12 industry. Our goal is to create operational software that empowers educators to work more efficiently in specific areas.

Evaluation is our teacher and staff observation and evaluation product. It is a Ruby on Rails application hosted on AWS, and it includes AI-powered features that help educators do their best work. We are hiring a Software Engineer III to own significant parts of the product. This is a small, tight-knit team, so the role carries real breadth: you will work across the Rails application, our AI-powered features, the data integrations that connect Evaluation to other systems, and the cloud infrastructure it all runs on. You will also help others understand how the system works, so documentation and mentoring are part of the job, not something you get to after the sprint. You will start with a structured onboarding period, then help shape where the product and its architecture go next. This is a remote role with core availability during US Central Time business hours.

We foster a supportive, inclusive, and innovation-driven culture where every voice matters and your work directly empowers teachers and students. Join us to grow, collaborate, and build solutions that transform K–12 education.

QUALIFICATIONS:

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Design, build, ship, and support features across the Evaluation application, from the first product conversation through release and production support.
  • Build and improve AI-powered product features: integrate large language models (LLMs) into real user workflows, and help design the prompts, safeguards, and quality checks that keep AI output accurate, safe, and useful for educators.
  • Build and maintain data integrations between Evaluation and other systems, with a focus on reliability and data quality.
  • Lead technical improvements on the roadmap, such as simplifying configuration, reducing technical debt, and modernizing parts of the application, and sequence that work so delivery keeps moving.
  • Write clean, high-quality, testable, secure, and maintainable code, and help strengthen our automated testing practices.
  • Build and operate in AWS using CI/CD and infrastructure as code, and troubleshoot production issues end to end across the application and infrastructure.
  • Meet FERPA, state student-privacy, and WCAG accessibility requirements as part of normal delivery.
  • Use AI-assisted development tools as a core part of how you work (planning, coding, testing, code review, and documentation) while checking everything they produce and standing behind every line you ship.
  • Help shape how the team uses AI in the development lifecycle, including shared conventions, reusable prompts and instructions, and guardrails for safe use.
  • Partner with Product Management to refine requirements, take part in backlog refinement and sprint planning, and turn specifications into scalable, secure implementations.
  • Mentor teammates through code review, pairing, and technical planning, and write clear documentation that helps others work confidently in the system.
  • Other duties as assigned.

Qualifications and Education Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 5+ years building and operating production web applications, including recent, hands-on Ruby on Rails experience (Ruby, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS).
  • Strong relational database skills (MySQL or similar): schema design, indexing, query performance, and safe migrations in a multi-tenant application.
  • Hands-on experience writing automated tests in Rails (for example, RSpec) at the unit and integration...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

Join Noma Security and help shape the future of AI security in a fast-paced, high-impact environment.

Noma is building the first comprehensive AI Security and Governance Platform, helping organizations adopt AI and LLMs with confidence and control. As AI becomes core to modern enterprises, we provide seamless visibility and protection across the entire AI lifecycle. Our team works at the intersection of AI, security, and cloud, shaping a new category in a rapidly evolving market. At Noma, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact while working with exceptional people on technology that truly matters.

We’re looking for a Talent Acquisition Partner to run full-cycle recruiting for Noma’s US go-to-market and G&A teams. You’ll partner directly with sales leaders and hiring managers to build pipelines, close top talent, and help scale Noma through the next phase of growth.

🛠️ What You’ll Do

  • Own full-cycle recruiting for US GTM and G&A roles across Sales, Sales Engineering, Channel, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and People, from intake through offer acceptance
  • Run hiring kickoffs that define the profile, align hiring managers on the bar, and set search strategy before sourcing starts
  • Build pipelines proactively by sourcing and engaging passive talent from leading cybersecurity, SaaS, and B2B enterprise tech companies
  • Manage multiple hiring managers and competing priorities at once, making clear tradeoff calls and keeping every stakeholder informed
  • Move searches quickly by holding candidates and hiring managers to tight timelines without lowering the bar
  • Deliver a clear, fast, and respectful candidate experience at every stage
  • Spot gaps in how we hire and propose fixes, from process improvements to new AI workflows, working with the People team across the US and Israel

✅ What You Bring

  • 3+ years of full-cycle recruiting experience in B2B enterprise SaaS
  • GTM recruiting experience is required
  • Proven ability to manage a heavy req load across multiple hiring managers at the same time
  • Strong hands-on sourcing skills, including Boolean search, referral mining, and creative outbound strategies
  • Everyday use of AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, etc.) in your recruiting workflow
  • Experience in a hypergrowth startup; a cybersecurity or AI-native background is a plus
  • Strong communication skills and comfort working asynchronously with a team based in Israel
  • Comfortable in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and speed matters

💙 Perks & Benefits

  • Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
  • Home office setup reimbursement
  • Short- and long-term disability insurance
  • Life and accident insurance
  • Unlimited paid time off (PTO) - We trust you to manage your time

What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

Reporting to the Senior Manager, Ad Operations, the Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Coordinator will support the analysis and optimization of customer journeys across our web and mobile platforms. This role combines marketing analytics, mobile attribution, and product analytics to identify conversion opportunities and improve business performance.

Working closely with Marketing, Product, Analytics, Engineering, CRM, and Promotions teams, you'll connect acquisition data with user behavior to understand how customers interact with our digital experiences, where they drop off, and what drives conversion.
We're looking for someone who understands marketing performance, has experience with mobile attribution platforms such as AppsFlyer, and can use product analytics tools to uncover actionable insights. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our Why At Dotmatics

At Dotmatics, a Siemens company, we believe science, data, and decision-making must be deeply intertwined for innovation to thrive. Our Portfolio includes Luma, LumaLab Connect, ELN Platform, Graphpad Prism, Geneious, SnapGene, Protein Metrics, OMIQ, FCS Express, LabArchives, NQuery, EasyPanel, SoftGenetics and Virscidian.

We have a vision for a new Lab of the Future that will change the future of scientific research.

We have created the world’s most comprehensive digital science platform – best-of-breed software applications already used by more than 2 million scientists, together in a single ecosystem united by a powerful, flexible enterprise data platform. This is not flat data buried away in digital graveyards. This is dynamic, multi-dimensional decision-making.

Scientific enterprises need a new level of effectiveness to achieve tomorrow’s breakthroughs. Illness will not wait. The biosphere will not wait. We are tireless in our vision, because the time for innovation is now.

Shaping the Future of Science At Dotmatics

Our global team of more than 800 colleagues are dedicated to supporting our customers in over 180 countries. Together, with our scientific community of users, we accelerate scientific innovation in order to make the world a healthier, cleaner, and safer place to live.

You’ll join a collaborative, global team pushing the boundaries of scientific innovation. Your ideas and efforts will have a tangible impact, accelerating scientific progress and discovery. We offer a dynamic, remote-friendly environment that fosters high integrity and collaboration, empowering you to excel. Dotmatics is a company built by scientists, for scientists. Combined, we are now the world’s largest cloud-based scientific research R&D platform. We need your help to keep growing and pioneering the future.

We are Science Driven. We are Customer Centric. We are Better Together.

What do we need

We are looking for a Customer Support Associate to join our Customer Success Group. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Veeva is the industry cloud for Life Sciences. We are enabling agentic biopharma through applications, agents, data, and consulting working together. Learn more about our products, vision, values, and status as a Public Benefit Corporation (PBC) on our website.
Consulting is changing, and Veeva Business Consulting is not like other firms. Launched in 2019, we’ve grown quickly and organically to over 500 global experts who combine deep industry knowledge and unique insights to accelerate drug development and commercialization for our customers.
We are growing aggressively and seeking great people to help Life Sciences work in a more efficient and connected way, shaping the future of the industry with the world’s leading AI applications, agents, and data at their back.

The Role

We are hiring high potential people who are early in their careers and want to pivot into Life Sciences Consulting through our Master Class Program.
Breaking into business consulting after starting your career down a different path can be hard. Designed as an alternative to earning an MBA, this program shapes experienced professionals into Business Consultants capable of making an impact for the Life Sciences industry.

Business Consulting spans five core practice areas: Analytics, Commercial, Content, R&D, and Quality. As a part of Master Class, you will align to one of those practices, allowing you to build targeted industry expertise. You will be asked to choose your preferred practice in the application process.
Early in the program, you will own key workstreams on customer-facing engagements within your practice, creating tailored solutions while collaborating with Veeva team members at all levels. You will be given the tools and resources to accelerate your consulting skills development.
If you’re graduating with an advanced degree, have 3-5 years of industry experience, or have served your country and are excited to pivot your career into consulting for a critical industry, Master Class is for you.
The anticipated start date is March 2027.

What You'll Do

  • Support and deliver all components of customer engagements (e.g., customer communications, workshops, stakeholder interviews, process and data analysis, managing timelines)
  • Collaborate with Business Consultants to create deliverables that optimize customer operating and engagement models, processes, and business performance
  • Leverage Veeva’s software and data to pull through tangible business and operational solutions

  • 3-5 years of experience from one of the following paths: Life Sciences industry or other non-consulting work experience; Advanced Degree (PhD, PharmD, MD); or Veteran/Military Service
  • Desire to work within an intense, challenging program and environment
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • A problem-solving mindset: anticipating issues early, analyzing, and proactively finding solutions
  • A process-driven person who loves digging into operations, numbers, and other data to find opportunities for improvement
  • High work ethic. Veeva is a hard-working company
  • High integrity and honesty. Veeva is a PBC and a “do the right thing” company, and we expect that from all employees
  • Willingness to travel up to 20% of your time per year. Travel varies per customer engagement, coworking, internal meetings, and events with your team

This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Job Title: Performance Test Engineer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]

Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually

Experience Required: 4+ years

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Performance Test Engineer to improve software quality through structured testing, automation, defect analysis, and release validation. Codekeeper is looking for a methodical and reliable Marketing Operations Specialist with a strong grasp of modern web marketing strategies and a clear talent for content creation and writing. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on working with structure, careful planning, and precision - yet enjoys a fast-paced environment where high-quality writing drives real impact.   • Address project-related issues promptly and come up with effective solutions

  • Make critical decisions to ensure project goals are achieved efficiently and effectively

Deliver Excellence

  • Ensure all marketing projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget

jobs.title: Founder's Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ActAI

There are over 5 billion users using basic applications today such email, notes, tasks, calendar and they're not AI-native. Our mission is to build proactive applications for anyone in the world, who are not used to complex prompting. We aim to bring intelligence to conversations, errands, organising and workflows, with minimal to no prompting.

Our first application is an agent-first mobile communication app. We believe building applications that users use daily for communication, coordination and collaboration needs will help integrate AI into their lives. The net effect is to eliminate misinformation, achieve low coordination costs, enable high quality tasks and collaboration at scale with minimal or little prompting.

 

About the Role

You will work closely with core teams on the highest impact initiatives across engineering, product, hiring, operations, and business development. As the company grows, you'll help solve new challenges, build new capabilities, and drive execution wherever it matters most.

We're looking for people who learn quickly, think deeply, and enjoy solving difficult problems in a fast-moving environment.

 

What You Will Be Doing

  • Drive high-priority initiatives across the business.

  • Work with leadership to solve business and product challenges.

  • Build new teams, processes, and capabilities as the company grows.

  • Lead cross-functional projects from planning through execution.

  • Research new markets, products, and business opportunities.

  • Improve how we operate by identifying problems and implementing practical solutions.

  • Take ownership of projects and deliver meaningful business outcomes.

 

What You Will Need

  • Strong problem-solving skills and business judgment.

  • Ability to learn quickly and adapt to new challenges.

  • Comfortable working across different business functions.

  • Strong ownership and execution skills.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-moving environment.

  • Curious, resourceful, and driven to build.

 

How We Work

The best products in the world are built by small, highly capable teams.

We operate with high talent density, high ownership and high standards. We value people who can think independently, move quickly and solve problems without waiting for instructions.

This is a hands-on environment. Everyone is expected to contribute directly to the company's success.

 

Interview Process

If there appears to be a fit, we will schedule up to 3 interviews.

jobs.title: Mobile Application Developer - AI Finance Agent
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for Mobile developer to build the native Android experience for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This role is for someone who cares about clean user flows, fast performance, product quality and shipping reliable mobile features used by real customers.

What You'll Own

  • Build and ship Android features using Kotlin.

  • Create clean mobile flows for insurance, payments, claims, renewals and financial services.

  • Work with product and design to simplify complex user journeys.

  • Integrate backend APIs and ensure mobile flows are stable, secure and reliable.

  • Improve app performance, crash rate, loading states, responsiveness and memory usage.

  • Use analytics, user behaviour and production issues to improve the product.

  • Build AI-assisted mobile experiences only where they genuinely improve the user journey.

What We're Looking For

  • 3+ years of Android development experience using Kotlin.

  • Strong Android fundamentals and experience shipping production apps.

  • Good knowledge of Jetpack, Coroutines, Flow and modern Android architecture.

  • Strong sense of mobile UX, usability, edge cases and user flows.

  • Experience integrating REST APIs and debugging production issues.

  • Fast execution, high ownership and strong attention to product quality.

  • App links, GitHub, screenshots or examples of shipped work are a strong advantage.

Tech Stack

  • Kotlin

  • Jetpack Compose

  • Android SDK

  • Coroutines & Flow

  • SQL / NoSQL

  • TensorFlow Lite (on-device inference)

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Thinks in user journeys, not just screens.

About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

The Role

We are looking for applied AI engineers to build AI-native systems for BJAK's AI Finance Agent.

This is not a research-only role. We need builders who can use AI to automate real workflows, improve products, reduce manual work and make financial services easier for users and teams.

What You'll Own

  • Build AI-powered workflows, assistants, agents and automation systems.

  • Apply AI across customer support, CRM, onboarding, claims, renewals, payments, operations and internal tools.

  • Work with product and engineering teams to turn manual processes into scalable AI-native systems.

  • Build integrations with LLMs, internal data, APIs, documents, knowledge bases and business systems.

  • Design evaluation, monitoring and fallback flows so AI outputs are useful, safe and reliable.

  • Prototype quickly, test with users or operators, then productionize what works.

  • Improve speed, quality and consistency across workflows using AI where it creates real business value.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong software engineering foundation, preferably with Python and backend systems.

  • Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs, agents, RAG, workflow automation or AI tools.

  • Able to connect AI systems with real product, data and operational workflows.

  • Good judgement on where AI helps and where rule-based systems or human review are better.

  • Understands evaluation, accuracy, latency, cost, privacy and failure modes.

  • Fast builder who can prototype, test and ship practical systems.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, support automation, CRM or operations automation is a strong advantage.

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Practical AI builder, not just a prompt experimenter.

  • Thinks in workflows, systems and measurable quality.

  • Can build quickly but still cares about guardrails and reliability.

jobs.title: Bilanzbuchhalter (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit, Stabilität und Transparenz im Herzen unserer Organisation.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die korrekte Buchführung und die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen in einem vielseitigen Unternehmensumfeld. Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle, begleitest steuerliche Prozesse und unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte.

In einem schlanken, dynamischen Team bringst du deine Sorgfalt, dein Fachwissen und deine Hands-on-Mentalität ein und trägst damit wesentlich zur finanziellen Steuerung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Organisation bei.

Über uns

Viessmann wurde 1917 gegründet und ist seit über einem Jahrhundert ein führendes Industrieunternehmen im Bereich Klimatechnologien. 2024 brachte das Familienunternehmen sein Climate Solutions Geschäft mit Carrier Global zusammen, um eine transatlantische Partnerschaft mit weltweit einzigartiger industrieller Reichweite zu schaffen. Die Viessmann Generations Group verkörpert seitdem die Weiterentwicklung hin zu einem globalen Ökosystem mit dem gemeinsamen Leitbild: Lebensräume für zukünftige Generationen zu gestalten.

Durch strategische Investments, Partnerschaften und philanthropisches Engagement unterstützt die Viessmann Generations Group Unternehmer:innen und Initiativen, die sich den zentralen Herausforderungen unserer Zeit stellen. Die thematischen Investitionsfelder reichen von der Vermeidung, Reduktion und Speicherung von Treibhausgasen über die Verbesserung von Luft- und Wasserqualität und Ernährungssicherheit bis hin zur Förderung von Gesundheit, Bildung, Wissenschaft und dem Schutz demokratischer Werten.

Der Viessmann Way beschreibt, wie wir arbeiten, führen und gemeinsam Wert schaffen – ob als Teammitglied, Unternehmer oder Partner in unserem Ökosystem. Der Viessmann Way ist kein Regelwerk, sondern ein Kompass: ein lebendiges Set an Prinzipien, geformt durch unternehmerisches Handeln und ausgerichtet auf unser langfristiges Leitbild.


Deine Chance

Diese Position bietet dir die Möglichkeit, deine Buchhaltungs- und Abschlussexpertise in ein werteorientiertes Umfeld einzubringen.

Als Bilanzbuchhalter:in (m/w/d) bei der Viessmann Generations Group übernimmst du Verantwortung für die sachgerechte Abbildung von Geschäftsvorfällen, die Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen und die Mitwirkung an internen Berichtsprozessen. Du arbeitest eng mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zusammen, bringst dein Fachwissen in steuerliche und treasury-bezogene Themen ein und sorgst für finanzielle Klarheit und Stabilität.

Bilanzierung & Jahresabschlüsse

  • Du erstellst Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB für mehrere Gesellschaften.

  • Du bewertest komplexe Geschäftsvorfälle und stellst eine korrekte buchhalterische Abbildung sicher.

  • Du wirkst bei der Optimierung von Bilanzierungs- und Reportingprozessen mit.

Finanzreporting & Steuern

  • Du unterstützt bei der Erstellung interner Finanzberichte sowie interner Reportings

  • Du kümmerst dich um umsatz- und ertragssteuerliche Fragestellungen und deren Umsetzung.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Bei GALVANY ist es unser Ziel, klimaneutrales Wohnen für alle zur Realität zu machen. Wir setzen auf Umsetzung und entwickeln konkrete, smarte Lösungen, indem wir Wärmepumpen, Batteriespeicher und Smart Metering einfach zugänglich, zuverlässig und bezahlbar machen.

Wir sind ein profitables Greentech-Startup und glauben, dass nachhaltiger Impact und langfristiges Wachstum nur auf Basis eines gesunden Geschäftsmodells möglich sind. Getrieben von Kundennutzen, Klarheit und Verantwortung stehen wir für hochwertige Heizlösungen und ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Menschen Verantwortung übernehmen und nachhaltigen Mehrwert schaffen.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) im Partner Sales unterstützt du unser Team bei der Betreuung unseres externen Vertriebsnetzwerks aus rund 300 aktiven Handelsvertretern, die unsere Wärmepumpen- und Energiesysteme direkt bei Hausbesitzenden vertreiben. Du hilfst dabei, eine hohe Beratungsqualität sicherzustellen, und trägst zu einem reibungslosen Übergang von Verkauf zu Umsetzung bei.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ansprechperson für unsere externen Handelsvertreter im Tagesgeschäft.

  • Prüfung eingehender Verträge auf Vollständigkeit, Plausibilität und technische Baubarkeit (z. B. Gebäudedaten, Objektfotos, Aufstellorte).

  • Statusverfolgung von Finanzierungen bei externen Partnern (z. B. Clover) sowie Datenpflege im CRM.

  • Tracking der Sales Performance des Vertriebsnetzwerks in Airtable und Unterstützung beim Reporting.

  • Mitorganisation von Events für externe Handelsvertreter.

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Operations, Installation und Finance.

Dein Profil

  • Immatrikulation in einem betriebswirtschaftlichen oder technischen Studiengang.

  • 20h pro Woche verfügbar.

  • Sicherer Umgang mit digitalen Tools, neue Software erlernst du schnell.

  • Fließende Deutschkenntnisse.

Zusätzlich sind uns folgende Fähigkeiten und Eigenschaften wichtig:

  • Reliable Executor: Du hältst Termine und Deadlines zuverlässig ein und lieferst gleichbleibend hohe Qualität ab.

  • Technical Understanding: Du verstehst bautechnische Zusammenhänge schnell und überträgst sie präzise in unser Feinplanungstool.

  • Customer-Facing Communicator: Du trittst Kund:innen gegenüber freundlich und kompetent auf und schaffst auch im Online-Termin eine vertrauensvolle Atmosphäre.

  • Adaptive Problem Solver: Du denkst mit, behältst auch in unklaren Situationen den Überblick und suchst pragmatisch nach Lösungen, statt bei Hindernissen stehen zu bleiben.

Benefits:

  • Werde Teil eines schnell wachsenden und profitablen Climate-Tech-Startups

  • Attraktive und wettbewerbsfähige Vergütung

  • Unser lebendiges Office ist das Herz unserer Kultur und fördert Zusammenarbeit und Austausch vor Ort

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineering Team Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About pplwise

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

About our client: Filics

Filics is reinventing intralogistics with autonomous mobile robots (AMRs) that change how material moves. Its double-runner system makes Filics the first and only AMR that can drive through load carriers such as Euro pallets. This breaks with forklift logic and sets a new standard for efficiency. Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. As Senior Mechanical Design Engineer (m/f/d) at Filics, you will lead the mechanical design of the robots as they move from prototype to series production.

About the role

This is an on-site/hybrid role in Munich, close to engineering and assembly.

Filics builds its own robot hardware in-house: mechanics, electronics and software. Orders are growing, and the robots are moving from prototypes to series production. Designs that worked in the lab now need to be built reliably, at scale and at the right cost. The hardest problems often sit between disciplines: parts that work on their own can fail once they're assembled with the electronics.

The mechanical team has four engineers, most of them at the start of their careers, and they need someone who guides them every day. You'll be the technical lead for the mechanical side of the product and the counterpart to the electronics lead, so the current mechanical manager can focus on core R&D. Your time splits roughly evenly between hands-on engineering and technical leadership. You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

You'll work closely with Electronics, Production, Procurement and the CTO, and you'll set the engineering habits while the team is still small.

What you'll do

  • Mentor the mechanical engineers day to day: help them make design decisions, set methods and keep projects focused

  • Design parts and assemblies in CAD, including tolerancing, and check every design for manufacturability and cost before it goes out

  • Lead testing and integration of mechanics and electronics, and solve the problems that only show once everything is assembled

  • Prioritise incoming work, follow up on progress and make the day-to-day technical calls on the mechanical side

  • Make the gated design process work in practice and run design reviews (safety, mechanics, electronics, manufacturability) before parts are integrated

  • Put design for manufacturing and design for cost in place: fewer, standardised parts and production methods that scale

  • Work with the electronics owner of each robot module from the first prototype on, and with Production on manufacturability and production jigs

  • Build and iterate prototypes based on customer and field feedback

About you

  • Several years of hands-on mechanical design in R&D at a company that develops and builds its own electromechanical products (e.g. power tools, home appliances, e-mobility, production machines, robotics, marine propulsion)

jobs.title: Büromanager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über pplwise
pplwise ist eine Recruiting-Beratung für schnell wachsende Technologieunternehmen in ganz Europa. Mit Recruiting as a Service und Executive Search besetzen wir Schlüsselpositionen für unsere Kunden, von Start-ups bis zu börsennotierten Unternehmen. Diese Position besetzen wir für unseren Kunden Filics.

Über unseren Kunden: Filics
Filics erfindet die Intralogistik neu, mit autonomen mobilen Robotern (AMRs), die verändern, wie Material bewegt wird. Dank seines Double-Runner-Systems ist Filics der erste und einzige AMR, der durch Ladungsträger wie Europaletten hindurchfahren kann. Damit bricht Filics mit der Logik des Gabelstaplers und setzt einen neuen Standard für Effizienz. Filics ist ein kleines, anpackendes Team, das schwierige Probleme mit technischer Exzellenz löst. Verantwortung übernimmt, wer Initiative zeigt und zuverlässig liefert. Als Office Manager (m/w/d) bei Filics machst du das Münchner Büro zu einem Ort, an dem das ganze Team seine beste Arbeit leisten kann.

Über die Rolle
Die Stelle ist vor Ort im Filics-Büro in München, wo Engineering, Montage und das restliche Team Seite an Seite arbeiten.

Im Büro kommt das gesamte Filics-Team zusammen. Mit dem Wachstum des Unternehmens braucht es jemanden, der dafür sorgt, dass jeden Tag alles reibungslos läuft, und der es zu einem Ort macht, an dem man gerne arbeitet. Du übernimmst das Büro komplett in Eigenverantwortung: Du etablierst Abläufe, planst Verbesserungen und sorgst dafür, dass einfach alles funktioniert. Du berichtest an den VP Operations, arbeitest eng mit HR zusammen und bist erste Ansprechperson für das Team, Gäste und Dienstleister.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest den täglichen Büroablauf und etablierst Routinen, die für einen reibungslosen Betrieb sorgen

  • Du planst Verbesserungen im Büro und setzt sie um, während das Team wächst

  • Du steuerst die Zusammenarbeit mit Vermieter, Facility Management und externen Dienstleistern

  • Du behältst den Bestand an Büromaterial im Blick und bestellst, was das Team braucht

  • Du empfängst Gäste, Bewerbende und Partner im Büro

  • Du koordinierst die ein- und ausgehende Post sowie Pakete des Büros

  • Du unterstützt HR bei der Planung von Meetings und Vorstellungsgesprächen und organisierst Reisen und Transfers für Bewerbende und Gäste

  • Du bereitest das Onboarding neuer Teammitglieder vor Ort vor, z. B. Arbeitsplatz, Schlüssel und Ausstattung

  • Du organisierst Office-Aktivitäten und Team-Events, die das Team zusammenbringen

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung im Office Management oder in der Administration, idealerweise in einem Start-up oder wachsenden Unternehmen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Office

  • Fließendes Deutsch und Englisch in Wort und Schrift

  • Starke Kommunikationsfähigkeit: Du gibst Informationen klar und auf den Punkt weiter

  • Du behältst viele Aufgaben gleichzeitig im Blick und setzt die richtigen Prioritäten

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung und packst an, was zu tun ist, ohne darauf zu warten, dass dich jemand fragt

  • Eine freundliche, positive und offene Art

pplwise is a recruiting consultancy for fast-growing technology companies across Europe. Through Recruiting as a Service and Executive Search, we fill key roles for our clients, from start-ups to publicly listed companies. We are filling this position for our client Filics.

Filics is a small, hands-on team that solves hard problems with engineering excellence. Leadership goes to those who take initiative and consistently deliver. This is an on-site role at the Filics office in Munich, where engineering, assembly and the rest of the team work side by side.

The office is where the whole Filics team comes together. As the company grows, it needs someone who makes it run smoothly every day and shapes it into a place people enjoy working in. You'll own the office fully: you set up the routines, plan the improvements and make sure everything just works. You report to the VP Operations, work closely with HR, and are the first point of contact for the team, visitors and service providers.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us 

Hawk is the leading provider of AI-supported anti-money laundering and fraud detection technology. Banks and payment providers globally are using Hawk’s powerful combination of traditional rules and explainable AI to improve the effectiveness of their AML compliance and fraud prevention by identifying more crime while maximizing efficiency by reducing false positives. With our solution, we are playing a vital role in the global fight against Money Laundering, Fraud, or the financing of terrorism. We offer a culture of mutual trust, support and passion – while providing individuals with opportunities to grow professionally and make a difference in the world. 

Your Mission
As Support Analyst, you will serve as the frontline technical and functional expert for customers using the Hawk platform, ensuring a seamless user experience. You will provide expert guidance on rule configuration, user management, workflows, and integration troubleshooting via our ticketing system while collaborating with internal teams to resolve complex issues. We are seeking a proactive problem solver, who can communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders fluently in German and English and ensure high customer satisfaction.

Your Responsibilities

  • Provide timely, high-quality support for customers via our ticketing system, assisting with rule configuration, user management, workflow optimization, and integrations.

  • Troubleshoot rule behaviour and configuration issues and investigate why alerts trigger (or don’t) and identifying root causes across data, configuration, and platform behaviour.

  • Diagnose, prioritize, and resolve system errors, collaborating with engineers and product teams to identify root causes and implement fixes.

  • Notify customers of incidents, document root cause analyses in collaboration with engineers, and ensure clear communication throughout the resolution process.

  • Work closely with internal teams to resolve complex issues, escalate critical cases, and relay customer feedback for product improvements.

  • Participate professionally in international video conference calls, providing clear, concise explanations of technical issues and solutions to a diverse customer base.

  • Develop comprehensive documentation for both technical and non-technical users, ensuring clarity in troubleshooting steps, platform functionality, and best practices.

  • Apply your understanding of Fraud Prevention, Compliance, and/or Payments Processing to guide customers effectively in a highly regulated and complex environment.

Your Profile

  • 3+ years of experience in technical support, application support, or a customer-facing technical role.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant – Healthcare Data & Strategy (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Statista, we’re all about facts and data, for we are the world's leading business data platform. By providing reliable and easy-to-use data as well as various data analytics products and services, we empower people worldwide to make fact-based decisions.

Founded in Hamburg in 2007, we have quickly grown into a global company with offices in major cities such as London, New York, Berlin and Tokyo. And we still have a lot of plans. Our constant growth does not only prove our success, but also keeps creating new development and career opportunities for our employees.

We value and celebrate our diverse culture. You are welcome here for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or whether you prefer bar graphs to pie charts. Your story matters – keep writing it as part of our team.

Are you ready to join us?

About Statista Healthcare
Statista Healthcare is a vertical business unit of Statista, focused on making healthcare quality transparent, measurable, and comparable across countries, care settings, and specialties. We work with leading healthcare stakeholders worldwide to support data-driven quality measurement and transformation by combining in-depth analytical expertise with scalable technology and communication power.

Our offerings span international rankings, ratings, benchmarking studies, and customized consulting projects. Our global healthcare rankings and hospital rating is published in collaboration with our trusted media partner Newsweek, enabling high visibility and credibility across markets.

We help healthcare organizations define relevant key performance indicators, validate and harmonize data structures, and translate insights into actionable strategies. At the heart of our approach is a data driven understanding of healthcare quality, grounded in robust methodologies, global comparability, and stakeholder trust.

In our consulting projects, we support healthcare providers and systems in developing tailored KPI frameworks, standardizing and validating data processes, and deriving actionable insights that enable measurable improvements in patient care and system-level performance. We combine structured methodologies with hands-on delivery to unlock the full value of healthcare quality data.

Your Role
As a (Senior) Consultant, you will play a central role in the delivery of international benchmarking and healthcare data consulting projects. You will lead workstreams, shape methodologies, and take ownership of client deliverables. In addition, you will actively support the development of high-impact proposals and pitch documents for prospective clients.

You will collaborate closely with internal teams, particularly the Data Science and Analysis teams, to ensure scalable, high-quality solutions for our clients. The position offers a clear development path toward leadership responsibilities within Statista Healthcare.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and deliver workstreams within international healthcare benchmarking and transformation projects

  • Co-develop project methodologies, KPI frameworks, and scoring logic in close coordination with the Analysis and Data Science teams

  • Actively contribute to pitch preparation, proposal development, and acquisition processes

jobs.title: Senior Kreditorenbuchhalter (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. Durch die Bereitstellung verlässlicher und einfach nutzbarer Daten sowie verschiedener Datenanalyseprodukte und -dienstleistungen unterstützen wir Menschen weltweit, faktenbasierte Entscheidungen zu treffen.

2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.

Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Deine Geschichte ist wichtig – schreibe sie weiterhin als Teil unseres Teams. Überzeuge dich selbst und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Dein Job

'• Kreditorenbuchhaltung im Tagesgeschäft: Du bearbeitest Eingangsrechnungen und klärst Abweichungen und offene Posten eigenständig. Auch bei hohem Volumen sorgst du für zügige Bearbeitung und verlässlich hohe Qualität.

• Verantwortung für den Prozess: Du behältst den gesamten Purchase-to-Pay-Prozess (P2P) im Blick – von Bestellung über Wareneingang und Rechnungsprüfung bis zur Zahlung – und arbeitest eng mit den beteiligten Teams zusammen.

• Abschlüsse und Abstimmungen: Du stimmst Kreditorenkonten ab, bearbeitest Klärfälle und lieferst belastbare Beiträge zu den Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen.

• Prozessverbesserung und Projekte: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe über Teamgrenzen hinweg, identifizierst Engpässe und setzt Verbesserungen gemeinsam mit den relevanten Schnittstellen um.

• Automatisierung und KI: Du prüfst, wo Automatisierung und KI die Bearbeitung sinnvoll unterstützen können, und gestaltest Lösungen mit, die Effizienz und Qualität verbessern – mit angemessenen Kontrollen und fachlicher Prüfung.

Dein Profil

'• Fundierte Praxis in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung: Du beherrschst das operative Geschäft sicher, priorisierst auch bei hohem Belegaufkommen gut und lieferst eigenständig präzise Ergebnisse.

• End-to-End-Verständnis: Du kennst die wesentlichen Teilbereiche des P2P-Prozesses aus der Praxis und hast bereits Projekte zur Analyse oder Verbesserung bereichsübergreifender Abläufe begleitet.

• SAP-Erfahrung: Du hast in der Kreditorenbuchhaltung mit SAP gearbeitet; Erfahrung mit SAP S/4HANA ist besonders willkommen.

• Gestaltungswille: Du hinterfragst Routinen konstruktiv, denkst über die eigene Aufgabe hinaus und setzt Verbesserungen pragmatisch um.

• Offenheit für neue Technologien: Du interessierst dich dafür, wie Automatisierung und KI Kreditorenprozesse verbessern können. Spezifische KI-Toolkenntnisse setzen wir nicht voraus.

• Sprachen: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Was wir bieten

Neben unserem großartigen Team, unserer Unternehmenskultur und dem gemeinsamen Ziel, Menschen mit Daten zu empowern, gibt es viele weitere Gründe, warum Statista ein großartiger Arbeitsplatz ist! Werde Teil unseres Teams und profitiere von folgenden Vorteilen:

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About BoWatt

BoWatt is building AI agents for requirements and systems engineering in manufacturing. We help the teams engineering cars, planes, rockets, factories, chips, and medical devices tackle complex engineering work with software.

We bootstrapped to €500k+ ARR before raising our first round. Our investors include Atlantic Foodlabs, Buildery (CDTM affiliates), and Prequel Ventures, alongside angels from Cohere and Luminovo.

Now we’re looking for an ambitious Account Executive to turn customer interest into closed deals.

The role

You want to become exceptional at selling. You’re early in your sales career, but you’ve already shown that you learn fast, create opportunities, and take ownership of results.

At BoWatt, you’ll own your pipeline from first conversation to signed customer. You’ll sell a technical product to manufacturing companies across DACH, learn directly from our CEO, and help turn what works into a repeatable sales process.

This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, not a sales-management position. You don’t need to have built a sales team. You do need the drive and judgement to move deals forward without waiting for a finished playbook.

What you’ll do

  • Build pipeline through targeted outbound, alongside leads generated with BDR support.

  • Run discovery with engineering and business stakeholders to understand their workflows, pain points, and buying process.

  • Deliver tailored product demos and build a clear business case for BoWatt.

  • Own opportunities through qualification, pilot discussions, negotiation, and close.

  • Keep your CRM and forecasts accurate, with clear next steps for every opportunity.

  • Bring customer feedback to the product team and help improve our messaging, demos, and sales process.

What you bring

  • Early experience in B2B software or technical sales. You may already be closing deals as an AE, or be a standout SDR/BDR ready to take on the full sales cycle.

  • Evidence that you perform: targets exceeded, pipeline you created, deals you helped win, rapid progression, or a business you built yourself. We care more about what you’ve done than your title or years of experience.

  • The curiosity to understand a technical product and explain its value clearly. Manufacturing experience helps, but isn’t required.

  • Strong communication: you ask good questions, listen carefully, and make the next step clear.

  • Resilience and initiative. You follow up, handle rejection, and find ways to make progress.

  • Fluent German and professional English, our internal working language.

  • Willingness to work from our Munich office four days per week.

What we offer

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission.

  • Meaningful equity

  • Close collaboration with the CEO and hands-on onboarding into our product, customers, and industry.

jobs.title: Senior Buchhalter (m/w/x)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Finanzbereichs suchen wir Dich als erfahrenen Senior Buchhalter (m/w/d), der nicht nur fachlich sicher im Rechnungswesen ist, sondern auch mit einer ausgeprägten Hands-on-Mentalität aktiv im Tagesgeschäft mitarbeitet. Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung in der operativen Buchhaltung und bringst Dein Know-how in die Weiterentwicklung von Prozessen und Abläufen ein. Perspektivisch ist vorgesehen, dass Du im nächsten Schritt die fachliche Verantwortung für unser dreiköpfiges Team im Rechnungswesen übernimmst und damit eine wichtige Schlüsselrolle in unserem Finanzbereich einnimmst.


  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung der laufenden Finanzbuchhaltung nach HGB, insbesondere in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

  • Mitarbeit bei der termingerechten Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB

  • Durchführung von Kontenabstimmungen sowie Klärung und Buchung von Sachverhalten im Hauptbuch

  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Auswertungen, Reports und betriebswirtschaftlichen Analysen für die Geschäftsführung und Fachbereiche

  • Mitwirkung bei der Liquiditätsplanung sowie Unterstützung im Zahlungsverkehr und Mahnwesen

  • Sicherstellung einer ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung unter Einhaltung gesetzlicher, steuerlicher und interner Vorgaben

  • Ansprechpartner für buchhalterische Fragestellungen innerhalb des Unternehmens sowie für Steuerberater, Wirtschaftsprüfer und externe Dienstleister

  • Mitwirkung bei steuerlich relevanten Themen, insbesondere im Bereich Umsatzsteuer, in Abstimmung mit externen Beratern

  • Unterstützung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von buchhalterischen Prozessen, Richtlinien und internen Kontrollen

  • Mitarbeit an Projekten im Finanzbereich, z. B. bei der Digitalisierung, ERP-Weiterentwicklung oder der Optimierung von Reporting-Strukturen

  • Je nach Teamstruktur fachliche Unterstützung und Anleitung von Kolleginnen und Kollegen im Rechnungswesen

Fachliche Anforderungen: 

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung zum Bilanzbuchhalter (IHK) oder abgeschlossenes betriebswirtschaftliches Studium mit Schwerpunkt Rechnungswesen/Finanzen oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung, idealerweise in einem mittelständischen Unternehmen

  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse im HGB sowie fundierte Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Monats-, Quartals- und Jahresabschlüssen

  • Gute Kenntnisse in den Bereichen Debitoren-, Kreditoren-, Anlagen- und Hauptbuchhaltung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit ERP-Systemen, idealerweise SAP R/3, sowie sehr gute MS-Excel-Kenntnisse; Erfahrung mit BI-Tools von Vorteil

  • Gute Kenntnisse in umsatzsteuerlichen Fragestellungen; weitere steuerliche Kenntnisse von Vorteil

  • Strukturierte, sorgfältige und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise sowie ein hohes Maß an Zuverlässigkeit

  • Hands-on-Mentalität und Freude an der operativen Mitarbeit im Tagesgeschäft

  • Analytisches Denkvermögen sowie Affinität zu Zahlen, Prozessen und Systemen

  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift; Englischkenntnisse von Vorteil

jobs.title: Integration Specialist – Electronic Data Interchange (EDI)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We Want You to Grow With Us 

We are strengthening our EDI integration capabilities at Intersnack IT. As our next Integration Specialist – EDI, you will bring your experience in electronic data interchange and your understanding of business processes to support reliable transactions between our business units, trading partners and applications.

Your knowledge of Order to Cash (O2C) and Source to Pay (S2P) will help you translate business requirements into effective integration solutions. Based in Düsseldorf, you will work closely with our Application Service Delivery & Support and Business Transformation teams, business stakeholders and external EDI providers, supporting both daily operations and international ERP initiatives.

What We Can Offer 

This position combines hands-on EDI development with responsibility for integrations that support our supply chain. You will apply your business process knowledge to practical technical solutions and contribute to global ERP initiatives and local EDI rollouts.

If you bring strong EDI expertise and experience with O2C and S2P processes, we can support your onboarding into the Infor M3 integration stack. You will build on your existing knowledge while becoming familiar with our applications, mapping tools and integration environment.

You will join a supportive, international IT team, working alongside colleagues and specialist providers with opportunities to deepen your expertise in integration delivery and EDI operations.

How You Will Spend Your Time as Our Next Integration Specialist – EDI 

You will connect business requirements with the technical delivery and operation of EDI integrations. Your work will span document mapping, integration configuration, rollout support and daily troubleshooting, helping ensure that transactions are processed reliably across our Infor applications and external EDI networks.

What You Will Do 

  • Translate business requirements and trading partner specifications into practical EDI solutions, supporting document flows across Order to Cash, Logistics and Source to Pay.

  • Create and maintain complex document mappings, transforming partner messages into standard XML formats and vice versa.

  • Develop, configure and maintain EDI integrations across Infor M3, Infor ION, Infor OS and Infor Enterprise Collaborator (IEC/MEC).

  • Define and maintain mapping standards, data validation rules and interface specifications, supported by clear functional and technical documentation.

jobs.title: Werkstudent (M/W/D)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Was wir tun

Als IoT-Pioniere entwickeln wir mit mittlerweile über 50 Kolleginnen und Kollegen an drei Standorten IoT-Komplettlösungen für unsere Kunden. Aktuell sind weltweit über 750.000 Geräte und Anlagen mit unseren Lösungen für Machine-to-Machine-Kommunikation ausgestattet. Unsere Kompetenz liegt in der Entwicklung kundenspezifischer IoT-Lösungen, basierend auf unserer Erfahrung, unseren erprobten Software-Bausteinen und einer Vielzahl von bereits realisierten Projekten.

Unser Team

Seit der Firmengründung im Jahr 2004 sind wir stetig gewachsen und haben uns in diesem Markt über die Jahre als starker Partner der Industrie etabliert. Damit das auch so bleibt, erweitern wir kontinuierlich unser Team mit talentierten und qualifizierten Entwickler*innen. Durch vielseitige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Teilnahme an Konferenzen und Workshops sowie eine ausgeprägte Feedback-Kultur heben wir unser Team auf die nächste Stufe.


Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt Werkstudenten an den Standorten

BISSENDORF bei Osnabrück), GARBSEN (bei Hannover)und BERLIN


Einstieg als Werkstudent*In

Werkstudent*innen arbeiten neben ihrem Studium in einem Unternehmen. Wenn Du Informatik oder ein ähnliches Studium absolvierst und gerne Software programmierst – könntest Du zu uns passen.

Als Werkstudent*in wirst Du bei uns voll in die Arbeitsprozesse integriert, lernst strategisch zu denken, zu präsentieren, Projekte zu managen, eignest Dir Soft Skills an, wie den Umgang mit Kollegen*innen, Verhalten bei Stress und Kritikfähigkeit.

Der Status als Werkstudent*in sorgt dafür, dass Du mehr Geld von Deinem Job behältst, denn als Werkstudent*in musst du keine Beiträge zur Kranken-, Pflege- und Arbeitslosenversicherung bezahlen.

ES MÜSSEN VOR ALLEM ZWEI VORAUSSETZUNGEN ERFÜLLT SEIN, DAMIT DU ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN ANGEMELDET WERDEN KANNST UND VOM WERKSTUDENT*INNEN-PRIVILEG PROFITIERST:

  • Du musst in einem Vollzeitstudium immatrikuliert sein (nicht im Urlaubssemester).

  • Du darfst maximal 20 Stunden pro Woche arbeiten (in der vorlesungsfreien Zeit ist mehr möglich).

Du bist neugierig auf das Berufsleben? Wir laden Dich ein, Teil unseres Teams zu werden!


DEIN AUFGABENGEBIET ALS WERKSTUDENT*IN

  • Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Anwendungen im M2M / IoT-Umfeld.

    • mit Java oder C/C++ auf embedded Linuxsystemen

    • oder mit Java in der Backend-Entwicklung

    • oder mit JavaScript in der Frontend-Entwicklung.

  • Du nimmst an Schulungen teil und bildest dich eigenständig weiter.

  • Du entwickelst Software im Team mit Tools wie GitLab, Maven, Node, JIRA, Confluence, u.a.

  • Du unterstützt unsere Kunden bei laufenden Projekten.

DEIN PROFIL

  • Du hast bereits Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung gesammelt.

  • Du bist wissbegierig und neue Technologien begeistern dich.

  • Deine Freunde bezeichnen Dich als Nerd und das ist OK für dich.

  • Du 'bastelst' gerne und hast Spaß daran mit Technologien Probleme des Alltags zu lösen.

  • Du bist zuverlässig und arbeitest gewissenhaft.

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team

  • Für dich ist geteiltes Wissen verdoppeltes Wissen.

Wenn Du dich da wieder findest, kannst Du bei uns sicher einen Job finden, der Dich fachlich und Menschlich weiterbringt und dir dein Studium finanziell versüßt.

Wir sind bestrebt unsere Werkstudent*innen auch nach dem Studim zu halten und freuen uns über alle studierenden, dessen Vertrag in einen festen Arbeitsvertrag übergeht.

jobs.title: Werkstudent/in Human Resource (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Aufgaben:

  • Unterstützung des HR-Teams im operativen Tagesgeschäft

  • Mitarbeit im Recruiting und Bewerbermanagement

  • Unterstützung bei Personalentwicklungs- und Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen

  • Erstellung von Auswertungen, Präsentationen und Reports

  • Pflege von Mitarbeiterdaten und Personalakten

  • Mitarbeit bei HR-Projekten auf nationaler und internationaler Ebene

  • Kommunikation mit Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften

Das bringst Du mit:

  • Laufendes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Recht, Psychologie, Personalmanagement oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs

  • Interesse an Personalthemen und organisatorischen Aufgaben

  • Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Gute MS-Office-Kenntnisse, insbesondere Excel und PowerPoint

  • Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Teamorientierung und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Bereichen und Menschen

Das bieten wir:

  • Eine abwechslungsreiche Werkstudententätigkeit mit mind. 12 Stunden pro Woche, max. 20 Stunden pro Woche.

  • Praxisnahe Einblicke in moderne Personalarbeit

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten passend zum Studium

  • Ein kollegiales und wertschätzendes Arbeitsumfeld

  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und spannende Projekte

  • Möglichkeit zur persönlichen und fachlichen Weiterentwicklung

  • Ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit spannenden Einblicken über den eigenen Aufgabenbereich hinaus

jobs.title: Baustellenkoordinator / Arbeitsvorbereiter (m/w/d) in der Kampfmittelräumung / Tiefbau
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir, die Tauber Unternehmensgruppe, wachsen weiter. Suchst du ein spannendes und familiäres Arbeitsumfeld? Dann bist du bei uns in der Kampfmittelräumung genau richtig.
Seit 1964 gibt es das familiengeführte Unternehmen TAUBER, bei dem über 650 Mitarbeitende in den Segmenten Kampfmittelräumung und Systemtiefbau tätig sind. In der Kampfmittelräumung bietet TAUBER alle Dienstleistungen von der Luftbildauswertung über die geophysikalische Untergrunddetektion bis hin zur Bergung, Entschärfung und auch Vernichtung von Munition an und ist somit in diesem Segment der Komplettanbieter.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams in Hamburg suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Baustellenkoordinator / Arbeitsvorbereiter (m/w/d) in der Kampfmittelräumung und dem Tiefbau.

Lass uns gemeinsam durchstarten und werde Teil unserer Erfolgsgeschichte!

Aufgaben

  • Projekt- bzw. Konzeptentwicklung unserer Bauvorhaben
  • Planung, Projektsteuerung und Leitung von Bauprojekten
  • Ausarbeitung von Antragsunterlagen und deren Einreichung bei den Genehmigungsbehörden
  • Koordination des Personals, Materialien und Maschinen
  • Führung und Einsatzplanung des Teams vor Ort
  • Überwachung von Terminplänen und Kostenvorgaben
  • Abstimmung der Maßnahmen und Einsätze mit dem Auftraggeber

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene kaufmännische oder technische Ausbildung oder ein kaufmännisches oder technisches Studium
  • Erfahrung in der Kampfmittelräumung und Projektleitung wünschenswert
  • gute EDV-Kenntnisse (MS-Office)
  • gute Organisations- und Teamfähigkeit
  • ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit, sicheres, zielorientiertes Auftreten mit Überzeugungskraft
  • Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift
  • Führerscheinklasse B wünschenswert

Benefits

  • Vollzeitstelle in einem erfolgreichen Traditionsunternehmen
  • 30 Tage Urlaub
  • ein attraktives Gehaltspaket mit Vermögenswirksamer Leistungen (VL) sowie die betriebliche Altersvorsorge
  • intensive qualifizierte Einarbeitung in angenehmer Arbeitsatmosphäre
  • exzellente berufliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten in einer stark wachsenden Unternehmensgruppe
  • flache Hierarchien sowie faires, kooperatives Miteinander
  • Firmenwagen
  • JOBRAD
  • Gesund bleiben: Kleiner Eigenbeitrag, große Auswahl – Zugang zu über 13.500 Fitness- und Wellnessangeboten
  • Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen durch die TAUBER Akademie (individuelle interne und externe Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten)

Verpasse nicht deine Chance, einzigartige und technisch anspruchsvolle Projekte bei uns zu erleben und mitzugestalten.
