jobs.title: Founder's Associate
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Intro

Die Bauindustrie verliert jährlich 1,6 Billionen USD durch Ineffizienzen. Einer der Hauptgründe: Dieselben Fehler wiederholen sich immer wieder, weil entscheidende Informationen noch immer in Papierdokumenten und unstrukturierten Dateien verborgen sind.

Genau hier setzt alago an. Wir sind ein Team von elf Personen und entwickeln KI-gestütztes Projektmanagement für die Baubranche. Bereits heute vertrauen uns mehr als 15 Kunden. Unsere Vision ist es, Risiken in Bauprojekten frühzeitig sichtbar zu machen – damit Großprojekte nicht mehr Jahrzehnte dauern oder scheitern.

Wir haben letztes Jahr eine Pre-Seed-Finanzierung von über 1 Mio. € von führenden VCs der Baubranche sowie einem der größten Projektentwickler Deutschlands abgeschlossen.

75 % der Infrastruktur, die im Jahr 2050 existieren wird, ist heute noch nicht gebaut.

Tasks

In dieser Rolle baust du die Maschine, während wir sie skalieren. Du sitzt im Zentrum der Firma, bekommst direkten Zugang zu Produkt, Kunden und Foundern – und trägst ab Tag eins echte Verantwortung.

🧱 Operational Backbone (≈ 1/3)

Du sorgst dafür, dass die Firma rund läuft und sauber mitwächst:

  • Hiring – Du unterstützt den gesamten Recruiting-Prozess: Stellenanzeigen, Sourcing, Pipeline-Pflege, Terminkoordination und Kandidaten-Kommunikation.

  • Operations – Du hältst unsere internen Abläufe, Tools und Dokumentation in Ordnung und schließt die Lücken, die im Alltag auffallen.

  • Datenschutz & Compliance – Du unterstützt bei Datenschutzthemen: Kundenanfragen und Fragebögen vorbereiten, Dokumente und Verzeichnisse aktuell halten, Fristen im Blick behalten.

  • Produkt-Setups – Du richtest neue Kundenprojekte im Produkt ein, bereitest Projektdaten auf und stellst sicher, dass alles startklar ist.

  • AI-Setup der Company – Du hilfst, unsere internen KI-Workflows aufzubauen und zu pflegen, damit jedes Team mit den besten Tools und Automatisierungen arbeitet.

🚤 Speedboats (≈ 2/3)

Du übernimmst schnelle, eigenständige Projekte, die direkt auf Wachstum einzahlen – zum Beispiel:

  • Interne Prozesse mit Notion, Zapier oder n8n automatisieren

  • Go-to-Market-Experimente aufsetzen und neue Kundensegmente testen

  • Kunden-Discovery vorbereiten und Erkenntnisse verdichten

  • Bei Pricing-Fragen und strategischen Analysen zuarbeiten

Diese Rolle passt zu jemandem, der unternehmerisch denkt, mit Unsicherheit gut umgehen kann und eine Firma an der Schnittstelle von KI und echter Welt mitbauen will.

Requirements

Rahmen

  • Du bist eingeschriebene:r Student:in oder absolvierst ein Pflicht-/freiwilliges Praktikum – idealerweise für mindestens 4–6 Monate, Vollzeit

  • Standort München oder Bereitschaft, für die Dauer des Praktikums von hier aus zu arbeiten

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprach-Niveau und sicheres Englisch

jobs.title: Risk Manger (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über GENO Broker

Wir entwickeln das Wertpapiergeschäft der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe weiter und schaffen ein neues digitales Neo-Brokerage-Angebot. Es richtet sich gezielt an junge, digital-affine Zielgruppen, die wir für unsere Finanzgruppe gewinnen wollen. Unser Ziel ist es, mit einem zukunftsweisenden Mobile-First-Angebot, bestehend aus einer leistungsstarken Brokerage-App, einem unverwechselbaren Marktauftritt mit erstklassigem Service und nahtlosem Zugang zu persönlicher Beratung unserer Primärbanken eine starke Antwort auf den sich wandelnden Brokerage-Markt zu geben. Dabei vereinen wir die Dynamik eines Start-ups mit der Stärke der Genossenschaftlichen FinanzGruppe.

Bei uns hast Du die einzigartige Chance, ein innovatives Angebot von Anfang an aktiv mitzugestalten – von der Markenentwicklung über die User Experience bis zum Produktdesign. Flache Hierarchien und agilen Arbeitsweisen erlauben dir schnell Verantwortung zu übernehmen und echten Impact zu schaffen.

Aufgaben

Als Risk Manager verantwortest Du den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung des Risikomanagements von ZuWachs mit. Du stellst sicher, dass finanzielle, operationelle und regulatorische Risiken frühzeitig erkannt, bewertet und gesteuert werden.

  • Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung des unternehmensweiten Risikomanagement-Frameworks

  • Identifikation, Bewertung und laufende Überwachung wesentlicher Risiken, insbesondere Geschäfts-, operationeller, Liquiditäts-, IKT-, Compliance- und Reputationsrisiken

  • Weiterentwicklung der Risikostrategie, des Risikosteuerungshandbuchs, der Risikoanalysen und Stresstests, des Limitsystems sowie geeigneter Maßnahmen zur Risikosteuerung

  • Erstellung von Risikoanalysen, Reports und Entscheidungsvorlagen sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Führungskräften und Wirtschaftsprüfern

Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Risikomanagement eines Brokers, Finanzdienstleisters, FinTechs oder einer Bank gesammelt

  • Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse regulatorischer Anforderungen im Wertpapier- und Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld, z. B. ICAAP / ILAAP, MaRisk oder DORA

  • Du hast Erfahrung im Aufbau und in der Weiterentwicklung von Risikomanagement-Prozessen

  • Du kommunizierst klar und souverän mit Management, Fachbereichen, Kontrollfunktionen und Wirtschaftsprüfern

  • Du übernimmst Verantwortung, setzt Prioritäten und bringst regulatorische sowie risikorelevante Themen konsequent voran

Benefits

Deine Vorteile

Neben einer vielseitigen und abwechslungsreichen Tätigkeit im Herzen von Frankfurt wirst Du Teil eines dynamischen und motivierten Teams, das die Umsetzung eines innovativen Geschäftsmodells mit Fokus auf das Wertpapiergeschäft verfolgt. In diesem Rahmen bieten wir Dir Freiraum für Deine persönliche Entwicklung und fördern Dich dabei über gezielte Fortbildungsmaßnahmen. Durch das Leben flacher Hierarchien kannst Du die Entwicklung des GENO Broker mitgestalten.

  • Mobiles Arbeiten – gerne stellen wir auch die benötigte Hardware dafür

  • Nutzung der DZ BANK Corporate Benefits

  • Vermögenswirksame Leistungen

  • eGYM-Wellpass für 30 EUR Eigenbeitrag

  • Kostenfrei zur Verfügung gestelltes Deutschlandticket

  • Nutzung unseres Job Rad-Angebots

  • Bezuschusste Mitarbeiterkantine der DZ BANK

  • Firmenevents sowie ein kostenloses Angebot an Kaffee und Wasser

  • Vorteile eines Mitarbeiters der genossenschaftlichen Finanzgruppe

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Tech Director - Mobile (f/m/d)

Job Description

adjoe is a leading mobile ad platform developing cutting-edge advertising and monetization solutions to meet the diverse needs of app publishers. Being part of the applike group ecosystem plus the significant financial backing from Bertelsmann empowers us to do this. At adjoe, we are proud of our advanced tech stack and dynamic and innovative workforce.

Meet Your Team: Rewarded Solutions - Mobile Integrations

The Mobile Integrations Team is part of our Rewarded Solutions Department which develops the technology behind adjoe's innovative rewarded engagement products that serve over 57 million daily mobile users.

 

Mobile Integrations is responsible for the native Android and iOS SDKs written in Java/Kotlin and Swift that handle much of the complex engagement flows. On top of the SDKs are widely customizable web applications built with React TypeScript; and a highly performant Golang backend hosted on AWS that processes millions of events hourly. Our system matches each game with its ideal users, delivering rewards optimized for satisfaction through data processed via AWS Athena, Kafka, Spark, S3, and MySQL.

 

For team members, this means having state-of-the-art resources to build engaging rewarded ad experiences that seamlessly integrate into the world’s top apps while delivering exceptional results for advertisers and monetizers in this industry-leading technology.

What You Will Do:

  • Architect & Innovate: Drive the holistic mobile architecture, technological direction, and platform scalability, ensuring our SDKs remain robust, performant, and future-proof across millions of daily active devices.

  • Foster Engineering Culture: Champion engineering best practices, sustainable code reviews, and architectural alignment across teams while collaborating with tech leads company-wide to push technical standards forward.

  • Build & Mentor: Play a defining role in recruitment and organizational growth; mentoring senior engineers and managers, fostering a high-performance culture, and helping every engineer reach their full potential.

jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, ML & Experimentation (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. With our core product Playtime Arcade, we've become the global leader in rewarded advertising, an ad unit built on a simple premise: users earn real in-app rewards for engaging with new apps. The result is one of the most effective value exchanges in adtech, connecting advertisers and publishers with over 770 million users annually.

Architecting Intelligence to Optimize 200M+ Daily Decisions

As the intelligence core of our engineering organization, our Data Science team doesn't just deploy models, we engineer the fundamental decision engine that powers our platform. At a scale of 770 million users and 100,000+ predictions per second, we are solving a multi-objective optimization problem that balances user incentives, advertiser ROI, and long-term platform health in real time.

Our architecture is built on a 1PB+ behavioral data lake, providing the high-fidelity input necessary to train deep learning models that predict individual user engagement with precision. We aren't just optimizing clicks, we are dynamically calculating optimal reward structures to sustain a global value exchange.

Engineered for performance, our stack leverages PyTorch for model training, NVIDIA Triton to achieve sub-100ms inference. We own the full ML lifecycle from high-level research and feature engineering to deployment and A/B experimentation. Here, you will find the autonomy, the data depth, and the massive scale required to solve the most complex optimization challenges in the adtech ecosystem.

The data infrastructure behind this runs at real scale: 2TB ingested in real time every day, 100+ Airflow jobs and data pipelines, and ML models handling p99 latency of 100ms across 100,000+ predictions per second.

What you will do:

  • Analyze and evaluate the performance of our machine learning models using user-level and aggregated data, identify inefficiencies and failure patterns, and turn findings into actionable recommendations for our Data Science teams.

  • Define and improve metrics for measuring ML model performance and business impact, working closely with Data Scientists and Product Managers to ensure we optimize for the right outcomes.

  • Design, prepare and analyze A/B tests and other experiments to measure the impact of new models, features and algorithmic changes. Assess statistical significance, experiment quality and practical business impact.

  • Act as a strategic analytical partner to Product, Data Science, and Business leads. You proactively translate ambiguous business challenges into analytical roadmaps and turn complex ML insights into clear recommendations that shape product strategy.

  • Challenge product and technical decisions with data, bringing an independent analytical perspective to model development, experimentation and product strategy.

  • Drive analytical projects with end-to-end ownership: from initial scoping and hypothesis generation to stakeholder alignment and post-decision impact. Establish reusable frameworks and best practices that raise the bar for how we use data across teams.

jobs.title: Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Manufacturing runs on fragmented data: machines, sensors, and decade-old systems that don't speak to each other. Data sits in departmental silos, knowledge lives in people's heads, and AI can not unfold its potential in point solutions that don’t deliver. At Manex AI, we build that missing layer with our platform: It handles manufacturing data at scale, models the factory ontology and builds agentic applications that reason and act across it.

We're a small team in Munich, backed by Lightspeed and BlueYard, with engineers from top companies. We ship fast, work close to the shop floor and we don't ship things we're not proud of.

 

The Role

You'll build the core of our platform: From data ingestion and our ontology layer to the applications manufacturers use on the shop floor every day. The work spans backend, frontend, performance, and tooling - you'll work where your skills count most. You own features end-to-end and work directly with founders and customers.

 

You should apply if you

  • Write maintainable, tested, and performant code

  • Own problems from design to production

  • Enjoy writing and reviewing RFCs

  • Know at least one of React, Python, TypeScript, or Rust

  • Thrive in the pace of an early-stage startup

  • Have 2+ years of professional experience

 

Nice to have

  • PostgreSQL, DuckDB or experience with lakehouse formats

  • Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, or AWS

  • ML and LLM systems

  • CI/CD pipelines, preferably GitHub Actions

  • Monitoring distributed enterprise systems

  • Open standards (e.g. RDF, OWL, SHACL)

 

What we offer

  • A cooperative team where you never solve hard problems alone

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • High trust and ownership from day one

  • Corporate Wellpass membership, subsidized public transport

  • Regular offsites with the greatest team - think austrian mountains, lakeside retreats, or european cities

  • Relocation support, incl. corporate housing offers

Are you willing to start contributing to European autonomy at scale? Apply now!

jobs.title: AI Researcher - Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our Mission
Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring an AI Researcher (f/m/d) to join our Pre-training team and help advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about how large models learn, want to run experiments that feed directly into production training runs, and want hands-on time on large-scale clusters (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture
We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organizational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues. New team members learn through real work: from your first weeks you will pair with experienced researchers on live problems, and take on more ownership as you grow into it.

About the Role
As an AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will work on the technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the intersection of research and engineering, you will learn to translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions, from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs. You will start with well-scoped problems alongside senior researchers and progressively take ownership of larger parts of the training recipe.

We are looking for someone with strong fundamentals, sharp experimental instincts, exceptional skills, and the drive to go deep fast. You learn as much from a failed run as from a paper, you write code others can build on, and you want to become an expert in large-scale pre-training.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Experiments: Design and run ablations on core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization), and implement PyTorch-based architectural changes. Evaluate their effect on convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Experiments: Run and analyze small-scale proxy experiments, and contribute to the hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methods we use to predict behavior at multi-thousand-GPU scale.

  • Run Monitoring & Debugging: Help monitor large-scale training runs and investigate convergence issues such as loss spikes and divergence. Work with the team to track down distributed training failures.

  • Research to Practice: Follow the literature, reproduce promising results at small scale, and bring ideas worth testing to the team.

jobs.title: Senior AI Researcher- Pre-training (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our Mission

Aleph Alpha is one of the few companies in Europe doing serious foundation model pre-training like our recently released Kolibri-1 model. Our customers - in finance, manufacturing, public administration - need models that understand German, meet European regulatory requirements, and work reliably in high-stakes settings. We're building that in Heidelberg.

We are hiring a Senior AI Researcher to join our Pre-training team and to advance the architecture and training of our next generation of foundation models. If you are excited about designing inference-efficient architectures, optimizing training recipes that scale reliably, and training models on a large scale cluster (thousands of NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs), we would love to hear from you.

Team Culture

We foster a culture built on ownership, autonomy, and empowerment. Teams and individual contributors are trusted to take responsibility for their work and drive meaningful impact. We maintain a flat organisational structure with efficient, supportive management that enables quick decision-making, open communication, and a strong sense of shared purpose. We collaborate closely on complex technical problems, working in pairs or using mob programming to resolve challenging issues.

About the Role

As a Senior AI Researcher in Pre-training (f/m/d), you will own the critical technical levers that determine the success of our next-generation models: architecture, optimization, stability, and scaling.

Working at the high-leverage intersection of research and engineering, you will translate mathematical reasoning and empirical observations into principled training decisions - from small-scale proxy experiments to multi-thousand-GPU runs.

We are looking for an expert who can combine rigorous experimental design with high-quality production code, directly influencing model quality, run reliability, and the efficiency of the models we ship.

Your Responsibilities

  • Recipe & Architecture Optimization: Own core elements of the training recipe (optimizers, schedules, initialization) and design PyTorch-based architectural improvements to maximize convergence, stability, and training efficiency.

  • Scaling Strategy & Predictability: Develop hyperparameter scaling laws and scale-up methodologies, using small-scale proxy experiments to reliably predict multi-thousand-GPU behavior and de-risk major training decisions.

  • Stability, Diagnostics & Debugging: Investigate complex convergence issues (loss spikes, divergence) and resolve hard-to-reproduce distributed system failures like communication bottlenecks, race conditions, and synchronization errors.

  • System-Model Co-Design: Partner with Compute Performance, Data, Evaluation, and Post-Training teams to align the model lifecycle with hardware constraints, memory bandwidth, and communication topologies.

Core Qualifications

  • You are proficient in Python and deeply familiar with PyTorch-based training workflows.

  • You have a strong track record in machine learning research and software engineering, demonstrated through shipped models, impactful open-source contributions, or published research.

Du willst in einem Unternehmen arbeiten, in dem Deine Stärken im Umgang mit Menschen geschätzt werden – und wo Du echten Impact hast? Dann bist Du bei Werkia richtig!

Unser Ziel: Handwerksbetriebe und qualifizierte Fachkräfte durch eine moderne Jobplattform schneller, einfacher und besser zusammenzubringen.

Als Customer Success Manager:in bist Du die erste Ansprechperson für unsere Fachkräfte und begleitest sie auf ihrem Weg zum passenden Job im Handwerk. Du sorgst dafür, dass jede Vermittlung ein voller Erfolg wird – für Bewerber:innen und Betriebe gleichermaßen.

  • Feedback als Schlüssel — Du holst aktiv Rückmeldungen ein, lernst daraus und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns Prozesse weiter.

  • Teamwork & Austausch — Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Customer Success und Account Management zusammen, lernst die Abläufe im Recruiting kennen und unterstützt uns bei der täglichen Arbeit.

  • Du erkennst, was Kandidat:innen brauchen – und unterstützt sie dabei, den richtigen Weg für sich zu finden.

  • Du packst an – du wartest nicht, bis dir jemand sagt, was zu tun ist, sondern legst los und denkst mit.

  • Zahlen schrecken dich nicht ab – du hast kein Problem damit, an KPIs zu arbeiten und deinen Beitrag zum gemeinsamen Ziel zu kennen.

  • Du bist kein Fan von leeren Kalendern – du gibst Gas, ziehst mit dem Team durch und willst gemeinsam wachsen. Feedback nimmst du als Chance, nicht als Kritik.

  • Digitales Grundverständnis – du musst kein Tech-Nerd sein, aber solltest dich mit Tools und Systemen wohlfühlen.

jobs.title: Werkstudent IT-Systemadministration (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du studierst Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder etwas Vergleichbares und willst neben dem Studium an echter Infrastruktur arbeiten statt nur an Übungsaufgaben? Du hast vielleicht schon ein Homelab, den Familien-PC-Support an der Backe oder einfach Spaß daran, herauszufinden, warum etwas nicht läuft? Dann passt du zu uns.

Du musst noch nicht alles können. Wichtiger ist uns, dass du Technik verstehen willst, zuverlässig bist und Fragen stellst. Den Rest lernst du bei uns, mit Kollegen, die mit dir draufschauen, und einem eigenen Lab zum Ausprobieren.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten, das IT-Infrastruktur für Unternehmen in der Region baut und betreibt.

Aufgaben

  • Du unterstützt unser Team beim Aufbau und Betrieb von Server- und Netzwerkumgebungen bei unseren Kunden

  • Du baust Server und Workstations zusammen, installierst sie und prüfst sie auf Herz und Nieren

  • Du hilfst bei der zentralen Betreuung unserer Kundenumgebungen, zum Beispiel bei Patching, Monitoring und Backup-Kontrollen

  • Du richtest Benutzer, Postfächer und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365 ein

  • Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen unserer Kunden und holst dir Hilfe, wenn es knifflig wird

  • Du dokumentierst Lösungen so, dass auch der nächste durchblickt

  • Du automatisierst, was sich wiederholt, und bringst eigene Ideen ein

  • Du begleitest deine Kollegen zu Einsätzen beim Kunden vor Ort

Du arbeitest von Anfang an an echten Kundenprojekten mit und übernimmst Schritt für Schritt mehr eigene Aufgaben. Und du sitzt mit deinen Problemen nicht allein da: Es ist immer jemand da, der mit dir draufschaut.

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Du bist eingeschriebener Student, idealerweise in Informatik, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder einem verwandten Studiengang

  • Du hast bis zu 20 Stunden pro Woche Zeit, in den Semesterferien gern mehr

  • Du interessierst dich für Server, Netzwerke und Betriebssysteme und hast Grundkenntnisse in Windows

  • Du arbeitest dich selbst in Neues ein und bleibst dran, wenn ein Problem nicht beim ersten Versuch gelöst ist

  • Du arbeitest zuverlässig und sagst Bescheid, wenn etwas nicht klappt oder du einen Fehler gemacht hast

  • Du sprichst gutes Deutsch und kannst Technik verständlich erklären

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns):

  • Erste Erfahrung mit Windows Server, Virtualisierung oder Microsoft 365, zum Beispiel aus einem Homelab, einer Ausbildung oder einem Nebenjob

  • Grundverständnis für Netzwerke: Du weißt, was Firewall, VPN und Routing tun

  • Erste Schritte mit Linux oder Skripting in PowerShell oder Bash

  • Führerschein Klasse B

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als gute Noten. Wichtig ist, dass du sauber arbeitest und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Eigenes Lab und lokale KI-Power. Du hast ein eigenes Lab zum Testen und Ausprobieren und arbeitest mit lokaler KI-Hardware.

Praxis, die im Studium fehlt. Du arbeitest an echten Kundenumgebungen und lernst, wie IT-Infrastruktur im Alltag wirklich betrieben wird.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. Aktueller Stack, KI-gestütztes Arbeiten (unter anderem mit Claude) und kein Altlast-Ballast, der dich ausbremst.

Flexible Arbeitszeiten. Vorlesungen und Klausurphasen gehen vor. Deine Arbeitszeiten stimmen wir mit deinem Stundenplan ab.

Start-up-Flair. Kurze Entscheidungswege, echte Eigenverantwortung und eine Atmosphäre, in der Ideen mehr zählen als Hierarchien.

Home-Office. Nach der Einarbeitung ist Home-Office in Absprache möglich.

Perspektive nach dem Studium.

  • Möglichkeit zum mobilen Arbeiten

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - Life Sciences - EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You:

Du hast deine Ausbildung zum Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration in der Tasche oder schon einige Jahre als Systemadministrator gearbeitet? Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Server, Netzwerke und Microsoft-365-Umgebungen selbst planen, aufbauen und betreuen? Dann passt du zu uns.

Ob Berufseinsteiger oder alter Hase: Wichtiger als die Zahl deiner Berufsjahre ist uns, dass du Technik verstehen willst, Verantwortung übernimmst und mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe sprichst. Was du noch nicht kannst, lernst du bei uns, mit Kollegen, die mit dir draufschauen, eigenem Lab und Budget für Zertifizierungen.

Wir sind MintCode Solutions aus Haselünne, ein Team aus 8 Leuten, das IT-Infrastruktur für Unternehmen in der Region baut und betreibt.

Aufgaben

  • Du planst, baust und betreibst Server- und Netzwerkumgebungen bei unseren Kunden

  • Du kümmerst dich um Firewalls, VPN und Netzwerk, damit alles sicher und sauber miteinander spricht

  • Du betreust unsere Kundenumgebungen zentral, von Patching und Monitoring bis Endpoint-Security und Backup

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden, wenn etwas hakt, vom kurzen Anruf bis zur kniffligen Störung, und dokumentierst Lösungen so, dass auch der nächste durchblickt

  • Du redest bei Standards, Tooling und unseren Abläufen aktiv mit und automatisierst, was sich wiederholt

Qualifikation

Das bringst du mit:

  • Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, zum Beispiel als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder vergleichbare Praxis

  • Du verstehst, wie Netzwerke grundsätzlich funktionieren, und weißt, was Firewall, VPN und Routing tun

  • Du telefonierst gern mit Kunden und erklärst Technik so, dass sie am anderen Ende auch ankommt

  • Du arbeitest dich selbst in Neues ein und bleibst dran, wenn ein Problem nicht beim ersten Versuch gelöst ist

  • Du sagst offen, was du denkst, auch wenn du anderer Meinung bist oder einen Fehler gemacht hast

  • Du teilst dein Wissen im Team und fragst nach, bevor du dich festfährst

  • Führerschein Klasse B und Reisebereitschaft, weil manche Kunden nicht nur um die Ecke sitzen

Schön, wenn du das schon kannst (sonst lernst du es bei uns):

  • Erfahrung mit Windows Server und Virtualisierung

  • Microsoft 365: Du hast schon Tenants eingerichtet, Postfächer migriert oder Benutzer und Lizenzen verwaltet

  • Du schraubst gern selbst an Hardware und baust Server lieber auf, als sie nur auszupacken

  • Firewalls und VPNs hast du schon selbst konfiguriert, nicht nur davon gehört

  • Du hast erste Erfahrung mit Linux oder automatisierst Aufgaben mit PowerShell oder Bash

Für uns zählen Persönlichkeit, Motivation und Potenzial mehr als ein dicker Stapel Zertifikate. Wichtig ist, dass du sauber baust und Lust hast, besser zu werden.

Benefits

Eigenes Lab und lokale KI-Power. Du hast ein eigenes Lab zum Testen und Ausprobieren und arbeitest mit lokaler KI-Hardware.

Möglichkeit auf einen eigenen Firmenwagen. Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, einen eigenen Firmenwagen zu bekommen. So bist du für Kundentermine flexibel unterwegs und musst dir um dein eigenes Auto keine Gedanken machen.

Moderne Tooling-Kultur. Aktueller Stack, KI-gestütztes Arbeiten und kein Altlast-Ballast, der dich ausbremst.

Zertifizierungen auf uns. Wer sich bei unseren Herstellern zertifizieren will, bekommt Zeit und Budget dafür.

Wellpass oder Streaming-Abo. Sport in tausenden Studios deutschlandweit oder Spotify bzw. Netflix auf uns. Such dir aus, was zu dir passt.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Wir suchen Dich als System Engineer (m/w/d) – IT-Monitoring & Infrastrukturbetrieb an den Standorten Berlin oder Bonn (hybrid). Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für den stabilen und sicheren Betrieb unternehmenskritischer Monitoring-Infrastrukturen in einem hochsensiblen Sicherheitsumfeld.

Deine Aufgaben dabei sind:

  • Installation und Betrieb sicherer Monitoring-Infrastrukturen unter Einhaltung hoher Sicherheitsstandards (BSI-Umfeld)
  • Installation von Monitoring-Agenten sowie strukturiertes Testen und Einspielen von System- und Tool-Updates
  • Kompetenter Anwendungssupport bezüglich der eingesetzten Monitoring-Tools
  • Störungsannahme, Fehleranalyse und Fehlerbehebung im Rahmen des Incident-Managements (1st- und 2nd-Level-Support)
  • Bearbeitung anfallender Changes sowie Unterstützung bei der nachhaltigen Ursachenanalyse im Problem-Management
  • Erstellung und Pflege aller notwendigen betrieblichen Dokumentationen

Dein Profil

Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Betrieb von Monitoring-Infrastrukturen, bevorzugt mit CheckMK
  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Praxiserfahrung mit aktuellen Serverbetriebssystemen der Hersteller Linux (Red Hat Enterprise Linux / RHEL) und Microsoft
  • Kenntnisse in der Programmiersprache Python (idealerweise ca. 3 Jahre Erfahrung) sind wünschenswert
  • Strukturierte, sicherheitsbewusste und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise
  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich.

Das bieten wir Dir

Deine Ideen. Deine Entwicklung. Unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur spannende Technologien, sondern auch die Freiräume, um eigene Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Zukunft aktiv gestalten: Arbeite an innovativen Technologien und gestalte digitale Entwicklungen mit.
  • Flexibel arbeiten: Profitiere von unserem hybriden New-Work-Modell.
  • Sicher durchstarten: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag.
  • Mehr für Dich: Nutze Deine givve Card als steuerfreien Unternehmensbenefit.
  • Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze Deinen Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum.
  • Persönlich weiterkommen: Entwickle Dich mit individuellen Karriereperspektiven gezielt weiter.
  • Gemeinsam mehr erreichen: Profitiere vom Wissenstransfer und Zusammenhalt in einem starken Team.
  • Technologie erleben: Entdecke vielfältige Technologien und arbeite an anspruchsvollen, sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen.

Und das Wichtigste: spannende Herausforderungen, echte Teamarbeit und die Möglichkeit, etwas zu bewegen.

Drive digital technologies with us!

Energieberatung · Energiekonzepte · Gebäudeeffizienz · TGA

Möchtest du nicht nur Energieberatung durchführen, sondern ganzheitliche energetische Lösungen entwickeln und deren Umsetzung begleiten?

jobs.title: Fachberater für Radiologie Implementierung
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über RadCentre – Part of EDL GmbH

RadCentre ist ein etablierter Anbieter von Softwarelösungen für die medizinische Bildgebung und Radiologie. Mit innovativen und leistungsstarken RIS-Lösungen (Radiologie-Informationssystemen) unterstützt RadCentre medizinische Einrichtungen und Fachkräfte bei der effizienten Organisation und Optimierung ihrer radiologischen Prozesse – von der Terminplanung bis hin zur Erstellung und Verteilung von Befunden.

Seit der Integration in die EDL GmbH ist RadCentre Teil der EDL Group, einem europäischen Softwareunternehmen, das auf innovative Anwendungslösungen für die medizinische Diagnostik spezialisiert ist. Mit seiner technologischen Expertise und seinen engagierten Teams unterstützt die Gruppe mehr als 600 radiologische Abteilungen und über 15.000 medizinische Fachkräfte in Europa.

Bei RadCentre zu arbeiten bedeutet, Teil eines engagierten Teams zu werden, von der Dynamik einer wachsenden europäischen Unternehmensgruppe zu profitieren und aktiv an der Weiterentwicklung von Softwarelösungen mitzuwirken, die einen wichtigen Beitrag zur Zukunft der medizinischen Diagnostik leisten.

Imaging the future together.

jobs.title: Bid / Tender Lead Energieinfrastruktur (m/w/d) | 100% | Region Aargau
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Für ein international tätiges Industrieunternehmen der Energieinfrastruktur steuerst du Angebote für Hochspannungsprojekte in globalen Märkten. Du führst das Bid-Team über alle Funktionen, bewertest Risiken und Chancen und bringst die Unterlagen termingerecht zur Abgabe. Gefragt ist echte Tender-Erfahrung aus der Branche, keine reine Vertragsassistenz.

Das zeichnet die Stelle aus

  • Gesamtverantwortung für den Angebotsprozess, von Bid/No-Bid bis zur Abgabe
  • Internationale Ausschreibungen von Netzbetreibern und Generalunternehmen

Deine Aufgaben

  • Ausschreibungen sichten und gemeinsam mit der Verkaufsleitung fundierte Bid-/No-Bid-Empfehlungen erarbeiten
  • Bid-Team aus Engineering, Projektmanagement, Einkauf, Produktion, Logistik, Finanzen und Recht führen
  • Kostenkalkulationen, Preisofferten und Vertragsbedingungen erarbeiten, Risiken und Chancen strukturiert bewerten
  • Angebotsunterlagen technisch, kommerziell und rechtlich zusammenstellen, prüfen und fristgerecht einreichen
  • Präqualifikationen und Lieferantenregistrierungen bei Netzbetreibern und Generalunternehmen vorbereiten und abschliessen
  • Ausschreibungs- und Pipelinedaten im ERP, zum Beispiel Microsoft Dynamics 365, pflegen und das Verkaufsreporting unterstützen
  • Vertragsverhandlungen begleiten, Win/Loss-Analysen auswerten und Vorlagen sowie Abläufe im Bid-Management verbessern

Dein Profil

  • Abschluss in Elektro- oder Energietechnik, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder Betriebswirtschaft, oder vergleichbare Ausbildung
  • Mindestens fünf Jahre eigene Tender-Verantwortung in Energieinfrastruktur oder vergleichbarem internationalem Projektgeschäft
  • Erfahrung mit Hochspannungssystemen oder Generalunternehmer-Projekten ist ein klarer Vorteil
  • Sichere Kostenkalkulation, starke Analytik und gute Kenntnisse kommerzieller Vertragsbedingungen
  • Nachweisbare Koordination funktionsübergreifender Teams, sicher in MS Office und ERP-Systemen
  • Verhandlungssicheres Englisch ist Pflicht, Deutsch im Alltag von Vorteil

Arbeitsort: Raum Aarau, Schweiz (vor Ort). Pensum: 100%.

Du bewirbst dich bei CONCAPE GmbH, Personalvermittlung, Städtle 13, 9490 Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Den Namen des Unternehmens besprechen wir persönlich mit dir. Vorgestellt wirst du nur mit deinem OK.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, New Products (0-1)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us:

Jerry.ai is a profitable, Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. We’re building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with the car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat) and accelerating our growth.

About this role:

We’re at an inflection point in our journey. After 2 years of profitable growth with a stable core business (car insurance marketplace), we’re ready to expand our product offerings and accelerate customer growth.

We’re looking for 2-3 Senior Product Managers to drive progress across one of our key new product bets, including motorcycle insurance (just launched), home insurance (also just launched), new insurance products for other assets like boat and RV (concept phase), as well as non-insurance products to make car and home ownership easier such as helping customers save money on their property taxes (about to launch).

Each of these new product areas comes with its own operational or technical challenges, its own customer pain points, and its own path to scale. And we’re looking for builders who are excited to build from scratch and own one of our new bets.

Why you will (or won't) like working here:

  • 0-to-1 scope: The products you will work on are new territory for us. There are no established frameworks, no prior PM who has figured it out.

  • Product complexity: Property tax rules vary county by county. Specialty vehicle insurance involves regulatory and product complexity that doesn't exist in standard auto. These are not clean, well-scoped problems to solve.

  • Big responsibility & impact: You will have meaningful ownership. And what you do will likely materially impact the trajectory of our business over the next few years.

What you'll own:

There are several new product bets in the motion. The specific product you will work on will largely depend on your prior experience, interests/preferences, and our business priorities when you join the team.

The goal in every case remains the same: ramp quickly on a new domain, distill data and insights to identify the highest leverage areas to prioritize (including quantitative data from our Data Science team and qualitative data from our Customer Insights & Research team), build and ship new products, get customer feedback quickly, apply learnings and iterate, and compound on what works.

Whether it’s home, motorcycle, boat or RV products, you will be a key contributor to our product roadmap and own execution from early concept or early launch to finding product-market fit, and scaling.

Who you are:

  • A first-principles thinker: You approach problems with curiosity and use data to develop clear hypotheses before you reach for a solution. You're analytically strong but your instinct is to ask "what are we trying to solve here?" before jumping to "what should I build?"

  • An owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside of your swim lane.

  • Empathetic & Curious: You care deeply about understanding what drives how they think, feel and behave.

  • Diligent: Your follow through is impeccable. When you own something, nothing falls through the cracks.

What you bring:

  • 5+ years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), consumer-facing product management, or equivalent role at a high-growth startup

  • Consumer product instincts, either from direct product building experience or from close work alongside consumer product teams

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: General Graphic Designer

Location: Remote (Ability to work within specified time zones as needed)

Work Schedule: Flexible based on employers needs, typically Monday to Friday.

Company Overview:

Sagan is an exclusive membership community for top executives, founders, and CEOs seeking to hire and maximize the impact of international talent. We bridge the gap between global talent and US-based businesses, connecting candidates from vibrant regions like Latin America, the Philippines, India, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and Africa with leading American companies. Discover a world of career possibilities with Sagan.

Position Overview

We are seeking a talented General Graphic Designer to join our dynamic design team. In this role, you will work on a variety of design projects, including branding, print materials, digital assets, social media graphics, and web design elements. You will play a key role in maintaining a consistent visual identity across all platforms, while collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality, on-brand designs.

The ideal candidate should have a strong design background, creativity, and the ability to meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment. We are looking for someone with experience in both print and digital design, proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, and a keen eye for detail.

Key Responsibilities

  • Graphic Design Creation
    • Create compelling visual assets for print materials (e.g., brochures, business cards, posters, flyers).
    • Design engaging social media graphics, email templates, and banners.
    • Develop website graphics, landing pages, and other digital assets in alignment with brand guidelines.
    • Design logos, brand assets, and templates for clients.
    • Ensure consistency in design style and messaging across all marketing materials.
  • Collaboration & Communication
    • Work closely with marketing, content, and product teams to understand project requirements and objectives.
    • Collaborate with other designers and team members to refine design concepts and provide feedback.
    • Communicate effectively with clients to understand their design needs and incorporate feedback.
  • Project Management & Time Management
    • Manage multiple design projects simultaneously, ensuring timely delivery of high-quality assets.
    • Maintain organization and attention to detail in managing files, ensuring smooth handovers to developers or other teams.
    • Ensure adherence to deadlines and project specifications, adjusting design concepts as necessary.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 2+ years of professional graphic design experience.
  • Software Proficiency: Strong proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Google Suite.
  • Attention to Detail: Ability to create pixel-perfect designs and provide high-quality final deliverables.
  • Creativity & Problem Solving: Strong design skills with the ability to think creatively and outside the box.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent written and verbal communication skills for both team collaboration and client interactions.
  • Time Management: Ability to prioritize and manage multiple projects and deadlines effectively.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in web design (e.g., creating web graphics, website layout design).
  • Knowledge of motion graphics or basic video editing (Adobe Premiere, After Effects).
  • Experience with branding and logo design.
  • Ability to adapt to changing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Knowledge of UI/UX design principles.

Only candidates who achieve an 80% or higher score on assessments will be considered.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Chief Project Officer (CPO) – Insurance & Investments

1. Role Summary

The Chief Project Officer (CPO) is responsible for leading the organization's strategic project portfolio, enterprise-wide program management, and major transformation initiatives across its insurance and investment businesses.

The role ensures that strategic projects are properly planned, prioritized, funded, executed, and delivered in alignment with organizational goals. The CPO will oversee complex projects involving insurance operations, investment services, digital transformation, regulatory compliance, business expansion, mergers and acquisitions, and operational improvement.

Working closely with the CEO, Board, and senior management team, the CPO will establish effective project governance, optimize resources, manage delivery risks, and ensure measurable business outcomes from the organization's project investments.

2. Key Responsibilities

Strategic Project & Portfolio Management

  • Develop and execute the organization's enterprise-wide project management and portfolio strategy.
  • Identify, assess, prioritize, and oversee strategic projects across insurance and investment business units.
  • Ensure project portfolios align with corporate strategy, growth objectives, and operational priorities.
  • Evaluate project feasibility, business cases, resource requirements, expected returns, and implementation risks.
  • Monitor portfolio performance and ensure projects deliver their intended strategic and financial benefits.

Insurance & Investment Project Delivery

  • Lead strategic initiatives involving life insurance, general insurance, reinsurance, investment management, wealth management, and financial services.
  • Oversee projects involving new insurance product launches, policy administration systems, claims management, underwriting processes, and distribution expansion.
  • Manage investment-related initiatives involving portfolio management systems, investment operations, client reporting, and service delivery, where applicable.
  • Coordinate projects involving regulatory changes, business process modernization, and operational restructuring.
  • Support the implementation of new business models, financial products, and market expansion initiatives.

Project Governance & PMO Leadership

  • Establish and oversee the Project Management Office (PMO), including project standards, methodologies, policies, and governance frameworks.
  • Implement project approval processes, stage-gate reviews, reporting structures, and escalation procedures.
  • Ensure consistent project management practices across business units and subsidiaries.
  • Monitor project scope, timelines, budgets, deliverables, and quality standards.
  • Present portfolio performance reports, major risks, and project recommendations to executive leadership and the Board.

Digital Transformation & Technology Projects

  • Lead strategic technology implementation and digital transformation projects across the organization.
  • Oversee projects involving insurance technology (InsurTech), financial technology (FinTech), automation, AI, cloud platforms, CRM, and enterprise systems.
  • Coordinate implementation of digital insurance platforms, customer portals, mobile applications, and investment service platforms.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
*We are open to supporting 100% remote work anywhere within the continental US.*

Our team is a leading provider of Digital Transformation services for Federal agencies. Our services focus on enabling agency mission and business transformation using industry-leading low-code platforms, mobile applications, robotics process automation, and data analytics platforms. We are partnered with some of the world’s leading and most innovative companies like Salesforce, ServiceNow, Microsoft, and UiPath. We focus on offering a full range of architecture and planning, system implementation, integration, analytics, and O&M for our customers.

ICF is seeking Salesforce Developers to join our team! You will work with our highly qualified Salesforce Architects and Business Analysts to translate business requirements into technical solutions that utilize Salesforce platform best practices. We leverage SCRUM Agile methodology to iteratively develop and test Salesforce solutions.

As Senior Developer, you will lead integrations using Web Services and APIs and lead data migration efforts from legacy applications. You will be responsible for Salesforce declarative or programmatic development resources such as triggers, Flows, validations, approvals, Apex classes, and Lightning Web Components. Execute test plans to ensure quality delivery using test code and unit tests. Working with and supervising & assisting junior team members, to scope and implement complex business solutions. Follow coding standards and participate in architect code reviews during projects to ensure appropriate design patterns are followed.

Responsibilities:

  • Participate in complete application life cycle from technical design, architecture, development, testing, and deployment of high-quality salesforce solutions using coding best practices
  • Identify and recommend creative solutions to build extensions to the out-of-the-box capabilities of the platform.
  • Communicate and collaborate with other technical resources like architects, admins, configuration experts, and stakeholders regarding status, risks, and any technical issues.
  • Implement multiple AppExchange tools like DocuSign, eSign Live, and others.
  • Develop salesforce to on-prem solution integrations using APIs and Web Services.
  • Ability to work well with customers both individually as well as in a highly collaborative team
  • Engage in code reviews and ensure adherence to best practices
  • Provide mentoring and technical leadership to other team members

Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of experience with Salesforce.com custom development including Lightning Design Systems, APEX, Visualforce, Lightning Design System, Lightning Components, etc.
  • 4+ years of experience integrating Salesforce with third-party applications such as Docusign & using web services like SOAP or REST API with OAuth.
  • 2+ years of experience with MuleSoft and Docusign
  • 2+ years of experience with GitHub and Jenkins
  • Must have lived in the US for the past 4 years and the work MUST BE PERFORMED in the United States (U.S.), as this work is for a federal contract and laws do apply
  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Federal Public Trust
  • Must be a US Citizen or Permanent Resident per contract requirements.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Salesforce Certification(s)
  • Specialized Consultant Certifications like Sales, Service or Community (Preferred)
  • Experience with Public Sector Solutions or Service Cloud and Agentforce.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

  • Build new features end to end, from technical design to release on the App Store.
  • Write clean, testable, and maintainable code, and take part in code reviews.
  • Ensure app performance, stability, and security, and troubleshoot issues when they come up.
  • Collaborate with designers, product owners, backend developers, and QA to deliver a great user experience.
  • Integrate apps with APIs, third-party services, and internal systems.

  • Hands-on experience with REST APIs and third-party integrations.
  • Familiarity with Git and Agile ways of working.
  • Ability to write clean, testable, and well-documented code.
  • Strong communication skills and a collaborative, knowledge-sharing mindset.

Salary ranges are flexible and depend on your experience.

So, get your dancing shoes on and come join the fun!

At ADDENDUM, we wholeheartedly reject all forms of discrimination, including but not limited to age, disability, sex, sexual orientation, pregnancy and maternity, race or ethnicity, religion or belief, gender identity, marriage, civil partnership, or any other protected category. jobs.title: Senior Technical Product Manager – AI Agents
jobs.descriptionHtml:
NVIDIA is the defining technology company of the AI era. We are looking for a Senior Technical Product Manager to lead NeMo Relay, an open-source library that helps developers observe and control what happens inside agent runs, without replacing the frameworks, models, or tools they already use.


Our team builds open-source libraries and reference architectures for agentic AI, including NeMo Relay, NeMo Fabric, and NemoClaw. We go to market through the ecosystem: our software is composed to be embedded into agent frameworks, developer tools, observability platforms, and third-party solutions, helping customers build agents that are safer, more observable, and more efficient on NVIDIA’s stack.


What you'll be doing:

  • Take charge of the vision, strategy, and multi-release roadmap for NeMo Relay as a framework-neutral library partners can embed, addressing lifecycle events, middleware, plugins, policy, observability, and adaptive performance tuning.
  • Drive adoption through integrations with agent frameworks, coding-agent harnesses, observability vendors, and ISVs, and build the examples that show developers how to use Relay in real systems.
  • Partner with the teams behind NeMo Guardrails, NeMo Fabric, NeMo Compass and OpenShell to make Relay work seamlessly with their components.
  • Turn open-source community and ecosystem feedback into prioritized product decisions.
  • Work with engineering and program management to plan releases and keep roadmap communications accurate.
  • Become a recognized voice in agent observability, safety, and optimization through talks, content, and community engagement.

What we need to see:

  • Deep familiarity with the AI agent landscape: open-source frameworks, coding agents and harnesses, and commercial agent platforms.
  • Proven understanding of agent execution, including LLM calls, tool calls, and multi-agent workflows.
  • Understanding of what developers need to operate agents in production: tracing, evaluation, guardrails, and cost and performance tuning.
  • Product management background on developer-facing libraries, SDKs, or infrastructure that other companies build on.
  • Proven track record to lead product direction in ambiguous, fast paced areas and to influence engineering, ecosystem, and leadership partners without direct authority.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of combined work in software development, ML ops, and/or technical product management, including 5+ years shipping enterprise software or infrastructure.

Ways to stand out from the crowd:

  • History of taking an open-source project from early releases to broad ecosystem adoption.
  • Track record of ecosystem-led go-to-market, such as integrations, co-engineering, or embedding into third-party products.
  • Hands-on familiarity with OpenTelemetry, OpenInference, or agent tracing and evaluation tools.
  • Ability to make exceptional runtime concepts simple for both developers and executives.
Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:
168,000 USD – 258,750 USD for Level 4; and 208,000 USD – 327,750 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 13, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Senior Associate, Business Operations & Analytics
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us:

Jerry.ai is a Series C, YC-backed tech startup with 5M+ customers and $240M in funding. Founded in 2017, product launched in 2019, and achieved profitability in 2024.

Why we exist:

Your car, home, and motorcycle aren't just purchases, they're the physical embodiment of the life you've worked hard to build. Yet the experience of owning them is stuck in the 90s. Every step of the journey — buying, insuring, maintaining, repairing, selling — is fragmented, complicated, and expensive.

Imagine having a trusted friend in your pocket who takes care of everything: they find you the right car or home at the right price, lock in the best insurance rate without you lifting a finger, remind you before that service appointment turns into an expensive repair, and help you sell at the best price when the time is right. That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

Why We’re Hiring

Our Business Operations & Analytics team has been a force multiplier and accelerant to our business that has helped us reach these pivotal milestones in spite of headwinds and within a highly competitive market. They are a team of former McKinsey, BCG and Bain consultants who drive data & insights, and inform decision-making across every corner of our business. They are analytical powerhouses and first principles problem solvers who push forward our most important initiatives across product, growth, tech, and operations.

Every business unit has a Business Operations & Analytics team member embedded within it — someone who doesn't just run analyses and build dashboards, but shapes what questions we should ask, what data to pull, what conclusions to draw, what decisions to make, and then drives our teams towards our next goal: go from 5M to 50M customers and become a $10B business in the next 4 years.

As our business continues to expand, there is growing demand for more Business Operations & Analytics team members. We are hiring 2-3 people to drive impact in these areas:

  • Growth Marketing

  • Product Development

  • Strategic Partnerships

On leveling: You may see job ads for this role at different job levels. Our priority is finding the right people, we can be flexible with job title/leveling.

Why You Will (Or Won't) Like Working Here

  • No slides: If you've worked in consulting, you know what it feels like to be up at 3am reformatting a deck. That doesn't exist here. The only work that gets done at Jerry is work that will materially change the trajectory of our business — an important product, a new growth channel, a key metric, a critical partner relationship, etc.

  • No corporate fluff: The Business Operations & Analytics team is 14 insatiable learners who care deeply about solving difficult problems and making a tangible impact. Every person owns a critical domain. There is no bloat, unnecessary meetings, or waiting for approvals.

  • Hands-on: This is not a pure strategy role, you will also own execution. Your day-to-day will be surfacing analytical insights, driving decisions, and seeing them through end-to-end.

What You'll Own

You'll sit on our central Business Operations & Analytics team but you’ll be embedded in one of Jerry's core business areas — growth, product, AI and automation, strategic partnerships — and own the analytical function for that business unit end-to-end.

That friend is Jerry.

We are building the first AI-powered advisor to manage all your physical assets. We started with your car in 2019, and now we’re expanding into new verticals (e.g. home, motorcycle, RV, boat).

About the role:

Our next chapter is about accelerating growth, from 5M to 50M customers by 2030.

This year alone, we launched 5 new products: home insurance, property tax, motorcycle insurance, car repair shop bids, and roadside assistance, among others within car and home ownership categories currently incubating. Each of these new businesses comes with its own operational complexity, distinct customer pain points, and its own path to scale.

We are looking for a General Manager to lead one of these new businesses. Reporting directly to our Cofounder/CEO, you will own the P&L, set the strategy, and be accountable for everything from product development, customer growth, partnerships, and operations. Depending on which product line, you may also lead a small team (1-2 people to start).

If you’re looking for an opportunity to build and scale a new business within a late-stage startup with an existing user base, product market fit, capital, traction, and a high caliber team, we’d love to hear from you!

Who we get excited about:

  • Owner: You act like your name is on the door. If something is broken, you feel responsible for fixing it, even if it’s outside your swim lane.

  • Insatiable learner: You are constantly seeking to deepen your knowledge, sharpen your skills, and master whatever you’ve set your mind to.

  • Tenacious: You are highly resilient. No challenge is too difficult, no issue unsolvable.

  • Sense of urgency: You have a strong bias for action and are impatient when progress is stalled.

What you bring:

  • 6+ years of experience in venture capital, private equity, or hands-on operating roles in fast-growing startups

  • Bachelor’s degree in any discipline

  • Ability to work in person in our Palo Alto office alongside our CEO and executive team

Compensation:

This position offers base salary and stock options. The base salary for this position within the San Francisco Bay Area is $200,000— $250,000 USD, but we can be flexible based on your prior experience and appropriate job levelling. We also offer comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, paid parental leave, 401(K) plan with 4% employer matching, and wellness benefits, among others.

Location:

This role is based in our Palo Alto office, 2-3 days a week.

While we appreciate your interest and application, due to the volume of applications we receive, only applicants under consideration will be contacted.

jobs.title: Utilization Review Nurse- 40hr
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Connecticut Children’s Center for Care Coordination (The Center) is dedicated to the integration of care coordination through the delivery of innovative programs, providing technical assistance, disseminating best practices, and building inclusive partnerships to strengthen families and build stronger communities. The Center utilizes a universal, evidence based, research informed, and policy driven approach to enhanced care coordination that not only meets the interrelated medical, developmental, behavioral, and social needs of children, but enhances the care giving capacity of families.

Utilization Management Nurse: The Utilization Review (UR) Nurse has strong clinical skills and a well-developed knowledge of utilization management, with a focus on medical necessity determinations. The candidate should possess a working knowledge of medical necessity tools such as InterQual® and Milliman Care Guidelines® and be proficient in medical record reviews. This individual supports the overall Utilization Management (UM) program by developing and/or maintaining effective and efficient processes for determining the defensible hospitalization status based on regulatory and reimbursement requirements of various commercial and government payers. This individual is responsible for performing a variety of concurrent and retrospective UM-related functions and ensuring that appropriate data is tracked, evaluated, and reported. This individual maintains current and accurate knowledge regarding commercial and government payers including regulatory requirements. The UR Nurse will function in accordance with facility policies and processes. This individual will support process improvement activities and report key metrics to facility leadership as requested. The UR Nurse effectively and efficiently manages a diverse workload in a fast-paced, rapidly changing regulatory environment. The UR Nurse provides support to the hospital’s UM Committee as needed. He/she collaborates with multiple leaders at various levels throughout the organization.

jobs.title: Director, Architecture and Data
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

The Director, Architecture & Data leads the team that sets the guardrails and owns the foundation for how Defense & Systems architects software environments and delivers a data fabric that enables the use of AI.

The team governs the reusable patterns and boundaries that let the business move fast without fragmenting, organizes information around the business domains it serves, and maintains a single enterprise-wide capability map so that AI is delivered as a native extension of the stack rather than a parallel initiative. It is the function that governs – it sets the boundaries and guidelines the delivery process runs inside – while the data it curates is the foundation that process runs on. To make the data foundation real, the role also delivers the Defense & Systems Data Fabric, coordinating with the Data Fabric Sr Principal Technical Product Manager and the Principal Architects for Enterprise, Data, Infrastructure, and Applications.

This is a people-leadership role that balances two accountabilities: being on the cutting of technology to invent the future of flight and lifting people up to work on world class teams; without every compromising safety. The role leverages four mature business processes to deliver to customers: the AI Control Tower (ATG) stage-gate, the Data Fabric capability-maturity (TRL/CRL) overlay, FLIGHT DECK agile delivery, and the Risk Management Framework (RMF) cybersecurity authorization that clears each product to build and to operate. Success improves Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost by giving every team one trustworthy data foundation, one set of reusable patterns, and one governed route from idea to authorized production.

Job Description

Key responsibilities

Team leadership and talent


  • Lead and develop the Architecture & Data team – enterprise, platform, software, and data architects plus the data engineers and product managers aligned to the Data Fabric – with clear role clarity, objectives, and standard work for each seat
  • Own the team’s performance and development; build a culture of ownership, flow, and continuous improvement, coaching problem-solving at the point of work
  • Identify and remove obstacles on behalf of the team, especially where delivery direction and supervisory authority are split across the matrix

Architecture, data, and AI governance

  • Own the architecture governance model: reference patterns, standards, the architecture review and decision process, and exception handling – the paved roads that keep delivery fast and coherent across product teams
  • Set unified architecture and AI standards, informed by TOGAF/Zachman and the NIST AI Risk Management Framework, and advise technology and AI investments
  • Maintain a single enterprise-wide capability map so AI can integrate into existing technology stacks
  • Set the data architecture and modeling standards, organized around the business domains the data serves, and govern data quality, lineage, and reusable data patterns across the organization

Data foundation and the Data Fabric

  • Deliver the Defense & Systems Data Fabric, carried as this role’s own top-priority objective, coordinating with the Data Fabric Sr Principal TPM, who sets policy and prioritization and directs the pod day to day
  • Supervise the Data Fabric engineers (Sr Staff TPM–Data, Principal Data & Information Architect, Sr Staff Data Engineer, Staff Data Engineer) in a matrixed arrangement, keeping their written objectives aligned to fabric delivery so priorities do not collide
  • Ensure the data foundation — the canonical ontology, catalog, and governed data products — covers the in-scope business domains and is trustworthy enough for every downstream analytic and AI use case to bui...

Join our expanding engineering team!

We're hiring 2x permanent Senior Backend Engineers II & III to join our Asset Sales group as we scale one of the most important parts of M-KOPA's FinTech platform. Build distributed, event-driven microservices and help shape what AI-native engineering looks like at M-KOPA.

The Impact 💚

Your code will directly power the systems that put smartphones and e-motorbikes into the hands of Every Day Earners across Africa. We've already helped over 10 million customers access more than $2 billion in credit. It's your chance to be part of something that's literally transforming lives across an entire continent 🌍

The Opportunity

🎯 Mission-driven engineering: Every service you build helps expand financial inclusion for under-banked populations

🏆 Global recognition: Join a company named by the Financial Times as one of Africa's fastest-growing companies for five consecutive years (2022–2026)

🚀 Scale challenges: Build backend systems serving millions across multiple African markets

🤖 AI-native from day one: We're actively embracing AI as part of the engineering craft, not bolting it on

🌍 Fully distributed: Work remotely with diverse teams across UK, Europe, and Africa

What You'll Do

At M-KOPA, you'll build and operate distributed C# and .NET microservices on Azure, working within an event-driven architecture at significant scale. This is an outcomes-driven role: we care far more about the value you create than where you sit or how many hours you're online. You'll own what you build end-to-end — from idea, through implementation and deployment, into production and iteration.

Technical Environment 💻

  • Modern C# stack: Distributed C# and .NET microservices

  • Cloud & orchestration: Hosted on Azure using Kubernetes

  • Architecture: Event-driven, supporting products used at significant scale

  • Observability: Grafana, Azure Application Insights, logs, traces, and metrics

  • AI tooling: Claude and other AI tools used throughout the engineering workflow — design exploration, code generation and review, test writing, incident investigation, and technical communication

Our Engineering Approach 🚀

  • AI-native engineering: We want engineers who tinker — experimenting with new tools, agents, and workflows, and sharing what works

  • Guardrails as we accelerate: Automated tests, SLOs, alerting, observability, and deployment safeguards around everything we ship

  • Own it beyond the pull request: Design for idempotency, retries, out-of-order events, and failure modes, and know how your services behave in production

  • The Campfire Rule: Leave the systems you touch a little better than you found them

  • On-call as feedback, not heroics: Engineers who build our systems also help operate them, using incidents to make the platform more resilient

What You Need

We're looking for a senior engineer who's curious, autonomous, and highly trusted. You're comfortable owning the entire software stack — including supporting infrastructure — throughout its lifecycle, and you see production data, not just deployment, as the real measure of "done."

jobs.title: Manager, Data Analytics - Engineering & Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Summary...

The Manager, Data Analytics supports the development and implementation of data-driven strategies to optimize business performance. Responsibilities include pricing, promotional strategies, market analysis, web analytics, and reporting, fostering cross-functional collaboration to drive insights and decision-making.

What you'll do...

We are seeking a Data Platform Lead to own and manage our GCP/BigQuery infrastructure, serving as the central point of accountability for all reporting and consumption datasets across the organization. This role is responsible for designing, optimizing, and governing our data platform to ensure high-quality, reliable, and performant data assets are available to stakeholders.

The ideal candidate brings strong analytical skills with meticulous attention to detail, ensuring data accuracy, consistency, and integrity across all downstream reporting. jobs.title: Pediatrician - CA License
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Clarity Pediatrics is reimagining pediatric chronic care, starting with ADHD. Nearly 10% of people in the US are diagnosed with ADHD, and for parents, it can feel impossible to find the right care. We are building a virtual pediatric ADHD clinic that delivers trusted care to all families. Our new clinical model is tech-enabled, backed by the best science, and has the potential to deliver exceptional health outcomes to transform a child’s trajectory. In the future, our pediatric care platform will expand rapidly to other common chronic conditions like asthma, allergies, and obesity.

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

What makes this role unique:

Opportunity to join a multi-disciplinary clinical team dedicated to providing integrated care to patients and families. We aim to give our providers the tools they need to provide excellent care including collaboration with peers, guidance from ADHD experts and researchers, and opportunities to pursue ongoing professional development.

Contribute to the development of a better pediatric healthcare system for patients and providers. Our team is dedicated to setting clinicians up for success, and you’ll be encouraged to help us make improvements to our care models, workflows, and clinical tools in order to make your work easier and more enjoyable.

Focus on your strengths. We appreciate how different clinical backgrounds help us learn from each other and take better care of patients. We encourage our clinicians to develop special areas of interest and expertise to become leaders within the team. We provide ongoing training opportunities to gain new skills as well as stipends for additional learning and development.

Responsibilities:

  • Provide comprehensive clinical services for children and teens with ADHD and their families, with a focus on diagnostic and medication management.

  • Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team that includes MD’s, nurse practitioners, psychologists and other clinicians to provide excellent care.

  • Complete administrative work and clinical documentation in a timely and accurate manner.

  • Contribute to implementation, evaluation and program development iteration to ensure optimal delivery of care.

  • This is a clinical position, but there may be opportunities to expand and grow into program development, and other leadership activities, depending on employee interest and company needs.

Qualifications:

  • Licensed to practice medicine in California

  • Board certified by the American Board of Pediatrics

  • Prescribing treatment plans including administering and managing ADHD stimulant medication

  • At least 5 years of patient care experience

  • Experience working with families from different cultural backgrounds and willingness to receive ongoing training and support in advancing your skills in delivering culturally responsive treatment

  • Interest or experience in Lifestyle Medicine. We emphasize evidence-based interventions that support children and families such as sleep hygiene, nutritional coaching and physical activity

  • Confidence in using an electronic medical record and telemedicine tools to deliver virtual care and support to families

  • Excitement about joining a startup and interest in learning new technologies and tools
