jobs.descriptionHtml:
We Are:

Accenture Supply Chain & Operations practice who specializes at the intersection of functional consulting, data, & technology. Our Fortune 500 clients all the way through private equity-backed portfolio companies need big-picture change, so we come at their challenges from all sides with functional insights, data power, digital leadership, and extensive industry know-how. It’s our job to show clients how to take major leaps forward in planning, procurement, manufacturing, fulfillment, and service while becoming more sustainable and resilient. How do we do it? We call out the most important metrics. We cut costs, optimize capital, improve response times and consider ESG values. We connect suppliers and customers across the extended supply chain. And we create strategies and operating models that really work.

You Are:

A Supply Chain and Operations professional who helps clients in implementing & optimizing the end-to-end planning process across supply chain and operations, ensuring alignment with business objectives, and driving efficiency. You will work with clients in leading & implementing Sales & Operations planning, demand planning, supply planning, production scheduling, and inventory management capabilities to ensure timely and cost-effective delivery of products.

As part of the working with the clients, you lead & advise several aspects of integrated planning including:


  • Integrated Planning Strategy: Develop and implement integrated planning strategies for clients that align with organizational goals, ensuring the optimal flow of goods and services from suppliers to customers.
  • S&OP: Lead S&OP planning including S&OP cycle of demand review, supply review, pre-Exec & Exec S&OP reviews.
  • Demand and Supply Planning: Develop Demand and supply planning processes for clients, including forecasting, production planning, procurement, and inventory management to balance supply with demand while meeting service level targets.
  • S&OE: Enable strategic and tactical plans developed during the S&OP process and ensuring they are implemented smoothly across the supply chain. This includes ensuring production schedules, inventory management, order fulfillment, and logistics are aligned with business demand.
  • Inventory Optimization: Develop inventory management strategies, ensuring optimal inventory levels across locations while reducing excess stock, stockouts, and working capital investment.
  • Process Improvement: Identify opportunities to streamline operations, improve forecasting accuracy, and reduce lead times. Implement best practices and new technologies for enhanced planning and operations efficiency.
  • Performance Management: Identify and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) for supply chain performance, including on-time delivery, inventory turnover, and order accuracy. Develop action plans to address performance gaps
  • Operating Model: Develop governance & operating model across sales, marketing, production, and logistics to integrate business needs and strategies into the planning processes.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Regularly communicate with internal stakeholders (e.g., executive team, sales, finance) to provide updates on planning performance and to ensure alignment on goals.
  • Risk Management: Proactively identify potential supply chain risks (e.g., disruptions, supplier issues) and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on business operations.
  • Reporting & Analytics: Provide insights into supply chain performance through data analysis and reporting, helping senior management make informed decisions on operational strategies.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Uplift

Uplift is a dynamic agency specializing in global talent search, covering EMEA, LATAM, USA, and APAC. With successful placements in 60 countries, we combine speed and cutting-edge technology to source top executive and mid-senior talent across various functions. Our innovative approach integrates global networks, AI, and advanced recruitment tools. Beyond recruitment, we engage with our audience through our podcast, newsletter, and webinars, ensuring we stay at the forefront of talent acquisition and global HR trends.

About Our Client

Our client is a leading global digital advertising company operating in over 130 markets worldwide. Through partnerships with nearly 60 major digital platforms, the company helps businesses expand their reach and maximize advertising opportunities. With a strong international presence and a dynamic, multicultural environment, our client offers exciting career opportunities for professionals looking to grow in the digital advertising industry.

The Client Solutions Manager is a critical role in delivering best-in-class service for advertising clients. In partnership with the Client Partner and in collaboration with the Brand Strategist, the CSM is responsible for ensuring successful design and delivery of all assigned campaigns strategy, including original content, custom-built, high-impact and targeted media.

  • Participate in strategic planning with sales to grow or generate new business opportunities.

  • Ability to manage large customer relationships and manage through conflict, driving groups to collective business decisions.
  • Providing feedback to product and tools teams to help us scale our advertising platform.
  • Provide actionable insight to clients and sales with quantitative and qualitative analysis on campaign performance drivers (products, budget, costs and creatives efficiency metrics against defined KPIs) and delivery.
  • Organize & manage account information, assets & data, and reports.
  • Knowledge in performance (analytics, google task, etc) is a plus.

Qualifications :

  • At least 3 years of experience in client relationship management and digital media.
  • Bachelor's degree in Advertising.
  • Intimately familiar with online media planning, design and art control of advertising pieces.
  • Strong communication and people skills (working directly with clients).
  • Aptitude, creativity and a preference for working in collaborative teams and across business unit.
  • Strong time management and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to multi-task under challenging deadlines still focusing on details.
  • Fluent in English

Work Schedule: Monday to Friday, aligned with Melbourne business hours, with at least 6 hours of overlap
Employment Type: Full-Time
Work Tools: Company laptop and required system access provided

Job Description

Position Objectives

Support Rawlinson Constructions' residential building projects through accurate construction estimating and effective contract administration.

This role is approximately 50% estimating and 50% contract administration, covering everything from reviewing construction drawings and preparing project estimates to managing procurement, variations and subcontractor documentation.

The ideal candidate has experience in Australian residential construction, strong attention to detail, and the ability to manage estimating and administrative tasks across multiple projects.

Key Responsibilities

Estimating and Tender Preparation

  • Review architectural, structural and engineering drawings, specifications and other project documentation.
  • Prepare quantity takeoffs, Bills of Quantities (BOQs) and detailed project cost estimates.
  • Calculate material and labour costs across various construction trades.
  • Request, follow up and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Prepare tender submissions, including scope summaries, inclusions, exclusions and allowances.
  • Identify scope gaps, raise RFIs and flag potential construction or pricing risks.
  • Update estimates and project costs in Buildertrend.

Contract Administration and Procurement

  • Prepare and manage project variations, including cost breakdowns and supporting documentation.
  • Prepare subcontractor scopes of work, agreements and onboarding documentation.
  • Prepare and manage purchase orders (POs) for suppliers and subcontractors.
  • Match supplier invoices and subcontractor claims against approved purchase orders.
  • Coordinate material orders, supplier quotations, product selections and delivery schedules.
  • Monitor project budgets, committed costs and potential cost overruns.

Project Coordination and Documentation

  • Maintain accurate project records, cost reports, quotations and document registers.
  • Assist with progress claims and monthly project cost reporting.
  • Coordinate with site supervisors, suppliers, subcontractors and internal stakeholders.
  • Monitor tender deadlines, outstanding quotations and project updates.
  • Prepare RFIs and project-related correspondence for management review.

Skills and Qualifications

Essential

  • At least 3 years of experience estimating Australian residential construction projects, including new builds, extensions or renovations.
  • At least 2 years of experience in contract administration or construction administration.
  • Strong understanding of Australian residential construction methods, materials and building processes.
  • Ability to interpret architectural, structural and engineering drawings.
  • Proven experience in quantity takeoffs, BOQs, cost estimation and supplier/subcontractor pricing.
  • Experience handling variations, purchase orders, subcontractor documentation and procurement.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills.
  • Experience using construction estimating or takeoff software such as Cubit, CostX, PlanSwift or Bluebeam.
  • Strong written English, communication and organisational skills.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing deadlines and proactively identify issues.
  • Degree or diploma in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Civil Engineering or equivalent qualification.

Desirable

  • Experience with custom or high-end residential construction.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is an opportunity to contribute to technology initiatives in a collaborative environment with opportunities for professional growth.

Job Title: Data Engineer

Location: Remote

Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2 - [Not open to C2C or 1099]

Salary Range: $115,000–$165,000 Annually

Experience Required: 4+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card holders, EAD holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. Bright Vision Technologies is unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary

Bright Vision Technologies is seeking a Data Engineer to design, build, validate, and support data solutions that make trusted information available for enterprise operations, analytics, and decision-making. The work includes data integration, modeling, quality, performance, and governance. The successful candidate will apply practical expertise in SQL, Python/Scala, ETL/ELT, data modeling, Spark or equivalent processing, orchestration, and cloud data platforms, work with cross-functional teams, and contribute to reliable, maintainable solutions through the delivery lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain data pipelines, transformations, reports, models, or platform components as required by the role.

  • Translate source-to-target and business requirements into validated technical data solutions.

  • Implement data quality checks, access controls, monitoring, and failure-recovery procedures.

  • Tune SQL, processing jobs, models, dashboards, or platform resources for performance and cost.

  • Document data definitions, lineage, operational procedures, and technical decisions.

Required Qualifications

  • Experience Required: typically 4+ years in a related professional role; exact threshold must match the approved requisition.

  • Practical experience with the role-specific technology stack: SQL, Python/Scala, ETL/ELT, data modeling, Spark or equivalent processing, orchestration, and cloud data platforms.

  • Professional experience in data engineering, analytics, data management, or the platform area relevant to this role.

  • Strong SQL skills and practical experience with the data technologies identified for the position.

  • Understanding of data modeling, ETL/ELT, data validation, and integration patterns.

  • Experience with data quality, security, access controls, and production support.

  • Ability to translate business requirements into accurate and maintainable data solutions.

  • Strong analytical, documentation, and stakeholder communication skills.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Additional hands-on depth in SQL, Python/Scala, ETL/ELT, data modeling, Spark or equivalent processing, orchestration, and cloud data platforms.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Paired is a global staffing and recruiting agency that pairs remote work with top-tier talent. We help individuals from around the world connect with great companies that are looking for their specific skill set. Our mission is to provide great jobs to talented people, no matter where they are located.

Our client is a fast-growing eCommerce brand specializing in action camera mounts for motorcycle, motocross, mountain biking, cycling, snow sports, automotive, and other action sports. We move fast, work smart, and we believe in ownership. We’re a lean, action-focused team where results matter, autonomy is earned, and great ideas can come from anyone.

As a Video Editor, you’ll turn raw footage from our team and creators into high-performing paid ads, UGC, and organic social content. You’ll edit for attention, retention, and conversion while helping us maintain a consistent flow of finished creative. This is a hands-on role for someone who lives in the timeline, works quickly, and understands what makes people stop scrolling, keep watching, and buy.

  • Create scroll-stopping video ads for Meta, TikTok, and YouTube that capture attention and drive conversions.
  • Transform raw footage into compelling, high-performing ad creatives.
  • Experiment with different hooks, angles, and editing styles to create multiple ad variations.
  • Craft engaging edits with strong storytelling, fast-paced cuts, captions, text overlays, sound effects, and transitions.
  • Edit UGC-style ads, product demos, testimonials, and voiceovers that feel natural and relatable.
  • Understand what makes people stop scrolling, stay engaged, and take action.
  • Use performance feedback and creative insights to continuously improve ad content.

Requirements

  • At least 1–2 years of experience editing short-form ads, UGC, or social content
  • A strong portfolio or editing reel is required
  • Proficiency in Adobe Premiere Pro, CapCut, or comparable editing software
  • Strong understanding of hooks, pacing, retention, and short-form storytelling
  • Ability to produce a high volume of edits without sacrificing quality
  • Strong organizational skills for managing footage and project files
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Ability to take feedback and apply it consistently
  • Self-directed, dependable, and comfortable working in a fast-moving environment
  • Strong written and spoken English

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Compensation Details:

$145000 per year + bonus opportunity

Job Description:

Ace Hardware Home Services is creating a first-of-its-kind field organization that connects Ace Hardware Home Services to the broader Ace Retail ecosystem while building strong local community relationships that drive growth. The Regional Manager will build and lead a team of Brand Ambassadors who serve as local connectors between Ace retailers, homeowners, community partners and Ace Hardware Home Services, creating awareness, building relationships and generating new business opportunities.

The mandate: build the team, activate Ace Stores and the local market, generate qualified leads, convert those leads into service and sales calls, and deliver measurable revenue and profitable growth.

CORE ACCOUNTABILITIES

1. Team Build

Build and scale the Brand Ambassador field team across all AHHS markets, establishing local Brand Ambassador coverage in each market. Create a repeatable recruiting profile and sourcing model for high-potential college and vocational-school talent. Establish onboarding, field certification, territory coverage, operating rhythms and performance standards. Build a high-accountability culture focused on productive retention, rapid ramp-up and clear results.


2. Team Leadership

Lead, coach and develop a geographically dispersed team of Brand Ambassadors. Coach sales skills, retailer and community relationship building, local activation and foundational HVAC, Plumbing and Electrical knowledge. Use weekly scorecards and in-field coaching to recognize wins, identify gaps and address underperformance quickly. Build future team leaders and succession depth as the model expands.


3. Sales & Growth

Own the field-growth funnel: Brand Ambassadors > Relationships & Activation > Leads > Bookings > Completed Jobs > Revenue > EBITDA. Drive qualified leads for both service calls and sales calls through Ace Stores and local-market relationships, events and partnerships. Increase lead volume, conversion, revenue per Brand Ambassador and return on field-team investment. Partner with branch leadership to ensure fast follow-up, strong handoffs and closed-loop reporting.


4. Strategic Vision Casting

Shape a new role and operating model that will remain fluid as Ace learns and scales. Turn field learning into a clear multi-year vision, repeatable playbook and expansion roadmap. Balance near-term results with the design of durable growth channels connecting Ace Retail, local communities and Home Services. Communicate priorities, progress and economics clearly to senior leaders, branch teams and retail partners.


5. Three-Year Career Planning

Partner with HR and the Head of Training to build a three-year career architecture linking performance, skill mastery, compensation and title progression. Create a visible path from Brand Ambassador to Senior Ambassador, Lead Ambassador/Market Leader and broader Ace Home Services opportunities. Make the program a sought-after early-career destination for high-potential college and vocational-school graduates.


6. Local Brand & Marketing Activation

Build authentic partnerships with Ace owners, managers and store associates, as well as community organizations and local referral partners in each market. Equip Ace Stores to identify homeowner needs and make qualified Home Services referrals easily. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Department Overview

The Information Security organization is advancing Application Security to help the enterprise deliver products and services securely as software development practices rapidly evolve. The Application Security Engineering and Innovation team builds, integrates, operates, and matures modern security capabilities across the software development lifecycle, with a particular focus on automation, developer experience, software supply chain security, and AI-enabled security engineering.


Job Overview

The Application Security Engineer, AI and Agentic Security is a senior individual contributor responsible for designing, prototyping, evaluating, and operationalizing generative and agentic AI capabilities within Application Security. The role combines hands-on software engineering, Application Security expertise, and practical experience with AI-enabled development patterns. It will help establish safe, scalable approaches for AI-assisted vulnerability identification, code analysis, remediation, validation, and security workflow automation.


This engineer will partner with Application Security, software engineering, cloud and platform teams, Security Architecture, AI Governance, and other information security functions to move promising concepts from experimentation into governed, supportable enterprise capabilities. The role is expected to balance innovation with disciplined engineering, security controls, measurable outcomes, and long-term operational sustainability.


Responsibilities

· Design, build, and test prototypes and production-ready capabilities using generative AI, large language models, AI agents, and multi-step agentic workflows.

· Develop Python-based services, automation, integrations, evaluation harnesses, and supporting tools for Application Security use cases.

· Evaluate AI-enabled security products and frameworks for vulnerability discovery, exploitability analysis, secure code guidance, remediation, validation, and developer workflow integration.

· Create controlled workflows in which AI capabilities can analyze code, use approved tools, recommend or generate changes, execute tests, and produce auditable evidence while maintaining appropriate human oversight.

· Establish technical guardrails for agent identity, least privilege, data access, tool use, repository access, secrets handling, logging, traceability, change control, and safe failure or termination.

· Develop test plans and benchmarks to assess accuracy, security, reliability, repeatability, cost, latency, false positives, remediation quality, and operational value.

· Perform security testing of AI and agentic workflows, including prompt injection, unsafe tool use, excessive agency, data leakage, insecure output handling, dependency and supply chain risks, and authorization failures.

· Integrate capabilities with source control, CI/CD pipelines, developer tools, issue management, security testing platforms, and vulnerability management workflows.

· Define reference architectures, reusable patterns, technical requirements, runbooks, and operational support models for approved capabilities.

· Partner with governance and architecture teams to ensure solutions align with enterprise AI, security, privacy, data protection, and technology standards.

· Support pilots with application teams, capture feedback, measure outcomes, and recommend whether capabilities should be scaled, redesigned, purchased, built, or retired.

· Maintain awareness of developments in generative AI, agentic systems, secure AI engineering, Application Security, and software delivery practices.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Title: Equal Employment Specialist

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Equal Employment Specialists to contribute to a dynamic customer project focused on advancing expertise in equal opportunity and compliance. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.

Scope of Work

  1. Review AI-generated position classification analyses, verifying that they apply the correct OPM classification standards and comply with EEO and merit system principles.
  2. Evaluate AI-generated applicant rating and ranking outputs, identifying errors, inconsistencies, or potential bias against established criteria.
  3. Assess AI-generated summaries and analyses of discrimination complaints, correcting legal and procedural errors based on your experience in EEO law and practice.
  4. Review AI-generated RIF retention registers, validating retention factors (tenure, veterans’ preference, performance, service computation date) and flagging calculation or logic errors.
  5. Evaluate AI-generated recommendations on adverse actions, confirming they are grounded in regulatory guidance, case law, and best practices.
  6. Create realistic scenarios and case analyses, with documented rationales, to train and test AI models on conflict resolution and equal opportunity processes.
  7. Provide clear written and verbal feedback that improves the accuracy, clarity, and real-world applicability of AI systems in EEO and HR contexts.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Minimum 5 years of experience as a GS-0260 Equal Employment Specialist, GS-0201 Human Resources Specialist, or similar federal role.
  2. Expertise in EEO law, discrimination complaint resolution, and federal position classification.
  3. Proven ability to interpret and apply OPM regulations and guidelines in complex organizational settings.
  4. Demonstrated experience in conflict resolution and in drafting effective, respectful communications.
  5. Strong written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail in documentation and feedback.
  6. Experience evaluating or quality-checking work products for accuracy and compliance.
  7. Prior federal government or AI/data annotation project experience is highly desirable.
  8. Passion for knowledge sharing and supporting the development of innovative technology solutions.

Location: Remote, United States only

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Compensation: $160–$180 USD per hour

About the role

micro1 is looking for experienced Medical Oncologists to support a customer project focused on improving AI-generated clinical documentation.

  5. Solid understanding of systemic cancer therapies, treatment-related toxicities, supportive care, and interpretation of laboratory and imaging results.

  1. Experience managing a broad range of solid tumors and complex oncology cases.

By combining international reach with US expertise, we build diverse and high-performing teams that are equipped to thrive in today’s competitive marketplace.

We believe that the foundation of every successful business lies in having the right people with the right skills. That is where we come in—helping Farmers build a winning team that delivers consistent and sustainable results.

Since we don’t have a local legal entity, we’ve partnered with Capgemini, which acts as the Employer of Record. Capgemini is responsible for managing local payroll and benefits.

Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

AlphaGov is hiring a Labor Relations Specialist to support municipal HR and management teams in collective bargaining and employee relations. You will analyze labor provisions, prepare decision materials and help leaders assess the operational and financial implications of bargaining options.

What you’ll do

  • Review labor agreements, HR policies and management priorities to organize the issues requiring attention.
  • Research comparable public-sector labor practices and compensation provisions to inform negotiation planning.

  • Support clear communication and preparation materials for management discussions with employee representatives.
  • Document recommendations, discussion outcomes and follow-up actions while protecting sensitive personnel information.
  • Coordinate with HR leadership and designated legal counsel so labor-relations advice stays aligned with policy and applicable requirements.

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • Experience advising public-sector employers on labor relations or collective bargaining matters.
  • Ability to interpret labor agreements and assess the implications of proposed changes.
  • Experience researching comparable labor provisions and preparing management briefing materials.
  • Ability to communicate clearly, exercise sound judgment and handle sensitive employee information.

Nice to have

  • Experience supporting municipal collective bargaining in California.
  • Experience costing wage-and-benefit proposals and coordinating with HR, finance and legal teams.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT THE COMPANY

Savvital is a forward-thinking organization that provides diversified services to small and medium-sized businesses in the international market, enabling them to build their future while benefiting from our customized solutions. Our team of educated experts are motivated individuals excited to handle tasks that add real capacity to a client's workday.

Our mission is to provide affordable solutions to growing companies through strategic task delegation. We envision creating an ecosystem that resonates with the human touch every business needs.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are looking for a Bilingual Insurance CSR who is fluent in Cantonese along with professional-level English communication skills, to join our team and support one of our international clients in the insurance industry.

The ideal candidate will be responsible for assisting customers with insurance-related inquiries, handling policy servicing requests, coordinating with insurance carriers, and ensuring a smooth customer experience. Since the client serves a large Chinese-speaking customer base, strong spoken Cantonese is highly preferred, while Mandarin-speaking candidates will also be considered.

This role requires someone who is confident handling phone conversations, detail-oriented when managing policy information, and comfortable communicating in both Chinese and English.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Customer Support: Handle incoming customer calls, respond to inquiries, and provide assistance with routine insurance-related requests.
  • Policy Servicing: Process policy changes, including adding or removing vehicles and drivers, and updating customer information.
  • Insurance Quoting: Assist with preparing insurance quotes and gathering the necessary information for policy applications.
  • Carrier Coordination: Communicate with insurance carriers in English to request information, process changes, and follow up on policy-related matters.
  • Call Management: Direct incoming calls to the appropriate team members or departments when required.
  • Customer Communication: Assist Cantonese- or Mandarin-speaking customers while ensuring clear and professional communication in English with internal teams and carriers.
  • Documentation: Maintain accurate customer records, document interactions, and update policy information in the agency management system.
  • Follow-Ups: Ensure timely follow-up on customer requests, policy changes, and pending service matters.
  • System Management: Use agency management software and carrier portals to manage customer information and process routine service requests.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Fluency in spoken Cantonese or Mandarin is required. Cantonese is strongly preferred.
  • Professional-level English communication skills, particularly for speaking with insurance carriers and handling written correspondence.
  • Previous experience in customer service, call center operations, client support, or an administrative role.
  • Strong phone etiquette and confidence handling customer conversations.

jobs.title: CMC Mechanical Analysis Lead Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

This role is within the Ceramic Matrix Composite (CMC) Commercial Mechanical Analysis team, where you will be analyzing CMC components within the combustion and high-pressure-turbine (HPT) module of the GE9X commercial turbofan engine. The team also supports fielded commercial engines (LEAP-1A and -1B) as well as New Technology Introduction (NTI) programs with CMC components.

The Lead Engineer will be responsible for supporting and leading mechanical analysis projects for CMC hot section hardware and/or interfacing metallic components with specific focus on manufacturing support (MRB) and, field findings, and durability. Tasks will include performing stress analyses and life analyses on these components using finite-element-analysis (FEA) software as well as proprietary post-processing tools. The individual will be accountable for the quality of own their own work and will be reliant on guidance from their supervisor and technical mentors. This role requires consistent collaboration and communication with the hardware owners, thermal systems design team, and material behaviors teams. In this position, you will have a moderate level of autonomy, working directly with your team lead or controlled title holder and component hardware lead. Evendale, OH location is preferred.

Job Description

Essential Responsibilities:

  • Execute the analysis and evaluation of assigned projects using sound engineering principles and adhering to standard practices, procedures, and product / program requirements.
  • Developing conceptual knowledge of turbofan hot section design and composite analysis. May include support roles with specialized expertise or technical knowledge in adjacent areas like component testing, material behavior, and thermal systems.
  • Applies general knowledge of mechanical engineering and mechanical analysis concepts through education or past experiences. Understands how work contributes to the hardware owner and engine program objectives.
  • Resolves issues using established procedures. Deliberately consults mentor or more senior team members to understand issues outside of defined workscope or expertise.
  • Collaborates with cross-functional team and presents outcomes to technical and business leaders.
  • Exchanges technical information, asks questions, and checks for understanding.
  • Documents assessment assumptions, boundary conditions, and results, and shares conclusions with adjacent teams.
  • Aides in the coaching and development of more junior team members.
  • Creation of macros or tools to standardize Stress Analysis practices for CMCs.
  • Supports the integration of AI-enabled tools and processes to accelerate model development and post-processing activities

Required Characteristics:

  • Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university (or a high school diploma/GED with a minimum of 4 years design engineering experience
  • Minimum of 3 years experience in Ceramic Matrix Composites or Manufacturing related role

Desired Characteristics:

  • Attention to detail, and ability to document and execute programs.
  • Strong interpersonal and leadership skills; experience in influencing and leading small teams.
  • Proven ability to coordinate multiple projects simultaneously with demonstrated project management experience.
  • Effective problem-solving, analytical skills, and ability to make appropriate risk-based decisions.
  • Willingness to learn and highly motivated to work with new technologies.
  • Experience in using Finite-Element-Analysis software (e.g. Ansys) and related pre-processing tools (e.g. Hypermesh, NX)
  • Experience in GE Aerospace’s CMC-specific mechanical analysis tools, practices and methodologies.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

BerryDunn is seeking a Staff Accountant to join our Outsourced Accounting Services Practice Group. You will handle multiple client engagements at any one time and will perform duties such as preparing and compilation financial statement engagements, full scope general ledger processing including: payables/receivables processing, bank reconciliations, recording bank and credit card activity, vendor inquiries, processing deposits and recording journal entries. Your work will include month end/quarter end closing procedures on multiple clients. Your work will be closely supervised through coaching and training, and you can expect to receive hands-on guidance from the senior, manager, or principal in charge of the engagement. You will receive extensive internal and external training on technical and soft skills, teamwork, and the firm’s systems, operations, and relationships. The firm expects you to demonstrate flexibility, have a willingness to seek out advice, and exhibit an ambition for learning. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Harris Computer's M&A team is looking for a Corporate Development Sales Associate to join our innovative Team!


We’re looking for a high-energy, resilient sales professional to drive our M&A strategy. As a Corporate Development Sales Associate, you'll be at the forefront of our growth, responsible for identifying, connecting with, and building relationships with software company founders and executives.


If you are a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, is passionate about building a pipeline from scratch, and is motivated by the thrill of initiating conversations that lead to major acquisitions, we want to hear from you!


The remote role is eligible to anyone in the U.S. and Canada.


What your impact will be:

  • Develop the M&A Pipeline: Proactively identify and source software companies that align with our investment goals; Use initiative and outreach strategies to build a robust pipeline of opportunities.

  • Entrepreneurial Drive: You are a high-energy, responsive self-starter who works well independently. You have the tenacity and resilience to see complex outreach campaigns through to success.
  • Executive Presence & Maturity: You can confidently and credibly engage with founders and senior executives, representing Harris with professionalism.
  • Business Acumen: You have a solid understanding of business operations, enabling you to quickly assess opportunities and articulate your ideas with conviction. 2 - 5 years of experience in M&A is preferred.

About Us:

Harris Computer is the largest operating group of Constellation Software Inc. (TSX: CSU), the most effective acquirer of software businesses globally. Harris acquires vertical market software businesses, manages them using industry best practices, and builds them for the future. Through acquisitions, Harris has grown extensively from its roots in the utilities, local government, education, and healthcare sectors. We have completed over 170 software acquisitions in 20+ software sectors, have 190+ offices globally and employ over 10,000 team members within Harris companies.

AI cloud providers face a critical challenge: turning increasingly complex accelerated computing systems into reliable, secure, and commercially usable capacity. Your primary audiences will include NVIDIA Cloud Partners, hyperscalers, and independent software vendors building cloud infrastructure solutions. About Ascent

Ascent Global Logistics, headquartered in Belleville, Michigan, is a leading global provider of expedited, time-critical logistics solutions and other direct transportation services. The company connects customers to its extensive carrier network, internal ground fleet and airline via its proprietary, digital PEAK freight marketplace, which provides robust carrier capacity and transparent pricing, backed by 24/7/365 logistics experts. Ascent’s offerings include air charter and ground expedited solutions as well as truckload, less-than-truckload, global forwarding, brokerage, and managed transportation services. The experienced Ascent team solves customers’ most challenging logistics needs by providing industry-leading service and top-tier satisfaction.

Our Guiding Principles


At the core of Ascent's culture is a strong commitment to excellence, driven by the passion and dedication of every team member. We're equally dedicated to going above and beyond for our customers, ensuring this commitment extends beyond our team and brings exceptional value to those we serve. We aim for perfect execution in everything we do and ‘play hard’ by creating an environment where tasks are performed with a can-do attitude from start to finish. We ‘play smart’ by delivering on our commitments in an honest, fair and ethical manner. We treat every person with whom we interface with the utmost dignity and respect. We understand that our teammates are our most valuable assets, so we ‘play together’ by making every effort to provide a professional and enjoyable experience, enabling careers to flourish and personal growth to be achieved.

ROLE SUMMARY

The Operational Key Account Manager (OKAM) is the performance owner of a portfolio of Ascent’s most important key account customers. The role is accountable for end-to-end service performance — SLAs, KPIs, continuous improvement, and cost-to-serve — across the assigned accounts. The OKAM runs the day-to-day operational cadence, owns issue resolution, and ensures Ascent delivers consistent, measurable execution on the commercial commitments made by the Growth KAM. Working closely with Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance, the OKAM turns performance data into customer-facing insight and continuous improvement — a hands-on, execution-focused role for a disciplined operational leader.

KEY ACTIVITIES

The six most important activities of the role:

  • Own Day-to-Day Service Performance — Accountable for SLA/KPI delivery (OTIF, TTFB, claims, win/capture) across the assigned account portfolio; run the weekly and monthly operational cadence with the customer.
  • Drive Continuous Improvement & Savings — Lead the CI roadmap for each account — identify systemic issues, deliver measurable cost-to-serve and OTIF improvements, and convert performance trends into documented savings.
  • Lead Root-Cause Analysis & CAPA — Own issue resolution, root-cause investigation, and corrective/preventive action for escalations; close the loop with Operations and the customer on sustainable fixes.
  • Maintain SOPs & Operational Governance — Design, maintain, and govern the account SOPs; ensure cross-regional consistency and smooth onboarding of new lanes, modes, or scopes awarded by the Growth KAM.
  • Deliver Performance Visibility via Power BI — Own the customer’s KPI dashboards and scorecards; turn Power BI data into structured performance narratives for internal reviews and customer QBRs.
  • Coordinate Cross-Functional Execution — Act as the central bridge between the customer’s operational teams, Ascent Operations, Control Tower, IT, and Finance; ensure one coordinated service delivery for the customer.

jobs.title: AOI-Programmierer:in / SMT-Fachkraft (m/w/d) | 100% | Region Ostschweiz, Schweiz
jobs.descriptionHtml:
In einem international tätigen Unternehmen der Elektronikfertigung sicherst du die Qualität von SMT-Baugruppen direkt an der Linie. Je nach Erfahrung prüfst du Baugruppen an der AOI oder erstellst und optimierst die Programme selbst. Deine Arbeit hebt die Erstausbeute und hält die Serie stabil.

Das zeichnet die Stelle aus

  • Zwei Einstiege: AOI-Prüfung an der Linie oder Programmierung und Prozessoptimierung
  • Gute Basis auch für SMT-Operator:innen mit Erfahrung an Bestückern und Druckern

Deine Aufgaben

  • AOI-Programme neu erstellen, optimieren und bei Änderungen an Baugruppen nachführen
  • AOI-Prüfungen selbstständig durchführen und SMT-bestückte Leiterplatten unter dem Mikroskop kontrollieren
  • Lötstellen und Röntgenbilder nach IPC-Standards beurteilen, Material und Dokumente auf Vollständigkeit prüfen
  • Prüfergebnisse auswerten und Prozesse an der Linie verbessern, um den First Pass Yield zu steigern
  • Scanprogramme aus CAD- und Kundendaten aufbauen und bei Prototypen und Baugruppenanalysen mitarbeiten
  • Produktion bei AOI- und Maschinenproblemen unterstützen und Fehlerursachen nachhaltig beheben
  • Produktionsdaten im MES verfolgen und Änderungen mit NPI, Qualitätsmanagement und IT abstimmen

Dein Profil

  • Erfahrung in der Elektronikfertigung, idealerweise in AOI, SMT oder optischer Inspektion
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse der Norm IPC-A-610 und ein genauer Blick für Lötstellen
  • Für die Programmierung: IPC-A-610-Zertifikat, auch abgelaufen, und Praxis mit PARMI oder vergleichbaren AOI-Systemen
  • Erfahrung als SMT-Operator:in, zum Beispiel mit SIPLACE oder EKRA, von Vorteil
  • Lötkenntnisse sowie Umgang mit CAD-Daten oder FactoryLogix von Vorteil
  • Bereitschaft zur Schichtarbeit, hoher Qualitätsanspruch und strukturierte, selbstständige Arbeitsweise

Das erwartet dich

  • 40-Stunden-Woche im 2-Schicht-Betrieb, teilweise 3-Schicht
  • Weiterbildungsangebot und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

Arbeitsort: Raum Bodensee, Schweiz (vor Ort). Pensum: 100%.

Du bewirbst dich bei CONCAPE GmbH, Personalvermittlung, Städtle 13, 9490 Vaduz, Liechtenstein. Den Namen des Unternehmens besprechen wir persönlich mit dir. Vorgestellt wirst du nur mit deinem OK.

jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Inhouse-IT & Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über die dokSAFE GmbH

Die dokSAFE GmbH ist ein Leipziger Softwareunternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung der SaaS-Lösung ACTAPORT spezialisiert hat. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, mit unserer Kanzleisoftware die Arbeitswelt in der Anwaltskanzlei zu revolutionieren.

Du sorgst dafür, dass jede:r bei uns sicher, schnell und ohne Reibung arbeiten kann, vom ersten Arbeitstag bis zum Offboarding? Dann suchen wir genau DICH! Als IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) – Inhouse-IT & Security verantwortest Du eigenständig den Betrieb und die Absicherung unserer gesamten Inhouse-IT (Workplace, Cloud-Services und firmenweites Identity & Access Management), inklusive Datensicherung, Monitoring und Patch-Management aller IT-Systeme. Du arbeitest in einem regulierten Umfeld, in dem Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit zum Produkt gehören. Bei infrastrukturnahen Themen unterstützt Dich unser DevOps-Team.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du betreust den Endgeräte-Lifecycle von Beschaffung bis Entsorgung inklusive Softwareverteilung, führst ein vollständiges Inventar aller IT-Systeme (Endgeräte, Server, Netzwerk- und Speichersysteme, SaaS-Tools) und stellst sicher, dass Sicherheitsupdates zeitnah und nachweisbar eingespielt werden.

  • Du administrierst Microsoft 365 (Entra ID, Exchange, SharePoint, Teams, Intune), Google Workspace, Atlassian (Jira / Confluence) und weitere SaaS-Tenants und behältst den Überblick über Tools, Lizenzen und Admin-Rechte.

  • Du verantwortest unser firmenweites Identity & Access Management (RBAC, SSO via SAML / OIDC, MFA, Conditional Access, Joiner-Mover-Leaver) sowie den Betrieb von VPN und Netzzugängen.

  • Du verantwortest Datensicherung und Wiederherstellung (Backup-Konzept, regelmäßige Restore-Tests) sowie Monitoring, Protokollierung und Alerting unserer Systeme.

  • Du pflegst die virtuellen Maschinen unserer Professional-Services-Umgebungen, steuerst Zugriffe auf Lab- und Migrationsumgebungen und stellst die richtlinienkonforme Nutzung der Fernwartungstools sicher.

  • Bei Sicherheitsvorfällen bist Du erste:r Ansprechpartner:in für das Team: Du dämmst ein, sicherst Spuren und arbeitest mit externen Dienstleistern zusammen.

  • Du setzt verabschiedete Sicherheitsmaßnahmen operativ um, dokumentierst die Umsetzung, arbeitest bei ISO-27001-Nachweisen und Audits zu und unterstützt Security-Awareness im Team. Die Verantwortung für ISMS und Governance liegt bewusst an anderer Stelle.

Deine Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Erfahrung im Betrieb einer Inhouse-IT mit: Endgeräte und Device Management (z. B. Intune), Windows-Server, virtuelle Maschinen, Datenbanken sowie Netzwerk- und VPN-Betrieb (Patching, Härtung, Fehlersuche). Du kennst Dich mit Backup-/Restore-Konzepten und Monitoring aus.

  • Du hast Praxis in der Administration von Cloud- und SaaS-Umgebungen wie Microsoft 365 / Entra ID oder Google Workspace und im Identity & Access Management: RBAC, SSO, MFA, Conditional Access und On-/Offboarding-Prozesse.

  • Du verstehst Informationssicherheit im regulierten Umfeld (ISO 27001, DSGVO), kennst den Zweck der Controls und kannst sie umsetzen und sauber dokumentieren.

  • Du arbeitest strukturiert und dokumentierst auch ohne Aufforderung, sodass eine Vertretung Deinen Stand übernehmen kann. In einer Einzelrolle priorisierst Du selbst, holst gezielt Unterstützung vom DevOps-Team und eskalierst sauber.

  • Du kommunizierst verhandlungssicher auf Deutsch und sicher auf Englisch für Tooling und Dokumentation sowie für die Kommunikation im Team.

  • Du bist bereit, Dich zur Verschwiegenheit nach § 203 StGB verpflichten zu lassen, denn Du arbeitest mit besonders geschützten Daten von Anwaltskanzleien.

jobs.title: Senior Baufinanzierungsberater m/w/d | Baue mit uns IMMODO Finance auf
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Berlin | Vollzeit | ab sofort

Wir haben die Kunden, die Leads und das Volumen. Jetzt suchen wir jemanden, der daraus IMMODO Finance macht.

Bisher haben wir unsere Finanzierungskunden lediglich an externe Partner weitergeleitet.

Ohne eigenen Finanzierungsberater.
Ohne aktive Kundenansprache.
Ohne eigenen Fokus auf Finanzierung.

Trotzdem ist daraus in den vergangenen Jahren konstant ein Finanzierungsvolumen von rund 10 Mio. Euro pro Jahr entstanden.

Jetzt wollen wir den Bereich selbst aufbauen und deutlich weiterentwickeln.

Dafür suchen wir einen erfahrenen Baufinanzierungsberater, der stark im Vertrieb ist, Verantwortung übernehmen möchte und Lust hat, einen neuen Geschäftsbereich von Anfang an mitzugestalten.

Deine Chance

Du startest nicht bei null.

Unsere Makler sprechen täglich mit Kaufinteressenten, die eine Finanzierung benötigen.

Du bekommst Zugriff auf unsere bestehenden Kunden und kannst diese aktiv telefonisch und schriftlich ansprechen.

Das Potenzial ist bereits vorhanden.

Deine Aufgabe ist es, daraus Abschlüsse zu machen und gemeinsam mit uns eine starke Finanzierungssparte aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

✅ Beratung unserer Kunden rund um Immobilienfinanzierungen

✅ Aktive telefonische und schriftliche Ansprache unserer Kaufinteressenten

✅ Entwicklung passender Finanzierungslösungen

✅ Begleitung der Kunden vom Erstgespräch bis zur Finanzierungszusage

✅ Prüfung und Aufbereitung der Finanzierungsunterlagen

✅ Kommunikation mit Banken und Finanzierungspartnern

✅ Aufbau effizienter Prozesse für IMMODO Finance

✅ Enge Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Maklerteam

✅ Perspektivischer Aufbau und Führung eines eigenen Finanzierungsteams

Das bringst du mit

✅ Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Baufinanzierung

✅ Sachkundenachweis für Immobiliardarlehensvermittlung

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wollen Sie Ihre berufliche Zukunft in einem wegweisenden Projekt gestalten? Bei der Deutschen Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) in Düsseldorf erwartet Sie eine spannende Herausforderung. Im Auftrag des Bundesministeriums für Wirtschaft und Energie entwickelt und betreibt die Deutsche Energy Terminal GmbH (DET) die vier schwimmenden LNG-Terminals an der deutschen Nordseeküste, über die LNG vom Schiff in das Gasnetz eingespeist wird. Die sogenannten Floating Storage and Regasification Units (FSRU) sind von entscheidender Bedeutung für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und damit kritische Infrastruktur mit hohem Risikopotenzial. Wir suchen motivierte Talente, die aktiv an der Gestaltung unseres Verantwortungsbereichs teilhaben möchten. Bewerben Sie sich noch heute und gestalten Sie die Zukunft mit uns!

Aufgaben

  • Eigenständige Analyse der globalen Energiemärkte und der Energieversorgung in Deutschland und Europa mit besonderem Fokus auf Resilienz, Diversifizierung, Nachhaltigkeit und Wirtschaftlichkeit.

  • Regelmäßige Unterrichtung des Managements zur Energiemarkt- und Versorgungslage, Erstellen von Briefings, Präsentationen, Faktenpapieren und Dokumenten für die Öffentlichkeitsarbeit.

  • Unterstützung der Geschäftsführung bei der Terminkoordinierung und -vorbereitung und im Informationsmanagement für den Geschäftsbereich.

Qualifikation

Erforderlich:

  • Wirtschaftswissenschaftliches Studium oder vergleichbare Studiengänge mit Schwerpunkt Analyse der Energiemärkte

  • Berufserfahrung in der Analyse von Energiemarktdaten und Vorbereitung von unternehmerischen oder politischen Grundsatzentscheidungen

  • Erfahrungen mit öffentlicher Präsentation von Analysen und Konzepten

  • Deutsch auf C2-Niveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

  • Kommunikations- und Organisationsstärke

  • Fähigkeit, sich in neue komplexe Themen einzuarbeiten und die damit verbundenen Aufgaben zu strukturieren und zu steuern

  • Stressresistenz und Reisefreudigkeit (Terminals, Begleitung zu öffentlichen Terminen)

Idealerweise:

  • Erfahrung in der Projektleitung bzw. der Steuerung von Research-Projekten und entsprechender Dienstleister

  • Erfahrungen und/oder Kenntnisse zum deutschen Gasmarkt und der Herausforderungen eines sich wandelnden Energiesystems

Benefits

  • Teilhabe an der Erfüllung einer Aufgabe, die für die Versorgungssicherheit Deutschlands und seiner Nachbarn von entscheidender Bedeutung ist

  • Aus- und Fortbildung

  • Ein dynamisches Umfeld mit abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und hoher Eigenverantwortung

  • 30 Urlaubstage

  • Homeoffice nach Vereinbarung

  • Wir arbeiten stetig an weiteren Vorteilen für unsere Mitarbeitenden: aktuell bieten wir eine medizinische Gesundheitsvorsorge, die Kostenübernahme des Deutschland-Tickets sowie einen attraktiven Arbeitsplatz als weitere Benefits

Bereit, den Energiemarkt mitzugestalten?
Dann freuen wir uns auf Ihre Bewerbung; auch, wenn Sie vielleicht nicht alle Stichpunkte erfüllen.
Gemeinsam sichern wir die Energieversorgung von heute – und gestalten die Infrastruktur von morgen.

  • Internationale Projekte: Je nach Projekt arbeitest du mit Kolleg:innen und Ansprechpartnern aus unterschiedlichen Ländern und Unternehmensbereichen zusammen.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über uns

Unsere Büros: Berlin und Potsdam.

nu:legal baut eine KI-Plattform, die Unternehmen rechtliche, regulatorische und bürokratische Prozesse von A bis Z abnimmt. Wir sind ein kleines, ehrgeiziges Team in Berlin. Wir arbeiten schnell, deployen oft und übernehmen echte Verantwortung, ohne starre Hierarchien und ohne auf Freigaben zu warten. Wenn etwas fehlt, bauen wir es.

Worum es geht

Du arbeitest direkt mit unserer Designer:in an den Oberflächen KI-gestützter Legal-Workflows. Deine Screens gehen an echte Kunden. Du erlebst, wie ein Design von einem groben Briefing zum fertigen Feature wird, und übernimmst ab Tag 1 eigene Teile davon.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produktideen, Feature-Anfragen und frühe Briefings in Wireframes und High-Fidelity-Designs in Figma übersetzen

  • Alternative Designlösungen für neue Features entwickeln und im Team zur Diskussion stellen

  • Screens mit unserem bestehenden Design System gestalten, damit das Produkt konsistent bleibt

  • Unsere Figma-Komponentenbibliothek pflegen und erweitern (Variablen, Component Properties, Auto-Layout) und Inkonsistenzen beheben

  • Nutzerforschung unterstützen, zum Beispiel durch die Vorbereitung von Usability-Tests und die Dokumentation von Erkenntnissen

Dein Profil

  • Du bist an einer Universität in Deutschland eingeschrieben

  • Du bist sicher in Figma: Komponenten, Variablen und Auto-Layout

  • Du hast ein Portfolio mit mindestens einem Projekt, das deinen Prozess von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Design zeigt

  • Du bist neugierig und findest gern selbst heraus, wie Dinge funktionieren

  • Du interessierst dich für KI-Produkte oder Legal Tech und probierst KI-Tools aktiv in deiner eigenen Arbeit aus

  • Du kommunizierst gut auf Englisch, Deutschkenntnisse sind ein Plus

Was wir bieten

  • Praxiserfahrung im Design von Oberflächen für KI-gestützte Workflows, an einem Produkt mit echten Kunden

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit einer erfahrenen Designer:in und regelmäßiges Feedback statt eines Reviews am Ende

  • Echte Verantwortung ab Tag 1

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten von 15 bis 20 Stunden pro Woche, geplant rund um Vorlesungen und Klausuren

  • Hybrides Arbeiten in Berlin und Potsdam

  • Voller Zugang zu den KI-Tools, die wir nutzen, und die Ermutigung, damit zu experimentieren

  • Ein bezuschusster Urban-Sports-Club-Zugang

  • Ein kleines, internationales Team mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen

  • Die Möglichkeit, nach dem Studium zu bleiben, wenn beide Seiten es wollen

So bewirbst du dich

Schick uns einen Link zu deinem Portfolio, deinen Case Studies oder deinen Figma-Dateien. Echte Arbeit und ein klarer Designprozess überzeugen uns mehr als Politur. Wir antworten auf jede ernst gemeinte Bewerbung innerhalb von zwei Wochen.

jobs.title: Unity Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your mission

About L1VE

L1VE is a growing media and technology company with locations in Berlin and New York. With immersive 14K, 3D and 360° streaming technologies and innovative live formats, L1VE is transforming the way people experience sports, music and entertainment.

Your Role
As we are continuously growing, we are looking for a full-time Unity Lead to join our team in Berlin as soon as possible. You will take technical ownership of the L1VE apps across Meta Quest, Apple Vision Pro and Pico, and lead the Unity team that builds and operates them.

As Unity Lead, you will own how our apps are built and how they perform during live events. You will lead and mentor our Unity developers, internal and external, set technical standards, and work closely with our backend and production teams to get every event on air. The work spans live video playback, real-time social features and releases across three platforms.
This is a hybrid role based in Berlin, with two days per week in our Berlin office.

Your Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture of our Unity apps across Quest, Vision Pro and Pico
  • Lead and mentor the Unity team through code reviews, standards and unblocking
  • Own live 360° video playback: smooth, low latency and free of dropped frames, including adaptive streaming and protected content
  • Build and maintain the social layer together with the backend team
  • Own builds, releases and in-app purchases across the app stores, including their review processes
  • Maintain the data analytics layer across all platforms, together with the backend team
  • Turn product ideas into technical plans with realistic estimates
  • Own on-time delivery of the Unity team's work and flag risks early

Your profile

Must-have

  • At least 5 years of professional experience with Unity and C#, including 2 years leading a team
  • At least one VR app shipped on Meta Quest or a comparable headset
  • Deep performance knowledge of standalone headset hardware
  • Experience with video playback in Unity: adaptive streaming, decoding, DRM, 360° and stereo formats
  • Experience with real-time networked applications (WebSocket), Unity's XR toolkits and OpenXR
  • Experience instrumenting an app for analytics and acting on what the data shows
  • Ability to explain technical decisions clearly to people who are not engineers
  • Comfortable working with AI tools, while relying on your own expertise to deliver quality results
  • Degree in computer science, software engineering or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
  • Fluent English (C1/C2); German is a plus, not a requirement

Nice to have

  • Background in live broadcast or streaming
  • Background in the XR industry

Why us?

  • You will shape the technical foundation of live immersive experiences in sports, music and entertainment.
  • You will bring live formats to audiences on three headset platforms.
  • You will have significant room to shape your work, short decision-making paths and the opportunity to build systems that create lasting value.

Interested?

Please send us your CV along with a short cover letter outlining your interest in L1VE and why you would be a strong fit for the Unity Lead role.
We look forward to hearing from you!

Contact person

Annette Hansen - Recruiting Manager

jobs.title: Technischer Systemplaner (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du bist Technischer Systemplaner (m/w/d) und auf der Suche nach einer neuen Herausforderung in Berlin?

Vielleicht ist diese Position bei Buro Happold genau das, was Du suchst!

Aufgaben

  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung der erforderlichen Konstruktionszeichnungen vom Vorentwurf bis zur Ausführungsplanung unterstützt durch Kolleginnen und Kollegen des Planungsteams

  • Verantwortung für das Aufsetzen und die tägliche Verwaltung der BIM-Modelle, einschließlich Ebenen, Raster, Koordinaten, Ansichten, Planköpfen, Legenden, Familien und gemeinsam genutzter Parameter, welche alle auf vereinbarten projektspezifischen Standards basieren

  • Modellierung, Koordinierung und Beschriftung relevanter Heizungs- und Lüftungs-, Sanitär- sowie Elektrosysteme in Revit 2019-2024

  • Management und Sicherung digitaler Projektdokumentation (RVT, IFC, DWG, PDF) unter Verwendung Cloud-basierter CDEs wie BIM360, ThinkProject und Aconex

  • Qualitätssicherung von BIM-Modellierung sowie daraus abgeleiteten Fertigungszeichnungen unter Einhaltung interner und externer Projektstandards

  • Zusammenarbeit mit den lokalen und globalen BIM-Teams zur Förderung und Weiterentwicklung neuer regionaler Standards sowie der Optimierung von Arbeitsabläufen

  • Koordination bei der Zusammenarbeit mit anderen Disziplinen und bei der Nutzung der Software Navisworks/Solibri/BIM Collab

Qualifikation

  • Abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung idealerweise als Konstrukteur, Technische Systemplaner, Anlagentechniker (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Ausbildung (Architektur, Tragwerksplanung mit Schwerpunkt BIM mit AUTODESK Revit)

  • mehrjährige Arbeitserfahrung in der Konstruktion von gebäudetechnischen Anlagen

  • Idealerweise sicherer Umgang mit AUTODESK Revit und Erfahrung mit CAD 2D – 3D Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit der Software Navisworks/Solibri von Vorteil

  • Versierte Deutsch-und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift und sicherer Umgang mit den MS-Office Programmen

  • Ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeiten sowie Erfahrung bei der Arbeit in Projektteams und dem Übermitteln zu externen Kundinnen und Kunden

  • Technische Schulungen für Revit, BIM Collab ZOOM + Plugin for Revit, Bluebeam, Linear, Caneco werden während der Arbeitszeit angeboten. Unsere umfangreichen Software-Tools, der interne IT-Support, das Mentoring-Programm für Vorgesetzte und die ständig aktualisierte Online-Bibliothek sorgen dafür, dass Du immer die passende Umgebung und Unterstützung bekommst, um erfolgreich arbeiten zu können.

Benefits

Warum Buro Happold?

Bei Buro Happold arbeitest Du an Projekten mit echtem Einfluss. Gemeinsam mit Expert:innen verschiedener Disziplinen entwickelst Du nachhaltige Lösungen für die gebaute Umwelt und profitierst von der Zusammenarbeit in einem internationalen Netzwerk. Dabei verbinden wir technische Exzellenz mit einer offenen, kollaborativen Kultur, in der Lernen, Weiterentwicklung und Teamarbeit im Mittelpunkt stehen.

Was wir bieten:

Flexibilität& Wellbeing
Flexible und hybride Arbeitsmodelle, Wellbeing-Initiativen und Unterstützungsangebote, die Dir helfen, Beruf und Privatleben in Einklang zu bringen.

Meaningful Work & Global Collaboration
Die Möglichkeit, an spannenden und herausfordernden Projekten mit lokalem und internationalem Einfluss zu arbeiten und dabei mit multidisziplinären Teams aus unserem globalen Netzwerk zusammenzuarbeiten.

Learning, Development & Career Growth
Klare Karrierepfade, regelmäßige Entwicklungsgespräche sowie interne und externe Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten zur Unterstützung Deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung.

Reward & Recognition

jobs.title: Project Manager (m/w/d) – Komplexe IT-Infrastrukturprojekte
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission

Wir suchen Dich als Project Manager (m/w/d) – Komplexe IT-Infrastrukturprojekte an den Standorten München oder Bonn (hybrid). Du wirst Teil eines zentralen Kompetenzteams für Projektmanagement und unterstützt ein großangelegtes Digitalisierungs- und Infrastrukturvorhaben im öffentlichen Sektor bei der Steuerung komplexer Programme.

Deine Aufgaben dabei sind:

  • Projektunterstützung in komplexen technischen IT-Infrastruktur- und Serviceprojekten über alle Projektphasen hinweg
  • Projekt-Controlling in Bezug auf Termine, Meilensteine und Kosten sowie Sicherstellung von Maßnahmen zur Qualitätssicherung
  • Aufzeigen und Koordinieren von Abhängigkeiten, Änderungen und Risiken in der Projektplanung
  • Aufbau und Umsetzung eines strukturierten Anforderungs- und Changemanagements
  • Unterstützung der Gesamtprojektleitung im Tagesgeschäft sowie eigenständige Zuarbeit bei Sonderthemen
  • Erstellung und Pflege von Projektplänen, Statusberichten, Protokollen sowie Projektlisten (Personal-, Kommunikations-, Abwesenheits- und Vertreterregelungslisten)
  • Aufsetzen und Durchführen der Regelkommunikation (Terminkoordination) sowie Management der gesamten Projektablage

Dein Profil

Folgende Kenntnisse und Fähigkeiten solltest Du auf jeden Fall mitbringen:

  • Mindestens 6 Jahre praktische Berufserfahrung in IT-Projekten, idealerweise im Umfeld komplexer technischer Infrastrukturen in Behörden oder Großkonzernen (ab 10.000 Usern)
  • Anerkannte Projektmanagement-Zertifizierung nach IPMA Level C, PMI PMP oder PRINCE2 Practitioner
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Jira sowie gängigen Projektplanungs- und Office-Tools
  • Strukturierte, proaktive und analytische Arbeitsweise sowie souveräne Kommunikationsstärke
  • Für die effektive Kommunikation im Projektumfeld sowie mit unseren deutschsprachigen Kunden ist ein sehr gutes mündliches und schriftliches Deutsch erforderlich.

Das bieten wir Dir

Deine Ideen. Deine Entwicklung. Unsere gemeinsame Zukunft.

Bei uns erwarten Dich nicht nur spannende Technologien, sondern auch die Freiräume, um eigene Ideen einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und gemeinsam innovative Lösungen zu entwickeln.

  • Zukunft aktiv gestalten: Arbeite an innovativen Technologien und gestalte digitale Entwicklungen mit.
  • Flexibel arbeiten: Profitiere von unserem hybriden New-Work-Modell.
  • Sicher durchstarten: Wir bieten Dir einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag.
  • Mehr für Dich: Nutze Deine givve Card als steuerfreien Unternehmensbenefit.
  • Freiraum für Deine Ideen: Übernimm Verantwortung und nutze Deinen Gestaltungs- und Entscheidungsspielraum.
  • Persönlich weiterkommen: Entwickle Dich mit individuellen Karriereperspektiven gezielt weiter.
  • Gemeinsam mehr erreichen: Profitiere vom Wissenstransfer und Zusammenhalt in einem starken Team.
  • Technologie erleben: Entdecke vielfältige Technologien und arbeite an anspruchsvollen, sicherheitsrelevanten Systemen.

Und das Wichtigste: spannende Herausforderungen, echte Teamarbeit und die Möglichkeit, etwas zu bewegen.

jobs.title: Nyx Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecraft for humanity.

We want you as a talented Software Functional System Verification & Validation Engineer to help us in our mission by making sure that Nyx's flight software does exactly what the system needs it to do, and that this is proven at the right level of test.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as a Software Functional System V&V Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day your duties will include:

  • Keep a holistic view of the system-level software functional requirements and ensure they are correctly implemented and verified.

  • Decide, per requirement, the right verification level: low-level unit test, SIL scenario, PIL run, HIL run, or vehicle-in-the-loop run.

  • Define, plan, and execute verification campaigns across these levels, and analyse and report the results.

  • Work day to day with the functional chain responsible in each subsystem team to define functional chains, test cases, and required test facilities.

  • Dive into the details when needed: analyse failures in the code and make hands-on adjustments to test scripts, test harnesses, and software, in coordination with the FSW team.

  • Maintain traceability from system requirements to implementation and verification evidence.

  • Review test descriptions, expected inputs and outputs, and verification reports for completeness and correctness.

  • Triage test failures, drive issue resolution with the FSW team, and manage related deviations and waivers.

  • Prepare test readiness and review material, and report verification status to the FSW lead and the Chief Engineer.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of Software Functional System V&V Engineer, ideally you will have the following:


What we would love to see from you

  • Degree in Aerospace, Software, Electrical, or Computer Engineering, or a related field.

  • 5-10 years of experience working on complex space projects, including software verification and validation of embedded, real-time, or safety-critical systems.

  • Hands-on experience with at least two of: SIL, PIL, HIL, or vehicle-level test campaigns.

  • Holistic system thinker who is also ready to go into the code and make adjustments when the details require it.

  • Strong C/C++ reading and debugging skills, plus scripting for test automation (e.g., Python).

  • Solid understanding of spacecraft subsystems and how functional chains span them (e.g., AOCS, power, thermal, propulsion, avionics).

  • Experience with requirements management and traceability tools.

jobs.title: Technical Support Manager (m/f/d) L2
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Keep 2,000+ care facilities running

When voize works, nurses get 39 minutes of their shift back. When something breaks, a firewall silently blocking sync, an interface mismatch with a facility's care software or a regression after a release; documentation stops and care teams feel it immediately. Your mission: make sure that downtime is minimum, and never happens twice.

As Technical Support Manager, you own our technically hardest customer cases end-to-end. You work at the intersection of our AI product, real-world facility IT, and the German care software ecosystem - with a direct line to our Engineering team, not a ticket queue between you. And your work has leverage: one root cause you find and fix can resolve an issue for dozens or hundreds of facilities at once.

🚀 Your Daily Business - No two days are alike

  • Own escalated cases from 1st-level support end-to-end: reproduce, isolate the fault across app, backend, customer network, and third-party systems and keep the customer clearly informed until it's solved

  • Debug integrations with leading German care documentation systems: interface errors, data and schema mismatches, and on-prem configurations in customer environments (Windows/Linux)

  • Untangle customer-side IT - firewalls, proxies, certificates, MDM-managed shared devices - often in direct coordination with a facility's IT

  • Take the lead in critical incidents: assess which facilities are affected, drive resolution together with Engineering, and own clear, timely communication to customers and internal stakeholders

  • Turn recurring issues into permanent fixes: root-cause analyses with Product & Engineering, input into pre-release QA, runbooks and knowledge-base articles - and mentor 1st-level colleagues along the way as you help shape our escalation playbooks

🤝 Your Skillset — What you bring to the table

  • Hands-on experience with observability/monitoring tools (Grafana, Sentry) and strong networking fundamentals (firewalls, proxies, DNS, TLS/certificates) - you can use logs, metrics, and traces to figure out why systems can't talk to each other

  • Solid Windows and/or Linux system administration in enterprise or customer environments - you're at home in logs, configs, and the comman...

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🎤 Warum voize? Weil wir mehr sind als nur ein Job!

Wir bei voize sind überzeugt: Das Wertvollste, was wir Pflegekräften zurückgeben können ist Zeit – Zeit, um sich zu kümmern, Beziehungen aufzubauen und wirklich präsent zu sein. Heute geht diese Zeit für Bürokratie und unübersichtliche Systeme verloren, die sie von dem abhalten, worauf es eigentlich ankommt: den Menschen.

Genau das wollen wir ändern. Wir bauen AI-Companions, die digitale Arbeitsabläufe nahtlos übernehmen. Wir ersetzen Menschen nicht durch Technologie – wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Unsere Mission wird von einer Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar getragen, angeführt von Balderton Capital und mit Beteiligung von HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Heute vertrauen über 2.000 Einrichtungen auf voize, und mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen setzen unseren KI-Companion ein, um ihren Arbeitsalltag zu erleichtern.

Als dynamisches Team verbinden wir erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Mehrwert. Und jetzt suchen wir dich, um diese Mission mit uns weiterzutragen!

💡 Deine Mission: Du verantwortest den Erstkontakt und baust unsere Pipeline auf

Wir suchen eine proaktive und empathische Persönlichkeit als Sales Development Representative (SDR), die den ersten Schritt im Vertriebsprozess übernimmt: herausfinden, wer unsere nächsten Kund:innen sein sollten, den passenden Weg zu ihnen entwickeln und mitgestalten, wie sich unsere Go-to-Market-Strategie weiterentwickelt, während wir in neue Segmente wachsen.

Hier bekommt niemand eine Liste und ein Skript in die Hand gedrückt. Du entwickelst dein eigenes Bild vom Markt, testest, was funktioniert, und spielst deine Erkenntnisse direkt in unsere Vertriebsarbeit zurück.

Für diese Position suchen wir jemanden, der hybrid aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten kann.

🚀 Dein Daily Business – kein Tag ist wie der andere

  • Du entwickelst und verantwortest deine eigene Outbound-Strategie für den Healthcare-Bereich – von der Account-Recherche bis zum qualifizierten Termin

  • Du hältst eine konsequente, hochfrequente Outreach-Kadenz über Telefon, E-Mail und LinkedIn – täglich unterstützt von KI-Tools, die dir die Fleißarbeit abnehmen, damit deine Zeit in Urteilsvermögen fließt und nicht in Admin

  • Du qualifizierst Opportunities anhand klarer Kriterien und übergibst nur Termine, die für unsere Account Executives wirklich spruchreif sind

  • Du dokumentierst jedes Gespräch und jedes Ergebnis sauber und vollständig in unserem CRM – deine Daten beeinflussen Entscheidungen weit über deine eigene Pipeline hinaus

  • Du bringst Kund:innen- und Marktsignale direkt in unsere GTM-Strategie ein – dein Blick auf den Markt verändert, wie wir ihn angehen, nicht nur, wie du arbeitest

  • Du verfolgst Entwicklungen in der Branche und übersetzt sie über die Zeit in eine schärfere Positionierung

    🤝 Dein Profil – was du mitbringst

  • Erste Erfahrung im B2B-Vertrieb, idealerweise im SaaS- oder Tech-Umfeld

  • Sicherheit bei Cold Calls und ein professioneller Umgang mit Absagen

  • Neugier darauf, die Bedürfnisse deiner Gesprächspartner:innen zu verstehen und mit unserer Lösung zusammenzubringen

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

Humana Healthy Horizons is looking for a Senior Learning Design Professional who will use instructional design, cognitive psychology and adult learning theory to determine the appropriate solution to a knowledge or performance gap. Your work assignments involve moderately complex to complex issues where the analysis of situations or data requires an in-depth evaluation of variable factors.

The Senior Learning Design Professional will analyze and organize content. You will design best-in-class solutions, and write storyboards, scripts, performance support, mobile learning, and manuals. The goal of these efforts is to ensure success for associates and meet learning needs.

  • Facilitate Humana Healthy Horizons (HHH) organizational training and professional development topics to existing associates.
  • Design and analyze learning needs and partner with subject matter experts across the organization to provide input for course curriculum.
  • Ensure course materials are current and relevant to training needs, along with tracking and analyzing training programs effectiveness.
  • Provide consultation, feedback, instructions and partners with stakeholders across the enterprise.
  • Utilize collaborative tools to design and facilitate virtual learning.
  • Partner and use consultative skills to assess project scope and conduct needs analysis with stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with leadership to influence and assist in the execution of department's strategy.
  • Exercise considerable latitude in determining objectives and approaches to assignments.


Use your skills to make an impact

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent years of professional experience in learning design or learning facilitation.
  • Three (3) or more years of instructional design, training and/or learning development experience.
  • Experience facilitating training across diverse functions and levels of an organization to drive knowledge, adoption, and consistent execution.
  • Expert level experience with the Articulate 360 Suite.
  • Experience with learning strategies and adult learning theories.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Outlook, PowerPoint, and Adobe PDF.
  • Understanding of curriculum design includes gathering content SME's and utilizing adult learning principles.
  • Prior demonstrated capability leading, developing and maintaining a dynamic and high performing team culture.
  • Ability to work with agility and flexibility, embracing an ever-changing, fast-paced work environment.
  • Ability to facilitate and deliver an exceptional learning experience to all types of learners.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Medicaid knowledge, including experience interpreting Medicaid contracts.
  • Operations content design and facilitation experience.
  • Experience using a wide variety of training tools to effectively facilitate to a wide audience.
  • Experience managing projects or processes.
  • Expert organizational skills with fast turnaround time.

Additional Information

  • Workstyle: This is a remote position.
  • Travel: Your work will involve occasional travel, estimated at up to 5%, which may include travel to locations outside the associate's state of residence.
  • Typical Workdays/Hours: Monday – Friday; 8:00am -5:00pm, Eastern Time (ET).

We are seeking an articulate, highly organized, and dependable Virtual Front Desk & Patient Communications Coordinator to join our team in supporting a high-volume U.S. medical practice. In this front-line remote role, your primary focus will be managing inbound and outbound patient communications, coordinating provider schedules, and maintaining clean patient records. As a secondary responsibility, you will assist with verifying insurance eligibility and processing prior authorizations through payer portals.

Because this position requires extensive daily interaction with U.S. patients, medical staff, and insurance representatives over the phone, hands-on proficiency with AthenaOne EHR and exceptional, accent-neutral verbal English communication are absolute, non-negotiable requirements. You must be comfortable managing high call volumes via RingCentral, operating independently under standard practice protocols, and handling confidential patient records in full compliance with HIPAA regulations.

Working Environment & Core Schedule

  • Role Title: Virtual Front Desk & Patient Communications Coordinator
  • Status: Full-Time (40 Hours / Week)
  • Schedule: Monday – Friday, Standard U.S. Business Hours (e.g., 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST / CST / PST)
  • Core Technology Stack:AthenaOne EHR, RingCentral (VoIP & Messaging), Insurance Payer Portals, Secure Practice Email
