  1. Inbound/Outbound Call Management: Answer high-volume patient calls and voicemails via RingCentral, address routine inquiries, route clinical concerns to medical staff, and document phone interactions in AthenaOne.
  2. Patient Scheduling & Calendar Coordination: Book, reschedule, and confirm consultations and follow-up visits, follow up on no-shows/cancellations, and optimize provider schedules in AthenaOne.
  3. Insurance Eligibility & Prior Authorization Support: Perform real-time benefits verification, initiate and track prior authorization requests across payer portals, and log authorization status updates in AthenaOne.

Core Responsibilities

  • Patient Communications & Call Handling: Manage heavy phone call traffic via RingCentral, providing warm, professional, and clear verbal communication for scheduling, general practice inquiries, and follow-ups.
  • Appointment Scheduling: Execute patient scheduling in accordance with practice-specific provider rules, send pre-appointment instructions, and actively manage recall/wait lists.
  • Front Desk Records Administration: Collect and update patient demographic data, insurance information, and medical histories inside AthenaOne EHR, ensuring full data accuracy.
  • Insurance Eligibility & Benefits Verification: Verify commercial, Medicare, and Medicaid coverage prior to appointments to determine active benefits and patient cost-sharing responsibilities.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position: Quantity Surveyor

Salary: Php 70,000 to Php 80,000

Working Hours: Aligned with NZ Business Hours

Work Type: Independent Contractor

ABOUT THE COMPANY:

The company is an established New Zealand civil construction and earthworks business with over 35 years of industry excellence. Servicing residential and commercial projects across Auckland, the North Shore, and surrounding regions, the company specialises in comprehensive site development—including bulk earthworks, excavation, drainage infrastructure, site preparation, retaining systems, foundations, concrete works, and residential subdivisions. Backed by a rapidly expanding project pipeline, the company is committed to high-quality delivery, operational efficiency, and sustainable business growth.

ROLE OVERVIEW:

Working directly alongside the Company Director and Project Manager, the Quantity Surveyor / Civil Estimator will spearhead internal estimating and tendering operations. The primary objective is to take full ownership of quantity takeoffs, detailed Bills of Quantities (BOQs), cost schedules, and tender preparation.

This critical role is focused on driving turnaround efficiency, clearing enquiry backlogs, and transitioning externally subcontracted estimating functions directly in-house. It offers an exceptional long-term opportunity for a proactive professional with direct exposure to New Zealand or Australian construction standards to manage projects autonomously with high accuracy.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Quantity Surveying & Cost Estimation:

  • Prepare precise quantity takeoffs, BOQs, and first-principle cost estimates from structural, architectural, and civil drawings.
  • Accurately calculate costs for plant, machinery, materials, direct labour, and specialist subcontractor packages.
  • Compile and present competitive, professional tender packages and client quotations across residential and civil scopes.
  • Audit project drawings and specifications to pinpoint scope ambiguities, discrepancies, constructability risks, and potential variations.
  • Maintain clean, auditable estimating databases, rate libraries, and project documentation.

Civil Earthworks & Siteworks Pricing:

  • Price diverse scopes including site clearing, excavation, cut/fill balancing, grading, levelling, and compaction.
  • Estimate residential and commercial drainage packages, including stormwater and wastewater retention/detention infrastructure.
  • Cost underground service trenching, piling, drilling, foundations, and retaining wall installations.
  • Formulate accurate estimates for concrete flatwork, paving, driveways, residential subdivisions, and exterior works.

Project & Commercial Coordination:

  • Liaise with the Director and Project Manager to align on commercial strategy, margins, and pipeline priorities.
  • Solicit, review, and benchmark supplier and subcontractor bids to guarantee cost certainty.
  • Proactively follow up on RFIs, missing design documentation, and addenda.
  • Support post-tender negotiations, value engineering exercises, and initial client correspondence.

Requirements

  • Proven track record as a Quantity Surveyor, Civil Estimator, or Construction Cost Planner.
  • Minimum of 2 years of direct experience pricing projects within the Australian or New Zealand construction sectors.
  • Solid technical proficiency across civil earthworks, drainage, infrastructure siteworks, and residential structures.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently read, interpret, and mark up civil, architectural, and structural plans.
  • Hands-on proficiency with estimating software (Buildxact or Bluebeam).
  • Advanced capabilities in Microsoft Excel for complex cost modelling.

Senior Computer Vision / ML Engineer


Full-time | Remote | Australia


About the Business

LexisNexis Risk Solutions helps organizations assess and manage risk across identity verification, fraud prevention, financial crime compliance, credit risk, and customer data management.


About Our Team

IDVerse builds identity verification technology to fight fraud at global scale. Our systems must stay effective against evolving attacks including spoofing, deepfakes, injection attacks, and AI-generated fraud. We are a team of researchers and engineers who think from first principles, experiment rigorously, and invent new approaches as we continuously improve our systems.


What You'll Do

  • Research and invent: Investigate difficult problems in computer vision, biometrics, liveness, anti-spoofing, deepfake detection, generative AI, and adversarial attacks. Form hypotheses, run controlled experiments, and develop conclusions that can be trusted. Understand not only whether something works, but why it works, where it fails, and what to try next.
  • Red Team Mindset: Develop novel presentation, injection, deepfake, synthetic-media, and AI generated attacks against our systems. Build adversarial evaluations, expose weaknesses, understand their underlying causes, and develop robust defenses.
  • Build advanced CV/ML models: Design, train, evaluate, and optimize deep learning approaches across image, video, and multimodal data, applying techniques such as representation learning, transformers, generative models, 3D/geometric vision, where appropriate.
  • Own research through production: Take ideas from research and prototyping through benchmarking, optimization, deployment, and real-world evaluation.
  • Push the state of the art: Stay close to emerging computer vision and AI research, reproduce and challenge promising ideas, and identify opportunities to turn research advances into meaningful improvements to IDVerse products.

Required qualifications

  • Deep knowledge of computer vision, machine learning, and deep learning, backed by strong foundations in mathematics, statistics, optimization, or related disciplines.
  • Demonstrated ability to solve open-ended research and engineering problems, rather than only implementing established solutions.
  • Strong experience with Python and PyTorch or equivalent modern deep-learning
  • frameworks.
  • Experience designing controlled experiments, analyzing model behavior and failure modes, and evaluating models against challenging datasets.
  • Ability to translate research concepts into efficient, reliable production systems.
  • Strong software engineering fundamentals. Experience with C/C++, CUDA, TensorRT, ONNX.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Mathematics,
  • Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent demonstrated expertise.

Highly Desirable

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in computer vision, machine learning, AI, mathematics, or a related field.
  • Publications, patents, significant open-source contributions, competition results, or other evidence of original technical or research contributions.
  • Experience with biometrics, liveness / presentation attack detection, deepfakes, synthetic media, adversarial ML, or AI security.
  • Red-team or adversarial research experience, particularly discovering novel ways to attack, manipulate, or stress-test ML/CV systems.
  • Familiarity with biometric security and presentation-attack standards such as ISO/IEC 30107.

Location and collaboration

The team is remote and globally distributed. Candidates must have full working rights in Australia.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
PLEASE NOTE: This job is open to applicants in the Philippines only.

Full-time, 30 to 40 Hours/Week (US business hours)

Salary: $6/Hour

Job Title: Medical Virtual Assistant (Credentialing)

We are hiring a Medical Virtual Assistant with hands-on credentialing experience. You will own provider enrollment and credentialing from start to finish: Medicare enrollment through PECOS, commercial payer applications, CAQH upkeep and re-credentialing deadlines. This role is for an experienced credentialing specialist. It is not an entry-level Medical VA role.

Responsibilities:

  • Prepare, submit and track Medicare enrollments in PECOS: initial enrollments, revalidations, reassignments (CMS-855I, 855B, 855R), changes of information and practice location updates.
  • Manage NPPES records: apply for and update NPIs (Type 1 and Type 2), and keep taxonomy codes and addresses accurate.
  • Manage CMS Identity & Access (I&A) connections and surrogacy so providers and staff have the right PECOS access.
  • Complete commercial payer credentialing and contracting applications (e.g., UnitedHealthcare, Aetna, Cigna, BCBS, Humana) and state Medicaid enrollments.
  • Create, update and re-attest CAQH ProView profiles, and authorize payer access.
  • Follow up with payers by phone, email and portal until each application is approved, then record effective dates and provider IDs.
  • Track licenses, DEA, board certifications, malpractice insurance and other expiring documents, and start renewals and re-credentialing before deadlines.
  • Keep a credentialing tracker and provider files current, and send regular status reports to the client.
  • Handle hospital privileging and facility credentialing paperwork when needed.
  • Work with billing teams to resolve enrollment-related claim denials.
  • Protect provider and patient information and follow HIPAA rules at all times.

Requirements

  • Experience as a Credentialing Specialist or Provider Enrollment Specialist for US healthcare providers.
  • Hands-on PECOS experience: you have submitted Medicare enrollments and revalidations yourself.
  • Working knowledge of CAQH ProView, NPPES and CMS I&A.
  • Experience with commercial payer credentialing and at least one state Medicaid enrollment.
  • Strong attention to detail. One wrong date or missing document can delay an approval by weeks.
  • Organized, persistent follow-up habits, with comfort calling US payers.
  • Excellent written and spoken English.
  • Reliable home office setup: a stable internet connection, a backup connection and a quiet workspace.
  • Willing to work US business hours.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
What success looks like in this role:

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide day-to-day support for middleware platforms [Oracle WebLogic, Apache Tomcat, JBoss/WildFly, IBM MQ, Apache/IIS], including installation, configuration, upgrades and troubleshooting.
  • Lead vulnerability fixes for middleware components: review scan findings, prioritize by risk, and apply patches, version upgrades, configuration changes and hardening.

  • Plan and implement new releases, updates and corrections to middleware and related applications.
  • Develop and maintain scripts and automation [Bash, Python, WLST, Ansible] to streamline patching, vulnerability fixes, deployments and routine operational tasks.
  • Evaluate, recommend and maintain monitoring and management tools.
  • Contribute to middleware projects, capacity planning and service improvements as capacity permits.
  • Explain technical issues and risks clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Maintain documentation, runbooks and knowledge articles.

Your ability to create positive experiences will significantly impact student enrollment and retention. . Admissions Counselor:

jobs.title: Senior Advisor, Data Management & Governance
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Cardinal Health’s Data Office organization empowers the enterprise with trusted, high-quality data to make informed decisions and achieve strategic goals by enabling a data-driven ecosystem where data is a strategic asset.​


The Data Management & Governance function serves as the operational backbone and quality engine of the Data Office. The team acquires, standardizes, and protects enterprise and third-party data to power clinical, commercial, and financial decisions while meeting rigorous regulatory and legal standards. Through clear guidelines, quality metrics, and policy enforcement, the team ensures enterprise data remains trusted, secure, and audit ready.


The Senior Advisor, Data Management & Governance leverages advanced clinical pharmacotherapy knowledge, regulatory acumen, and data stewardship principles to oversee enterprise pharmaceutical master data assets. This role is accountable for clinical and regulatory classifications, alternative logic, formulary alignments, and the procurement and integration of third-party data. By driving cross-functional data governance and quality frameworks, this role ensures data flowing across procurement, billing, inventory, and dispensing pipelines is clinically validated, compliant, and operationalized for decision making.


Responsibilities:

  • Establish, standardize, and govern critical clinical and product attributes across the master data lifecycle
  • Author and maintain data dictionaries, business rules, policies, standards, and validation logic to ensure data integrity during item setup, maintenance, and system conversions
  • Lead the strategic alignment of product attributes with industry-standard clinical vocabularies
  • Manage clinical, regulatory, commercial, and reimbursement inquiries and execute resolution activities
  • Resolve complex data exceptions, discrepancies, and cross-reference mapping errors
  • Evaluate regulatory changes and manufacturer notices to assess their operational, clinical, and data impact
  • Oversee the procurement, ingestion, transformation, linkage, and maintenance of third-party data and associated reference data
  • Collaborate and partner with business leaders to translate strategic objectives and business process and regulatory requirements into scalable solutions across multiple domains (e.g., CSMP, QRA, Finance, Sourcing, Revenue Management, IT, Commercial Technologies, Customer Success, and Account Management)
  • Validate external data for accuracy, completeness, and timeliness and convert unstructured data to structured data for ease of use
  • Create data views and reports that promote data quality, business insights, and enable accuracy and efficiency for downstream users
  • Lead and support data modernization initiatives
  • Subject matter expert for clinical and product datasets

Qualifications:

  • Must have an active, unrestricted Registered Pharmacist (RPh) license in good standing in at least one U.S. jurisdiction, State of Ohio, preferred
  • Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm.D.) or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy (B.S. Pharm) from an accredited college of pharmacy preferred
  • 8+ years of experience in related field preferred
  • 8+ years in hospital or retail pharmacy, both preferred
  • Experience in clinical pharmacy practice, pharmacy informatics, healthcare data stewardship, or pharmaceutical supply chain master data
  • Prior experience with pharmaceutical compendia
  • Direct experience with enterprise master data management systems or ERP solutions

jobs.title: Energy Engineer - Measurement & Verification
jobs.descriptionHtml:
AlphaGov delivers public-sector consulting for cities, counties, school systems, special districts, utilities, and related agencies. Our work spans classification and compensation, organizational and operational studies, research and program evaluation, economic and workforce analysis, surveys and community research, and applied data and infrastructure research.

We engage experienced practitioners as project-based collaborators. Engagements are remote-first with occasional client travel. When you authorize it, AlphaGov may name you as an expert collaborator or key personnel on proposals that match your expertise. We build ready teams for live pursuits - not speculative staffing banks.

AlphaGov is building a bench of energy engineers who measure and verify savings from building efficiency, weatherization, heat pump, and electrification programs for state energy offices, public service departments, and utilities. You would lead the engineering side of program evaluations, from site measurement to savings calculations.

We confirm scope, schedule, and fee with you before any engagement begins.

What you'll do

  • Develop measurement and verification plans using IPMVP options and program technical reference manuals (TRMs)
  • Conduct or oversee site visits, metering, and data logging for heating, cooling, and building envelope measures
  • Build building energy models and engineering savings calculations for thermal and electric measures
  • Review TRM algorithms, deemed savings values, and baseline assumptions
  • Calibrate engineering estimates against billing and interval data with evaluation analysts
  • Write the engineering sections of evaluation reports and answer regulator questions
  • Contribute qualifications and past-performance narrative to AlphaGov proposals when you authorize naming

Apply to be considered.

Requirements

Required

  • At least 5 years in energy engineering, energy auditing, or M&V for efficiency or electrification programs
  • Building energy modeling experience (for example eQUEST, EnergyPlus, BEopt, or similar)
  • Working knowledge of IPMVP and technical reference manuals
  • Comfortable as a 1099 project-based consultant

Nice to have

  • PE, CMVP, or CEM credential
  • Residential retrofit, weatherization, or heat pump program experience
  • Vermont, New York, or New England program experience

Job Title: Sr. Director, Digital Pricing Strategy

Job Location: Remote

Job Location Type: Remote

Job Contract Type: Full-time

Job Seniority Level:

Job Description Summary

GE HealthCare is undergoing a significant customer and business model transformation, driven by the acquisition of Intelerad and the expansion of innovative software, SaaS, and cloud-based solutions. These solutions are designed to address some of the most complex challenges in the healthcare industry.

This role is a critical leadership position supporting GE HealthCare’s transition to a SaaS-first software business model. As part of a global, cross-functional environment, the Sr. Director of Digital Pricing Strategy will define and operationalize pricing and monetization strategies across newly integrated organizations. This role will play a key part in aligning commercial, finance, and product teams while driving profitable growth and long-term scalability.

Job Description

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Pricing Design

Develop and lead global pricing strategies for SaaS and cloud-based offerings, ensuring alignment with overall business objectives across AI, digital, and enterprise software solutions. Drive pricing transformation as core products evolve to a cloud-first model.

SaaS Monetization & Business Model Transformation

Lead the design and implementation of modern SaaS monetization strategies, including ARR growth, net revenue retention (NRR), attach rate expansion, price realization, and margin optimization. Drive the evolution from legacy licensing models to scalable subscription, consumption, and platform-based pricing models.

Post-Acquisition Integration & Change Leadership

Partner across legacy organizations to harmonize pricing strategies, tools, and operating models following the Intelerad acquisition. Lead change management efforts to ensure adoption of new pricing frameworks and foster alignment across commercial, finance, and product teams.

Analyze market trends, competitor pricing, and customer insights to inform pricing strategy. Stay current on industry trends, regulatory environments, and best practices in SaaS and healthcare software markets.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

Collaborate closely with Sales, Finance, Product Management, Legal, Professional Services, and Marketing to ensure pricing strategies align with go-to-market objectives. Engage early in product development cycles to incorporate customer value and market needs into pricing models.

Product Pricing & Enterprise Structuring

Partner with product teams to design scalable pricing structures across multi-product portfolios. Ensure pricing models support enterprise agreements spanning multiple offerings, customer segments, and healthcare modalities.

Platform & Advanced Pricing Models

Develop and implement modern SaaS pricing approaches, including platform pricing, subscription models, consumption-based pricing, and outcome-based pricing for strategic enterprise customers. Utilize advanced pricing analytics, segmentation, and elasticity modeling.

Deal Structuring & Commercial Execution

Provide hands-on leadership in structuring complex enterprise deals, including pricing, packaging, and multi-solution offerings. Translate pricing strategy into actionable sales tools, guidance, and scalable frameworks to support field execution.

Performance Forecasting & Financial Partnership

Collaborate with Finance to develop revenue forecasts, financial models, and KPI tracking frameworks for SaaS products. Ensure pricing decisions directly support margin expansion and long-term profitability.

This position plays a key role in ensuring accounting and finance technology solutions effectively support organizational objectives, regulatory requirements, and operational efficiency.

    • Coordinate system configuration changes, testing activities, and implementation plans.

As Senior Occupancy Planner, you will be responsible for providing strategic occupancy planning expertise, leveraging a deep understanding of our client’s space supply and demand to develop scenario and occupancy plans for our client's portfolio in a designated region.

Fostering relationships

You'll foster critical relationships between various individuals and organizations, including:

  • Corporate Real Estate to review and resolve planning forecast requirements, concerns, and issues,
  • Business Unit leadership to collect headcount forecasts and resolve headcount forecast discrepancies between their numbers and those collected at the group level,
  • Corporate Finance group to gather top-down headcount and growth projections,
  • Project management to review planning strategies that drive construction projects and support the implementation of these projects,
  • Move coordination and facility management teams to review and approve moves, develop migration plans, and conduct facility audits, and
  • Other members of the occupancy planning team to ensure the development of portfolio strategy plans across separate locations.

Driving optimal occupancy planning solutions

Your primary focus areas for this role will be managing the development of occupancy plans, sequencing group-level and individual moves, and resolving planning issues identified during client planning sessions. You will ensure the alignment of planning with corporate guidelines and that all scenarios maximize the use of space. You will recommend, educate, and enforce space policies/standards, procedures, and protocols, notify the client of customer-requested exceptions, and, as necessary, assist in developing site-specific Planning Strategies with Senior Leadership. You will be a Subject Matter Expert in the client's workplace program and in using data to drive solutions that increase productivity. You will be a leader in the Occupancy Planning and account team, modelling superior client relationship management and strategic thinking.

Reporting

One of your major requirements will be to get familiar with space utilization methods and the presentation of utilization data. Interacting with organizational leadership, you will identify space requirements and prepare and update project status reports on actual versus projected seat demand at the building level. In addition, you will report on current supply and capacity, forecast inventory changes as required, and work with the client to reconcile any discrepancies from top-down projections.

jobs.title: Automation Engineer - Patching
jobs.descriptionHtml:
What success looks like in this role:

U.S. Citizenship and Residency Required


Job Summary:

We are seeking a motivated Automation Engineer with 3-5 years of experience to replace repetitive manual tasks across our Steady State teams (Windows, Linux, Storage, and Backup) with reliable, reusable automation. The role focuses on automating patch management across the environment using tools such as Ansible, GitLab CI/CD, HashiCorp Vault, Terraform, and the JFrog Artifactory suite (Xray, Catalog, and Curation).


Key Responsibilities:

  • Partner with Windows, Linux, storage, and backup teams to understand patch management cycles and identify opportunities to automate patching activities.
  • Analyze ServiceNow patching tickets to identify recurring manual tasks and quantify their frequency and effort across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Prioritize patch management automation opportunities based on patch severity, operational risk, and impact across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Develop reusable Ansible playbooks and roles to automate patch management procedures
  • Use Terraform to maintain repeatable infrastructure configurations that support patch management workflows.
  • Build and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines to package, test, and safely deploy patch management automation to production.
  • Manage secrets, credentials, and certificates required by automated patching workflows through HashiCorp Vault.
  • Use JFrog Artifactory, including Xray, Catalog, and Curation, to manage and secure artifacts used by patch management pipelines.
  • Validate automated patching workflows against existing manual procedures before replacing manual patching activities.
  • Track and report on patch automation coverage and reductions in manual patching effort and related ticket volume across Windows, Linux, storage, and backup systems.
  • Document patch management procedures, Ansible playbooks, and pipeline configurations for Windows, Linux, storage, and backup environments.
  • Regularly review patching ticket trends to identify recurring manual work and keep the patch automation backlog current.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience and 3-5 years of experience in infrastructure operations, patch management, or related engineering roles, including patching automation.
  • Hands-on experience using Ansible, Terraform, GitLab CI/CD, and HashiCorp Vault to support production patch management workflows.
  • Experience analyzing patching tickets and incident data in ServiceNow or a similar ITSM tool to identify recurring issues and opportunities to improve patch delivery.
  • Ability to gather patching requirements from operations teams and translate patch cycles and procedures into repeatable workflows.
  • Working knowledge of Windows and Linux systems administration, storage, and backup operations, with experience supporting patch management across these environments.
  • Strong scripting skills in Bash, Python, PowerShell, or similar languages to automate patching tasks and validation.

Unisys offers an outstanding benefits package, featuring unlimited paid time off, a 401(k) plan, comprehensive healthcare, HSA matching, ongoing learning opportunities, and more! We’re committed to supporting work-life balance and investing in your future success.

At Unisys, we incorporate video interviews as a key part of our hiring process. This allows us to get to know you better and provide a more engaging and convenient interview experience. We appreciate your understanding and look forward to connecting with you virtually!

The Company is vertically integrated, with offices in Los Angeles, Riverside, San Francisco, San Diego, Seattle, Phoenix, Austin, Dallas, and Houston, and is able to acquire and close transactions without the need for lengthy due diligence periods. jobs.descriptionHtml:
ICF is seeking experienced emergency management professionals to join our Disaster Response Logistics Section Reservist Cadre. This is an On-Call position supporting the ICS Logistics Section responsible for providing support for facilities, supplies, resources and services needed to enable incident operations to meet objectives. Assignments are activated based on project and disaster operational needs and may involve deployments to Emergency Operations Centers (EOCs), Joint Field Offices (JFOs), Disaster Recovery Centers (DRCs), client sites, field locations, or remote environments. Deployment opportunities are not guaranteed and may vary in duration, location, and frequency.

Reservists are typically activated for disaster events, emergency exercises, planning projects, and surge support requirements. Candidates should be prepared to deploy with limited notice, work flexible schedules that may include evenings, weekends, and holidays, and support incident operations in dynamic and fast-paced environments.

About On-Call Employment with ICF
Due to the seasonal or project-specific nature of our disaster and emergency management work, ICF hires professionals as "On-Call" employees. On-Call employees are scheduled for work as it becomes available, with the freedom to accept or decline assignments. Individuals may work on concurrent projects outside of their ICF assignments, provided there is no conflict of interest.

Key Responsibilities
• Support the ordering, tracking, deployment, and accountability of personnel, equipment, supplies, and other resources, including monitoring resource utilization, identifying shortages, and maintaining situational awareness of operational needs.
• Coordinate logistics activities that support emergency response and recovery operations, including transportation, facilities, communications, equipment, responder sustainment, lodging, and food services.
• Support Emergency Operations Center (EOC) activations, operational briefings, planning meetings, and incident management activities while assisting with documentation, reporting, and information sharing.
• Coordinate with Operations, Planning, Finance & Administration, Command Staff, vendors, contractors, and partner organizations to support incident objectives and operational priorities.
• Assist with the establishment and operation of emergency management facilities, ensuring workspace, communications, equipment, technology, and support services meet mission requirements.
• Support deployment readiness, disaster recovery operations, resource planning, operational transitions, and logistical requirements for field teams and stakeholders.
• Apply National Incident Management System (NIMS) and Incident Command System (ICS) principles in support of emergency response and recovery operations.

Location: Remote, Philippines
Client location: Abu Dhabi, United Arab Emirates
Engagement: Independent contractor through OutsourcedIn
Hours: Full time, 10 am to 6 pm UAE time (2 pm to 10 pm Philippine time)

Qualification: CFA Level II candidate or recently qualified

Every investment decision at this firm rests on a paper someone prepared carefully: a model that has been stress tested, diligence that states what could not be verified, and a closing file with every executed document in place. If you enjoy taking a deal from first screen through to a clean closing record, this role will feel familiar.

OutsourcedIn is recruiting an Investment Associate to support a lean, regulated investment firm in Abu Dhabi. You will work closely with the firm's Chief Operating Officer, Chief Executive Officer and Chief Financial Officer across deal execution, analysis, investor reporting and the operational work that keeps every investment vehicle properly recorded.

About Our Client

Our client is a regulated investment firm based in Abu Dhabi. It specialises in late stage technology companies, including businesses preparing for a public listing, across artificial intelligence, compute infrastructure, space, deeptech and fintech. Investors gain access to these companies through special purpose vehicles (SPVs) built to institutional standards.

The firm serves sovereign wealth funds, financial institutions, family offices and professional investors. It is now upgrading its licence to launch a series of pooled funds across private equity, venture capital and real estate.

The team is deliberately small and does institutional grade work. People here own an area from start to finish, document what they build so someone else can run it, and say plainly when something cannot be evidenced. Everyone works across more than their own discipline, and the structure is designed to make that collaboration work.

The Role

This role provides the analytical, transactional and communications support behind a lean investment team. You will support the origination, evaluation, execution and monitoring of investments across the firm, its funds and its SPVs, from first screen through SPV establishment and completion, then into ongoing portfolio and investor reporting.

You will report to the Chief Operating Officer, with a dotted line to the Chief Executive Officer. You will have no direct reports, but you will check the work of analysts before it moves on and explain your corrections rather than simply making them.

This is a hands on role. You will run workstreams and prepare recommendations. Investment decisions, fund releases, valuations and public statements are approved by others, as set out below.

Deal execution

Analysis and modelling

  • Carry out commercial, market and counterparty due diligence.
  • State clearly in every recommendation what could not be verified, so no decision rests on an unstated gap.

Purpose 

Delta Faucet Company is seeking a Salesforce Solution Architect to serve as the design authority for our Salesforce ecosystem within the Channel, Experience & Portfolio function of IT. This is a customer-side architecture role — you will partner closely with business leaders to shape the platform according to our roadmap, own how it evolves over multiple years, and guide its direction beyond how any single project is coded. 


Our environment spans B2B, B2C and B2B2C: wholesale distributors, trade professionals, retail partners, e-commerce and direct consumer service, supported by Sales Cloud, Service Cloud, Experience Cloud, Marketing Cloud, Data Cloud and CPQ/Revenue Cloud, integrated to ERP, PIM/DAM and analytics platforms. You will act as trusted advisor to business partners, set the architectural direction, and hold internal and third-party delivery teams accountable to that direction. 


You will succeed here if you enjoy owning the long-term integrity of a platform inside the company that runs it.

What Success Looks Like in Year One 

  • Within 90 days: You have documented the current-state Salesforce architecture, data model and integration landscape, and identified the top technical-debt risks with a remediation point of view. 
  • Within 6 months: You are the recognized design authority on all Channel & Experience initiatives — no significant design decision, internal or vendor-proposed, moves forward without your review. 
  • Within 12 months: A published multi-year platform architecture roadmap is in place and aligned to enterprise architecture standards; measurable reduction in custom code and rework on delivered releases; business partners come to you early, not after requirements are frozen. 

Key Responsibilities and Duties 

  • Design Authority: Own end-to-end solution design across multiple Salesforce Clouds — object and data model, security and sharing, automation strategy, and integration patterns — balancing near-term delivery against long-term maintainability. 
  • Roadmap Ownership: Translate business strategy into a multi-year platform architecture roadmap; recommend build vs. buy vs. configure, and sequence capability delivery accordingly. 
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Act as trusted advisor to Sales, Marketing, Customer Solutions and channel partners; challenge requirements constructively and translate them into technical specifications. 
  • Technical Leadership: Guide internal and partner development teams on best practices, data modeling, automation and API integration; lead design reviews rather than perform hands-on build. 
  • Vendor Governance: Provide architectural oversight of third-party delivery partners and systems integrators — validate that proposed solutions leverage out-of-the-box functionality wherever possible, and hold external partners accountable to industry best practices, security protocols and our standards. 
  • Documentation & Governance: Maintain architecture artifacts and decision records; establish and enforce standards that minimize technical debt. 
  • Emerging Capability: Evaluate new platform capability — including Data Cloud, generative and agentic AI such as Agentforce — and form a defensible point of view on where it creates value while protecting brand, privacy and governance standards. 
  • Validation: Use prototypes and proof-of-concepts, built personally or directed through the team, to de-risk significant design decisions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
What success looks like in this role:

The Senior Manager, Procurement Contracting, reporting to the Director of Procurement Contracting, leads contract drafting, negotiation, redlining, and support for supplier agreements across Unisys. This role ensures that contractual terms align with enterprise policies and risk standards by working closely with Category Managers, the Legal team, and Commercial Contract Managers (CCMs). The Senior Manager plays a key role in standardizing contract language, accelerating negotiation timelines, and maintaining version control through Unisys’s contract management systems.


What Success Looks Like in this Role

  • Draft and redline supplier contracts including MSAs, SOWs, NDAs, and licensing agreements using approved clause libraries and fallback language.
  • Collaborate with Legal and CCMs to ensure alignment with enterprise legal policies and client flow downs.
  • Support procurement category teams in executing timely, accurate supplier agreements.
  • Manage contract versions, comments, and approvals using Agiloft (CLM system).
  • Escalate legal or risk-related terms when needed and follow through on stakeholder feedback.
  • Maintain up-to-date contract templates, clause playbooks, and guidance materials.
  • Contribute to the development of a standardized and scalable Contracting CoE model.

You Will Be Successful in This Role If You Have

  • Proficiency in redlining contracts and applying pre-approved clause positions.
  • Attention to detail and strong organizational skills for managing multiple agreements.
  • Comfort working cross-functionally with Legal, Procurement, and Commercial teams.
  • Familiarity with contract lifecycle management (CLM) platforms like Agiloft or DocuSign CLM.
  • Exposure to AI-based contract analysis tools (e.g., clause suggestion engines or auto-redlining assistants) is a plus.
  • Ability to interpret and apply company policy to complex commercial terms.
  • Ability to speak Spanish, Portuguese, and English.

You will be successful in this role if you have:

  • Bachelor's degree from an accredited institution.
  • Law degree from an accredited law school strongly preferred.
  • Certification in contract management or procurement (e.g., CPCM, CPSM) is a plus.
  • Have experience in the activities described

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are hiring a Senior Full-stack Developer. You will build and ship new products across a portfolio of companies. You work from the backlog alongside your team, and you manage your own day-to-day work. You also help our digital marketing agency with technical needs from time to time. The work happens in TypeScript and JavaScript stacks, with AWS and mobile app releases as part of the work.

About Us

New products here start on Lovable and similar platforms so we can test them fast. The ones that work get taken over with time, which means moving the code, the infrastructure, and the app store accounts into our own hands. As our first hire, you are how that handoff begins, and you set the technical foundation the rest of the team builds on.

What You Will Do

  1. Build and Ship Production Code. You write and own full-stack code in React, TypeScript, and Node.js, and you take products from AI-generated prototypes into production.
  2. Make Sure Stakeholders Never Find a Bug. You test your work before it reaches a stakeholder. That means writing automated tests, testing on web and on real iOS and Android devices, and releasing only when it holds up.
  3. Rapid AI Prototyping and Development. You use our AI-assisted workflows (Lovable, Cursor, and emerging AI agents) to spin up and validate feature prototypes quickly. Then you carry them into full engineering production, including the call on when a product has outgrown its starter platform and needs to move to our own codebase and AWS setup.
  4. Hands-on Architecture and Code Review. You review code, diagnose build bottlenecks, and directly program code overrides or refinements when AI generation tools hit their limits. You set the technical standards so the output stays clean, type-safe, and scalable.
  5. Work From Specs and Sharpen Them. You build from the specs and acceptance criteria written by our product manager and stakeholders. When you spot a gap, you raise it early and propose a solution.
  6. Ship Mobile Releases. You manage App Store and Google Play submissions, review responses, and release schedules for our mobile apps.
  7. Support the Agency. You help with the agency's technical needs as they come up, including AWS accounts, hosting, access, software costs, and the technical side of client projects.

Tech Stack

  • React, TypeScript, and Node.js, front end and back end
  • Supabase and PostgreSQL for application back ends and databases
  • AWS for hosting and infrastructure
  • Data warehouse storage for reporting and analytics
  • AI-assisted development with Lovable, Cursor, Windsurf, v0, and emerging AI agents, where most new products begin
  • WordPress for marketing sites, hosted on Cloudways
  • iOS and Android app releases through the App Store and Google Play

  • Deep Coding Expertise: 7+ years of hands-on full-stack development experience (React, TypeScript, Node.js, and Supabase/PostgreSQL). You have the technical authority to audit other developers' work and enforce structural code quality.
  • Self-Directed Work: You manage your own time and priorities, take direction once, and carry it through without needing a manager to check on you.

Role Overview - Chief Financial Officer (CFO)

Seeking an experienced, hands-on CFO to lead financial operations, strengthen financial controls, and oversee the transition from our existing in-house financial platform to QuickBooks Online (QBO).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Você vai apoiar as iniciativas de melhoria da postura de segurança do ambiente AWS que sustenta os produtos financeiros da RecargaPay. Você terá autonomia para conduzir a segurança em nuvem de ponta a ponta: identificar e reduzir riscos de configuração e de acesso, responder a incidentes, embutir controles na infraestrutura como código e nos pipelines e manter o ambiente em conformidade com as melhores práticas e exigências regulatórias. Tudo isso lado a lado com os times de infraestrutura e engenharia, com um objetivo claro: fazer da segurança algo que acelera a entrega, não algo que a trava.

RESPONSABILIDADES

Gerir a postura de segurança das contas AWS (Control Tower, Organizations, SCPs, Security Hub, Config, GuardDuty), priorizando os achados críticos e conduzindo a correção com os times de engenharia até o fechamento.

Revisar e endurecer políticas IAM, roles e acessos entre contas, aplicando menor privilégio e eliminando credenciais estáticas e permissões excessivas.

Investigar e responder a alertas e incidentes de segurança na nuvem (CloudTrail, GuardDuty, VPC Flow Logs), conduzindo triagem, contenção e post-mortem.

Incorporar controles de segurança à infraestrutura como código (Terraform) e aos pipelines de CI/CD: revisão de mudanças, policy-as-code e scanning de IaC e de imagens.

Proteger workloads containerizados e serverless (EKS/ECS, Lambda): baseline de imagens, gestão de segredos e segmentação de rede.

Produzir e manter evidências de controles para auditorias e requisitos regulatórios (PCI DSS, Banco Central, LGPD) em conjunto com Compliance.

Automatizar detecções e remediações recorrentes, reduzindo trabalho manual e o tempo de correção.

Documentar padrões e guardrails de segurança na AWS e orientar engenheiros na adoção de práticas seguras.

Requirements

Formação superior completa; desejável pós-graduação. Experiência de 4+ anos em Information Security.

Histórico comprovado de entregas de alto impacto.

Experiência sólida em segurança da informação, com pelo menos 3 anos protegendo ambientes AWS em produção.

Domínio de IAM da AWS (políticas, roles, SCPs, acessos entre contas) e dos serviços nativos de segurança: GuardDuty, Security Hub, CloudTrail, Config e KMS.

Conhecimento de AWS Control Tower: landing zone, controles preventivos e detectivos, Account Factory e governança de contas em ambiente multi-conta.

Conhecimento de melhores práticas de segurança em nuvem e de frameworks de referência, como o CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark e o AWS Security Maturity Model.

Experiência prática com Terraform (ou outra IaC) e com segurança em pipelines de CI/CD. Vivência em investigação e resposta a incidentes em ambientes de nuvem.

Capacidade de automatizar tarefas de segurança com Python, Bash ou linguagem similar. Diferencial: experiência em fintech, meios de pagamento ou outro ambiente regulado (PCI DSS, Banco Central).

Diferencial: segurança de Kubernetes/EKS e containers.

Diferencial: experiência com SIEM e criação de regras de detecção.

Diferencial: certificações como AWS Certified Security – Specialty ou CCSP. Diferencial: inglês e espanhol intermediários.

Benefits

  • Salário competitivo e alinhado ao mercado.
  • Trabalho remoto — esteja onde estiver, você faz parte do time!
  • Auxílio home office com um depósito mensal no app RecargaPay.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico sem coparticipação.
  • Seguro de vida.
  • Vale-refeição flexível (via Flash).
  • TotalPass para cuidar da sua saúde

The Electrical Designer will support the preparation and updating of electrical drawings and design documentation for industrial plant modifications and improvement works. The role will work closely with electrical engineers, other engineering disciplines and site stakeholders to translate engineering requirements and verified site information into clear, coordinated and constructible design deliverables. This position would suit a practical designer with experience in electrical drafting and design for industrial, manufacturing, mining, minerals processing, utilities or similar facilities. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Prepare and update electrical drawings, layouts, schematics, single-line diagrams and installation details. * Assist with the preparation of cable schedules, equipment schedules, material take-offs and other electrical design deliverables. * Update existing and as-built drawings using information collected during site inspections and field verification activities. * Support electrical engineers in developing design solutions for plant modifications, equipment installations and brownfield works. * Review existing drawings and site information to identify inconsistencies, missing information and potential design interfaces. * Participate in site inspections and field verification activities. * Coordinate electrical drawings with mechanical, process, civil, structural, instrumentation and other engineering disciplines. * Incorporate design-review comments and maintain accurate drawing revisions. * Apply project drafting standards, document-control requirements and Beca quality procedures. * Support constructability reviews and respond to drawing-related queries during implementation. * Maintain clear records of design inputs, assumptions, changes and outstanding information. Our clients from Indonesia: Astra International, Traveloka, Angkasa Pura, Peduli Anak Foundation. Our clients from Australia: Bike Exchange, Downsizing, Red Balloon, Sectara, and many more. **What will you get?** * **Competitive Salary.** We believe that salary is one of the main factors that keep the employee in the company, therefore we can guarantee a competitive salary for our Staff. * **Career Development & Training.** We have a wonderful onboarding process where we help new team members get familiar with how we work. * **Reasonable & Flexible Schedules.** We are encouraging a culture where people can have a good work-life balance. Our schedules are pretty flexible. Need to run an errand in the middle of the day? Totally cool. * **English Class.** Working in SoftwareSeni means that you would get massive improvement in your English, both spoken and written guarantee! * **Annual Leave entitlement.** 12 working days which can be taken after 3 months of joining. * **Performance Review**. We will review your performance twice annually in December and June. So, you can focus on your work and improve your performance every day. * **Relocation Allowance.** We provide a relocation allowance if you do not live in Yogyakarta. The allowance will cover moving costs for you and your family. * **Staff Engagement Activities.** We provide fun icebreaker activities in the middle of our working hours to chill and build relationships with all the staff. Sounds fun, right? * **Birthday Leave.** We also want to celebrate our staff's happiest day by giving them half-day leave on their birthday. **Skills & Requirement :** * **5+ years** of experience with React.js development. * Expertise in **Next.js** and its core concepts (SSR, static generation, routing, etc.) * Strong knowledge of **JavaScript/TypeScript**. * Proficiency in **HTML5, CSS3**, and responsive design. * Experience with event-driven programming and handling asynchronous data flows (e.g., API calls, Promises) * Solid understanding of software engineering practices, including: * Familiarity with Git and collaborative development workflows (e.g., feature branching, pull requests) * **Strong communication skills in English, both written and spoken.** * **Willing to work onsite at our Yogyakarta office.** **Responsibility :** * Develop SoftwareSeni's products. * Work as a team to investigate and resolve issues. * **Note**: This position requires fluency in English, as most communication will be conducted in English. If you're confident (or eager to grow) in using English at work, this position could be a great fit. **Disclaimer**: By submitting your application, you consent to PT Software Services Indonesia collecting and processing your information for recruitment purposes. **Please submit only your CV/resume at this stage; do not attach additional personal identification or sensitive documents**. Your details will be treated with strict confidentiality and used solely to evaluate your application for current or future employment opportunities with us.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: Bangkok, Thailand, Khon Kaen, Thailand Full-time Permanent employee **What We Need** ---------------- Oivan is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to own the platform that runs our internal technology, including the AI agents we build and operate for ourselves. You will report directly to the CTO and shape how Oivan ships, runs and secures its own systems. This is an internal technology role, not a client delivery position. You will build and run the platform behind Oivan's own products and internal systems, the pipelines, clusters, cloud infrastructure and observability that everything else depends on. A large part of the work is deploying and operating AI agents. Oivan builds AI into its own operations, and you will be the engineer who takes those agents from a working prototype to something that runs reliably in production, with the model endpoints, orchestration, data stores, guardrails and monitoring that requires. You report directly to the CTO, which means you have a real say in platform direction, technology choices and build-versus-buy decisions. We are looking for someone who is comfortable owning a problem end to end rather than waiting for a ticket. We are offering relocation to **Khon Kaen** for people interested. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Design, build and operate the CI/CD pipelines and deployment platform for Oivan's internal applications and services. * Deploy, run and monitor AI agents and LLM-backed services in production, model endpoints, orchestration layers, vector stores, evaluation and the guardrails around them. * Own our Kubernetes clusters end to end: provisioning, upgrades, autoscaling, networking, ingress, secrets and workload management. * Manage cloud infrastructure, with clear cost visibility and sensible guardrails. * Build observability that people actually use, metrics, logs, traces, alerting and dashboards. * Automate everything repeatable with Infrastructure as Code. * Harden the platform: identity and access, secrets management, network policy, patching and vulnerability management. * Support the internal front-ends and the services behind them through build, release and runtime. * Work with the CTO on platform roadmap, tooling decisions and where we build versus buy. * Act as the escalation point for internal platform incidents, and drive the follow-up that stops them recurring. **What You Have** ----------------- Must have * 5+ years in DevOps, platform engineering or SRE, operating at strong medior to senior level. * Hands-on Kubernetes in production, GKE, EKS or on-premise. Not just deploying to a managed cluster, but owning it * CI/CD ownership — designing and running pipelines, not only using them. * Infrastructure as Code — Terraform, Pulumi or equivalent. * Cloud platform experience at production scale. * Linux administration and scripting — Bash and Python. * Containers and registries — Docker, image hygiene, supply chain basics. * Observability — Prometheus, Grafana, centralized logging and alerting. * Secrets management and identity across services and environments. * Networking fundamentals — DNS, TLS, load balancing, firewalls. * Advanced English and strong communication. You will work directly with the CTO and across teams, and you will be expected to explain technical decisions clearly to non-specialists. * Based in Thailand, able to work from Khon Kaen. Bangkok is also a possibility for the right candidate. Good to have * Deploying and operating AI agents or LLM-backed services in production — this is the fastest way to make an impact here. * Google Cloud Platform specifically — GKE, Cloud Run, Vertex AI, Cloud Build. * Angular — enough to support front-end build and release pipelines and to work with the front-end team. * GitOps — Argo CD, Flux or Rancher Fleet. * Service mesh or API gateway experience. * Building reusable Terraform modules and platform abstractions. * Cost optimisation and FinOps practice. * DevSecOps tooling and security certifications ...

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Location:** Remote, with onsite days in Bali once a month (and occasionally when needed) **Job type:** Full-time **About Us** HeyRCG is a Bali-based, full-service marketing and performance agency. We help brands across hospitality, F&B, ecommerce and D2C grow through Meta, Google, social media, email marketing, creative production and web development. Data sits at the centre of how we work, from campaign reporting and client dashboards to the AI-powered tools we’re building for our team and clients. **About the role** You'll build the data foundations behind our reporting, analytics and AI-powered products, covering pipelines, data quality, governance and AI-ready data models. jobs.title: CNC Machining Operator
jobs.descriptionHtml: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. **SUMMARY** Under direct supervision, responsible for operating automated manufacturing equipment for Jabil manufactured assemblies. **ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES include the following. Other duties may be assigned.** · Perform routine equipment set-up, operation, and adjustment. · Coordinate with other team members to set up machines according to set-up sheets. · Ensure board loader and feeders are continually kept loaded with the correct parts, and prepares for next part run by loading feeders for next run before needed. · Maintain and load solder screen printer; operates LSM machine to check amount of solder paste applied to boards; enters data into CIQ system. · Maintain orderly work area by tubing fallout parts, and cleaning area and machines as needed. · Monitor machine rejects to assure that parts are being sorted and ran on a daily basis. · Maintain necessary documentation. · May perform basic quality auditing, testing, and troubleshooting functions. · Ensure that assigned area is clean and organized. · Work direction may additionally be communicated verbally through visual aids and set-up sheets. · Adhere to all safety and health rules and regulations associated with this position and as directed by supervisor. · Comply and follow all procedures within the company security policy. **MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS** High school diploma or equivalent required; and six months to one-year experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience. Must be able to obtain and maintain all required job related certifications. BE AWARE OF FRAUD: When applying for a job at Jabil you will be contacted via correspondence through our official job portal with a jabil.com e-mail address; direct phone call from a member of the Jabil team; or direct e-mail with a jabil.com e-mail address. Jabil does not request payments for interviews or at any other point during the hiring process. Jabil will not ask for your personal identifying information such as a social security number, birth certificate, financial institution, driver’s license number or passport information over the phone or via e-mail. If you believe you are a victim of identity theft, contact your local police department. Any scam job listings should be reported to whatever website it was posted in. **Jabil, including its subsidiaries, is an equal opportunity employer and considers qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.** **Accessibility Accommodation** =============================== If you are a qualified individual with a disability, you have the right to request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access Jabil.com/Careers site as a result of your disability. You can request a reasonable accommodation by sending an e-mail to Always\_Accessible@Jabil.com with the nature of your request and contact information. Please do not direct any other general employment related questions to this e-mail. Please note that only those inquiries concerning a request for reasonable accommodation will be responded to. #whereyoubelong

jobs.title: Product Builder (eks. Product Manager, eks Product Designer)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari Product Builder yang mampu membangun solusi secara langsung, bukan menulis spesifikasi lalu menunggu. Produk yang Anda bangun akan digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen di lebih dari 1.200 institusi pendidikan tinggi di Indonesia.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang satu modul dari awal hingga akhir: memahami permasalahan pengguna di kampus, menentukan bentuk fitur, membuat prototype yang dapat diklik dengan bantuan AI, mengujinya ke pengguna, lalu bekerja bersama seorang Product Engineer hingga fitur tersebut benar-benar digunakan. Anda tidak mengelola orang. Anda mengelola hasil. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Mengumpulkan kebutuhan langsung dari pengguna dan menyusunnya menjadi dokumen kerja yang jelas, termasuk alur, UI/UX, dan *acceptance criteria*. * Membuat prototype yang berfungsi dengan bantuan AI dan melibatkan pengguna sejak tahap awal. * Memeriksa hasil kerja AI dan menentukan bagian yang perlu diperbaiki. * Memantau tingkat pemakaian fitur pascarilis sebagai ukuran keberhasilan. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki rekam jejak membuat sesuatu yang digunakan oleh orang lain dan dapat menunjukkannya. * Mampu mengarahkan AI untuk membuat prototype serta mengenali bagian hasilnya yang keliru. * Mampu memprioritaskan, termasuk menolak fitur yang tidak perlu dibuat. * Bersedia berinteraksi langsung dengan pengguna, tidak hanya melalui laporan. * Memiliki pemahaman teknis yang cukup untuk berdiskusi dengan Product Engineer mengenai dampak sebuah fitur terhadap data dan sistem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Sertifikasi Scrum atau pengalaman mengelola tim besar. * Kemampuan coding dari nol. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman. Kami menilai apa yang telah Anda bangun. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu karya yang Anda buat dengan bantuan AI dan telah digunakan oleh pengguna, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus satu hari:** Ubah permasalahan nyata dari institusi pendidikan menjadi prototype yang dapat diklik. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi hasil AI:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah hasil AI yang memuat sejumlah kesalahan dan menjelaskan temuan Anda. * **Wawancara pengguna dan keputusan produk:** Pembahasan mengenai pengalaman Anda dengan pengguna nyata dan cara Anda mengambil keputusan. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Builder yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu mengarahkan agent, memeriksa hasilnya secara menyeluruh, dan bertanggung jawab atas aspek teknis produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Catatan Penting** Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. Penilaian kami berfokus pada instruksi yang Anda berikan, hasil yang Anda periksa, dan keputusan yang Anda tolak. Fulltime Surabaya, Jawa Timur

The Civil Engineer understands key business drivers and applies this knowledge to solve problems in straightforward situations by analyzing possible solutions using technical experience, judgment, and precedents. Our ingenuity fuels daily life. For more than 100 years, we've been making the impossible possible. We offer customers a lightning fast and convenient way to book delivery and moving services whether they are at their home, at work or on the go. People talk about O2O, we live it! Our strength lies in our internal values, namely **Passion** in serving local communities, empowering SMEs and our driver partners, **Execution** and **Grit** because that is how we differentiate ourselves by never giving up and striving for excellence, and **Humility** - awareness in ourselves to learn from others and never stop improving. Delivery is what we do best and we ensure it is always fast and simple. Since 2013, we have tackled the logistics industry head on to find the most innovative solutions for the world’s delivery needs. Our vision is to bring communities closer and make city life easier by allowing fast and convenient circulation of goods. We realize this vision with a ‘glocal’ approach, building a robust operations team to adapt our product to local networks of businesses and delivery contractors. At the same time, we have ambition to build an international brand by establishing an even more global presence. jobs.descriptionHtml: At Pepperl+Fuchs, we combine a strong commitment to innovation with a deep respect for the traditions that have shaped our success. From renewable energy and automotive production to water treatment plants and chemical systems, our advanced electronic sensors and automation components enable smooth and safe operations around the globe. We take pride in fostering a supportive and collaborative workplace culture, where employees feel connected and valued - much like a close-knit family. As we continue to grow, we are excited to welcome a new team member for the following position: HR Manager **Role Purpose:** We are seeking a dynamic and people-focused HR Manager to lead and enhance our human resources strategy, ensuring a positive employee experience and strong organizational performance. Are you excited about this opportunity? We can’t wait to get to know you! Submit your application online — we’re looking forward to hearing from you! Pepperl+Fuchs actively promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion and is committed to a policy of equal employment opportunity. We welcome applications from all individuals, regardless of ethnicity, country of origin, gender, religion, sexual orientation, age, skin color, physical or mental abilities, social background, or any other protected characteristic. All employment decisions are made based on these principles and in full compliance with applicable federal and state laws.

jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **About the Role** BYD is seeking an experienced and hands-on **HR Generalist** to manage end-to-end Human Resources operations for our growing organization. This role plays a key part in establishing and maintaining operational excellence across HR functions, ensuring full compliance with Indonesian employment regulations, and supporting business scaling. The ideal candidate brings comprehensive, multi-disciplinary HR expertise—spanning talent acquisition, total rewards, labor relations, statutory compliance, and expatriate management—with the autonomy to drive daily operations with minimal supervision. ### **Key Responsibilities** * **Talent Acquisition & Development:** Lead end-to-end recruitment processes, manage smooth onboarding programs, and coordinate employee training and career development initiatives. * **Compensation, Benefits & Payroll:** Oversee monthly payroll processing, tax calculations (PPh 21), statutory benefits administration (BPJS Ketenagakerjaan & BPJS Kesehatan), and employee welfare schemes. * **Employee Relations & Manpower Compliance:** Oversee labor relations, handle employment contracts (PKWT/PKWTT), manage employee grievances, and ensure strict alignment with Indonesian labor laws and company regulations (PP/PKB). * **Expatriate Management:** Coordinate expatriate administration, including end-to-end processing of work permits (RPTKA, IMTA/Notifikasi), visas, ITAS/KITAS, and local residency compliance. * **Policies, SOPs & Documentation:** Maintain accurate employee database records, draft and update HR policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs), and safeguard confidential HR files. * **HR Reporting & Continuous Improvement:** Generate comprehensive HR metrics and operational reports, identifying continuous process improvements to support operational efficiency and business growth. ### **Qualifications & Requirements** * **Position:** HR Generalist * **Education:** Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology, Human Resource Management, Law, Business Administration, or related disciplines. * **Experience:** Minimum 5 years of proven, hands-on experience across full-spectrum HR operations; prior experience in manufacturing or large-scale multinational enterprises is highly preferred. * **Functional Expertise:** Strong mastery of end-to-end payroll computation, C&B structures, Indonesian manpower regulations (UU Ketenagakerjaan & UU Cipta Kerja), and grievance handling. * **Certifications:** Brevet A/B tax certification or formal training in Indonesian payroll/employment taxation is a plus. * **Language Skills:** + Fluent professional working proficiency in **English** (written and verbal). + Professional working proficiency in **Mandarin** is an advantage for cross-border alignment. * **Core Competencies:** Strong analytical thinking, solid cross-cultural communication, structured organizational skills, problem-solving mindset, and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment.

🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission

As a Care Expert, you are the trusted care advisor for voize's most important care group customers. Together with their Customer Success Manager, you make sure voize really changes how care teams work - not just that it goes live. You speak with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer, because you have done their job. Your success shows in adoption and in the time teams get back.

🚀 Your Daily Business

  • Support 6-10 strategic care group accounts as their care expert, side by side with their Customer Success Manager

  • Look at QM processes, documentation routines and the EHR setup (e.g. Vivendi) before go-live, so mismatches surface early instead of during rollout

  • Talk with QM-Leitungen and Pflegedienstleitungen as a peer about process design, how documentation is structured, and change management - in their language, not ours

  • Review adoption with customer leadership after go-live and share clear, practical recommendations on voize settings and on care workflows

  • Bring what you see across accounts back to our Product team, and name clearly what is a process topic, an EHR setup topic, or a real product need

🤝 Your Skillset

  • You have worked as Pflegedienstleitung, QM-Beauftragte/r or in a similar senior care quality or operations role - at the level of the people you will advise

  • You know QM processes, care documentation standards and EHR systems (ideally Vivendi/Snap) in stationärer Altenpflege

  • You speak fluent German and can meet a careful Pflegedienstleitung, a cautious Geschäftsführung and a busy IT admin on the same day, each in their own way

  • You think in a structured way and can tell whether something is a process topic, a system setup topic, or a change management topic - and what helps in each case

  • You enjoy close collaboration: with CSMs, with Product, and on building the Care Expert playbook together

🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle new topics, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

  • We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remote...

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (E-Commerce)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Choco, where we build and own solutions that reshape a broken food system.

The global food supply chain is inefficient by design. Waste is high, margins are thin, and most distributor order processes are done over the phone, tracked across broad spreadsheets, and based on intuition rather than strong data.


At Choco, we’re changing that. We build software used daily by food distributors and their customers to run their business. It automates orders, reduces errors, and helps operations run faster and more reliably. Because it’s embedded in daily operations, our SaaS platform has immediate, real-world impact, on efficiency, margins, and how businesses run day to day.

Mission

Technology and a great e-commerce experience lie at the heart of our business. Thousands of restaurants order their supplies through Choco every day. You will own a core part of that experience, from how buyers find products to how they place their orders. We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager with a practical approach, strong analytical skills and commercial acumen. You understand what makes digital buying experiences work and turn buyer needs and enterprise customer requirements into scalable product improvements that make ordering easier and drive measurable business growth.

What You’ll Do

  • Own a core area of the e-commerce experience across journeys such as product discovery, search, cart, checkout and ordering, shaping its roadmap and driving measurable improvements for buyers and the business.

  • Lead a squad of engineers and a designer from discovery to delivery, shipping valuable features at a high pace and quality.

  • Talk directly with buyers and enterprise customers to understand their needs, test product ideas, and turn insights into improvements to the buying experience.

  • Make data-driven decisions that measurably improve the e-commerce experience and drive business impact, assessing the value of features before and after launch with a focus on conversion rate, average order value, purchase frequency and retention.

  • Partner with Sales and Customer Success to win and grow enterprise accounts, from large distributors to manufacturers. Turn customer-specific needs into scalable product capabilities, balancing commercial opportunities with value for the broader customer base.

  • Use AI in your daily work and find opportunities to apply it in the buyer experience.

What You Bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience in B2B SaaS, including work with enterprise customers.

  • Experience building and optimizing customer-facing e-commerce journeys such as product discovery, search, catalog, cart, checkout and ordering.

  • A track record of leading a product area end to end, from discovery to delivery, in a scale-up and measurably improving its business results.

  • Sharp product sense and prioritization: you can dive deep into detail while keeping the bigger picture in view.

  • Strong ownership and flexibility: you thrive in a fast-changing environment, are comfortable with ambiguity, and take full responsibility for results.

About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role

As Director, Solution Engineering EMEA, you’ll lead Parloa’s Solution Engineering team across EMEA and build it into the trusted technical advisor for our enterprise customers. You and your team will help some of the world’s best-known brands see what AI agents can do for their customer experience, and how to bring them to life in their business. Working side by side with our EMEA sales leadership, you’ll shape how we win across the region.

Areas of ownership

  • Lead and grow the team: Hire, develop, and lead the EMEA Solution Engineering team through its managers. You own performance, career paths, and the hiring bar.

  • Lead on strategic deals: Be the senior technical voice with customer executives on the region’s most important opportunities.

  • Scale through the ecosystem: Work closely with Partnerships, Value Engineering, and Professional Services to give customers a seamless experience from first conversation to go-live.

  • Turn field signal into product: Turn customers' needs into clear input for Product and Engineering.

Who you are

  • 5+ years in Solution Engineering or a similar customer-facing technical role within SaaS or enterprise technology, including 2+ years of leadership experience

  • Strong technical foundation across APIs, cloud environments, integrations, and enterprise architecture

  • Hands-on understanding of AI infrastructure, including LLMs, model deployment, and how AI agents run in production

  • Experience running complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles with MEDDPICC or a similar framework

  • Ability to translate technical concepts into clear business value and outcomes

  • You're AI native and use AI in everything you do

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them.
