About the role:

As Business Continuity & DR Manager, you will build, implement and maintain Parloa’s Business Continuity Management System (BCMS), including business continuity, disaster recovery and crisis management plans for our digital systems, operations and infrastructure. You will be part of IS&T Governance and play a key role in strengthening Parloa’s resilience and overall security posture.

This is your opportunity to build a BCMS at a fast-growing, global AI company and lead it to ISO 22301 certification, keeping essential services running for enterprise customers who trust Parloa with their most important customer moments.

Areas of ownership:

  • BCMS Design and ISO 22301 Certification: Run gap analyses, define the framework and maintain the policies, procedures and guidelines behind it. Lead the certification process end to end, including preparing for external audits.

  • Risk Assessment and Business Impact Analysis: Identify and prioritise critical business processes by building risk models and mapping dependencies and vulnerabilities. Turn business impact analyses into a tailored continuity strategy for each critical process.

  • Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery Plans: Create and maintain plans for all critical processes, with clear recovery objectives, resources and recovery teams. Review them regularly so they stay current as Parloa grows.

  • Testing and Exercises: Plan and run tabletop exercises, drills and simulations across critical functions on a recurring schedule. Evaluate results, close gaps and refine plans based on what you learn.

  • Stakeholder Alignment and Resilience Culture: Build strong relationships with department heads and report progress, risks and milestones to senior management. Define KPIs for the BCMS and deliver training and awareness programmes that make resilience part of how Parloa works.

Who you are:

  • Proven experience developing and testing business continuity and disaster recovery plans, including risk assessments and business impact analyses.

  • Solid knowledge of how to implement a BCMS according to ISO 22301.

  • Strong understanding of IT infrastructure, risk management and crisis response.

  • A structured, execution-focused way of working: you build and follow a clear project roadmap, make decisions and see them through.

  • Confident communicator who engages stakeholders at all levels and presents to groups with clarity.

jobs.title: Principal Software Engineer - Real-Time Voice
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About The Role:

Voice is one of the most demanding and differentiated parts of what we do. As Principal Software Engineer for Voice/VoIP, you'll own the technical direction of our real-time voice infrastructure — the systems that let AI agents have natural, low-latency phone conversations at enterprise scale, across telephony providers, carriers, and global markets.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You'll set architectural direction, solve the hardest problems yourself, and raise the bar for how the wider engineering org builds and reasons about voice systems. You'll work closely with infrastructure, AI/ML, and product teams to ensure our voice stack is fast, reliable, and ready to scale globally.

Areas Of Ownership:

  • Own the architecture and technical roadmap for Parloa's Voice/VoIP infrastructure, including SIP trunking, media handling, and real-time audio pipelines

  • Design for low-latency, high-availability voice at enterprise scale — across global telephony carriers and providers

  • Drive technical decisions on protocols and standards (SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, WebRTC, ICE, STUN/TURN) and real-time media transport

  • Partner with AI/ML teams to optimise the integration between voice infrastructure and conversational AI models (ASR, TTS, turn-taking, barge-in)

  • Diagnose and resolve deep, systemic issues in call quality, latency, jitter, and packet loss across distributed, multi-region deployments

  • Define and uphold engineering standards for reliability, observability, and security across the voice stack

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers, acting as a technical multiplier across the organisation

  • Evaluate and integrate with telephony providers, carriers, and SIP trunk vendors as Parloa expands into new markets

  • Represent Parloa's technical voice expertise in conversations with enterprise customers and partners where needed

Who You Are:

  • 10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years hands-on building, operating, or debugging production Voice/VoIP, SIP, WebRTC, or carrier-grade voice infrastructure

  • Strong knowledge of SIP, SDP, RTP/SRTP, RTCP, WebRTC, ICE, and real-time media transport protocols

  • Hands-on understanding of audio codecs and media behavior, including Opus, G.711/G.722, codec negotiation/transcoding, DTMF/RFC2833, jitter buffers, packetization, and codec-related quality/latency trade-offs

  • Experience building or operating large-scale, distributed, real-time systems with strict latency and availability requirements

  • A track record of owning architecture for complex systems and driving technical decisions with broad organisational impact

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. About The Role:

We are looking for a Staff UX Researcher to join our Design team and shape how research informs the products we build.

You will be a hands-on researcher, leading qualitative and quantitative research into our most important and ambiguous customer and product questions. Working closely with Product, Design, Engineering, AI, and leadership, you will turn what we learn into insights that shape product decisions and strategy.

Alongside your research, you will establish and evolve our Research Operations. Our embedded Product Designers already conduct research within their product teams. You will enable them to do this effectively while building the practices, tools, and systems that strengthen and scale research across Parloa.

You will research both the people who build and manage AI agents and the customers who interact with them. This creates complex questions around how people understand, trust, control, and collaborate with AI, and how expectations and behaviors change as AI becomes increasingly capable.

Areas Of Ownership:

  • Lead hands-on research into our most important and ambiguous customer and product questions, using qualitative and quantitative methods from problem framing and study design through analysis, synthesis, and communication.

  • Shape product decisions through research by uncovering needs and opportunities, challenging assumptions, and ensuring customer evidence informs product direction, priorities, and strategy.

  • Enable Product Designers to conduct high-quality research independently through coaching, methodological guidance, and lightweight research practices.

  • Establish and evolve Research Operations that make research easier, faster, higher quality, and more scalable, including participant recruitment, tooling, governance, research practices, and knowledge management.

  • Build organizational knowledge by connecting research across teams and studies, making existing insights accessible, and identifying broader patterns, knowledge gaps, and strategic insights that individual teams may not see.

Who You Are:

  • You are an excellent mixed-method researcher, with deep qualitative expertise and strong quantitative research skills. You know how to combine methods and sources of evidence to answer complex questions.

  • You have experience researching across both complex B2B/expert and consumer/end-user experiences, and can adapt your approach to different users, contexts, and levels of expertise.

About the role:

As Senior Partnerships Manager, Eastern Europe, you will build and scale the partner ecosystem that establishes Parloa as the leading agentic AI solution across Eastern European markets. Working closely with EMEA leadership, you will shape the regional strategy and carry out the moves that secure Parloa's presence in these key expansion markets.

This is your opportunity to build a regional footprint from the ground up and own the partner engine behind Parloa's entry into Eastern Europe.

Areas of ownership:

  • Partner Recruitment and Growth: Identify, sign, and grow leading service partners across Eastern Europe, using your existing network to speed up market entry.

  • Joint Business Planning: Build shared business plans with partners that align goals and strategy, and turn them into co-selling, referral, and implementation wins.

  • Partner Go-to-Market: Lead joint marketing and sales efforts with partners to bring Parloa's AI solutions to market with confidence.

  • Partner Performance: Run regular check-ins and quarterly business reviews to track progress against goals and speed up partner-driven growth.

  • Cross-Functional Alignment: Work with sales, marketing, and product teams so partner priorities, messaging, and goals stay aligned.

Who you are:

  • 8+ years of experience in partner management, channel sales, or strategic alliances within SaaS, contact center, or AI companies.

  • A proven track record of entering new markets and building partner programs from scratch.

  • A deep, existing network of partners and enterprise decision-makers across Eastern Europe.

  • Strong credibility with C-level executives and senior stakeholders, with the ability to build trusted, long-term relationships.

  • Professional fluency in English and any Eastern European language. Being based in Germany (ideally Berlin or Munich) is a plus.

Our recruiting process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As a Staff Product Engineer, you will work directly inside our most strategic enterprise customers. You will build the software that makes their AI agents work in production, and be measured by the difference it makes for the customer.

Our agents are built by business users in Parloa’s platform, AMP. AMP already comes with a broad library of tools and integrations. Your job is the part AMP does not cover yet for a given customer: the last connection into their systems, or a capability the product does not have. Our customers are large enterprises in financial services, telecom, insurance, travel and retail. For them, a working prototype is where an engagement starts, not where it ends.

The work comes in two forms. Some engagements run for years. You stay with the account, deepen its integrations and help it grow into new use cases. Others are short experiments. You test a new idea with a real customer and decide quickly whether it is worth building. At Staff level, you take on the hardest cases of both: accounts where a pilot-grade solution would fail in production, and capabilities nobody at Parloa has built before. Staff means harder problems and more ambiguity, not less hands-on work.

On many accounts, you work alongside a Deployment Strategist. Think of the two of you as the account’s leadership team. The Deployment Strategist acts as its CPO and defines what success looks like. You act as its CTO and own the architecture and the build. On accounts without a Deployment Strategist, you own the engineering yourself.

Areas of ownership:

  • Lead the hardest engagements. Run complex programmes with several workstreams. Make the architecture decisions that span Parloa’s platform and several parts of the customer’s organization.

  • Build what AMP does not cover yet. Systems of record, telephony and contact-center integrations, state management, data readiness, multi-agent orchestration and retrieval. When the answer is unclear, build a prototype quickly and decide whether it is worth pursuing before Parloa invests a full quarter in it.

  • Own production quality and security. Evals, production readiness, observability and incident playbooks for enterprise-scale traffic. Meet the data handling standards a regulated customer expects, including PII, access control and audit trails. Debug live issues, whether they are technical or caused by model behaviour.

  • Grow the account, and share what belongs in the product. Drive the second use case, the second business unit, the renewal. Set the delivery standard for other engineers on complex accounts. When something you build would help every customer, flag it. That is how Parloa decides what goes into the core product.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

Our mission is clear: deliver robust, enterprise-grade, resilient, and reliable AI solutions at speed. In a fast-moving market where sales cycles for multimillion-dollar deals can be as short as 1-2 months, speed is our currency. We are competing head-to-head with the big-tech companies and fast-moving AI-native startups.

Our engineering organization is structured into Customer Experience Automation (CXA), Product Platform, and Technology Platform together delivering a Composable Customer Experience Platform built from Packaged Business Capabilities (PBCs). Think AWS-like granularity, but built to empower enterprises with speed, flexibility, and resilience.

About The Role

A Senior Engineering Manager at Parloa does the same job as an Engineering Manager, at a bigger and harder scope. You own delivery and business outcomes for a large team, for two or more teams, or for a domain whose work spans several teams. Sometimes the scope is defined by size; sometimes it is defined by difficulty, such as a problem area where the technical and organisational complexity is genuinely hard, and where getting it right matters to the company's roadmap.

What changes at this level is altitude and durability. You communicate credibly to Directors and VPs without your manager in the room, framing recommendations and trade-offs rather than reporting status. You own the narrative for cross-functional work that travels beyond your teams. You take the conversations that Engineering Managers escalate to you - performance edge cases, prioritisation conflicts between teams, hard disagreements with peers - and you resolve them. And you are building the next layer of leaders: the tech leads who will become EMs, the senior engineers who will become Staff.

You are not primarily a manager of managers. Some Senior EMs move that way, on the path to Director, but most do not and this role does not require it. The people work gets harder at this level, not lighter.

Areas Of Ownership

  • Own delivery across a multi-team or multi-domain scope. Set milestones, critical path, and quality gates. Manage cross-team dependencies actively rather than reporting on them. Hold a consistent bar for Definition of Done and quality across the scope.

  • Set strategy and roadmap with Product, not unilaterally. Frame engineering investment in commercial terms - revenue, retention, margin - and surface customer and market signals into the plan.

  • Own the narrative for cross-functional initiatives. Stakeholders walk away aligned, not merely informed. Author durable artefacts - plans, RFCs, escalation memos, postmortems — that still stand up months later and travel beyond the people in the room.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As Senior Program Manager, Product & GTM Programs, you run program management between our GTM organization and Product & Engineering. 

You are the connection point between both sides. You bring them together early on upcoming changes, align on what those changes mean for customers & partners, and determine what support customers need and which internal teams have to be prepared. From there, you own the path to our customers and partners.

Where a change is large enough to become a program in its own right, you own that program end to end. Other teams own their functional deliverables; you own the plan, the sequence, the cadence, the deadline, and the outcome. These programs carry hard cutoffs and significant revenue.

This is a cross-functional program management role at its core: a lot of coordination, judgment, and real accountability for the outcome. There's no playbook waiting for you — building it is part of the job.

Areas of ownership:

  • GTM to Product & Engineering Interface: Serve as the connection point for upcoming customer-impacting changes, bringing both sides together early to align on how customers and partners are affected and what they need to do. You determine which internal teams have to be enabled, from Engagement Managers and Sales to Solution Engineering, Partnerships, and Product Marketing.

  • Program Orchestration: Act as the single coordination point across Product, Engineering, Professional Services, Product Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, and Engagement Managers. You steer cross-functional kickoffs, run the cadence that keeps programs moving, and hold functional owners to their commitments, including when that means escalating or re-sequencing.

  • Communication Sequencing: Design the plans for customer and partner communication so they experience one coordinated channel instead of several, and collect early customer and field feedback before it becomes an escalation.

  • Execution and Accountability: Track progress against plan, enforce deadlines, own escalation management end to end, and report to senior leadership in a way that makes risk visible early rather than defensible late.

  • Building the Discipline: Define and measure success metrics for each program, run retrospectives that produce process change rather than documents, and build the playbooks, SOPs, and governance cadence that make this function durable.

  • 5-7+ years in program or project management, owning complex cross-functional programs end to end — not workstreams inside someone else's program

  • You've worked as the connective tissue between technical and commercial teams, translating in both directions

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

How do you deliver an AI platform capability that spans multiple engineering teams and an enterprise customer’s go-live date - without compromising quality, reliability or security?

This is the challenge you’ll solve as a Senior Technical Program Manager at Parloa. We’re looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to lead one of Parloa’s most strategic cross-organizational programs from definition through launch.

Parloa is building an enterprise AI platform powering Fortune 2000 companies with conversational AI. Our Agent Management Platform (AMP) is trusted by global organizations including Booking.com, Allianz and American Express. As we scale rapidly, we’re building an engineering organization optimized for speed, quality and innovation.

This role is about delivering outcomes, not coordinating activity.

You will be accountable for one of the company’s highest-impact programs, bringing together multiple engineering teams and cross-functional partners to deliver a critical business outcome. You will own the integrated execution plan, dependency management, launch readiness, executive communication and decision-making mechanisms that determine whether the program succeeds.

When the program is at risk, you’re expected to know first, understand why, and arrive with well-reasoned options - not just status updates.

This is not a delivery coordination or Scrum facilitation role. Product defines what we build. Engineering owns how we build it. You ensure we successfully deliver across organizational boundaries.

Enterprise customers expect reliability, security and operational excellence - not just feature delivery. You will establish a clear readiness bar for your program, ensure delivery trade-offs are explicit and well understood, and help leaders make informed decisions before deadlines force implicit ones.

Although you won’t write production code, this is a highly technical role. You should be comfortable discussing architecture, rollout strategies, system dependencies, and reliability risks with senior engineers, and be able to challenge assumptions when delivery plans don’t align with technical complexity.

The ideal candidate thrives in ambiguity and has successfully delivered complex technical programs across teams they did not directly manage. You are an exceptional written communicator who can simplify ambiguity for executives while earning credibility with engineers. Experience building AI products is valuable, but curiosity, learning velocity and sound engineering judgment matter more than prior domain expertise.

 

Areas of ownership:

  • Serve as the accountable leader for one strategic cross-organizational program, or two closely related programs, with clear business impact.

  • Build and maintain the integrated execution plan, including milestones, critical path, dependencies and cross-team commitments.

About The Role:

As a Staff or Principal Product Manager – Agent Management Platform (AMP), you will help shape the platform that enables the world’s largest enterprises to design, deploy, manage, and scale AI agents safely and reliably.


Parloa AMP brings together the capabilities needed to run enterprise-grade AI customer service - from highly skilled autonomous AI agents and real-time AI assistance for employees to agent lifecycle management, simulations and evaluations, and AI model and data orchestration.


You’ll own a strategic area within AMP and work closely with Engineering, Design, and commercial teams to turn complex AI capabilities into scalable, intuitive products. You’ll help define how enterprises build and operate AI agents at scale, balancing speed, reliability, safety, and exceptional user experience while driving measurable customer and business impact.
This is a high-impact role for a Product Manager who wants to help define how enterprise AI agents are built and managed, rather than simply adding AI features to an existing product.

 

Areas Of Ownership:

  • Define and Drive Product Strategy: Develop a clear, actionable product vision and roadmap, aligning with company objectives and market opportunities.

  • Build for Scalability and Modularity: Ensure the platform is built with flexibility and integration capabilities, using industry best practices for APIs, SDKs, and modular design.

  • Champion Process Excellence: Lead the creation of streamlined processes for feature requests, prioritization, and delivery, aligning with Parloa's operating model and product standards.

  • Collaborate Across Functions: Partner with Engineering, Design, and Commercial teams to prioritize features based on strategic fit, technical feasibility, and business impact.

  • Elevate Decision-Making with Data: Implement robust analytics and observability tools to measure platform performance, prioritize features, and refine strategies.

  • Foster Customer-Centric Development: Align platform goals with customer and market needs to ensure relevance and impact across our ecosystem.

 

Who You Are:

  • Proven Experience: 10+ years of experience in product management, solution architecture, technical consulting, CTO/CPO role.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. It is not just a vision; Parloa has powered over ONE BILLION interactions between global enterprise brands and their customers, with companies like Booking.com, HealthEquity, Allianz, SAP, BarmeniaGothaer, and TUI already deploying Parloa at scale.

About the role:

As an Enterprise Engagement Manager, you will drive customer success, value realization, and long-term growth across Parloa’s enterprise customers. You’ll guide organizations from implementation through adoption and expansion, ensuring they unlock the full potential of agentic AI in their customer experience.

This is your opportunity to partner with leading enterprises on their AI and CX transformation, shaping how they scale intelligent automation while delivering measurable business impact.

Areas of ownership:

  • Customer Success & Value Realization: Own the end-to-end customer journey post-sale, ensuring successful adoption, measurable outcomes, and long-term value realization.

  • Strategic Advisory: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise clients, building strong relationships and guiding stakeholders through AI-driven transformation.

  • Account Growth & Expansion: Identify and drive expansion opportunities by developing growth plans across new use cases, teams, and automation initiatives.

  • Implementation Oversight: Lead and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure smooth, on-time implementations and successful go-lives.

  • Value Communication: Translate product capabilities and data into clear business impact through success plans, reporting, and executive storytelling.

  • Stakeholder Management: Align technical and business stakeholders, ensuring clarity, momentum, and accountability across all phases of the customer lifecycle.

Who you are:

  • 2+ years of experience in Customer Success, Consulting, or Account Management within enterprise environments

  • Proven ability to drive strategic value and support digital transformation in complex organizations

  • Track record of turning customer success into measurable business impact and growth opportunities

  • Strong project and stakeholder management skills, with a focus on execution and outcomes

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage both technical and non-technical audiences

  • Technical curiosity and interest in AI, automation, and customer experience

  • Native or bilingual in German, and fluent in English

Our Recruiting Process:

Talent Acquisition → Hiring Manager → Technical Interview(s) → Bar Raiser

About the role:

SAP is one of Parloa's most strategic global alliances, and EMEA is its home turf. As SAP Partner Sales Manager — EMEA, you will drive the alliance where SAP's presence is deepest: its headquarters ecosystem, its strongest field organizations, and Europe's densest network of SAP-aligned service partners. You will convert the global partnership strategy into regional pipeline, co-sell wins, and revenue across EMEA, with proximity to SAP's Walldorf headquarters as a strategic advantage.

Areas of ownership:

  • Own the SAP-sourced and co-sell pipeline for EMEA: build, manage, and forecast a qualified regional pipeline with SAP field teams across DACH and priority EMEA markets (CX, BTP, and industry AEs), with clear accountability for sourced/influenced pipeline and closed-won contribution.

  • Be the liaison between Parloa field sales and SAP: connect Parloa AEs with their SAP counterparts across EMEA regions, drive account mapping cadences, and ensure both field organizations know when, why, and how to bring each other into deals.

  • Drive prospecting and local pipeline generation: plan and execute regional co-sell campaigns, joint prospecting motions, and local pipeline events (executive roundtables, DSAG and SAP ecosystem events, SAPPHIRE Madrid and regional summits) with SAP and ecosystem partners.

  • Enable Parloa sales reps on the SAP motion: train AEs on SAP-relevant messaging, joint solution plays (e.g., Parloa + SAP CX / Service Cloud), integration narratives, and how to navigate SAP's field and incentive structures across EMEA markets.

  • Coordinate SAP and partner involvement in RFPs and demos: orchestrate SAP solution engineers, reference architectures, and SAP-aligned SI partners into active pursuits — including complex, multi-country enterprise RFPs common in EMEA.

  • Manage deal registration and conflict resolution: own hygiene of SAP-related deal registration, rules of engagement between direct and partner-led motions, and swift, fair resolution of channel conflict across regions.

  • Feed field intelligence back to the alliance team: report competitive signals, SAP field sentiment, win/loss insights, and program friction to the RVP and partner development team — leveraging your proximity to SAP headquarters for early insight into program and product direction.

Who you are:

  • 7–10+ years in partner sales, channel sales, or alliances within enterprise software, with a track record of hitting partner-sourced pipeline and revenue targets.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Parloa

Parloa's mission is to make every customer conversation feel effortless for both customers and the companies serving them. As agentic AI accelerates, Parloans are shaping the foundation of a new era in customer experience, one where customer support is no longer transactions, but meaningful exchanges. About the role

As a Sr Agent Architect at Parloa, you will act as a solution architect for enterprise AI Agent deployments. You will design end-to-end system architectures that connect Parloa's platform to complex enterprise environments, solve multi-system integration challenges, and apply systems thinking to build reliable, scalable AI solutions for global enterprise clients.

You will also shape the conversational experience layer, using prompt engineering and your knowledge of LLMs to translate customer requirements into agent behavior. Architecture and integration depth are the core of this role. Conversational design skills are valued and can be developed on the job.

Areas of ownership

  • Design end-to-end solution architectures for AI Agent deployments, mapping how Parloa's platform integrates into customers' enterprise systems (CRMs, ERPs, ticketing systems, contact center platforms).

  • Build and configure integrations using integration platforms and APIs, applying systems thinking to solve complex, multi-system data flows.

  • Collaborate with Forward Deployed Engineers on complex or custom integration scenarios that go beyond standard integration capabilities.

  • Apply structured testing approaches to validate architecture, integration reliability, and AI agent performance under real-world conditions.

  • Identify and resolve blockers together with other departments at Parloa (e.g., Product, Solution Engineering, Sales) and the customer.

  • Scope AI Agent deployments, providing strategic architecture advice and execution support to customers and partners.

  • Use your knowledge of LLM internals (e.g., embeddings) to analyze customer requirements and design prompts for reliable, user-aligned agent behavior.

  • Translate complex customer workflows into structured conversational components that LLMs can execute reliably.

  • Fine-tune conversational flows and voice output (e.g., SSML, Lexicons, Regex) to align with customer brand standards.

  • Document best practices, how-to guides, and product capabilities for internal and external audiences, representing the expertise of the Agent Architect team.

Who you are

  • 3+ years of experience in enterprise customer-facing roles, with proven expertise in solution architecture, systems architecture, or enterprise integration.

  • Strong systems thinking, with a track record of solving complex technical problems across multiple systems and data sources.

  • Experience with complex SaaS implementations at scale (CRMs, ERPs, contact center platforms, ticketing systems).

jobs.title: Sales Development Representative Deutschland (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Werde Sales Development Representative (m/w/d) bei Qonto und mach aus Event-Gesprächen echte Qonto-Kundschaft. Du triffst Gründungsteams und Selbstständige live in ganz Deutschland und rufst sie direkt danach an. Dabei begleitet dich Eric Sohl, unser Head of Business Development Central Europe.

➡️ Was du bei uns machst

  • Events in ganz Deutschland: Du reist zu Events, sprichst Interessierte direkt am Stand an und begeisterst sie für Qonto.

  • Leads bearbeiten: Du kümmerst dich um jeden Lead, von der ersten Recherche bis zum Abschluss.

  • Schnell nachfassen: Du rufst jeden Lead innerhalb von 24 bis 48 Stunden nach dem Event an.

  • Outreach selbst bauen: Du testest, was bei Anrufen und Nachrichten funktioniert, und optimierst es laufend.

➡️ Was wir uns wünschen

  • Erste Jobs hinter dir: Du bringst schon Berufserfahrung mit und willst jetzt im Sales durchstarten.

  • Hunger auf Sales: Du hast richtig Lust zu verkaufen – am Stand genauso wie am Telefon.

  • Eigeninitiative: Du knobelst erst selbst an einer Lösung, bevor du um Hilfe bittest.

  • KI im Arbeitsalltag: Du nutzt KI ganz selbstverständlich und findest damit eigene Wege.

  • Sprachen: Du sprichst fließend Deutsch und Englisch.

➡️ Was wir dir bieten

  • Lernkurve vom ersten Tag: Du lernst Sales von Grund auf und das Produkt direkt im Job.

  • Echte Verantwortung: Du betreust die Leads von den Events, auf denen du selbst warst.

  • Direkter Impact: Wie gut du nachfasst, entscheidet sichtbar, was aus jedem Event wird.

  • Freiraum: Du darfst Dinge ausprobieren, statt einem starren Skript zu folgen.

➡️ Dein zukünftiger Manager

Du berichtest an Eric Sohl, Head of Business Development Central Europe. Eric bringt über zwölf Jahre Erfahrung aus der Tech- und Startup-Welt mit, unter anderem bei Uber und Gorillas sowie als COO eines Early-Stage-Startups. Er führt mit hohem Tempo und viel Vertrauen: Du bekommst früh Verantwortung und Raum für eigene Ideen, und wo du Unterstützung brauchst, packt er selbst mit an.


[DIVERSITY] At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick - who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.

[HIRING PROCESS DURATION] On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (DE) - Company Creation (6 months, freelance)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil von Qonto als Marketing Manager (m/w/d) Deutschland – Company Creation und treibe messbares Wachstum für unser Company-Creation-Segment rund um die Unternehmensgründung in Deutschland voran.

Befristung: 6 Monate (Start idealerweise Anfang Dezember). Freelance ist ebenfalls möglich.

Du verantwortest Strategie und hands-on Umsetzung von 360°-Kampagnen entlang des gesamten Company-Creation-Funnels — mit echter Autonomie. Du berichtest an Laura Günder, unsere Head of Marketing – Central Europe.

➡️ Was du tun wirst

  • 360°-Kampagnen end-to-end verantworten: Du steuerst Kampagnen mit Fokus auf Acquisition – von Strategie und Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung und Optimierung. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit unseren Teams von Content, Website, CRM, Paid, Brand, SEO, Partnerships, Events und Social Media zusammen.

  • Bestehende Flows weiterentwickeln: Gemeinsam mit dem Produkt-Team, Business Development sowie unserem Company-Creation-Partner optimierst du unsere Acquisition-Flows, identifizierst neue Wachstumspotenziale und bringst neue Features, Produkte und Rechtsformen erfolgreich auf den Markt.

  • Performance analysieren: Du wertest Performance KPIs aus, identifizierst Engpässe im Funnel und leitest konkrete Optimierungsmaßnahmen ab.

  • Wettbewerb im Blick behalten: Du analysierst regelmäßig relevante Wettbewerber und Markttrends, um unsere Angebote wettbewerbsfähig zu positionieren und neue Chancen frühzeitig zu erkennen.

➡️ Was wir suchen

  • Hands-on Kampagnenerfahrung im deutschen Markt, idealerweise SaaS, Fintech oder vergleichbares B2B-Umfeld.

  • Analytische Stärke: Du interpretierst Funnel- und Performance-Kennzahlen sicher und triffst Entscheidungen datenbasiert statt aus dem Bauch heraus.

  • Schnelle, eigenständige Einarbeitung: Du lieferst bereits im ersten Monat operativ.

  • Projekt- & Stakeholder-Management sowie solides Copywriting für Kampagnen- und Partner-Kommunikation.

  • Sprachen & Standort: Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau (Muss), fließendes Englisch. Berlin.

➡️ Was wir dir bieten

  • Eigenverantwortung für einen unserer Category Entry Points in Deutschland, unserem Priori­tätsmarkt Nummer eins.

  • Eine Mission mit echtem Mehrwert: Du gestaltest aktiv mit, wie wir Bürokratie für Gründer:innen in Deutschland abbauen und den Gründungsprozess einfacher, schneller und zugänglicher machen.

  • Teilnahme bei Partner-Calls sowie enge Zusammenarbeit mit Business Development und Produkt - echte cross-funktionale Verantwortung.

  • Flexibles Setup (Anstellung oder Freelance) mit schnellem, sichtbarem Impact über klare Metriken.

➡️ Über deine zukünftige Managerin

Join us as a Senior Product Engineer (iOS/Swift) to build the mobile app that 750,000 customers across Europe use to run their business finances every day, and to keep it fast and reliable as it grows.

Impact: Your work ships to the customers who use Qonto's iOS app for their daily payments and cash management. You will join one of our squads, each owning a clear product scope. You'll work with a team lead, Product, Design, and Frontend and Backend engineers. Squads have 5 to 10 people.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager 🇩🇪 (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil von Qonto als Customer Success Manager und baue das Portfolio unserer deutschen Geschäftskund:innen aus, während Qonto den Weg zur Banklizenz geht. Mit proaktivem, vertrauensbasiertem Kontakt treibst du Aktivierung und Umsatz voran und berichtest an Nicole Ostrowska, die unser Customer Success & Management Team in Berlin leitet.

➡️ Was du bei uns bewirkst

  • Erste Ansprechperson für dein Kundenportfolio sein: Du betreust deine deutschen Geschäftskund:innen von A bis Z und sorgst dafür, dass jede und jeder von ihnen bei Qonto einen erstklassigen Service erlebt, vom ersten Gespräch bis zur langfristigen Partnerschaft.

  • Kund:innen helfen, das Beste aus Qonto herauszuholen: Du erkennst, was deine Kund:innen wirklich brauchen, und empfiehlst die passenden Lösungen, ob Abonnements, Karten oder FX. So wachsen ihr Erfolg und unser Umsatz gemeinsam.

  • Strategische Partnerschaften aufbauen: In regelmäßigen Strategiegesprächen (QBRs) blickst du mit deinen Kund:innen auf ihre Ziele und zeigst ihnen neue Möglichkeiten auf. Du wirst zur vertrauten Beraterin oder zum vertrauten Berater an ihrer Seite.

  • Kundenbeziehungen langfristig sichern: Du erkennst früh, wenn Kund:innen unzufrieden sind, und findest gemeinsam mit ihnen Lösungen, damit sie langfristig gerne bei Qonto bleiben.

  • Mit KI den Unterschied machen: Du nutzt KI täglich, um Chancen zu erkennen, Gespräche vorzubereiten und deine Kundenkommunikation noch persönlicher und wirkungsvoller zu gestalten.

➡️ Was du mitbringst

  • Portfolio-Erfahrung im CSM oder Account Management: Du hast bereits ein Kundenportfolio verantwortet und weißt, wie man es strategisch weiterentwickelt.

  • Deutsch auf Muttersprachniveau: Du führst Kundengespräche und Verhandlungen sicher auf Deutsch. Außerdem sprichst du fließend Englisch, unsere Arbeitssprache bei Qonto.

  • Stark am Telefon, mit kommerziellem Gespür: Du schaffst schnell Vertrauen, erkennst, was Kund:innen wirklich brauchen, und siehst Abwanderungsrisiken oder Upselling-Chancen, bevor sie offensichtlich sind.

  • Erfahrung in Fintech, Banking oder SaaS: Du sprichst bereits die Sprache der Finanzprodukte oder bist genauso versiert im SaaS-Bereich.

  • KI-affin: Du nutzt KI täglich, um schneller zu arbeiten, nicht als nachträglichen Gedanken.

➡️ Was wir dir bieten

  • Ein Portfolio mit echtem Gewicht: Du betreust Beziehungen, die Qontos Weg zur Banklizenz tragen.

  • Einblick in laufende Initiativen: Du wirkst an strategischen Projekten mit, die den deutschen Markt für Qonto voranbringen.

  • Gestaltungsspielraum bei KI: Das Team baut seine KI-Praxis aktiv aus, und du kannst das mitgestalten.

  • Echte Eigenverantwortung: Kleines Team, große Verantwortung. Du bist Teil eines erfahrenen Teams, in dem du dein Portfolio wirklich selbst verantwortest.

jobs.title: Marketing Manager (m/f/d) - Berlin
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Voyfai, a fast-growing Series A startup shaping the future of logistics and technology across Europe.

Headquartered in Berlin, we operate at the centre of a broader group of companies active across several European markets.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with our Co-Founders from day one, drive meaningful impact and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Whether you're shaping how we run the company, leading strategic initiatives or building new organisational rhythms from scratch, your contributions will directly influence the success of Voyfai and the companies we support. If you're passionate about building from scratch and excited to be part of a company on the rise, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role

As our Marketing Manager (m/f/d), you will drive our social media reach to grow our membership. You will attract European and US freight forwarders who join our network and route their Asia–Europe volumes through our procurement hub in Hong Kong, with LinkedIn and WeChat as your key channels, supported by trade press outreach. You are a hands-on executor: you turn goals into content, campaigns and pitches that get results, and you bring ideas of your own. You will report to our Director of Global Network and work closely with our commercial, product and procurement teams. This role is based in Berlin.

What You Will Do

  • Own our social media presence, starting with LinkedIn and expanding to WeChat, including content, campaigns and the profiles of our leadership and network team

  • Create content built for reach, and adapt it to how each platform's algorithm works

  • Run campaigns and pitch our story to freight and logistics trade media to bring qualified freight forwarders to the commercial team

  • Write presentations, sales pitches and member material together with the commercial and product teams

  • Work with our Hong Kong procurement team to showcase the strength of our offering

  • Prepare the marketing material for trade fairs and industry events, such as decks, one-pagers and social posts

  • Brief and coordinate freelancers or other support where needed

  • Track reach, engagement and member growth, and report on results

What You Bring

  • 5 years of B2B marketing experience with a focus on social media, ideally in freight, logistics, B2B services, SaaS, membership or network businesses

  • A proven track record of growing reach and engagement on LinkedIn, organic and paid

  • Experience in freight, logistics or a similar industry, or a track record of marketing to logistics professionals, ideally including freight forwarder networks or membership organisations

  • A clear understanding of how social media algorithms work and what drives reach

  • Fluent English with excellent writing and presentation skills, including sales pitches, decks and media pitches

  • Comfort working with AI tools in your daily work

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager (Builder) (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Voyfai, a fast-growing Series A startup shaping the future of logistics and technology across Europe.

Headquartered in Berlin, we operate at the centre of a broader group of companies active across several European markets.

This is a unique opportunity to work directly with our Co-Founders from day one, drive meaningful impact and grow within a dynamic, fast-paced environment. Whether you're shaping how we run the company, leading strategic initiatives or building new organisational rhythms from scratch, your contributions will directly influence the success of Voyfai and the companies we support. If you're passionate about building from scratch and excited to be part of a company on the rise, we'd love to hear from you.

Your Role:

As Senior Product Manager (m/f/d), you own a part of our product from the problem to the release. You spend time with operators in our forwarding companies, decide what is worth building, and design it yourself instead of writing a ticket and waiting. You work with the Head of Product, our engineers and the teams inside our group companies. AI tools are how you work every day, so an idea becomes a clickable prototype in days, not in a sprint. In your first six months, success means operators on Compass and Customs feel the difference in their daily work, and at least one new AI agent you shaped runs in production.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the discovery: sit with operators across Europe, watch how they really work, and decide what we build next

  • Design and prototype your own ideas with tools like Claude Code, Claude Design, Cursor or Lovable, and test them with real users the same week

  • Write specs that engineers can pick up without a long meeting, then stay close until the feature is live

  • Build the AI agents that take the manual work out of freight forwarding, for example customs declarations, air waybill creation and document extraction

  • Ship the small fixes and improvements yourself instead of adding them to a queue

  • Keep operators, engineers and stakeholders aligned, and say no to the things that do not move the needle in terms of impact.

What You Bring:

  • 3 to 5 years in product, ideally in B2B SaaS or operational software, with real ownership and not only delivery

  • Daily practice with AI-native tools, not a few tests on the weekend

  • Design craft you can show, plus enough code to push a small change to production alone

  • Experience running user interviews, and the discipline to cut a messy problem into a small first scope

  • Comfort with ambiguity, and with travel, because many of our users sit in offices in Netherlands, Poland, Germany and beyond

  • Fluent English, and patience with people who use it as a second language

Bonus If You Have

  • Exposure to logistics, freight forwarding, customs or another complex operational domain

  • Experience inside acquired companies, where change management weighs as much as the product

What We Offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity options

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

As a Sales Engineer with a focus on Enterprise and Midmarket, you are responsible for all technical aspects of supporting our sales team by determining technical requirements, matching them to Sophos solutions, making product trials and evaluations successful, and generating business. You will present in front of, as well as train, larger audiences.

  • Assist technical staff from partners and customers in the design and architecture of prospect solutions based on appropriate sizing and resiliency guidelines

  • Conduct demos, product and company presentations - also to larger audiences - to help increase the company revenue; support partners, sales or other audience

  • Technical expertise in Endpoint products and MDR/SOC Services

  • Knowledge in AI technologies and Tools

  • Understanding the principles of public Cloud infrastructure Technologies

  • Experience in working and supporting channel Partners

  • Good presentation skills – ability to prepare and deliver an effective technical presentation to a technical or non-technical management audience unassisted

  • Ability to link product features to business Benefits and requirements

  • Ability to perform needs assessment, understanding technical needs/fit, pain points and competitive threats

  • Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal also in English

  • Strong troubleshooting skills – escalating the issue with appropriate details if required. Offer prescriptive suggestions for future prevention.

  • Ability to be hands-on, working directly with partners and customers, handling technical requirements and configuration issues

  • A full driving license is required.

  • Willingness to frequent travel within Germany, Austria, Switzerland, occasionally international for conferences and training.

jobs.title: Inside  Sales - Commercial Account Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role Summary

With a focus on Commercial Accounts (1-100 company size), you will be the Sophos Sales representative in an assigned territory in  Germany. You will be responsible for generating business for Sophos with our partners, building and maintaining strong and sustainable relationships, managing customers and prospects in order to develop and maintain Sophos business and meet/exceed sales targets.

This hybrid role requires on-site attendance 1–2 days per week.

What You Will Do:

  • Achieve bookings quota & KPIs for all accounts in the assigned territory (size of company may vary before starting a new financial year)

  • Achieve new business and product targets

  • Manage the entire customer engagement process, from customer requests coming through channel partners to development and retention

  • Engage and enable joint selling with channel partners

  • Work closely with channel partners in order to work on their opportunities and requests and expand their customer base

  • Regularly interact with internal Channel Teams to plan, work, and discuss Pipeline

  • Consistently articulate Sophos’ value proposition to customers to maintain and expand Sophos’ business within assigned customer accounts

  • Work on Sophos-generated Leads & Opportunities meeting internal SLAs

  • Proactively engage Sales Engineers & other stakeholders in appropriate opportunities

  • Successfully implement our sales methodology ‘BaseLine Selling’ as well as MEDDPICC in your daily business calls with end customers & partners

  • Ensure Pipeline Management is accurate for the current and upcoming quarters ahead meeting internal SLAs

  • Participate in internal education and training programs

  • Maintain good knowledge of the IT security market & Competition

  • Analyse territory performance based on Management key metrics (e.g. activity planning, revenue, daily billings, pipeline, won/loss, product growth etc…)

  • Deliver quarterly business review to Management

  • Provide timely and accurate sales forecasts

  • Log all activity to maintain accuracy of CRM and forecasting systems & meet internal SLAs

  • Handling of administrative tasks e.g. Quoting, CRM data cleaning

  • Attend Sophos or Partner organised events

  • Willingness to travel and meet customers/Partners/Distributors on site when needed

  • Substitution of colleagues within the sales team during holidays, illness and transition times

What You Will Bring:

  • First Work experience in a similar sales role, preferably experience in selling IT solutions through channel partners

  • Good knowledge of Sales Processes including acquisition, development and retention

  • Previous use of CRM / Forecasting System

  • Fluent in English and German verbal / written

  • Strong structured working method

Team Lead Global Logistics (all genders)

Your Role & Impact

  • Ensure operational efficiency, inventory accuracy, quality, and scalability of hub operations.

Engineering Manager - Device Plattform (all genders)

 

Your Role & Impact

At tonies, we are continuously evolving our device and system architecture to strengthen the foundation for future product experiences. As Engineering Manager for the Device Platform team, you define the system architecture (RTOS, Embedded Linux, Android, or alternatives) and deliver a stable, performant firmware platform that ‘Experience teams’ can build against with confidence.

In our JDM setup, the manufacturing partner handles electronics hardware, low-level drivers, BSP, and mechanics, while your team steers platform decisions to ensure a reliable, product-grade system. You will scale our existing core team, primarily through external engineering partners, to drive our platform roadmap.

Our device architecture is feature-rich, battery-powered, and connected—requiring expertise in connectivity, sensors, tight power budgets, and real-time requirements.

 

What you'll do

  • Team Leadership & Build-up: Take ownership of the existing team and scale it — largely through external partners — while building a cohesive engineering culture across internal staff, external engineers, and JDM partner engineers.

  • Platform Selection & Architecture: Drive the programme's most consequential technical decision: choosing and validating the system platform based on product requirements, resource constraints, time-to-market, and long-term extensibility.

  • JDM Steering: Act as the engineering counterpart to the JDM on electronics and firmware — defining deliverables, setting quality standards, reviewing hardware designs and drivers, and ensuring BSP drops integrate cleanly.

  • Interfaces & Delivery: Experience teams specify the APIs they need; your team delivers them reliably. You turn every boundary — JDM below, experience teams above — into a testable contract rather than a coordination bottleneck.

  • Leading Through Ambiguity: Requirements will shift, trade-offs will be sharp (performance vs. battery, flexibility vs. time-to-market). You keep the team productive and aligned through that uncertainty.

  • Technical Credibility: Stay close enough to the firmware to challenge architectural choices, evaluate JDM deliveries with authority, and step in on critical problems yourself.

  • Delivery Excellence: Own milestones, JDM integration gates, and release cadence to the experience teams — keeping the programme plannable and on track.

jobs.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Merge is the leading provider of agentic tools and customer-facing integrations for frontier LLMs, Fortune 500 organizations, and B2B SaaS companies.

Our platform offers two core products: Merge for Product, and Merge for Workforce. Merge for Product enables teams to ship AI features and integrations at massive scale. Merge for Workforce helps engineering teams govern AI access at the company level. Merge's enterprise-grade platform handles the entire integration lifecycle, from authentication and security to monitoring and maintenance. Thousands of companies trust Merge to accelerate product development, unblock sales, reduce customer churn, and save engineering resources—allowing them to focus on their core product.

Merge is seeking an experienced DevOps engineer to join our Foundations Engineering team. The right person will be a key player in driving new data and services strategies when it comes to infrastructure and AWS decisions for Merge, as well as being critical to delivering on re-architecture strategy as we scale the company.

What will you be doing?

  • With reliability and scalability in mind, work with the rest of the engineering team to produce highly performant architectures that extend to some of our largest customers, reading and writing millions of rows per second across numerous databases, workers, and services

  • Participate in roadmapping, architecture, and planning discussions

  • Produce high-quality, production-ready, maintainable infrastructure as code

  • Lead large projects from initial inception to production

  • Run production systems at scale

  • Participate in on-call rotation and infrastructure maintenance

What experience is required?

  • 4+ years of full-time DevOps experience

  • Deep experience with AWS/GCP cloud infrastructure, Terraform, and Kubernetes

  • Ability to own the planning and deployment of highly scalable systems

  • Familiarity with some or all of the following technologies: AWS Aurora, Redshift, Kinesis, EC2, EKS, ECS, Redis, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Grafana, VictoriaMetrics

Compensation

  • The cash compensation range for this role is $155,000-$185,000.

  • Actual compensation packages are based on a wide array of factors unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, years & depth of experience, certifications. In addition to cash compensation, all employees receive an equity compensation package.

Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO + 10 company holidays

  • Pre-Tax commuter benefits

  • 100% covered health, vision, and dental insurance

  • 401K Plan

  • $200 one-time home office stipend, and free dinner when working past 6pm

  • Annual company off-sites and quarterly team events. Past locations have included: Nashville, Sonoma, Hudson Valley, San Diego

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer - Healthcare IT/Telematikinfrastruktur (x/f/m)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Du hast ein starkes technisches Wissen und Lust, Dich tief in die deutsche Healthcare-IT einzuarbeiten? Dann bist Du hier richtig.

Im Technical Services arbeitest Du an der Schnittstelle zwischen unserer Doctolib-Plattform und der deutschen Healthcare-IT-Landschaft. Du löst komplexe Integrationsprobleme, unterstützt unsere Kund:innen bei technischen Herausforderungen und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass Doctolib reibungslos in die Infrastruktur unserer Kund:innen integriert ist.

Du musst nicht vom ersten Tag an alles wissen. Mit Deinen fundierten Grundlagen und Deiner Motivation, unterstützen wir Dich, Dich in Themen wie die Telematikinfrastruktur und API/Konnektoren, einzuarbeiten.

Deine Aufgaben 

Du bist technische Ansprechperson rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur – von der Schnittstellen-Architektur über Kartenverwaltung bis hin zu Gematik-Standards. Kein Tag ist wie der andere.

  • Produkte, die laufen: Du supportest Doctolib-Lösungen rund um die Deutsche Telematikinfrastruktur. und sorgst dafür, dass sie korrekt konfiguriert sind – und wenn doch mal etwas hakt, findest du heraus, warum.

  • Komplexe Probleme, echte Lösungen: Interoperabilitätsprobleme mit Konnektoren und APIs gehören zu deinem Alltag – du arbeitest eng mit IT-Service-Partnern zusammen und bringst auch schwierige Fälle zum Abschluss.

  • Tiefer tauchen, sauber dokumentieren: Du analysierst technische Herausforderungen eigenständig, hältst alles strukturiert in Jira fest und arbeitest direkt mit den Entwicklerteams zusammen, um Fehler nachhaltig zu beheben.

  • KI als Werkzeug, nicht als Buzzword: Du nutzt KI-Tools aktiv, um schneller zu Lösungen zu kommen und Dir fundiertes Wissen aufzubauen – effizient und zielgerichtet.

  • Wissen, das bleibt: Du teilst dein Know-how proaktiv mit internen Teams, damit Probleme gar nicht erst entstehen und unsere Kund:innen das bestmögliche Erlebnis haben.

Dein Profil

Das solltest du mitbringen:

  • API-Integration und Troubleshooting sind für dich kein Neuland – du hast echte Erfahrung damit, Probleme zu identifizieren und zu lösen.

  • Du kennst dich mit komplexen IT-Infrastrukturen, Netzwerken und sicherheitskritischen Systemen aus – und weißt, worauf es in solchen Umgebungen ankommt.

  • Du kannst technische Sachverhalte so erklären, dass sie ankommen – egal ob du gerade mit einer Entwicklerin oder einer Praxismanagerin sprichst.

  • Deutsch fließend (C1) und Englisch solide (B2) – du bewegst dich in beiden Sprachen sicher.

Das ist ein Plus – oder du lernst es bei uns:

  • Kenntnisse rund um die Telematikinfrastruktur, Gematik-Standards oder andere Healthcare-IT-Systeme – wer schon mal mit KIM+, eAU- oder E-Rezept-Workflows gearbeitet hat, ist klar im Vorteil.

  • Erfahrung mit Observability-Tools wie Kibana, Datadog oder Elasticsearch.

  • Ein Abschluss in Informatik, Medizinischer Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Berufserfahrung ist willkommen – aber kein Pflichtfeld.

Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Wir suchen Dich als Senior Medical Content Manager (x/f/m) als Unterstützung für das Patient Content Factory Team in Berlin.

Doctolib ist Europas führender Health Companion und begleitet Millionen von Patient:innen und Gesundheitsfachkräften auf dem gesamten Kontinent. Wir transformieren die Gesundheitsversorgung, indem wir unsere Plattform mit innovativen Lösungen rund um Prävention und Patient:innen-Empowerment bereichern.

Unser nächster Schritt: Doctolib zur vertrauenswürdigsten Gesundheitskontent-Destination in Europa zu machen. Dies umfasst Präventionskampagnen sowie personalisierte Gesundheitsinformationen (Artikel, Videos, interaktive Inhalte), die auf verifizierten medizinischen Kenntnissen basieren.

Du verantwortlich für das Verfassen und die Verwaltung von Inhalten für den Health Companion der App — und stellst dabei höchste Qualitätsstandards sicher. Du koordinierst funktionsübergreifende Stakeholder, sorgst für End-to-End-Qualität an allen Touchpoints und steuerst die gesamte Content-Produktion.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du hilfst beim Aufbau und der Pflege des Redaktionskalenders für alle deutschen Gesundheitsinhalte und identifizierst Content-Möglichkeiten basierend auf Patient:innen-Bedürfnissen und öffentlichen Gesundheitsprioritäten

  • Du schreibst und erstellst verständliche medizinische Inhalte für Patient:innen und übersetzt komplexe medizinische Informationen in klare, handlungsorientierte Artikel für das deutsche Publikum

  • Du managst den gesamten Content-Workflow von der Idee bis zur Veröffentlichung und koordinierst interne sowie externe Content-Writer:innen für eine termingerechte Umsetzung

  • Du trägst zum Aufbau eines Netzwerks aus glaubwürdigen Partner:innen (Institutionen, Expert:innen, medizinische Fachgesellschaften) bei, um die Autorität von Doctolibs Gesundheitsinhalten zu stärken

jobs.title: Customer Success Consultant (x/f/m)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Werde Teil unserer Mission, werde Teil von Doctolib!

Gemeinsam mit uns gestaltest Du die Zukunft der Gesundheitsversorgung, digital, zugänglich und besser für alle.

Als Customer Success Consultant (m/w/d) sorgst Du dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen im Arbeitsalltag optimal mit Doctolib arbeiten können. Du unterstützt Dein Team im operativen Tagesgeschäft, bearbeitest Kundenanfragen, stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher und sorgst für reibungslose Abläufe in der Betreuung Deines Kundenportfolios.

Damit leistest Du einen wichtigen Beitrag zu langfristiger Kundenzufriedenheit, nachhaltiger Kundenbindung und weiterem Wachstum. Gleichzeitig hilfst Du Gesundheitsfachkräften dabei, ihren Arbeitsalltag effizienter zu gestalten, damit mehr Zeit für das bleibt, was wirklich zählt: die bestmögliche Versorgung ihrer Patient:innen.

Deine Rolle im Customer Success

Du arbeitest eng mit Deinem Team zusammen und unterstützt bei allen operativen Aufgaben rund um die Betreuung unserer Kund:innen. Dabei übernimmst Du Verantwortung für die Qualität und Effizienz der täglichen Abläufe.

Das erwartet Dich

  • Du betreust Dein Kundenportfolio operativ:
    Du führst standardisierte Prozesse in der Kundenbetreuung durch und stellst sicher, dass die täglichen Abläufe reibungslos funktionieren.

  • Du bearbeitest Kundenanfragen:
    Du prüfst eingehende Anliegen, bewertest deren Dringlichkeit und leitest sie bei Bedarf an die richtigen Ansprechpartner:innen innerhalb des Teams weiter.

  • Du sorgst für eine effiziente Bearbeitung:
    Du koordinierst die Weitergabe von Kundenanliegen und stellst sicher, dass relevante Informationen vollständig und nachvollziehbar dokumentiert sind.

  • Du stellst eine hohe Datenqualität sicher:
    Du pflegst und aktualisierst Kundendaten sorgfältig und dokumentierst Kundeninteraktionen sowie wichtige Informationen strukturiert.

  • Du konfigurierst Produkteinstellungen:
    Du richtest Einstellungen in Doctolib ein, überprüfst deren Nutzung und optimierst sie, damit unsere Kund:innen das Produkt bestmöglich in ihrem Arbeitsalltag einsetzen können.

  • Du begleitest Kund:innen in unterschiedlichen Phasen:
    Du unterstützt bei Vertragsabschlüssen, Kündigungen und organisatorischen Anliegen, beispielsweise bei Lizenzübertragungen.

  • Du arbeitest teamübergreifend:
    Gemeinsam mit Deinem Team setzt Du operative Schwerpunkte um und trägst zu unseren gemeinsamen Zielen bei: Kundenzufriedenheit, Kundenbindung und Wachstum.

Das bringst Du mit

Vorab: Wenn Du nicht jedes einzelne Kriterium erfüllst, aber überzeugt bist, dass die Rolle zu Deinen Fähigkeiten passt, freuen wir uns trotzdem über Deine Bewerbung.

Für diese Position bringst Du idealerweise Folgendes mit:

  • Erste Erfahrung im Kundenkontakt:
    Du hast bereits erste Erfahrungen im Umgang mit Kund:innen gesammelt, zum Beispiel als Werkstudent:in im Customer Success, im Kundendienst, im Vertriebsinnendienst oder in einer vergleichbaren operativen Rolle. Auch als Quereinsteiger:in bist Du willkommen.

  • Organisationstalent:
    Du arbeitest strukturiert, behältst auch bei mehreren parallelen Themen den Überblick und kannst Aufgaben sinnvoll priorisieren.

jobs.title: Staff Site Reliability Engineer (x/f/m)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

We are looking for a Staff Site Reliability Engineer to join our SRE team dedicated to platform reliability within Platform Engineering.

Your mission will be to act as a technical leader driving Doctolib's reliability and scalability at a European scale, ensuring our platform remains reliable, debuggable, and resilient across infrastructure, observability, and cross-cutting reliability initiatives. You will play a pivotal role in a team driving reliability standards across 170+ applications, contributing directly to supporting 520,000 health professionals and 90 million patients in their daily healthcare journey.

This role sits at the intersection of infrastructure, developer experience, and product engineering. You'll act as a technical leader and strategic partner to SREs, software engineers, and product teams, guiding decisions, mentoring engineers, and driving cross-cutting initiatives that elevate our operational maturity.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead large-scale cross-cutting reliability initiatives across the platform, spanning infrastructure automation, observability, and incident management

  • Identify and drive improvements to incident detection, response, and postmortem analysis capabilities

  • Define and evolve SLOs, error budgets, and alerting standards across multiple product teams

  • Take part in the on-call rotation, and actively contribute to improving our on-call experience by refining alerting, reducing noise, and ensuring actionable telemetry

  • Serve as a mentor and technical coach to senior engineers, helping elevate the craft of reliability engineering across the company

  • Influence strategic decisions by providing technical guidance to leadership and representing reliability engineering in architectural reviews and platform discussions

  • Partner with software engineering teams to embed reliability practices early in the development lifecycle

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have extensive experience (8+ years) in SRE, platform engineering, or infrastructure roles within a large-scale, multi-team production environment

  • Have proven experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure

  • Have strong experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, Kubernetes is a must, its deployment and scaling strategies ecosystem

  • Have implemented and operated SLIs, SLOs, and error budgets in production

  • Have experience managing on-call rotations and leading incident response in high-stakes environments

  • Have a strong systems engineering background with fluency in at least one backend programming language (e.g., Go, Python, Ruby)

  • Have a proven ability to lead through influence: setting technical direction, driving consensus, and mentoring engineers across teams

  • Are comfortable balancing long-term architecture work with fast, iterative improvements

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Working Student – IT Asset & Stock Management (x/f/m) – Berlin

Join our mission, join Doctolib!

Doctolib is looking for you as a Working Student in IT Asset & Stock Management to support our IT team at our office in Berlin.

To give the best experience to Doctolibers and support Doctolib’s growth, you will help manage our IT stock and asset base, including laptops, smartphones and accessories. Reporting to the IT team, you will own the reliability of our hardware inventory and contribute to day-to-day on-site support in an international environment across Germany, France, Italy and the Netherlands.

What you’ll do

As a Working Student, you will support us in the following areas:

IT stock and asset management — approximately 70%

  • Manage the site’s IT stock, including receiving, checking, labelling and storing laptops, smartphones and accessories

  • Keep the inventory up to date in our asset management tool and ensure the accuracy of serial numbers, assignments and statuses

  • Follow the full equipment lifecycle, including assignment, return, loan, vendor repair, refurbishment and recycling

  • Run periodic physical inventories and consistency checks between physical stock and the asset management tool

  • Monitor stock levels, flag replenishment thresholds and contribute to supplier orders

  • Prepare devices, including mobile device management enrolment, standard configuration and accessory kits

  • Propose improvements to stock processes, documentation, automation and key performance indicators

On-site support — approximately 30%

  • Support onboarding and offboarding by preparing, handing over and recovering equipment for joiners and leavers

  • Run the Berlin IT Corner as a physical point of contact for Doctolibers

  • Manage meeting room hardware by testing, updating and replacing equipment

  • Handle level 1 requests and incidents, including basic diagnosis and application access, and escalate to level 2 when needed

  • Identify recurring requests and contribute to continuous improvement

Working with us, you will learn:

  • How to manage the full lifecycle of IT hardware and maintain reliable asset data

  • How on-site IT support contributes to a smooth employee experience

  • How to identify opportunities to improve operational processes through documentation, automation and performance indicators

Who you are

jobs.title: Praktikum Campaign Management (x/f/m)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Gemeinsam gestalten wir die Gesundheitsversorgung der Zukunft

Doctolib sucht Dich ab Januar 2027 als Praktikant:in im Bereich Campaign Management für unseren Standort in Berlin.

Unser Team im Bereich Patient Solutions betreut gesponserte Präventionskampagnen auf Doctolib – immer mit dem Ziel, die Gesundheit aller zu verbessern. Die Onlinekampagnen behandeln Themen wie Rückengesundheit, Krebsvorsorge oder Angststörungen und richten sich an unsere 30 Millionen Nutzer:innen in Deutschland. Über die Doctolib Patient App sowie die mobilen und Desktop-Versionen erreichen wir sie genau in dem Moment, in dem sie sich mit ihrer Gesundheit beschäftigen. Unser Anspruch ist es, mit vertrauenswürdigen Informationen einen konkreten Beitrag zur Gesundheit zu leisten.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Praktikant:in unterstützt Du uns dabei in folgenden Aufgabenbereichen: 

  • Du trackst die Performance laufender Kampagnen und bereitest die Ergebnisse für unsere Kund:innen auf.

  • Du begleitest Kampagnen von der Vorbereitung über den Livegang bis zur Auswertung ihrer Performance.

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner:in für das operative Kampagnenmanagement.

  • Du arbeitest eng mit dem Sales-Team zusammen.

  • Du analysierst die Zufriedenheit unserer Kund:innen und identifizierst Optimierungspotenziale in der Umsetzung.

  • Du bringst Dich in die strategische Weiterentwicklung unserer Dashboards, insbesondere in Tableau, sowie unserer Prozesse ein.

  • Du arbeitest mit Tools wie Canva, K.I., WordPress etc.

Während Deiner Tätigkeit bei uns wirst Du:

  • umfassendes Wissen im Bereich Healthcare Marketing sammeln.

  • Kampagnen-KPIs und Kundenzufriedenheit messen, reporten und verbessern.

  • Deine Fähigkeiten in den Bereichen Kommunikation und Projektmanagement mit internen und externen Stakeholdern weiterentwickeln.

Dein Profil

Du bist der festen Überzeugung, dass Du genau das mitbringst, was es für die Position braucht? Dann ermutigen wir Dich, Dich zu bewerben. Selbst wenn Du nicht jede Anforderung erfüllst, bist Du vielleicht genau die/der richtige zukünftige Doctoliber:in für diese oder andere Stellen!

Um Teil unseres Teams zu werden, bringst Du Folgendes mit:

  • Du studierst im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation oder einem ähnlichen Bereich oder hast Dein Studium gerade abgeschlossen und stehst für ein 6-monatiges Praktikum zur Verfügung.

  • Du begeisterst Dich für digitales Marketing und Kampagnenmanagement und interessierst Dich für Gesundheitsthemen.

  • Du arbeitest gerne datenbasiert und zeichnest Dich durch eine strukturierte, proaktive Arbeitsweise sowie ein ausgeprägtes Auge fürs Detail aus.

jobs.title: Engineering Manager  (x/f/m)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Set a new pulse for healthcare!

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to join our team in Berlin.

Working in the tech team at Doctolib means building innovative products and features to improve the daily lives of care teams and patients.

What you'll do

Your responsibilities include but are not limited to:

  • Lead a team of 6 to 7 engineers of mixed seniority, owning delivery, quality and production health end to end — keeping engagement high and standards higher

  • Together with your product partner, define the mission and vision for your team and build a roadmap you can defend to stakeholders

  • Take part in architecture reviews and help shape the technical direction of the Scheduling stream, including the migration of core scheduling capabilities from the monolith into purpose-built services

  • Set and uphold the security, reliability, performance and scalability standards required to remain the most trusted e-health SaaS in Europe

  • Partner with Talent and People teams to recruit, develop and retain engineers through career conversations and feedback they can act on

  • Embed AI-assisted engineering into how your team works day to day, with a clear and honest view of where it helps and where it does not

  • Continuously improve how the team operates — planning, on-call, bug backlog, incident follow-up — so the team spends its energy on what moves the needle

Who you are

Before you read on: if you don't have the exact profile described below, but you feel this job description matches your skill set, we still encourage you to apply.

You'll be a great fit if you:

  • Have at least 6 years of software engineering experience and 3 years of engineering management experience, including leading a team of 5+ engineers through delivery, hiring and growth

  • Are credible with senior backend engineers — distributed systems, data modelling, latency and throughput are conversations you can hold and challenge; you stay close enough to the code to review a pull request, without needing to be the one writing it

  • Have hands-on experience modernising a large legacy system, ideally extracting services from a monolith, and know how to keep a team delivering while the ground moves

  • Are an effective communicator who can translate company goals into team objectives, and who says the uncomfortable thing early rather than late

  • Think critically and objectively, with a solution-oriented approach that brings people with you

It would be fantastic if you:

  • Have worked in a regulated industry such as healthcare or fintech, where privacy and data protection shape design decisions

  • Have navigated hyper-growth environments and understand the trade-offs they force on architecture and team organisation

  • Have formed a considered view on AI coding assistants — their real benefits and their real shortcomings
