jobs.title: Teach English From Home with YiYi !
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.title: College Counselor- Part-Time
jobs.descriptionHtml:
A part-time college counselor works with students and families through the college search and admissions process. This person must have impeccable communication skills, be able to connect with both high school students and their parents and be incredibly knowledgeable about colleges and the admissions process. The Counselor will also support other college counselors and our essay coaches in their work with students.

The position reports to the Director of Admissions Counseling. Because we work mostly with high school students and their parents, we tend to work in the later afternoons, evenings, and weekends. There is some flexibility in the schedule, as long as it is coordinated with families and the team. The position will evolve over time as the ideal candidate will take our current practices and expand and enhance them.

Families may sign up to do hourly work with a counselor or may sign up for our comprehensive program, which does not count hours. A typical student starts work with a counselor in the early Junior year. A part-time counselor must commit to working with at least 5 "comprehensive" (or hourly equivalent) students in each graduating class.

College Counselor Responsibilities:

We are currently seeking hire an additional College Counselor in one of our offices or remotely to work with high school students and their families through the college admissions process. This position may be part-time or full-time, depending on the candidate’s preference.

Direct Services

  • Work with roughly 30 students (full-time) or 5+ students (part-time) in each graduating class through all aspects of the college admissions process;
  • Communicate with parents on a regular basis;
  • Make use of publicly available data to inform advice and expertise;
Professional Development
  • Regularly participate in professional development opportunities, including regional and national conferences, webinars, college tours, and more;
  • Keep current on current trends in college admissions;
  • Develop training and educational materials for self and others on the team.

Building a Caseload (for Full-Time Counselors)

  • Write blogs and articles targeted at high school students and their parents;
  • Coordinate events to speak publicly about college admissions;
  • Develop relationships with local high school counselors and other educational experts.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required / advance degree preferred;
  • A minimum of three years of experience in admissions at a selective college or as an independent college counselor OR a minimum of five years of experience working as a counselor in a high school;
  • Exceptional writing skills;
  • Exceptional communication skills;
  • Attention to detail, with strong organizational skills;
  • Expertise in using web-based tools to advise students;
  • Ability to work evenings and weekends, as needed (determined by students’ schedule).
Compensation and Benefits
  • The full-time position is a salaried position ($70,000-$90,000 based on previous experience and education); the part-time position is compensated on an hourly basis ($60-90 per billable hour; all team members are also paid a prep-time rate for non-billable work).
  • Up to 5% match 401(k) (for eligible employees)
  • Health insurance stipend (for full-time employees)
  • Paid membership in professional organizations
  • Stipend for travel for college visits and conferences
  • 3 weeks PTO (for full-time employees)

jobs.title: Virtual Medical Billing and RCM specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced and detail-oriented Virtual Medical Biller to manage the complete revenue cycle for family practice and primary care physician accounts. In this remote role, you will oversee day-to-day medical billing operations to maximize collection rates, minimize accounts receivable (A/R) days, and ensure accuracy across all patient billing lifecycles.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

1. End-to-End Revenue Cycle Management: Manage the full medical billing cycle from patient registration and insurance verification to charge entry, claim submission, and payment posting.

2. Claims Scrubbing & Submission: Ensure electronic claims are meticulously reviewed and scrubbed prior to submission to reduce initial rejection and denial rates.

3. Denials Management & Appeals: Proactively track, analyze, and appeal denied or rejected claims with commercial payers, Medicare, and Medicaid.

4. Accounts Receivable (A/R) Follow-Up: Regularly work aging reports, follow up on unpaid claims, and resolve billing discrepancies with insurance carriers.

5. Patient Billing & Support: Handle patient billing inquiries, set up payment plans, and assist with financial clearance when necessary.

6. Compliance & Accuracy: Ensure all billing practices comply with HIPAA regulations, payer guidelines, and coding standards.

Qualifications & Requirements:

  • Experience: Minimum of 2 years of dedicated medical billing experience specializing in full revenue cycle management.
  • Specialty Experience: Proven track record working with Family Practice or Primary Care physician practices.
  • EMR/EHR Proficiency: Hands-on experience and deep familiarity with Athenahealth and/or AdvancedMD electronic medical record systems.
  • Technical Skills: Strong understanding of ICD-10, CPT, and HCPCS coding, medical terminology, and insurance verification workflows.
  • Communication & Organization: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work independently in a remote virtual environment.
  • Reliable and able to commit long term for this role.

Business Systems Analyst II (m/w/d)

Vollzeit / Unbefristet


CSL ist ein weltweit führendes Biotechnologieunternehmen und entwickelt Therapien, die Menschen mit seltenen und schweren Erkrankungen ein besseres Leben ermöglichen. Grundlage vieler dieser Therapien ist menschliches Plasma, und hier kommt CSLPlasma ins Spiel. Wir betreiben eines der größten Plasmaspendenetzwerke der Welt und sorgen dafür, dass dieser wertvolle Rohstoff sicher gewonnen, verarbeitet und transportiert wird. Unsere Mitarbeitenden arbeiten dabei jeden Tag mit geschäftskritischen Anwendungen, die Plasmagewinnung, Produktion und Logistik zuverlässig steuern.

In dieser Rolle unterstützt du unsere Operations-Teams für das Donor Management System und das Plasma Logistics System. Das Donor Management System wird täglich in unseren europäischen Plasmaspendezentren eingesetzt, das Plasma Logistics System in unseren globalen Plasma-Logistikzentren und in den Fraktionierungen. Dein Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Erstellung und Pflege von Dokumentation sowie auf Test- und Validierungsaktivitäten. Dabei arbeitest du eng mit Fachbereichen, Entwicklung und Qualitätswesen zusammen und begleitest Änderungen und Releases von der Anforderung bis zur Freigabe.

Deine Aufgaben

× Unterstützung der Fachabteilung zur Definition der Benutzeranforderungen an das Softwaresystem (User Requirements) sowie deren Abstimmung in lokalen & globalen Projektteams.

Architekturspezifikationen, Funktionsspezifikationen, Designspezifikationen, Listen und Diagramme, funktionale und Konfigurationsspezifikationen), um die Darstellung und technische Umsetzung der Benutzeranforderungen zu gewährleisten sowie den Systemprogrammierern entsprechende Anweisungen zu geben.

× Erstellung der Validierungsplanung in Übereinstimmung mit einer Funktion aus dem Qualitätswesen

× Kontrolle und Überwachung der Umsetzung der definierten Maßnahmen im Validierungsplan

× Vorbereitung von Testfällen und Skripts, die für die Design- und Funktionsanforderungen relevant sind, um die CSL-Qualitäts- und Governance-Standards und -Verfahren einzuhalten

× Koordination oder Durchführung der Systemfunktionsprüfung mit geeigneten internen oder externen Ressourcen

× Erstellung und Aktualisierung von SOPs, Betriebs- und Projektdokumentation auf Basis interner und externer Vorgaben

× Durchführung der Wartung von Applikationen für die zugeordneten globalen IT-Funktionsbereiche

× Beurteilen und Umsetzen von Änderungsanforderungen

× Zusammenarbeit mit globalen Prozesseignern / Business Stakeholdern, um die Prüfbarkeit zu gewährleisten

Deine Qualifikationen

× i.d.R. abgeschlossenes Studium zum Bachelor of Science, bspw. Informatik oder Computer Science

× Kenntnisse der MS Office Produkte

× Kenntnisse in allen Aspekten des SDLC

× Technische und funktionale Kenntnisse zur Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Architektur von Lösungen

× Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

× 4-5 Jahre Berufserfahrung

× Wünschenswert:

o Erfahrung im GxP-regulierten Umfeld (z.B. Computer System Validation)

o Erfahrung mit Jira/Confluence, GitLab und Veeva

o Erfahrung mit Automated Testing z.B. Playwright

o Kenntnisse in einer relationalen Datenbank, Programmiersprache oder Reporting Engine

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sedona Digital is a technology consulting and services company specialising in AI, Data, Security, Business Applications and Software Engineering. We help organisations solve complex business and technology challenges, from strategy and solution design through to implementation and ongoing delivery.

Our teams combine deep technical expertise with a practical, outcome-focused approach, working with clients through consulting, project delivery, capability augmentation and managed teams. We are focused on helping organisations modernise their technology, unlock value from their data, adopt AI safely and build the capabilities they need for the future.

The Role

Sedona Digital is looking for a Senior Business Analyst to lead analysis for a Finance / FP&A data-product engagement. This is a senior, self-sufficient role requiring someone who can independently own complex requirements, challenge senior stakeholders, connect business needs to data and technology delivery, and provide analytical leadership across the wider Business Analysis activity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead discovery and requirements activity across Finance, Data and Technology stakeholders.
  • Define the problem, scope, business outcomes, use cases and end-to-end requirements.
  • Facilitate workshops and challenge assumptions, ambiguity and conflicting stakeholder needs.
  • Produce and manage epics, features, user stories, process/data flows and acceptance criteria.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

LMI is seeking a Staff Data Engineer to build authoritative data products supporting Customs and Border Patrol (CBP) acquisition and program operations. This engineer will own data pipelines, models, and ontology within the LIGER deployment to CBP’s Google Cloud environment.

This is a senior individual-contributor role for an engineer who can make architectural decisions, build production systems, and raise the technical standard of the team.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Own the architecture and implementation of scalable data pipelines and data products.
  • Integrate and transform data from multiple CBP and enterprise sources.
  • Develop data models and ontology that support applications, reporting, and analysis.
  • Design for data quality, lineage, security, observability, and long-term maintainability.
  • Establish engineering standards for testing, source control, deployment, and operations.
  • Partner with software engineers, product designers, and customer stakeholders.
  • Review technical designs, mentor engineers, and resolve complex data challenges.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, data science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Two or more years of experience building production data systems. 4 years or more preferred
  • Strong proficiency with Python, SQL, and modern data-engineering patterns.
  • Experience designing data pipelines and products on enterprise data platforms (preferably Google Cloud & Big Query).
  • Experience with data modeling, ontology, data quality, and lineage.
  • Strong software-engineering fundamentals, including testing, source control, CI/CD, and monitoring.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting a Department of Homeland Security customer.
  • DHS Public Trust clearance.
  • Experience with Kafka or other distributed data-processing technologies.
  • Experience with cloud platforms, DevSecOps, and infrastructure as code.
  • Experience building data pipelines/data models for an AI system

Target salary range: $120,000 - $180,000

Individual salaries are determined by various factors including, but not limited to location, internal equity, business considerations, client contract requirements, and candidate qualifications, such as education, experience, skills, and security clearances.

jobs.title: Logistic Operations Manager US
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Hilo by Aktiia

High blood pressure is the world's most common disease, causing 18M deaths each year. At Hilo by Aktiia, we're building a world where no lives are lost to its effects — with technology that helps people take control of their health.

We're a venture-backed scale-up with $96M raised from investors in Europe and the US. Rooted in 18 years of research at the Swiss Center for Electronics and Microtechnology (CSEM), our device is the world's only medically accurate, cuffless, continuous blood pressure monitor for daily use — clinically validated and CE Marked as a Class IIa medical device, now available in 12 countries. In July, we launched in the US.

We're a remote-first company headquartered in Neuchâtel, Switzerland, united by our passion for impact and innovation.

Role overview

Every Hilo Band that reaches a customer on time is one more person who can start taking control of their blood pressure. As Logistics Manager you own our day- to- day D2C logistics execution end to end: Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada markets. That covers daily fulfilment and outbound logistics, inbound transportation from our factories to regional warehouses, last mile delivery, returns, and the daily relationship with our 3PLs and carriers. Our network has grown to six third party logistics partners worldwide, including our newest partner in the US. Your impact comes from running the operation superbly well every day, resolving issues before customers feel them, and steadily making the flows you own smoother, faster and more cost efficient. You contribute to our wider logistics strategy, while overall network architecture sits with Operations leadership. You work as an individual contributor without direct reports, in close collaboration with Manufacturing, Finance, Sales, Quality and Customer Service, with room to grow as the network scales.

Location: US-based, preferably East Coast, must be authorised to work in the United States, with regular traveling. The role requires minimum half-day working hours to overlap with our European-based team (CET), and travel to team and business events quarterly (or as needed).

Core responsibilities

End to end D2C logistics operations

  • Own end to end D2C logistics for Webshop and Amazon across the USA and Canada.
  • Run daily fulfilment and outbound logistics from order processing through final delivery, including last mile, returns and issue resolution.
  • Resolve exceptions fast and cleanly so customers never feel the friction behind the scenes.
  • Contribute to planning and implementing the overall logistics strategy.

3PL and carrier management

  • Manage and scale a multi 3PL network, including ramping up our newly launched US operation.
  • Own SLAs, performance reviews and capacity planning across logistics partners.
  • Be the daily operational contact for 3PLs and carriers, building relationships based on trust and clear expectations.

Inbound and international transportation

  • Own inbound transportation from our factories, for example in China and Vietnam, to regional warehouses.
  • Lead inbound carrier selection, route design, rate negotiation and cost to serve optimisation.
  • Coordinate freight booking, shipping schedules and handover to logistics partners.
  • Manage customs clearance processes and import documentation.

Product integrity and inventory execution

  • Ensure product integrity for devices that are sensitive to temperature, humidity and pressure.
  • Maintain inventory visibility across warehouses and sales channels.
  • Coordinate replenishment to avoid both stockouts and excess inventory.

Reporting and collaboration

  • Define and track logistics KPIs such as OTIF, lead time, cost per shipment...

jobs.title: Work from home - Online English Teacher with YiYi
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.title: Sales Partner - RealAdvisor (Mercado Español)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sales Partner – RealAdvisor (Mercado Español)

Buscamos vendedores con mentalidad de closer.

RealAdvisor es una de las principales plataformas digitales del ecosistema inmobiliario europeo. Fundada en Suiza, hoy apoyamos a más de 5.000 agencias inmobiliarias y llegamos a más de 10 millones de usuarios cada año en Europa.

Estamos acelerando nuestro crecimiento en el mercado español y buscamos Sales Partners freelance capaces de transformar oportunidades comerciales en clientes.

No es necesario conocer el sector inmobiliario: te formaremos en el producto y en el mercado. Lo que buscamos es una demostrada capacidad de venta y de cierre.

El resultado que buscamos

Nuestro objetivo es construir un equipo de vendedores capaces de alcanzar al menos 15 ventas al mes.

Para los profesionales que alcanzan un alto rendimiento, el plan de comisiones ofrece un potencial de ingresos superior a 20.000 € al mes, en función de los resultados obtenidos.

El principio es simple: cuanto más vendes, más ganas.

Tu rol

Tendrás la responsabilidad de todo el ciclo de venta, desde el primer contacto hasta la firma del contrato. No buscamos personas especializadas exclusivamente en prospecting o en demos. Buscamos full-cycle sales, capaces de gestionar de forma autónoma una negociación de principio a fin.

Tus responsabilidades incluirán:

  • Prospecting outbound y generación autónoma de oportunidades
  • Gestión de leads inbound
  • Gestión de reuniones cualificadas proporcionadas por nuestro equipo de SDR
  • Cualificación de prospects
  • Demos comerciales por videoconferencia
  • Análisis de necesidades del cliente
  • Presentación de la solución y propuesta de valor
  • Gestión de objeciones y negociación
  • Seguimiento estructurado
  • Envío y gestión del contrato
  • Cierre de la venta
  • Gestión completa del pipeline en el CRM

En resumen: del primer contacto a la firma.

Un rol de alta intensidad comercial

Es importante ser claros sobre el ritmo de trabajo requerido.

El rol prevé indicativamente 5 demos al día, generalmente a través de videollamadas de 20 a 40 minutos.

A estas actividades se suman el prospecting, el seguimiento, la negociación y la gestión del pipeline. Parte de las reuniones estará organizada por nuestro equipo de SDR, pero esperamos que el Sales Partner sea capaz de generar nuevas oportunidades por sí mismo.

Requirements

Requisitos (Quién buscamos)

No se requiere experiencia previa en el sector inmobiliario, pero es fundamental tener experiencia concreta en venta B2B/outbound.

Buscamos profesionales que:

  • Tengan experiencia previa en roles comerciales y venta outbound.
  • Sepan realizar demos comerciales efectivas por videollamada.
  • Dominen la gestión de objeciones, la negociación y el cierre de contratos.
  • Estén acostumbrados a trabajar por objetivos y KPIs.
  • Tengan mentalidad emprendedora, autonomía y disciplina.
  • Tengan experiencia en el uso de herramientas CRM.
  • Cuenten con español nativo o fluido (C1/C2).

No buscamos simplemente un comercial: buscamos un closer.

Benefits

Qué ofrecemos

  • Potencial de ingresos de 20.000 €+ al mes para perfiles de alto rendimiento (contamos con compañeros que superan de forma estable los 30.000 €/mes).
  • Plan de comisiones fuertemente orientado a resultados.
  • Reuniones cualificadas facilitadas por el equipo SDR.
  • Formación completa sobre el producto y el sector inmobiliario.
  • Colaboración freelance a largo plazo.
  • Apoyo continuo ...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Project Manager – Payment owns delivery of defined project(s) from initiation through close. Ensures plans are realistic, stakeholders are aligned, execution stays on track, and risks/issues are actively managed.

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain project plans, milestones, RAID logs, and status reporting.
  • Facilitate team meetings, decisions, issue resolution, and stakeholder follow-up.
  • Coordinate scope, schedule, resources, communications, and delivery readiness.
  • Escalate risks and tradeoffs in a timely manner.
  • Ensure project artifacts, governance requirements, and documentation are complete.
  • Owns one project’s scope, timeline, and execution discipline.
  • Utilize AI responsibly, to amplify productivity to draft status reports, maintain RAID logs, generate meeting notes and action items, build project plans, and prepare stakeholder communications.
  • Share best practices with project managers, product owners, business analysts as appropriate.
  • Proactively manage risks and issues, and escalate in a timely manner.
  • Key Interfaces -
    • Program Managers
    • PMO Analyst
    • Business stakeholders
    • Product
    • R&D
    • Operations
    • Vendors (if applicable)
  • Complete all responsibilities as outlined in the annual performance review and/or goal setting.
  • Complete all special projects and other duties as assigned.
  • Must be able to perform duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed and is not to be construed as an exhaustive list of responsibilities, duties and skills required. This job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change as the needs of Cotiviti and requirements of the job change.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's Degree or equivalent experience required.
  • 5+ years of project management experience required.
  • Certification in Project Management (PMP, CAPM, or equivalent).
  • Experience running cross-functional projects with disciplined status, RAID, and timeline management.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and facilitation skills.
  • Experience with healthcare operations, software delivery, or business transformation preferred.
  • Agile and waterfall delivery methods.
  • Smartsheet/Jira/PM tooling.
  • Project planning.
  • Schedule management.
  • Issue resolution.
  • Meeting facilitation.
  • Stakeholder communication.
  • Execution discipline.
  • Attention to detail.

Cognitive/Mental Requirements:

  • Communicating with others to exchange information.
  • Problem-solving and thinking critically.
  • Completing tasks independently.
  • Interpreting data.
  • Making timely decisions in the context of a workflow.
  • Maintaining focus.
  • Applying established protocols in a timely manner.

Working Conditions and Physical Requirements:

  • Remaining in a stationary position, often standing or sitting for prolonged periods.
  • Repeating motions that may include the wrists, hands, and/or fingers.
  • Must be able to provide a dedicated, secure work area.
  • Must be able to provide high-speed internet access / connectivity and office setup and maintenance.

Base compensation ranges from $100,000 to $135,000 per year. Specific offers are determined by various factors, such as experience, education, skills, certifications, and other business needs.

  • High school diploma or equivalent

  • 3+ years of customer service and/or sales experience in an insurance environment

  • Active Property and Casualty or Personal Lines license required

  • Schedule Requirements: Monday - Friday, 10 a.m. to 6 p.m. Central Time with rotating Saturday's with team. Saturday hours would be 8 am to 4 pm Central Time.

  • Receive and respond to calls and emails received by the insurance service center, documenting all activity (changes to policy, coverage options, recommendations and cross-selling) in our agency management system.

  • Serve as liaison between the customer, sales agent and manager to ensure timeliness of responses and compliance with established company policies and procedures.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

Designed for businesses that sell, support, and grow through conversations, Wati observes customer intent in real time, decides the next best revenue action, and executes it across marketing, sales, and support — on WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, SMS, and more.

Trusted by over 16,000 customers across 190+ countries, Wati simplifies complex operations and business conversations with a unified inbox, no-code automation, and our intelligent AI layer, Astra.

Proudly backed by Tiger Global, Sequoia Capital, DST Global, and Shopify, and recognised as a Premium Partner of Meta and Google.

Wati, the AI-Powered Customer Engagement Platform for Revenue Grow.

What You’ll Be Doing

As an Account Executive, you’ll drive new business and manage complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles with mid-market clients across the Italy region. You’ll own the end-to-end sales process — from prospecting and discovery to demo, negotiation, and close — partnering cross-functionally to ensure customer success and long-term value realization.

  • 3–5 years of SaaS or B2B tech sales experience

  • Strong presentation, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent in English (required) and Italian.
  • Self-motivated, disciplined, and comfortable working in a remote-first, fast-paced environment.
  • Experience with CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.

Why Join Wati?

  • Join a hyper-growth SaaS company redefining how businesses communicate.

  • Competitive base salary with attractive performance-based incentives.

  • High on-target earnings with attractive performance incentives.
  • Celebrate your birthday with paid leave.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are seeking a highly driven Regional Vice President, Sales - Legal IT Infrastructure to partner with our exec team and double-down on our expansion into the Legal Managed IT Services market.

In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, pursuing, and closing contracts with law firms ranging from boutique practices to the AmLaw 100 and 200. You will not just be selling traditional IT helpdesk support; you will act as a strategic consultant, positioning our organization as a critical partner in cloud migration, cybersecurity, compliance readiness, and artificial intelligence (AI) integration. Position reports to the VP of Legal IT Infrastructure.

Qualified candidates will have 5+ years of proven success in B2B technology sales, specifically within Managed IT Services (MSP), cloud architecture, cybersecurity, or legal enterprise software (SaaS). Ideal candidates are located in NYC or Boston. Must have confidence in network and ability to close business within 6 months of hire.

About Us

IST Management is a business process outsourcing company. Founded in 1997, we have over 1,800 employees and operations across the U.S. We provide a range of services geared toward litigation and corporate office support including e-Discovery processing and hosting, court reporting, digital forensic collections, managed review, and managed services. IST Management is a Relativity Certified Provider and tool-agnostic. We also provide a full range of facilities management and office services.

We’ve been recognized as one of the fastest-growing companies in the U.S. as a winner of the Nation’s Best & Brightest Companies to Work For, as well as the HR Professional Excellence Award from the Society for Human Resource Management. We are proud to belong to the Military Spouse Employment Partnership through our nation’s Department of Defense and have committed to Hiring Our Heroes’ mission to hire 100,000 active and former service members. IST Management has also been included in the INC 5000 list!

Check us out at istmanagement.com for more information.

Compensation

Competitive base salary + uncapped commission

3% on equipment sales revenue

5% on services sales revenue

OTE Y1 225K+

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, STD, LTD, Life, 401k, Bonus incentives, Seven paid holidays and 23 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year accrued at a rate of 3.54 hours/wk

This is a full-time remote role, but with travel expectations for establishing and maintaining client relationships - including air travel. This is an outside sales position.

Responsibilities

  • Pipeline Generation & Full-Cycle Sales: Prospect and secure new business by targeting law firm Managing Partners, Chief Operating Officers (COOs), and IT Directors who require enterprise-grade IT infrastructure and white-glove service desk support.

jobs.title: Remote - Nonprofit Salesforce & Operations Consultant - Catholic Church
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This position is contingent on contract award. Candidates will be contacted if contract is awarded to BSI.

Beta Systems International is seeking an experienced independent consultant to support the Church Engagement team of a major U.S.-based Catholic international humanitarian organization. This is a short, high-impact engagement of roughly 100 hours over about eight weeks starting in December (an average of 12–13 hours per week, flexible around the holidays). You will be the named lead consultant on the engagement, working directly with the team’s director and staff.

What You Will Do

Salesforce and data systems
  • Develop a consistent nomenclature guide for entering engagements into Salesforce, and train and support team members in using it.
  • Build Salesforce reports for different areas of work and a monitoring dashboard aligned with team objectives and key activities.
  • Finalize and test a reporting tool for partners.
  • Provide ongoing data entry, data quality control and assurance.
Microsoft Teams and team operations
  • Redesign the team’s MS Teams file architecture to reflect current priorities.
  • Develop a practical structure and process guide for managing collaborative team work, including calendaring.
Strategy and measurement
  • Facilitate development of team-wide OKRs for the next quarter and set up a simple way to monitor them.
  • Design a monthly team progress review meeting, write its facilitation guide, and facilitate the first session(s) to review results and capture learning.

What You Bring

Required
  • Hands-on Salesforce experience: building reports and dashboards, defining data entry standards, and cleaning data (Salesforce Administrator certification or equivalent experience preferred).
  • Advanced proficiency with Microsoft 365, especially Teams, SharePoint and Outlook calendaring, plus web conferencing tools.
  • Experience leading strategy and measurement work: OKRs or similar goal frameworks, MEAL (monitoring, evaluation, accountability and learning), and data analysis.
  • Proven facilitation skills with small teams, in person and virtually.
  • In-depth knowledge of the Catholic Church in the United States and Catholic Social Teaching.
  • Demonstrated project management skills: you deliver clear, usable products on tight timelines.
  • Strong interpersonal, communication and organizational skills; comfortable training non-technical colleagues.
Preferred
  • Prior consulting work with Catholic dioceses, parishes, or faith-based nonprofits.
  • Experience with Salesforce Nonprofit Cloud / NPSP or Experience Cloud partner reporting.
  • A prior assignment you can point to that combined data systems, strategy and operations support.

Engagement Details

  • Independent contractor (1099); you provide your own equipment.
  • Availability of 10–15 hours per week from December 1, 2026 through January 29, 2027, including some availability in the December 15–30 window.
  • You must be able to provide two professional references, at least one for similar systems, strategy or operations work.
  • During the engagement you may not concurrently provide services to other international relief and development organizations without client approval, and you will be asked to disclose any current or past relationship with the client organization.
  • Compliance with the client’s safeguarding policy and code of conduct is required.

Contract (1099) | Remote, U.S.-based, occasional travel possible | Approx. 100 hours, December 1, 2026 – January 29, 2027

jobs.title: Associate Actuary - Medicare Forecasting
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Purpose: Conduct actuarial analysis, pricing, and risk assessment to evaluate and project Medicare Advantage financial performance. As part of the Medicare Actuarial Forecast & Financial Performance Team, this role supports quarterly forecasting, Medicare bid target setting, and key business decisions that shape Medicare benefit offerings and financial performance.

Key Details: Seeking an ASA with strong actuarial analytics experience who can analyze complex information, identify trends and financial drivers, and develop valuable insights and recommendations for complex business problems. Three or more years of experience with a strong focus on analytics is highly preferred, with Medicare Advantage experience a strong plus, particularly financial forecasting, financial performance analysis, cost trend analysis, and Medicare bid development or support. Requires a Bachelor’s degree, ASA designation, a minimum of 2+ years of actuarial experience, advanced Excel skills, and basic SQL/query knowledge. MAAA designation or eligibility for Medicare bid certification is preferred; AI/Copilot experience is a plus. Fully remote within the Continental U.S.

  • Analyze and evaluate business risks and opportunities.
  • Analyze various data reports, identify trends and gaps, and recommend actions.
  • Apply knowledge of mathematics, probability, statistics, finance, and business principles to calculate financial outcomes.
  • Develop probability tables based on analyses of statistical data and other pertinent information.
  • Research and analyze the impact of legislative changes.
  • Determine equitable methods for distributing funds for insurance benefits.
  • Create and update actuarial reports.
  • Participate in merger and acquisition analyses.
  • Certify annual Medicare bids.

Education/Experience: Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience. 2+ years of actuarial experience.

License/Certification: Associate of the Society of Actuaries (ASA) (or equivalent international certification).

Pay Range: $87,700.00 - $157,800.00 per year

jobs.title: Integration Principal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

We are seeking an experienced Integrations Principal to lead the design, development, and implementation of advanced integration solutions in healthcare technology. This role requires deep expertise in clinical data interoperability, system integrations, and connecting disparate platforms to support seamless data exchange.

As the Integrations Principal, you will provide technical leadership, mentorship, and strategic guidance to multiple teams, driving successful integration projects that enhance patient care and improve operational efficiency. The ideal candidate brings proven experience in healthcare integrations, strong problem-solving skills, and a passion for building scalable, innovative solutions in a collaborative environment.

Responsibilities

  • Integration strategy and roadmap: Collaborate on the development of and execute the interoperability strategy to ensure seamless, scalable integration across internal and external systems.
  • Health Information Exchanges (HIEs): Oversee technical implementation and maintenance of national and state HIEs to facilitate secure, efficient data exchange among providers, payers, and partners.
  • Electronic Health Record (EHR) Integrations: Guide and support the development of EHR integrations. Research future EHR integrations to expand services, collaborating with cross-functional teams to understand integration requirements and provide technical expertise.
  • Clinical Data Management and Stewardship: Ensure the accurate, complete and secure handling of patients’ clinical data throughout ingestion, transformation, exchange, and storage.
  • System Architecture: Partner with architects to design and maintain the architecture for integration solutions, ensuring scalability, reliability, and compliance with industry standards and regulations. Continuously monitor and optimize data processing workflows to improve performance and reduce latency.
  • Data Compliance, Governance and Security: Ensure all integration solutions comply with relevant regulations (e.g., HIPAA, HL7, FHIR) and maintain the highest standards of data integrity, security and privacy at the industry and organizational level. Help guide implementation of best practices for access control, encryption, auditing, and incident response across integration and data platforms.
  • Project Leadership: Lead cross-functional planning, execution, and delivery of integration projects, aligning scope, timelines, and outcomes to business goals.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders, including healthcare providers, IT departments, and vendors, to understand integration needs and deliver effective solutions. Support on- and off-shore team members as a SME, when applicable.
  • Mentorship: Provide technical leadership and mentorship, fostering a culture of continuous learning and improvement.
  • Continuous Improvement: Track industry trends and emerging technologies; evaluate and adopt tools and methods that advance interoperability and data capabilities.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Healthcare Informatics, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum of 7 years of experience in healthcare IT with a focus on systems integration, interoperability, HIEs, and clinical data management, data integration, and architecture.

Technical Skills

  • Healthcare data standards and payload transports: e.g. HL7, FHIR, CDA, USCDI, REST, SOAP
  • Integration platforms: e.g. Mirth, Cloverleaf and/or native EHR integrations e.g. Epic, Oracle, Meditech

jobs.title: Advanced Monitoring Expert
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

About Sygnia

Sygnia is a top-tier cyber technology and services company, providing high-end consulting and incident response support for organizations worldwide. We work with companies to proactively build their cyber resilience and to respond to and defeat attacks within their networks. Sygnia is the trusted advisor and cybersecurity service provider for IT and security teams, senior managements, and boards of leading organizations around the world, including Fortune 100 companies.

Our team combines top talent from elite military technology units and across the cyber industry. We bring technological expertise, digital combat experience, data analytics and a business-driven mindset to cybersecurity, enabling organizations to thrive in the face of cyber threats.

The Role

We are looking for an Advanced Monitoring Expert to join our team of cybersecurity analysts. In this role, you will conduct advanced and tailored monitoring activities in post-breach client environments. You will develop detection analyses, triage alerts, investigate security incidents, and perform proactive threat hunting. The role also involves onboarding new clients, working closely with incident response teams, and enhancing visibility and detection capabilities.

This position is ideal for someone who enjoys working in dynamic environments, has strong problem-solving skills, and thrives when collaborating with clients and teammates.

What You’ll Do

  • Perform post-breach monitoring in client environments, including triage of alerts and host forensics analysis.
  • Develop custom detection and analysis methods to monitor client environments, often based on known threat actor tactics, techniques, and procedures (TTPs).
  • Support major incident response engagements by delivering accurate detection when active threats are suspected.
  • Maintain visibility and log forwarding across endpoints, cloud environments, and network devices.
  • Conduct proactive threat hunting using host- and network-based analysis, malware hunting, and IOC searches.
  • Create automation tools and capabilities for alert triage, escalation, visibility management, and reporting.
  • Collaborate with client security teams, providing regular updates and follow-ups on alerts and security events.
  • Generate reports and metrics on incidents, trends, visibility status, and response procedures.

Requirements

What We’re Looking For

  • 3-5 years of experience in cybersecurity roles within SOC, SecOps, or security monitoring environments.
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work independently.
  • Strong understanding of the lifecycle of advanced security threats, attack vectors, and exploitation techniques.
  • Hands-on experience with SIEM tools such as Splunk, QRadar, ArcSight, or Exabeam.
  • Knowledge of common data and log sources for detection and analysis, including Event Logs, Firewalls, and EDR tools.
  • Technical understanding of network fundamentals, common Internet protocols, and security controls.
  • Familiarity of host-based forensics and OS artifacts.
  • Proficiency in scripting languages such as Python.
  • Experience with cloud infrastructure, web applications, or servers is a plus.
  • Strong customer-facing communication skills.
  • Willingness to work outside normal hours and travel occasionally.

Bonus Points For

  • Experience developing custom detection logic or automation workflows.
  • Previous involvement in incident response or digital forensics investigations.
  • Familiarity with threat intelligence platforms or red-team engagements.
  • Security certifications such as GCIA, GCIH, or OSCP.

Why Sygnia

Nice to Have

  • Background in a remote RCM role

The RCM Specialist owns the revenue cycle from insurance verification and claims submission through payment posting, claims follow-up, denials, and patient collections, reporting to the Team Lead. The role works directly with patients, families, payers, and internal teams to resolve billing and reimbursement issues. Success means clean claims, faster reimbursement, fewer repeat denials, and a clear billing experience for families.

Position Overview

The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. Requirements

  • Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

jobs.title: Visual Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is a remote position.

Our demand generation strategy is entirely content-led. Every lead that enters our pipeline starts with a piece of content someone saw on LinkedIn or found on our website. The visual quality of that content directly affects whether someone stops scrolling, engages, and eventually becomes a client. This role exists because the content only works if it looks as good as it reads.

You will own all visual output across Revisory's content. You will work across three content types:

  • Graphics Design: static visuals for LinkedIn posts (carousels, single images, framework diagrams, data visuals) and website assets. Built in Canva and Affinity.
  • Motion Design: animated diagrams that bring our frameworks and models to life for LinkedIn. Built in Cavalry.
  • Video Editing: editing talking-head videos, adding captions, transitions, branded intros and outros, and cutting long-form recordings into short-form clips for LinkedIn. Done in CapCut.

Requirements

  • Experience using graphics design, motion design, and video editing tools. You should be comfortable working across all three categories and able to pick up new tools quickly. Our current stack is Canva, Affinity, Cavalry, and CapCut.
  • Ability to take a written concept or rough sketch and turn it into a polished visual without heavy art direction.
  • Super curious and obsessed with learning. You are the kind of person who teaches yourself new skills because you want to, not because someone told you to.
  • Hard working. We publish on a weekly cadence. Deadlines are not flexible.
  • Clear communication. You will work remotely and asynchronously. You need to be comfortable flagging blockers and managing expectations without being chased.

Nice to Have

  • Experience designing content for B2B companies or professional services.
  • A portfolio that includes LinkedIn content.

Benefits

  • Fully remote. Work from Nigeria.
  • Potential to transition to a full-time role after 6-months based on performance and mutual fit.
  • Direct collaboration with the Founder. You are not buried in layers of approval.
  • This is a great role for someone who is self-taught, wants to learn by doing, and get paid while at it.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools.

Now is the time to join! Here's why:

  • Build out our detection and response function. Liftoff has a mature security information and event management platform (SIEM), established detection content, and a working incident response program. Your charter is to take it to the next level — including leading our investment in AI-augmented SOC tooling.
  • High visibility, high impact. Detection and response is a critical capability for Liftoff.
  • Security-conscious engineering culture. Liftoff's engineering org is a willing and capable partner on security work.
  • Hands-on technical work. Stay deep in code, detections, and incidents.
  • Breadth of work. Detection and response is the primary focus, but you'll partner across the security team on cloud, infrastructure, and application security where the work demands it.
  • Large-scale, interesting systems. Liftoff processes millions of requests per second across its demand-side platform (DSP), mobile software development kit (SDK), and ad exchange.

Responsibilities:

  • Own day-to-day operation of Liftoff's SIEM (Panther) — log source ingestion, detection content, and the alert investigation pipeline.
  • Lead Liftoff's adoption of AI-augmented SOC tooling (e.g. Prophet, Dropzone, or equivalent) as a multi-year modernization investment.
  • Triage incoming security alerts and drive timely investigation and remediation with stakeholders across Engineering and IT.
  • Lead incident response — investigation, containment, and post-incident review — and mature processes and runbooks so response becomes predictable and repeatable.
  • Build tooling and automation that detects active threats, enriches alerts, and reduces manual investigation toil.
  • Partner with Engineering and IT to make detection and response self-service where possible — clear log-onboarding paths, documented detection proposals, accessible runbooks — so security scales without becoming a bottleneck.
  • Close the feedback loop between the team's offensive and proactive findings and detection coverage.
  • Partner across the security team on cloud, infrastructure, and application security work alongside your detection and response focus — every engineer on this team covers breadth beyond their primary focus.
  • Participate in the Security team's on-call rotation and incident response.

Minimum Qualifications:

  • 5+ years in security engineering, security operations, detection engineering, or software engineering with a security focus.
  • Hands-on production SIEM operation — onboarding log sources, writing and maintaining detection content, and triaging alerts.
  • Write production-quality code for security automation and detection-as-code.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Business Development Manager – Canada

New Sales Business | Walnut Insurance | Remote, Canada | Reports to the COO

The role

You'll bring in Walnut's next enterprise partners in Canada, and you'll start with the relationships you already have. This is a pure new-business role. You source your own leads, open the doors, qualify hard, and convert the right ones into signed partners on both sides of our platform: distribution partners such as banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos and consumer brands that should be offering insurance inside their products, and insurance carriers looking for new embedded distribution. You'll run your own territory, plan and pipeline with very little oversight. You'll report directly to our COO and work alongside our founders, who still sell with the team. Once a partner signs, our account management and implementation teams take it from there, so your time goes on finding and winning the next one.

About Walnut

Walnut is Canada's leading embedded insurance platform. Partners like Wealthsimple, BMO, KOHO and TELUS use us to launch insurance inside their products in 90 days, compared with nine months or more going direct to a carrier. We hold the carrier relationships, the licenses and the compliance; our partners keep the customer. We're nationally licensed in P&C and life and health across every province, including Quebec.

What you'll do

  • Source your own leads. Start with your network, then build out from it. Work your contacts, referrals, events, associations and outbound to create a steady flow of conversations with decision-makers at Canadian financial institutions, telcos, digital brands and insurance carriers. Nobody hands you a lead list. You build the pipeline.

  • Open doors at the senior level. Get meetings with the people who can say yes: heads of product, partnerships, digital, lending and insurance at distribution partners, and heads of distribution, partnerships and product at carriers. Use warm introductions wherever you have them, and cold outreach that gets answered where you don't.

  • Qualify fast and manage the pipeline. Separate real opportunities from interest early. Keep every lead, contact and next step current in HubSpot, and run a forecast you'd stand behind in front of the board.

  • Convert. Run discovery, build the business case for an embedded program, and take deals through proposal, security review, procurement and legal to signature. Our solutioning, legal and carrier teams back you along the way.

  • Hand off and move on. Pass signed partners to account management and implementation with a clear scope, then go back to sourcing.

  • Run yourself. Set your own territory plan, activity targets and priorities. Report progress weekly and flag what you need before it slows a deal.

  • Bring back what you hear in market. Tell us which segments are buying, which messages land and which products prospects keep asking for.

What you bring

  • A real Canadian network. You have relationships you can call this week at banks, credit unions, lenders, fintechs, telcos, large consumer brands or insurance carriers. We'll ask you to show us where.

  • Seven or more years in B2B sales or business development, with a track record of sourcing and closing new enterprise business yourself, not inheriting it.

Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About PostHog

PostHog is your product’s context layer. It ingests and stores your analytics, errors, replays, and business data so you and your agents can query and act on it.

We launched out of Y Combinator's W20 cohort. We've since shipped more than a dozen products, including:

  • PostHog MCP for users and their agents to query and act on their product and business data

  • Data warehouse so users can query product and customer data together using custom SQL insights.

We are:

  1. Product-led. More than 500K organizations have installed PostHog, mostly driven by word-of-mouth. We have intensely strong product-market fit.

  2. Default alive. Revenue is growing incredibly quickly, and we're very efficient. We raise money to push ambition and grow faster, not to keep the lights on.

  3. Well-funded. We've raised more than $180m from some of the world's top investors. We're set up for a long, ambitious journey.

We're focused on building an awesome product for end users, hiring exceptional teammates, shipping fast, and being as weird as possible.

 

Things we care about

  • Transparency: Everyone can read about our roadmap, how we pay (or even let go of) people, our strategy, and how we work, in our public company handbook. Internally, we share revenue, notes and slides from board meetings, and fundraising plans, so everyone has the context they need to make good decisions.

Engineers lead product teams and make product decisions. Teams are flexible and easy to change when needed.

Die Chemion Logistik GmbH ist ein Logistikdienstleister, der auf die Bedürfnisse der Chemie und chemienahen Geschäftszweige spezialisiert ist. #Traumjob, #TeamChemion, #neueChancen

Werkstudent (m/w/d) Transformation & Logistikoptimierung

  • Durchführung von Markt-, Wettbewerbs- und Trendanalysen zu Logistik-, Technologie-, Digitalisierungs- und Automatisierungsthemen.

  • Idealerweise erste Erfahrungen mit Datenanalysen, Simulationen, Power BI, Python oder vergleichbaren Analysetools

Die Vergütung erfolgt gemäß festem Einstellungsbezug

jobs.descriptionHtml:
DAS IST DER JOB

Location: Deutschland (Remote möglich)

Wir sind everdrop – eine schnell wachsende D2C Brand mit der Mission, die Welt der Haushalts- und Pflegeprodukte nachhaltig zu verändern. Bei uns ist Influencer Marketing kein „Add-on“, sondern einer unserer wichtigsten Wachstumstreiber. Als (Senior) Influencer Marketing Manager (m/w/d) trägst du den Großteil unseres monatlichen Creator-Spends im sechsstelligen Bereich und bist die strategische und analytische Instanz für unser gesamtes Creator-Portfolio. Du entscheidest gemeinsam mit deinem Team Lead, wo wir investieren, was wir skalieren und was wir stoppen. Dabei nutzt du deine Creator-Beziehungen, Daten und KI, um neue Standards für unser Team zu setzen.

  • Budget- & Portfolio-Ownership: Du verantwortest den Großteil unseres monatlichen Kooperationsbudgets im sechsstelligen Bereich eigenständig. Du steuerst ein hochvolumiges Portfolio aus Always-on-Creatorn, Performance-Partnern und Top-Creatorn und allokierst Budgets nach CAC, NC ROAS und Skalierungspotenzial. Du bist bereit, Budgets konsequent umzuschichten, wenn die Zahlen es verlangen.

  • Datenanalyse auf Expertenniveau: Du analysierst die Performance über den gesamten Funnel, von CPM und CTR über CVR und AOV bis zu CAC, NC ROAS und LTV. Du baust Dashboards und Forecasts selbst und kannst jederzeit belegen, warum eine Kooperation performt hat oder nicht. Deine Analysen sind die Grundlage für Budgetentscheidungen im Management.

Du führst anspruchsvolle Vertrags- und Rahmenverhandlungen mit Top-Creatorn und Agenturen und entwickelst Vergütungsmodelle für nachhaltig hohen NC ROAS und langfristige Partnerschaften.

  • Kreatives Testing mit System: Du denkst in Hypothesen und isolierst Variablen sauber. Du planst Testing-Roadmaps für Produkte, Hooks, Formate und Angles, wertest sie statistisch belastbar aus und überführst die Learnings in Briefings, Bundles und Landingpages.

  • KI als Hebel und neuer Standard: Du setzt KI dort ein, wo sie Qualität und Geschwindigkeit steigert, zum Beispiel bei Creator-Scouting und -Scoring, Performance-Auswertung, Briefing-Erstellung oder Content-Analyse. Du entwickelst daraus Workflows und Best Practices, die das ganze Team nutzt, und hinterfragst bestehende Prozesse kritisch.

  • Konzeption, Bundles & Verkaufspsychologie: Du übersetzt Daten in messerscharfe, kreative Creator-Briefings, konzipierst unwiderstehliche Produkt-Bundles und gestaltest Landingpages mit, gezielt mit verkaufspsychologischen Triggern für maximale Conversion.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
This role is located in Munich, Germany. TULIP is a hybrid work environment and we are in the office 3+ days/per week.

About TULIP

TULIP is the frontline operations platform that helps manufacturers digitize, connect and continuously improve how they run production, with AI at the core of the product. TULIP was founded out of the MIT Media Lab. It is headquartered in Boston, has offices in Munich, Tokyo, Tel Aviv, Budapest and Singapore, and has customer sites in more than 45 countries.

In January 2026, TULIP closed its $120M Series D, at a valuation of $1.3B. Leading global manufacturers run on TULIP, including VEKA, DMG Mori, Roche, AstraZeneca, Richemont, Saint-Gobain Aerospace and Mitsubishi Electric. We partner with NVIDIA, PwC, McKinsey, BCG and more than 160 technology partners worldwide. TULIP is part of the World Economic Forum's Global Innovator community, and our CEO, Dr. Natan Linder, co-chairs the Forum's Advanced Manufacturing Industry Governors Community. 

The opportunity in DACH for TULIP

DACH is the heart of global manufacturing. Germany is Europe's largest industrial economy and the birthplace of Industrie 4.0. Switzerland is a global centre for pharma, life sciences and precision manufacturing. Austria is a strong base in automotive, machinery, metals and semiconductors. The region is also home to many of the world's "Hidden Champions", mid-sized companies that lead global niche markets. Today, these companies face similar pressures: fewer skilled workers, rising quality and compliance demands, and the need to modernize existing plants without stopping production. TULIP gives their frontline teams an AI-native production system to meet those pressures and accelerate time-to-value.

TULIP GmbH is a full operating entity and Munich is TULIP's headquarters in Europe. The team covers sales, solutions engineering, pre-sales engineering, customer success, and R&D. Local customers trust our product in regulated, high-precision environments. 

About You:

We are seeking a highly motivated and talented individual to join our delivery team in our Munich office.

  • You know the challenges in manufacturing and operations, and you believe in putting the operator in the center
  • You can take on and lead projects with complex stakeholder landscapes
  • You are comfortable communicating with customer stakeholders from the shop floor to the C-suite
  • You're flexible and can thrive in environments that don't have defined processes, and you're excited to help build
  • those processes
  • You have experience working in a startup environment or at a minimum are ready to take the plunge.

What skills do I need?

  • BS Degree: Industrial Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Management, Computer Science or a related field.
  • 5+ years of work experience; prior experience in project management and manufacturing or process engineering is - a plus
  • Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with a keen eye for detail.
  • Basic coding skills and familiarity with SQL and REST API
  • Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.
  • Proactive, self-starter attitude with a willingness to learn and grow.
  • Fluency in English & German is reuired, French - a big plus.
  • A strong track record of academic excellence and a passion for continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Customer Support, Deliveroo Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Our mission is to transform the way people shop and eat, connecting consumers, restaurants, shops, and riders to bring the neighbourhood to their door. We're redefining convenience by giving customers the ability to buy what they want, as they want it, when and where they want it.

Deliveroo is a technology-driven company at the forefront of one of the world's most dynamic industries. We are a relatively small team making a very large impact, moving fast, valuing ownership, and tackling some of the most interesting challenges in global commerce. We're driven by innovation, autonomy, and the ambition to deliver exceptional experiences for our customers, partners, and riders alike.

What You'll Be Doing

You will own frontline operational performance across two closely linked parts of Deliveroo's customer support network: an in-house Global Escalations team of around 50 agents based across the UK and Georgia, and the outsourced network delivering support on our behalf through three BPO partners and three Shared Service Centres, circa 1,500 agents across multiple locations, including the team leads and ops managers embedded within those outsourced functions.

Global Escalations sits at the heart of Deliveroo's most critical customer moments. The team manages our most sensitive, high-risk, and high-impact contacts, including complaints escalated to the Executive team. As the leader directly accountable for this recovery-focused centre of excellence, you will ensure the team operates with exceptional skill, judgement, and empathy, protecting Deliveroo's reputation, driving improvement through root cause analysis, and embedding a culture of integrity and customer-first recovery across the organisation.

For the outsourced network, you own how performance is delivered day to day, working closely with the team leads and ops managers embedded in each BPO and Shared Service Centre, not just the vendor relationship at arm's length. You own the operational rigour needed to make the network the best in class, from an experience and consistency perspective, across every market it supports.

Your key objective is to drive qualitative improvements to the customer experience, measured through CSAT, while balancing cost metrics like average handling time (AHT) and refund costs, rather than trading one off against the other. You will be the voice of Support to Deliveroo's market General Managers, taking full accountability for the Support experience in your markets, and you will partner closely with cross-functional Support & Operations teams, including Workforce Management, Training, Quality, and Policy, to drive initiatives that positively impact all three sides of the marketplace: customers, riders, and merchants.

jobs.title: Werkstudent:in Marketing & Growth
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Brand, Community & Content

ToysReloved ist der einfachste Second-Hand-Service für Spielzeug: Eltern geben Spielsachen, aus denen ihre Kinder herausgewachsen sind, mit einem Klick weiter und tun dabei etwas Gutes. Wir sind ein dynamisches Berliner Start-up und bringen die Kreislaufwirtschaft in die Spielzeugbranche.

Jetzt suchen wir dich, um ToysReloved als Love Brand für Familien aufzubauen. Du bringst kreative Ideen ein, setzt sie gemeinsam mit dem Gründungsteam um und begeisterst Menschen für unsere Mission.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Brand & Community: Du entwickelst Ideen für unsere Marke und baust eine Community auf, die uns kennt, mag und weiterempfiehlt.

  • Content & Social: Du erzählst unsere Geschichte auf Instagram, TikTok und weiteren Kanälen, entwickelst neue Formate, produzierst Inhalte und stehst auch selbst vor der Kamera.

  • Go-to-Market & Growth: Du planst, startest und testest mit uns Kampagnen, Creator-Kooperationen und Aktionen, um neue Familien für uns zu gewinnen.

  • Customer Care: Du betreust täglich unseren Kundenchat, beantwortest Fragen und bist damit am nächsten dran an dem, was Familien bewegt. Aus ihrem Feedback machst du Ideen für Content und ein besseres Kundenerlebnis.

  • CRM & Kommunikation: Du hältst den Kontakt zu unserer Community, etwa über Newsletter, Geschichten und relevante Impulse für unsere Kund:innen.

  • Reichweite & Partnerschaften: Du findest Themen, Geschichten und Kooperationen, die uns auch über Social Media hinaus sichtbar machen, etwa über Suche, Medien oder Events.

  • Projekte & KI: Du bringst eigene Initiativen von der Idee bis zur Auswertung voran und nutzt KI-Tools kreativ, um Inhalte und Prozesse besser zu machen.

Das bringst du mit

  • Du bist eingeschrieben, arbeitest gern selbstständig und bist gern bei uns im Berliner Office.

  • Du willst etwas aufbauen, denkst unternehmerisch und wartest nicht auf fertige Briefings.

  • Du verstehst Social Media, erkennst Trends und hast Spaß daran, selbst Content zu produzieren.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, denkst aus Kundensicht und fühlst dich vor der Kamera wohl.

  • Du probierst KI-Tools aus und hast Ideen, wie sie kreative Arbeit und Abläufe verbessern können.

  • Du kommunizierst sorgfältig und setzt Ideen auch im Tagesgeschäft zuverlässig um.

  • Du sprichst und schreibst sehr gut Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Plus: Erste Erfahrungen mit Instagram, TikTok, Canva, Klaviyo und generativer KI.

  • Bonus: Ein Herz für Nachhaltigkeit, Familien und Spielzeug.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Verantwortung ab Tag eins, Raum zum Experimentieren und Platz für deine eigenen Ideen.

  • Eine kreative Rolle zwischen Brand, Community, Content und Growth statt starrer Aufgabenlisten.

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit dem Gründungsteam in einem wachsenden Start-up.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote-Arbeit, die zu deinem Studium passen.

  • Ein heller Arbeitsplatz in einem historischen Gebäude am Ostkreuz, mit gutem Bio-Kaffee.

  • Arbeit mit Sinn: Du hilfst, Spielzeug ein zweites Leben zu schenken.

Lust, mit uns die Spielzeugbranche zu verändern? Dann bewirb dich jetzt!

jobs.title: Social Media & External Communication Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Agent F

Agent F is building an autonomous finance function: software that takes on the work of keeping a company’s finances in order. That means bringing information together from different systems, recording transactions correctly, preparing useful reports, and helping people understand what needs their attention.

Today, much of this work depends on spreadsheets, repeated data entry and people checking one system against another. Our ambition is to make that work increasingly automatic, while keeping every number explainable and every consequential action under clear control.

We are building towards a complete business management system for growing companies. This role will shape both the company and the way we work.

About the role

You will own how Agent F and its founder show up in the world: on LinkedIn, Instagram and YouTube, on the blog and in the newsletter, in the press, on podcasts and stages, and in the ecosystem around us. You will create and distribute content every day, run the founder’s profiles, manage relationships with journalists and media makers, and keep the network warm.

The bar is concrete. At least one to two good pieces of content go out every day. The audience grows, and it is the right audience: finance and operations leaders, founders and the people around them. Inbound interest arrives that can be traced back to something you published. You will have the founder’s time, the customers’ stories and the product’s progress as raw material; turning that into a consistent, credible voice is your job.

You will work closely with the Online Marketing Manager, who owns paid channels and the funnel. You own the organic, owned and earned side: the brand, the voice, the content and the relationships.

What you will build and own

  • The founder’s presence. Positioning, editorial calendar, drafting and publishing, replies and community. The founder reviews; you run it.

  • The company’s channels. LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, blog, newsletter. One voice, one visual identity, a cadence that does not slip.

  • Daily content. Posts, short videos, articles, visuals. Take one idea and make it work across formats and channels.

  • External communication. Press relations, podcasts, events and speaking, launches and announcements, partner communication; working with PR agencies where engaged.

  • The network. Journalists, podcasters, communities and ecosystem contacts, kept on a live list and in a warm relationship.

  • Brand assets. Guidelines, templates and tone of voice, kept current and actually used.

For example, a customer goes live and their CFO says something memorable in the final call. You would turn it into a founder post the same day, a short video for the company channel the next, a line in the newsletter and a pitch to a journalist who covers finance software, and track what came back from each.

What you bring

You have three or more years in content, social media or communications for a B2B company or a founder brand, with proof of an audience you built and content you shipped at pace. You write clearly in German and English, edit short video and work with design tools and AI tools every day.

You understand finance, software or the Mittelstand well enough to write for a demanding audience without embarrassing yourself or us. You can show us a channel you grew, a piece that worked and one that did not, and a press placement you earned. You are fast, consistent and allergic to empty posts, and you are comfortable approaching journalists and strangers.

Ad spend per channel, the funnels behind it, the landing pages, the email sequences, the tracking: all of it is yours to build, measure and improve. You will produce funnel content yourself, brief agencies and freelancers for the rest, and run experiments until the numbers move.

The idea is simple and unusual for our category: sell business software the way consumer products are sold online. Our buyers are finance and operations leaders at corporate subsidiaries and Mittelstand companies, and they search, click, compare and book like everyone else. You will find the channels, messages and paths that bring them to a demo or a sign-up at a cost that works, and you will keep looking for the next growth hack when the last one stops working.

Our north star is live ARR: how many companies have signed, gone live, are satisfied and have started paying, and from there, how many stay and grow with us. Every commercial role at Agent F is measured against that chain. For you, that means pipeline and live ARR that trace back to marketing.
