jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

BY JOINING OUR TEAM YOU’LL GET TO

  • Shape the architecture of a fusion power plant – Own system-level decisions that determine how a first-of-a-kind energy technology is designed, integrated, and ultimately deployed at scale.

  • Solve some of the most complex engineering challenges – Work across tightly coupled disciplines (plasma physics, magnets, cryogenics, manufacturing, controls, and more) to resolve critical trade-offs and turn cutting-edge science into a functioning product.

  • Design real hardware with a pragmatic, fast-moving team from all over the world – Combine advanced simulation and systems thinking with a strong execution mindset, focusing on practical engineering solutions that accelerate the path to commercial fusion energy.

YOUR IMPACT

Alpha will be the first stellarator to demonstrate net energy. Achieving this milestone requires building a deeply coupled machine, where plasma, magnets, structures, cryogenics, and heating work at the edge of each discipline’s capability. As part of the integrated stellarator design team you will work in between plasma physics and technology and make sure that all stellarator systems are designed according to clear and optimal design criteria. You will ensure that modelling uncertainties are quantified and used appropriately. You will drive projects where overarching design solutions with multi-system trades need to be found.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Ensure interfaces, design criteria, load cases and uncertainties are correctly defined: so that engineering design can iterate quickly and with clear assumptions.

  • Understand systems interactions: in order to minimize unintended consequences of the main architectural decisions.

  • Solve integration challenges: Identify, track, and solve the hardest integration challenges and risks of a machine not achieving its mission requirements.

  • Harness simplification opportunities: Identify, track, and address the most promising opportunities that affect the Alpha architecture.

jobs.title: (Senior) Marketing Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Unsere Kunden lernen uns meist persönlich kennen: auf sechs bis neun eigenen Events im Jahr, die meisten davon in München. Dazu gehört das Commerce Impact Forum, bei dem Geschäftsführer und CIOs aus Handel und Industrie zusammenkommen. Außerdem Webinare, Messen und unsere Inhalte auf LinkedIn und im Blog. Als (Senior) Marketing Manager planst du das mit der Geschäftsführung, setzt es selbst um und sorgst dafür, dass aus Teilnehmern Gespräche werden.

Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung zusammen und hast viel Raum, Prozesse und Formate selbst aufzubauen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du planst mit der Geschäftsführung, welche Events, Webinare und Messen wir im Jahr machen, und setzt sie um, bei Bedarf mit Unterstützung aus dem Team.
  • Du bist am Puls der Zeit: Du verfolgst, was in der Branche passiert, und bekommst Input aus dem Team, der Geschäftsführung und Projektleitung. Daraus machst du Inhalte und verantwortest dafür alle unsere Kanäle, etwa LinkedIn für das Unternehmen und die Geschäftsführung, Blog, Newsletter und Website, und alles, was künftig dazukommt.
  • Du verantwortest unsere Marketing- und Outreach-Prozesse: wie wir Kontakte gewinnen, im Blick behalten und an den Vertrieb übergeben, einschließlich der Automatisierung dahinter.
  • Du wertest aus, was funktioniert, und entwickelst unser Marketing mit neuen Formaten und Ideen weiter.
  • Du steuerst Agenturen und Freelancer, wenn wir sie für Design oder Produktion einsetzen.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung im B2B-Marketing, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung im Commerce- und Datenumfeld.
  • Erfahrung mit Marketing-Automation: Du hast Prozesse, Sequenzen und Workflows selbst aufgebaut, idealerweise in HubSpot.
  • Du schreibst sicher auf Deutsch für Entscheider und kannst in der Stimme anderer Personen schreiben. Dasselbe auf Englisch ist ein Plus.
  • Du hast Events oder Messeauftritte geplant und durchgeführt.
  • Du nutzt KI-Werkzeuge selbstverständlich in deiner Arbeit.
  • Du schaust, what andere Beratungen und Agenturen machen, schlägst neue Formate vor und misst, ob sie funktionieren.
  • Du arbeitest gern auf Augenhöhe mit der Geschäftsführung und widersprichst, wenn dich ein Vorschlag nicht überzeugt.
  • Themen wie Commerce, Daten und KI interessieren dich genug, um darüber zu schreiben, auch ohne technischen Hintergrund.
  • Gutes Englisch, denn unsere Teamsprache ist Englisch.

Was dich erwartet

  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Du baust Prozesse und Formate auf und prägst, wie wir nach außen auftreten.
  • Du verantwortest eigene Formate wie das Commerce Impact Forum und baust dir dabei ein Netzwerk zu Entscheidern aus Handel und Industrie auf.
  • Weiterbildung ist bei uns fest vorgesehen: Du schlägst Konferenzen, Kurse oder Zertifizierungen vor, und wir planen sie gemeinsam ein.
  • KI-Werkzeuge und moderne Hardware als selbstverständlicher Teil der Arbeit.

jobs.title: (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Rolle

Du berätst unsere Kunden dabei, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und verantwortest, dass es dort ankommt. Als (Senior) Consultant & Project Manager arbeitest du an Projekten und Produkten in Commerce, Daten und KI, vom ersten Workshop bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson des Kunden, führst die Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung und Partnern und übernimmst Product Ownership.

Deine Aufgaben

Beraten

  • Du klärst mit dem Kunden, was ein Projekt erreichen soll, und übersetzt seine Geschäftsziele in Produktentscheidungen.
  • Du leitest Discovery-Workshops mit Fachbereichen und empfiehlst, was gebaut wird und was nicht.
  • Nach dem Go-live prüfst du mit dem Kunden, ob das Projekt die Kennzahlen bewegt, für die es gestartet wurde.

Steuern

  • Du planst und steuerst mehrere Projekte parallel und verantwortest Zeit, Budget und Qualität.
  • Du übernimmst Product Ownership: Du priorisierst das Backlog und triffst Scope-Entscheidungen mit dem Kunden.
  • Du sprichst Zielkonflikte früh an und führst Entscheidungen herbei.
  • Du arbeitest eng mit Entwicklung, UX und Daten-Teams zusammen und begleitest Releases, Go-lives und die Weiterentwicklung danach.
  • Du nutzt KI in deiner eigenen Arbeit und entwickelst unsere Methoden weiter.
  • Als Senior berätst du Kunden bis auf Führungsebene, führst größere oder strategische Projekte, bist fest in Angebote und Pitches eingebunden und unterstützt andere Kolleginnen und Kollegen mit deiner Erfahrung.

Dein Profil

  • Mehrere Jahre Erfahrung in Beratung, Projektmanagement oder Product Ownership bei technischen Digitalprojekten, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder Beratung.
  • Erfahrung mit Projekten in Commerce, Daten oder KI. Erfahrung mit agentischen Lösungen ist ein Plus.
  • Du denkst in Kennzahlen des Kunden und kannst Fachbereichen erklären, was eine technische Entscheidung für ihr Geschäft bedeutet.
  • Du steuerst Budget und Scope sicher, auch wenn mehrere Projekte parallel laufen.
  • Du arbeitest agil oder klassisch, je nachdem, was das Projekt braucht.
  • Du sprichst mit Kunden auf Augenhöhe und sprichst Konflikte an, bevor sie teuer werden.
  • Erfahrung mit Workshops auf Fachbereichs- oder Führungsebene ist ein Plus.
  • Sehr gutes Deutsch (mindestens C1) und gutes Englisch.

Was dich erwartet

  • Projekte mit Händlern und Herstellern auf einem modernen Composable-Stack, mit Partnern wie commercetools, Snowflake und weiteren.
  • Direkte Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und kurze Entscheidungswege.
  • Austausch mit anderen Consultants, Project Managern und Product Ownern im Team.
  • Ein klarer Weg vom Project Manager zum Senior, mit der Möglichkeit, dich in Discovery, Pitches und Beratung einzubringen.
  • Weiterbildung ist bei uns fest vorgesehen: Du schlägst Konferenzen, Kurse oder Zertifizierungen vor, und wir planen sie gemeinsam ein.
  • KI-Werkzeuge und moderne Hardware als selbstverständlicher Teil der Arbeit.

jobs.title: Hosting-Architekt
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Die Projektron GmbH entwickelt und vertreibt die webbasierte Projektmanagement-Software BCS. Für die Unterstützung unserer europaweit über 820 Kunden sowie die kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung unserer Software sorgen mehr als 130 Mitarbeiter an fünf Standorten in Deutschland.

Ab sofort suchen wir für unseren Hauptsitz in Berlin Mitarbeiter, die unser Hosting in Vollzeit oder Teilzeit unterstützen.

Aufgaben

  • Unterstützung bei der Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer automatisierten Hostingumgebung für BCS

  • Wartung und Pflege bestehender Hosting-VMs und -Instanzen

  • Kommunikation mit unserem Rechenzentrumsdienstleister

  • Mitwirkung bei der Umstellung der Hostingumgebung auf Containertechnologien zur Optimierung der Ressourcennutzung

  • Erstellung und Umsetzung technischer Konzepte zur Containerisierung und Anbindung an bestehende Verwaltungsstrukturen

  • Mitverantwortung für die Absicherung und Härtung von Webservern und Betriebssystemen im Rahmen der IT-Sicherheit

Qualifikation

  • Guter bis sehr guter Abschluss eines IT-nahen Studiums
    oder abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik bzw. vergleichbare
    durch Berufserfahrung erworbene Kenntnisse

  • Erfahrung in der Administration einer automatisierten Hostingumgebung

  • Erfahrung mit Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform oder ähnlichen Containertools

  • Erfahrung in der technischen Administration von Webanwendungen

  • Administration von Linux Serversystemen

  • Kenntnisse in Tools: Nginx, Apache, HAProxy, Ansible, Puppet

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1 oder höher)

Benefits

  • Work-Life-Balance: Flexible Arbeitszeitmodelle, 30 Tage Urlaub, Sabbatical, mobiles Arbeiten & Workation

  • Familienfreundlich: Familienbeauftragte, bezahlte Kind-krank-Tage, Familientag, Betreuungstage bei kranken Angehörigen

  • Moderne Büros: Sitz-Steh-Tische, helle und ruhige Räume, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze

  • Flache Hierarchien & offene Kommunikationskultur: kurze Entscheidungswege, agiles Arbeiten, Einarbeitung inkl. Mentoring-Programm, Chancengleichheit

  • Mitarbeiter-Events: Vorträge und Workshops, Spieleabend, Basteln, Mitarbeitertreffen, Grillen auf der Dachterrasse

  • Sport & Gesundheit: Kickerliga, Tischtennis, Yoga, Zahnzusatzversicherung, Fahrradkeller, Lauftrainings, Duschen, Urban Sports Club, JobRad-Leasing

  • Weitere Vorteile: ÖPNV-Firmen-Ticket, bAV & BU, gemeinsamer Essensbereich, Müsli-Bar, Bio-Obst und -Getränke

  • Individuelle jährliche Weiterbildungen

Die Projektron GmbH bietet zukunftsweisende, an Chancengleichheit orientierte Personalpolitik, die mit dem BestPersZertifikat, dem BestPersAward, dem TOTAL-E-QUALITY-Prädikat dem Preis Unternehmen für Familie sowie von Great Place to Work ausgezeichnet ist. Wir setzen uns für Chancengleichheit im Beruf ein und ermuntern Frauen, sich zu bewerben.

Für das Jahr 2027 suchen wir für unseren Hauptsitz in Berlin duale Studenten für den Studiengang B.Sc. Informatik in Kooperation mit der HWR Berlin.

Wir möchten insbesondere Frauen dazu ermutigen, sich bei uns zu bewerben.

Aufgaben

Im Rahmen deines Studiums erhältst du die Möglichkeit, Praxiserfahrung bei einem der besten Arbeitgeber Berlin Brandenburgs zu sammeln. Entsprechend deines Studienschwerpunkts wirst du innerhalb der Praxisphasen in verschiedenen Abteilungen eingesetzt. Du erhältst so einen Einblick in nahezu alle Bereiche einer Software-Firma:

  • Für die Supportabteilung bildest du eine wichtige Schnittstelle zwischen unseren Kundenunternehmen und der Technik, unsere Mitarbeiter weisen dich in die Anpassung unserer Software nach Kundenwunsch ein

jobs.title: Werkstudent (m/w/d) – Finance & Beratung (unternehmerisch, leistungsbasiert)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du studierst und willst mehr als einen „Nebenjob“? Du willst Verantwortung, klare Ziele und ein Umfeld, in dem Leistung zählt? Dann ist diese Werkstudentenrolle dein Einstieg in die Finanzberatung, mit strukturiertem Onboarding, Coaching und einem klaren Weg in ein Trainee-Programm.

Diese Rolle ist unternehmerisch geprägt und bietet dir die Möglichkeit, dich aktiv einzubringen, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und dich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln. Leistung und Eigeninitiative spielen dabei eine zentrale Rolle, gleichzeitig wirst du durch strukturiertes Onboarding, Coaching und ein erfahrenes Team unterstützt.

Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1+) sind erforderlich, da die Ausbildung, die Kommunikation im Team sowie die Perspektive Richtung IHK vollständig auf Deutsch stattfinden.

Dein Aufgabenbereich

Startphase (erste Wochen):

  • Terminaufbau: Du vereinbarst Kundentermine (Telefon, Netzwerk, Leads) und baust eine saubere Pipeline auf.

  • Prozesslernen: Du lernst Gesprächsleitfäden, Bedarfsermittlung, Nachbereitung und Dokumentationsstandards.

  • Performance-Optimierung: Du arbeitest mit KPIs, bekommst Feedback und verbesserst systematisch deine Ergebnisse.

Im weiteren Verlauf:

  • Analyse & Vorbereitung: Du unterstützt bei der Analyse von Kundensituationen und bereitest Beratungsunterlagen strukturiert vor.

  • Kundenkontakt: Du begleitest Gespräche (je nach Stand), übernimmst Follow-ups und sorgst für klare nächste Schritte.

  • Dokumentation & Organisation: Du hältst Prozesse sauber, dokumentierst konsequent und stellst Verlässlichkeit sicher.

  • Teamarbeit: Du arbeitest eng mit einem leistungsstarken Team und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Aufgabenpakete.

Das bieten wir dir

  • Strukturierter Einstieg: Trainingsplan, Leitfäden, klare Standards

  • Mentoring & Coaching: regelmäßiges Feedback, klare Ziele

  • Leistungsorientierte Vergütung (Erfolgslogik – du wirst für Output belohnt)

  • Skalierbare Perspektive: Option auf Übernahme ins Trainee-Programm

  • Remote möglich – eigenverantwortlich statt “nach Uhr”

  • Team mit Performance-Kultur: klare Kommunikation, klare Ergebnisse


Nichts für dich, wenn…

  • du einen typischen Werkstudentenjob mit “ein paar Stunden nebenbei” suchst

  • du Telefon/Terminaufbau vermeiden willst

  • dein Deutsch unter C1 liegt

  • du lieber Sicherheit als Entwicklung priorisierst

Muss

  • Immatrikuliert (Uni/FH)

  • Deutsch mindestens C1 (mündlich & schriftlich)

  • Kommunikationsstärke, Verbindlichkeit, Zuverlässigkeit

  • Eigeninitiative und strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Lust auf Leistung und messbare Ergebnisse

Wunsch

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb, Service, Beratung, Sport-/Leistungskultur

jobs.title: (Senior) Product Owner | Full Time (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who Are We ?

🚧 Picture logistics that run like clockwork – fast, smart, and seamless.

Autonomous logistics does not start with self-driving trucks. It starts with CONROO.

At CONROO, we are building an intelligent infrastructure that drives terminals and depots towards autonomy by connecting truck drivers, terminals, and depots through continuous data flows. We replace manual and paper-based processes with real-time, data-driven workflows, turning chaos into connected systems and making truck handling fully digital.

Every step we automate today lays the foundation for terminals and depots to operate autonomously tomorrow.

We are CONROO and we are driving logistics to autonomy.

💼 About This Role

As a (Senior) Product Owner at CONROO, you'll be one of the people steering where our product goes next. You'll spend time with customers and stakeholders to really understand what they need, then turn that into requirements the team can actually build from. You'll work closely with our developers day to day, answering questions, and making calls when priorities need to shift. It's a role with real ownership in the sense that what you decide matters, and you'll see it show up in the product.

🎖 What Success Looks Like

In your first month

  • You become familiar with the company, product, development process, customers, and key business areas and projects.

  • You work closely with Tech, Sales, and other teams to understand customer needs, business objectives, and product priorities.

  • You join Scrum ceremonies and observe how requirements and priorities are managed.

  • You align and guide a cross-functional team. Setting clear priorities, offering direction, and helping people do their best work.

By 3 months

  • You analyse and manage project requirements and stakeholder demands.

  • You independently create, prioritize, and maintain the product backlog based on customer needs and business objectives.

  • You take ownership of user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements.

  • You take an active role in Scrum management and coordination.

  • You ensure our product meets UX standards, quality standards, and relevant regulatory requirements.

  • You will communicate product vision, goals, priorities, and progress to internal and external stakeholders.

  • You communicate directly with customers and stakeholders to understand their needs and translate them into actionable requirements.

  • You will have full ownership of assigned projects and topics and manage them with increasing autonomy.

By 6 months

  • You independently manage projects and requirements from initial stage through implementation.

  • You have full ownership of Scrum processes and ensure effective collaboration and communication across teams.

  • You proactively identify customer needs, product opportunities, risks, and areas for improvement.

  • You contribute significantly to product development and prioritisation.

  • You consistently improve project management, requirements management, and quality processes where needed.

  • You operate autonomously while keeping relevant stakeholders aligned and informed.

  • You become the trusted point of contact for product-related topics across Tech, Sales, and other teams.

🚀 What You Need to Be Successful

  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Computer Science, Business Informatics, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • You bring 5+ years of experience as a Product Owner in a SaaS environment.

jobs.title: Looking for native Swiss French speakers for a *non-professional* recording project
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are collaborating with one of our key clients on an exciting project to train AI bots used in call centers. The goal is to help these bots understand different intonations, speech cadences, and accents. If you’re a native Swiss French speaker and have a PC with a microphone, this opportunity is perfect for you!

This project will start in May/June (we don’t know the exact timeline yet)

Tasks

What You’ll Do: Record approximately ~300 provided utterances (short phrases) in your native language, with each utterance saved as a separate file.

Why You’re Needed: Your recordings will help train call-centre bots, enabling them to better understand diverse speech patterns. Note: These recordings will not be used for commercial purposes.

Requirements

  • NATIVE speakers of SWISS French (no linguistic or professional voiceover experience needed).

  • A PC with a microphone.

  • Ability to install and use the free recording software Audacity (we provide detailed setup instructions).

  • A quiet environment for clear, noise-free recordings.

Technical Specifications:

  • Format: Single-channel WAV PCM.

  • Frequency: 16 kHz.

  • Silence: 0.5 seconds of silence at the beginning or end of each recording.

To ensure a diverse pool of voices and verify that the recording environment meets the required standards (e.g., no background noise), we will ask shortlisted candidates to submit a short voice sample as part of the application process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Deine Mission: Digitale Spuren sichern!

Unser Mandant ist ein spezialisiertes Beratungsunternehmen im Bereich Cyber Security. Es bietet individuelle, nachhaltige Lösungen und setzt auf langfristige, vertrauensvolle Kundenbeziehungen. Mit fundierter Erfahrung in Security Incident Response, IT-Forensik und Krisenmanagement unterstützt unser Mandant seine Kunden beim Schutz sensibler Daten und Systeme. Zur Verstärkung des Teams suchen wir ab sofort einen IT-Forensiker / Analysten (mIwId), der gemeinsam mit erfahrenen Experten an spannenden Projekten arbeitet und zur digitalen Sicherheit unserer Kunden beiträgt. Starte jetzt deine Karriere in der Cyber Security und gestalte eine sichere digitale Zukunft.

Standort: Großraum Frankfurt I Einstiegsdatum: nach persönlicher Verfügbarkeit

Aufgaben:

  • Unterstützung bei der IT-forensischen Analyse nach Cyberangriffen unter Anleitung erfahrener Kollegen
  • Mitwirkung bei der Identifikation, Isolierung und Sicherung digitaler Daten, Spuren, Artefakte und potenzieller Beweismittel
  • Unterstützung bei der Wiederherstellung gelöschter Daten und der Identifikation sowie Eindämmung von Schadsoftware
  • Mitarbeit bei der Analyse und schrittweisen Rekonstruktion von Cyber-Angriffen auf Basis forensischer Erkenntnisse
  • Zuarbeit bei der Erstellung rechtskonformer Dokumentationen und Berichte zu Untersuchungsverläufen und Ergebnissen
  • Beteiligung an der Entwicklung und Umsetzung provisorischer Infrastrukturen zur Aufrechterhaltung des Notbetriebs
  • Zusammenarbeit mit internen Teams zur Wiederherstellung und Absicherung kompromittierter IT-Systeme

Anforderungen:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung oder Studium in der Informatik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation
  • Du hast eine Affinität für die IT-Forensik
  • Du verfügst über eine strukturierte Denkweise und arbeitest selbstständig
  • Erste Einblicke in forensische Methoden hast du bereits gesammelt
  • Du kennst dich mit verschiedenen Datei- und Betriebssystemen (insbesondere Microsoft und M365) sowie Netzwerkprotokollen aus
  • Idealerweise hast du bereits mit gängiger Forensik-Software und Sicherheitstools gearbeitet
  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab

Wissenswertes:

  • Vielfältige persönliche und fachliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten
  • Bezuschusste betriebliche Altersvorsorge, 30 Tage Urlaub, Erfolgsbonus und 13. Monatsgehalt
  • Eine Arbeitsatmosphäre mit Herzlichkeit und Persönlichkeit
  • Individuelle Begleitung bei der Weiterentwicklung – von Coaching bis hin zu berufsbegleitendem Studium

Interesse geweckt? Dann werde Teil eines engagierten Teams und gestalte die digitale Sicherheit unserer Kunden aktiv mit! Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung.

jobs.title: Junior Google Performance & Analytics Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
In dieser Position bist du für die operative Umsetzung unseres Google-Marketings zuständig. Während die Strategie und das technische Setup vorgegeben werden, verantwortest du das fehlerfreie Einbuchen, die tägliche Pflege und das exakte Monitoring unserer Google-Ads-Kampagnen. Du hältst dem Team im Tagesgeschäft den Rücken frei, überwachst die Budgets nach klaren Vorgaben und bereitest die Performance-Daten in übersichtlichen Reportings auf. Durch deine strukturierte Arbeitsweise sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Kampagnen verlässlich laufen und optimiert werden.

Aufgaben

  • Kampagnen-Setup & Pflege: Du buchst Google-Ads-Kampagnen (Search, Shopping, Performance Max) nach klaren Vorgaben ein und pflegst Anzeigen, Texte sowie Budgets im System.
  • Tägliches Monitoring: Du überwachst laufend die Performance und die Tagesbudgets unserer Accounts, um einen reibungslosen und fehlerfreien Ablauf der Kampagnen sicherzustellen.
  • Datenpflege & Reporting: Du exportierst regelmäßig die Leistungsdaten der Werbekampagnen und bereitest diese in übersichtlichen Excel-Listen oder Dashboards für das Management auf.
  • Operatives Tagesgeschäft: Du unterstützt bei der täglichen Organisation der Marketing-Aktivitäten, übernimmst die Abstimmung von Werbemitteln (wie Bildern und Texten) und erledigst anfallende Routineaufgaben im Account.

Qualifikation

  • Ausbildung oder Studium: Du bringst ein abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. Betriebswirtschaft, Marketing, Kommunikationswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Ausbildung mit.
  • Erste Marketing-Einblicke: Du hast erste praktische Erfahrungen im digitalen Marketing gesammelt (z. B. durch Praktika, Werkstudententätigkeiten oder erste Berufsschritte).
  • Google-Kenntnisse als Plus: Idealerweise hast du schon mal mit Google Ads oder Analyse-Tools gearbeitet – das ist ein großer Vorteil, aber kein Muss. Wichtiger ist, dass du Lust hast, dich schnell in diese Systeme einzuarbeiten.
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise: Du bist absolut zuverlässig, arbeitest extrem gewissenhaft und prüfst deine Aufgaben lieber doppelt, bevor etwas online geht.
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Zahlen: Du hast eine gute Affinität zu Daten und kannst sicher mit Excel oder Google Sheets umgehen, um Listen und Tabellen zu pflegen.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Kombination aus Home Office und Arbeit im Büro, für mehr Flexibilität und Teamgeist.
  • Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Zugang zu Schulungen und Workshops, um deine Fähigkeiten kontinuierlich auszubauen und deine Karriere innerhalb der Agentur voranzutreiben.
  • Teamkultur: Ein motiviertes, unterstützendes Team und eine offene Arbeitskultur.
  • Ausstattung: Moderne Arbeitsmittel und leistungsstarke Tools für deine täglichen Aufgaben

Überzeuge dich selbst und mache einen Abstecher zu unserer letzten Workation in Portugal:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=dXcSIfU1zK

Du hast Lust, unser Google-Marketing operativ auf das nächste Level zu heben, die täglichen Kampagnen erfolgreich zu steuern und gemeinsam mit uns das Wachstum auf diesem Kanal voranzutreiben?

Dann freuen wir uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen.

Come fly with us – bei der eFLY.

jobs.title: Sr. Backend Engineer II - US Stocks
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Founded to transform retail finance, Ajaib Group is an Indonesian fintech unicorn breaking barriers to financial access. Having recently secured a $270M Series C—the single largest funding round in Southeast Asia over the past four years—we are backed by premier global investors including Y Combinator, Ribbit Capital, SoftBank, and SBI Holdings.

To build world-class products, we assemble world-class talent. Supported by our fully remote work arrangement, our team spans Eastern Europe, the Middle East, India, and Southeast Asia, allowing you to work with brilliant engineers and builders from around the globe from wherever you are. We operate with an impact-driven purpose where everyone is the owner of our customers' satisfaction. Driven by a growth mindset and a fierce will to win, we refuse to settle and constantly push engineering boundaries.

Role Overview

As a Sr. Backend Engineer II in the US Stocks team, you own backend services for trading US stocks from design to production: order flow to our brokerage partners, balances and currency conversion, market data, portfolio and corporate actions. You take on larger and more complex features, make sound design decisions under real traffic, and mentor engineers around you.

  • Design, build and run scalable, secure backend services and APIs for trading, funding, market data and portfolio features.
  • Own larger features and services end to end, including monitoring, alerting and on-call follow-up.
  • Design for correctness first: accurate money and quantity handling, idempotent requests, safe retries and audit trails.
  • Integrate with US brokerage and custody partners, and make those integrations resilient to outages, delays and duplicate or out-of-order messages.
  • Build and improve reconciliation between our records and our partners' records, and drive root-cause fixes for mismatches.
  • Handle US-specific events correctly, such as market hours, dividends, stock splits and settlement timing.
  • Keep services fast and stable at US market open and during volatile days, and plan capacity ahead of known events.
  • Lead design reviews and give thoughtful code reviews.
  • Investigate production incidents, run root cause analysis and ship lasting fixes.
  • Mentor mid-level engineers and share knowledge within the team.
  • Design resilient, low-latency order routing logic to manage execution across multiple Liquidity Providers (LPs) and venues, handling rate limits, partial fills, and complex order lifecycles.
  • Proactively identify systemic risks across the US Stocks domain and propose architectural improvements, acting as a technical bridge to Staff engineers.

Requirements

  • Education: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional backend engineering, with a track record of owning production services under high traffic.
  • Languages: Strong in Java, Go or another modern backend language.
  • System Design: Solid understanding of microservices, REST/gRPC APIs, event-driven design, and reliability and observability practices.
  • Data & Messaging: Hands-on with relational and NoSQL databases (query tuning), caching (Redis) and messaging (Kafka).
  • Infrastructure: Experience running services on cloud platforms (GCP or AWS), with containers and CI/CD.
  • Mindset & Domain: Ownership mindset and clear communication. Experience in brokerage, trading, payments, cross-border money movement or another regulated environment is a strong plus.
  • Deep understanding of modern API-first brokerage platforms (e.g., Alpaca, Interactive Brokers) or crypto exchanges, including WebSocket streaming for market data and FIX protocol fundamentals.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our client, a global leader in next-generation identity resolution, creates and maintains an accurate, real-time map of devices, user identities, and their relationships. Leveraging over 20 billion online signals every 24 hours and more than 15 billion email open and login events per month, their privacy-friendly solutions are powered by the signature Identity Device Graph. This graph offers deterministic accuracy, probabilistic scale, real-time processing, and operates seamlessly across multiple environments, including cookieless, MAID-less, and CTV.

Join Our Team:

Become a part of our core backend team, which is responsible for high-performance services that serve both customers and other system components. Our team also manages operational data and other infrastructure services, ensuring the system remains at peak performance.

Tech Stack:

Java, Spring, Cassandra, Protobuf, Spark, AWS services (SQS, Lambda, S3, Athena, EMR, and others), Redis, and more.

Your Role:

  • Take ownership of core backend services within a dynamic, growing backend infrastructure team.
  • Develop backend components with high throughput and near real-time latency.
  • Engage in technologically advanced projects, solving diverse, complex problems at scale.
  • Collaborate with Data Pipeline, Data Science, DevOps, Frontend Development, Product, and other teams.
  • Play a significant role in a small company where every team member is crucial and part of an elite group.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of hands-on Java development experience.
  • Proficiency in Golang.
  • Strong server-side skills.
  • Experience working with Spark.
  • Familiarity with high throughput, low latency, mission-critical distributed systems.
  • Experience with large-scale production databases.
  • B.Sc. in Computer Science or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and drive results in a highly collaborative setting.
  • Quick adaptability to changes and a strong desire to learn and grow.

Bonus Points:

  • AdTech experience and understanding of ORTB.
  • Experience with web clients and HTTP/Rest APIs.
  • SAAS product development experience.
  • BigData-oriented development experience.
  • Experience with Aerospike, Spring, EMR, Docker & Kubernetes, and Maven.

Why Join Us:

Our client's family-like atmosphere encourages you to express your full potential, supported by great mentors and a collaborative environment. We believe in balancing work with personal life. If this sounds like the opportunity you've been looking for, your place is with us!

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Data Science team at Penguin Random House builds recommendation systems, forecasting models, and AI-powered tools that shape how readers discover books across our platforms. Our team of scientists and engineers develops and operates these systems end-to-end, from research through production.

We are building a dedicated cloud environment on AWS, along with ML platforms that enable our scientists to deliver models to production quickly. We are hiring a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to build and maintain the foundational systems that support this work.

You will build on a mature MLOps foundation and work closely with AI to evolve and run our cloud platform.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design and own core components of our AWS environment used across data science products. Set the standards for how people and AI agents change infrastructure: review, tests and guardrails.
  • Build self-service paths to production for scientists: CI/CD pipelines, promotion gates, and automated triggers, so scientists can ship models without hand-holding.
  • Help maintain the security, compliance, and reliability of cloud environments.
  • Shape the platform roadmap by identifying the infrastructure work that will most unblock our scientists, and keep stakeholders informed as it progresses.
  • 5+ years building and running production systems.
  • Track record of designing infrastructure components or tooling that other engineers or teams adopted.
  • Hands-on cloud experience (AWS preferred).
  • You can use AI agents to build and operate systems, and you can show work you shipped this way.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work closely with data scientists and engineers.
  • Experience running infrastructure for ML or data-intensive workloads in production, such as model training, batch scoring or model serving.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience defining SLOs or SLAs and managing cloud cost for ML production systems.
  • Experience with evaluation or error analysis of ML or LLM systems in production.

The salary range for this position is $185,000-$210,000.  All positions are currently eligible for an annual profit award or bonus, subject to Company results.

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 3, 2026, or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we review applications on a rolling basis. For this position a complete application should include your resume and cover letter, as both are required for consideration. Before applying for any role at Penguin Random House, we recommend you review our applicant resources pageand our FAQs page.

Penguin Random House job postings include a good faith compensation range for each open position. The salary range listed is specific to each particular open position and takes into account various factors including the specifics of the individual role, and candidate's relevant experience and qualifications.

Full-time employees are eligible for our comprehensive benefits program. Our range of benefits include, but are not limited to, Medical/Prescription drug insurance, Dental, Vision, Health Care/Dependent Care Flexible Spending Account, Health Savings Account, Pre-Tax and Roth 401(k), Short and Long-Term Disability Insurance, Life/AD&D Insurance, Commuter Benefits, Student Loan Repayment Program, Educational Assistance & generous paid time off.

jobs.title: Researcher, World Models
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Menlo

Menlo Research is an Applied R&D lab building Asimov, an open-source humanoid robot platform, and the full software stack that powers it. Our mission is to make humanoid labor economically viable, turning software into physical labor at scale. We build across the full stack: hardware architecture, locomotion, autonomy, simulation, and infrastructure. We move fast, ship to real robots, and open-source everything we can. If you want your work to matter beyond a paper or a demo, this is the place.

The Role

We are hiring a Researcher to advance the world models at the core of Asimov's ability to perceive, predict, and act. You will work at the intersection of self-supervised representation learning, predictive architectures, and embodied control, in close collaboration with our platform, firmware, and hardware teams.

What You'll Do

  • Design, train, and rigorously evaluate world models that let Asimov predict the consequences of actions across visual, proprioceptive, and force/torque modalities.

  • Advance our self-supervised learning stack for visual and sensor representations, building on and extending the JEPA family (V-JEPA, I-JEPA, and related predictive-embedding approaches).

  • Prototype and benchmark generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs) against JEPA-style objectives for embodied prediction and planning.

  • Own the data pipeline for your experiments end to end: curation, tooling, and scaling, without depending on a separate data-engineering team to move.

  • Integrate what you build with our platform, firmware, and software teams so research reaches the robot, not just the paper.

  • Contribute to sim-to-real transfer, inverse dynamics, and multi-modal sensor fusion, and publish or open-source work where it strengthens the field and the team.

What We Look For

  • Proven modeling track record: you have trained models and can show solid, honest evaluations, not just training curves.

  • JEPA fluency: you understand the joint-embedding predictive approach and can reason about where it fits versus alternatives.

  • Breadth across approaches: familiarity with prior and adjacent work, including VLA (vision-language-action) models, and a view on their trade-offs.

  • Depth in a modality: strong depth in at least one sensory domain (vision, audio, natural language, or similar).

  • Strong data abilities: you get things done without depending on a whole data-engineering team.

  • Solid engineering: you can implement, integrate, and ship what you build alongside platform, firmware, and software teams.

  • Conversant, ideally deep, in several of: SSL for visual and sensor representations; world models (JEPA, V-JEPA, I-JEPA, LeJEPA, MJEPA); generative and predictive architectures (diffusion, DiT, flow matching, VAEs); robotics ML (VLA, inverse dynamics, sim-to-real, optical flow); sensor fusion (vision, proprioception, force/torque, multi-modal encoders); PyTorch, JAX, and distributed training.

Nice to Have

  • Publications at NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CoRL, or RSS (or arXiv work with comparable citations).

  • PhD or equivalent research experience in ML, robotics, or computer vision. Not required with a strong portfolio.

  • Demonstrated hardware or robotics interest or hands-on experience.

  • Strong communication: technical blogs, talks, or clear written research.

Why Join Menlo

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Partner Discovery & Requirements Analysis

  • Lead and document working sessions with clinical, finance, operations, product, and technical stakeholders to understand existing workflows, business rules, data requirements, and operational processes.
  • Translate manual and system-supported workflows into structured business and functional requirements.
  • Produce gap-analysis documentation mapping current-state processes and partner requirements to existing platform capabilities.
  • Classify requirements based on appropriate disposition, such as existing functionality, configuration, new development, acceptable operational workaround, shared platform enhancement, or out of scope.
  • Maintain a consistent backlog structure across implementations so requirements remain comparable, traceable, and reusable.

System Reconciliation & Technical Analysis

  • Analyze application logic, SQL, stored procedures, configuration parameters, integrations, and data flows to understand existing system behavior.
  • Determine whether business requirements can be satisfied through configuration, existing functionality, process changes, or new development.
  • Validate assumptions about platform behavior against available technical evidence and distinguish confirmed system behavior from inferred behavior.
  • Identify discrepancies between documented behavior, stakeholder expectations, system configuration, and implemented logic.
  • Trace business rules to underlying parameters, data elements, calculations, integrations, and system components.
  • Identify where behaviors are configurable versus hardcoded and assess the impact on future implementations.

Requirements Authoring

  • Write clear business and functional requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, assumptions, dependencies, open questions, and proposed workarounds.
  • Maintain appropriate separation between business-facing requirements and technical implementation details.
  • Ensure acceptance criteria reflect the agreed solution approach, including configuration changes, operational workarounds, or new functionality.
  • Apply a consistent standard for distinguishing standalone requirements from assumptions, configuration decisions, implementation details, or operational procedures.
  • Maintain traceability from business need through solution decision and development implementation.

Cross-Functional Facilitation & Governance

  • Facilitate requirements, solutioning, and review sessions across business, clinical, product, engineering, data, and operational teams.
  • Drive open questions toward resolution and update requirements and documentation to reflect confirmed decisions.
  • Identify ambiguity, conflicting requirements, downstream impacts, and cross-feature dependencies before development begins.
  • Prevent scope drift and ensure implementation-specific requirements do not unintentionally become platform-wide requirements.
  • Support prioritization and decision-making by clearly communicating business impact, implementation complexity, dependencies, and risk.

Ticket Creation & Scoping

  • Translate approved requirements into development-ready tickets containing problem statements, user stories, functional scope, acceptance criteria, dependencies, assumptions, and open questions.
  • Partner with engineering and architecture teams to clarify technical scope and implementation approach.
  • Track dependencies across features, integrations, implementations, and shared platform capabilities.
  • Identify common capabilities that can support multiple clients, workflows, or future implementations rather than creating one-off solutions.

The Manager Operations is responsible for overseeing the operational conduct of clinical trials at

contracted medical institutions within a defined country or region in accordance with Milestone One

contractual obligations. The Manager Operations provides leadership to Lead Site Coordinators and

Site Coordinators, serving as a subject matter expert and escalation point for operational issues. This

position plays a key role in staff development, process improvement, and continuous operational

excellence.

  • Assesses feasibility of research protocols by reviewing clinical, operational, and resource requirements and recommending suitable trials for the medical institution.

  • Monitors the progress of budget negotiations and study activation timelines to support timely site readiness.

  • Manages the team of (Lead) Study Coordinators, oversees the quality and results of their work by monitoring and follow-up of study related reports, timesheets, site trackers and other operational tools to ensure satisfactory performance of the Milestone One team.

  • Drives process improvement and standardization of clinical trial operations in alignment with ICH GCP, regulatory requirements, MO1 Controlled Documents, by contributing to the development of operational guidelines, templates, and procedures.

  • Certifications ICH GCP Training

  • Fluent use of English

  • Excellent management skills, experience managing remote staff preferred.

If you want to join a developing company where people matter, you're independent and accountable, Milestone One is the right place for you.

jobs.title: Lead AWS Platform Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our client is seeking a remote Lead AWS Platform Architect to provide senior technical leadership for a mission-critical cloud platform in a remote work environment.

This is a hands-on architecture and platform-engineering role focused on AWS, Amazon EKS, Terraform, GitOps, CI/CD, security, and federal cloud compliance. The platform is highly automated, with infrastructure and application changes managed through code, peer review, and deployment pipelines rather than manual console configuration.

The Lead AWS Platform Architect will take ownership of platform architecture and implementation across multiple AWS environments, helping guide the evolution toward a secure multi-account federal cloud architecture.

The right candidate is equally comfortable designing cloud architecture and implementing it. You should be able to move from architecture decisions and Terraform modules to EKS operations, GitOps workflows, CI/CD security controls, and production troubleshooting.

Success in this role means delivering secure, reliable, highly automated cloud infrastructure while raising engineering standards across architecture, security, change control, automation, and operational evidence.

What You Will Do

  • Serve as a senior technical lead for AWS platform architecture, engineering, security, and automation.

  • Own and evolve Terraform across multi-environment and multi-account AWS infrastructure.

  • Develop reusable Terraform modules and manage remote state, dependencies, lifecycle, and infrastructure drift.

  • Safely reconcile existing AWS resources with Infrastructure as Code.

  • Design, operate, and improve production Amazon EKS environments.

  • Manage EKS networking, autoscaling, add-ons, workload identity, Helm, ingress, load balancing, upgrades, and cluster lifecycle.

  • Design and maintain secure AWS networking and identity patterns.

  • Support IAM, workload identity, network isolation, secrets management, and least-privilege access.

  • Develop and extend GitOps deployment models using Argo CD, Flux, or comparable technologies.

  • Design and maintain GitLab CI/CD pipelines supporting infrastructure and application delivery.

  • Implement automated security controls including SAST, Infrastructure as Code scanning, container scanning, secrets detection, policy-as-code, and deployment gates.

  • Support secure container supply-chain practices including image validation, signing, and deployment controls.

  • Help design and implement a federal multi-account AWS landing-zone architecture.

  • Develop approaches for cross-account identity, networking, environment isolation, and controlled promotion between development, testing, and production environments.

  • Work with AWS services including VPC, IAM, EKS, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Secrets Manager, Lambda, and related cloud technologies.

  • Support cloud-native, containerized, microservices, and serverless architectures.

  • Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and continuous security visibility across the platform.

  • Support the technical implementation of controls aligned with NIST SP 800-53, FISMA, RMF, and Authority to Operate requirements.

  • Produce and maintain technical evidence supporting security assessments, compliance reviews, and ATO activities.

  • Troubleshoot complex AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, networking, GitOps, CI/CD, and security issues.

  • Mentor engineers and provide technical direction on cloud architecture, automation, Kubernetes, Infrastructure as Code, and DevSecOps practices.

  • Improve engineering standards around peer review, change management, deployment validation, documentation, and evidence-based operati...

jobs.title: Teach English From Home !
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Company

Ajaia is a rapidly growing AI consultancy and product studio dedicated to helping organizations move from experimentation to real results. We operate across four core pillars: AI Strategy and Advisory, AI Engineering and Automation, Workforce Training and Enablement, and Custom Product Development.

In addition to client services, Ajaia builds proprietary AI products, copilots, and vertical solutions that solve high-value industry problems. This dual model allows us to translate hands-on implementation experience into scalable products while continuously refining our approach through real-world deployment.

Our operating model combines deep technical execution with practical change management, enabling enterprises to deploy secure, compliant, and high-impact solutions that drive measurable operational value. From executive roadmapping to production-ready systems and workforce upskilling, Ajaia embeds intelligent tools directly into the workflows that matter most.

Mission: Help organizations win the AI moment.

Position Overview

As a Junior AI Engineer at Ajaia, you will build and ship AI-enabled software across client engagements and internal products, working alongside senior engineers who will review your work and help you grow.

You will take clearly scoped tasks, ask good questions, and deliver working code across web interfaces, backend services, LLM integrations, and AI-driven workflows. Over time, you will take on larger pieces of work with less guidance.

This is an individual contributor role for an early-career engineer who learns fast, cares about quality, and wants real production experience in applied AI.

Every role at Ajaia is AI-forward. We expect engineers to use AI tools in daily workflows across research, implementation, debugging, testing, and documentation. AI usage is a core execution capability, not optional tooling.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Build and fix frontend and backend features for AI-enabled applications, under the guidance of senior engineers.
  • Help integrate large language model APIs, prompts, and simple AI workflows into products.
  • Write clean, tested code and take part in code reviews, both giving and receiving feedback.
  • Work with APIs, databases, and cloud deployments on well-defined tasks.
  • Use AI tools daily for coding support, debugging, research, test generation, and documentation.
  • Ask clarifying questions early and raise blockers quickly.
  • Keep documentation, tickets, and status updates current.
  • Learn the team's engineering patterns and apply them consistently.

Requirements

  • 0–2 years of professional experience, or a strong portfolio of shipped projects (internships, freelance, open source, or personal projects count).
  • Working knowledge of a modern frontend framework (such as React or Next.js) and a backend language (such as Python or Node.js).
  • Basic understanding of REST APIs, SQL databases, and authentication.
  • Some hands-on experience calling a large language model API (such as OpenAI, Anthropic, or Gemini) in a project.
  • Comfortable with Git and GitHub for daily collaboration.
  • Clear written and spoken English with technical and non-technical colleagues.
  • Active daily use of AI tools for coding, debugging, and learning.
  • Ability to check AI-generated code for correctness instead of accepting it as is.
  • Eagerness to learn, take feedback, and improve quickly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • A project that uses retrieval (RAG), embeddings, or a simple AI agent.
  • Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or Google Cloud Platform.
  • Experience with PostgreSQL or MySQL.

Schedule and Location

  • This is a fully remote role within approved hiring locations, subject to Ajaia hiring and compliance...

En tant que Senior Manager Smart Building, directement rattaché au directeur de la Squad Smart & Digital Building, vous aurez sous votre responsabilité des consultant.e.s. jobs.title: Marketing Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

AfterShip, a Great Place to Work Certified company, is transforming the global eCommerce landscape. Founded in 2012, AfterShip is a post-purchase SaaS company on a mission to build the world’s leading automation platform for ecommerce merchants.

AfterShip unifies shipping & labels, order tracking, AI predictive delivery, and returns management into one system—giving merchants a single place to manage and automate everything that happens after checkout. By centralizing these workflows, AfterShip enables merchants to reduce customer support inquiries, deliver a more reliable and engaging customer experiences, and unlock incremental revenue at every post-purchase touchpoint.

AfterShip integrates seamlessly with eCommerce platforms including Shopify and TikTok Shop, and connects with more than 1,400 carriers worldwide. Today, over 20,000 businesses—including Samsung, Gymshark, Mejuri, Dr. Squatch, and Alo Yoga—rely on AfterShip to turn every post-purchase moment into an opportunity to build trust, reduce costs, and drive repeat purchases.

Built for a global market from day one, AfterShip operates with an engineering-driven, internationally distributed team. The company employs more than 450 people across 8 offices, spanning North America, Europe, and Asia, and representing over 20 cities worldwide.

Your Mission:

Our marketing team ships at a high cadence across paid, email, events, organic social, and web. In 2026 we built the strategic creative direction. In 2027 we need production horsepower—designers who turn that direction into volume, fast, using AI as leverage. The ideal candidate is a builder first and foremost, not an abstract strategist. This role reports to AfterShip’s Manager of Creative.

What You’ll Do:

  • Performance marketing ad creative (static + simple motion) for paid channels.
  • UI snippets that showcase our product benefits, used across channels.
  • Demand gen campaign creative including campaign identity + asset development.
  • Web asset development + templated wireframes leveraging our core design system.
  • Other assets as needed: organic social assets, email marketing assets, IRL event graphics.
  • Contributing to the build out of AI-native production workflows — pushing Claude Design, Midjourney, Runway, Figma AI, and whatever’s next to the limit.

Who We're Looking For:

  • Taste: Your portfolio shows you know what great B2B tech marketing design looks like.
  • AI as a reflex: You build your own agents and default to AI-native production methods every day — not as a demo you rolled out once. You are deeply curious and constantly seek out new ways to get leverage out of AI tooling.
  • Hustle: You ship fast. You care about getting to prod. You see the value in creative testing and iteration vs. aiming for polished perfection.
  • Design chops: Strong graphic design + fluency in simple motion design. Figma is your home.
  • Extreme ownership: When a project is assigned to you, you own it from beginning to end. You clear blockers and problem solve as needed to deliver on the assignment.
  • Opinionated: You always bring a POV to your work, and can articulate the rationale behind the creative choices you make.

At AfterShip

jobs.title: AI-assisted Junior Project Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Hi,

We are Monterail - ~ 130 experts working together to create meaningful software.
As a software agency, we collaborate with multiple clients, so as a Junior Project Manager, you will most likely run a few projects simultaneously.
We specialise in 4 main industries Fintech, MedTech, HRtech & E-commerce.

We are opening a Junior Project Manager opportunity with a specific twist: at least half of your projects will be AI-augmented.

What does that mean? In some of our projects we use AI tools like Claude, Claude Code connected to our repos to handle the work that used to take hours: drafting tickets, summarising calls, surfacing risks in git history.

We are looking for someone who is excited to utilise AI in their projects but also work in traditional set-up of projects.

Requirements

Project work - what will you do?

  • collaborate on building web and mobile applications from prototyping through delivery
  • coordinate a project team of Backend, Front-End or Mobile Developers, supported by QA Specialists and Designers
  • organize project workflows and facilitate regular meetings - stand-ups, sprint plannings, retros
  • act as a project advisor, balancing the client's roadmap and communication with our internal possibilities
  • set the project flow using different tools and methods
  • work with client budget sheets and gradually work alongside senior PMs on schedule and delivery for the projects you’re engaged on
  • monitor risks and actively look for inefficiencies
  • challenge your project team and client to balance product quality with work efficiency
  • collaborate closely with a Tech Lead to tackle technological complexity and prioritise the backlog

AI- augmented work - what will you do?

  • use Claude (and similar tools) to draft Jira tickets, refinement summaries, decision logs and client updates
  • turn long call transcripts into structured decisions, action items and follow-ups without losing nuance
  • spot when AI output is wrong, vague or hallucinated, and rewrite it
  • maintain memory files for each project so context doesn't live only in your head

Skills:

  • 6–12 months of relevant experience - junior PM, associate PM, scrum master, product analyst, project coordinator, or a software developer in web/mobile or similar areas
  • communication - proactive, friendly and assertive
  • tech-savviness and hands-on use of Claude Code, Cursor or another AI coding tool
  • english C1 (speak and write) - 99% of our communication is in English
  • active interest in AI tools - genuine interest and use. We will ask what you use and what you've automated.
  • good understanding of how web and mobile products work - backend vs. front-end, what an API is, what makes software quality high or low
  • critical thinking and focus on delivery
  • awareness of Agile and Scrum - you don't need a certification, but you should know why a daily exists and what a retro is for

Benefits

Salary

  • B2B contract: 36 - 48 PLN / hour

Description

Helfy is a European leader in digital health, facilitating over 300,000 monthly treatments across the continent through our flagship platform, DoktorABC. We connect licensed physicians, partner pharmacies, and patients to make healthcare faster, discreet, and reliable.

As we expand our footprint in the French market, we are looking for dedicated Independent Endocrinologists to join our medical network. This remote role offers complete autonomy to set your own workload, fitting smoothly alongside an existing practice or hospital appointment while generating a consistent supplemental revenue stream.

Responsibilities

As our Endocrinology Category Lead, you will combine remote clinical consultations with high-impact clinical leadership. You will serve as our primary specialist authority in France, shaping our medical standards, safety frameworks, and treatment protocols in specialized endocrine and metabolic health.

  • 100% Remote Opportunity: Lead consultations and protocol development from your home or personal workspace, wherever you are based, provided you hold valid authorization to practice in France.

Engagement: Six-month contract, approximately 40 hours per week, with potential extension or conversion to permanent employment

We're looking for a highly experienced, hands-on DevSecOps / AWS Platform Engineer to help strengthen and modernize our cloud infrastructure, application security, and development operations.

This engagement encompasses two major initiatives: improving our cloud and application security infrastructure and migrating business-critical legacy systems into AWS.

You'll work closely with our engineering and technology leadership teams, with significant autonomy to recommend solutions, make technical decisions, and implement improvements.

This is not a purely advisory or architectural role. We want an engineer who enjoys designing solutions, writing code, automating infrastructure, and delivering working systems.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 4+ years of hands-on experience in DevOps, cloud infrastructure, platform engineering, SRE, or related disciplines.
  • Strong AWS expertise, including networking, compute, databases, IAM, security, monitoring, and infrastructure architecture.
  • Demonstrated experience migrating production workloads from legacy or third-party environments into AWS, preferably including Windows-based applications.

jobs.title: Director, US Defense & Federal Sales
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fotokite is the global category leader in actively tethered autonomous Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms. Born as an ETH Zurich deep-tech spin-off with 22 granted patents, Fotokite combines autonomous robotics, un-jammable tethered station-keeping, and enterprise SaaS to deliver continuous 24/7 situational awareness.

With over 1,100 fielded systems dominating North American public safety, Fotokite is scaling its European commercial infrastructure.

Role Overview & Strategic Charter

We are seeking a high-caliber, battle-tested Director, US Defense & Federal Sales to own and scale Fotokite’s US Defense vertical.

This is a true Player-Coach role. You will take 100% ownership of our Defense Go-To-Market (GTM) engine—leading direct engagements with DoD contracting officers, building strategic alliances with major Defense Primes and navigating complex federal procurement pathways (IDIQs, OTAs, DLA, and Programs of Record).

The Strategic Gap You Will Bridge

Fotokite already possesses strong end-user field demonstration capabilities—our team can effectively put hardware in the hands of operators, tactical teams, and unit commanders in the field. The Fotokite team is seeking an expert who has demonstrated expertise in converting end-user demand into awarded contracts and scalable program line items. You will manage direct reports (including tactical field sales and solutions engineers) and provide the federal contracting expertise, procurement navigation, and C-suite Prime strategy required to win major defense business.

Core Responsibilities

1. Federal Contract Execution & Deal Closing (Player Focus)

  • Pipeline to Contract Conversion: Take direct ownership of closing high-value deals across all branches of the US Department of Defense (Army, Air Force, Navy, Marines, USCG, SOCOM, and National Guard).
  • Federal Procurement Mastery: Navigate FAR/DFARS regulations, Other Transaction Authorities (OTAs), Small Business Innovation Research (SBIR/STTR) transitions, and multi-year DoD budget cycles (POM).
  • Contract Vehicle Optimization: Weaponize pre-existing contract vehicles and prime channels—including DLA Prime Vendors, GSA Schedules, and established Primes' IDIQs—to shorten procurement cycles.

2. Strategic Defense Prime Alliances & Teaming

  • Prime Partnering: Architect formal teaming agreements, subcontracting arrangements, and technology integration partnerships with top-tier US Defense Primes.
  • Program of Record Integration: Position Fotokite’s tethered ISR technology as a required subsystem/payload inside larger Defense Programs of Record (e.g., base security, vehicle-mounted ISR, tactical MANET relays).

jobs.title: Community Game Tester (Paid, On-Call)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Department: GBTN

Location: Remote (Work from Home)

About GBTN

GBTN is a community of gamers who help shape the future of video games. We partner with developers to test unreleased and in-development titles from the comfort of our members' homes.

Our community is essential for testing multiplayer games, verifying online infrastructure, and providing critical feedback on the user experience. If you are passionate about gaming and want a behind-the-scenes look at how games are made, this is a perfect opportunity for you.

The Role: What You'll Do

As a GBTN Community Tester, you will be invited to participate in paid, "on-call" test sessions. This is a highly flexible role with no set hours—you participate when you are available for an invited session.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Participating in scheduled game tests using your own personal hardware (PC, console, mobile device, VR headset, etc.) and internet connection from the comfort of your home
  • Stress-testing multiplayer servers and online features.
  • Evaluating games for user experience (UX), gameplay feel, and balance.
  • Identifying and clearly reporting bugs, glitches, and other technical issues.
  • Providing detailed, constructive feedback through surveys and written reports.

Please Note: This is Not a Job

This is not a full-time or part-time position. It is a flexible, paid, on-call role.

  • You will be paid for the specific test sessions you are invited to and choose to participate in.
  • This is an ideal role for students, gaming enthusiasts, retirees, or anyone looking to earn extra income while contributing to the gaming industry.

Confidentiality is Critical

Due to the sensitive, pre-release nature of the projects you will test, all GBTN members are required to sign a strict Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

  • You must not discuss any aspect of the tests, games, or materials with anyone outside of the GBTN program.
  • Breaching the NDA will result in immediate removal from the program and potential legal action.

Requirements

Who We're Looking For

We are seeking reliable, discreet, and passionate gamers to join our community.

Requirements:

  • Must be 18 years of age or older.
  • Access to a stable, high-speed internet connection.
  • Own at least one gaming device (e.g., a PC, game console, mobile device, or VR headset).
  • Must be willing and able to sign and strictly adhere to our Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA).

Nice-to-Haves (not required):

  • Previous experience in game testing or Quality Assurance (QA).
  • Familiarity with a wide variety of game genres.

Why Join GBTN?

  • Get Paid to Play: Earn money for participating in test sessions.
  • Ultimate Flexibility: Accept invitations that fit your schedule.
  • Behind-the-Scenes Access: Be one of the first people in the world to play unreleased games.
  • Make an Impact: Your feedback directly helps developers improve their games.

Benefits

----

Location: Japan, Korea

Area of Work: QA Testing Services

Service: GBTN

Employment Type: On-call

Working Pattern: Remote

As a co-dev game studio, we now focus on solving some of the most difficult problems that face multiplayer games — and we bring our experience working on games like PUBG, League of Legends, and Rocket League with us. We truly love the work we do and we want to funnel our passion and expertise into features and games that billions of players will enjoy worldwide.

Rushdown Studios is looking for an experienced Game Build Engineer to join us in support of an existing partner studio! In this role, you’ll work alongside our existing team to improve infrastructure reliability and automate infrastructure creation, builds, and deployments for a large-scale game development project.

Our ideal candidate is a self-motivated and demonstrated team player with the ability to juggle and jump between different tasks as necessary. Prior game development experience is required for this role, but we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet all of the requirements listed below!

Work Location: Rushdown Studios is based in Saratoga Springs, NY and we have a strong preference for local candidates willing to work from our office on a hybrid basis (i.e., Tuesday-Thursday) or fully remote candidates in the Eastern United States. However, we're always open to expanding our list of remote-eligible states for the right candidate, as well.

  • Experience compiling code and/or managing pipelines that compile code.
  • Ability to debug unexpected issues that arise during development.
  • Experience working with cloud providers (e.g. Azure, AWS, GCP).

Nice-to-Haves

jobs.title: Vice President of Customer Success
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fotokite develops autonomous, high-endurance tethered unmanned aerial systems to help firefighters and public safety teams save lives.

Fotokite systems allow first responders to quickly and easily gain situational awareness after arriving at emergency scenes: our autonomous one-touch launch/land system makes operation simple and safe; the dual color and thermal camera payload provides situational awareness from the system’s aerial perspective; and actively tethered flight means the system can be flown without a certified pilot, and can be left flying for as long as the situation requires.

Fotokite is seeking a hands-on, high-impact Vice President of Customer Success to architect, build, and lead our global post-sales function from the ground up. Operating in a Player-Coach capacity, you will write the official Customer Success Playbook, implement the technical infrastructure and tracking tools, and directly manage key strategic accounts while scaling a high-performing team across North/South America and Europe.

You will bridge hardware logistics, software telemetry, and customer retention to transform post-sale operations into a predictable, high-margin revenue engine across public safety agencies, defense entities, OEMs, and enterprise security clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Playbook Architecture & Standard Operating Procedures

  • Create the CS Playbook: Build the end-to-end Fotokite Customer Success Playbook from scratch, establishing standardized SOPs for Order Handoff, Technical Commissioning, Day 30 CSAT Audits, Day 90 QBRs, and Renewal Triggers.
  • Scale Repeatable Processes: Codify segment-specific onboarding and expansion workflows tailored to Firefighting, Law Enforcement, Defense, and Enterprise Security verticals across global regions.

2. Infrastructure, Tooling & Analytics Setup

  • Build the CS Tech Stack: Select, configure, and roll out customer health tracking platforms (e.g., Gainsight, Totango, ChurnZero, or advanced CRM modules) and integrate them with hardware telemetry logs.
  • Establish Health Scoring & Dashboards: Develop real-time customer health dashboards tracking system flight hours, deployment frequency, software utilization, maintenance status, and churn risk indicators.

3. "Player-Coach" Team Leadership & Account Execution

  • Lead by Example (Player): Directly manage flagship enterprise, defense, and strategic municipal accounts; personally conduct high-stakes in-person QBRs, flight demos, and executive check-ins.
  • Scale the Global Team (Coach): Recruit, mentor, and manage regional Customer Success Managers (CSMs) and Sales Engineers across the Americas and Europe, instilling a high-accountability, customer-centric culture.

4. Revenue Ownership: Retention, Expansion & Software Attach

  • Drive Account Expansion: Partner with Regional Sales Managers and Resellers to execute systematic fleet expansion campaigns, driving multi-unit orders and accessory upsells.
  • Monetize Software & Support: Own post-sale revenue for annual software subscriptions, cloud data streaming, software maintenance, and extended warranty/service attachments.

Key Qualifications

  • Player-Coach Mindset: Proven willingness to roll up your sleeves, write documentation, configure software tools, and manage customer accounts directly while building executive strategy.
  • Zero-to-One Infrastructure Builder: Direct experience selecting, setting up, and deploying CS tracking platforms, CRM health scoring, and customer telemetry dashboards from scratch.
  • Author of CS Playbooks: Demonstrated track record creating formal, scalable Customer Success Playbooks and SOPs in a hybrid Hardware-plus-SaaS, IoT, Robotics, Defense, or GovTech environment.
  • 5+ Years CS Leadership: Proven leadership experience building and scaling CS teams.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Teach English Online!

  • Stable Class Hours = Stable Income
  • Fixed Student & Teacher pairing
  • Long-term employment only! (1 year+)

About YiYiEnglish:

Since 2017, YiYiEnglish has been providing high quality English lessons to students in China. Our goal is to provide an excellent, accessible educational opportunity to our students. If you’re a qualified teacher who has a passion for teaching, you’ve found the perfect place!

Working With YiYiEnglish:

YiYiEnglish puts the upmost care and attention to our teachers. We will be alongside you every step of the way from the application process to our boot camp to your very first student and beyond. Our business practice requires close collaboration with teachers, so you’ll have your own dedicated associate to ask questions to, receive feedback from, and to discuss student related topics.

All of our students subscribe to a regular schedule. This means that our teachers will have a consistent schedule that will be stable throughout your contract with us. This will allow teachers to build relationships with their students to better understand their strengths, weaknesses, learning styles, and interests in order to provide the best learning outcomes possible. Regular students also provides teachers with financial security since your weekly schedule will be consistent and reliable. Because of our model of pairing students with teachers, all of our teachers need to have stable, fixed schedules throughout your contract with us. No more stressing about your schedule each day!

Teaching Philosophy:

Learning matters, it’s important. Educational progress, development, and success are a priority at YiYiEnglish. We genuinely care whether students learn, hone, and master English. We understand the burden of responsibility of introducing young students to English. It’s our collective responsibility to provide our students with a warm, caring, and judgement free learning space so they can develop a love for English. If done properly, the impact that we can make on our student’s lives can be consequential and life changing. If you share our passion for teaching then YiYiEnglish is the perfect place for you!

Who We’re Looking For:

YiYiEnglish relies on our teachers to exemplify our teaching philosophy. We want teachers who genuinely care about their students. We want teachers who take their work seriously and who can show that they are responsible and passionate teachers.

  • Native or near native pronunciation
  • Great communication skills
  • Commitment to responsibility
  • Experience working in English as a Second Language (ESL/TESL) preferred
  • High-speed internet connection
  • Access to a HD camera and mic
  • Bachelors degree
  • TEFL/TESOL/CETL or equivalent
  • [REQUIRED] Fixed schedule for a minimum of 6 months

Our Application Process:

  1. Complete your online job application.
  2. Complete an initial set of video questions.
  3. Conduct a live demo lesson to showcase your skills.
  4. Sign a contract and start teaching!
