jobs.title: Support Engineer, PAYGO
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Exa

We raised a $250M Series C to build the search engine for AIs. Led by a16z, with existing investors Benchmark, Lightspeed, and YC doubling down, the round brings Exa's valuation to $2.2 billion.

Exa is building a search engine for the AI era. Our Search API currently powers Agents, Fortune 500s, and AI labs as we transform an industry that hasn't been disrupted since the 90s. We're a largely SF-based team of ~100 from Harvard, MIT, Meta, Google Research, ex-founders, and dropouts alike.

We are rapidly building the most intelligent search engine in history. We're high agency, low-ego, and united by the feeling that this is one of the last problems worth getting right.

About the Role

Thousands of developers and companies use Exa on pay-as-you-go. As the Support Engineer for PAYGO, you own all of their inbound questions: getting started, search quality, billing, errors, integrations, and real bugs. The volume is high and every day is different.

It's one of the fastest ways to learn Exa end to end. You'll work with our AI support tools, the docs, Product and Engineering, and you'll see what developers build with Exa before anyone else does. Some of the people writing in are tomorrow's biggest customers, and you'll be the one who spots them.

In this role, you will:

  • Own the PAYGO queue: answer what the AI first line can't, quickly and clearly

  • Debug with customers: reproduce issues with the API, read their code and send working fixes

  • Triage well: production issues and unhappy customers first, everything else in order

  • Escalate with full context: bugs to Engineering, product gaps to Product, and anything you can't resolve to the Support leader

  • Spot growth: flag PAYGO accounts that look like future enterprise customers to Sales

  • Improve the AI first line: fix the docs, help center and agent workflows so the same question doesn't need a human twice

  • Spot patterns across tickets and turn them into product feedback

Requirements

  • Programming experience: you can read unfamiliar code, call an API and debug a failing request

  • Clear, short writing. Customers can act on your answers without coming back

  • You learn fast and keep quality high when the volume is high

  • Good judgment on what to answer yourself and what to escalate

  • Comfort working AI-first, with AI tools and agents as part of your daily workflow

  • Early-career candidates are welcome

You might excel if you...

  • Have worked in support, developer relations or a customer-facing technical role at a developer-tools, API or AI company

  • Have built side projects with LLMs, RAG or agents

  • Enjoy being the person who finally figures out what's going on

  • Want to grow into an FDE or Solutions Architect role over time

  • Care deeply about the problem of organizing the world's knowledge and making it accessible to machines

jobs.title: Schülerpraktikant (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mode ist unsere Leidenschaft - und das bereits seit über 55 Jahren. Saison für Saison entwickeln wir als familiengeführte Unternehmensgruppe erfolgreiche Kollektionen, die inzwischen in über 70 Ländern und 15.000 Schuhgeschäften zu finden sind. Unsere Maxime lautet: Immer ein bisschen mehr tun als der Wettbewerb, Dinge ausprobieren, ausgetretene Pfade vermeiden und die Bodenhaftung nicht verlieren. Dass dieses Konzept aufgeht, spiegelt unsere Erfolgsgeschichte wider. 


Du möchtest im Rahmen Deines Schulpraktikums oder freiwilligen Praktikums unsere Unternehmenswelt kennenlernen? Dann bewirb Dich bei uns als Schülerpraktikant (m/w/d).


Praktikumsverlauf:

  • Du durchläufst verschiedene kaufmännische Abteilungen und lernst die Abläufe und Prozesse in den einzelnen Bereichen kennen.

  • Du erarbeitest eigenständig kleinere Projekte und Aufgaben.

  • Du begleitest unsere Auszubildenden und dual Studierenden bei ihrer täglichen Arbeit.


Unser Bewerbungsstatus für die kommenden Monate auf einen Blick:


Grün: Du hast Glück! In diesen Monaten sind noch Plätze frei – nutze Deine Chance und bewirb Dich schnell.

Gelb: Es wird eng! Hier sind nur noch wenige Restplätze verfügbar. Warte nicht zu lange mit Deiner Bewerbung.

Rot: Leider ausgebucht! In diesen Monaten sind bereits alle Praktikumsplätze vergeben.


Was Dich ausmacht:

  • Du solltest mindestens 14 Jahre alt sein und die 9. Klasse besuchen.

  • Du bist dabei, einen der folgenden Abschlüsse zu machen: Abitur, Fachgebundene Hochschulreife oder Fachhochschulreife.

  • Du hast Spaß an Mode, bist kommunikativ, wissbegierig und ein echter Teamplayer.


Trifft unsere Beschreibung genau auf Dich zu? Dann stell' Dich mit Deinen vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen bei uns vor:

  • Motivationsschreiben: Warum Du? Warum wir?

  • Tabellarischer Lebenslauf

  • Die letzten 2 Schulzeugnisse

  • Sonstige Qualifikationsnachweise


Wir freuen uns auf Dich!




DEIN KONTAKT

Alexandra Löhr

HR Coordinator Young Professionals

Wortmann KG

Internationale Schuhproduktionen
Personalmanagement

32758 Detmold

jobs.title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du gestaltest CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit – von der Segmentierung über automatisierte Journeys bis zur datenbasierten Optimierung.

In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle gestaltest du CRM & Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji von Grund auf mit. Dabei hast du die Zusammenhänge und Abläufe der relevanten Systeme und Datenquellen im Blick.

Think about your last hotel stay. Did you skip the front desk line with mobile check-in? Message the staff for extra pillows? Order a late-night snack with a tap on your phone? Then you’ve likely run into Canary in the wild.

Canary Technologies is the leading agentic AI platform for hotel and guest management, powering the digital infrastructure for more than 20,000 hotels in 125+ countries. The world's most renowned hospitality brands, including Marriott International, Four Seasons and Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, partner with us to increase revenue, improve operations and elevate the guest experience.

We’ve executed the largest deployment of autonomous AI systems in hospitality, building technology that fundamentally redefines how guests and hotels interact. It’s made us one of the top-funded hotel technology companies in the world, with nearly $200M raised to date.

Canary has been recognized as a 2024 and 2025 Deloitte Technology Fast 500™ company, Inc. 5000 fastest-growing company, and swept the 2026 HotelTechAwards, including Best Place to Work, #1 Guest Experience Platform, and the Hotelier’s Choice Award. We're growing quickly, and we're looking for people who are passionate about their work, want to grow with us and are ready to take on more responsibility along the way. Come join us! Let’s shape the future of hospitality together.

jobs.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
SENIOR DEVOPS ENGINEER

Catapult is building the future of sports performance technology, with a mission to Unleash the Potential of every athlete and team on earth. We don't just work in the sporting industry; we are actively changing it.  Since 2006, our solutions have been leading the way in sports performance software, science, and data, in a world where 1% can literally mean the difference between winning and losing.

We work with over 5,000+ teams around the world, empowering coaches, managers and trainers in premier teams in the NFL, NBA, NHL, MLS, EPL, AFL, NRL, NCAA and more. We provide the information they need to optimize athletes' health, game-day readiness, and performance, as well as in-game tactics.  

Catapult is a sports technology company that empowers professional teams to make data-driven decisions. We deliver health, performance, video, and AI insights from the locker room to competitive environments, ensuring every decision is an opportunity to gain an advantage, sharpen performance, and build lasting success. 

WE WANT PEOPLE WHO ARE PASSIONATE ABOUT SOLVING HARD PROBLEMS

We are looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer to help build, operate and improve the infrastructure, platforms and tools that enable our teams to develop, deliver and run reliable software at scale.

Based in Cologne, you will join a team with broad ownership of our technical environment. We take a cloud-agnostic approach, combining cloud services and self-hosted infrastructure to meet the needs of our products and engineering teams. Our responsibilities span the full lifecycle, from provisioning and deployment to observability, security and ongoing operation.

You will combine infrastructure expertise with automation and software engineering to improve how our software is built, deployed and operated. This includes streamlining development workflows, integrating and maintaining shared tools, and supporting demanding workloads across data processing, media and machine learning. Working closely with engineering teams and colleagues across the business, you will build practical solutions that support our expanding product portfolio.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving a wide range of technical problems, takes ownership from initial idea through to production, and thrives in a fast-growing environment where priorities and requirements evolve quickly. You will help shape how our infrastructure, platforms and tools adapt as the business grows.

WHAT YOU'LL DO 

  • Design, operate, and continuously improve our Kubernetes platform across both self-hosted clusters and AWS
  • Own our infrastructure as code using Terraform and Ansible, driving a GitOps workflow to ensure all changes are versioned, reviewed, and reproducible
  • Build and maintain robust CI/CD pipelines (GitLab CI) and shared templates that empower product teams to build, test, and deploy reliably
  • Operate and scale specialized infrastructure for demanding workloads, including GPU clusters for computer vision models, media engines, and data analytics platforms 
  • Evolve our observability stack to proactively monitor system health, define meaningful alerting, and ensure high availability
  • Drive platform security and compliance through continuous vulnerability scanning, automated image screening, robust secrets management, and strict access controls
  • Collaborate closely with software engineers, data scientists, and product teams to design scalable architectures and act as a strategic technical partner for new infrastructure initiatives 

Help define technical direction, engineering best practices, and quality standards within the infrastructure domain <...

jobs.title: Praktikant (m/w/d) – Produktentwicklung & Datenaufbereitung
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CERTUSS beschäftigt über 150 Mitarbeitende in Deutschland, Großbritannien und den USA und ist mit seinen Dampferzeugern in mehr als 90 Branchen weltweit vertreten. Besonders im Gesundheitswesen, der Chemie-, Pharma- und Automobilindustrie sowie der Hotellerie und Lebensmittelbranche leisten unsere Produkte einen wichtigen Beitrag – von der Automobilfertigung bis zur Sterilisation in Krankenhäusern.

Ab sofort bieten wir engagierten Studierenden einen Pflichtpraktikumsplatz im Bereich unserer Produktentwicklung an. Während deines Praktikums erhältst du vielfältige Einblicke in den spannenden Fachbereich unseres Unternehmens, in dem Produkte für eine nachhaltige Zukunft entwickelt und überarbeitet werden und sammelst praktische Erfahrungen in einem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsumfeld. Du arbeitest an realen Aufgaben mit, bekommst ein Gefühl für verschiedene Schnittstellen und lernst unterschiedliche Perspektiven kennen.

Das bieten wir Dir:

  • Einblick und Unterstützung in einem innovativen Unternehmen in Hard- und Softwareentwicklung mit einem Schwerpunkt der Datenaufbereitung (Stammdaten, Prozessdaten)

  • Eigenverantwortliche Aufgaben und die Möglichkeit, Prozesse aktiv mitzugestalten

  • Ein motiviertes Team, das Dich unterstützt und dir wertvolle Erfahrungen vermittelt

  • Bei uns übernimmst Du schnell Verantwortung für Deine Themen und stehst im Austausch mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern

  • Deine Ideen sind willkommen – wir fördern Dein Engagement für bessere Prozesse


Dein Profil:

  • Du bist hochmotiviert und möchtest etwas bewegen

  • Eingeschriebener Student (m/w/d) im Bereich Elektrotechnik, Informatik, Mechatronik, Produktentwicklung im Maschinenbau, Datenanalyse, Datenmanagement, Technische Kommunikation, Technisches Informationsdesign oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • Das Praktikum ist Teil Deines Studiums (Pflichtpraktikum)

  • Strukturierte und selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Du arbeitest gerne im Team, kannst aber auch Aufgaben eigenverantwortlich und selbstständig vorantreiben

  • Eigeninitiative, Teamfähigkeit und ein gutes analytisches Denkvermögen

  • Als Praktikant (m/w/d) unterstützt Du uns für mindestens 3 Monate


Deine Aufgaben:

  • Du unterstützt uns bei der internen Weiterentwicklung im Bereich der Produktentwicklung, Datenanreicherung und -auswertung - von der Analyse über die Optimierung von Prozessen bis hin zu abwechslungsreichen Ad-hoc-Aufgaben

  • Arbeite an bereichsübergreifenden Projekten mit und optimiere unsere Abläufe

  • Entwickle und setze interne Verbesserungsmaßnahmen um

  • Erhalte wertvolle Praxiserfahrung und unterstütze unser Team im abwechslungsreichen Tagesgeschäft


Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Dann werde Teil des CERTUSS-Teams und wachse mit uns! Wir freuen uns auf Deine Bewerbung!


CERTUSS - zuverlässig und vertrauensvoll.
Ein Traditionsunternehmen seit 1957!


Aus Gründen der besseren Lesbarkeit wird auf die gleichzeitige Verwendung weiblicher und männlicher Sprachformen verzichtet und das generische Maskulinum verwendet. Sämtliche Personenbezeichnungen gelten gleichermaßen für alle Geschlechter.

jobs.title: Strategic Valuation & Modeling - Senior Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are currently looking for an ambitious and diligent individual to join our Strategic Valuation & Modeling team in Frankfurt or Munich as a Senior Manager. In this role, you will work with experts in the field of valuations, transformation, restructurings and transaction services, but will mainly focus on:

  • Performing and reviewing complex valuation models

  • You value companies, intangible and tangible assets as well as strategic alternatives in connection with tax, transactional and accounting matters

  • You provide support with fairness opinions to assess the appropriateness of transaction prices and structure

  • Identifying and understanding the key business drivers and provide value to the client through our services and the deliverables we produce

  • Being responsible for the day-to-day management of engagements and act as the main point of contact for clients in this process

  • Managing the preparation of deliverables including reports, presentations and discussions with the different stakeholders

  • Steering and providing guidance to more junior team members

  • Actively contributing to business development (both internal and external) and thought leadership is expected


To ensure that we find the best candidate for this position, we expect our future Senior Manager to have :

  • A Master’s degree in economics, engineering, science, business administration or business economics

  • Financial analytical skills and good accounting knowledge are considered as a prerequisite as well as giving meaning to the numbers and translate this into a well-structured report

  • Between six to eight years of relevant professional experience in valuations, corporate finance investment banking or corporate development/strategy

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and a hunger to be exposed to challenging projects

  • A clear opinion that you gladly share with others

  • A drive to solve new issues in a practical and creative manner

  • Fluent in MS Office (especially with Excel and PowerPoint)

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to be a great team player

  • Fluency in German and English

  • Prior experience in developing and managing small teams

  • Eagerness to work on cross border assignments

If you meet the above requirements and are excited about this opportunity, we encourage you to apply.

Feel free to reach out if you have any questions or need further clarification.

jobs.title: Senior Controller  (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Die SCHAEFER GmbH ist ein weltweit agierendes mittelständisches Unternehmen mit Sitz in Süddeutschland. Seit über 60 Jahren entwickeln, produzieren und vertreiben wir qualitativer hochwertige Komponente und Lösungen für die globale Auszugsindustrie.

Für die SCHAEFER Gruppe suchen wir für den Standort Sigmaringen einen

Senior Controller (m/w/d)


Ihr Verantwortungsbereich:

  • Gesamtverantwortlich für den Controlling-Bereich der inländischen sowie ausländischen Niederlassungen

  • Analyse und aktive Steuerung von Kosten-, Leistungs- und Ergebnisstrukturen

  • Margensteuerung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung der Ergebnisqualität

  • Budgetplanung, Forecasts sowie Mehrjahresplanungen für alle Standorte erstellen

  • Erstellen aussagekräftiger Reports, KPIs und Präsentationen für das Management

  • Optimierung der Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung zur Effizienzsteigerung

Caseware ist die globale KI-Plattform für Audit und Accounting. Gegründet vor über 35 Jahren in Toronto, nutzen heute mehr als 500.000 Anwender:innen in 130 Ländern unsere Lösungen, und über 36.000 Fachleute weltweit führen Caseware als Skill auf LinkedIn. Als wachstumsstarkes Technologieunternehmen, backed by Hg, beschleunigen wir die Transformation unserer Branche Richtung Cloud und AI, und bauen die nächste Generation von Audit- und Accounting-Workflows. Wenn du in einem Umfeld arbeiten willst, das global skaliert, technologisch vorne liegt und echten Impact liefert, bist du bei uns richtig.

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) bei Caseware wandelst Du Marktinteresse in messbare Ergebnisse. Du gewinnst neue Kunden, baust bestehende Beziehungen gezielt aus und erkennst Potenziale innerhalb deines Kundenportfolios frühzeitig. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Role
 
Als Account Executive übernimmst du eine Schlüsselrolle in der Skalierung von JobAuto, indem du potenzielle Partnerunternehmen für unser Mitarbeiter-Benefit Programm JobAuto gewinnst. Dabei bist du für den gesamten Sales Cycle, von Leadgenerierung bis zu Account Closing verantwortlich.  Mit JobAuto richten wir uns an Unternehmen aller Größenordnungen, die ihren Mitarbeitern den Umstieg auf (Elektro-)Mobilität durch Gehaltsumwandlung erleichtern wollen. Mit deiner Leidenschaft für Vertrieb, einem ausgeprägten Geschäftssinn und Blick für die Herausforderungen deiner Kund:innen entwickelst du gemeinsam mit einer Vielzahl interner und externer Stakeholder wertstiftende Lösungen und bringst die Verhandlungen zu erfolgreichem Abschluss. Damit hast du maßgeblichen Einfluss auf den Erfolg und das Wachstum unserer JobAuto Unit.

Your Mission
  • Land & Expand: Dein Ziel ist es, unser Produkt bei neuen Geschäftskund:innen zu platzieren und damit die optimale Basis für den langfristigen Ausbau von Key Accounts zu legen.  Dafür etablierst du tiefgreifende Beziehungen mit wichtigen Entscheidungsträgern auf VP- und C-Level Ebene.
  • Steuere den gesamten Sales-Cycle: Du bist von der aktiven Leadgenerierung über die Qualifizierung bis zum Closing komplett für die Gewinnung von JobAuto-Kund:innen verantwortlich. Dabei hast du die Möglichkeit, neue Verkaufsstrategien für die Gewinnung von Outbound Leads einzubringen. 
  • Kenne den Markt und unser Produkt: Du entwickelst ein tiefes Verständnis für unser Angebot im Bereich Mobilitätsmanagement und wirst zum Experten für den Markt der Gehaltsumwandlung für Autoabos und unser Angebot. 
  • Entwickle das JobAuto Produkt weiter: Du bist in stetigem Austausch mit unseren Kund:innen, sammelst Feedback und identifizierst Verbesserungspotenziale, um unser Produkt und die JobAuto Customer Journey kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. So stellst du sicher, dass wir Marktchancen optimal nutzen, Prozesse verbessern und unsere Kundenzufriedenheit kontinuierlich steigern.

    • Your Profile

    Must-have:

    • Ausbildung & Erfahrung: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium (z. B. BWL, Wirtschaftswissenschaften) oder eine vergleichbare kaufmännische Qualifikation mit nachgewiesener Erfolgsbilanz im B2B-Vertrieb komplexer Unternehmenslösungen.

    • Kommunikations- & Verhandlungsstärke: Exzellente Argumentations- und Networking-Fähigkeiten auf Führungsebene gepaart mit lösungsorientiertem, unternehmerischem Denken.

    • Drive & Eigeninitiative: Starker Bias for Action, Hands-on-Mentalität sowie die Bereitschaft, eine schnell wachsende Sales Unit aktiv mitzugestalten.

    • Sprachkenntnisse: Fließende/Exzellente Deutschkenntnisse (C2-Niveau) sowie verhandlungssichere Englischkenntnisse.

Introduction to the Team & Role

 
What if your team was the one that got to build the future of how a company runs — and tried it on itself first?
 
GTM Systems owns the tech stack behind 360Learning's commercial engine — Salesforce, Marketo, data enrichment and AI tooling across sales, marketing, customer success and services. Our mission is to be a force multiplier for the business: making go-to-market faster, smarter and more effective.
 
We already have a high-performing team, mature systems, extensive documentation, and an ambitious AI vision. Now we need someone to build on that foundation and take it to the next level.
 
You'll work closely with GTM leaders, operators, data teams and engineering to turn ambiguous business problems into reliable, scalable products. You'll partner with each team to define the target state — where AI can take work off their plate, and where the human touch matters — then build the systems and agents that get them there.
 
This is a high-impact role for someone who loves working at the intersection of product, systems, AI and go-to-market strategy.

  • Keep the team a step ahead as customer zero for AI, turning what works into patterns other functions adopt.
  • Own the long-term design of the GTM stack — CRM, marketing automation, CS tooling — deciding what to build vs. buy.
  • Help the company prioritize by identifying the best solution to each business problem and sizing its cost and feasibility.
  • Lead and coach five senior ICs across Salesforce, marketing/BDR, CS systems and web ops. Set a high bar for documentation, testing and deployment — and hold it without slowing the team down.
  • Run vendor management end to end: evaluations, the quarterly keep-or-kill review, and renewals.
  • Partner as a peer to the leaders of Data, Enablement, Security, Finance and every commercial function.
  • Drive adoption and change management for new GTM capabilities across distributed teams.

  • Understand the main business challenges and opportunities for each GTM function
  • Own the team's current quarterly objectives and the routines that keep them visible.

  • Have taken one major cross-functional change from plan to done
  • Own the full vendor-renewal cycle across the commercial stack
  • Have co-written the next quarter's objectives with the performance and enablement teams, each one stating the business problem, the current state, the expected impact and the plan.

    • Within 6 months, you will:

  • Show, in numbers, the capacity the commercial organization reinvested because of what the team built.

Als Microsoft Copilot Studio und AI Solutions Consultant (m/w/d) entwickelst du intelligente und skalierbare KI Lösungen für unsere Kunden.
 
Du begleitest wertvolle Anwendungsfälle von der ersten Idee über Prototyp und Pilot bis in den sicheren produktiven Betrieb. Im Zentrum stehen Microsoft Copilot Studio, Microsoft Foundry, Azure AI Services sowie die Integration von Unternehmensdaten, Prozessen und bestehenden Plattformen.

• Fundierte Kenntnisse in Microsoft Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Azure AI Services oder vergleichbaren Plattformen für generative KI.
• Technisches Verständnis für Large Language Models, Prompt Engineering, Orchestrierung, Retrieval Augmented Generation und Datenintegration.
• Erfahrung mit Power Platform, Connectors, REST APIs, Automatisierung und Enterprise Architekturen.
• Kenntnisse zu Sicherheit, Governance, Datenschutz, Compliance und verantwortungsvoller KI im Unternehmenskontext.
• Teamfähigkeit, Freude an Innovation und sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch und Englisch.

So entstehen Lösungen mit nachhaltiger Wirkung und genau das macht uns zu einem der führenden Anbieter im Bereich Cloud-Technologien. 

Unser Anspruch ist es, echte Ergebnisse zu schaffen, die messbar Wirkung zeigen und Projekte nachhaltig voranbringen. Wir beraten nicht nur, sondern setzen um. Denn Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Wirkung zu erzielen, gehört für uns zusammen.

jobs.title: Lead Employment Counsel
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the Role:

We are hiring a Lead Employment Counsel to be the first line of legal support for our People team. This person will advise directly on employment matters, manage our key legal and HR vendor relationships, and reduce our reliance on outside counsel. This is a hands-on, embedded role for an attorney who wants to operate as a trusted business partner, not a gatekeeper. The right candidate will have a passion for People and a strong legal background.

What you'll be doing:

  • Serve as the first line of support for employment legal questions, resolving most matters directly rather than routing them to outside counsel.

  • Partner with each People Business Partner to advise on employee relations, performance management, terminations, leaves, and accommodations. Manage severe employee relations cases directly.

  • Own the Remote.com relationship, including contract terms, service levels, escalations, and ongoing performance.

  • Own the external legal counsel relationship, including a clear evaluation of scope, spend, and who we engage with

  • Partner with Legal and Finance on cross-functional projects involving employment law, compliance, or spend.

  • Ensure compliance with employment law across every jurisdiction where Camunda operates, including in the DACH region. Find opportunities to reduce risk or balance risk with business value.

  • Identify and adopt AI tools that make legal support to the People team faster and more effective.

jobs.title: Care Expert – Medizincontrolling & Pflegedokumentation Krankenhaus (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🎤 WARUM voize? WEIL ES UM MEHR GEHT ALS EINEN JOB.

Bei voize glauben wir: Das Wertvollste, was wir Menschen in der Pflege geben können, ist Zeit. Zeit für Zuwendung, für Gespräche, fürs Dasein. Heute geht genau diese Zeit in Verwaltungsarbeit und komplexen Systemen verloren.

Das wollen wir ändern: mit KI-Begleitern, die digitale Abläufe im Hintergrund übernehmen. Wir ersetzen keine Menschen durch Technik, wir verstärken ihre Wirkung.

Hinter unserer Mission steht eine Series-A-Finanzierung über 50 Mio. US-Dollar unter Führung von Balderton Capital, gemeinsam mit HV Capital, Y Combinator und weiteren führenden VCs. Über 2.000 Einrichtungen vertrauen heute auf voize, mehr als 200.000 Nutzer:innen entlastet unser KI-Begleiter im Alltag.

Wir verbinden erstklassige Technologie mit echtem gesellschaftlichem Nutzen. Und jetzt suchen wir dich.

💡 DEINE MISSION

Im Krankenhaus dokumentieren Pflegekräfte mit voize direkt am Bett. Die freigegebenen Einträge landen strukturiert im KIS, über unsere Integration mit ORBIS U von Dedalus. Damit ist Pflegedokumentation nicht nur Grundlage guter Pflege, sondern auch Grundlage für Kodierung, Abrechnung und MD-Prüfungen. Abgerechnet werden kann nur, was belegt ist.

Genau hier brauchen wir deinen Blick aus dem Medizincontrolling. Als Care Expert berätst du Kliniken, wie ihre Pflegedokumentation aufgebaut sein muss, damit erbrachte Leistungen vollständig und prüfsicher in der Akte stehen. Mit den strengeren MD-Prüfquoten ab 2027 wird das für viele Häuser zur wirtschaftlichen Frage. Du arbeitest auf Augenhöhe mit Medizincontrolling, Pflegedirektion, Stationsleitungen und Klinik-IT. Dein Erfolg zeigt sich darin, dass Pflegekräfte Zeit gewinnen und die Dokumentation zugleich den Anforderungen von Kodierung und Prüfung standhält.

🚀 DEIN ALLTAG

  • Dokumentation verstehen, bevor es zählt: Vor dem Go-live analysierst du mit Medizincontrolling, Pflege und Klinik-IT, wie die Pflegedokumentation im KIS aufgebaut ist, von Assessments wie ePA-AC und Barthel über LEP-Maßnahmen bis zu Vitalwerten, Bilanzierung und Wunddokumentation.

  • Die Erlös- und Prüfperspektive einbringen: Du zeigst, welche pflegerischen Inhalte für die Rechtfertigung der Verweildauer, Nebendiagnosen, Komplexbehandlungen wie die geriatrische frührehabilitative Komplexbehandlung und die MD-Prüfung relevant sind, und wo heute Informationen auf dem Weg in die Akte verloren gehen.

About RoomPriceGenie ✨🧞‍♂️

Founded in 2017, RoomPriceGenie is dedicated to helping hoteliers around the globe achieve optimal pricing. 🌍 We understand that many small hotels face challenges with digitalization, making their operations increasingly complex and often resulting in lost revenue. This is where we come in!

We have developed a powerful solution that enables hotels to set the right prices in just seconds. ⏱️ Our state-of-the-art algorithm analyzes both internal hotel data and market trends to recommend pricing strategies that enhance revenue and improve booking rates.

With customers spanning the globe—from the USA and Canada to Iceland, South Africa, China, Slovenia, Italy, and the UK—RoomPriceGenie has made a meaningful impact in the hospitality industry, and our clients love the results. ❤️

Now, we are excited to expand our customer base and spread the word about how we can support hoteliers in optimizing their pricing strategies. We invite you to join us on this journey! We actively encourage applications from candidates with diverse backgrounds to enrich our team and drive innovation.

The Role

The goal of this role is pipeline revenue, driven through relationships. The Partner BDM is where the global partnership strategy meets the market, and you own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed that number. Every relationship, every lead, every partner conversation in your territory goes through you. You execute all three partnership pillars locally — integration depth, reseller acquisition, and long tail activation — and you feed the national programs run by Isabel and the Director of Reseller Partnerships with the contacts, intelligence, and HubSpot discipline that makes those programs possible.

This role also carries a global partner management component. In addition to your regional territory, you will be assigned one or two global partner accounts — relationships that span multiple BDM regions and require a consistent strategic, commercial presence above the regional level. You will manage these accounts directly, briefing with the Global Partner Marketing Manager before any senior contact touchpoint and feeding back the account intelligence that informs RPG's global partner strategy.

The BDM is not a lone hunter. You are supported by intelligence briefs from the Director of Partnership Strategy, onboarding infrastructure from the Partner Operation and Enablement Manager, co-sell support from the Director of Channel Growth Reseller, and global account context from the Global Partner Marketing Manager. The discipline of using those inputs — requesting briefs before first calls, completing HubSpot fields that trigger Isabel's onboarding, registering every lead in Introw on the day — is what makes the whole system work.

Your Role

Pipeline and revenue ownership — your region

  • Own the partner pipeline and revenue target for your region — you are the person who drives the strategy to meet and exceed this number, not just a contributor to it

  • Build and maintain a consistent bottoms-up pipeline plan, built up against your region's targets and TAM — showing exactly how your book of business adds up to your target, by partner type and by deal stage

Wir suchen neue Mitarbeiter (m/w/d) für den Bereich IT-Management, Digitalisierung & Prozesse, die uns bei der Planung und Umsetzung der IT-Infrastruktur unterstützen.

Du hast Wirtschaftsinformatik studiert und Spaß an neuen Tools, Schnittstellen und Automatisierung? Dich reizt die Vorstellung, mit Technologie internationalen Fachkräften den Weg in den deutschen Arbeitsmarkt zu ebnen? Dann passt du perfekt in unser stetig wachsendes Team.

Deine Aufgabenbereiche:

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer SaaS-Anwendungen

  • Einrichtung und Konfiguration von Standartd-Software

  • Analyse, Dokumentation und Digitalisierung unserer digitalen Geschäftsprozesse

  • Entwicklung von Automationen, die unserem Team Routinearbeit abnehmen

Unser Ziel: der führende Vermittler internationaler Fachkräfte in Deutschland zu werden. Bei uns bekommt jeder die Chance, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und mit dem Unternehmen zu wachsen.

Wir suchen Leute, die anpacken und etwas aufbauen wollen. Wenn du Lust hast, in einem Unternehmen mit echtem Impact die IT mitzugestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung!

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.

Was wir dir bieten:

  • Langfristige Perspektive: Wir stellen ein, um langfristig zusammenzuarbeiten – das Ziel ist immer eine unbefristete Anstellung.

Das bringst du mit:

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftsinformatik

  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehenden Prozessen zu folgen

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Eigenverantwortung

  • Belastbarkeit auch in intensiven Phasen

  • Teamgeist

  • Sicheres, fehlerfreies Deutsch in Wort und Schrift; gutes Englisch für die Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Indien-Team

  • Erfahrung mit No-Code-Tools (z. B. Glide, Airtable, n8n, make) oder im Recruiting-Umfeld ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

jobs.title: Medical Document Retrieval Specialist (PH | Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Medical Document Retrieval Specialist (Remote)

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Apply here:

Overview

The Medical Document Retrieval Specialist plays a pivotal role in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. As the first step in the workflow, this position ensures all requests are complete, accurate, and prepared for downstream processing. The quality of intake directly impacts the speed and accuracy of records retrieval for our law firm clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Provider Research & Identification

  • Determine all relevant healthcare providers associated with a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
  • Locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, prior request history, and direct provider calls.
  • Input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

  • Review and correct incoming Release of Information (ROI) forms, which are incomplete or incorrect in approximately 90% of cases.
  • Create accurate base forms before assembling final submission packets.
  • Conduct thorough quality assurance checks for each ROI packet, ensuring all required components (cover letters, affidavits, etc.) are accurate and complete.

3. Request Assignment

  • Assign requests to appropriate records team members based on workload and utilization metrics.

4. Handling Special Cases

  • Identify and escalate provider-specific requirements (e.g., custom forms) to the appropriate Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing or conflicting information by liaising directly with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of healthcare companies, law firms, or related organizations.
  • Attention to Detail: Extreme accuracy is essential errors can cause months-long delays in retrieval.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency in Adobe Acrobat and PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

Join ITC, a trailblazing force with offices in Shanghai, Singapore, and Saigon. We are a hub of innovation for Fortune 500 companies and industry leaders, guiding them through the complexities of the Chinese and APAC markets.

At ITC, you'll play a pivotal role in transforming their business landscapes using cutting-edge MarTech, e-Commerce, and Omnichannel solutions. As part of our team, you'll not only witness but also contribute to significant ROI achievements and market successes. We're not just navigating the future of digital commerce; we're creating it.

Our expertise includes:

  • Digital Transformation & Change Management (including Digital Transformation Talent Augmentation)
  • CRM, CDP, Data, Marketing Automation & Clienteling
  • Talent Augmentation Solutions
  • Tailor-made Digital & Commerce Experiences: WeChat Mini Programs, Websites, Apps

About This Position

We are seeking experienced Salesforce Project Managers to join our freelance team. As a Salesforce Project Manager, you will lead and oversee the implementation of Salesforce solutions for our clients. This role requires a strong technical background and experience in the related industries.

Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage end-to-end Salesforce projects, from initiation to delivery.

  • Collaborate with technical teams to ensure successful integration and delivery.

Charger logistics invests time and support into its employees to provide them with the room to learn and grow their expertise and work their way up. We are entrepreneurial-minded organization that welcomes and support individual idea and strategies. Charger Logistics is seeking a well-rounded individual able to work in a fast-paced environment to join our team.

Responsibilities:

  • Designing, redesigning, and implementation of connectivity, security, delivery and monitoring services relating to virtual networks, VPN, NAT gateways, DNS, load balancers, web application firewalls, application gateways, etc.
  • Extensive experience in networking within large enterprise environments, including WAN, LAN, data centers, and cloud environments.
  • Design, deploy, and manage cloud-based network solutions using Azure, GCP and AWS platforms
  • Develop and implement strategies for seamless cloud integration, including hybrid cloud environments.
  • Experience with HPE Aruba network solutions, including wireless and wired networking
  • Experience designing and implementing BGP routing policies to ensure optimal path selection and traffic engineering.

  • Competitive Salary

jobs.title: Senior Director, Product & AI Security
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Director, Product & AI Security THE ROLE

Reporting directly to the Fortive Chief Information Security Officer, you will be responsible for delivering strategic vision and operational oversight for Product Security and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Security across the enterprise. This role will lead the development and execution of a comprehensive security strategy that embeds secure-by-design principles into software, connected products, firmware, and AI-enabled capabilities.

You will work across operating companies, engineering, product management, R&D, legal, and compliance teams to ensure product security, AI security, and secure-by-design controls are integrated throughout the product lifecycle. This leader will define enterprise standards, drive measurable risk reduction, and enable innovation by aligning security controls with business objectives, regulatory expectations, and customer commitments.

You will lead, coach, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of product and AI security professionals operating across Fortive and its operating companies.

REPORTS TO

VP & Chief Information Security Officer at Fortive

TEAM

Team consists of FTEs, contractors, and third-party security partners supporting product security engineering, AI security engineering, secure development lifecycle, and vulnerability management.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

Product & AI Security Strategy: Develop and implement a comprehensive product and AI security strategy aligned with business objectives, growth initiatives, and regulatory requirements. Establish enterprise standards for secure software development, AI model security, data protection, and product security risk management.

Secure Development Lifecycle (SDLC): Embed security and AI security controls into the full product lifecycle, including requirements definition, architecture, design, development, testing, deployment, and sustainment. This role will focus on NeMo Evaluator, which helps teams understand whether changes to AI agents are making those agents better. As AI systems become more autonomous and more deeply integrated into real workflows, teams need practical infrastructure for observing behavior, measuring progress, catching regressions, and iterating with confidence.

BTSE Group is a global leader in fintech and blockchain technology, anchored by three core business pillars: Exchange, Payments, and Infrastructure Development. Serving over 100 corporate clients worldwide, we provide white-label exchange and payment solutions. Our offerings encompass everything from exchange infrastructure hosting and development to custody, wallets, payments, blockchain integration, trading, and more.
BTSE has pioneered multiple trading technologies that have been widely adopted across the industry, establishing new benchmarks for innovation, performance, and security in digital asset trading. Consistently ranked among the top 10 global exchanges, BTSE is expanding rapidly and invites ambitious, driven professionals to become valuable members of its B2C and B2B businesses.

About the Opportunity:

Join our team as a Token Listing Manager and play a key role in the dynamic blockchain and cryptocurrency industry. Conduct in-depth market research, identify emerging trends, and collaborate with top crypto funds to list innovative projects. Leverage your strong analytical and communication skills to provide strategic insights and detailed reports. jobs.descriptionHtml:
This position will be fully remote and can be hired anywhere in the continental U.S.


Optiv + ClearShark is looking for a Contract Analyst – Federal to play a key role in supporting our federal contracting and procurement activities. This role assists in the preparation, review, and administration of government contracts while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and company policies. The Contract Analyst will collaborate with internal teams to support contract lifecycle activities, contribute to the successful execution of federal programs, and help maintain strong relationships with government customers. This position is ideal for individuals looking to develop their expertise in federal contracting, regulatory compliance, and contract administration while working in a fully remote environment.


How you’ll make an impact

  • Manage the entire contract lifecycle from initiation to closure, including negotiation and execution.
  • Review, process, and track customer contracts, purchase orders (POs), and vendor agreements in the company ERP system. Creation of new contract vehicles and managing updates as needed (i.e. – PoP; Contracting Officer information, etc.)
  • Collaborate with sales and purchasing teams to verify contract terms, pricing, and compliance before quoting customers and/or placing orders with vendors.
  • Maintain organized records of contracts, including physical and digital files, and ensuring accuracy and audit readiness. Maintain an organized, centralized repository of contracts, amendments, and related correspondence.
  • Monitor and manage software subscription renewals and hardware maintenance contracts, ensuring timely, accurate, and proactive renewals to avoid service interruptions.
  • Act as a liaison between sales, legal, and finance departments regarding contract status and deliverables.
  • Assist with reporting on contract metrics, including renewals, revenue, and active contract volume. Ensure contract fee payments are submitted to Government on time.
  • Coordinate with Partner/Alliance Team to receive OEM/Vendor Price Lists for contract vehicles. Ensure monthly/quarterly price lists are uploaded into CRM tool and all quotes/orders are priced according to contract terms and conditions.
  • Manages tech refreshes/compliance checks in SF.
  • Serve as the deputy contracts manager for ITES-SW2, DoW ESI Agreements, and GSA MAS. Responsible for tech refreshes, back-up data flags, product catalog updates, order processing, CLIN list creation/management, program management reviews, and sales enablement.
  • Works with Marketing Team to ensure all information is accurate and up to date on public facing Contracts websites. Additionally, conducts audits quarterly on Government and Distributor websites to ensure contracts information is accurate and up to date.
  • Collects federal EULAs from OEMs/Vendors and ensures EULAs are up to date on EULA Master Site.
  • Manages contract vehicle quote language and terms and conditions are up to date and accurate in Salesforce.
  • Responsible for the processing, tracking and management of all CPARs.
  • Coordinating with Sales and Marketing Teams to manage and create contract vehicle collateral, to include CV Tracking Tool and Linecards.
  • Ensures all Contracts standard operating procedures (SOPs) are current and updated as needed.
  • Assist Client Directors and Inside Sales Representatives with contracts questions and issues to enable sales. Detailed review of Customer Quote Packages for accuracy and compliance with GWAC terms, and completion of all required reps and certs, pushing back to the requisite Sales Team for task completion if/as needed to ensure a compliant submission.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.
  • Complies with all policies and standards.

jobs.title: Content Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
SuperSummary is transforming how millions of readers discover, understand, and connect with books. We’re building the world’s most comprehensive literature platform — combining over 10,000 expert-crafted Study Guides with interactive, innovative tools that make reading more engaging, rewarding, and fun. Beyond summaries, our paid subscription offers chapter-by-chapter analysis, character breakdowns, themes and symbols exploration, thought-provoking discussion questions, and interactive quizzes. Our growing suite of AI-powered features helps readers engage more deeply with texts, whether they’re students tackling assignments, teachers preparing lessons, book clubs seeking richer conversations, or lifelong learners exploring new genres.

Founded over a decade ago, SuperSummary’s website and mobile app has become a trusted, go-to resource for curious readers worldwide. We’re part of the Lift Ventures portfolio of EdTech brands (with over 250 million consumers reached to date) and are a fully remote, global team united by curiosity, creativity, and a shared love of learning.

About the Job

SuperSummary is looking for a Senior Content Designer to grow our library of reading resources by spotting what readers need and building it. Reporting to the Head of Product, you will own the content experience from the reader’s point of view: talking to readers to find new content opportunities, prototyping concepts, and turning the ones that work into content we can produce at scale.

Our content is our primary value driver, and our biggest opportunities come from rethinking existing formats or inventing new kinds of content that readers want. You will help shape our content bets, from our biggest initiatives to quick experiments. You will validate opportunities with research and benchmarking, prototype the content yourself, refine the prompts that produce it, and hand well-defined concepts to the product team for development. You will also raise the bar on product copy and content structure across the product.

The ideal candidate pairs strong editorial taste with fluency in user research, design, and AI. You are comfortable talking directly to readers, you form a point of view quickly and test it, and you hold AI-generated content to the same standard as hand-written work. SuperSummary helps book club members, avid readers, and academic audiences understand and enjoy books, and you share their passion for reading.

This is a part-time contract role.

What You’ll Do


Discover and Validate Content Opportunities

  • Talk to readers regularly through interviews, surveys, reviews, and support conversations to find gaps in what our content gives them
  • Partner with CX to turn incoming reader feedback, such as Trustpilot reviews and NPS comments, into content opportunities
  • Validate each opportunity with user research, competitive benchmarking, SEO and keyword demand, and behavioral data before investing in it, using AI tools to speed up research and synthesis
  • Challenge long-standing assumptions about our content and bring a clear, well-reasoned point of view on which opportunities to pursue first

Prototype New Content Concepts

  • Build realistic prototypes of new content with AI, using real titles and real data, so the team has something concrete to react to
  • Explore several directions quickly and narrow to the strongest one before asking for broader feedback
  • Ground every concept in strong design and usability principles so content is easy to scan, navigate, and use, especially on mobile
  • Partner with product managers and designers on how new content will appear in the product

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

About Liftoff Security Team

The Liftoff Security team protects Liftoff's customers, users, and employees. We architect Liftoff's security posture, build the tools and systems that defend it, and partner with engineering teams as they ship new products and features. Our work spans the entire stack — infrastructure, web, mobile, and IT — and we approach security from a software engineering standpoint, scaling our impact through automation and well-designed tools. As our Security Engineer, Offensive Security, you will own internal offensive testing and lead the move from point-in-time penetration tests to continuous, AI-assisted testing. You will independently plan assessments, safely validate vulnerabilities, work with engineering teams through remediation and retesting, and build sustained knowledge of our source code and systems. You will contribute across application, cloud, and infrastructure security, support Accelerate and MX as priorities change, and share the team's on-call and incident-response work.

  • Independently plan and execute internal penetration tests across applications, APIs, cloud infrastructure, and corporate systems; prioritize assessments by risk and business impact.

  • Combine hands-on testing with source-code review and architectural analysis to find vulnerabilities and demonstrate realistic attack paths.
  • Partner with engineering teams to explain findings, agree on practical fixes, track remediation, and retest to confirm the risk is resolved.
  • Maintain knowledge of Liftoff’s systems and attack surface, revisit high-risk attack paths as systems change, and turn confirmed findings into repeatable tests.
  • Build testing tools and workflows that combine hands-on assessments with ongoing automated testing and remediation validation.
  • Make security testing self-service where practical through reusable tests, documented assessment and retesting workflows, and clear remediation guidance.
  • Support the annual third-party penetration test for independent validation and customer and audit requirements; coordinate scope and follow findings through remediation.
  • Lead adoption of AI-assisted offensive security tooling: evaluate platforms and build workflows for code analysis, test generation, and finding triage; measure coverage, accuracy, and effort saved.
  • Partner with Detection & Response to turn validated attack paths and offensive findings into detection improvements and incident-response exercises.
  • Work across application, cloud, and infrastructure security as priorities change, including Accelerate and MX, and share the team’s on-call and incident-response rotation, including occasional off-hours response and post-incident follow-up.

jobs.title: Senior FHIR Data Platform Engineer (Remote Opportunity)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are currently looking for a Senior FHIR Data Platform Engineer for a 100% remote position supporting a large federal government healthcare modernization project. This role will optimize and maintain the HAPI FHIR data platform, with a strong focus on PostgreSQL performance, FHIR resource indexing, data quality, Master Data Management (MDM), and healthcare data reporting. The engineer will also develop FHIR-based quality measurement services, support HEDIS reporting, and work with large-scale healthcare datasets to ensure reliable, accurate, and performant data exchange.

The role operates in a highly collaborative environment, partnering with cloud platform engineers, data engineers, architects, and healthcare interoperability teams to optimize database performance, support reporting initiatives, maintain platform availability, and deliver production-ready solutions. The engineer will work extensively with HAPI FHIR, Java, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, OMOP, and related data technologies.

The candidate must reside within the continental US.

Responsibilities

  • Optimize the HAPI FHIR JPA persistence layer within PostgreSQL, including search parameters, custom indexes, partitioning strategies, reindexing, resource expunge and history policies, Bulk Data export performance, and asynchronous MDM link tables.
  • Design and execute FHIR data quality checks, including US Core STU 9 conformance, duplicate and orphaned reference detection, and source-event precedence validation.
  • Develop and maintain measure-reporting services for digital quality measurement engines and HEDIS baselines, including FHIR-based measure evaluation, facility and statewide reporting, administrative-effort baselines, and DHHS monthly service report exports.
  • Query OMOP Common Data Model and Apache Iceberg data marts for reporting purposes and collaborate with data engineers on the transformation of published healthcare data into OMOP when FHIR-side changes affect downstream datasets.
  • Produce capacity planning and performance evidence supporting 99.9% availability, 15-minute Recovery Point Objective (RPO), and 4-hour Recovery Time Objective (RTO) requirements for the FHIR platform.
  • Support cloud platform engineers with Aurora PostgreSQL sizing, read-replica configurations, backup verification, and database performance optimization while delivering migration scripts, runbooks, dashboards, and test suites into designated repositories.
  • Take on additional tasks and responsibilities as needed to support team objectives and ensure the success of the project.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, or a related field and 7+ years of professional PostgreSQL experience in production environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with PostgreSQL query planning, index design, partitioning, and performance troubleshooting across multi-terabyte databases.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with HAPI FHIR JPA server internals, including resource tables, search-parameter indexing, Bulk Data, MDM, FHIR R4, and US Core.
  • Working knowledge of OMOP Common Data Model (CDM) v5.4, including concept, vocabulary, and clinical-event tables, with experience writing analytical SQL queries.
  • Experience developing healthcare quality reporting solutions using FHIR-based measures, CQL, FHIR Measure/MeasureReport, digital quality measures (dQM), HEDIS, or equivalent clinical quality reporting sta...

jobs.title: Legal Intake Specialist (Argentina | Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Legal Intake Specialist (Remote)

Schedule: Full-Time | Monday - Friday, 9:00 AM - 5:00 PM EST

Apply here:

Position Overview

The Legal Intake Specialist plays a pivotal role as the first step in the healthcare medical records retrieval process. This position ensures that every request is accurate, complete, and optimized for downstream success. The precision and quality of the intake process directly influence the speed and accuracy of medical record retrieval for law firm clients.

Key Responsibilities

1. Provider Research & Identification

  • Identify all relevant healthcare providers involved in a clients treatment, beyond the main facility listed by the law firm.
  • Research and locate billing providers and related entities using tools such as Chartswap, historical request data, and direct provider outreach.
  • Accurately input all identified providers into the admin application.

2. Request Creation & Quality Control

  • Review incoming ROIs (Release of Information forms), correcting incomplete or inaccurate submissions (noting that ~90% require adjustments).
  • Prepare accurate base forms before generating submission packets.
  • Conduct comprehensive quality assurance checks on each ROI packet, verifying inclusion of all required details such as cover letters, affidavits, and other documentation.

3. Request Assignment

  • Assign requests to the appropriate records team members based on workload balance and utilization metrics.

4. Handling Special Cases

  • Identify and escalate special provider requirements (e.g., unique forms or protocols) to the assigned Client Success Manager (CSM).
  • Resolve missing, unclear, or conflicting information by liaising with the law firms case manager.

Requirements

  • Experience: Prior hands-on experience requesting health records from providers on behalf of law firms.
  • Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy; even small mistakes can cause delays of several months.
  • Technical Skills: Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat and other PDF editing/combining tools.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with a proactive problem-solving mindset.

jobs.title: ABA Intake Coordinator (Guatemala | Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: ABA Intake Coordinator (Applied Behavior Analysis | Autism Care)

The ABA Intake Coordinator(Applied Behavior Analysis | Autism Care) serves as the first point of contact for prospective families seeking care. This role is critical in shaping the family's initial experience by ensuring that all necessary information is gathered promptly and accurately, while guiding them smoothly through the benefits verification and authorization process.

The ideal candidate is empathetic, detail-oriented, bilingual (Spanish strongly preferred), and thrives in a high-volume, fast-paced environment.

Apply here:

Key Responsibilities

1. Outreach & Screening

  • Promptly contact prospective families following online sign-ups or inquiries.
  • Conduct intake screenings to gather missing information and confirm eligibility.
  • Provide compassionate support to families, establishing trust from the very first interaction.

2. Lead Management & Documentation

  • Accurately record and manage intake data in Salesforce.
  • Convert qualified leads into opportunities and seamlessly transition them to the benefits verification and authorization team.
  • Disqualify or close leads when appropriate (e.g., no qualifying diagnosis, unresponsive families).

3. Conversion & Follow-Up

  • Proactively re-engage families who have paused or gone inactive to maximize conversions.
  • Provide intake coverage during evenings and weekends as needed to capture leads in real time.

4. Collaboration & Quality

  • Partner with Intake Managers to follow established SOPs, scripts, and quality assurance standards.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (clinical, revenue cycle management, operations) to ensure a smooth handoff and transition into care.
  • Participate in ongoing training, feedback, and process improvement initiatives to enhance the patient and family experience.

Qualifications

  • Bachelors degree or equivalent work experience preferred.
  • 2+ years of experience in patient intake, customer service, or healthcare operations.
  • Bilingual (English/Spanish) strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or other CRM systems.
  • Experience with ABA (Autism) therapy or healthcare intake strongly preferred.
  • Strong phone presence with excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to provide empathetic, patient-centered support.
  • Highly detail-oriented with exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities.
  • Flexible availability, including evenings and weekends as needed.

Apply here:

jobs.title: Senior Media Buyer-CTV/OTT
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a senior, hands-on TV & Video Media Buyer who can own execution, optimize performance, and expand our efforts into OTT/streaming. This role is for a results-oriented buyer who knows how to buy, negotiate, optimize, and deliver ROI—not just plan. You will also oversee light operational support (trafficking, reporting) to ensure all campaigns run cleanly, efficiently, and accurately.

Immediate Scope of Work

  • Primary (CTV/OTT): Develop and execute a comprehensive strategy for launching our brand on FAST (Free Ad-Supported Streaming TV) channels.

  • Secondary (Linear TV): Audit the performance of our current TV network mix and provide actionable, expert recommendations for immediate optimization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Media Buying & Execution: Plan, buy, and optimize local and national TV (broadcast, cable, syndicated) alongside OTT/CTV/streaming buys across DSPs and direct publisher relationships.

  • Performance Optimization: Monitor and optimize campaigns daily based on response, CPL, CPC, and ROI; swiftly identify underperforming inventory and pivot strategy in real time.

  • Vendor Negotiation: Negotiate rates, added value, and premium placements with stations, networks, and streaming inventory providers.

  • Operational Oversight: Direct and manage admin support to ensure seamless trafficking, accurate reporting, continuous pacing tracking, clearance verification, and delivery monitoring.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with internal creative and analytics teams to refine messaging, track attribution, and improve overarching campaign performance.

Qualifications

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on local and national TV media buying with proven expertise in OTT/CTV/streaming acquisition.

  • Niche Background: Direct experience in legal advertising (SSD, PI, Mass Tort, MVA, or similar high-intent sectors).

  • Core Competencies: Data-driven mindset with a relentless focus on response metrics; strong track record of direct negotiations with stations and vendors; ability to move fast and remain accountable for delivery.

  • Operations: Experience directing or managing media support staff.

  • Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related field preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct Response: Heavy experience in DRTV or high-frequency/low-cost inventory buying.

  • Attribution & Tools: In-depth knowledge of TV/streaming attribution methodologies (call tracking, view-through, matched-market testing) and advanced Excel/dashboard reporting capabilities.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Connexus Credit Union - Who We Are:

Serving members across all 50 states, Connexus Credit Union is a member-focused cooperative that is proud to return profits to member-owners through high yields for checking accounts and deposit products, as well as competitive rates on our loans. We are a remote first employer with the majority of our employees residing in the upper Midwest.

As an employer we foster collaboration and high performance to achieve excellence. We holistically care for and develop our employees to thrive personally and professionally. We are proud to share our success with our employees and those we serve.

Connexus offers an Amazing Benefits package:

  • 25 days of paid time off and 10 paid holidays
  • 16 hours of paid Volunteer Time Off
  • 401K Retirement with up to 6% employer match
  • Excellent Health, Dental, Vision insurance, including multiple plan options
  • Health Savings Account with generous employer contributions
  • Employer paid Life insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability
  • Tuition Reimbursement from $4,000 - $7,000 per calendar year
  • Robust Learning and Development program that includes an annual professional development stipend

About the Role:

The HR Data Analyst will partner with HR and business leaders to turn workforce data into insights that help inform decisions and improve the employee experience. This role will build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytics that provide meaningful visibility into key workforce trends and metrics. They will evaluate data across the employee lifecycle, identify opportunities for improvement, and share recommendations that support organizational goals. In addition, they will help ensure data quality, streamline reporting processes, and expand the organization's use of people analytics.

Responsibilities:

HR Analytics Strategy, Reporting, & Dashboard Ownership

  • Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of HR dashboards, scorecards, and automated reporting solutions that provide meaningful insights across the employee lifecycle.
  • Design, implement, and monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) related to talent acquisition, employee engagement, retention, learning and development, total rewards, and HR operations.
  • Ensure analytics solutions align with organizational priorities, strategic objectives, and the organization’s Employer of Choice commitment.
  • Develop data visualizations and reporting tools tailored to both technical and non-technical audiences, enabling leaders to make informed, data-driven decisions.

Data Analysis & Strategic Insights

  • Conduct complex analyses of workforce data to identify trends, patterns, risks, and opportunities across all areas of Human Resources.
  • Apply advanced analytical techniques, statistical methods, and predictive modeling to solve complex HR business challenges and support strategic decision-making.
  • Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical approaches and actionable recommendations.
  • Research internal and external workforce trends, labor market conditions, and industry benchmarks to provide meaningful comparative insights.

Employee Experience & Listening

  • Measure and monitor employee sentiment, engagement, and experience through surveys, listening strategies, and workforce feedback mechanisms.
  • Analyze employee lifecycle metrics to identify opportunities that strengthen attraction, engagement, development, and retention.
  • Partner with HR leaders to evaluate the effectiveness of employee programs, initiatives, and organizational strategies.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Senior Product Manager, Platform

Location: Ireland/UK (Remote)

About Entity

Entity is building the destination for high calibre games on the web. A curated catalogue of bestselling full-scale game titles running natively in the browser: click a link and you’re playing in seconds on the device you already own.

There are no downloads, no installs and no new hardware. This new low-friction way of playing games is powered by the latest developments in web technologies such as WebAssembly and WebGPU, allowing us to render high-quality game experiences on your device. This is not a game streaming service; this is the power of the New Web.

For developers, we’re the official, licensed channel for proper games on the web. We offer self-serve D2C tools to publish, operate and grow their games, with social play, identity and a unique end-to-end business analytics suite built in.

We’ve signed top-tier publishers representing many millions of unit sales on PC and console to date and are preparing for our launch in 2027.

We’re early, funded and moving fast. Joining Entity at this stage is a rare opportunity to help shape our company and our mission. We are an AI-native business; embracing the latest technologies and tools is essential to being successful with us.

About the role

We're hiring a Product Manager to own the platform itself. That covers what players use to find, play and share games, and the portal and tools developers and publishers use to bring their games to Entity.

Product at Entity is split into two roles that work as one team:

  • Product Manager, Platform (this role) owns what we build: core platform features, the player experience, developer tools, and the governance a platform needs, such as age verification, GDPR and payments compliance.
  • Product Manager, Live owns how the product performs once it's live: the store, pricing, the player funnel, live ops and product performance.

You'll own the platform roadmap and decide what goes into each release. The Live PM is one of your most important internal customers.

You'll work inside the development team, not at a distance from it. We don't write a spec and throw it over the fence. We want someone who works through problems directly with engineers and designers, makes decisions quickly, and keeps everyone clear on the goal.

We're a small team with a launch window ahead of us, so we need to move fast and iterate. The right person knows how much process and documentation is enough to keep everyone aligned, and no more. You'll also be close to how games and players are changing, and keen to build for where the industry is heading.

Key responsibilities

  • Roadmap and releases. Own the platform roadmap: what we build, when and why. Set the scope of each release, sequence the work and keep a single prioritised backlog for the platform team.
  • Player experience. Define the core player-facing features, with core and mid-core players at the centre:
    • Finding (Discovery), launching and playing games, quickly
    • social features incl voice, spectate, virality
    • accounts, profiles, billing and the core systems needed to run a consumer platform at scale
    • cloud saves, trials, drm and the many other games specific features
    • The playing experience across devices (Incl mobile web)
  • Developer and publisher tools. Help define the tool suite that our game developers and publishers use to publish, manage and understand their games. We are a D2C self publishing and distribution platform unlocking the web as a channel.
  • Governance and compliance. Own the platform requirements for:
    • age verification and ratings
    • GDPR and privacy
    • accessibility
    • security
    • payment provider rules
  • Payments infrastructure. Own billing and payments as a platform capabil...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
What We Can Achieve Together:


The Operations & Engagement Manager leads a portfolio of organizational effectiveness, employee experience, internal communications through organization-wide coordination. Reporting to the Deputy Director, you will help ensure staff are informed, engaged, connected, and supported to do their best work, while ensuring organizational priorities, planning cycles, and major internal activities are coordinated effectively.


Working closely with the Leadership Team, managers, staff, and enterprise partners, the Operations & Engagement Manager will translate organizational priorities into coordinated action and strengthen how Nature United works together. The portfolio will include:


  • Leading the integrated organizational calendar and planning rhythm, connecting annual and quarterly reviews, objective setting, workforce and financial planning, governance activities, and recurring organizational forums.
  • Leading employee experience initiatives, including engagement, organizational onboarding, recognition, learning, retreats, staff events, and connection, in partnership with HR, Events, and other functional leads.
  • Coordinating cross-organizational initiatives and planning processes, clarifying ownership, dependencies, sequencing, and follow-through.
  • Leading internal communications so staff have timely, relevant, and accessible information about organizational priorities, decisions, changes, and opportunities for engagement.
  • Designing and coordinating all-staff meetings, surveys, organizational conversations, and other forums for staff connection and input.
  • Managing the Operations team budget and coordinating organization-level workplace operations, facilities, sustainability, safety, administrative support, and related needs with those responsible for day-to-day implementation.
  • Acting as a key liaison with Human Resources, Finance, Information Technology, Legal, Risk Management, Culture & Engagement, and other enterprise partners to coordinate priorities and ensure Nature United’s needs are understood and addressed.
  • Supporting responsible adoption of new workplace practices and technologies, including generative AI, through organizational learning, engagement, guidance, change adoption, and continuous improvement.

The Manager will lead these functions with organizational partners, vendors, and enterprise teams, managing multiple projects, budgets, contracts, and recurring activities. They will exercise independent judgment, lead improvements within their portfolio, maintain confidentiality, and make operational decisions within delegated authority, escalating strategic, financial, legal, governance, and policy matters as appropriate. They may act on behalf of the Deputy Director within established parameters. Travel up to 20% and flexible hours are required to support organizational priorities, meetings, retreats, and events.


We’re Looking for You:


Are you looking for work you can believe in? Nature United is a workplace where we care about each other and know that what we do matters. We have a vacancy for an Operations & Engagement Manager who can connect organizational priorities with the practical coordination, communication, and employee experience that help people do their best work.


You see how teams, activities, and decisions connect, and can turn competing demands into clear plans and coordinated action. You bring sound judgment, strong communication skills, and a practical approach to improving how an organization works. You are comfortable navigating ambiguity, building alignment across functions, and following through from planning to implementation.

jobs.title: Senior Combat Designer [CA]
jobs.descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Combat Designer, you’ll focus on creating mechanics, scenarios and characters that contribute to deep yet accessible combat experiences for the player. You’ll be collaborating with Level Designers, Engineers, Animators and more to prototype, implement and polish all combat-related systems and content for our next flag-ship project. Your typical duties include but are not limited to:

  • Player combat mechanics, weapons, and abilities.
  • Enemy behavior, abilities, and weapons.
  • Other core player systems such as camera, interaction, and traversal.
  • Build and refine the design over time using playtest metrics and internal/external feedback.
  • At least 5 years of professional experience as a Combat/Game Designer
  • At least one shipped AAA title on PC/Console
  • Strong hands-on scripting abilities
  • Self-motivated and open-minded

You Will Stand Out If You Have:

  • Open-World experience
  • 3rd-Person-Action experience
  • Unreal experience

Benefits:

  • Competitive salary
  • 100% employer-paid healthcare premiums for you and your dependents
  • Generous paid time off
  • 401K/ RRSP plan
  • Employer-paid life and disability insurance
  • Team-building activities throughtout the year
  • Flexible working hours

We are an equal opportunity employer that believes diverse backgrounds are key to bringing our concepts to life. If you’re looking to play a key role in creating the best immersive virtual world experience for our users, we invite you to join our team.

Learn more online by clicking here.

Do We Support Flexible Work?

Yes, as a remote team across North America time zones, we embrace flexible working. You may choose to work remotely, in-offices or hybrid, for a more flexible lifestyle that suits you best. Our offices are located in downtown Montreal and downtown Santa Monica, surrounded by great restaurants, entertainment, and cultural venues.

Learn more online by clicking here.

At HoYoverse, we are committed to creating immersive virtual world experiences for players around the world. In addition to game products such as Genshin Impact, Honkai Impact 3rd, Tears of Themis, and Honkai: Star Rail, HoYoverse also launched the dynamic desktop software N0va Desktop, the community product HoYoLAB, and created a variety of products such as animations, comics, music, novels, and merchandise around our original creative concept.

Adhering to our mission of Tech Otakus Save the World, we have always been committed to technology research and development, exploring cutting-edge technologies, and have accumulated leading technical capabilities in cartoon rendering, artificial intelligence, cloud gaming technology, and other fields.

HoYoverse is actively engaged in globalization, with offices in Singapore, Montreal, Los Angeles, Tokyo, Seoul, and other areas.
