Where other test prep companies hire part-time gig workers to teach 'hacks,' we hire full-time professionals to build lasting core skills. We don't run an assembly line; we treat every student as an individual, preparing them for top-tier colleges and beyond.

jobs.title: Senior Field Service Technician
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Area Field Services Manager

__

As a Senior Field Service Technician, you will be responsible for delivering high-quality technical support and service to our customers. You will perform installations, maintenance, and repairs on equipment, ensuring optimal performance and customer satisfaction.

The work model for this role is: Remote.

Our Team Dynamics

Our teams support each other, collaborate, and never stop learning. Everyone brings something unique, and together we push ideas forward to solve real problems. Being part of our team means your work matters - because the progress we make here creates real impact out there.

Key Responsibilities

  • Ensure Safety & Compliance: Follow all ABB HSE, ABB Way, Safety Manual, and product warranty policies while maintaining up‑to‑date knowledge of relevant safety standards and procedures.

  • Technical Execution & Expertise: Perform hands‑on project work—including startup, commissioning, troubleshooting, design, and repair—across power delivery equipment while continually developing technical and industry knowledge.

  • Quality, Standards & Customer Satisfaction: Contribute to improving installation and field service standards, adhere to engineering procedures, and deliver exceptional customer satisfaction in all interactions.

  • Administrative & Cost Management: Complete required technical reports, job status updates, material orders, quotations, time and expense reports, and exercise sound judgment in controlling costs and maintaining company assets.

Qualifications

  • High School Diploma with a minimum of 8 years of engineering / field experience. Additional formal education may substitute for required experience on a year‑for‑year basis.

  • Technical skills in testing of power distribution and delivery to include Low Voltage and Medium Voltage Breakers, Switchgear, Relays and Transformers. Experience in the repair and refurbishment of LV and MV circuit breakers

  • Ability and willingness to travel approximately 70+% as required.

  • Ability and willingness to possess and maintain a valid driver's license.

  • Any offer of employment is conditioned upon the successful completion of a background investigation and drug screen.

  • Candidates must already have work authorization that would permit them to work for ABB in the US.

What's in it for you

We want you to bring your full self to work—your ideas, your energy, your ambition. You’ll have the tools and freedom to grow your skills, shape your path, and take on challenges that matter. Here, your work creates impact you can see and feel, every day.

ABB is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer for protected Veterans and Individuals with Disabilities at ABB.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to their- sex (gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation), marital status, citizenship, age, race and ethnicity, inclusive of traits historically associated with race or ethnicity, including but not limited to hair texture and protective hairstyles, color, religious creed, national origin, pregnancy, physical or mental disability,...

Type:Contract

jobs.title: Senior Director, Engineering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Silvaco is hiring a Memory Design Lead to drive the architecture, design, customer interface and delivery of our embedded memory compiler portfolio: single-port SRAM, ROM, single- and dual-port register files (1PRF, 2PRF), and dual-port RAM (DPRAM). You will lead a team of memory designers, set the technical direction across multiple process nodes, and serve as the senior technical voice in customer engagements — from early presales architecture discussions through PPA negotiation, integration support, and silicon qualification.

This role blends deep technical leadership with direct customer impact. You will shape what our compilers can do, how competitive their PPA is, and how confidently our customers can integrate them into their SoCs. If you have built memory compilers in production, mentored design teams, and enjoy translating customer requirements into winning silicon, this is a high-leverage role at a fast-growing semiconductor IP and EDA company.

Key Responsibilities

Technical Leadership & Memory Design

  • Lead architecture, circuit design, and physical implementation of memory compilers across SRAM, ROM, 1-port and 2-port register files, and dual-port RAM.

  • Define bitcell selection, peripheral architecture (decoders, sense amps, write drivers, IO, self-timing), redundancy and repair strategy, and assist circuits (read/write assist, body bias) to hit aggressive PPA targets.

  • Drive Vmin, leakage, performance, area, and yield optimization across PVT corners, process variation, and aging effects.

  • Own the technical roadmap for the memory portfolio: new compiler variants, new nodes, feature enhancements, and methodology improvements.

  • Establish design, verification, and signoff methodology, while leading design and layout reviews, SPICE/FastSPICE characterization, statistical/Monte Carlo analysis, BIST/repair, DFT, and physical verification.

  • Lead silicon validation efforts including test chip development, testing and reporting.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of memory design engineers spanning circuit design, layout, characterization, and compiler/automation.

  • Set individual and team goals, conduct technical reviews, and develop career paths for engineers at multiple levels.

  • Allocate engineering effort across roadmap projects, customer commitments, and silicon programs; manage schedules, dependencies, and risk.

  • Build a culture of design rigor, peer review, and continuous methodology improvement.

Presales & Customer Engagement

  • Serve as the senior technical lead in presales engagements — qualifying opportunities, presenting Silvaco's memory portfolio, and shaping winning technical proposals.

  • Translate customer SoC requirements (frequency, voltage, density, power, port configuration, special modes) into compiler specifications and PPA commitments.

  • Partner with sales, field application engineers, and product management on RFQs, technical evaluations, and competitive benchmarking.

  • Lead deep-dive technical workshops with customer architects and design teams; respond to detailed technical questionnaires and audit-style reviews.

PPA Analysis & Benchmarking

  • Own PPA analysis across the memory portfolio — performance, power (active and leakage), area, and yield — at both the instance and SoC-aggregate level.

  • Build and maintain competitive benchmarks against foundry and third-party memory IP; identify gaps and prioritize closure.

jobs.title: Middle Data Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Boosters — це українська продуктова компанія. Ми створюємо глобальні продукти в сферах Productivity та EdTech, які несуть цінність для 60 мільйонів людей. Для нас важливо будувати продукти з довготривалим впливом — системні, масштабні та здатні залишатися актуальними десятиліттями.

Зараз ми шукаємо Middle Data Engineer в наш флагманський продукт JustDone — AI асистент для академічної аудиторії, який допомагає краще працювати з науковими роботами, навчатись і проводити глибинні дослідження. Ми віримо, що AI може суттєво змінити те, як люди навчаються та працюють з інформацією. Не через cheating, а через якісніший і глибший рісьорч, швидшу роботу з великими обсягами інформації та автоматизацію формальних і рутинних задач. Так у студентів і дослідників залишається більше часу на те, що справді має значення — мислення, навчання та власні ідеї.

Основна мета цієї ролі — взяти ownership за аналітичну data-інфраструктуру JustDone, забезпечувати її стабільну роботу та знаходити можливості для оптимізації й розвитку. Також ти матимеш можливість долучатися до суміжних задач NLP-напрямку.

Сьогодні JustDone це

  • 3+ млн преміум користувачів;
  • #1 позиція в США в ніші AI Writing Assistants;
  • 90%+ одиниць контенту, створених користувачами, знаходять реальне застосування;
  • понад 3 млн одиниць контенту, який генерується користувачами щомісяця;
  • власні AI та NLP рішення: AI Detector, Text Humanization Engines, AI Research Assistant.

Твоє майбутнє середовище

Наша головна перевага — це люди. Ми працюємо з тими, хто щодня прагне до самовдосконалення та задає високу планку гри. Ти станеш частиною команди фахівців з Data Engineering і працюватимеш пліч-о-пліч із Владом, Сергієм, Данилом та Олею.

Лідерка напрямку — Люба, Lead NLP Engineer. Для Люби важливі небайдужість до результату, самостійність та ownership - не просто закрити задачу, а розуміти, навіщо ми її робимо і чи справді вирішили проблему.

Ми цінуємо сфокусовану роботу та не перевантажуємо команду зустрічами. У нас немає зайвої бюрократії в ухваленні технічних рішень: можна пропонувати нові інструменти, експериментувати з підходами та впливати на те, як організована робота. Важливо лише розуміти, яку цінність принесе запропоноване рішення.

Саме в цій ролі ти отримаєш

  • Автономність та вплив. Зможеш самостійно визначати можливості для покращення аналітичної інфраструктури, пропонувати технічні рішення та бачити їхній результат.
  • Роботу з масштабними технічними задачами. Працюватимеш із production-системами та великими обсягами даних, впливаючи на їхню надійність і продуктивність.
  • Експертизу на перетині Data та AI. Зможеш долучатися до NLP-задач, працювати з Milvus і переймати досвід команди.
  • Перспективи зростання. Розвиватися до Senior Data Engineer із подальшою можливістю рухатися в напрямку Data/Platform Architect.

Твоя зона впливу

  • Розвиток event pipelines. Підтримуватимеш і розвиватимеш потоки даних від RabbitMQ до DWH та Amplitude / Reteno.
  • Інтеграція джерел даних. Підключатимеш нові та підтримува...

Optiv + ClearShark is looking for a Contract Analyst – Federal to play a key role in supporting our federal contracting and procurement activities. This role assists in the preparation, review, and administration of government contracts while ensuring compliance with applicable regulations and company policies. The Contract Analyst will collaborate with internal teams to support contract lifecycle activities, contribute to the successful execution of federal programs, and help maintain strong relationships with government customers. This position is ideal for individuals looking to develop their expertise in federal contracting, regulatory compliance, and contract administration while working in a fully remote environment.

  • Manage the entire contract lifecycle from initiation to closure, including negotiation and execution.
  • Review, process, and track customer contracts, purchase orders (POs), and vendor agreements in the company ERP system. Creation of new contract vehicles and managing updates as needed (i.e. – PoP; Contracting Officer information, etc.)
  • Collaborate with sales and purchasing teams to verify contract terms, pricing, and compliance before quoting customers and/or placing orders with vendors.
  • Maintain organized records of contracts, including physical and digital files, and ensuring accuracy and audit readiness. Maintain an organized, centralized repository of contracts, amendments, and related correspondence.
  • Monitor and manage software subscription renewals and hardware maintenance contracts, ensuring timely, accurate, and proactive renewals to avoid service interruptions.

  • Works with Marketing Team to ensure all information is accurate and up to date on public facing Contracts websites. Additionally, conducts audits quarterly on Government and Distributor websites to ensure contracts information is accurate and up to date.
  • Collects federal EULAs from OEMs/Vendors and ensures EULAs are up to date on EULA Master Site.
  • Manages contract vehicle quote language and terms and conditions are up to date and accurate in Salesforce.
  • Responsible for the processing, tracking and management of all CPARs.
  • Coordinating with Sales and Marketing Teams to manage and create contract vehicle collateral, to include CV Tracking Tool and Linecards.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is a remote position.

Product & Services Marketing Director (EMEA)

Mind Partners is an executive search firm with offices in London, Paris and New York. We specialise in retained headhunting for executives, senior management, and experts. We are now partnering with Arkance to appoint their Product and Servies Marketing Directoe for EMEA.
ARKANCE is a global company specialising in providing technology solutions and services for the architecture, engineering, construction (AEC), and manufacturing industries. They focus on enhancing efficiency, quality, and profitability through advanced automation and purpose-built software solutions.
ARKANCE aims to empower businesses to design, build, and solve the challenges of tomorrow.
ARKANCE isa fully owned subsidiary of the French B2B Services Group Monnoyeur. Founded in 1906 the Monnoyeur group operates in the construction, industry, and agriculture sectors. ARKANCE was established in 2018 with a vision to become a leading partner for digitalisation of the construction and manufacturing sectors.

Job Description:

ARKANCE is seeking a dynamic Product & Services Marketing Director to lead and structure our new Product & Services Marketing team across the EMEA region. This role involves building a high-performing team from scratch and ensuring our products and services align with evolving market needs.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Team Leadership:Build and manage a team of Product & Services Marketing Managers and a Community Manager. Define roles, workflows, and career paths within the team.
  • Market Insights:Consolidate market trends and competitive intelligence across EMEA. Lead voice-of-customer initiatives and develop a deep understanding of key industries.
  • Offering & Messaging:Define positioning, value propositions, and messaging. Contribute to structuring and packaging offers.
  • Go-to-Market (GTM):Build and execute multichannel GTM plans in partnership with Services, Sales, and Marketing teams. Support sales enablement with tailored materials.
  • Performance Tracking:Define and monitor key metrics, set up feedback loops, and communicate results internally to influence the roadmap.

Requirements

Requirements:

  • Professional Experience:Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, Marketing, or related field. 8+ years of experience in product launches, product marketing management, or go-to-market strategy.
  • Industry Knowledge:Deep knowledge or strong interest in the AEC, Infrastructure, and Manufacturing industries.
  • Skills:Strong analytical, strategic, and project management skills. Competent in competitive analysis, market research, and enablement skills. Excellent communication and storytelling abilities.
  • Tools:Knowledge of marketing tools (HubSpot, Canva, WordPress), business management tools (NetSuite, Airtable), and collaborative tools (Miro).
  • Languages:Fluent English (verbal and written) is a must. Other European languages are a plus.

Soft Skills:

  • Collaborative leadership, strong interpersonal skills, strategic thinking, customer-centric, and results-oriented.

Benefits

An excellent salary package including basic salary and bonus is on offer

jobs.title: Amazon Connect Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Leidos is seeking an experienced Amazon Connect Developer to design, develop, test, implement, and maintain cloud-based contact center capabilities supporting the Department of Defense (DoD) and Defense Health Agency (DHA).


The successful candidate will develop and enhance Amazon Connect functionality, including multi-level interactive voice response (IVR), intelligent call routing, conversational AI, chatbots, workforce management integrations, call recording, transcription, and contact center analytics.


The Amazon Connect environment will integrate with Salesforce Health Cloud to support healthcare contact center operations, including patient engagement, nurse advice services, care coordination, appointment scheduling, and referral management.


This position will participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC), working closely with developers, system administrators, cloud engineers, cybersecurity personnel, and program stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable contact center solutions.


Primary Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain Amazon Connect contact flows, multi-level IVR applications, inbound and outbound call routing, queues, callbacks, and automated self-service capabilities.
  • Develop conversational AI solutions using Amazon Lex, including voicebots, chatbots, intents, dialog management, and automated customer interactions.
  • Develop serverless application components using AWS Lambda, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, and associated AWS services.
  • Design and maintain integrations between Amazon Connect and Salesforce Health Cloud, including customer identification, screen pops, case creation, contact activity logging, and API-based data exchanges.
  • Develop and maintain integrations supporting workforce management, call recording, transcription, contact analytics, and operational reporting.
  • Implement secure REST APIs, event-driven processing, data transformations, authentication, and error-handling mechanisms.
  • Develop and execute unit tests, integration tests, and automated validation procedures for contact center applications and integrations.
  • Provide Tier 3 technical support, including troubleshooting complex IVR, call routing, chatbot, integration, and application performance issues.
  • Perform root cause analysis and implement corrective actions for recurring software defects and production incidents.
  • Participate in Agile development, code reviews, CI/CD processes, release planning, and production deployments.
  • Maintain technical documentation, contact flow diagrams, integration specifications, and deployment procedures.
  • Ensure application development follows applicable DoD/DHA cybersecurity, privacy, and information protection requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline and 8-12 years of relevant experience, or a master's degree with 6-10 years of relevant experience. Equivalent experience may be considered in accordance with Leidos policies.

All candidates from LATAM are welcome to apply!!!

  • Employment Type: Full-Time Contractor
  • Workplace: Remote
  • Compensation: USD $900 - $1,200 / month
  • Schedule: Monday-Friday schedule, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM CST.

About Us

HireHawk connects skilled professionals around the world with U.S. and Canadian companies that value ownership, reliability, and meaningful remote work. For this opportunity, you will support a pediatric dental practice in Texas that wants every family interaction to feel warm, personal, and well cared for. HireHawk offers a fully remote environment, structured onboarding, clear expectations, and an outcomes-first culture.

About the Role

We are looking for a full-time Dental Scheduling Virtual Assistant who has proven experience scheduling outstanding treatment plans and re-care appointments in a dental practice.

This is not a passive administrative role. Your primary goal is to proactively work the practice's outstanding patient lists, connect with families, and turn follow-up opportunities into booked appointments.

You will have direct access to the practice's cloud-based dental software and internet phone system and will work closely with the practice owner and two front-office coordinators. Success will be visible in the numbers: quality outreach, completed follow-ups, and patients successfully added to the schedule.

Responsibilities

  • Own the daily outreach process for outstanding treatment plans and overdue re-care patients from report to booked appointment.
  • Pull and work outstanding treatment and re-care reports from the practice management system every working day.
  • Complete an initial target of 40-60 quality outbound call attempts per day while maintaining a warm, patient-focused experience.
  • Follow up consistently with patients who do not book on the first attempt instead of allowing opportunities to fall through the cracks.
  • Schedule outstanding treatment and re-care appointments accurately based on practice availability and patient needs.
  • Use the practice's internet-based phone system so outbound calls appear to come directly from the dental office.
  • Maintain a clear daily activity report covering patients contacted, re-care appointments scheduled, and outstanding treatment plans scheduled.
  • Keep outreach lists organized and make it easy for the practice owner to see progress and results.
  • Participate in regular update meetings with the practice owner and two front-office coordinators.
  • Represent the pediatric practice with the same friendly, professional, and family-focused communication patients would receive from the in-office team.

Requirements

Must-Have:

  • Proven dental-office experience scheduling outstanding treatment plans and re-care or recall appointments from practice management reports.
  • A demonstrated track record of turning outbound patient follow-up into booked appointments.
  • Confidence completing 40-60 quality outbound call attempts per day and following patients consistently until there is a clear outcome.
  • Ability to work full-time Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM-5:00 PM Central Time, and start as soon as possible.
  • Comfort learning and working independently in cloud-based dental practice management software and internet phone systems.
  • Reliable home-office setup with backup internet and power, plus willingness to participate in HireHawk's standard activity monitoring dur...

jobs.title: Customer Service Representative (PH)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fully Remote Customer Service Representative (Self-Serve SaaS)(Weekend + Weekday Schedule)

Apply here:

Are you passionate about helping users succeed with innovative software? Join us on the frontlines as a Customer Service Representative during our exciting self-serve launch. You'll be the go-to resource for troubleshooting, guiding users, and enhancing the customer experience all while collaborating closely with a fast-moving internal team.

Role Overview

As a key member of our remote support team, you'll provide world-class assistance to self-serve users, ensuring their onboarding is seamless and their questions are resolved quickly and effectively. You'll work across multiple communication channels and support systems, helping shape our support function at a critical stage of growth.

Note:

This is a 100% remote, full-time role with a schedule that includes Saturdays, Sundays, and 3 weekdays. Candidates must be available to work on weekends.Note: This is a 100% remote, full-time role with a schedule that includes Saturdays, Sundays, and 3 weekdays. Candidates must be available to work on weekends.

What You'll Do

Customer Interaction & Issue Resolution

  • Respond promptly to customer inquiries across Slack, support email, and ticketing systems (e.g., Pylon), while meeting SLA targets
  • Collaborate with AI-powered bots, escalating complex or sensitive issues for human resolution as needed
  • Communicate clearly, empathetically, and professionally with users from diverse backgrounds

Knowledge Sharing & Onboarding

  • Assist new users with onboarding, answering first-time questions and guiding them through setup
  • Identify knowledge gaps and contribute to internal documentation and help articles
  • Coordinate with the core team during initial onboarding phases before transitioning to night shift coverage

What We're Looking For

Must-Have Experience

  • Previous experience in a customer support role at a software company (startup or fast-growth SaaS strongly preferred)
  • Exceptional written communication skills in English
  • Familiarity with tools like Slack, Intercom, Linear, Jira, Pylon, or similar support and automation systems
  • Ability to thrive in a remote setting with minimal oversight, embracing ambiguity and startup-paced work

Tools You'll Use

  • Slack
  • Pylon
  • Jira
  • Linear

jobs.title: Client Success Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Papa is the most comprehensive and strategic in-home care platform, connecting health plan members and employees with highly vetted companions called Papa Pals. Our core companion care model provides personalized, hyper-local support on a national scale, addressing the root social needs that impact a person's health and well-being. Papa Plus builds on this foundation by combining companion care with targeted quality programs to create a single, comprehensive benefit.

Built on human connection and validated through millions of visits and dozens of studies, Papa’s first-of-its-kind care model has been shown to improve member engagement, enhance quality of life, and contribute to more informed use of healthcare services—leading to lower costs and better health. We’re driven by our vision of aging better, together. Learn more at papa.com.

About the Role:

The Client Success Manager owns the day-to-day relationship for an assigned portfolio of health plan clients. As the client's primary point of contact, you'll make sure programs run smoothly, deliverables land on time, and clients feel supported and heard. You'll build trusted relationships with your client contacts, keep a close eye on program health, and partner with internal teams to solve problems quickly.

This role is focused on strong execution and relationship management. You'll support implementations and launches for your accounts, manage reporting and contract deliverables, and resolve day-to-day client issues—escalating more complex or sensitive matters to Client Success leadership. You'll work closely with internal partners to monitor client health and performance.

Successful candidates will be equally comfortable presenting to client stakeholders, digging into performance data, troubleshooting an operational issue, and bringing together teams to drive a solution.

The overarching goal is simple: deliver exceptional client outcomes that drive retention and growth.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own day-to-day relationship management for an assigned portfolio of clients, serving as their primary point of contact and building trusted, long-term relationships.
  • Monitor client satisfaction, program health, and performance, and proactively flag risks, trends, and potential growth opportunities to Client Success leadership.
  • Support client implementations and launches, coordinating operational requirements and keep tasks on track.
  • Lead recurring client meetings, executive business reviews, performance discussions, and other client communications.
  • Track account activity, tasks, and deliverables for your portfolio in project plans and other tools.
  • Ensure data files are set up correctly and coordinate ongoing data file needs in a timely manner within client SLAs/KPIs.
  • Prepare and deliver routine client reporting according to contract requirements and SLAs (including Q/A, delivery, scorecards, etc.).
  • Support business reviews by pulling data, preparing materials, and highlighting key program results.
  • Manage client complaints and requests for additional information, resolving issues directly where possible and escalating complex or sensitive issues appropriately.
  • Manage client invoices and respond to billing inquiries.
  • Ensure timely completion and coordination of client compliance/audit requests.
  • Coordinate and manage care referrals for members, highlighting critical referrals to the client.
  • Partner with internal teams to meet client deliverables, ensure continuity of support after go-live, and drive process improvements.
  • Anticipate client needs and bring forward solutions to overcome obstacles.

jobs.title: Web Developer: Remote & 4.5 Day Week (read fully before applying)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
This is a remote position.

REMOTE - MEXICO

PLEASE DO NOT apply for this job without reading everything below.

Summary:

Do you enjoy programming? Do you love the idea of furiously typing lines of code that will ultimately bring a client’s website to life? Do you speak in CSS and HTML more than your own native language? If so, this may be the job you’ve been looking for!

We are looking for a Wordpress web developer to help us take website designs and program them into a functioning Wordpress website for our clients. We want to provide the latest in UX/UI design and functionality, which means we’ll lean on you to make it happen.

Who We Are:

We are Spotlight Branding - one of a few internet marketing companies NOT focused on SEO. We believe there is much more to the internet than where a business shows up on Google. Our services include website design, social media management, email newsletters, and more, which lets us help lawyers build a strong online brand for their firm. Rather than focusing on creating leads from Google, we are more interested in helping them build a strong brand, stay top of mind with their contacts, and increase their referrals!

Job Description:

We provide internet marketing services specifically for small law and financial firms. We’re like Yoda - we’re the guides leading lawyers through the marketing world. If that reference doesn’t make sense, watchStar Warsbefore your interview with us.

As part of your daily routine, you’ll be tasked with the following:

  • Converting .psd and other documents to fully functioning websites on Wordpress

  • Assisting in the programming maintenance of our current clients’ websites, such as the addition of new page elements, images, spacing, icons, logos, and more

  • Managing the plugin suite on our Wordpress websites, including updates, maintenance, troubleshooting, and new plugin research

  • Helping the rest of the team by using your unique problem solving skills to address other issues


Requirements

Required Attributes:

If you possess the following skills, we want to talk to you TODAY.

  • Passion for user experience and site usability

  • Expert knowledge of responsive web frameworks, such as HTML and CSS

  • Understanding of scripting languages like Javascript and PHP

  • Demonstrated experience with Wordpress programming

  • Enthusiasm with excellent written and verbal communication skills

  • Strong attention to detail

  • Immaculate problem solving skills


Benefits

Pay, Hours, etc:

This position pays a range between $1,200–$1,500 USD per month. Our hours of operation are Monday - Friday, 8AM - 5PM EST.

How to Apply:

If you are interested in applying for this job, apply via this website AND send an email to HR(at)SpotlightBranding.com with a video explaining why you are interested in this job. The subject line should be: “I’m about to make your websites even better!” Also, attach your resume.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Looking for an innovative, high-growth, multi-award-winning company in one of the hottest segments of the security market?  Look no further than Veracode!

Veracode is a global leader in Application Risk Management for the AI era. Powered by trillions of lines of code scans and a proprietary AI-generated remediation engine, the Veracode platform is trusted by organizations worldwide to build and maintain secure software from code creation to cloud deployment.

Learn more at , on the Veracode blog, and on LinkedIn and Twitter.

Veracode is looking for someone who KNOWS Webflow inside out and knows how to make a large B2B website work harder for the business.
Must be equally comfortable building a reusable component, debugging custom JavaScript, improving a page’s visual hierarchy, and using conversion data to decide what to build next. You have the technical depth to solve problems yourself and the experience to own a website’s strategy, operations, and ongoing growth.
At Veracode, you’ll help bring a modern enterprise Webflow website to life and lead its continued evolution as a marketing and sales engine. Working closely with our Creative Director and partners across marketing, you’ll create experiences that express our brand, help buyers understand our value, and turn interest into qualified demand.
This is a hands-on website ownership role. Deep, recent Webflow design and development experience is required. General CMS experience or experience managing website projects alone will not meet the needs of this position. Building, troubleshooting, and improving the site yourself will be a regular part of your work.

What you’ll own

  • Hands-on Webflow development. Build and refine responsive pages, CMS collections, reusable components, templates, and interactions. Maintain clear structure and styling conventions so the site can scale without becoming difficult to manage.
  • Design execution and brand quality. Translate Figma designs into polished Webflow experiences. Bring a strong eye for typography, spacing, layout, imagery, motion, and responsive behavior, working with the Creative Director to extend the brand thoughtfully.
  • Website strategy and priorities. Own the roadmap and daily website function. Turn marketing and sales goals into a practical plan, balance campaign needs with longer-term improvements, and follow work through implementation and measurement.
  • Migration and launch quality. Take ownership of the in-progress WordPress-to-Webflow migration alongside internal teams and agency partners. Validate CMS structure, content migration, redirects, search visibility, tracking, forms, integrations, and launch readiness, then resolve issues after launch.
  • Conversion and buyer journeys. Improve how visitors discover content, understand our products, and take the next step. Develop and test improvements to navigation, landing pages, calls to action, forms, and conversion paths.
  • Analytics and actionable insights. Use GA4, Google Tag Manager, search data, heatmaps, and testing tools to identify opportunities. Explain what the data means, recommend changes, implement them, and measure their effect on qualified conversions and pipeline with marketing operations.

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience. Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

Remote (United States) | Full-Time | Monday–Friday | Flexible Schedule

Position Overview

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced Professional Fee (ProFee) Emergency Department Coding Auditor / QA Specialist to join our remote team.

This position is responsible for conducting comprehensive audits of professional Emergency Department coding, with a strong emphasis on ED Evaluation & Management (E/M) leveling, procedure coding, documentation accuracy, and regulatory compliance.

The ideal candidate will have a proven background in ProFee ED auditing, exceptional attention to detail, and the ability to identify coding discrepancies, provide actionable feedback, and support ongoing quality improvement initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform detailed audits of Professional Fee Emergency Department encounters, ensuring accurate E/M leveling, procedure coding, and appropriate code assignment.

  • Identify coding discrepancies, documentation deficiencies, missed charges, and opportunities for improved accuracy and compliance.

  • Prepare accurate audit reports, summarize findings, and provide recommendations for corrective action.
  • Collaborate with coding teams, leadership, and clients to communicate audit findings and support quality improvement initiatives.
  • Assist with coder and provider education, including clarification of coding guidelines, documentation requirements, and audit findings.
  • Maintain established quality and productivity standards while meeting client deadlines.
  • Stay current with regulatory updates, coding changes, and Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer requirements.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum of 3 years of professional coding auditing experience, specifically involving ProFee Emergency Department services.
  • Active CEMC and/or CPC certification required.
  • Demonstrated expertise in Professional Fee ED E/M leveling and procedure coding — both are required.
  • Strong understanding of Emergency Department documentation, medical necessity, modifier usage, and appropriate code assignment.

jobs.title: GHY eBiz Customs Import Specialist (#2631)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Customs Import Specialist | Evening & Overnight

Know customs. Solve problems. Keep trade moving when it matters most.

At GHY, we don’t just move goods across borders. We help businesses navigate complexity and trade with confidence.

For more than a century, we’ve helped importers and exporters navigate global markets. As one of Canada’s Best Managed Companies and a family-led organization, we’ve built our reputation on expertise, integrity, innovation, and genuinely caring about our clients and one another.

If you have strong customs experience, know the release process inside and out, and enjoy solving the issues that keep trade moving, this could be your next opportunity.

About the Role:

As a Customs Import Specialist, you’ll play a key role in keeping our clients’ shipments moving across the Canada-U.S. border during critical evening and overnight hours.

This isn't an entry-level customs role. You'll use your experience across the pre- and post-release process to prioritize shipments, troubleshoot rejects, assign tariff classifications, manage PGA requirements, process corrections, and work directly with customs authorities, clients, carriers, and vendors.

You’ll have the ability to solve problems as they arise while being part of an experienced team that understands just how important accuracy, urgency, and sound judgment are in customs brokerage.

What You’ll Do:

  • 🌎 Keep cross-border trade moving. Prioritize shipments by ETA and ensure timely submission to both CBP and CBSA.
  • 🔎 Solve the issues others can’t leave until morning. Monitor alerts, investigate and resolve rejects, and address release issues as they arise.
  • 📋 Get the details right. Assign appropriate tariff classifications and PGA data to support accurate customs processing.
  • 🚚 Support the full release process. Complete carrier eManifests and manage pre- and post-release activity, including RMD corrections.
  • 📊 Stay ahead of entries. Monitor entries through CADEX and take action when something requires attention.
  • 📞 Keep everyone connected. Communicate professionally with customs representatives, clients, carriers, vendors, and internal teams to gather information and resolve issues.
  • 📝 Protect the audit trail. Maintain clear eLogs and documentation so actions, decisions, and corrections are accurately supported.
  • 💡 Use your experience. Recognize when something doesn't look right, investigate the issue, and take appropriate action to keep shipments moving while protecting compliance.

Who You Are:

You’re someone who already understands customs brokerage and doesn’t need every situation to come with step-by-step instructions.

You bring:

  • Strong understanding of the customs release process, including pre- and post-release activities
  • Working knowledge of CBP and CBSA requirements
  • Experience with tariff classification and Partner Government Agency requirements
    Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Exceptional attention to detail
  • The ability to prioritize time-sensitive shipments and competing deadlines
  • Confidence communicating with clients, customs authorities, carriers, vendors, and teammates
  • The ability to work independently while knowing when an issue needs to be escalated
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Word, and Excel

You know how quickly priorities can change when shipments are approaching the border, and you can stay organized, make sound decisions, and communicate clearly when something needs attention.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Approximately 5 years of customs brokerage or related industry experience
  • Certified Customs Specialist (CCS) designation
  • High school diploma or equivalent
  • U.S. Customs Broker License is an asset
  • Ex...

What We're Looking For

Who We Are

Clean Air Task Force (CATF) is a global nonprofit organization working to safeguard against the worst impacts of climate change by catalyzing the rapid development and deployment of low-carbon energy and other climate-protecting technologies. With 30 years of internationally recognized expertise on climate policy and a fierce commitment to exploring all potential solutions, CATF is a pragmatic, non-ideological advocacy group with the bold ideas needed to address climate change. CATF has offices in Boston, Washington, D.C., and Brussels with staff working virtually around the world.

What You’ll Do

The Contracts and Legal Operations Manager will support CATF’s General Counsel and work directly with program and operations teams on contracts, grants, compliance, and day-to-day legal operations. The role combines hands-on contract administration with responsibility for helping staff navigate legal intake and compliance processes, maintaining accurate records, and improving the systems that support this work. You will handle routine matters independently, use sound judgment to identify issues, and escalate more complex legal questions to the General Counsel. Overall, this role helps CATF manage contracts and compliance work consistently and efficiently across the organization.

  • Systems & Process Improvement – Improve workflows and operational efficiency, support system implementations and updates, and help manage contract and document management systems, including reporting and tracking.
  • Policy, Template & Records Management – Support updates to contract templates, organizational policies, procedures, and guidelines; maintain organized legal files; and manage the internal trademark tracker, including application statuses, renewal deadlines, and office actions.
  • Research & Legal Operations Support – Conduct legal, industry, and historical research; monitor relevant legal cases and developments; and provide additional administrative support to the General Counsel as needed.

Job Summary


The Sr. Product Manager, Strategic Growth for Clinical & Procedural Workflows is responsible for understanding clinical user experience and workflows across all healthcare environments of care, including operating room (OR) and procedural spaces. The role assesses clinical needs, workflow variation, market dynamics, customer priorities, and emerging innovations to define clinical and procedural workflow strategies, identify portfolio expansion opportunities, and translate validated customer and clinical-user problems and desired outcomes into product concepts and requirements. jobs.title: Senior BI- en Dataconsultant Assetplanning (In dienst of freelance)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

De dienst Assetplanning binnen de netbeheerorganisatie beheert het budgetteringsproces voor assets in vijf disciplines (E/G/OV/Rio/Warmte) en houdt daarbij rekening met de geldende assetmanagementrichtlijnen.

Als Senior Data Consultant Assetplanning werk je mee aan de opmaak en opvolging van de budgetten. Je ondersteunt de verdere digitalisering van het budgetproces en de integratie van het huidige Excel-budgetbestand in een centrale databron.

  • Je verzamelt en analyseert gegevens uit verschillende applicaties en van interne en externe stakeholders om een correct beeld te krijgen van de situatie en de context.
  • Je ondersteunt de uitwerking van het budget en het meerjareninvesteringsplan, zowel op technisch als op financieel vlak, en biedt zo kwalitatieve ondersteuning aan de interne organisatie.
  • Je volgt interne en externe stakeholders op en adviseert hen bij de uitvoering van de langetermijnplanning en budgetten.

Specifieke verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je werkt nauw samen met interne en externe stakeholders bij de opmaak van de budgetten.
  • Je zoekt actief naar optimalisaties en best practices om het beheer, de ontsluiting en de verwerking van informatie voortdurend te verbeteren.
  • Je zet op korte termijn een basisstructuur op in Databricks volgens de standaarden van de organisatie en vertaalt de huidige Excel-oplossing naar een centrale database.
  • Je houdt budgetwijzigingen historisch bij, onder meer via SCD Type 2, met voldoende traceerbaarheid van aanpassingen, beslissingen, aannames en scenario’s.
  • Je adviseert en ondersteunt de dienst Assetplanning bij besluitvorming en bij gecontroleerde gegevensinvoer via interfaces en bulkuploads.
  • Je ondersteunt opleidingen en communicatie over de informatie en processen.
  • Je treedt op als onafhankelijke facilitator en coördinator en bewaakt de samenhang van informatie en processen binnen en buiten de netbeheerorganisatie.
  • In een latere fase kan je meewerken aan de ontwikkeling van een interface boven op Databricks.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt ruime praktische ervaring als BI Consultant en met Databricks, Python en Power BI. Je kunt zelfstandig een technische BI-oplossing opzetten.
  • Je hebt ervaring met data management en ETL, databeheer, datamodellering en historisering.
  • Je kent audit trails en data governance en hebt ervaring met reporting tools.
  • Je kunt requirements analyseren en technische assets vertalen naar bruikbare informatie- en dataprocessen.
  • Je bent sterk in dataverwerking en -analyse met Databricks, Python en Power BI.
  • Je bent analytisch ingesteld, werkt graag samen en bent resultaatgericht.
  • Je kunt conceptueel denken en informatieanalyses en datapreparatie uitvoeren.
  • Je werkt vanuit een helikopterperspectief zonder het operationele pragmatisme uit het oog te verliezen.
  • Je bent verantwoordelijk en flexibel en neemt initiatief.
  • Je beschikt over goede communicatieve vaardigheden.
  • Je kunt tijdens een interview overtuigen met je analytisch en conceptueel denkvermogen.

💼 Aanbod

Je zal deel uitmaken van een groeiende KMO met ruimte voor initiatief en persoonlijke ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen ervoor dat je in een uitdagende maar aangename werkomgeving terecht komt met leuke collega's. Samen met jou stippelen we een carriereplan uit, met aandacht en budget voor bijkomende opleidingingen / certificaties. Je kan rekenen op een motiverend salaris, aangevuld met extralegale voordelen, inclusief bedrijfswagen (of alternatieve vergoeding).

(Freelance is ook mogelijk)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role type: Contractor

Location: United States

Commitment: Part-time, project-based

Duration: 6 weeks

Compensation: $30–$60 USD/hour

About the opportunity

micro1 is looking for Data Privacy Specialists to support a customer project focused on evaluating how personal information is handled and protected in digital systems.

You'll apply your expertise to identify privacy risks, assess potential data disclosures, and evaluate compliance with data-protection principles.

What you'll do

  1. Review scenarios involving personal and sensitive information.
  2. Identify potential privacy risks, inappropriate disclosures, and data-handling issues.
  3. Evaluate whether information is handled according to established privacy principles.
  4. Assess complex privacy scenarios and provide clear, evidence-based judgments.
  5. Document findings and recommend improvements to privacy practices.

What we're looking for

Required qualifications

  1. Professional experience in data privacy, data protection, or information governance.
  2. Strong understanding of privacy principles, sensitive data handling, and disclosure risks.
  3. Ability to assess privacy concerns and identify potential violations.

jobs.title: Account Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: About Us: AI needs a new infrastructure layer. We're building it at Modal. Every era of computing brought new workloads that previous infrastructure couldn't support: mainframes, databases, and the cloud. Each time, the company that rebuilt the layer underneath defined the decade. AI is no different, except it touches everything instead of one slice, and the window to build the layer underneath it is open right now. Our customers include category-defining companies like Ramp , Cognition, DoorDash, and Suno. They rely on Modal for instant GPU access, sub-second container starts, and native storage, so it's simple to serve low-latency inference, fine-tune models, and access production-ready sandboxes at scale. We've passed $1B in annualized run rate, up 15x from a year ago. In October 2026 we raised a $750M Series D led by Accel at a $15.75B valuation. Our team includes creators of popular open-source projects (e.g., Seaborn , Luigi ), academic researchers, international olympiad medalists, and experienced engineering and product leaders with decades of experience. About the Role: We're hiring the first Account Managers at Modal. You'll report to the Regional Director of Account Management and be a founding member of the team. This function does not exist yet. There is no playbook, no territory map, no established motion. You'll own a book of business from day one and build the motion at the same time — from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprise teams running critical infrastructure on Modal. This is a commercial role with a revenue target. You'll be measured on retention and expansion across your accounts. While you won't be delivering the technical recommendations and implementation, the work is technical by nature. Our customers are engineers running GPU workloads, inference, and batch jobs in production, and you need to hold your own in those conversations. The profile we're hiring is a technical account manager. You've worked at companies that are deeply technical and consumption in nature. You bring the commercial instincts to grow revenue from an existing base and enough technical depth to know which conversation actually matters. And you can credibly work with a CxO all the way down to a Developer. What the Role Is: A founding seat. You're helping build the AM function with us, not joining one that already runs. The account plans, expansion motions, and customer cadence you and the rest of the founding team figure out are what we scale to every AM we hire after you. A technical customer-facing role. You'll work directly with Developers and ML teams on what they're building and how Modal fits. You translate and triage the deeper technical work to FDEs and Product when it's needed. A book of business. You’ll own a set of accounts and be responsible for the revenue that comes from them. Expect to be meeting with customers in your first few days because the best playbooks are built from real experiences. What the Role Is Not: A traditional post-sales role. You're measured on revenue, not health scores. An on-call support function. You're not fixing bugs or triaging tickets. You're driving growth. A technical delivery role. You're not implementing for the customer. You know where the technical work goes and you pull in the right people. An inherited motion. Nothing is handed to you. If you identify gaps in process, tooling, or a playbook — you help build it. A single-lane job. Our priorities go customer → company → team → me. We focus on delivering maximum impact vs. "this is my job". What You'll Achieve: Build Modal's account management function and iterate on it as we scale the business Own and deliver on a revenue target across your book of accounts Grow an account's first use case, expand into a second, and drive standardization across the Modal platform Get fluent enough in Modal to hold your own with engineering teams on their workloads, and know when to pull in FDEs, Support, or Product Work with Sales, Soluti...

jobs.title: Werkstudent Customer Success & Sales (all gender)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über leakshield

leakshield ist ein junges Legal-Tech-Start-up. Wir schützen die Inhalte einiger der größten Creator und wichtigsten Medienhäuser im deutschsprachigen Raum, darunter Papaplatte, Tomatolix und Marvin Wildhage sowie RTL, DER SPIEGEL und ProSiebenSat.1. Dafür finden wir urheberrechtsverletzende Kopien und lassen sie entfernen, ob bei Suchmaschinen, auf Social-Media-Plattformen oder bei Hostern.

Wir suchen eine Person (m/w/d), die unsere Creator-Kunden im Chat betreut, Trial-Nutzer zu zahlenden Kunden macht und inaktive Kunden zurückholt. Du bist die erste Ansprechperson für mehrere hundert Kunden und arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung.

Was du machst

  • Kundenanfragen (WhatsApp, Telegram, E-Mail) beantworten – schnell, klar, zweisprachig

  • Trial-Nutzer und Inbound-Leads aktiv ansprechen und in Bezahlpläne überführen

  • Inaktive und ehemalige Kunden systematisch reaktivieren

  • Kündigungsabsichten erkennen und abfangen, Upsells auf höhere Pläne anbieten

  • Kundenstatus im CRM pflegen (Trial, aktiv, Risiko, inaktiv, reaktiviert)

  • Unterstützung in Enterprise-Anfragen, Preisverhandlungen und rechtliche Themen an die Geschäftsführung übergeben

Was du mitbringst

  • Eingeschriebene:r Student:in (Werkstudentenstatus, bis 20 Std./Woche in der Vorlesungszeit)

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch und gutes Englisch in Wort und Schrift – ein großer Teil der Kunden schreibt auf Englisch

  • Erfahrung mit Messaging-Tools (wie Superchat)

  • Verständnis, wie ein CRM funktioniert und warum saubere Daten Umsatz bringen

  • Gutes Gespür bei der Kundenkommunikation, auch bei schwierigen Kundensituationen

  • Erste Erfahrung in Vertrieb oder Kundenbetreuung ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung

  • Social Media und die Creator-Szene interessieren dich (Pluspunkt)

Das wird von dir erwartet

  • Immatrikulation als Student:in an einer staatlich anerkannten Hochschule

  • Verfügbarkeit von 20 Stunden pro Woche

  • Sicherer Umgang mit gängigen Kommunikationskanälen

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse

Rahmen

  • Start: spätestens Januar 2027

  • Werkstudentenvertrag, 20 Std./Woche, marktübliche Grundvergütung

  • Zusätzlich 5 % Provision auf alle monatlich wiederkehrenden Umsätze, die du reaktivierst, konvertierst oder upsellst – laufend, solange der Kunde zahlt.

  • Berlin (nähe S Schönhauser Allee) vor Ort in der Einarbeitung (ca. 3 Monate), danach hybrid oder remote möglich

Deine Bewerbung

Wenn du den Grossteil dieser Anforderungen erfüllst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung. Die Position ist auf 12 Monate befristet und sieht eine Probezeit von 3 Monaten vor. Eine Verlängerung schließen wir nicht aus.

Wir haben keinerlei Interesse an Headhunter-Agenturen und werden solche Anfragen nicht beantworten.

jobs.title: Senior Legal Counsel, Product
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.

Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:

  • Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

  • Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

  • Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register.

We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

Job Description

🎯 You will be a trusted legal partner to our Product and R&D leadership and teams, as our privacy and product counsel. As such you will specifically be supporting our Product and R&D teams, developing further our readiness for AI regulation and advising on wider digital regulatory requirements, to allow n8n to keep building and be early. You will also help shape a modern, AI-first legal strategy as part of a growing Legal team, and bring your product insight to the technology and commercial deals where it makes the difference. You will report to the General Counsel.

What success looks like after 6 months: you are the go-to legal partner in Product and R&D roadmap, you design and launch reviews, our AI regulation readiness plan is in place with clear owners, and templates and playbooks are updated so the wider Legal team can run standard deals without R&D and Product related escalation.

Responsibilities:

Partner with Product and R&D (c. 80% of the role)

  • Partner with the existing Legal team to build out our current approach to AI regulation: EU AI Act readiness and risk classification, AI risk assessments, model and provider due diligence, AI use policies, and customer-facing AI transparency commitments.

  • Partner with others in the Legal team on our response to the wider digital regulatory landscape for software (for example the EU Data Act, and other digital regulation), from horizon scanning through to product readiness and compliance roadmaps.

  • Be the embedded Product and Engineering partner, joining roadmap, design and launch reviews, advising on platform and product terms from the design stage, and turning legal requirements into clear product requirements engineers can build against.

jobs.title: Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Als IT-Dienstleister treiben wir die Digitalisierung des öffentlichen Sektors voran und schaffen echten Mehrwert für Millionen Menschen in Deutschland. Wir können vieles richtig gut, aber eben noch nicht alles. Darum suchen wir immer wieder neue Kolleg:innen, die mit ihren Ideen, ihrem Können und Engagement etwas bewegen wollen. Fühlst du dich angesprochen? Dann gestalte Deine Welt zum Besseren und werde Teil unseres Customer Clusters Justice.

DEINE MISSION

Als Kubernetes Administrator/Private Cloud Engineer (m/w/d) stellst du sicher, dass unsere Container-Infrastruktur reibungslos läuft und zukunftsfähig bleibt. Deine Mission ist es, eine hochverfügbare, skalierbare und sichere Plattform zu schaffen, auf der unsere Anwendungen zuverlässig betrieben und weiterentwickelt werden können. Gemeinsam mit deinem Team treibst du die Automatisierung und Optimierung unserer Cloud-Umgebung voran.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Beratung, Konzeption und Implementierung von Private Cloud Plattformen

  • Zusammenarbeit mit weiteren Fachteams zur Bereitstellung der nötigen Infrastruktur

  • Messung, Analyse und Optimierung der Performance und Stabilität

  • Aufbau und Betrieb verteilter Systeme unter Anwendung des DevOps-Ansatzes

  • Förderung von Continuous Integration & Deployment-Prozessen für eine effiziente und schnelle Bereitstellung der Lösungen

  • Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen

DAS IST UNS WICHTIG

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre relevante Berufserfahrung im Cloud-/Plattformbetrieb

  • Erfahrung in der agilen Entwicklung und im Betrieb von verteilten Systemen

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Kubernetes und Ansible sind unerlässlich

  • Erfahrung in der Fehleranalyse und -behebung in Container-Umgebungen

  • Erfahrung in Konfiguration und Betrieb sowie in der Entstörung von Proxies

  • Ein tiefes Verständnis für DevOps-Praktiken ist von Vorteil

  • Erfahrungen mit CI/CD-Pipelines OpenShift und mit JavaEE sind ein Plus

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (C1-Niveau) sowie Englischkenntnisse auf Konversationsniveau

DEIN NEUER ARBEITSPLATZ

  • Was bei uns zählt? Klar definierte Rollen, echtes Miteinander und ein gemeinsames Ziel. Wir nennen das Responsiveness – transparent, wertschätzend und zielorientiert.

  • Hier bist du am Wandel direkt beteiligt, wenn du möchtest. – Nimm Teil an Projekten, die uns als Unternehmen weiterentwickeln.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und Remote Work? – Sind selbstverständlich.

  • Individuelles Hardware-Budget? – Stell dir deinen Arbeitsplatz so zusammen, wie du dich am wohlsten fühlst.

  • Mental Health? – Dein mentales Wohlbefinden ist uns wichtig. Mit OpenUp unterstützen wir dich und bieten dir jederzeit kostenlosen Zugang zu professioneller psychologischer Unterstützung.

  • Individuelles Weiterbildungsbudget? – Egal ob die nächste Zertifizierung oder ein lang ersehnter Sprachkurs – du entscheidest, worin und wann du dich weiterbildest.

  • Mitarbeiter:innen-PC-Programm? – Lease dir dein nächstes Device zur rein privaten Nutzung einfach über virtual7.

  • JobRad oder Firmenwagen? – Wir helfen dir dabei, so mobil zu sein, wie du es brauchst

Als Senior DevSecOps Engineer (m/w/d) verbindest Automatisierung mit Sicherheit und bringst Cloud-Anwendungen zuverlässig in den Betrieb. jobs.title: Senior Tech Operations Specialist (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Distribusion is the world’s leading ground transportation marketplace and gives travellers seamless access to ground transportation online, from search to ticket purchase. We have built a cutting-edge B2B technology platform that connects bus, rail and ferry operators in 70+ countries with the biggest online retailers including Google Maps and Booking.com.
We are shaping the future of travel and building the largest global network of transport providers and retailers. We are one of the fastest-growing startups in travel, backed by two leading VCs (TQ Ventures & Lightrock), and now, following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Technical Operations Specialist who will join our Control Room team. You will play a vital role in managing ongoing escalations and investigations, ensuring seamless communication with our partners and management during issue resolution, conceptualising new operational flows and guaranteeing the seamless operation of all company products.

What you will do:

  • Operational Ownership: Take full ownership of high-level monitoring for the company’s operations, ensuring smooth and efficient processes across the business.

  • Incident Management & Resolution: Lead the management of escalations and incidents, driving swift resolutions and minimizing impact on business operations.

  • Problem-Solving & Innovation: Conduct in-depth technical investigations and collaborate in designing solutions that address complex challenges and improve system performance.

  • Data-Driven Insights: Leverage data analysis to validate hypotheses, uncover insights, and identify optimisation opportunities that drive operational excellence and incident prevention.

  • Strategic Project Leadership: Play a pivotal role in supporting and leading strategic and operational projects that shape the direction and efficiency of the business.

  • Continuous Improvement: Proactively identify and implement key improvements in our product and tech systems from an operational perspective, making a tangible impact on performance.

  • Tool & Process Development: Work closely with the operations team to build, implement, and refine tools and processes that drive efficiency and streamline workflows, leveraging AI to help us scale as we grow.

  • Effective Communication: Manage internal and external communication effectively, collaborating across teams to ensure seamless issue resolution and clear, transparent updates.


Workplace: Berlin, hybrid or Germany, remote


Who you are:

  • You bring at least 3+ years of experience in similar roles in 2nd and 3rd level Technical support, IT Analyst, Monitoring roles etc. 

  • You are able to successfully detect root cause of incidents reported and provide analysis of the solution design on a high level

  • You bring a product-oriented mindset: You do not focus on the immediate solution only, but you are bringing long-term risk prevention and mitigation strategies

  • You feel comfortable with investigating into complex SQL queries and relational databases

  • You can develop strategies to predict, prevent, and address potential technical and operational bottlenecks and inefficiencies

  • As a big plus, you have already worked with Jira and Prometheus, Grafana, New Relic or other monitoring tools

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sie verstehen AI nicht nur technisch, sondern können daraus überzeugende Lösungen für Kunden entwickeln, komplexe Themen auf C-Level erklären und neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mitgestalten? Dann bauen Sie bei einem internationalen Daten-, KI- und Beratungsunternehmen die deutsche AI Practice mit auf, kommerziell, strategisch und fachlich.

 

DIE ROLLE IN KÜRZE

• Mehr als die Hälfte Ihrer Zeit: AI-Presales und Business Development, also strategische Kundengespräche, Solution Shaping, Workshops, Pitches und RFPs

• Rund ein Fünftel: Führung eines Teams aus fünf bis sechs erfahrenen AI-Spezialist:innen, überwiegend promoviert

• Brücke zwischen dem deutschen Markt und der globalen AI-Organisation; Sie berichten direkt an den Head of Practices

• Sichtbarkeit nach außen: Sie positionieren das Unternehmen als anerkannten AI-Experten im deutschen Markt

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Ein bis zwei Tage pro Woche in einem der Büros des Unternehmens (München, Frankfurt, Hannover oder Wolfsburg) sind wünschenswert; Kundenbesuche erfolgen bei Bedarf

 

UNSER KUNDE

Ein international aufgestelltes Technologie- und Beratungsunternehmen mit über 25 Jahren Erfahrung in Data Management, KI und digitaler Transformation und mehr als 2.000 Expert:innen in Europa, Asien und Amerika. Es arbeitet mit großen Unternehmen aus Automobil, Fertigung, Pharma, Gesundheitswesen, Einzelhandel und Finanzdienstleistungen, entwickelt eigene AI-Lösungen und Accelerators (u. a. agentische KI für Back-Office-Prozesse, AI-gestützte Auditautomatisierung, Logistikoptimierung sowie Governed AI für regulierte Branchen) und investiert derzeit massiv in GenAI, LLMs und intelligente Automatisierung.

 

WAS SIE ERWARTET

 

Presales und Business Development

• Eigenständige Leitung von AI-Presales: Sie analysieren Kundenherausforderungen und übersetzen Business-Anforderungen in AI-Strategien und Lösungskonzepte

• Gemeinsam mit Expert:innen und der globalen AI Practice gestalten Sie Lösungen und präsentieren sie überzeugend vor Senior- und C-Level-Entscheidern

• Sie unterstützen Sales- und Account-Teams bei Pitches, Proposals, RFPs und der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftschancen

• Sie tragen zur Vermarktung und Weiterentwicklung der eigenen AI-Lösungen und Accelerators bei

 

AI Leadership in Deutschland

• Führung, Mentoring und Weiterentwicklung des lokalen AI-Expertenteams

• Aufbau von Kompetenzen und Delivery-Standards für eine wachsende deutsche AI Practice

 

Brücke zur globalen Organisation

• Sie bringen Marktwissen, Kundenbedarfe und AI-Trends aus Deutschland in die globale AI-Organisation und globale Standards und Methoden in den deutschen Markt

 

Thought Leadership

• Sie vertreten das Unternehmen bei Konferenzen, Fachveranstaltungen und Kundenworkshops und sind intern Ansprechperson für AI-Themen

 

VON VORTEIL

• Etabliertes Netzwerk im deutschen AI-Markt

• Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Transformation einer AI Practice

• Vortragserfahrung oder Veröffentlichungen zu AI-Themen

• Erfahrung mit AI in regulierten oder stark datenintensiven Branchen

 

WAS WIR BIETEN

• Erhebliche Autonomie und Gestaltungsspielraum beim Aufbau der deutschen AI Practice

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der globalen AI-Leitung und mit hochqualifizierten Expert:innen weltweit

• Arbeit mit eigenen AI-Lösungen ebenso wie mit individuellen AI- und Datenlösungen für führende Unternehmen

• Ein flexibles, hybrides Arbeitsmodell mit Kundenbesuchen bei Bedarf

• Die Chance, Delivery und Geschäftsentwicklung der Practice gleichermaßen zu prägen

jobs.title: Finance & Controlling Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
📊 Wie profitabel ist ein Event wirklich, und wohin entwickeln sich unsere Zahlen in den nächsten Monaten? Bei Dreamlight Labs findest du es heraus. Wir suchen eine zahlenstarke Persönlichkeit, die unsere Finanzen und das Controlling übernimmt und zur Expert:in für alles wird, was bei uns mit Geld zu tun hat.

Du willst in einem wachsenden Start-up Verantwortung für die Zahlen übernehmen und neue Strukturen aufbauen? Wir freuen uns auf dich! 🎉

Deine Aufgaben als Finance & Controlling Manager:in

Du übernimmst eigenverantwortlich unser Controlling und unsere Finanzen. Du tauschst dich eng mit der Geschäftsführung aus und bringst Struktur in einen businesskritischen Bereich.

  • Monatliches Controlling und Forecast: Zahlen auswerten, Abweichungen erkennen und Forecasts laufend aktualisieren

  • Kostenüberblick: u.a. Event-, Personal- und Marketingkosten steuern, inklusive Marketingabgrenzung und Kosten- und Leistungsrechnung

  • Eventkalkulation: verstehen und weiterentwickeln

  • Finanzbuchhaltung: Basics sicher abdecken, dazu Intercompany und Quellensteuern

  • Struktur schaffen: Tabellen und internes Finanz-Tool verstehen, eigene Prozesse aufbauen

  • Reporting: Zahlen für die Geschäftsführung aufbereiten und Handlungsbedarf erkennen

Das bringst du mit

  • 2–3 Jahre Vollzeiterfahrung in Finance, Controlling, Buchhaltung oder Steuerberatung

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kennzahlen, Forecasts sowie Kenntnisse in der Finanzbuchhaltung

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe: Du findest dich in bestehende Systeme rasch ein

  • Du denkst weiter und siehst, wohin die Zahlen uns führen können

  • Start-up-Mentalität: Du hast schon in kleineren Unternehmen gearbeitet, packst pragmatisch an und behältst auch mit wenig Struktur den Überblick

  • Nice to have: KI-Affinität, Erfahrung in der Eventbranche oder internationalen Steuerrecht

Das bieten wir dir

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung: Du übernimmst den Bereich Finanzen und Controlling

  • Direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung und echter Einfluss auf unsere Entscheidungen

  • Attraktive Vergütung und flexible Arbeitszeiten

  • Zeit, dich einzuarbeiten, und Raum, Prozesse nach deinen Ideen aufzubauen

  • Engagiertes Startup-Umfeld mit viel Raum zur Mitgestaltung

Magische Erlebnisse bei Dreamlight Experiences

Dreamlight Labs entwickelt und produziert immersive Live-Erlebnisse, die Schauspiel, Musik und Inszenierung verbinden. Mit über 250.000 Gästen, mehr als 550 ausverkauften Events und Stationen in über 150 Städten in Europa gestalten wir Abende, die Menschen aus dem Alltag holen und in die Welten ihrer liebsten Geschichten entführen.

Wenn du gern Verantwortung für Zahlen übernimmst und aus wenig Struktur ein sauberes System machst, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 💫

jobs.title: Growth Lead (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About viral.app

viral.app is the software brands and agencies use to run UGC marketing at scale. It helps to hire creators, track every video on TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, Facebook and Snapchat, and pay creators based on performance.

So far the founders have run marketing alongside everything else: SEO and content, free tools, our newsletter The FYP Leak, Google Ads, and posts on LinkedIn and X. Tracking and a lot of the scrappy growth work already run on AI automations we built ourselves. We're hiring a Growth Lead for the channels and content that don't automate well and need skill and taste.

This is a hands-on role. You set the plan and do most of the work together with the founders.

Your tasks

  • Own growth end to end: the plan, the budget and the execution.

  • Build a niche audience around creator marketing on LinkedIn and X under your own name. If you already have one, bring it. If you don't, you're motivated to build it from zero.

  • Create the content formats that are hard to automate, for example short-form video, customer stories, founder-led posts and deep dives on what makes UGC perform.

  • Test and run any channel that could bring us customers, for example LinkedIn, X, YouTube, cold email, Google Ads, Meta ads, organic content, AEO (getting cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews), Reddit, affiliate marketing and B2B creators. Spend most of your time on the channels where quality beats volume.

  • For paid channels, run the ad accounts yourself: targeting, copy, creative briefs and budget.

  • Run experiments every week. Measure them against signups, trials and revenue, and keep what works.

  • Work with the founders and engineering on positioning, launches, onboarding and pricing pages.

  • Bring in freelancers or agencies where they're faster, and help build a growth team as we grow.

What success looks like after 90 days

  • You've launched at least two content formats we couldn't have automated, and our audience shares them.

  • You've found at least one organic and one paid channel that bring in signups week after week.

  • You post on LinkedIn and X every week, and your audience in creator marketing is growing.

  • Experiments ship every week, and each one ends with a written result.

  • We have a growth plan for the next six months that you wrote and own.

Your profile

  • About 3 years in B2B SaaS growth or marketing, with results you can show in numbers: signups, pipeline or ARR. Fewer years are fine if your results stand out.

  • You've grown a B2B SaaS product through organic channels such as SEO, content, community or product-led loops, and you did much of that work yourself.

  • You've run paid acquisition for B2B SaaS from inside the ad accounts. You know what CAC and payback should look like for a self-serve plan compared with a sales-assisted deal.

  • You've owned several channels at once, from first idea to live campaign to reporting.

  • You move fast. You'd rather ship five small tests this week than one perfect campaign next quarter.

  • You're scrappy. You write the landing page, build the campaign and pull the numbers yourself, and you know where AI saves time and where it hurts quality.

  • You have taste. You can tell a post, video or landing page that will land from one that won't, and you can make the good one yourself.

  • Fluent English. German is a plus.

Nice to have

  • An existing audience of marketers, founders or creators on LinkedIn or X

  • Experience with creator, UGC or influencer marketing, or with selling to performance marketers and agencies

  • Early-stage startup experience, ideally as the first marketi...

jobs.title: Director of Field Operations (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We see the potential inside everything and everyone. Starting with you.

Orbem uses AI to industrialize MRI, delivering non-invasive insight into everything from fruits to eggs to the human body. We are transforming what is becoming the world's largest biological dataset into actionable intelligence to reduce waste, increase quality, and accelerate the shift toward a more sustainable and healthier future.

Headquartered and founded in Munich, Germany, with an office now in Houston, Texas, our world-class team is scaling inside-out technology to transform how humanity sees and understands biological matter.

Help us see what's possible. Join us.

Your Role


You will own how Orbem shows up at customer sites — installing, servicing, and maintaining multi-million-euro imaging systems that sit at the heart of our customers’ production lines. When our systems run, our customers run. When they don’t, the cost is measured in lost production days. Field Operations is where our technology meets reality, and you own that interface.

Field Operations spans Europe and the US, with regional teams on both sides of the Atlantic. A lot has already been built: dedicated Field Engineers and Project Managers, regional leadership, and real investment in SOPs, planning, and tooling. The next step is maturity — turning what exists into an operation that runs consistently across every site, every partner, and every geography, and that scales without depending on individual heroics.

You inherit that and the mandate to shape what comes next. We are expanding fast into new verticals and geographies, and installation and service quality is one of the few things that can either unlock or throttle that growth. This is a role for someone equally at home setting the operating model and being close to the work itself — credible with a customer's engineers and with our executive team on the same day — and who is unwilling to let the same problem happen twice.


Your Day to Day

Running Operations (≈ 40%)

  • Own end-to-end delivery of installations, on-site service, and scheduled maintenance across Europe and the US — on time, on budget, and at a quality level appropriate to assets worth more than €1M each.

  • Empower and enable Regional Leaders and Project Managers to flawlessly orchestrate complex site deliveries involving customers, MRI suppliers, and automation partners.

  • Be the escalation point that actually resolves things — including on site, out of hours, when a go-live is at risk.

  • Own the operational KPIs and the commitments we make to customers, and keep Technical Customer Support, Business Development, and the executive team informed.

 

Building the Operating System (≈ 35%)

  • Raise SOP maturity — across our own team, our partners, and our customers’ contractors.

  • Implement a continuous improvement engine together with the Operational Excellence team.

  • Leverage and drive the tooling and data we need to run this at scale — field service management, installation and service documentation, spare parts and capacity planning — and make sure people actually use it.

We're the agentic operating system for the enterprise. We enable business teams to build, scale, and manage the most capable AI employees on the market.

We raised $3M from YC and angels like Aravind (CEO Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). We have thousands of agents running at 2,000+ person scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. We have PMF and are doubling revenue every month. We have far more demand than we can handle.
