jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ralph baut das Operating System für Wohnimmobilien. Der Markt ist riesig, und er läuft noch größtenteils auf Aktenordnern, Outlook und USB-Sticks. Wir sind der erste AI Property Manager, der auf einem eigenen Operating System läuft, und betreiben Gebäude damit End-to-End. Ralph OS automatisiert Zahlungen, Buchhaltung, Compliance und Kommunikation. AI-Agenten bereiten die Arbeit vor, und unser Team gibt sie frei. Die Hausverwaltung ist unser Einstieg. Das Ziel ist die neue Infrastruktur für die ganze Kategorie, mit Fintech, Versicherung und Finanzierung auf derselben Plattform. Heute verwalten wir über 10.000 Wohneinheiten und wachsen schnell, organisch und durch Zukäufe. Verantwortung bekommst du bei uns früh, und was du baust, nutzen wir direkt im Alltag.

Deine Rolle

Unser Ziel ist es, die größte deutsche Hausverwaltung durch Buy & Build aufzubauen. Du baust dafür den M&A Funnel auf, der dieses Wachstum trägt. Nach 6 Monaten kennen wir alle relevanten Hausverwaltungen und die ersten sind gekauft. Nach 12 Monaten wurden alle relevanten Verwaltungen mehrfach von uns kontaktiert, und wir stehen mit allen in engem Austausch, die sich einen Verkauf vorstellen können.

 

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du baust einen Datensatz mit allen relevanten Hausverwaltungen auf

  • Du entwickelst einen personalisierten Multi-Channel Outreach per E-Mail und Telefon und nutzt dafür moderne Tech Tools wie Clay, Smartlead und HubSpot

  • Du qualifizierst Verwaltungen und führst vielversprechende Gespräche zum Verkauf

  • Du unterstützt bei der Due Diligence und der Angebotserstellung

  • Du pflegst unser CRM konsistent und aktuell

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit dem Chief Commercial Officer, den Gründern und dem Tech Team und Input zur Verbesserung unserer Prozesse und Software

 

Das bringst du mit

  • Berufserfahrung: 1 bis 2 Jahre in einer anspruchsvollen Position oder mindestens 2 Jahre im Vertrieb

  • Vertriebserfahrung oder Erfahrung in kleinteiligen M&A-Prozessen

  • Keine Scheu vor Cold Outreach

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und eine strukturierte Denkweise

  • Bonus: Erfahrung mit Buy & Build oder Roll-ups

  • Bonus: Hintergrund in Beratung (bevorzugt MBB) oder Investment Banking

  • Bonus: Immobilienerfahrung

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, hohe Verbindlichkeit und Eigenverantwortung

  • Starkes Kommunikationsvermögen & Offenheit für neue Herausforderungen und digitale Tools

  • Deutsch: C2 (Muttersprache)

 

Das bieten wir

  • Modernes Setup: MacBook, iPhone und moderne Tools von Tag eins

  • Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten ohne Mikromanagement

  • Hybrides Arbeiten mit klar geregelten Bürotagen

  • Urban Sports Club Zuschuss

  • Regelmäßige Team-Events, Team-Lunches und Getränke im Büro

jobs.descriptionHtml:
📍 Wir suchen dich!

Für unseren Standort in Kreuzberg suchen wir ab sofort eine Pflegefachkraft stationär (m/w/d) in Vollzeit und Teilzeit.

 

 

🙋 Wer wir sind

Wir betreiben ein Pflegeheim mit derzeit 30 Bewohnerinnen und Bewohnern. Unser Haus wird von einem kleinen, eingespielten Team getragen. Viele Kolleginnen und Kollegen arbeiten schon lange zusammen. Der Umgang ist direkt und unkompliziert. Die Wege sind kurz, Entscheidungen werden zügig getroffen.

Wir versorgen überwiegend chronisch kranke Menschen. Neben der pflegerischen und medizinischen Betreuung sind wir auch hauswirtschaftlich für unsere Bewohnerinnen und Bewohner da. Unsere Arbeit folgt dem Grundgedanken, jedem Menschen ein würdevolles Leben zu ermöglichen, seine Lebensqualität zu sichern und seine Selbstständigkeit zu fördern.

 

 

🎁 Was wir bieten

  • Außertarifliche Entlohnung, plus Bonus, Sonn-, Feiertags- und Nachtzuschlag

  • Einbindung in die betriebliche Altersversorgung

  • Förderung von Aus- und Weiterbildung

  • Unfallschutz im betrieblichen und außerberuflichen Bereich

  • Engagement für offene Kommunikation, Toleranz und Respekt auf allen Ebenen

  • Zeit für gute Pflegequalität

  • Gute Schichtbesetzungen

  • Familienfreundliche und individuelle Arbeitszeiten

 

📝 Deine Aufgaben

  • Ganzheitliche Pflege und Betreuung der Bewohner nach aktuellen pflegefachlichen Standards.

  • Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation des Pflegeprozesses.

  • Verabreichung von Medikamenten sowie Durchführung ärztlich verordneter Maßnahmen.

  • Beobachtung des Gesundheitszustands und Einleitung geeigneter Maßnahmen bei Veränderungen.

  • Beratung und Unterstützung von Bewohnern sowie deren Angehörigen.

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Ärzten, Therapeuten und dem interdisziplinären Team zur Sicherstellung einer hochwertigen Versorgung


🔑 Anforderungen

  • Ausbildung als Pflegefachkraft

  • Erfahrung in der stationären Pflege wünschenswert

  • Klarer Blick für Prioritäten, zuverlässige Kommunikation und Freude daran, ein Team zu stärken

  • Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und operative Aufgaben mitzugestalten



Jeder Mensch ist unterschiedlich und befindet sich in anderen Lebensumständen. Wir möchten, dass alle unsere Mitarbeiter mit ihrer Work-Life-Balance und mit Ihrem Gehalt zufrieden sind. Sag uns im Vorstellungsgespräch was deine Bedürfnisse sind und lass uns gemeinsam Lösungen finden.

Welcome to the world of Zoi! We transform manufacturing and retail enterprises through AI-first strategies that deliver measurable business value. We don't just advise: we implement, operate, and scale solutions that turn AI adoption into competitive advantage.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management – technology-driven, patient-centered, and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals, and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with over 650 rehabilitation clinics and 25,000 nursing and homecare providers. With currently around 100 employees, we continue to grow – and we are looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system and solve administrative complexity across care journeys in Europe.

Our AI portfolio spans model development through to production inference at scale, in a highly regulated healthcare context. This role exists to make sure that infrastructure runs reliably, scales predictably, and gets AI engineers' work safely into production.

  • Purposeful work – your work keeps our AI portfolio reliable and performant for hospitals and aftercare providers who depend on it daily.

  • Company culture – we believe in flat hierarchies that promote high performance and strong team dynamics. We foster an environment characterized by mutual respect, loyalty, and recognition. Together, we strive for our goals – and expect the same from you.

  • Flexibility – want to pick up your child from daycare? Like to exercise during lunch? We'll support you. We are a remote-friendly company offering flexible working hours. Workations are also possible by arrangement.

  • Edenred card – which you can use according to your needs.

  • Extra vacation day – so you can celebrate your birthday with your loved ones, you'll have the day off.

This is how you will make an impact as a Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

  • Our AI portfolio needs to run reliably and perform well. Thus it has to be properly monitored.

  • Capacity needs planning, support scaling initiatives, and ensure our systems remain stable as the company grows.

  • SageMaker models need to be continuously delivered, following AWS' best practices.

  • AI engineers need assistance with productionalizing AI workloads end-to-end, from code to container build, and rollouts using optimal deployment strategies.

How we build

We run a modern cloud-native stack to build, ship, and operate AI workloads reliably in a regulated healthcare environment.

  • Runtime: Kubernetes and Postgres

  • Inference: Bedrock, SageMaker, ClearML

  • Observability: Datadog, LangFuse, OTEL

Requirements

Here's how we picture you as our Senior Forward Deployed Platform Engineer:

These are the knowledge and skills you need:

  • Experience with AWS (CloudFormation, IAM, ECR, SageMaker, Bedrock, S3, SQS, DynamoDB, RDS, KMS).

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Efficio is the world's largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy. Headquartered in London, we have offices across Europe, the Americas, East Asia, and the Middle East. We're a diverse team of more than 1,300 people, representing 60+ nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we're still growing!
 
What sets us apart? We’re committed to delivering sustainable, measurable value for our clients. Our specialist focus means you'll develop deep expertise, while our hands-on approach to partnering with clients from strategy to implementation means you'll see the impact of your work. You'll have the opportunity to work on projects around the world in a wide variety of sectors, collaborating with colleagues from across our global offices.
 
We are currently recruiting new team members across Germany, where you'll join a growing team of 50+ people. Our consultants work on a range of engagements, from rapid assessments to short-term savings programmes to long-term partnerships to help clients achieve lasting value.
 
Consultants based in Germany work with clients across the country and Europe, with opportunities to take on projects beyond Europe as well. 

Your responsibilities:
  • Leading consulting engagements from initial analysis and strategy development through to implementation and delivery.
  • Identifying opportunities for cost optimisation, procurement transformation and supply chain improvement.
  • Managing project teams, ensuring high-quality deliverables, effective collaboration and successful project outcomes.
  • Building trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, understanding their business priorities and translating these into actionable solutions.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Development Representative  - (Remote)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re a growing team, and as we scale, so does our need to focus on expanding our sales development team. You’ll join a people-focused business that is putting AI at the center of how manufacturers and distributors price, quote and manage incentives, with a real opportunity to accelerate your career in enterprise SaaS sales.

As a Senior Sales Development Representative, you will identify and engage our ideal customers using Vendavo’s target account profile. You will lead the first stage of the customer journey, starting conversations and building early relationships through outbound prospecting, targeted campaigns, events and coordinated marketing activity.

You will guide prospects through the early stages of the commercial lifecycle: discovering opportunities, qualifying interest and fit, and securing high-quality meetings for our Account Executives. You will also support the account team on key marketing activity. Your work lays the foundation for predictable, high-quality pipeline across our enterprise segment.


THE OPPORTUNITY
  • Leverage research and tailored outreach to create new opportunities with both New Logo accounts and existing customers.
  • Run outbound prospecting (cold calling, email, LinkedIn) on strategic target accounts using concise, research-led messaging. Most of your quota will be expected to come from outbound.
  • Qualify inbound leads against set criteria, using strong questioning to identify true fit and move the right opportunities forward.
  • Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach.
  • Build a solid understanding of our technology and solutions, and clearly explain the problems we solve and the value we deliver to prospects.
  • Lead team meetings on relevant topics, share learnings and new strategies to improve SDR performance, and take part in weekly pipeline reviews.
  • Monitor social media for relevant trends and keywords, and share insights with the SDR, marketing and content teams.
  • Assist in the mentorship and training of new SDRs on process, technology and the company, and act as a leader and problem solver for the team.
  • Support the sales cycle through forecasting, data management and clear communication. Co-own sales tech stack reporting, review insights weekly and recommend changes to process, people or procedures.
  • Contribute to and lead team meetings on a monthly basis on topics relevant to the role. 
  • Pipeline review with weekly team meeting 
  • Other duties as assigned. 

    •  

     


    THE SKILL SET
  • Minimum of 5 years related work experience; bachelor's degree preferred.
  • Consistent track record of meeting and exceeding lead generation and new account development objectives.
  • Fluent English and German or French preferred but not essential 
  • Excellent communication skills in writing, speaking, listening, and outbound calling - able to communicate clearly, concisely, and with precision.
  • Proficiency in our sales tech stack, or the ability to become proficient quickly: Salesforce (CRM, pipeline and reporting), Gong (email outreach and engagement tracking), Common Room (contact enrichment, prospecting and intent data) and Claude (research, account planning and outreach).
  • Stays current with AI and prospecting tools, and tests and applies them to improve outreach quality and efficiency.
  • Experience calling into Fortune 1000 accounts preferred.
  • Ability to understand and successfully promote technical offerings and solution sets, supported by strong curiosity about business problems and product value.
  • Highly motivated and positive, with an entrepreneurial, self-starting mindset and st...

jobs.title: Werkstudent*in Promotion (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir suchen Student*innen mit ENERGY für Berlin
Bei Octopus treiben wir die Energiewende voran: fair, einfach und mit Fokus auf erneuerbare Energien.
Und du bringst das Thema zu den Leuten!

Das gibt´s bei uns: 
  • 15–18 € / Stunde fix - verlässlich bezahlt ab Stunde 1.
  • Zusätzliche Chancen: Du willst mehr? Wenn du eigenständig Beratungen übernimmst und Abschlüsse machst, winken attraktive Zusatzverdienste.
  • Flexible Schichten: Perfekt planbar rund um deinen Stundenplan (Fokus auf Do–Sa).
  • Abwechslung: Coole Venues in Berlin - von Einkaufszentren bis zu Outdoor-Events im Sommer und Winter.
  • Entspanntes Team: Tolle Kolleg*innen, die dich anlernen und unterstützen.




Dein Job:
Du stehst an unserem Stand und sprichst sympathisch Leute an. Das ist deine Hauptaufgabe!
  • Du das Eis brichst: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und sorgst für Aufmerksamkeit rund um unseren Stand.
  • Du verbindest: Wenn jemand neugierig ist, übergibst du das Gespräch ganz entspannt an unsere Expert*innen am Stand.
  • Teamwork: Gemeinsam mit dem Team vor Ort machst du den Tag erfolgreich und hast Spaß dabei!

    • Das bringst du mit:
  • Eingeschriebene*r Student*in an einer Berliner Hochschule oder Universität - idealerweise mit Ausblick auf eine langfristige Zusammenarbeit (mind. 1 Jahr Reststudienzeit).
  • Kommunikationsfreude: Du sprichst gern mit Menschen, bist offen und bringst eine positive Ausstrahlung mit.
  • Sprachen: Du bringst gute Deutschkenntnisse mit (Niveau C1). Du sprichst zusätzlich noch eine andere Sprache? 
    Perfekt für Berlin - wir freuen uns über jede Mehrsprachigkeit!
  • Vorerfahrung brauchst du keine - deine Ausstrahlung und Motivation zählen!

    • Dein Studi-Job wartet – zeig uns, wer du bist!
    Bock auf deinen flexiblen Studi-Job?

    Bewirb dich in nur 2 Minuten – ganz ohne langes Anschreiben!
    Wir wollen sehen, wer du als Mensch bist und wie du redest – dein perfekt formatierter Lebenslauf ist uns erst mal völlig egal.

    Lass uns einfach kennenlernen! 




    Deine Benefits bei uns:
     
    ✅ Vergünstigungen & Vorsorge:
    - Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Nahverkehrsticket
    - Monatlicher Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
     
    ✅ Sport & Gesundheit
    - Zuzahlungen zu Fitness- Angeboten über Wellpass
    - Förderung deines mentalen Wohlbefindens mit unserem Partner Open Up
     
    ✅ Lernen & Weiterbildung
    - Kostenlose Sprachkurse über Busuu
     
    _________________
     
     
    Bereit, den Energiemarkt mit uns zu revolutionieren? Erzähle uns, warum genau du uns dabei unterstützen solltest. Schicke uns deinen CV und alles, was wir wissen sollten, über unser Online-Formular. Wir freuen uns auf dich!
     
    Du findest die Stelle super spannend, bist dir aber unsicher, ob du alle geforderten Skills zu 100% erfüllst? Bitte zögere nicht, dich trotzdem zu bewerben!
     
    P.S.: Octopusse gibt es in allen Farben, Formen und Größen. Wir freuen uns auf Mitarbeiter*innen jeden Geschlechts, Alters, jeder sexuellen Identität, Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, mit und ohne Behinderungen. Für uns zählt nur eins: du passt zu uns und brennst darauf, etwas zu verändern.

    Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About us

Netlight is an international digital consulting firm, helping leading companies to succeed in the digital landscape, from advice to implementation. Our service contains the collective intelligence of more than 2000 consultants offering a comprehensive range of digital services, from strategy to technology. Co-creating the future today, since 1999.
 
Netlight has been awarded several times for profitable growth and management, as a top employer, and for our engagement in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion. Located in Stockholm, Gothenburg, Oslo, Helsinki, Copenhagen, Munich, Hamburg, Berlin, Frankfurt, Zurich, Cologne, Amsterdam, Madrid, Toronto and London.
 

What does it mean to be a consultant at Netlight? 

Join the Netlight Hamburg team as a consultant and be a part of shaping the software products and technical solutions of today and tomorrow alongside your colleagues and clients. Our focus is not just on the digital product, but also on the team and the business. You'll have the ownership to carve your own career path, choosing from a range of clients and roles based on your personal experience, strengths, interests, and market demand. Our projects encompass a wide technical spectrum, including Fullstack Development, Backend, Data Engineering, Cloud Solutions, Architecture, Web Development, DevOps, and more. Instead of predefined roles, we tailor positions to fit individuals. At Netlight, you define your career path, clients you engage with, your role (based on your strengths, interests, and experience), and your connections with mentors, coaches, EDGE networks, and social circles. The possibilities are endless. Come build the future with us at Netlight.

Talent Acquisition Intern

Deine Mission bei trawa

Bei trawa sind wir überzeugt: Die Energiewende beginnt bei den Menschen, die sie möglich machen. Du willst leistungsstarke Teams mit aufbauen und Recruiting von Grund auf so lernen, dass es wirklich Wirkung hat? Dann bist du bei trawa genau richtig.

Als Talent Acquisition Intern bist du das operative Rückgrat unseres Talent-Teams und sorgst mit uns dafür, dass die richtigen Menschen zu trawa finden. Du hältst unsere Prozesse am Laufen, gestaltest reibungslose Candidate Journeys, räumst administrative Hürden aus dem Weg und hilfst, ein Hiring-Erlebnis zu bauen, das hängen bleibt. So bringst du direkt mit voran, was uns antreibt: Unternehmen den Zugang zu echter, grüner Energie zu ermöglichen.

Diese Rolle passt perfekt zu dir, wenn du Talent Acquisition hands-on lernen willst, gerne mit modernen Tools und KI-Lösungen arbeitest und direkt sehen möchtest, wie dein Beitrag das gesamte Team schneller und besser macht.

Bei uns findest du keine starren Strukturen - dafür Gestaltungsspielraum, Vertrauen und ein Team, das die Energiewende gemeinsam voranbringt.

Wir freuen uns darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

Was du bei uns vorantreibst

  • Bewerbungen screenen: Bewerbungen entlang klarer Basic Requirements checken und Kandidat:innen schnell und fair durch die Pipeline steuern.

  • ATS & Tracking: Unser ATS sauber, aktuell und strukturiert halten - plus einfache Tracker pflegen, damit alle jederzeit den Status im Blick haben

  • Interview-Organisation: Interviews end-to-end organisieren: Termine finden, Kalender koordinieren und das Team mit allen Infos versorgen.

  • Candidate Communication: Eine starke Candidate Experience sicherstellen - zeitnahe Updates geben, Fragen beantworten und durch den gesamten Prozess begleiten.

  • Interview-Flow: Feedback von Interviews schnell einsammeln, nachhalten und Stakeholder proaktiv erinnern.

  • Active Sourcing: Kandidat:innen vor allem über LinkedIn finden, erste Profileinschätzungen machen und die Ansprache übernehmen - damit aus „spannend“ schnell ein Gespräch wird.

  • Cross-functional Hiring supporten: Hiring über verschiedene Teams hinweg supporten (Product, Engineering, Operations, Commercial) und dabei unterschiedliche Anforderungen & Profile verstehen lernen.

  • Team-Rituale & Ad-hoc: An Talent-Team-Routinen teilnehmen, Best Practices aufschnappen und spontan mit anpacken, wenn’s im Hiring gerade drauf ankommt

Wen wir suchen

  • Eingeschriebenes Studium, Gap Year oder Phase zwischen zwei Studienabschnitten

  • Lust darauf, Recruiting operativ stark aufzustellen und Hiring-Prozesse zu verbessern

  • Hands-on-Mentalität sowie Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und Themen verlässlich ins Ziel zu bringen

  • Empathisches, souveränes und professionelles Auftreten gegenüber Kandidat:innen und Stakeholdern

  • Strukturierte, detailgenaue Arbeitsweise mit gleichzeitigem Blick für das große Ganze

  • Fähigkeit, Prioritäten zu setzen und Timings zu koordinieren

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We're looking for a senior B2B Growth Marketer to build and scale demand generation for ElevenLabs in India. This is a hands-on, in-country role focused on generating enterprise pipeline, growing our brand with technical buyers, and creating programs that become benchmarks for B2B marketing in AI.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

jobs.title: Solutions Consultant, Mid-Market, DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.

Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.

About the Role:

Notion is shaping the future of Go-To-Market, and as a Solutions Consultant (SC), you’ll bring that future to life by building alongside customers and turning their biggest challenges into measurable outcomes. As a customer-facing, quota-carrying SC, you’ll bring together technical fluency and commercial ownership to grow your book of business. You’ll build pipeline with BDRs, engage key stakeholders, lead discovery, co-build workflow solutions live with customers, and guide opportunities through close. You’ll connect each solution to a clear business case and stay engaged through adoption, expansion, and renewal so customers realize the value of what they buy.

You’ll partner with BDRs, Outcomes Architects, and technical or product specialists while maintaining clear ownership of customer relationships, opportunity momentum, and next steps. If you’re a builder who loves to sell—and want to work at the intersection of AI, productivity, and enterprise—this is the role.

This role will be based in Dublin. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days.

What You'll Achieve:

  • Create pipeline across your book of business. Build target-account plans with BDRs and initiate outreach to priority stakeholders to generate qualified opportunities, alongside BDR-sourced pipeline.

  • Own opportunities from first conversation through close. Lead discovery, qualify business needs and urgency, align stakeholders, shape the solution and business case, and drive the evaluation and commercial decision. Navigate commercial sizing, proposal construction, procurement, legal, and security review to close deals with the right scope, credits, and implementation path.

  • Design and validate workflow solutions that deliver measurable value. Map current- and future-state workflows, co-build solutions live in Notion, and define realistic scope, success criteria, and an implementation path. Translate customer needs and validated outcomes into a clear business case, commercial recommendation, and decision path. Treat discovery as an opportunity to build and validate.

jobs.title: Venture Development Intern
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Venture Development Intern (m/f/d) – FastLeap Partners

Internship, 3–6 months · Full-time

About FastLeap Partners

FastLeap Partners is a company builder and investment firm headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, with portfolio companies mainly operating in Germany. It is backed by a small group of entrepreneurs and family offices from Germany and Switzerland with successful entrepreneurial track records. The firm has launched several ventures in sectors including HR, FinTech and EdTech – all cash-flow-driven and built with AI as their core foundation from day one.

About the internship

FastLeap Partners launches and scales several companies in parallel, from the first validation of a business model to an operating company with its own team. As a Venture Development Intern, you work at both ends of this process: you assess which new business models FastLeap Partners should pursue and launch next, and you help our portfolio companies tackle critical operational bottlenecks that constrain their growth.

You work as the right hand of the founder of FastLeap Partners and collaborate closely with the founders and teams of our portfolio companies. From day one, you are given a high degree of responsibility. You will take ownership of projects with a direct impact on the business success of FastLeap Partners and its portfolio companies.

Your responsibilities

Evaluating new business models

  • Validate business models through market research and customer development, including conversations with potential customers and partners.

  • Develop business cases and translate your findings into a clear recommendation: pursue, adapt or discontinue.

  • Build the talent pipeline: help assemble founding teams for new ventures and identify and engage early employees for the portfolio.

Supporting our portfolio companies

  • Take on critical operational projects across the ventures – from coordinating sales campaigns and product launches to sourcing and evaluating potential partners and drafting customer contracts.

  • Keep track of open items across the ventures and follow up with the teams until they are resolved.

  • Design and implement AI-driven tools and workflows that automate recurring processes and allow the ventures to scale without adding complexity.

Who you are

  • A clear communicator. You write and speak clearly and precisely, and you present your results convincingly to founders and the leadership team.

  • Structured. You maintain an overview of several topics at once and reliably drive open items to resolution.

  • Focused on execution. You recognize what matters most at any given time and see it through to completion.

  • Curious and grounded. You ask the right questions, learn quickly and seek to understand a business before forming an opinion.

  • AI-native. You use AI tools as an integral part of your daily work and continuously look for ways to work more effectively with them.

Qualifications

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in business, economics, engineering, computer science or a related field, ideally in an advanced semester.

  • First experience in fast-paced environments close to the center of an ambitious organization, for example through internships in startups, venture capital, consulting, banking or private equity, or through a project you founded yourself. What you have done matters much more to us than any single logo or pedigree.

jobs.title: Solutions Engineer - German Speaker
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Synthesia is the world’s leading AI video platform for business, used by over 90% of the Fortune 100. Founded in 2017, the company is headquartered in London, with offices and teams across Europe and the US.

As AI continues to shape the way we live and work, Synthesia develops products to enhance visual communication and enterprise skill development, helping people work better and stay at the center of successful organizations.

Following our recent Series E funding round, where we raised $200 million, our valuation stands at $4 billion. Our total funding exceeds $530 million from premier investors including Accel, NVentures (Nvidia's VC arm), Kleiner Perkins, GV, and Evantic Capital, alongside the founders and operators of Stripe, Datadog, Miro, and Webflow.

The Role

We’re hiring Solutions Engineers to build Synthesia’s pre-sales function for the DACH region. This is a founding role: you’ll be one of the first SEs, shaping the playbook, tooling and best practices as we scale, not following an established model. If you’re someone who is excited by building whilst scaling, we’d love to hear from you.

As a Solutions Engineer at Synthesia, you will partner with Account Executives, Customer Success and Product Marketing to run discovery, deliver demos, scope POCs and design the technical solution for each deal. You will be a trusted advisor focused on the value customers get from Synthesia, and you’ll take what you learn in the field back to Product.

This is an incredible opportunity to join us as we become a multi-product company for the first time, and continue to scale across DACH.

What You'll Do

  • Co-plan and support discovery calls with your AE to understand customer requirements, technical environment, and business challenges.

  • Design and execute repeatable demo methodologies that prove Synthesia's business value quickly, whether the customer is deploying Studio at scale, building Roleplay Sessions for skill uplift, or integrating Interactive Avatars into their product.

  • Build and maintain strong working knowledge of Synthesia's platform capabilities, roadmap, and positioning across all product lines, so you can speak to the use cases that drive value

  • Deliver demonstrations that speak to customer problems and tell a credible story of why Synthesia is the right solution.

  • Identify technical objections and integration questions as they come up, working with your AE and the broader ecosystem to find a path forward.

  • Contribute your assessment of technical fit and opportunity risk to help your AE shape account and deal strategy.

  • Keep your deal team and manager informed on deal status, timeline, and technical dependencies.

  • Identify, build relationships with, and actively enable technical champions within customer organizations so they can advocate for Synthesia internally.

  • Provide technical guidance on platform capabilities, API and SDK integrations, security, compliance topics (SOC 2, GDPR, enterprise identity), and scalability for global deployments, troubleshooting issues and validating integrations with LMS, HCM, and content systems as they surface.

  • Partner with Enablement to complete certifications, stay current on new releases, and keep your demo and objection-handling skills sharp.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

We're Redis. We built the product that runs the fast apps our world runs on. (If you checked the weather, used your credit card, or looked at your flight status online today, you’re welcome.) At Redis, you’ll work with the fastest, simplest technology in the business—whether you’re building it, telling its story, or selling it to our 10,000+ worldwide customers. We’re creating a faster world with simpler experiences. You in?

Our ideal candidate is a collaborative individual with an entrepreneurial mindset who thrives in a fast-paced environment and yearns to join a hyper-growth company where you can make a real difference. Your portfolio will include leading brands in your territory that are ready to execute on an enterprise-grade Redis deployment. It’s hard work but incredibly rewarding and a lot of fun! We also recognize that you do have a life and at Redis we go to great lengths to ensure the wellbeing of all our employees is at the heart of everything that we do.

If you are a new business hunter with a passion for scaling a business and owning your own territory, then we would like to hear from you.

Why join Redis now

  • Redis is one of the world’s most successful Open Source Software projects with widespread adoption in the industry

  • Redis is on a pathway to IPO

  • Commission is uncapped with accelerators

  • Best in breed Sales training in MEDDIC, and our comprehensive Sales Enablement programs

  • Stock option grants on joining

What you’ll do:

  • Formulate and execute a sales strategy plan to drive revenue growth for your territory.

  • Identify, qualify and develop sales pipeline collaborating with internal teams.

  • Close business to exceed monthly, quarterly and annual quota objectives.

  • Build strong and effective relationships with your customers, delivering the value they come to expect from you and from Redis.

  • Work independently and with the whole team, up-selling and cross-selling.

What will you need to have?

  • Native level proficiency in German language

  • 10+ years of experience in B2B technology sales

  • You must have enterprise level sales experience.

  • A consultative and value-based approach to selling open-source software for cloud, on premise and hybrid deployments.

  • An entrepreneurial mindset and can-do attitude to enable you to thrive in our fast-moving environment

  • A deep understanding of the sales cycle, from lead generation, lead development, opportunity management, to closing

  • Exceptional communication skills and the ability to present the business value of complex solutions in a simple and straightforward way

  • Proven track record of consistently achieving targets and objectives

  • Generous and competitive benefits

jobs.title: Head of Engineering, Platform (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.

About the role:

We are looking for a full-time Head of Engineering to help us build a securities Platform for financial institutions, the first API of that kind in Europe.

You will lead the Platform Tribe, which comprises three teams. These teams are responsible for critical domains such as Infrastructure, Reliability and Development Tooling and shared libraries, all of which are essential for Upvest’s Investment API.

 

The Platform Tribe exists to give every engineer at Upvest the fastest, safest path from idea to production. We own the foundations that make great engineering possible: the infrastructure teams build on, the tools they build with, the shared libraries that let them move fast without reinventing the wheel, and the observability and reliability practices that keep our systems trustworthy at scale. We measure our success not by what we ship, but by how much faster and more confidently every other engineering team can ship — because when the platform is invisible, it's working.

What you’ll do:

  • Own and shape the tribe's roadmap with real autonomy over what we build and why.

  • Partner closely with product tribes to understand their needs and translate them into platform priorities.

  • Work with modern tools and technologies, with real influence over our technical direction and stack.

  • Directly influence the reliability, velocity, and quality of every product we ship.

What you bring:

  • Ability to bridge strategic "why" with engineering solutions, actively discussing tradeoffs and proactively suggesting ideas, demonstrating a strong product engineering mindset.

  • Strong interest in Upvest's product domains and a proactive desire to understand the business use cases Upvest enables for clients.

  • Experience in leading and growing larger engineering teams in a technical leadership capacity.

  • Prior experience within the Fintech domain.

  • Strong technical expertise and hands-on experience in developing highly scalable, distributed, asynchronous, and resilient platforms.

jobs.title: (Senior) Account Executive, Embedded Investments - Europe (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us:

At Upvest, we are on a mission to make investing as easy as spending money. Upvest empowers businesses to offer a wide range of investment products and the best experience in the field of capital market investment and retirement planning. Upvest’s Investment API is easy to integrate so that fintechs and financial institutions can save resources and fully focus on their core business.

We are proud to partner with Europe’s leading Fintechs and financial institutions such as DKB, Revolut, N26 and Raisin. Founded in 2017 by Martin Kassing, Upvest now brings together over 270 talented professionals from more than 70 nationalities. Upvest is backed by €280M in total funding from world-class investors, including BlackRock, Tencent, Sapphire Ventures, and Bessemer Venture Partners, Earlybird, Notion Capital, and Motive. Our latest €105M funding round in March 2026 - led by Sapphire and Tencent - serves as a massive catalyst for our growth, allowing us to offer premier investment experience.


About the role:

The Growth team at Upvest is driving our go-to-market activities, spanning across Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our mission is to become the Investment-as-a-service category leader for Europe's leading brokers, banks, wealth managers, and non-financial platforms. We're honoured to work with some of Europe's leading brands in a fast moving and expanding market already and are just getting started.

As Upvest enters the next stage of growth, we are seeking a highly motivated and outcome-driven Account Executive to join us and build out our Embedded Investments segment. All our team efforts are centred around the client and give you the opportunity to work with high autonomy coupled with inspirational leadership. Working in the Growth team combines impactful work with a relaxed and fun atmosphere. We have established strong practices around feedback, team health and social events.

Embedded finance is a €100bn+ opportunity in the EU and UK by 2030 and is rapidly expanding beyond payments and lending. Investments are the next frontier: payment apps, online retailers, social networks, telecoms, spend management, and a new generation of AI platforms just to name a few all reach millions of users who expect financial services to be simple and frictionless. For them, embedded investing is a new revenue stream and a powerful way to strengthen engagement and loyalty. In Europe, this market is largely untapped.

In this role, you will work directly with our Director of Growth Alexander Reichhardt to open that market for Upvest. You will sell to companies who have not launched an investment products before, which means translating what our Investment API does into their language: product, growth, and user engagement. This is an opportunity to build a segment from the ground up, own sizeable client relationships from first contact to signature, and accelerate Upvest's path to 100m+ end users.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the cross-functional sales cycle until contract closing to meet or exceed sales targets

  • Build our embedded pipeline across Europe by identifying and opening platforms outside traditional financial services, from consumer apps, retailers and telecoms to B2B software and AI platforms

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our Mission:

Omnea is the agentic operating system for procurement.

Procurement touches every pound a business spends, yet requests still stall for weeks and approvals get lost in inboxes. Our AI-first platform changes that: our agents capture requests, route approvals, onboard suppliers, flag risk and track every renewal, while anyone in the business can ask a question and get an answer grounded in their own company’s data. Buying becomes painless for everyone, procurement gets a seat at the table, and our customers have saved more than 100,000 hours of manual work so far.

Companies like Spotify, PayPal, T. Rowe Price, JustEat, Adyen and S&P Global run procurement on Omnea. We’re backed by $75M from Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners and Accel, and we’ve been named the UK’s number one startup in the Startups 100, ranked 11th on Sifted’s 2026 list of Europe’s fastest-growing companies, and recognised as one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies.

Talent density matters more to us than almost anything else. We keep the bar high in every team, so everyone here has real ownership and real impact. Our team is full of former founders and operators who’ve scaled unicorns, and we’re looking for people who want to do the best work of their careers alongside them.

Find out more about the team and life at Omnea here.

The role in one line

Be Omnea's first Enterprise Account Executive in DACH, as one of Europe's fastest-growing AI companies expands globally.

Why now

Omnea is the UK's number one startup for 2026 and the 11th fastest-growing tech company in Europe. We're in the middle of a major global expansion and hiring Enterprise Account Executives to lead it in each region. The product, customers and sales motion are proven. What's missing is the person who takes them into DACH.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Global enterprises including Spotify, Wise, Adecco and McAfee already run on Omnea

What you'll do

  • Open DACH from Frankfurt or Munich: build pipeline, run complex enterprise cycles and close our first wave of local customers

  • Run multi-stakeholder new business deals across Finance, Procurement, Legal, Security and IT, from first meeting to signature

  • Shape how Omnea goes to market in DACH: messaging, target verticals, partners and events

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and engineering, and see it shipped

  • Lay the foundations for the team that follows you

Who this is for

  • 3 to 7 years in B2B SaaS sales, with a record of closing enterprise new business in DACH

  • Fluent German and English

  • Consistently at or near the top of the leaderboard

  • Comfortable building pipeline from zero, before there's a local team...

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Financial Experience
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead Financial Experience (FinXP), the team that builds how practices and patients deal with money at Nelly.

That covers how a patient says yes to a treatment they can’t pay for upfront, and how delivered care becomes an invoice, then a payment, then cash in the practice’s account. You’ll lead a team whose work shows up directly in what practices earn and in what Nelly earns.

The problem space: Practices rarely lose revenue because care isn’t needed. They lose it at two points. Before treatment, patients delay or decline because they can’t pay upfront. After treatment, revenue leaks on its way to cash: invoices go out late or wrong, payments get chased by hand, and billing runs through manual steps. The domain Financial OS closes both gaps. We offer financing at the moment the patient decides, through installment plans and factoring, and we turn every delivered treatment into a correct invoice and cash in the practice’s account. Because we sit where treatment is planned, we know what it’s worth and whether it is converted before we take on the risk, which no bank or payment provider can do. We earn a share of the revenue we help collect, so the practice’s growth is our growth.

The domain has two teams. Financial Platform builds the infrastructure that moves money and keeps compliant records of it. Financial Experience builds everything doctors, practice staff, patients and our own teams touch, across the Doctor Portal, Patient Portal and Backoffice.

About Nelly

We are building the AI-Driven Financial Operating System for European healthcare, solving the biggest challenges for patients and practices. We create what no bank or software platform can handle. Our all-in-one platform transforms chaotic administrative processes into intelligent, automated workflows, from patient care to billing to next-generation payments. Because we truly believe: healthcare should be less about paperwork and more about people.

Why? Because Europe is facing a massive shortage of medical professionals. And if we don't rethink the way practices work, the system won't be able to keep up. With our Series B funding of over €50 million from world-class investors, we are turning our vision into reality.

What sets us apart: We work with the best team, which is why we give everything together every day. We believe in Talent Density, because exceptional people make everyone around them better. At Nelly, we move fast and expect everyone to keep up. Stagnation isn’t an option, which is why we invest heavily in growth. AI is an essential part of how we work at Nelly. We expect you to use it every day and give you everything you need to do so. You get trust and ownership and we expect you to speak up, even when it's uncomfortable.

Joining us, you will:

  • Lead, inspire and grow a high-performing team of 3–6 software engineers

  • Own hiring for your team, building a team of high-performing engineers

  • Work closely with your product manager to build, launch and improve the financial journey iteratively. That starts at the point of decision, with cost plans, credit checks and installment plans, and runs through to collection, with invoicing, dunning and the processing of billing files

  • Own the quality, reliability and security of your team's products, delivering highly available production systems that handle sensitive financial...

jobs.title: Founding Customer Success Manager - DACH
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re Heidi.

We're building the future of healthcare by giving every clinician the earth's finest AI Care Partner. Our platform has absorbed the administrative chaos of 175 million patient visits and supported 67 million clinical hours. Today, we support 2.8 million patient sessions a week across 190+ countries, in 110 languages and over 200 specialties.

Healthcare systems are failing us; clinicians spend more time on documentation than on patients, and the human connection that makes medicine worth practicing is eroding. Our mission is simple: double the world’s capacity for care and strengthen the human connection at its heart.

We found product-market fit with a freemium medical scribe that clinicians love. Now, we're expanding. Every task a clinician hands to Heidi is a patient who feels more attended to, a health system unclogged, and a clinician who gets to be a clinician again.

We’ve grown annual recurring revenue from $1 million to $50 million in two years.

To go further, we’ve secured US$340 million: a $100 million Series C led by Blackbird, with Phoenix Court, Point72 Private Investments and Headline, alongside a $240 million growth investment led by General Catalyst’s Customer Value Fund.

If you want to join us in doing work worth shipping, jump in.

The role

As a Customer Success Manager at Heidi Health, you’ll be the bridge between technology and care - helping hospitals, clinics, and clinicians across Germany adopt and love Heidi.

You’ll manage the full customer journey for both public and private hospital deployments, ensuring seamless implementation, strong clinician engagement, and measurable impact on patient care.


This role is ideal for someone with a medical background (e.g. former doctor, nurse, or allied health professional) who’s excited to drive digital transformation in healthcare.

What you’ll do

  • Own customer outcomes: Be the strategic partner for a portfolio of Heidi’s customers, ensuring they achieve measurable success and realise value.

  • Lead onboarding & training: Lead onboarding of new customers from planning, training through to go-live, delivering seamless integrations into customer workflows.

  • Track and improve metrics along customer journey like time-to-first-value and early activation.

  • Drive strategic adoption: Develop and execute tailored adoption plans to maximise user engagement and satisfaction, enhancing the continued love for Heidi among clinicians.

  • Enhance Retention & Growth: Identify expansion opportunities, mitigate churn risks and work cross-functionally to deepen product engagement.

  • Customer advocacy: Build executive-level relationships and become the voice of the customer internally, advocating for their needs and priorities and showcasing wins.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Q ENERGY is Europe’s 360° green energy company. Together with our more than 500 employees we develop, build, and manage renewable energy assets across the entire value chain of large-scale renewable energy projects – from solar, to onshore wind and offshore wind, to energy storage and hybrid power plants. With a pipeline of more than 11 GW we are among the leading renewable energy companies in Europe. We are always on the lookout for people who want to work with us to empower a sustainable world with green energy.  

We are looking for a motivated and detail-oriented Working Student to support the successful delivery of utility-scale renewable energy projects from development through construction and into operational handover.

Working closely with experienced Project Managers, you will gain broad exposure to the entire project lifecycle, supporting the planning, coordination, execution, and commercial management of complex solar PV, battery storage, wind, and other renewable energy infrastructure projects. This role is an excellent opportunity for engineering students who are passionate about the energy transition and aspire to build a career in project management within the renewable energy sector.

Your responsibilities:

You will join our project management team and support the delivery of EPC construction projects. The role is broad. You won’t be expected to cover everything below. Your tasks will depend on your background, interests, and experience, and you’ll grow into more areas over time.

Depending on your focus, you may support us with:

Planning and project controls:

  • Developing and implementing project execution plans, schedules, budgets, quality plans, reporting structures, and risk management plans
  • Tracking project progress against key milestones and KPIs, identifying risks, issues, delays, and cost impacts, and helping implement mitigation measures
  • Monitoring project costs, forecasts, cash flow, invoice verification, and budget performance
  • The invoice payment process and internal approvals

Contracts and commercial management

  • Administering the main EPC contract with clients and monitoring compliance with contractual obligations, rights, and responsibilities
  • Ensuring contractual requirements are reflected in procurement activities, subcontract agreements, project strategies, and execution plans
  • Managing contractual claims, variation orders, and commercial negotiations with clients and subcontractors
  • Technical evaluations and the selection of EPC subcontractors, suppliers, consultants, and specialized service providers

Delivery and coordination

  • Coordinating engineering, procurement, quality assurance, permitting, construction, commissioning, and handover activities
  • Ensuring permitting requirements, grid connection requirements, environmental obligations, and technical specifications are incorporated into project planning and execution
  • Managing technical interfaces between contractors, suppliers, utilities, clients, and other project stakeholders
  • Coordinating project activities to ensure timely delivery and a smooth transition into Operations & Maintenance (O&M)

Requirements

  • Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program in one of the following fields: Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Energy Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline
  • Advanced German (at least B2) and good command of English
  • Good knowledge of MS Office (especially Excel, Word, and PowerPoint)
  • Genuine interest in renewable energy and project management
  • Structured, detail-oriented, and proactive way of working

jobs.title: Regional Director of Sales
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role at RobCo

RobCo is building the category of Autonomous Industrial Robotics and we're doing it fast. We believe that automating the ordinary frees humans to do the extraordinary, and we're building the end-to-end robotics infrastructure to make that possible - hardware, software, and AI in one stack that just works.

 

As our Regional Director of Enterprise Sales, you act as the primary catalyst for RobCo's enterprise growth across the German market, driving large-scale industrial adoption of our Autonomous Manufacturing Platform. You will lead high-impact sales strategies, build strategic relationships with executive stakeholders in key industrial sectors, and scale our enterprise footprint from the ground up.

Your Responsibilities

  • Drive Regional Revenue: Lead and execute the German enterprise sales strategy to achieve and exceed ambitious revenue and market-penetration targets.

  • Build Executive Relationships: Target, engage, and secure long-term partnerships with C-level executives and key decision-makers across mid-market and large-scale manufacturing and industrial enterprises.

  • Champion Technical Solutions: Direct complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise sales cycles by clearly communicating the strategic, financial, and technical ROI of RobCo's modular robotics and physical AI solutions.

  • Scale Enterprise Footprint: Identify and unlock new market verticals and geographic opportunities across the DACH region to continually expand the sales pipeline.

  • Partner Cross-Functionally: Collaborate closely with Solution Engineering and Product teams to align client requirements with product capabilities and deliver seamless rollouts.

  • Forecast with Accuracy: Maintain meticulous pipeline hygiene, actionable sales reporting, and highly accurate quarterly/annual revenue forecasts in Salesforce.

  • Represent the Brand: Position RobCo as the premier AI-driven automation provider through representation at key industry events, panel discussions, and executive roundtables.

  • Team Leadership & Enablement: Lead, mentor, and coach a high-performing team of Senior Account Executives, driving quota attainment, pipeline growth, and continuous performance management.

We're looking for someone who has:

  • Degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Industrial Management, or comparable experience.

  • Proven track record of sales leadership, with demonstrated success enabling Senior Account Executives to consistently achieve and exceed revenue targets.

  • Several years of experience in Enterprise SaaS or Hardware/Robotics Sales, specifically closing complex, high-value B2B deals within the German industrial or manufacturing sectors.

  • Proven track record of consistently exceeding enterprise sales quotas ($2M+ ARR responsibility) and managing complex, multi-month deal cycles.

  • Deep understanding of industrial automation, manufacturing workflows, or Robotics-as-a-Service (RaaS) models.

  • Willingness to travel up to 50-75% within Germany for client meetings, trade shows, onsite evaluations, and international team offsites.

  • Culture-aligned mindset...

jobs.title: Recruiter, Commercial
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials and goods for energy and infrastructure. We execute trade and distribution end-to-end, on our own account, at the speed of compute - and we are becoming the supplier of record for the entire industry.

Industrial procurement is a €900B market in Europe alone and the largest manual market on earth. 95% of customers have no direct access to global supply chains. Materials pass through four or five intermediaries before they reach a site, and 40% of the margin evaporates on the way. For decades, the operating system of this industry was people: people to source, negotiate, finance, ship, and sell.

We built the alternative from scratch. We are the supplier. We buy from global sources and sell to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, credit, and financing. One request. A firm quote in minutes. Delivered on time. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier. No warehouses. No fleet. No inventory risk. Every trade is pre-sold before it is bought.

We are also the credit counterparty. Customers are scored and insured in minutes and get up to 60 days of payment terms priced into the quote itself. The working capital behind every trade is bank-funded, not equity-funded.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover run rate, the majority of it from repeat customers

  • Seven European markets live, sourced from suppliers across Asia and beyond

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), London, and Shanghai

  • $90M raised in equity and debt, including our $40M Series B, from Atomico, Project A, Target Global, and Inven Capital - with working capital facilities from UniCredit and KfW

The margin is in the bits. The moat is in the atoms. We are building the supplier of record for industrial materials - and redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

Your mission

Our market moves fast, and so do we. As our business continues to scale, we're looking for an ambitious, German-speaking Commercial Recruiter to take ownership of hiring across the DACH region.

You'll be the driving force behind building our commercial powerhouse — attracting and securing exceptional talent across Sales, Account Management and Business Development.

From the initial hiring kick-off to the final signed contract, you'll own the entire recruitment journey. You'll partner closely with business leaders, shape hiring strategies, identify outstanding talent and turn ambitious growth plans into reality.

This isn't just about filling vacancies. It's about building the people, teams and capabilities that will define our next chapter.

If you love moving fast, building relationships and making great hires happen, we'd love to meet you.

What you'll do

  • Own the full cycle: intake, sourcing, screening, offer, close.

  • Hunt passive talent via LinkedIn, referrals, events and direct approach.

  • Interview in German and English and deliver sharp shortlists, fast.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive, New Business
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Fyxer

Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role

You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.


What we're looking for

  • High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization

  • You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed

Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work

Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product.

We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.


The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win

  • The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32.

  • The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.

  • The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.

  • Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.

 

This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact

The basics

  • Remote, US

  • Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)

  • Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales

  • Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers

Compensation: $90K – $100K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • $180-200 OTE 50/50 split. Uncapped with accelerators above 100%

jobs.title: Head of Operations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who we are

Foundation models transformed text and images. Structured data - the largest and most consequential data format in the world - stayed untouched, until now. What LLMs did for language, we're doing for tables.

We pioneered tabular foundation models: TabPFN v2 was a Nature cover story, has passed 3.5M+ downloads and 7,500+ GitHub stars, and runs in production from detecting lung disease with Oxford Cancer Analytics to preventing train failures with Hitachi. The hardest problems - millions of rows, real-time inference, entirely new modalities - are still open, and no one else is working on them at this level.

We're a small, highly selective team of 40+ with backgrounds from Google, DeepMind, Meta, Apple, Amazon, Jane Street, and CERN, led by Frank Hutter, Noah Hollmann, and Sauraj Gambhir, and advised by Bernhard Schölkopf and Turing Award winner Yann LeCun.

In July 2026, less than 18 months after our €9M pre-seed, we joined SAP as an independent frontier AI lab - same team, mission, and open-weights models, now backed by more than €1 billion over four years.

The Role

The Head of Operations reports to Sauraj (Co-CEO, GTM and Operations) and take ownership of operational excellence company-wide. As Finance, Legal, People, IT and InfoSec, and Compliance grow into their own functions, this person partners with each lead on the operational side of their work and holds the whole together as one system. They lead the operations team and grow it into one fit for a company many times our current size.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Visbek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Produktentwickler (m/w/d) Frische

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

In Visbek befindet sich das Herzstück der Plukon Food Group in Deutschland. Hier sind gleich drei wesentliche Bestandteile unserer Unternehmensgruppe ansässig: Die Plukon GmbH ist die deutsche Verwaltungszentrale von Plukon. Von hieraus steuern Management und Verwaltung die Geschäftsaktivitäten. Ebenfalls am niedersächsischen Standort angesiedelt ist die Plukon Visbek GmbH. Hier handelt es sich um einen Geflügel-Verarbeitungsbetrieb, der auf die Herstellung tiefgekühlter Convenience-Produkte spezialisiert ist. Last but not least hat auch die Plukon Agri GmbH in Visbek ihren Sitz. Plukon Agri ist als Partner unserer Landwirte für den Verkauf von Eintagsküken und den Einkauf von Schlachtgeflügel zuständig.

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Entwicklung neuer Produkte von der Rohware bis zum Endprodukt

  • Bearbeitung / Erstellung von Musteranfragen / Mustern

  • Begleitung von Erstproduktionen und Linientests

  • Rezepturmanagement und Projektdokumentation

  • Organisation und Prüfung neuer Zutaten

  • Bearbeitung von Spezifikationen (Rohwaren, Endartikel)

  • Aktualisieren der bereits bestehenden Produktionsprozesse und -abläufe

  • Prozess- und Produktoptimierung im Rahmen von Neuentwicklungen

  • Deklarationsprüfung

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Laboren und Forschungseinrichtungen

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der Lebensmitteltechnologie, Oecotrophologie oder Fachkraft für Lebensmitteltechnik mit fundierter Berufserfahrung in einer vergleichbaren Position

  • lebensmittelrechtliches und -chemisches Grundwissen

  • Erfahrung mit HACCP, Allergenmanagement und IFS

  • Prozesskenntnisse in der Lebensmittelindustrie

  • Sorgfältige und Selbstständige Arbeitsweise

  • Engagement und Durchsetzungsvermögen sowie zielgerichtetes, sorgfältiges und effizientes Handeln

  • hohes Maß an Selbstständigkeit, Organisationsvermögen und Teamgeist

  • analytische und konzeptionelle Arbeitsweise, gutes Zahlenverständnis, vorausschauendes und ganzheitliches Denken

Das bieten wir:

  • Wir bieten Dir einen spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Vollzeitjob (alternativ Teilzeit - muss von den HR Managern angegeben werden).

  • Bei uns erwartet Dich ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem internationalen Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielen freundlichen Kolleginnen und Kollegen.

  • Firmenfitness (wir bezuschussen eine Fitnessstudio Mitgliedschaft im Rahmen des EGYM Wellpass-Verbundes).

jobs.title: Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung/Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams an unserem Standort in Storkow suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Mitarbeiter in der Qualitätssicherung/Produktkontrolleure (m/w/d)

Informationen über unseren Betrieb

Unser Produktionsstandort in Storkow ist pulsierender Knotenpunkt unserer Tätigkeiten. Der Betrieb gilt als Musterbeispiel für eine innovative Geflügelproduktion. In Storkow vereinen sich Fachwissen und fortschrittliche Technologie, um tagtäglich eine Vielzahl frischer und hochwertiger Hähnchenprodukte herzustellen. Unsere Produkte liefern wir unter unseren eigenen Marken Friki, FairMast und Stolle an den Lebensmittelhandel in ganz Deutschland. Darüber hinaus produzieren wir einen großen Teil unserer Produkte für exklusive Marken unserer Handelspartner. 

Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Durchführung von Qualitätskontrollen entlang des gesamten Produktionsprozesses (Anlieferung, Schlachtung, Zerlegung, Verpackung)

  • Überwachung und Dokumentation der Einhaltung interner Qualitätsrichtlinien sowie gesetzlicher Vorgaben

    (HACCP, LMHV, VO (EG) 853/2004 etc.)

  • Durchführung von Hygienekontrollen und mikrobiologischen Schnelltests

  • Überprüfung von Prozessparametern und Produktmerkmalen (z. B. Temperatur, Sensorik etc.)

  • Erstellung und Pflege qualitätsrelevanter Dokumentationen und Prüfberichte

  • Meldung und Nachverfolgung von Abweichungen sowie Einleitung von Sofortmaßnahmen

  • Unterstützung bei Audits und Zertifizierungsmaßnahmen (IFS, QS, BIO, Tierschutzlabel)

  • Schulung und Sensibilisierung von Mitarbeitenden im Bereich Hygiene und Qualität

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Lebensmittelbereich, z. B. Fachkraft für Lebensmitteltechnik, Fleischer, Tierwirt,

    Lebensmittelkontrolleur oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Idealerweise Berufserfahrung in der Geflügelverarbeitung oder Fleischindustrie

  • Kenntnisse relevanter Lebensmittel- und Hygieneregelwerke

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Dokumentation und Prüfmethoden

  • Verantwortungsbewusstsein, Durchsetzungsvermögen und ein geschultes Auge fürs Detail

  • Bereitschaft zur Arbeit in Früh-/Spätschicht

  • Teamfähigkeit und Kommunikationsstärke

Das bieten wir:

  • Krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem „systemrelevanten“, internationalen Unternehmen

  • Leistungsgerechte Entlohnung und Unternehmensvorteile wie ein Jobrad, Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld, Firmenfitness etc.

  • Flache Hierarchien

  • Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten unter Berücksichtigung der individuellen Bedürfnisse

Haben wir Dein Interesse geweckt?

Wenn Du Lust auf neue Herausforderungen hast, freuen wir uns Dich kennenzulernen. Bewirb Dich einfach über unseren Bewerbungsbutton und das entsprechende Bewerbungsformular. Wenn Du noch Fragen zu dieser Stelle hast, kannst Du uns telefonisch oder per E-Mail kontaktieren. Du erhältst so schnell wie möglich eine Rückmeldung.

jobs.title: Analyst, Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Analyst, Financial Planning and Analysis

What you will be doing:

The Financial Analyst supports the forecasting and budgeting of various business units and corporate functions of the Company by entering and analyzing financial data, preparing financial statements, identifying trends, and recommending actions to address opportunities. The Financial Analyst works closely with assigned business areas to gather the necessary information to maintain financial structures, prepare financial statements, provide variance analysis, and enter expense, capital, and headcount forecasts.

Key Responsibilities

Responsibility #1– 100%

Forecast & Budget General

• Analysis and forecasting/budgeting support to the business unit leaders and the leaders within FP&A around business unit expense, capital and headcount
• Interface with HR on cost center personnel assignment issues as needed to support forecasting
• Interface with cost center managers around specific questions pertaining to cost center performance against budget/forecast
• Research specific anomalies in financial and operational data as requested by business unit leaders and/or senior leaders of FP&A
• Perform other ad hoc financial forecasting analysis or strategic finance support duties as required

​Required Qualifications

Work Experience:

Years of Applicable Experience - 2 or more years

Education:

Bachelors (Required)

Preferred Qualifications

Skills:

• Analysis

• Budgeting

• Forecasting

Experience:

• Comfort/ability to learn and use budget/forecasting software. Preferred time/exposure in managing large data sets. Experience with Business Intelligence tools and/or specifically Adaptive Insights.
• Adaptable and capable of learning how to pull data for analysis from multiple disparate software programs
• Ability to synthesize ambiguous raw data sets, develop meaningful insight thru analysis of trends, and succinctly communicate findings

Additional Job Requirements:

  • Remain in a stationary position for prolonged periods of time

  • Be adaptive and change priorities quickly; meet deadlines

  • Attention to detail

  • Operate computer programs and software

  • Ability to communicate effectively with audiences in person and in electronic formats.

  • Day-to-day contact with others (co-workers and/or the public)

  • Making independent decisions

  • Ability to work in a collaborative business environment in close quarters with peers and varying interruptions

Working Conditions: RemoteTravel Requirements: Travel 1-20% within the USPhysical Demands: Sedentary: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally, and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves remaining stationary most of the time.
