jobs.descriptionHtml:
Founded in 2017, Lovelytics helps some of the most complex enterprises across Energy & Utilities, Media & Entertainment, Manufacturing, Retail & CPG, Healthcare and Financial Services modernize their data and put AI to work, not in a deck, but in production. We move fast, stay close to the cutting edge, and care more about outcomes than optics.

Our work spans the full data and AI lifecycle: Data Strategy & Advisory, Data Engineering, Analytics & Visualization, Generative AI & ML, and Cloud Migration & Modernization. All of it is delivered primarily on Databricks, with deep partnerships across AWS, Azure, and GCP.

In September 2026, Lovelytics became a CDW company. CDW completed its acquisition on September 25, 2026, bringing our team into its Data & Analytics Practice. Together, we can take customers from data strategy to production AI with a single partner across the full technology lifecycle.

Lovelytics now has 600+ people across the United States, Canada, Argentina, and Colombia, all working exclusively in data and AI. We’ve kept the technically excellent, low-ego culture that earned us a Best Places to Work recognition, a spot among Databricks’ top partners, and three appearances on the Inc. 5000.

We’re looking for a Solution Architect to design and lead the build-out of a broad scope of modern, scalable data platforms and pipelines for clients across industries. This role is deeply hands-on in data engineering architecture, helping clients modernize their data to improve business outcomes.

You’ll define technical strategies, architect data platforms, and guide delivery teams to implement best-in-class ingestion, transformation, and storage solutions on the cloud. You’ll also partner with sales and account teams to scope engagements, shape technical proposals, and showcase Lovelytics’ engineering expertise.

This role is open to remote candidates in the U.S. and Ontario, Canada. You’re also welcome in any of our offices in Arlington, VA; Chicago, IL; New York, NY; or Toronto!

This role is not open for sponsorship

Primary Responsibilties

  • Formulate forward-looking data strategies aligned with client business objectives and industry best practices
  • Design and oversee large-scale AI, lakehouse and warehouse implementations on Databricks (must-have) and other cloud-native technologies
  • Create solutions that integrate on-premises and multiple cloud environments seamlessly.
  • Architect batch and streaming ingestion, real-time processing, and ELT/ETL patterns
  • Ensure security, privacy, compliance, and data quality at scale on client engagements
  • Tackle intricate data engineering challenges and make strategic decisions to de-risk delivery
  • Introduce emerging technologies and methodologies to keep client solutions at the cutting edge.
  • Drive performance, cost optimization, scalability, and maintainability across data engineering solutions
  • Mentor engineers, review architectures and code, and guide teams through implementation.
  • Lead technical discovery, shape solution architectures, respond to RFPs, and deliver demos and proofs of concept for data engineering engagements
  • Create technical blueprints and recommend tools, frameworks, and design patterns aligned to client needs

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing Manager (B2B SaaS / FinTech) for DigiFi
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Satellite, we are looking for an experienced Growth Marketing Manager to join our team and work with a rapidly growing US-based startup – DigiFi.

About Client:

DigiFi is a NYC-based next-gen platform for automated digital lending. The all-in-one platform streamlines the lending journey from application to funding, powering a best-in-class experience and offers an unparalleled level of flexibility to allow lenders to launch new digital products and deliver amazing borrower experiences – for any product, anywhere.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly tactical, hands-on Growth Marketing Manager to take ownership of our top-of-funnel digital acquisition. As our first marketing hire, you will not be managing an agency or a team - you will be the builder. Your primary goal is to drive high-intent, qualified website traffic and convert that traffic into inbound demo requests for our sales team through PPC, targeted content, and conversion rate optimization (CRO).

Key Responsibilities:

  • Paid Acquisition: Build, launch, and strictly manage high-intent B2B campaigns on Google Ads (Search), LinkedIn Campaign Manager, SaaS review sites and other platforms while optimizing for Cost-Per-Qualified-Lead and pipeline ROI.
  • Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO): Design, launch, and A/B test product-specific landing pages to maximize the visitor-to-demo conversion rate.
  • Content & Lead Generation: Produce high-value, bottom-of-funnel content (e.g., technical guides, buyer's checklists, case studies) that attracts lending executives and captures their contact information.
  • Marketing Operations: Set up and manage the foundational marketing tech stack (e.g., HubSpot, GA4, conversion tracking) to ensure seamless lead routing to the sales team and accurate attribution.
  • SEO Strategy: Identify and capture high-intent, long-tail search terms related to loan origination, decision engines, and digital banking software.

Qualifications:

  • Experience: 4+ years of B2B SaaS digital marketing or growth experience, marketing products to US and European customers. Experience in FinTech, RegTech, or targeting enterprise executives is a massive plus.
  • PPC Mastery: Proven hands-on experience managing Google Ads in high-CPC environments, with a deep understanding of negative keyword filtering and intent matching.
  • Technical Tooling: Proficient in setting up landing pages (Webflow, WordPress, or HubSpot CMS) and configuring conversion tracking independently.
  • Builder Mentality: Comfortable operating with a "day zero" mindset. You can write your own ad copy, build your own landing pages, and analyze your own data without relying on a large support team.
  • Data-Driven: Obsessed with tracking pipeline metrics rather than just vanity metrics like clicks and impressions.
  • English: At least C1 !!!
About Us: Satellite builds dedicated engineering teams for successful American startups. We find and nurture the most driven technical talent for our clients that build innovative products and look for the truly best people to join their teams.

jobs.title: Junior Performance Marketing Specialist (Paid Acquisition & Growth)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Junior Performance Marketing Specialist (Paid Acquisition & Growth) to join the Growth team of a fast-growing international consumer AI technology company. This is a hands-on performance marketing opportunity focused on launching, managing and optimising paid acquisition campaigns across mainstream digital advertising platforms, including Meta, TikTok, Google, Instagram and Reddit.

You will be responsible for managing campaigns directly, testing new audiences and creatives, analysing performance data and implementing improvements that drive customer acquisition and commercial growth. Working closely with the CMO & Co-founder and the wider Growth team, you will gain exposure to consumer marketing at scale while developing towards independently managing larger advertising budgets.

The ideal candidate already has practical experience running paid campaigns, understands key performance metrics such as CAC, ROAS and conversion rates, and can demonstrate measurable improvements resulting from their own actions. This is an execution-focused position rather than a purely analytical or reporting role. We are looking for someone who enjoys working directly within advertising platforms, experimenting with campaign strategies and continuously improving results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Launch, manage and optimise paid acquisition campaigns across mainstream consumer advertising platforms.

  • Take direct ownership of individual campaigns, including setup, monitoring, testing and performance optimisation.

  • Manage campaigns across platforms such as Meta, TikTok, Google, Instagram, Reddit or comparable consumer acquisition channels.

  • Monitor customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS), conversion rates and other commercial performance indicators.

  • Analyse campaign data to identify opportunities for improving acquisition efficiency and overall performance.

  • Design and execute structured tests across audiences, targeting strategies, advertising creatives and campaign configurations.

  • Evaluate test results and implement data-driven changes to improve campaign outcomes.

  • Identify underperforming campaigns and take proactive steps to optimise results.

  • Track individual campaign contributions and communicate actions, decisions and measurable improvements.

  • Collaborate with the Growth team on acquisition strategies, creative testing and performance initiatives.

  • Research emerging consumer acquisition opportunities and advertising platform developments.

  • Support continuous experimentation to improve conversion, customer acquisition and marketing efficiency.

  • Develop the skills and experience required to independently manage larger advertising budgets.

  • Work closely with the CMO & Co-founder to support the company's consumer growth objectives.

Requirements

  • Hands-on professional experience in performance marketing, paid acquisition or media buying.

  • Proven experience personally launching, managing and optimising paid advertising campaigns.

  • Practical experience with at least one major consumer acquisition platform, such as Meta Ads, TikTok Ads, Google Ads, Instagram Ads or Reddit Ads.

  • Strong understanding of CAC, ROAS, conversion rates and commercial campaign performance.

  • Ability to demonstrate individual campaign ownership and clearly explain specific actions taken to improve results.

  • Experience testing advertising creatives, audiences, targeting strategies or campaign structures.

  • Ability to interpret campaign performance data and translate insights into practical optimisation decisions.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role

Help train and evaluate AI agents on expert-level fluid simulation tasks. You'll take CAD geometry, set up and run simulations, build verified reference solutions, and write Python checks for the agent's results.

Requirements

  • A degree in Mechanical or Aerospace Engineering, or a related field such as energy or oil & gas. A PhD is preferred but not required.
  • Several years of hands-on industry or research CFD with OpenFOAM, ANSYS Fluent/CFX or STAR-CCM+, including meshing.
  • Solid verification and validation practice: mesh-independence studies, and validation against experiment or benchmarks.
  • Comfortable with Python and GitHub.
  • English at B2 level or above.
  • Nice to have: aerospace, automotive, offshore or turbomachinery background; multiphase or particle-laden flow experience.

Project time expectations

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

Compensation

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

Why this freelance opportunity might be a great fit for you?

  • Work fully remote on your own schedule with just a laptop and stable internet connection.
  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.
  • Participate in performance-based bonus programs that reward high-quality work and consistent delivery.

Data Science Consulting

Up to 25%

Ability to Obtain Public Trust

What You Will Do:

As a Data Analyst / Visualization Senior Consultant, you will help transform complex operational and infrastructure data into meaningful insights that inform programs, policies, and performance decisions. You will work on high-visibility initiatives, using modern analytics, visualization, and automation tools to improve how data is collected, analyzed, communicated, and acted upon. This role offers the opportunity to build practical solutions that make information easier to understand, streamline manual processes, and deliver measurable value for stakeholders.

  • Collect, clean, validate, and analyze data from multiple sources.
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations using tools such as Power BI and Tableau.
  • Design and develop workflow applications and automated processes using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Identify opportunities to streamline manual processes through automation.
  • Translate business needs into analytical, reporting, and workflow requirements.
  • Test, troubleshoot, document, and maintain dashboards, applications, and automated workflows.
  • Identify trends, patterns, anomalies, and data-quality issues.
  • Communicate findings to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and multidisciplinary project teams.

​

What You Will Need:

  • Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DHS "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.
  • US Citizenship is contractually required.
  • Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university.
  • Minimum of THREE (3)+ years of work experience.
  • Experience in data analysis, reporting, business intelligence, data visualization, automation, or application development.
  • Experience developing dashboards or visualizations using Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.
  • Experience developing workflow applications and automations using Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps and Power Automate.
  • Ability to work collaboratively in a client-facing consulting environment.

​

What Would Be Nice To Have:

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Real Geeks

Real Geeks is a leading real estate technology company helping agents and teams build their

brands, generate leads, nurture relationships, and grow their businesses.

Our integrated platform combines IDX websites, CRM, marketing automation, AI-powered tools,

and lead generation solutions to help real estate professionals build stronger, more sustainable

businesses.

We're a relatively small, fast-moving technology company with ambitious goals. We're looking

for a marketing leader who can help us sharpen our positioning, elevate our brand, and

accelerate growth.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a strategic, hands-on marketing leader to own and drive our marketing

strategy.

This is a high-impact leadership role for someone who knows how to turn great positioning into

compelling campaigns, brand awareness into demand, product innovation into customer

adoption, and marketing investments into measurable business results.

You'll lead a small team of marketing professionals and work closely with our Sales, Product,

and Training teams to ensure our messaging, campaigns, product launches, and customer

experience are aligned.

We don't need someone who simply manages marketing activities. We need a driver, a

changemaker, and a builder. Someone who challenges the status quo, brings fresh ideas, sets

a clear direction, and inspires others to execute.

You'll need to think strategically, act decisively, and be comfortable getting into the details. We're

a lean organization, and everyone — including our leaders — rolls up their sleeves when

needed.

What You'll Own

Marketing Strategy & Positioning

  • Develop and own a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives and revenue goals.
  • Define and sharpen our brand positioning, differentiation, value propositions, and messaging across key customer segments.
  • Translate market insights, customer needs, and competitive intelligence into clear marketing priorities.
  • Build integrated marketing plans that connect brand awareness, organic growth, demand generation, product marketing, and customer engagement.
  • Establish a consistent, compelling brand narrative across all marketing channels and customer touchpoints.

Team Leadership & Execution

  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of three marketing professionals, creating clarity around priorities, ownership, and expectations.
  • Build a focused, accountable, high-performing team that works collaboratively toward shared goals.
  • Create a culture of ownership, creativity, continuous improvement, and results.
  • Establish effective planning and execution processes so that every major initiative has a clear what, why, who, when, and definition of success.
  • Prioritize ruthlessly, manage resources effectively, and keep the team focused on the work that matters most.
  • Step in and execute when needed. This is a hands-on leadership role, not one for someone who prefers to delegate everything.

Budget Management, Data & Performance

  • Own the overall marketing budget, ensuring investments align with company strategy, priorities, and revenue objectives.
  • Define and own marketing KPIs, performance dashboards, and reporting.
  • Use data to guide strategy, prioritize investments, evaluate results, and continuously optimize performance.
  • Build a culture where decisions are grounded in customer insights, market evidence, and measurable outcomes.
  • Ensure initiatives begin with clear objectives, success metrics, owners, timelines, and execution plans.
  • Regularly assess what's working, what's not, and where to double down, adjust, or stop.

Organic Growth & Demand Generation

jobs.descriptionHtml:
To apply, visit our website remotepro.ph/We're a family-owned business with all-local Philippines leadership and team. We've been 100% work-from-home since day one — not a pandemic pivot. We've grown by valuing our people, building long-term relationships, and doing great work for great clients.

About the Role:

You're not here to close tickets faster. You're here to make sure the same problem doesn't come back — and ideally, to catch it before it ever reaches a ticket queue.

We're looking for a Senior IT Engineer who thinks like an automator and operator first, a firefighter second. You'll handle complex Tier 2/3 escalations when they arise, but your real work is building the systems, automations, and processes that prevent issues from happening in the first place. You'll own client environments, lead from the front technically, and raise the standard of the team around you.

.The Mindset We're Looking For

The best engineers we've worked with share a few traits:

  • They hate doing the same thing twice. If they fix something manually, their next thought is: "How do I make sure no one — including me — has to do this again?"
  • They take ownership. From the moment a problem is theirs, it's theirs until it's fully resolved, documented, and won't come back
  • They think upstream. Instead of asking "how do I fix this faster?" they ask "why is this happening, and how do I prevent it?"
  • They communicate clearly. Status, blockers, and resolutions are shared openly — before being asked for
  • They keep learning. Twelve months from now, they know more than they do today — without anyone telling them to

Who Thrives Here

People who want to do genuinely good work, be trusted by their team, and build something that lasts. We move fast and hold a high bar — but we've also built an environment where people are respected, given real ownership, and invested in over time. Those things aren't in conflict here.

We're a growing MSP, which means not every process is fully documented and not every system is perfect yet. For the right engineer, that's not a problem — it's the opportunity to shape how we operate, not just execute within it.

This Role Is Not for You If:

  • You need step-by-step direction to know what to do next
  • You fix the symptom and move on without asking why
  • You treat documentation as someone else's responsibility
  • You're comfortable letting a ticket sit without following through
  • Your outside commitments regularly affect your availability and focus
  • You're looking for a stable, low-pressure remote job with a predictable routine

There's no judgment in that list — it's just not the environment. We'd rather be honest now than waste each other's time.

Responsibilities:

  • What You'll Do
  • You'll walk into a fast-moving MSP environment where clients depend on you and junior engineers look to you. Your job isn't just to solve the problem in front of you — it's to make sure the team and the environment are better because you were there.
  • That looks like:
    • Serving as the Tier 3 escalation point for complex issues across servers, networks, cloud platforms, and endpoint security — diagnosing root causes, not patching symptoms
    • Proactively auditing client environments to catch risks, vulnerabilities, and inefficiencies before they become incid...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ciklum is looking for a Senior Data Engineer to join our team full-time in Romania.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Senior Data Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and maintain Snowflake data pipelines and ETL/ELT processes
  • Write complex SQL queries, stored procedures, views and data transformations
  • Implement incremental data loading using Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks
  • Design data models and perform data validation and reconciliation
  • Optimize query performance and troubleshoot production issues
  • Apply data security controls, including role-based access control (RBAC)

Requirements:

  • Hands-on Snowflake development experience (minimum 2 years)
  • Advanced SQL, data warehousing and data modelling
  • Strong ETL/ELT and data integration experience
  • Working knowledge of Python and Git/version control
  • Understanding of Snowflake performance tuning and production support

Desirable:

  • 4–7 years of experience in data engineering or data warehousing, with a degree in Computer Science, IT or a related discipline
  • Experience working in Agile teams is preferred
  • Snowpark, dbt, Apache Airflow, Azure Data Factory / AWS Glue, cloud storage (Azure Data Lake / Amazon S3), and CI/CD

What’s in it for you?

  • Strong community: Work alongside top professionals in a friendly, open-door environment
  • Growth focus: Take on large-scale projects with a global impact and expand your expertise
  • Tailored learning: Boost your skills with internal events (meetups, conferences, workshops), Udemy access, language courses, and company-paid certifications
  • Endless opportunities: Explore diverse domains through internal mobility, finding the best fit to gain hands-on experience with cutting-edge technologies
  • Enjoy radical flexibility – work remotely or from an office, your choice

jobs.descriptionHtml:
ABOUT GENERATION:

At Generation, we believe in the power of employment to change lives. We are a global nonprofit organization that supports adults to achieve economic mobility through employment. Generation trains and places adult learners of all ages into careers that are otherwise inaccessible, working in partnership with governments, employers, and other system actors. We also conduct original research and share data insights on high-priority global workforce transition topics to inform decision-making by workforce system stakeholders. Launched in 2015, Generation comprises a global hub (Generation You Employed, or GYE) and a network of in-country affiliates. To date, the network has 150,000+ graduates and 23,000+ employers across 50 professions and 17 countries.

When learners join Generation, 91% are unemployed, of which nearly half are long-term unemployed. Three months after completing our program, graduates have a 78% job placement rate, rising to 88% within six months. Of our employed graduates, 79% are hired by repeat employers who have previously hired Generation graduates, and 89% are in jobs directly related to the profession for which we have trained them. Employed graduates immediately earn an average of 3-4X their previous earnings. Two to five years after graduation, 77% of our alumni from upper-middle income countries continue to meet their daily financial needs and 63% can save for the future. To date, Generation’s global graduates have earned more than $1.9 billion in wages. Generation graduates typically have a secondary school background, 52% are female, 28% have dependents, and the majority identify with underrepresented communities in their country.

Position Overview:

The Learning Technology & AI Innovation Lead drives the exploration, development, and implementation of technology-enabled learning solutions across Generation's global learning ecosystem. The role combines responsibility for identifying emerging opportunities in AI, rapidly developing and testing prototypes, and translating successful concepts into scalable solutions in partnership with the Digital Team. The Lead also oversees the continuous improvement and integration of Generation's existing AI-enabled learning tools, ensuring they are effectively embedded within the learning experience and aligned with evolving learner, instructor, and organizational needs. Acting as a bridge between Curriculum & Instruction, Online Learning, and Digital functions, the Lead ensures technology investments are grounded in sound pedagogy, operational feasibility, and learner impact.

Location:

This role is remote, with preference given to candidates based in Chile.

Generation is an equal opportunity employer and actively encourages applications from people of all backgrounds.

You believe what we do matters. So do we.

While we’re not able to respond to every submission, we truly appreciate you taking the time to connect with us.

Job Description:

Position Purpose

The Inventory Coordinator supports inventory and logistics operations by ensuring shipments, delivery milestones, and inventory transactions are recorded accurately and on time.

This role is responsible for monitoring shipment activity, maintaining accurate records in OTM and NetSuite, supporting inbound and outbound logistics processes, and helping ensure compliance with Nextracker’s procedures, Incoterms, title-transfer requirements, and audit controls.

The coordinator will work closely with Inventory, Logistics Operations, OTM support, internal business teams, and freight forwarders/3PL partners to resolve discrepancies, improve shipment visibility, and support timely IR/IF transactions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review shipments for missing, delayed, or incorrect OTM milestones.
  • Compare freight forwarder delivery records with OTM data.
  • Coordinate with Logistics Operations to obtain shipment schedules, pickup confirmations, delivery information, and supporting documentation.
  • Follow up with freight forwarders, in coordination with Logistics Operations, to ensure all required milestones are updated accurately and on time.
  • Coordinate with the OTM team to resolve system issues, missing milestones, and transaction exceptions.
  • Maintain an open-issue tracker and follow up through resolution.
  • Provide regular status updates and escalate overdue or high-risk issues.
  • Support month-end and quarter-end reconciliation activities.
  • Identify shipments that may impact inventory receipts, fulfillments, revenue transactions, payment processing, audit compliance, or delivery visibility.
  • Process inventory receipts and fulfillments in NetSuite in accordance with Incoterms, title-transfer, and risk-of-loss requirements.
  • Maintain accurate and timely inventory transaction records in NetSuite.
  • Validate shipment, ASN, receipt, and fulfillment data for completeness and accuracy.
  • Support SOX and other audit requirements by maintaining appropriate documentation and audit trails.
  • Collaborate with 3PL partners and internal teams to improve data accuracy, service levels, and operational performance.
  • Prepare and maintain Excel, Power BI, and other operational reports.
  • Support process improvements and other special projects assigned by management.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain Management, Logistics, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • Looking for 5+yrs experiences
  • Prior experience in logistics, inventory management, supply chain operations, or a related field is preferred but not required. Entry-level candidates who are eager to learn, highly detail-oriented, analytical, and strong problem-solvers are encouraged to apply.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data-reconciliation skills.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Experience with ERP and transportation management systems; NetSuite and OTM experience is preferred.
  • Strong Excel skills; experience with Power BI and reporting tools is preferred.
  • Understanding of global logistics, 3PL operations, Incoterms, and title-transfer concepts is a plus.
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Excellent organizational and follow-up skills.
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with teams across different time zones.
  • Knowledge of logistics processes and continuous improvement practices.

As part of our team, you will work collaboratively across the company and directly with clients to build and facilitate strategies that reduce energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions, advancing them towards a net-zero carbon world. Share your passion for solving the world’s most challenging issues at a place where you can effect real change that creates a more sustainable future – energize your career at GreenGen! GreenGen offers an opportunity to design and enhance a rewarding and fulfilling career. We are dedicated to growth creating the success of our employees through competitive base salary, incentives, education, and health and retirement benefits.

WHO WE ARE– Founded in 2011, GreenGen is an award-winning global leader assisting the world’s leading investors with executing net-zero carbon strategies to drive financial outcomes and decarbonize their assets. Our unique approach to integrating energy, capital markets, real estate, and technology helps us support our clients across diverse asset portfolios. We believe that investing in climate is profitable, and all team members have the responsibility to help our clients meet their sustainability goals while creating both financial and climate outcomes.

jobs.title: Principal Aftermarket Technical Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description Summary

As Principal Technical Product Manager – Aftermarket, you will own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for the digital solutions that support the Service & Repair value streams in support of Avionics & Electric Power & Propulsion. You will represent the customer across the end-to-end repair lifecycle, from customer request, quotation and induction through repair execution, materials and shipment to invoicing. You will lead a portfolio of ERP and enterprise applications, together with Product Owners and technical teams, to deliver measurable improvements in turnaround time, cost, quality and customer experience.

You will be accountable for all aspects (strategy, roadmap, planning, delivery and support) of the end-to-end digital lifecycle of the Service & Repair and aftermarket product portfolio, and you will directly affect the organization's ability to meet its service, repair turnaround time, quality and cost objectives. You will have significant autonomy, and you will need a high level of strategic and operational judgment to balance competing business priorities and deliver results.

Job Description

Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Product vision & strategy Set the vision, strategy and roadmap for the Service & Repair and Aftermarket product portfolio, aligned with Avionics & Electric Power & Propulsion Aftermarket business priorities.
  • End-to-end ownership Act as the technical IT owner for the full repair lifecycle: quotation, repair order induction, inspection and repair execution, materials and spare parts, shipment, invoicing and warranty.
  • Business partnership Partner with Aftermarket, Repair shops, Supply Chain, and Finance leaders to understand business problems, align IT investments and turn business outcomes into an enterprise-wide product roadmap.
  • Portfolio leadership Coordinate a portfolio of 10+ products that make up the aftermarket application suite, including ERP Oracle modules such as Service/Depot Repair, Order Management, Inventory and Procurement, plus integrated shop-floor, MRO and customer-facing applications.
  • Simplify & modernize Standardize and simplify the Service & Repair process across sites and D&S ERP Oracle instances, eliminate technical debt and customizations, and drive cost-out and modernization initiatives, including cloud and ERP transformation.
  • Data-driven decisions Define and track product KPIs (repair turnaround time, on-time delivery, quote cycle time, system availability, customer satisfaction) and use them to prioritize the roadmap and demonstrate value.
  • Delivery & risk Manage risks, scope changes, dependencies and non-standard events across multiple interdependent programs, and provide clear status reporting and communication to senior leadership.
  • Executive influence Influence executive-band stakeholders and shape strategy, resource allocation and policy for the area of responsibility.
  • Compliance by design Ensure solutions meet Aerospace quality, regulatory and compliance requirements, including traceability, airworthiness release documentation, export control, cybersecurity (CMMC, UK Cyber Essentials, etc.) and SOX.
  • Culture Build a culture of customer focus, Lean continuous improvement and high performance that drives innovation; navigate ambiguity and prioritize conflicting demands.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree from accredited university or college with minimum of 10 years of professional experience OR Associates degree with minimum of 13 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with minimum of 15 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum of 7 years of overall professional experience, including at least 3 years in ERP product mana...

jobs.title: Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform
jobs.descriptionHtml: Designation Software Engineer (Fullstack) - 2 Job Title Software Engineer (Full-stack) - AI Platform Job Description About the Role We’re hiring for a Full-stack Engineer for Flip's newly created AI Platform team. You will be working with the technology that will support and empower our various product offerings, including but not limited to payments & transfers, lifestyle products, gaming, payment gateway, and many others. You’ll be working across both front-end and back-end components — turning ideas into impactful features that enhance user experience and business efficiency. In this role, you’ll collaborate closely with Product Managers, fellow engineers, and cross-functional stakeholders to design, develop, and optimize solutions that align with our technical and business goals. You’ll also have the opportunity to continuously improve our codebase, share best practices, and explore new technologies that keep our systems robust and future ready. About Flip Rafi, Luqman, and Anjar, who were college friends in Universitas Indonesia, started Flip as a project in 2015 to transfer payments to each other at a fraction of what banks would charge them. They are pioneers in the Indonesian market, with their technology now helping millions of Indonesians, both individuals and businesses, carry out bank-to-bank money transfers through a reliable and seamless app. After ten years of operations, Flip has helped Indonesians transfer money worth several trillions of rupiah and has received double-digit funding from respectable investors such as Sequoia India, Insight Partner, and Insignia. Flip’s ultimate mission is to give Indonesians access to one of the most progressive and fairest financial services in the world. At Flip, we always strive to provide the fairest place for you to work, learn, and grow with talented and fun people in various opportunities to advance your career and get fair rewards. We believe that we have to treat employees, customers, and all stakeholders fairly and respectfully. Fair treatment for employees means we establish clear goals, facilitate our employees to achieve them, and value their contribution to the company with equitable benefits. What You'll Do: * *Develop and maintain front-end and back-end applications.* * *Collaborate with Product Managers, Engineers, and other stakeholders to deliver high-quality features.* * *Write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.* * *Participate in code reviews and provide constructive feedback.* * *Troubleshoot and debug applications.* * *Stay up to date with emerging technologies and industry trends.* * *Report directly to the Engineering Manager and will work closely with other engineers and a Product Manager in their dedicated stream.* What You'll Need: * *Have a solid background in common programming problems and solutions.* * *Experience working on both the front-end (user-facing side) and back-end (server-side)* * *Knowledge and experience in Go, React.JS, & Next.js* * *Experience in working with large data set and/or high concurrency systems is a plus.* * *Solid understanding of algorithms, algorithmic complexities, OOP, design patterns, and clean code.* * *Ability to plan, prioritize, estimate, and execute a task with a good degree of predictability.* * *Ability to scope, review and refine user stories and/or tasks for technical completeness and to alleviate dependency risk.*

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Informationen über unseren Betrieb

Unser ultramoderner Produktionsstandort in Storkow präsentiert sich als Musterbeispiel für Innovation im deutschen Geflügelsektor. Unsere Produkte verkaufen wir sowohl unter unserer Marke Friki als auch unter exklusiven Eigenmarken unserer Handelspartner. Storkow ist der pulsierende Mittelpunkt unserer Tätigkeiten. Unsere Hähnchenprodukte aus Storkow liefern wir national und international an diverse Orte, darunter auch an unsere eigenen Niederlassungen.

Für unser modernes Werk in Storkow suchen wir zur Verstärkung unseres Teams zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen verantwortungsvollen und verlässlichen Fachinformatiker (m/w/d).


Deine Tätigkeiten: 

  • Beschaffung, Installation und Verwaltung von Hard- und Software

  • Konfiguration und Betreuung von Computersystemen, Telefonanlagen, Druckern und Faxgeräten

  • Schnelle und kompetente Bearbeitung von Störungsmeldungen im Rahmen des IT-Supports

  • Betreuung Hardware-Infrastruktur

  • Beratung, Unterstützung und Schulung von Kolleginnen und Kollegen bei IT-relevanten Fragestellungen

Diese Qualifikationen solltest Du mitbringen:

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossene Ausbildung im IT-Bereich, ein entsprechendes Studium oder mehrjährige einschlägige Berufserfahrung

  • Fundierte Kenntnisse in Hard- und Software sowie in unterschiedlichen Netzwerkstrukturen

  • Erfahrung im Montieren, Warten und Reparieren von IT-Hardware

  • Teamfähigkeit, Kommunikationsstärke und eine serviceorientierte Arbeitsweise

  • Selbstständiges, strukturiertes und lösungsorientiertes Arbeiten

Das bieten wir:

• Krisensicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem „systemrelevanten“, internationalen Unternehmen

• Leistungsgerechte Entlohnung und Unternehmensvorteile wie ein Jobrad, Weihnachtsgeld, Urlaubsgeld,

Firmenfitness etc.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant SAP SD (m/w/d) S/4HANA Sales
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Als SAP & Prozessberater im Supply Chain & Manufacturing realisieren wir mit unseren Kunden eine gemeinsame Vision: Eine wettbewerbsfähige, intelligente und resiliente Supply Chain, die den Champions der Fertigungsindustrie nachhaltiges Wachstum in einem unsicheren Umfeld ermöglicht.

Unsere SSCM Practice verbindet strategische Business Beratung mit tiefgreifender Umsetzungskompetenz in der IT - von der Strategie über den Produktentstehungsprozess (PLM), Produktion (PP / PS, DM, MES, PM), Lager (WM), Qualität (QM) und Beschaffung (MM) bis hin zu Vertrieb, Zollabwicklung und Service (SD, GTS, CX. S/4 Service). Durch umfassende Value Stream Kompetenzen von Design to Operate erzeugen wir kontinuierlichen Business Value – Strategy to Execution!

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir erfahrene SAP S/4HANA Logistik Consultants (m/w/d) im Bereich Vertrieb (SAP SD).

Was dich erwartet

  • Lösungsorientierte Prozessberatung großer Industrieunternehmen mit einem Schwerpunkt in der produzierenden Industrie

  • Konzeption, Design und Implementierung von Unternehmenslösungen im Bereich SAP Logistik

  • Übernahme von Modulverantwortung im Bereich SD in nationalen und internationalen SAP Projekten

  • Change Management & Coaching

  • Unterstützung im Presales und beim Auf- und Ausbau unserer Kundenbeziehungen

  • Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen

  • Mentoring von Trainees und angehenden Senior Consultants


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Erstklassiger Hochschulabschluss in BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Maschinenbau, Logistik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 4 Jahre Berufserfahrung als SAP Logistikberater mit dem Schwerpunkt SAP SD in Prozess- und Optimierungsprojekten im Bereich Logistik

  • Idealerweise modulübergreifende Integrationskenntnisse im Bereich Logistik

  • Erste Erfahrungen als Projektleiter von fachbereichsnahen SAP Beratern oder als Teilprojektleiter in großen SAP Projekten von Vorteil

  • Selbstständige und proaktive Arbeitsweise, analytische und konzeptionelle Denkweise, ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit auf Ebene des Teams und der Abteilungsleitung in multikulturellen Umgebungen 

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft, auch für gelegentliche Auslandseinsätze

Unsere Benefits:

Aus- und Weiterbildung

SAP- und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, Competence Center-Tage, Fachspezifische Schulungen

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Im Geschäftsfeld SAP Authorizations bieten wir unseren Kunden innovative und hochindividuelle Konzeptlösungen für die Administration der Berechtigungen in ihren Systemlandschaften. Unser Expertenteam unterstützt Kunden auf verschiedenste Art und Weise auf der Suche nach der jeweils optimalen Lösung. Den IT-Teams unserer Kunden bieten wir Support bei einer großen Vielfalt von Systemen und SAP-Technologien, von klassischen ECC-Systemen bis zu den neuesten SAP Public Cloud-Versionen, inklusive S/4 HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, GTS, u.v.m.

Eine weitere Stärke unseres Teams ist das Fortbildungsangebot für Administrationsteams, Key-Usern, SAP-Moduls SpezialistInnen, und weitere InteressentInnen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir derzeit mehrere Beraterpersönlichkeiten (m/w/d) mit Erfahrung im Bereich SAP-Berechtigungen, die sich sowohl für klassische als auch für innovative SAP-Technologien begeistern und die Chance nutzen möchten, mit uns zusammen die Gestaltung der Kundenlösungen der Zukunft voranzubringen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Erstellung von prozessübergreifenden SAP Berechtigungskonzepten für SAP Systeme diverser Art (vorrangig S/4 und ECC-Systeme, jedoch auch BW, HCM, GTS, EWM, etc.)

  • Umfangreiche Analyse von bestehenden SAP Berechtigungskonzepten

  • Umsetzung des technischen Rollen-Customizing nach Anforderungen des Kunden

  • Behebung von Berechtigungsproblemen: Ursachenforschung, Erstellung und Umsetzung von Lösungsvorschlägen

  • Wartung von bestehenden Rollenkonzepten: Rollenänderungen, Rollenerweiterungen sowie periodische Wartungsaktivitäten

  • Durchführung von Präsentationen und Workshops bei Kunden und Interessenten

  • Kontinuierliche Fortbildung in den neuesten Themen rund um das SAP-Berechtigungswesen

  • Mitarbeit in einem gut eingespielten, internationalen Team von erfahrenen ExpertInnen


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Erstellung, Umsetzung und Wartung von SAP-Berechtigungskonzepten

  • Erfahrung in der Analyse und Behebung von Berechtigungsfehlern

  • Konzeptionell ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten

  • Du bist kommunikationsstark und hast Freude am Umgang mit Menschen

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

  • Reisebereitschaft, auch für gelegentliche Auslandseinsätze

jobs.title: Business Development Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Intersog is a software engineering and IT consulting company delivering custom development, dedicated development teams, and IT staff augmentation services. We partner with organizations that need high-quality technology expertise and flexible delivery models to move their products and business goals forward. Our work is centered on helping clients solve real business challenges with the right technical talent and consulting support.

As Business Development Manager, you will play a direct role in expanding Intersog's client base and driving growth for our IT staff augmentation services. This role is focused on building new business, creating strong client relationships, and turning opportunities into measurable commercial results. You will have a clear impact on revenue generation and help shape how we grow our presence in the market.

Responsibilities

  • Generate new business opportunities and acquire new clients for the company.
  • Drive sales for Intersog's IT staff augmentation services.
  • Manage the sales process proactively from prospecting through deal closure.
  • Close deals and convert opportunities into revenue.
  • Deliver revenue within the probation period.

Requirements

Required Qualifications

  • Proven sales experience in information technology staff augmentation.
  • Demonstrated success acquiring new clients, closing deals, and generating revenue.
  • Strong understanding of sales and staff augmentation services.
  • Experience selling to hiring managers and senior technology vice presidents.
  • Must be based in Canada or the United States.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Business development experience in information technology staff augmentation.
  • Experience using HubSpot.
  • Experience using LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

Working at Abbott

jobs.title: Commission-Based Recruiter – Multilingual Roles in Europe – Durban
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Same time zone as Europe. If you've worked agency or BPO desks on commission, you already know how this works, now paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Durban and across South Africa.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

jobs.title: Mid Level Data Scientist Greece
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Data Scientist, Greece
Role type: Full time
Location: Greece (fully remote)
Preferred start date: ASAP
Salary: €1400 - €3400 gross per month

ABOUT SATALIA

Satalia builds enterprise-grade AI systems for WPP and its FTSE 100 client base. Led by WPP Chief AI Officer Daniel Hulme, we run as a decentralised organisation where engineers and scientists own their domains end to end. Our data scientists are also at the core ofWPP Research, conducting frontier research and developing prototypes that evolve into tools used in production across WPP.

THE ROLE

Our current work includes:

Agentic systems. Developing long-horizon agents that plan, use tools, and collaborate. We also build the core infrastructure to ensure reliability and governance at scale, spanning context/memory, observability, traffic control, and continuous verification.

Federated and privacy-preserving learning. Training shared models when the data cannot move: federated LLM fine-tuning across independent data owners, and aggregation strategies that hold up under heterogeneous datasets.

Identity intelligence. Predictive and probabilistic modelling on large behavioural datasets: propensity and similarity models, and probabilistic record linkage across data sources.

Geospatial intelligence. Spatial statistics, geospatial feature engineering, and forecasting and optimisation over location data, plus computer vision on imagery.

Synthetic data. Generating realistic synthetic data with known ground truth to stress-test models and agents under controlled adversarial conditions.

You will own significant parts of these workstreams: choosing the modelling approach, building the training and evaluation infrastructure, and shipping to production by collaborating with engineers and domain experts across Satalia and WPP.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own well-defined components of a project, from data and modelling to evaluation.
  • Develop models, agents, and the evaluation harnesses that keep them safe and reliable.
  • Work with engineers to take your work to production.
  • Share your work clearly with the team and stakeholders, and support junior colleagues.
  • Continously upskill as the field evolves.

MUST HAVE

  • 2 to 5 years building ML/AI models in production.
  • Strong modelling skills for both structured and unstructured data.
  • Hands-on experience building LLM-powered systems.
  • Good software engineering habits: Python, version control, testing, code review.
  • Clear communication with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

NICE TO HAVE

  • Experience with temporal and geospatial data.
  • Experience building and testing agents.
  • Experience with federated learning, clean rooms, or other privacy-preserving methods.
  • Background in marketing technology, ad tech, audience modelling, or media mix modelling.
  • Publications or meaningful open-source contributions.

WHAT WE OFFER

· Healthcare benefits

· Remote working

· Flexible working hours

· Impactful projects

· Continuous learning and development

Satalia is home to some of the brightest minds in AI. If you're looking for a company that values autonomy and freedom and embraces a culture of inclusion and warmth, we'd love to hear from you.

We aim to respond to all applications within 2 weeks. If you have not heard from us within 2 weeks this means your application has been unsuccessful.

SUMMARY


The Legal Administration Specialist II performs a variety of law-related and administrative activities supporting Rackspace Technology's Legal Support Function, including workflow administration, contract support, document preparation, and legal research.


RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Conduct initial intake, triage, and management of standard legal workflows and requests.
  • Support attorneys with contract administration, document editing, formatting, and analysis.
  • Perform standard legal and factual research and compile clear, evidence-based reports.
  • Develop, manage, and deliver standard legal resources, guidelines, and training materials.
  • Interact directly with internal and external stakeholders while adhering to company policies and standards.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • High School Diploma or regional equivalent required; formal legal administration/paralegal training preferred.
  • Proven experience in legal administration, contract processing, legal research, or related administrative support.
  • Strong project management, organizational, and task-prioritization skills.

Rackspace Technology is the trusted operator of the full enterprise AI stack, from governed private cloud to AI inference and agents in production. From edge to core to cloud, we operate the infrastructure, data layer, and software integration to deliver business outcomes with the predictable cost, reliability, security, and compliance that regulated and mission-critical environments demand. We support customers in more than 120 countries with AI capabilities spanning private cloud, public cloud, applications, data and cyber resilience.


More on Rackspace Technology

Though we’re all different, Rackers thrive through our connection to a central goal: to be a valued member of a winning team on an inspiring mission. We bring our whole selves to work every day. You'll lead three-hour live onboarding calls, walk clinicians through the EHR platform and payroll system via screen share, prepare materials ahead of each session, support clinicians with follow-up questions, and flag recurring issues so the onboarding process improves over time.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About our Team:


Law360® provides breaking legal news and analysis on the most important topics legal professionals, business leaders and regulators need to stay on top of issues, safeguard clients and sharpen their competitive edge. The award-winning journalism of Law360 keeps readers connected to the latest, most essential news and insights across 70+ practice areas, industries and jurisdictions, including federal litigation, business deals, mergers & acquisitions, security and more. Law360, which serves more than 2.7 million readers every day, is owned by LexisNexis Legal & Professional® and part of RELX, a global provider of information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers.

About the role

The Account Executive drives new business and account expansion for Law360 and MLex within an assigned legal market territory. This role owns the full sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through demonstrations, proposals, negotiation, and closing.

The Account Executive builds relationships with law firm decision-makers and demonstrates how legal news and regulatory intelligence support legal practice, client service, and business development. Success requires consultative selling, disciplined territory management, accurate forecasting, and effective collaboration with account teams and Customer Success. Individual contributor position with responsibility for coordinating internal resources and influencing account strategy. No direct supervisory responsibilities.

Responsibilities:

  • Territory Strategy and Revenue Growth: Develop and execute a territory plan to achieve sales goals. Identify prospective customers, prioritize opportunities, and expand Law360 and MLex adoption within existing accounts.
  • Prospecting and Pipeline Development: Generate qualified opportunities through direct outreach, referrals, account research, industry events, and collaboration with internal sales partners. Maintain sufficient pipeline to support consistent performance.
  • Customer Discovery: Understand each firm’s practice areas, industry focus, information needs, purchasing process, and business priorities. Identify decision-makers, influencers, budget owners, and potential barriers to purchase.

From maintenance planning and flight operations to compliance and resource management, our products enable customers to optimize performance, reduce costs, and ensure regulatory compliance.

As part of a global network of specialized software companies, our aviation teams operate with entrepreneurial agility while benefiting from shared expertise, innovation, and best practices across the wider Valsoft group.

  • Measure launch success through adoption, leads, and market feedback.

Requirements

  • Track record influencing product roadmap and sales strategy, not just producing collateral.

jobs.title: Data Analyst (Loyalty & Retention)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re looking for a Data Analyst to work on our loyalty and retention mechanics. You’ll tell the team whether a mechanic actually drives more bookings, what it costs, and how to tune it.

The work goes well beyond reporting. You’ll segment partners by behavior, run and read experiments, build financial models for new program features, and turn your findings into rules that the Retention, Commercial and Finance teams act on.

Requirements

  • 2-4 years as a data or marketing/product analyst, ideally in e-commerce, travel, fintech or a marketplace.
  • Explains findings clearly to non-technical people and turns ambiguous questions into a structured plan.
  • English level B2+ (written and spoken).
  • Strong SQL: window functions, CTEs, query optimization. Experience with Vertica, Trino, PostgreSQL or similar.
  • Solid A/B testing: experiment design, power and significance, choosing the unit of randomization, calculating and interpreting results.
  • Experience with a BI tool: we use Tableau (Looker or Power BI experience is fine too).
  • Can work with large, messy data where business logic hides in free-text fields and edge cases.
  • Hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar agentic coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, etc.): writing effective prompts, working with agents, and maintaining project context files (such as CLAUDE.md) so results are repeatable.
  • Comfort building financial or scenario models in spreadsheets, with clear assumptions and adjustable parameters.
  • Proactive approach: you spot inefficiencies in reporting and analysis workflows and fix them yourself (automation, reusable queries, templates), rather than waiting to be asked.

Nice to have

  • Hands-on experience with loyalty, CRM, rewards or affiliate program analytics: points economics, liability, redemption and breakage.
  • Experience with segmentation and cohort or retention analysis.
  • Python for analysis (pandas, scipy, seaborn).
  • Experience with dbt and Airflow.
  • Methods beyond classic A/B tests (causal inference, diff-in-diff).

Benefits

  • Flexible schedules and opportunity to work remotely.
  • Ambitious and supportive team who love what they do, appreciate each other, and grow together.
  • A structured onboarding, a personal development plan, and regular internal lectures and demos from the team.
  • Internal programs for adaptation and training, development of soft skills, and leadership abilities.
  • Partial compensation for participating in external training and conferences.
  • Corporate English school: Group and individual lessons, speaking clubs with colleagues from all over the world.
  • Corporate prices on hotels and travel services.
  • MyTime Day Off - an extra non-working day without loss of compensation.

jobs.title: Strategic Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Reports to: Head of Global Support

Location: Remote, USA

About Proscia

Proscia is revolutionizing pathology, the last major frontier in healthcare to embrace digital. As a leader in pathology AI software, we are empowering pathologists and scientists to transition from traditional microscope-based workflows to digital, AI-driven approaches, unlocking new possibilities in precision medicine.

The digital pathology market is experiencing explosive growth as advances in AI enable unprecedented insights into diseases like cancer. Pathology is central to medicine, and the shift to AI-powered solutions is not just modernizing workflows—it’s transforming how diseases are diagnosed, treated, and understood. Predictions for the future of pathology show a tidal wave of adoption, with experts describing the field as “poised for the next major breakthrough” in healthcare innovation.

Backed by over $100 million in funding from leading healthcare and technology investors, Proscia is at the forefront of this revolution. Joining Proscia means being part of a company at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, where the possibilities are limitless. With the convergence of AI, precision medicine, and digital pathology, we’re not just changing pathology—we’re redefining what’s possible in medicine.

About the Role

Some customers don't file a ticket and wait. They pick up the phone and expect the person on the other end to already understand their environment and workflows. Those are your customers. Proscia’s most strategic accounts run mission-critical digital pathology at scale, and they turn to one person who owns the technical relationship end-to-end.

As a Strategic Support Engineer, you are the technical owner and trusted advisor for a portfolio of Proscia’s highest-profile customers. This isn't queue work. You know your accounts better than anyone, drive their hardest issues to resolution, and carry what you learn back to Engineering and Product so the platform evolves to meet what your customers need. You do it in an AI-first support organization, using modern tooling to move faster than the role previously allowed.

About You

You think in relationships, not tickets. You'd rather understand a customer's workflow deeply enough to anticipate the next problem than close the current one and move on. You reason from evidence and follow through relentlessly, investigating problems across software, infrastructure, and integrations until the customer has a real answer. You’re the calm voice on a major-incident call and the persuasive one in an internal prioritization debate.

You treat AI as a native part of how you work, reaching for these tools to investigate, reproduce, and communicate faster without losing the human judgment that separates a plausible answer from the right one. You know how to validate and constrain what these tools produce rather than trust them blindly. And you don't hoard what you learn; every diagnosis becomes something the team can stand on next time.

  • Own your customers. Serve as the go-to SME for your assigned strategic accounts. Own their issues, run their check-in and troubleshooting calls, maintain the documentation behind them, and monitor cases to keep them moving toward resolution. Back up the broader queue as needed.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Recruit for Europe from home, paid in euros per placement. Your own hours, your own methods. Open to recruiters based in Bogotá and across Colombia.

Please read the whole post before applying. It's long on purpose. If it isn't for you, that's completely fine, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.
  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.

This is NOT for you if

  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.
  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

jobs.title: Data Scientist Geostatistiek en Bodemdata (Freelance)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
📋 Taken en verantwoordelijkheden

In deze rol ondersteun je de beleidsafdeling bij het uitvoeren en verfijnen van statistische analyses op bodemdata. Je werkt onder meer aan de volgende onderwerpen:

Vlaams bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk

Het Vlaamse bodemkoolstofmonitoringsnetwerk werd in juli 2021 opgestart. Over een periode van 10 jaar worden bodems onder alle landgebruiken bemonsterd, waaronder bodems in waterrijke gebieden, (half-)natuurlijke graslanden en bodems die worden beheerd door overheden, lokale besturen en burgers.

Na drie werkjaren is veel data beschikbaar voor verdere statistische analyse. De resultaten moeten op termijn bruikbaar zijn voor LULUCF-rapporteringen en prognoses. Zo kunnen ze helpen onderbouwen of landbouwbodems of bodems in residentieel gebied koolstof opslaan of verliezen. Daarnaast brengen de analyses verbanden tussen verschillende bodemeigenschappen verder in kaart.

Digital Soil Mapping

Het monitoringnetwerk genereert puntdata over Vlaanderen. Om die data gebiedsdekkend te maken, combineer je puntdata met gebiedsdekkende predictoren via digital soil mapping en random forest. Een historische bodemdataset werd eerder op dezelfde manier verwerkt. Het is de bedoeling om die doorrekening te optimaliseren en af te stemmen op de verwerking van de monitoringdata.

Europese Soil Monitoring Law

De Europese Soil Monitoring Law is momenteel in onderhandeling. Als de wet wordt aangenomen, moet Vlaanderen verschillende aspecten van de monitoring van bodemdata statistisch uitklaren. Het gaat onder meer om het aantal monitoringplots, verbanden tussen verschillende methodes en de nauwkeurigheid, betrouwbaarheid en accuraatheid van de monitoring. Ook moeten monitoringseenheden worden uitgewerkt.

Indicatoren en rapportering

Je berekent indicatoren voor de opvolging van het Vlaamse bodembeleid en voor de voorbereiding van rapportering over de Europese Soil Monitoring Law. Je past bestaande methodieken toe, stuurt ze bij en werkt nieuwe methodieken uit in samenwerking met beleidsmedewerkers. Daarbij gebruik je statistische analyses, geostatistiek, datakwaliteitscontrole en machine learning. Je optimaliseert ook berekeningsmethoden.

📝 Jouw profiel

  • Ervaring met het optimaliseren en tunen van databases en queries.
  • Ervaring met digital soil mapping.
  • Ervaring met het analyseren van datastromen.
  • Ervaring met R.
  • Ervaring met de publieke sector.
  • Ervaring met databanken, in het bijzonder SQL en Oracle.
  • Kennis van geostatistiek.
  • Ervaring met machine learning.
  • Ervaring met rapportering.
  • Ervaring met scripting in Shell, Perl en Python.
  • Vertrouwdheid met het domein bodem.

⚠️ Deze functie wordt aangeboden als een deeltijdse freelance rol (50%).

This is a contingent position, meaning employment is dependent upon the successful award of the associated contract to Aretum and completion of any required background investigation or security clearance verification.

About Aretum

Aretum is a mission-driven organization committed to delivering innovative, technology-enabled solutions to our customers across defense, civilian, and homeland security sectors. Our teams work at the intersection of strategy, technology, and transformation, helping agencies solve their most critical challenges. We believe in investing in our people and creating a culture where collaboration, inclusion, and professional growth are at the forefront.

Job Summary

The Solutions Specialist serves as the senior technical lead and business solutions expert responsible for configuring, enhancing, maintaining, and optimizing the client's inventory system built on ServiceNow and Nuvolo. This individual collaborates with Government stakeholders, leads Agile delivery activities, serves as Scrum Master, and ensures that all enhancements, maintenance activities, accessibility requirements, and platform upgrades are successfully delivered.

Due to the nature of our work as a federal consulting organization, employees may be expected to handle Controlled Unclassified Information (CUI) and must adhere to applicable safeguarding and compliance requirements.

Responsibilities

  • Lead Agile software development and operations activities
  • Serve as Scrum Master, facilitating sprint planning, backlog grooming, daily coordination, sprint reviews, and stakeholder communications
  • Develop and apply advanced methods for ServiceNow and Nuvolo configuration and customization
  • Analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Create system specifications, design artifacts, workflow designs, and configuration documentation
  • Support Operations & Maintenance (O&M) activities, including defect remediation and technical troubleshooting
  • Support ServiceNow and Nuvolo platform upgrades across all environments
  • Ensure all deliverables comply with WCAG, Section 508, and accessibility standards
  • Participate in demonstrations, user acceptance testing support, deployment planning, and production releases
  • Collaborate with Government personnel to prioritize product backlog items and sprint deliverables
  • Contribute to transition-in and transition-out planning activities
  • Support preparation of monthly status reports and project documentation

Requirements

  • Minimum five (5) years of experience implementing, configuring, and supporting ServiceNow solutions
  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience)
  • Experience with ServiceNow Asset Management and workflow automation
  • Experience with Nuvolo applications and integrations
  • Experience supporting Agile software development programs
  • SAFe Fundamentals Certification or Certified Scrum Master (CSM), if serving as Scrum Master
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Federal Government clients
  • Demonstrated knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 and Section 508 accessibility requirements
  • Knowledge of ServiceNow upgrades, release management, and platform administration
  • Familiarity with USPS, inventory management, logistics, or asset management systems

At Pavago, one of our clients is hiring a Senior Accountant to lead full-cycle accounting, financial reporting, reconciliations, and month-end close activities across a growing organization.

This is more than a traditional accounting role. You’ll take ownership of maintaining accurate financial records, preparing reliable financial statements, supporting audits, improving accounting processes, and ensuring compliance with GAAP or IFRS standards.

Working closely with Finance, FP&A, Payroll, and Operations, you’ll help deliver timely financial insights that support strategic business decisions while maintaining strong internal controls and audit-ready records.

Responsibilities

General Ledger & Accounting Operations

  • Ensure the general ledger remains accurate and compliant with accounting standards.

Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

  • Maintain close checklists and ensure all reconciliations and journal entries are completed accurately.

  • Generate Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet, and Cash Flow reports for leadership.
  • Prepare variance analyses comparing actual results against budgets and forecasts.
  • Provide clear financial commentary and recommendations to support executive decision-making.

Audit, Compliance & Internal Controls

  • Support external audits by preparing PBC (Prepared By Client) schedules and supporting documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with GAAP, IFRS, and internal accounting policies.
  • Assist with sales tax, property tax, and corporate tax preparation.
  • Maintain organized, audit-ready accounting records and documentation.
  • Strengthen internal controls and ensure adherence to financial governance standards.

Process Improvement & Systems

  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting workflows and operational efficiency.
  • Reduce manual processes through automation and system enhancements.
  • Assist with ERP implementations, migrations, and accounting system improvements.
  • Develop and maintain accounting SOPs and process documentation.
  • Improve reporting accuracy, consistency, and month-end close efficiency.

Team Collaboration & Support

  • Review and support work completed by junior accountants and accounting staff.
  • Mentor team members on reconciliations, reporting, and accounting best practices.
  • Collaborate with FP&A, Operations, Payroll, and leadership teams.
  • Coordinate with Sales and Operations to ensure accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting.

Required Experience & Skills
