jobs.descriptionHtml:
Savanta is looking for a Vice President to lead market research delivery across the Americas, bringing strong, hands-on expertise in quantitative and mixed-methods research to a senior client-facing and team leadership role.

This is open to candidates working East Coast hours from anywhere in the US, or hybrid from our New York office.

About Us:

Savanta is a leading data, market research and advisory company helping the world's leading brands make better decisions, faster. With over 500 people across offices in multiple countries, we combine deep research expertise, proprietary technology and high-impact consulting to give our clients a complete view of their markets, their customers and their competitors.

About the Role:

As Vice President, you will bring your curiosity and insight storytelling to lead research programs that help answer strategic questions for your clients.

You'll own and grow an existing account portfolio, acting as a strategic advisor to clients while identifying new business opportunities that drive sustainable, double-digit year-over-year growth.

Also lead and develop a high-performing team, setting clear progression plans, managing performance, and fostering a culture of innovation and client obsession, while bringing a tech-first mindset that pushes both team and clients toward faster, technology-enabled ways of generating insight.

About You:

We're not looking for expertise in a specific sector, though prior experience in financial services research would be a strong advantage.

What matters most is strong market research experience across both quantitative and mixed methodologies, paired with the commercial acumen and leadership capability to manage a high-performing team and act as a trusted advisor to senior stakeholders.

You'll be a fast-paced, autonomous operator, comfortable delegating to senior and mid-level team members while retaining accountability for revenue, delivery quality, and team performance.

The role also works with leads across regions to share best practice and support global client relationships that intersect with Americas accounts.

Essential:

  • 8+ years of experience in delivering market research, insights, or a related consulting field.
  • Proven track record of managing and growing client revenue.
  • Experience leading and developing a team, including managing performance and career progression.
  • A genuine tech-first mindset, comfortable championing new technology and AI-enabled approaches over traditional research methods.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to operate as a strategic partner to senior client stakeholders.

And in return, Savanta offers:*

jobs.title: Senior Data Scientist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Porch Group is a leading vertical software and insurance platform and is positioned to be the best partner to help homebuyers move, maintain, and fully protect their homes. We offer differentiated products and services, with homeowners insurance at the center of this relationship. We differentiate and look to win in the massive and growing homeowners insurance opportunity by 1) providing the best services for homebuyers, 2) led by advantaged underwriting in insurance, 3) to protect the whole home.

As a leader in the home services software-as-a-service (“SaaS”) space, we’ve built deep relationships with approximately 30 thousand companies that are key to the home-buying transaction, such as home inspectors, mortgage companies, and title companies.

In 2020, Porch Group rang the Nasdaq bell and began trading under the ticker symbol PRCH. We are looking to build a truly great company and are JUST GETTING STARTED.

Job Title: Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing
Location: United States
Workplace Type: Remote


Job Summary

The future is bright for the Porch Group, and we’d love for you to be a part of it as our Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing.

As a senior member of our data science team, you will own the development and deployment of our homeowners insurance pricing and risk models, taking complex modeling problems from scoping through production deployment. While GLM-based pricing sits at the core of this role, you will also contribute to profitability and retention modeling, geospatial risk analysis, and the evaluation of emerging techniques like generative AI. You’ll partner closely with actuarial, product, and engineering teams to translate Porch’s unique property data into a durable competitive advantage in underwriting and pricing. This is an ideal role for an experienced practitioner who wants to deepen their technical expertise, support other data scientists, and drive measurable business value.


What You Will Do As A Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing

  • Contribute to modeling standards and best practices for insurance pricing and risk modeling, helping the team apply them consistently
  • Support and mentor junior data scientists through code review, knowledge sharing, and technical guidance
  • Build, validate, and deploy GLM-based models (frequency, severity, and loss cost) for homeowners insurance pricing
  • Build machine learning models (GBMs, neural networks, etc.) that drive underwriting accuracy, competitive positioning, and profitability
  • Develop ensemble models predicting insured-level profitability, customer retention, and conversion, including customer lifetime value (LTV) models to prioritize marketing and underwriting strategies
  • Incorporate non-traditional data sources, including aerial imagery, satellite data, government records, and building permits, to quantify localized risk and inform pricing and underwriting decisions
  • Partner with product, actuarial, engineering, and business stakeholders to scope initiatives and integrate data science solutions into operational workflows
  • Work with the actuarial team to develop, file, implement, and monitor new predictive models that meet regulatory requirements
  • Follow rigorous deployment practices in high-traffic environments, including A/B testing, performance monitoring, and continuous refinement
  • Evaluate emerging techniques, including generative AI and LLMs, to identify new opportunities for competitive advantage

What You Will Bring As A Senior Data Scientist, Insurance Pricing

  • 5+ years of experience in data science, with significant depth in insurance pricing or risk modeling

jobs.title: Business Development Manager, Data Center Solutions
jobs.descriptionHtml:
If you’re looking for a special place to build or grow your career, you’ve found it. Whether you’re an experienced professional, a recent college graduate or somewhere in between, IDEX is a place where you can apply your existing skills and learn new ones in an environment where you can make an impact.

With interesting opportunities in engineering, marketing, sales, supply chain, operations, HR, finance, and more across more than 40 diverse businesses around the globe, chances are, we have something special for you.

SUMMARY OF JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

The position of Business Development Manager (BDM) -Data Center Solutions, focusing on expanding market share within the rapidly growing data center market. The BDM will be responsible for selling BAND-IT products and solutions to data center projects including hyperscales, colocation providers, general contractors, and MEP firms. This role requires a proactive approach in targeting data center projects and generate leads into sales pipeline.

REPORTING TO: Global Data Center Project Leader

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Strategic Market Development: Define and execute a data center market specific business development plan to penetrate hyperscale, colocation, and enterprise data center projects.
  • Specification Sales: Proactively collaborate with data center design engineers, consultants, and Architecture & Engineering (A&E) firms to secure product specifications in the design-build phase.
  • Relationship Building: Develop and nurture relationships with decision-makers at target data center operators, Engineering, Procurement and Construction (EPC) contractors, and electrical contractors.
  • Project Lifecycle Management: Lead full project cycle sales from initial opportunity identification through proposal, negotiation, and closure.
  • Consultative Sales & Support: Act as a subject matter expert on fastening applications with customers, assisting with site surveys and technical design discussions.
  • Pipeline Management: Utilize CRM tools (e.g., Dynamics) to track opportunities, maintain accurate forecasting, and document project developments.
  • Industry Engagement: Represent BAND-IT at data center industry events, such as DCD, 7x24 Exchange, and AFCOM, to generate leads and push brand awareness.
  • Actively model IDEX values: Team, Trust, and Excellence.
  • Performs other related duties as assigned.

KNOWLEDGE, SKILLS, AND ABILITIES:

The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required to perform this job successfully.

  • Technical Acumen: Ability to read and interpret design specifications, blueprints, and 2D/3D layouts.
  • Sales Cycle Knowledge: Proven experience navigating complex, long-cycle project sales (6–18 months).
  • Networking Skills: Proven track record of networking with general contractors, engineers, and end-users.
  • Communication: Strong presentation skills with the ability to explain technical products to diverse stakeholders.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, business, or a related technical field.
  • 3–6 years of experience in B2B sales or business development, with a focus on data center infrastructure, construction fasteners, or structural mechanical solutions.
  • Direct experience selling into Hyperscales (e.g., Google, AWS, Meta) or Tier 1 Colocation providers.
  • Experience in value-engineering products to reduce installation time and operational costs.

This position is open until filled. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis.

The compensation range represents the anticipated low and high end of the pay range for this position. Actual compensation will depend on factors such as experience, skills, and internal equity.<...

Join Our Vision: We are building the next generation of Spatial Media - a new way people experience videos through interaction, multi-user presence, haptics, AI, and immersive storytelling.

DeoVR is the leading immersive streaming technology serving multiple enterprise customers and millions of users globally.

We are now expanding the boundaries of what video can be - moving from passive watching to active, interactive, multi-user journeys.

If this excites you more than it scares you, you are in the right place.

The Role

We are looking for a versatile Video Editor with a strong foundation in 2D video editing who is also open to handling other post-production tasks. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a dynamic environment, enjoys working across different aspects of post-production, and is passionate about high-quality video production and eager to expand their skills in VR post-production.

What You Will Do

  • Edit and master high-quality 2D and VR video content for various platforms

  • Make stereo correction, image and sound quality control

  • Perform color correction, grading, and sound design to enhance footage

  • Render, export, and optimize videos for different formats and platforms

  • Take care of file intake, organization, and archiving for efficient workflow

  • Troubleshoot technical or workflow issues to maintain smooth operations

  • Experiment with new post-production techniques and tools

  • Work closely with production, marketing, and content teams to align on project objectives

  • Engage with the community on forums and social media, responding to user questions, feedback, and requests

  • Proven experience in 2D video editing, with a strong portfolio showcasing your work

  • Proficiency in DaVinci Resolve, After Effects

  • Excellent organizational, file management, and multitasking skills

  • Strong problem-solving, communication, and collaboration abilities

  • Passionate about high-quality video production, innovation, and exploring latest trends and VR editing

  • Ability to quickly learn and work with new software tools.

  • Strong sense of aesthetics, style, and rhythm, with storytelling skills and creativity to work independently.

  • Fluency in English

Bonus Points

  • Familiarity with VR-specific tools like Mistika VR or Adobe VR workflows

  • Knowledge of Fusion Studio (Blackmagic)

  • Motion design skills

Hiring Process

  • HR Screening (30 min)

  • Team Interview (1 hour)

  • Case Task (2-4 hours)

  • CEO Interview (30 min)

💼Explore our hiring process

What We Offer

  • The chance to be part of a pioneering team in a rapidly evolving industry

  • Direct impact on the future of immersive media

  • Flexible working hours and remote-first culture

  • A team that values initiative, clarity, and collaboration

  • Access to all tools and tech you need

  • Unlimited DeoVR Premium

  • A work environment where ideas matter and people are treated with respect

Stay Connected

Join our Facebook community and follow updates as we advance interactive VR experiences through cutting-edge technology. Join us and step into a role where legal expertise meets innovation.

Asteris has helped veterinarians manage their diagnostic images since 2004, and we're still built by people who know veterinary medicine from the inside. Our Keystone Software Suite helps veterinary practices, hospitals, and specialists store, view, share, and report on diagnostic images easily and securely from anywhere. Asteris is part of Valsoft Corporation, which acquires and grows vertical market software companies.

The Role

As a Client Success Representative, you'll own the experience of our veterinary clients from their first day on the platform through every renewal. You'll onboard new practices, run Quarterly Business Reviews, solve everyday product questions, keep accounts healthy, and grow them through add-on modules.

This role suits someone who knows how a veterinary clinic actually runs, enjoys teaching, and isn't afraid to pick up the phone when an account needs attention. You'll work closely with our Sales, Product, and Support teams, act as the client's voice inside Asteris, and report to Jamie Phippen, Head of Customer Success.

Why Asteris

  • Made for vets, not adapted for them. Keystone is designed specifically for veterinary practices, from companion animal clinics to equine hospitals, rather than retrofitted from human medicine.
  • Clinical and software expertise under one roof. Asteris was founded by people with deep experience in both veterinary care and software, and we still build our products around feedback from the veterinarians and technicians who use them.
  • We take care of our clients ourselves. Our support team is in-house, so clients work with people who know them and the product, never a third-party call centre.
  • Connected to the tools vets already use. Keystone integrates with leading practice management systems, including DaySmart Vet and VetlinkPRO.
  • Stable backing, room to grow. As part of Valsoft Corporation, we have long-term stability while keeping the close-knit, family-values culture we were founded on.
  • Your voice shapes the product. The feedback you bring back from clients goes directly to the Product team.

What You'll Do

Onboarding

  • Lead new clients through implementation, from kickoff to go-live
  • Train veterinarians, technicians, and key stakeholders on the platform, virtually and occasionally on site
  • Set clear success goals with each practice and track progress against them

Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs)

  • Prepare and run QBRs that review usage, outcomes, and goals for the next quarter
  • Build relationships with key stakeholders, including practice owners, medical directors, and practice managers
  • Share usage insights and recommend practical next steps for each practice

Product Troubleshooting

  • Answer day-to-day product questions and resolve basic technical issues
  • Escalate complex issues to Support or Product with clear, complete information
  • Follow up until each issue is fully resolved

Account Retention

  • Monitor account health and identify at-risk clients early
  • Proactively reach out to at-risk accounts with a plan to re-engage them
  • Relay client feedback to Product and leadership to shape the roadmap
  • Keep account notes, activities, and health scores current in Salesforce

Expansion

  • Identify clients who would benefit from additional Asteris add-on modules
  • Demonstrate the key benefits of add-on modules in a way that connects to each practice's goals and workflow
  • Run product demos during QBRs, check-ins, and onsite visits...

Coordinate engineering changes and design revisions. Support equipment testing, energization, and commissioning activities. job description

The Centre of Excellence (COE) is the driving force behind SmartPA, where strategy comes to life. As part of this dynamic department, you will act as a Project Coordinator, responsible for architecting and maintaining the coordination frameworks, delivery timelines, and logistics pipelines that keep complex client accounts running flawlessly. This particular role is assigned to one of our dedicated client accounts, meaning you will represent our brand while working very closely with a global tech giant.
In this role, you will serve as the coordination engine for critical technical deployment and infrastructure programmes. By managing end-to-end recruitment pipeline logistics, technical milestones, cloud migration timelines, and stakeholder feedback logs, you will prevent operational bottlenecks. skills

jobs.title: Finance ERP Oracle Lead
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Finance ERP Oracle Lead serves as the primary liaison between DTV Finance, IT teams, and third-party vendors, to ensure that financial and accounting requirements are accurately represented and effectively implemented across the Oracle ERP ecosystem. This role leads functional system strategy, oversees operational support, and owns the month end close processes within Oracle. The Lead will translate complex financial needs into actionable technical specifications, drive system enhancements, and ensure the ERP platform supports accurate, efficient, and compliant financial operations.

Here’s what you’ll do:

Business Partnership & Liaison

  • Represent DTV Finance requirements to IT teams, the Oracle Finance Technology group, and external vendors for all new project initiatives.
  • Serve as the primary functional voice for Finance in cross departmental discussions, ensuring alignment between business needs and technical solutions.

Oracle ERP Functional Leadership

  • Act as the overall functional lead for all Oracle driven financial activities, enhancements, and optimizations.
  • Oversee configuration, testing, and deployment of updates or new functionality within Oracle financial modules.
  • Maintain deep understanding of Oracle ERP capabilities to recommend improvements and best practices.

Operational Support & Issue Resolution

  • Lead daily operational support for Oracle financial modules, resolving system issues and coordinating troubleshooting efforts with IT and vendors.
  • Monitor system performance and proactively identify opportunities to improve stability, accuracy, and efficiency.

Financial Close Ownership

  • Support system processes related to monthly, quarterly, and annual book close.
  • Ensure Oracle workflows, integrations, and data flows support timely and accurate financial reporting.
  • Partner with Finance teams to streamline close activities and reduce manual work through system automation.

Requirements Gathering & Solution Design

  • Translate complex accounting and financial needs into clear, actionable technical specifications.
  • Document business requirements, partner with IT to create functional designs, and process flows for new projects or enhancements.
  • Collaborate with IT and vendors to ensure solutions meet functional, compliance, and performance expectations.

What you’ll need to be successful:

Required

  • Strong functional expertise in Oracle ERP financial modules, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting, ARCS, and other related financial components.
  • Strong understanding of accounting principles, financial operations, and month end close processes.
  • Proven experience acting as a liaison between Finance and IT organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot complex system issues and lead cross functional resolution efforts.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate between technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

Preferred

  • Experience with Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials or similar financial ERP applications.
  • Background in project management or business process redesign.
  • Familiarity with integrations between Oracle and third-party financial systems.
  • Experience working with external vendors or managed service providers.

jobs.title: Research Scientist 2
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Become a part of our caring community

Role Overview
The Research Scientist 2 applies statistical, epidemiologic, and analytical methods to healthcare data to evaluate clinical program performance, understand drivers of outcomes, and support clinical and business decision-making.

This role will be part of the Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team supporting the performance management and evaluation of clinical programs. The Research Scientist 2 will design and execute rigorous outcomes studies, conduct deep-dive analyses to diagnose program performance, and translate complex analytical findings into clear recommendations for clinical, operational, and business partners.

The role requires strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to approach moderately complex analytical questions independently while seeking guidance on more complex or ambiguous methodological issues.

Humana’s Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team is seeking a Research Scientist 2 (Remote) to support the evaluation and performance management of clinical programs.

At Humana, we are focused on transforming the healthcare experience by improving health outcomes, managing healthcare costs, and advancing operational excellence. The Quality & Cost Strategy Analytics team operates at the intersection of clinical strategy, analytics, and enterprise value, using rigorous research and advanced analytics to inform clinical priorities and improve outcomes for our members.

Our team partners across the organization to identify opportunities, evaluate and optimize clinical solutions, and generate actionable insights that support high-value care. We apply rigorous performance measurement and research methods to understand what is working, for whom, and why, and translate those insights into opportunities for continuous program improvement.


Responsibilities

As a Research Scientist 2, you will:

  • Design and execute outcomes studies to evaluate the clinical, utilization, and financial performance of clinical programs using observational and experimental methods.
  • Apply causal inference, epidemiologic, and statistical methods to estimate program impact and generate credible evidence for decision-making.
  • Conduct deep-dive analyses using medical and pharmacy claims, enrollment, and operational data to identify key performance drivers, diagnose performance gaps, and uncover opportunities for improvement.
  • Translate clinical and business questions into clearly defined analytical questions and hypotheses, partnering with senior scientists as needed on more complex study designs and methodologies.
  • Partner with clinical, operational, financial, and business stakeholders to translate analytical insights into recommendations that inform clinical strategy, program design, contracting, and performance improvement.
  • Develop high-quality analytical reports, presentations, and executive-level readouts for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Translate complex methodologies and findings into clear, actionable business insights, communicating both implications and analytical limitations to technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Independently determine appropriate analytical approaches and make sound methodological decisions in complex or ambiguous situations.
  • Manage multiple analytical priorities while maintaining high standards for methodological rigor, accuracy, and reproducibility.

Required Qualifications

  • Master’s degree or PhD in Epidemiology, Biostatistics, Economics, Statistics, Health Services Research, Clinical Informatics, or a related quantitative discipline.

About Elements

Elements is building a foundational platform to automate and connect high-stakes finance workflows. We are in advanced beta, live with early customers, and preparing for a full production launch. The product is already operating in demanding, real-world environments.  This is a rare moment to join early with real traction and low execution risk. We are well funded, actively used by multiple customers, and seeing strong inbound demand as we prepare to scale.

The Opportunity

We are hiring Software Engineer as a foundational team member. This fully remote role offers deep ownership over core services, interfaces, and system architecture as we move from advanced beta to production. You will work directly with the founders and influence technical direction, product decisions, and engineering standards.

What You’ll Do

  • Design and build backend and frontend services from the ground up.

  • Own major architecture components as the platform scales.

  • Drive the product from advanced beta to production readiness.

  • Write clean, scalable code using Java (Spring Boot) and React.

  • Collaborate closely with founders in a high‑autonomy environment.

  • Establish engineering best practices as the team grows.

Who We’re Looking For

  • Strong understanding of application architecture and system design.

  • Proven track record building production systems end to end.

  • Ability to balance quality engineering with startup pace.

  • Ownership mindset with experience in zero‑to‑one environments.

  • Strong problem‑solving skills and technical judgment.

  • Experience with Java, Spring Boot, Python, React, or similar technologies.

Why Join Elements

  • Real ownership in a category‑defining product.

  • Meaningful equity as a founding team member.

  • Direct impact on how critical finance systems operate.

  • A small, experienced team focused on building the right way.

jobs.title: HRBP - HR People Management
jobs.descriptionHtml: Department People LevelExperienced (Individual Contributor) LocationJakarta The People team plays a crucial organisational role in Shopee by channeling important resources to key functions in the company. People are key to Shopee’s growth, and as our business expands, so does the need to develop and support our employees. Job Description: * Drive and socialize Human Resource (HR) standards and strategic practices by providing tailored guidance, data-backed insights, and solutions on People matters to business leaders, ensuring all strategic decisions align with HR perspectives within the project period. * Maintain annual and quarterly manpower planning, oversee employee selection, orientation, onboarding, offboarding, and internal transfers, ensuring complete alignment with company policies and prevailing Indonesia Labor Law. * Generate regular analytical reports and updates regarding HR metrics, operational issues, and project milestones for both the HR Lead and Business Leaders. * Evaluate and resolve complex Legal or Industrial Relations issues to maintain strict compliance with internal regulations and statutory labor standards. * Conduct thorough, objective, and efficient workplace investigations for HR-related concerns, formulating comprehensive action plans and corrective measures. * Perform deep-dive operational analytics and gap analyses on existing business processes to enable HR to design, launch, and execute targeted programs, initiatives, and organizational solutions. * Collaborate closely with the HR Lead and cross-functional stakeholders to resolve intricate HR business issues that require specialized functional expertise and strategic intervention. * Formulate, review, and revise department-specific HR policies and operational guidelines for assigned business units to maintain organizational scalability. Requirements: * Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, Industrial Engineering, Law, or a related field. * Minimum 3 years of relevant professional experience in human resources business partnering, organizational development, or HR generalist area. * Hands-on experience in managing end-to-end employee lifecycle processes, manpower planning, industrial relation, organization structure analysis and performance management.

jobs.title: Senior Consultant SAP Cloud und Process Integration (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Unsere Kunden beraten wir im Bereich Enterprise Integration umfassend beim Design und der Implementierung von system- und unternehmensübergreifenden Prozessen. Durch unsere langjährige Expertise und enge Zusammenarbeit mit SAP sowie unserer breiten Kundenbasis gehört die cbs zu den führenden deutschen Beratungsunternehmen im Bereich SAP-Integration.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir SAP Berater oder Entwickler (m/w/d), die sich gezielt in Richtung Cloud Integration weiterentwickeln wollen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Schnittstellendesign und -entwicklung auf Basis von SAP Integration Suite, SAP Cloud Integration, SAP API Management, SAP Event Mesh, SAP TPM und SAP Process Orchestration / SAP Process Integration

  • Integration von Cloud-Anwendungen (SAP, Salesforce, Microsoft etc.), IoT-Services und externen Partnern

  • Evaluierung von neuen SAP Technologien und Unterstützung des gezielten Know-how-Aufbaus

  • Technische Beratung und Entwicklung in globalen SAP Einführungs- & Rolloutprojekten und Migrationsprojekten nach SAP Integration Suite

  • Etablierung von KI im Integrationskontext: Neue Methoden und Tools für Schnittstellendesign, -entwicklung und -betrieb; Integration Design für Agentic AI

  • Möglichkeit von internationalen Projekten als auch reduzierter Reisetätigkeit

  • Vielseitige fachliche Betätigungs- und Weiterentwicklungsmöglichkeiten im Leistungsumfeld der cbs Business Technology: S/4HANA, Teilprojektleitung, SAP Business Technology Platform, eInvoicing, etc.


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Mehrjährige Berufs- und Projekterfahrung im Bereich SAP Process Integration, SAP Process Orchestration und/oder SAP Integration Suite

  • Know-how im Bereich SAP Schnittstellenentwicklung und Programmierkenntnisse in ABAP und/oder Groovy/Java

  • Idealerweise Erfahrung mit EDI-Kommunikation (EDIFACT, VDA, SAP B2B Add-On, Seeburger, etc.), SAP Process Orchestration oder in einem SAP Logistikmodul (SD, MM)

  • Interesse an neuen Technologien und Innovationen rund um SAP Technologie und Integration

Unsere Benefits:

Aus- und Weiterbildung

SAP- und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, Competence Center-Tage, Fachspezifische Schulungen

Betriebliche Gesundheitsförderung

Zuschuss zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Zusatzversicherungen, diverse Sportangebote wie Urban Sports Club, Yoga etc.

Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Der Geschäftsbereich Cloud Platform beschäftigt sich mit der Digitalisierung der Geschäftsprozesse unserer Kunden. Unabhängig von der aktuellen Systemarchitektur - ob Cloud, Hybrid oder On-Premise - die Beraterinnen und Berater planen gemeinsam mit den Kunden die End-to-End Architektur und entwickeln nutzerfreundliche Apps auf der SAP Business Technology Platform (ehemals SAP Cloud Platform). Dabei werden innovative technologische Ansätze wie z.B. Machine Learning genutzt, um die konkreten Herausforderungen unserer Kunden zu lösen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams im Bereich Cloud Platform, suchen wir an allen cbs Standorten Senior Consultants / Architekten (m/w/d), die gerne Verantwortung übernehmen und in einem stark innovativen Umfeld arbeiten möchten.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Spannende Projekte im Bereich Digitalisierung von End-to-End Prozessen

  • Design, Konfiguration und Implementierung von modernen SAP Anwendungen auf Basis von Business Technology Platform in Kombination mit anderen SAP Anwendungen

  • Projekt- und Kundenverantwortung für cbs Projekte auf der Bereich Business Technology Platform

  • Einsatz von neuen Technologien wie Business Technology Platform, HANA, SAPUI5, Machine Learning, Blockchain, IoT

  • Evaluierung von neuen SAP Technologien und Unterstützung des gezielten Know-how-Aufbaus


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss in (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-) Ingenieurwesen, Naturwissenschaften, Mathematik oder über eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Du hast mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als SAP-Experte und kannst solide Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren SAP Technologien vorweisen, wie z.B. Business Technology Platform, ABAP, Fiori, HANA, Integration, OData, SAPUI5, ERP, Java, Enterprise Portal, S/4HANA

  • Expertise im Bereich ERP und/oder S/4HANA und ein gutes Verständnis für End-to-End Prozesse

  • Du bist motiviert Verantwortung zu übernehmen, kommunikationsstark und kundenorientiert

  • Reisebereitschaft

Aus- und Weiterbildung

SAP- und Salesforce-Zertifizierungen, Competence Center-Tage, Fachspezifische Schulungen

Wir fangen da an, wo der SAP Standard endet - Im Bereich Business Application Technology beraten wir unsere Kunden im Rahmen der Transformation zu S/4HANA dabei, passende Zielarchitekturen aufzuzeigen sowie hybride Landschaften nachhaltig und flexibel zu entwickeln.

Dabei setzen wir state-of-the-art Technologien wie ABAP, On-stack extensibility/ Cloud ABAP, RAP, HANA, OData oder SAPUI5 / Fiori ein. Wir agieren als Experte für komplexe IT-Landschaften und Pionier der Digitalen Transformation im Umfeld von S/4HANA und BTP bei namhaften Industriekunden.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir mehrere kommunikationsstarke SAP Technical Consultant / Solution Architects (m/w/d) an unseren Standorten Heidelberg, Hamburg, Dortmund, München, Freiburg, Raunheim und Stuttgart, die gerne in einem dynamischen Umfeld Verantwortung übernehmen.

Was Dich erwartet

  • SAP-Technologie-Beratung und Teilprojektleitung für den Technologie Stream in komplexen Transformationsprojekten und in globalen SAP S/4HANA-Template- und Rollout-Projekten

  • Fachliche Führung des Technology Streams als Teilprojektleiter oder Solution Architect in großen SAP Projekten von der Vertriebsphase bis zum Go- Live

  • Eigenständige Analyse funktionaler Kunden- Anforderungen, Konzeptionierung und Realisierung von IT Lösungen unter Einsatz von state-of-the-art Technologien wie ABAP 7.4+, Cloud ABAP, RAP, HANA, SAPUI5 oder IoT, im Umfeld von S/4HANA und BTP

  • Führung, Coaching und fachliche Weiterentwicklung von Teammitgliedern in fachlichen und methodischen Fragen

Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption und Umsetzung der unternehmensweiten, neuen Planungslandschaft.

Wir suchen ab sofort SAP Senior Consultants (m/w/d) im Bereich IBP (Integrated Business Planning) für unsere Standorte Heidelberg, Hamburg, Dortmund, München, Stuttgart, Berlin, Frankfurt, Düsseldorf und Freiburg.

  • Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung von SAP SCM Projekten bei großen national und international agierenden Industrieunternehmen

Hier wird der Unterschied gemacht: Von der Beziehung zu den Zulieferern, über die Logistik und die Herstellung des eigentlichen Produktes, bis hin zur nachhaltigen Kundenbeziehung. Unsere Kunden haben diesen End-2-End Prozess über Jahrzehnte verfeinert und optimiert. Als marktführende Prozess- und Technologieberatung im Bereich Supply Chain Management helfen wir ihnen dabei, diesen auch in einer zukunftstragenden digitalen ganzheitlichen Target-Landscape durchgehend, resilient und innovativ als auch ergebniswirkend zu gestalten

Wir suchen ab sofort mehrere Senior Consultants (m/w/d) im Bereich Supply Chain Planning aus dem Beratungsgeschäft sowie Prozessexperten aus der Industrie.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Die Chance, die Zukunft von Weltmarkführern in abwechslungsreichen und herausfordernden Projekten aktiv und nachhaltig mitzugestalten

  • Prozessberatung im Bereich Supply Chain Planning, Logistics & Manufacturing, mit Fokus auf die taktische Planungsebene zur Unterstützung der Strategieumsetzung

  • Eigenverantwortliche Durchführung von SCM Projekten bei großen national und international agierenden Industrieunternehmen

  • Konzeption und Design von effizienten Prozessen, Organisations- & Governance-Strukturen sowie Kennzahlensystemen zur Realisierung der integrierten Geschäftsplanung

  • Implementierung und technische Umsetzung der Ergebnisse entlang der gesamten Supply Chain gemeinsam mit Technologieexperten

  • Durchführung von Workshops und Schulungen


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Erstklassiger Hochschulabschluss in BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik,

  • (Wirtschafts-)Ingenieurwesen, Logistik oder vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung als Berater oder Experte im Bereich Supply Chain Management

  • Erfahrung in der Durchführung von SCM Projekten

  • Kreativität zur Erarbeitung kundenspezifischer Lösungsansätze

Unsere SLT Berater mit Fokus auf SAP System Performance Optimierung unterstützen das Team und den Kunden bei der Minimierung der Migrationslaufzeit.   • Kenntnisse in Employee Central Payroll (ECP) sind ein plus

  • Erfahrung in der Beratung oder Betreuung von Payroll-Prozessen und deren Digitalisierung

Der Bereich System Landscape Transformation (SLT) der cbs ist eine der tragenden Säulen unseres Beratungs- und Produktangebotes. Dabei bietet cbs einen ganzheitlichen Transformationsansatz – von der Strategieableitung über die Prozessdefinition bis hin zur Implementierung und Transformation liefern wir alles aus einer Hand. Du arbeitest an den spannendsten Transformationen im SAP-Umfeld, von M&A-getriebenen Carve-outs bis hin zu globalen S/4HANA-Transformationen. Dabei verbindest du Business-Prozesse, Daten und Systemlandschaften zu einer ganzheitlichen Zielarchitektur. 

Ob Datenkonvertierungen, Migrationen zwischen SAP-Systemen, von Non-SAP nach SAP oder Selective Data Transition – der Bereich SLT begleitet und berät unsere Kunden auf ihrem individuellen Weg der digitalen Daten- und Systemtransformation. 

Dabei setzen wir gezielt unsere Standardsoftware cbs ET Enterprise Transformer for SAP S/4HANA® ein, um auch komplexeste Transformationsszenarien effizient, skalierbar und sicher umzusetzen. 

Du bewegst dich dabei an der Schnittstelle von Business, IT und Daten über alle Ebenen hinweg und entwickelst Lösungen, die nicht nur konzeptionell überzeugen, sondern auch in der Umsetzung funktionieren. Insbesondere zu Beginn der Projekte schaffst du maßgeblichen Mehrwert und stellst sicher, dass die Umsetzung zielgerichtet und effizient erfolgt, ohne dich langfristig in der Implementierung zu verlieren.

jobs.title: Werkstudent - AI Manager Support (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Im Bereich Practice Transformation gestalten wir die Zukunft unserer Beratungs- und Projektarbeit mit Künstlicher Intelligenz. Unser Team AI Enabled Projects & Processes sorgt dafür, dass KI nicht nur verfügbar ist, sondern einen echten Mehrwert in Projekten, PMO-Routinen und Beratungsprozessen schafft.

Als Werkstudent (m/w/d) AI Manager Support unterstützt Du den AI Manager dabei, die Einführung und Nutzung von KI in Transformationsprojekten voranzutreiben. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von AI-Tools, Projektteams und PMO, analysierst Nutzungsmuster, entwickelst AI Use Cases mit und trägst dazu bei, KI-Lösungen erfolgreich in den Projektalltag zu integrieren.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Unterstützung des AI Managers bei der Planung, Umsetzung und Nachverfolgung von AI-Adoption-Maßnahmen sowie im Projekt- und PMO-Umfeld.

  • Erstellung und Analyse von KPI-Reports und Dashboards zur Nutzung von KI-Tools sowie Ableitung von Optimierungspotenzialen und Handlungsempfehlungen.

  • Mitarbeit bei der Entwicklung und Einführung von AI Use Cases, einfachen Automatisierungen und Proof of Concepts (z. B. mit Microsoft Copilot, Copilot Studio oder Power Automate).

  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Enablement-Materialien wie Trainingsunterlagen, Click-Guides, Prompt Libraries und How-to-Dokumentationen.

  • Dokumentation und Strukturierung von AI Use Cases, Best Practices und Projektwissen sowie Aufbau wiederverwendbarer Inhalte und Toolkits.

  • Unterstützung bei der Identifikation von Nutzungshürden und Entwicklung pragmatischer Maßnahmen zur erfolgreichen Integration von KI in den Projektalltag.


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Eingeschriebene/r Bachelor- oder Masterstudent/in der Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen, BWL mit Tech-Fokus oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs.

  • Interesse an generativer KI, AI Adoption und digitalen Technologien sowie erste praktische Erfahrungen mit KI-Tools, Microsoft 365, Power Platform oder Low-Code-/No-Code-Lösungen sind von Vorteil.

  • Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, Daten auszuwerten und daraus konkrete Handlungsempfehlungen abzuleiten.

  • Technisches Grundverständnis für Automatisierung, Datenanalyse und digitale Prozesse; Kenntnisse in Power BI, Excel, Python, SQL oder APIs sind ein Plus.

  • Kommunikationsstärke und Teamfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, technische Inhalte verständlich für unterschiedliche Zielgruppen aufzubereiten.

  • Eigeninitiative, Neugier und Lernbereitschaft sowie Interesse an Projektarbeit, Prozessoptimierung und der erfolgreichen Einführung von KI-Lösungen im Unternehmensumfeld.

jobs.title: Salesforce Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Ciklum is looking for a Salesforce Engineer to join our team full-time in Poland.

We are a custom product engineering company that supports both multinational organizations and scaling startups to solve their most complex business challenges. With a global team of over 4,000 highly skilled developers, consultants, analysts and product owners, we engineer technology that redefines industries and shapes the way people live.

About the role:

As a Salesforce Engineer, become a part of a cross-functional development team engineering experiences of tomorrow.

The company is on an incredible journey to become the universal symbol of trust. As the world's largest independent consumer review platform, they bring consumers and businesses together to foster transparency and improvement. With over 300 million reviews and 64 million monthly active users, the work we do together has a massive global impact, helping millions of people make better choices every day. In this role, you will join the Go To Market department within the Technology organization. You will be pivotal in delivering large strategic projects and change requests across the Salesforce platform, supporting commercial, marketing, ops, and customer service teams. You will work as a key link with the business-wide team responsible for the entire company’s Salesforce ecosystem, working with a proactive approach to operational excellence, system architecture, code quality, and process automation.

Responsibilities:

  • Salesforce Development & Architecture: Design, develop, and implement custom Salesforce solutions using Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), and platform automation (Flows)
  • Integrations & APIs: Build and maintain secure integrations between Salesforce and internal/external systems using REST, SOAP, and various API integration patterns
  • Declarative & Automated Solutions: Develop and maintain complex Salesforce Flows and process automations, balancing programmatic capabilities with declarative best practices for optimal performance and scalable architecture
  • Collaborative Engineering & Peer Review: Participate in code reviews, troubleshooting, unit testing, and quality assurance alongside the cross-functional GTM Tech team and broader Salesforce engineering ecosystem
  • DevOps & Delivery: Apply change management via standard CI/CD pipelines, using version control tools (e.g., GitHub) and deployment workflows for smooth project delivery
  • Documentation & Compliance: Maintain comprehensive technical documentation, system auditing evidence, and integration/customization processes
  • Team Growth & Support: Collaborate closely with technical and non-technical stakeholders, provide support and guidance to junior team members/administrators, and contribute to an inclusive knowledge-sharing environment

Requirements:

  • We are looking for engineers with a strong background in Salesforce development and apassion for high-quality, scalable code
  • Experience: 4+ years of hands-on experience as a Salesforce Developer & Administrator, specifically with Salesforce Service Cloud
  • Core Declarative & Programmatic Skills: Expert proficiency in Apex, Visualforce, Lightning Web Components (LWC), SOQL/SOSL, and platform automation tools (Salesforce Flows)
  • Web Fundamentals: Solid understanding of web technologies including HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
  • Integrations & Security: Experience with Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP, Bulk) and understanding of Salesforce security models (profiles, permission sets, sharing rules, roles)
  • Quality & QA: Strong focus on unit testing, debugging, and familiarity with automated testing frameworks (e.g., Provar)
  • DevOps & Developer Tools: Salesforce CLI, version control (GitHub), and CI/CD tools

jobs.title: Professional Fee QA Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is a leading provider of Revenue Cycle Management (RCM) and Risk Adjustment services, helping healthcare organizations optimize operations, improve financial performance, maintain compliance, and enhance the patient experience. Recognized as a KLAS® Top Performer, GeBBS combines innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to excellence to deliver measurable results for clients across the healthcare industry. We are dedicated to being a trusted healthcare partner by upholding the highest standards of quality, information security, and compliance.

At GeBBS, we foster a collaborative and growth-oriented culture where employees are empowered to develop their skills, advance their careers, and make a meaningful impact in transforming healthcare.

GeBBS Healthcare Solutions is seeking an experienced Professional Fee (ProFee) Inpatient & Outpatient Coding Auditor to join our team in a remote, part-time capacity, Monday-Friday

The ideal candidate brings a strong background in professional fee coding and auditing across hospital-based inpatient and outpatient services, with expertise in ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS, and modifier assignment to include Hospital E/M leveling, Bedside procedures, Office E/M leveling and in-office procedures.

In this role, you will conduct coding audits, identify compliance risks, evaluate documentation accuracy, and provide meaningful feedback and education to coding professionals. Your expertise will help ensure coding accuracy, regulatory compliance, reimbursement integrity, and continuous quality improvement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct comprehensive audits of professional fee inpatient and outpatient coding to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with coding guidelines and payer requirements.
  • Review medical records and validate ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, and modifier assignments to include Hospital E/M leveling, Bedside procedures, Office E/M leveling and in-office procedures..
  • Identify coding errors, documentation gaps, compliance risks, and opportunities for improvement.
  • Evaluate appropriate modifier usage, code selection, and sequencing in accordance with applicable guidelines.
  • Ensure compliance with CMS regulations, Official Coding Guidelines, Coding Clinic guidance, NCCI edits, OCE edits, and payer-specific policies.
  • Prepare clear, detailed audit reports outlining findings, recommendations, and educational opportunities.
  • Provide constructive feedback, coaching, and coding education to improve accuracy and consistency.
  • Monitor coding quality trends, identify root causes of errors, and recommend corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with coding leadership and operational teams to support quality assurance and process improvement initiatives.
  • Research coding updates, reimbursement regulations, and payer guidelines to maintain compliance with industry standards.
  • Meet established productivity, quality, and turnaround time expectations.

Required Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years of professional fee coding experience within hospital-based inpatient and/or outpatient settings.
  • Minimum 2 years of coding auditing, quality assurance, compliance, or coding education experience.
  • Active CPC, CPMA, or equivalent AHIMA/AAPC certification required.
  • Strong proficiency in ICD-10-CM, CPT, HCPCS Level II, and modifier assignment.
  • Demonstrated knowledge of professional fee coding guidelines, Medicare, Medicaid, commercial payer requirements, and reimbursement methodologies.

We are seeking a Senior Backend Developer to join a cross-functional team operating in the alcoholic beverage industry, specifically within a B2B e-commerce platform that is already active in 30 countries. This client is one of our largest partners, and this role is vital for the transformation and continuous improvement of the business model and the scaling of the application. In this position, you will work collaboratively across the full lifecycle — build, deployment, hypercare, steady-state operation, and L3 on-call — partnering closely with partner technical teams throughout.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
CREATOR MANAGER (Germany) - SMT GROUP

Germany market | Up to €4,000 per month

OWN CREATOR GROWTH FOR GERMANY WITHIN AN INTERNATIONAL ECOMMERCE GROUP

SMT Group is building the next generation of creator-led growth across its portfolio of international arts and crafts brands. With more than five million customers across 20+ countries, we're looking for a German Creator Manager to help make our German creator community one of the strongest in the group.

This is an opportunity to drive creator-led growth in one of SMT Group's key markets. You'll identify and activate high-performing creators, build a scalable network of content partners and turn creator relationships into a consistent pipeline of winning content for Meta, TikTok Shop and affiliate channels. You'll help turn creator activity into measurable commercial growth, while strengthening the brand's connection with its customers.

ABOUT SMT GROUP

Founded in 2016, SMT Group operates a portfolio of digitally native arts and crafts brands, led by DIY Malen nach Zahlen in Germany, Schilder op Nummers in the Netherlands and DIY Art Club across international markets.

DIY Malen nach Zahlen has spent more than seven years building a substantial presence in German eCommerce, serving over one million customers. This is an established, locally relevant brand with a large customer community and an exciting opportunity to strengthen the way it connects with people through creator-led content.

DIY Malen nach Zahlen - Germany

The group operates at serious international scale, invests €200,000 per day on Meta advertising and launches more than 100 new product designs each week. SMT has launched with Trybe, opening a significant opportunity to scale creator-led affiliate activity alongside its established paid-social engine. TikTok Shop is about to launch, adding another major growth channel. Its products are made to be experienced and shared - ideal for creative storytelling, demonstrations, transformations and enthusiastic communities.

The ambition is simple: become the world's leading eCommerce group for creative hobby products. Germany is an important part of that journey.

THE OPPORTUNITY

You'll be the person who knows the German creator landscape inside out: who is emerging, who genuinely connects with audiences, what content resonates and which relationships are worth investing in.

Working with the international community team, Media Buyers and Creative, you'll develop and run creator activity that produces compelling content, strengthens brand affinity and informs better marketing decisions.

This is a hands-on role with genuine ownership. You'll help shape how German customers see and connect with DIY Malen nach Zahlen, influencing brand perception, customer relationships and the content that brings its products to life. You'll have the backing of an international business, access to a growing creator programme and the freedom to bring local insight and initiative to the table. You'll be close to the action as SMT scales its Trybe affiliate ecosystem and launches TikTok Shop, helping German creators produce content that can win organically and as paid advertising.

Build the German creator network

Deliver standout creator campaigns

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer - Design Systems
jobs.descriptionHtml:
"We may say most aptly that the Analytical Engine weaves algebraic patterns just as the Jacquard loom weaves flowers and leaves."

— Ada Lovelace, 1843

What Lovelace saw in the loom was the pattern — flowers and leaves, repeated faithfully, each one begun by a hand that chose it. Mercury is built from patterns too. Every component, every interaction our customers come to trust, starts with someone deciding how it should go, and making it good enough to be used again and again. Tending those patterns, and giving everyone at Mercury the means to weave with them, is the work of our Design System team, and the north star of this role.

As a Senior Frontend Engineer on the Design Systems team, you will build and care for those patterns: the components and foundations that everything else at Mercury is built on. Done well, a single decision here makes every product team faster.

The ground under that work is shifting, though. Software is being built in new ways, and AI is increasingly part of how design systems are made and used. We are looking for someone who is fluent at that intersection: deeply versed in design systems, and equally as serious about what it takes to build a system that holds up at the leading edge of AI.

As part of this role, you will:

  • Build and maintain the components, patterns, and foundations (tokens, type, color, layout) that Mercury's product is woven from, holding a high bar for accessibility, performance, and pixel-level craft.
  • Lead projects that ship new UI patterns to solve real pain points for product teams, helping them build better experiences faster.
  • Develop a design system that's as ready for AI as it is for people, applying the technology to create leveraged outcomes.
  • Invest in the design system's prototyping experience, shaping the next iteration of how our design function rapidly prototypes, iterates on the product, and explores new concepts.
  • Raise the craft and AI fluency of the people around you, through mentorship and clear best practices.

The ideal candidate for the role:

We're looking for someone who cares about the foundational work that lets other people do their best work, and who's eager to help define what a design system means in a world where agents build alongside us. A successful candidate will likely have:

  • 7+ years of frontend development, with deep experience in React, TypeScript, and modern web technologies.
  • Experience building or maintaining a design system or shared component library.
  • A thorough command of modern frontend tooling: build systems, CI/CD, and testing.
  • High agency, and comfort creating clarity in ambiguous spaces. You take ownership and move without waiting for a defined path.
  • First-principles systems thinking that stays oriented to outcomes. You make clear decisions that drive toward results instead of getting stuck in open questions.
  • Strong product taste, and an instinct for leverage: the change that makes many teams better, not the one component polished in isolation.
  • Hands-on fluency at the intersection of AI and software development: a real command of how emerging AI paradigms are changing the way software gets built, and the ability to turn that into practical leverage, both for the design system itself and for the people who build on it.

If this role interests you, we invite you to explore our public demo at .

*Mercury is a fintech company, not an FDIC-insured bank. Banking services provided through Choice Financial Group and Column N.A., Members FDIC.

jobs.title: Materials Scientist - Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Description: Materials Scientist (Nanoparticle Sizing & Lot Release)

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced Materials Scientists specializing in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation to contribute to an advanced nanomaterial assessment and AI training project.

The role focuses on evaluating nanoparticle characteristics using Transmission Electron Microscopy (TEM) and Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM). You will perform independent technical analysis, interpret complex micrographs, validate measurements, and provide expert assessments to support material qualification and quality control.

No prior AI experience is required. Strong domain expertise and analytical skills are essential.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Manually analyze TEM and SEM micrographs to assess nanoparticle size, distribution, and morphology.
  2. Determine and document particle size distributions (PSD) with accuracy and reproducibility.
  3. Establish and communicate lot-release acceptance criteria using technical reference cases and quality control standards.
  4. Prepare detailed reports outlining findings, methodologies, and recommendations for material qualification.
  5. Validate measurement techniques through manual calibration, image thresholding, and comparison with reference data.
  6. Participate in technical discussions and provide expert insights on nanomaterial characterization and quality control.
  7. Communicate technical findings and recommendations clearly to support collaboration and knowledge sharing across project teams.

Required Qualifications

  1. Advanced knowledge of nanomaterial characterization, particularly using TEM and SEM techniques.
  2. Hands-on experience in nanoparticle sizing, particle size distribution analysis, and lot release evaluation.
  3. Proficiency in manual image analysis, including thresholding, calibration, and complex morphology interpretation.
  4. Strong understanding of quality control standards and reference material qualification protocols.
  5. Ability to independently evaluate and validate technical reference cases without relying on AI-based tools.
  6. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical reporting skills.
  7. Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  8. Background in materials science, scientific consulting, or laboratory-based analytical roles is preferred.

Our Treasures clients have access to personalised advice and support from proficient relationship managers, seasoned investment counsellors, specialised bancassurance professionals and dedicated assistant relationship managers. As a Treasures Relationship Manager, our clients’ success is ultimately your success.

  • You have one goal: creating, growing andstrengthening the wealth of our high net-worth customers and their families. This simple yet sophisticated goal drives you to uncover and understand our clients’ every need and deliver the right product solutions to enable their success.

  • You demonstrate strong interpersonal and excellent communication skills.

Apply Now

Location & Company Overview

  • 100% remote position based in Malaysia.
    - A.I / ML native start-up / scale-up headquartered in Singapore.
    - Focused on enterprise customers in the pharmaceutical industry.
    - Tech stack includes Node.JS, JavaScript, and Python.

    Why Should You Apply?
    - Company founded by industry veterans from GSK & Pfizer.
    - Mission to enhance compliance in early-stage clinical trials, expanding patient access to new treatments.
    - Operating in one of the fastest-growing niche industries post-COVID, with government and regulatory support.
    - Opportunity for rapid career progression from Lead Engineer to Head of Engineering as the team expands.

    Key Responsibilities
    - 70% hands-on technical engineering using Node.js, Python, and JavaScript (must have a passion for coding).
    - 30% leadership of a small internal team (Data, A.I, Developers) and management of two external vendors.
    - Involved in requirement gathering, architectural design, building, and deploying scalable, enterprise-ready cloud solutions.
    - Take ideas and new features from concept to production, ensuring proper documentation, code refactoring (or rewriting), and clearing existing backlog.
    - Create intuitive, responsive user interfaces.
    - Deploy, monitor, and maintain systems on AWS, Azure, or GCP.

    - Previous experience in a scale-up or start-up environment, with the ability to work remotely and independently.
    - Bonus: Experience with machine learning and A.I technologies.

    - Report directly to the CTO and Co-Founder; you will be the most senior engineer in the team.
    - Expected to have 8-12 years of relevant experience.
    - Collaborate closely with product, design, and data teams to deliver impactful solutions.
    - Co-founder is based in Malaysia; CTO (consultant) is based in Singapore.

    About You
    - Demonstrate start-up grit and adaptability; able to thrive in a fast-growing business with high customer expectations and tight timelines.
    - Passionate about expanding technical knowledge in the rapidly evolving ML and A.I space, with a willingness to learn on the job.
    - Comfortable switching between hands-on engineering, supporting junior engineers, managing vendors, and responding to client requests.

    How to Apply
    - Click the “apply” button; you may submit an old CV or your LinkedIn profile—just send what you have.
    - The recruiter is available to share more information with you before proceeding.
    - Every applicant or enquiry will receive a reply.

    Additional Notes
    - A full and detailed job description will be provided to shortlisted candidates.
    - Employment passes, work visas, or relocation support are not available.
    - Only candidates with work rights in Malaysia will be considered.

jobs.title: Global Vice President, HR Business Partnering
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Clinigen is looking for an accomplished Global Vice President, HR Business Partnering to lead our HR Business Partner organization globally and play a central role in the continued evolution of our business and People strategy.

This is a highly visible leadership opportunity for an HR executive who combines exceptional business partnership with strong commercial judgment and the ability to lead through growth, transformation and change.

Reporting directly to the Chief Human Resources Officer, the Global VP will lead our regional HR Business Partners and work closely with senior leaders across Clinigen to translate business priorities into focused workforce, organization, talent and leadership strategies.

What You'll Do

  • Lead and develop Clinigen's global and regional HR Business Partner organization.
  • Act as a trusted strategic partner and advisor to senior business leaders.
  • Translate business strategy into actionable workforce and people plans.
  • Lead organization design, strategic workforce planning and organizational effectiveness initiatives.
  • Strengthen succession planning, leadership pipelines and retention of critical talent.
  • Coach senior leaders and support leadership team effectiveness.
  • Drive performance, accountability and manager effectiveness.
  • Lead the people aspects of significant organizational change, restructuring, integration and transformation.
  • Use people data and business insights to identify organizational risks, opportunities and priorities.
  • Partner with Talent, Total Rewards, People Operations and HRIS, Talent Acquisition, and Employee Communications and Engagement to deliver integrated solutions.
  • Build a consistent, commercially focused HRBP operating model globally while ensuring appropriate regional expertise.
  • Champion a culture of accountability, collaboration, inclusion and customer focus.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who has operated at significant scale and is equally comfortable discussing business performance with an executive leader, coaching a leadership team, working through an organization design, and building the capabilities of an HRBP organization.

  • Significant progressive HR leadership experience.
  • Significant experience leading HR Business Partnering in a complex, global organization.
  • Experience partnering directly with C-suite executives, business presidents, general managers or comparable senior leaders.
  • Strong commercial and financial acumen.
  • Deep experience in organization design, workforce planning, executive talent, succession and change.
  • Experience leading geographically dispersed HR teams.
  • A track record of navigating transformation, organizational change and complex talent decisions.
  • Experience in life sciences, pharmaceuticals, healthcare services or another regulated industry is strongly preferred.
  • Experience within a private equity-backed or similarly high-growth, performance-oriented environment would be particularly valuable.
  • M&A and integration experience is highly desirable.

The Leadership Profile

Commercial. You understand the business first and bring HR expertise to help it perform.

Strategic and practical. You can operate at enterprise level while ensuring strategy translates into action.

Courageous. You are comfortable challenging senior executives constructively and having difficult conversations when necessary.

Global. You know when consistency matters and when local context matters more.

Talent-minded

Help train and evaluate AI agents that work inside a real CAD environment on long engineering tasks, work that would take an expert 10–15 hours. You'll design part geometry, build reference solutions, and judge the agent's attempts. You'll work alongside CFD engineers who simulate the geometry you build.

  • Comfortable with Python and GitHub.
  • English at B2 level or above.

For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10–20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active.

On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent, depending on their level and pace of contribution.

Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

  • Apply your expertise to real-world technology projects while gaining experience building high-quality solutions for a global platform.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Positionné(e) au cœur des opérations, vous jouerez un rôle stratégique dans l'onboarding des studios clients et l'optimisation de leurs pipelines de production. Vous serez la référence technique pour concevoir, déployer et adapter des environnements Cloud GPU sur mesure, tout en contribuant activement à l'évolution de la plateforme interne.

Vos responsabilités et défis au quotidien

  • Intégration & Accompagnement client (Onboarding) : Accompagner les studios partenaires lors de leur transition technique vers la plateforme et assurer une mise en route fluide.

  • Analyse de pipelines & Déploiement : Auditer les flux de travail (VFX, 3D, rendu) et déployer des postes de travail virtuels (VDI) et des environnements GPU optimisés pour chaque cas d'usage.

  • Collaboration Produit : Travailler main dans la main avec l'équipe de développement produit pour remonter les besoins du terrain et enrichir les fonctionnalités de la plateforme.

  • Automatisation & Documentation : Concevoir des scripts (Python) pour automatiser les tâches récurrentes, rédiger des documentations techniques claires et établir des guides de bonnes pratiques.

  • Architecture & Conception système : Évaluer les besoins logiciels et matériels pour concevoir, implémenter et maintenir des infrastructures haute performance.

  • Leadership technique : Agir à titre de référent expert auprès des équipes internes et assurer le partage de connaissances.

  • Expertise sectorielle : Expérience démontrée dans l'industrie du VFX, de l'animation 3D, du jeu vidéo ou des médias numériques.

  • Logiciels créatifs & Moteurs de rendu : Excellente compréhension des outils majeurs de l'industrie (Houdini, Nuke, Blender, After Effects, etc.).

  • Compétences techniques :

    • Maîtrise avancée du langage Python (ou autre langage de scripting/automatisation).

    • Solides connaissances en administration de serveurs Linux et Windows.

    • Maîtrise des concepts d'architecture Cloud GPU, de virtualisation et de systèmes de stockage distribué.

  • Qualités interpersonnelles :

    • Talent affirmé de vulgarisateur (capacité d'échanger aussi bien avec un concepteur VFX qu'un développeur réseau).

    • Grande autonomie, rigueur méthodologique et sens aigu de l'organisation.

  • Exigences linguistiques : Maîtrise du français (oral et écrit). L'anglais est un atout très apprécié.

Atouts considérables :

  • Expérience pratique avec des fermes de rendu et des gestionnaires de file d'attente (ex. Deadline).
  • Expertise avec l'écosystème GPU NVIDIA et les technologies de virtualisation avancées.
  • Expérience dans l'intégration d'API cloud ou d'outils d'automatisation de la facturation.
  • Diplôme universitaire (Baccalauréat) en informatique, génie logiciel ou formation/expérience équivalente.
  • Flexibilité totale : Mode de travail 100 % télétravail avec une grande souplesse dans la gestion de vos horaires.
  • Projets stimulants : Opportunité de travailler à la pointe de la technologie pour le compte de studios de renommée internationale.
  • Avantages sociaux : Banque de vacances généreuse et conditions de travail axées sur le bien-être.
  • Culture d'entreprise : Un environnement axé sur l'innovation, la souveraineté des données et l'écoresponsabilité.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
OUR VISION

EQUS is building the trust infrastructure for personal AI. Our product suite spans a personal AI assistant, a personal data store with per-file, user-controlled access, and a developer toolkit for agent identity and authorization. It all runs on a single permission rail designed around one principle: your data belongs to you. We are preparing for a major public launch and scaling from build mode to operate-at-scale mode.

WHAT YOU WILL DO

As a Senior AI Engineer at EQUS, you own the AI assistant layer end to end: architecture, standards, and the service contracts that security, storage and front-end engineers support. You are a technical decision-maker, not only an implementer. You recommend the right approach for each problem, and you are prepared to say "this does not need AI" when it doesn’t. Privacy, safety, and cost sit at the center of every call you make. Your day-to-day includes, but is not limited to:
  • AI architecture and context engineering. Design the context augmentation pipelines, spanning vector RAG, CAG, agentic file exploration, Text-to-SQL, knowledge graphs, fine-tuning, and MCP-based context engineering, and select the right approach for each use case. Select chunking strategy, embedding models, and retrieval architecture for user-owned document systems with multi-tenant isolation. Privacy and security guides each decision.
  • LLM integration and agent systems. Integrate and manage commercial and open-source LLM APIs, and deploy multi-agent systems with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph. Lead model selection, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, and production evaluation across the AI stack.
  • Evaluation and optimization. Build evaluation frameworks that measure output quality, relevance, and safety. Optimize pipelines for latency, token cost, and throughput, monitor production for drift and regression, and close the feedback loop from evals back into iteration.
  • Privacy and safety engineering. Privacy is our product, not a compliance checkbox. Own PII handling, GDPR and CCPA compliance, encryption at rest and in transit, and user-scoped access boundaries at the systems level. Build prompt injection defenses, output filtering, and data leakage prevention, and partner with security and trust experts on agentic workflow guardrails and shadow AI detection.
  • Infrastructure and standards. Deploy and operate production AI systems on AWS, Docker and Kubernetes, and GitLab. Define the AI service contracts and APIs other engineers build on top of, and set the standard for how AI works here, including mentoring engineers and raising the technical bar around you.

WHAT YOU WILL NEED TO SUCCEED

You have shipped AI in production, you know where pipelines break, and you make architectural decisions that prove right. You exercise strong judgment on build vs. buy and on what separates an MVP from a production system, and you know the cost-performance tradeoffs cold: when a smaller fine-tuned model outperforms a general-purpose large one, and when expanding the context window beats RAG.

You treat AI safety as a first-class engineering concern rather than a review-stage checklist. As part of the new generation of AI-native developers, you have already been using Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, or a comparable tools as a core part of your development workflow and utilize processes that enable speed and efficiency without compromising code quality and human intellectual control over the deliverables.

You have experience in both small and large teams, effectively use tools such as Jira and Confluence, and are a valuable colleague to product managers as new features and products are emerging. You have experience working effectively with consultants and outsourced development teams, including transitioning responsibilities for systems.
