jobs.descriptionHtml:
Testronic is a global leader in Quality Assurance and technology services for the games and entertainment industries. We work with some of the world's leading game developers and publishers, providing Functional QA, Compliance QA, Localization QA, Compatibility QA, and other specialized services.

With diverse teams across Europe, Asia, and North America, we foster an inclusive, collaborative culture built on four core values: We Care Deeply, Passion for Quality, Trust in Unity, and Pride in Ownership. Whether you're starting your career or looking for your next challenge, Testronic offers opportunities to learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact.

We’re looking for an experienced Mobile Compliance Test Lead to ensure our mobile titles meet App Store and Google Play requirements. You’ll lead compliance testing, identify potential risks, provide guidance on platform requirements, and work closely with QA, Production, and Publishing teams to support successful submissions and releases.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead and execute compliance testing for mobile titles across iOS and Android platforms.

· Serve as the subject matter expert (SME) on Apple and Google certification requirements, including mobile platform submission guidelines, metadata, and submission processes.

· Reviews features and prototypes to provide guidance on potential requirements and related risks.

· Provide consultation and guidance regarding mobile-specific requirements.

· Collaborate with QA, production, and publishing teams to ensure timely and successful submissions.

· Act as the primary liaison with platform representatives and release managers during submission and review cycles.

· Maintain up-to-date documentation on platform requirements and changes.

· Train and mentor QA team members on compliance best practices and tools.

Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in mobile QA, including at least 2 years working directly with mobile compliance, certification, or submissions.
  • Strong hands-on knowledge of both iOS and Android ecosystems.
  • Practical experience with Apple App Store and Google Play requirements and submission processes.
  • Experience testing mobile titles against platform requirements and identifying issues that could block or delay a release.
  • Good understanding of areas such as IAP compliance, privacy requirements, age ratings/IARC, metadata, device compatibility, and release requirements.
  • Previous experience leading or coordinating QA teams, defining test coverage, improving processes, or providing technical/compliance guidance to other testers.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with developers, QA teams, production, publishing, and other stakeholders.
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to turn complex platform requirements into clear, actionable guidance for the team.
  • Experience with tools such as JIRA, TestRail, App Store Connect, Google Play Console, and relevant mobile testing/development tools.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title

Spring Multimedia Intern

Job Description


Foreign Policy magazine (FP) is recruiting a spring multimedia intern. The intern will assist our social media and creative teams. Work will include drafting copy for FP’s social media accounts, editing video, selecting photos, and collaborating with both teams on editorial projects. The intern’s duties may also include occasional collaboration with FP Live, our live journalism platform, for pre-interview research and social clips. Previous video experience is required.


We are a collaborative team; candidates should work well with others and be committed to FP’s mission—explaining Washington to the world, and the world to Americans.


This is a part-time paid internship, with a preference for candidates based in Washington, D.C., New York, or Seattle, although remote applicants will be considered.


Previous Foreign Policy interns have gone on to full-time roles at prestigious media organizations around the world. This is a terrific opportunity to learn more about journalism, geopolitics, and new media. Successful candidates will be passionate, curious, and collaborative.


Requirements:

  • Demonstrated interest in social media with the ability to synthesize complex information into engaging social posts
  • Experience in video production and editing with a strong understanding of the Adobe Creative Suite, especially Adobe Premiere Pro
  • Background in visual communication; the ability to follow brand guidelines, including typography use and image selection, is a plus
  • Solid understanding of international relations and politics
  • Enrolled in or recently graduated from a bachelor’s or master’s program

Links to prior video work and/or portfolios are strongly encouraged. All applications must be submitted by November 20, 2026.


Location

Remote/Nationwide, USA

Additional Locations


Time Type

Part time

Foreign Policy showcases the smartest ideas, analysis, and journalism on global affairs, reaching audiences around the world through its award-winning website, quarterly print magazine, podcasts, and video. Founded in 1970, FP is today a diversified multimedia company, including live events convening top leaders and decision-makers, a research and analytics division, and a thriving audio group.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Senior Sales Executive is responsible for driving profitable revenue growth by developing new enterprise customer relationships and expanding existing accounts through consultative, solution‑based selling. They focus on understanding complex customer supply chains, identifying opportunities across the company’s full portfolio of solutions, and delivering measurable value to customers. They act as a trusted advisor to decision makers, partnering closely with Commercial teams, Operations, and internal stakeholders to deliver a seamless customer experience. This position requires strong commercial acumen, strategic thinking, and the ability to lead internal teams without direct authority. Success in this role is measured by revenue growth, customer retention, and long‑term account expansion. The role is highly visible and plays a critical part in the organization’s enterprise growth strategy.

Compensation: $75,000 minimum starting base salary, depending on experience. Commission plan included.

Responsibilities

  • Develop new business and drive revenue growth by identifying and qualifying prospective enterprise customers through research, networking, and consultative discovery.
  • Conduct in‑depth analysis of customer supply chains to understand business challenges, operational needs, and opportunities for the company’s solutions.
  • Present, propose, and implement customized solutions that align the company’s portfolio with customer objectives and deliver long‑term value.
  • Maintain and grow existing customer relationships by deeply understanding customer operations and proactively identifying expansion and retention opportunities.
  • Partner closely with Customer Success teams to ensure customer onboarding, solution adoption, retention, and long‑term account health.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders including specialized product sales teams and cross‑functional team members to deliver a consistent, high‑quality customer experience.
  • Regularly engage customers to reinforce understanding of company’s capabilities and maximize utilization of the full portfolio.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
HOW YOU WILL MAKE AN IMPACT
At LifeNet Health, as the Donation Outreach Coordinator, you will make an impact by leveraging your expertise, collaboration, and commitment to excellence to help advance our mission of Saving Lives, Restoring Health, and Giving Hope. Through your daily work, you will contribute to innovative solutions, operational excellence, and meaningful outcomes that support donors, patients, healthcare providers, and our communities. Whether driving strategic initiatives, improving processes, supporting customers, advancing research, developing talent, or ensuring quality and compliance, your contributions will help strengthen our ability to transform lives and shape the future of regenerative medicine.

The role provides compassionate and professional donation and grief support by engaging families in crisis, advocating for eye, tissue, research, and education donation opportunities, securing authorization, completing all required documentation accurately, and conducting thorough Donor Risk Assessment Interviews while maintaining effective communication with funeral homes, medical examiners, eye banks, hospitals, and donor families. Additionally, the position assesses and triages incoming calls and electronic communications, prioritizing urgent needs and routing inquiries appropriately to ensure smooth operations and a positive experience for all stakeholders.

WHAT YOU WILL BRING

  • 3 years with HS Diploma/GED or 1 year with AS degree - working with families through counseling, bereavement and/or crisis intervention or experience with donation approach experience in an OPO/Tissue environment

Pay Transparency Statement
$22.40 - $37.33/hourly

The salary range displayed represents the national base salary range for this position and is provided in good faith to support pay transparency. For positions located in designated higher-cost labor markets, a geographic pay adjustment may apply above the posted range for eligible positions according to LifeNet Health's current policy. Final compensation will be determined based on factors such as work location, relevant experience, skills, qualifications, and internal equity. Total compensation may also include bonuses, benefits, and other rewards that are not reflected in the posted salary range.

LifeNet Health is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected status under applicable law.

jobs.title: Manager, Clinical Data Management
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Manager, Clinical Data Management is responsible for the full lifecycle of our Encounter Data Submission and Reconciliation strategy, ensuring that diagnoses are accurately tracked, submitted, and accepted by payers and CMS. In this role, you’ll lead the operational and strategic work that turns clinical documentation into reliable, compliant, and financially meaningful data. You’ll collaborate across internal teams, vendors, and payers to spot gaps early, solve root causes, and continuously improve how we submit and reconcile encounter data. If you thrive at the intersection of healthcare data, process ownership, and cross-functional leadership, this role offers the chance to make a measurable difference.

Primary Duties

    Data Submission & Reconciliation Process

  • Oversee end-to-end strategy, priorities, and operations for accurate and compliant encounter data submission to payers and CMS.
  • Create and transmit ASM files on established cadences, maintaining payer-specific templates and submission methods annually.
  • Establish routine reconciliation processes to track diagnoses from documentation to acceptance, quantifying gaps and identifying dropped/truncated records early.
  • Lead root-cause analysis and corrective action across internal teams, vendors, and payers for rejected or dropped diagnoses.
  • Partner with operations leadership to drive strategy, chart selection, and annual evaluation for the retrospective chart review initiative.

    • Compliance & Quality Assurance

  • Monitor submission metrics and acceptance rates, applying data scrubs and business rules to meet regulatory standards and CMS/payer deadlines.
  • Collaborate with leadership and legal partners to ensure full compliance regarding add and delete diagnosis workflows.
  • Develop and maintain process documentation, SOPs, and routine workflow updates.

    • Process Improvement

  • Identify tools and long-term strategies to improve encounter acceptance rates, minimize manual effort, and expand ASM processes across eligible payers.
  • Evaluate annual ROI across submission and audit processes, optimizing workflows to drive financial performance.

    • Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Lead cross-functional initiatives with key stakeholders to resolve data flow issues and implement system updates.
  • Integrate accepted ASM submitted diagnosis data into existing risk reporting dashboards and build new recurring reports for leadership
  • Own ASM valuation and financial results, partnering with Data and Analytics on metric definitions and data quality
    • Other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, IT, Healthcare Analytics, or Operations
  • 6+ years of experience with Medicare Advantage or ACA encounter data processes, and/or risk adjustment experience within a payer, vendor, or Value Based Care organization
  • 3+ years of program or project management experience, including ownership of complex, multi-stakeholder initiatives
  • 2+ years of working knowledge with X12 837 transaction sets; Working knowledge of CMS EDPS experience (MAO-002/MAO-004 reports)
  • Strong analytical capabilities with a demonstrated ability to interpret complex datasets and synthesize actionable insights
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with proven experience developing and presenting key information to executive leadership
  • Working knowledge of SQL, including writing, modifying, and executing queries
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace, project tracking software (i.e. Jira, Smartsheet), and business intelligence or dashboard platforms

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiarity with Business Process Reengineering (BPR) principles and methodologies to optimize process...

jobs.title: Patent Analytics Expert (IP & Portfolio Analysis Products)
jobs.location: Remote (Germany, Isle of Man, United Kingdom)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Patent Analytics Expert (IP & Portfolio Analysis Products)


Do you want your patent analytics expertise to shape the products and AI that others rely on?

Do you revel in testing a polished AI answer and finding exactly where its reasoning breaks down?

Come join us and help build the world's most trusted patent analytics and AI for IP and business decision-makers!

About the team:


LexisNexis Intellectual Property, part of RELX, helps the world's innovators, IP professionals, law firms, and investors understand patents: their own, their competitors', and those of the companies they are assessing. Our products, including PatentSight+, IPlytics and TotalPatent One, and the patent data we deliver directly into customers' own systems, inform decisions on R&D investment, licensing, litigation, M&A and competitive strategy.


Many of our customers use patents to make business decisions: comparing their portfolio with competitors', spotting acquisition or licensing targets, deciding what to keep or drop, or tracking where a technology is heading. Increasingly, they ask an AI assistant to help. We're looking for someone who knows what good answers to these questions look like, to help make sure our products, and the AI inside them, give them.

About the role:


"How does our portfolio compare with our three closest competitors?" "Which companies would strengthen our position in power electronics?" "What does this patent actually claim?" Answering questions like these well takes judgment: which companies to group together, how to count, which time window to use, how to read a claim, and what the numbers can and cannot support. AI can now produce a polished answer in seconds, which makes that judgment more important, because a convincing answer can still be a wrong one.


In this role, you will represent the people who ask these questions, and you will be forward deployed: working closely with the product and engineering teams building specific end-user experiences, rather than advising from a distance. You will define what a genuinely useful answer looks like across different use cases, contexts, and data scenarios, and encode that judgment in artefacts and other mechanisms, including AI agents, so it can scale. You will test our analytics and AI against it and help shape what we build next.

Key Responsibilities:


  • Be the voice, alongside the product and engineering teams building our end-user experiences, of the various types of end users who use patent analytics for business decisions: IP and portfolio managers, competitive-intelligence analysts, corporate development and M&A teams, R&D strategists and investors, by deeply understanding their needs, aspirations and the jobs they need to get done.
  • Define what good looks like across a broad range of AI-assisted uses, such as portfolio exploration and comparison, competitor benchmarking, technology and sector trends, acquisition and licensing target identification, portfolio optimisation, and patent summaries and claim interpretation.
  • Capture that definition in governed, versioned question sets, graded example answers, scoring rubrics, and acceptance criteria that teams build closed-loop evaluations on, and work closely with engineering teams to guide them as they build evaluation frameworks on these.
  • Perform structured human-in-the-loop evaluations and drive the eyes-on evaluation layer for our AI assistant and analytics features: design and carry out expert reviews, judge whether results meet the bar, and feed what you learn back into the standards.
  • Collaborate closely with other patent experts in the team to develop methods that scale eyes-on human evaluation.
  • Help engineering teams troubleshoot issues by working backwards from AI o...

You will ensure alignment of pharmacy initiatives with organizational goals, key performance indicators (KPIs), and client value propositions to achieve measurable outcomes.

This is a field-based role allowing remote work from any US location.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Position Summary

The Director, Commercialization is responsible for translating the company’s brand, consumer, category, and business strategies into compelling go-to-market strategies and actionable commercial plans that drive sales growth across channels.

This role serves as a critical connector across Marketing, Sales, Consumer & Shopper Insights, Category Management, and Innovation, synthesizing complex information into clear, differentiated sales narratives and tools that enable the organization to win with customers.

The Director leads the national commercialization strategy and sales narrative, ensuring priorities are clearly articulated and customized for the unique needs of each sales channel and customer. This individual also owns the national sales toolkit and supports innovation commercialization.

Key Responsibilities

Go-to-Market Strategy & Commercialization

  • Collaborate cross functionally to help shape go-to-market strategies for key business priorities, including portfolio initiatives, major brand programs, innovation launches, and strategic growth opportunities.
  • Establish commercialization frameworks, processes, and timelines that align cross-functional teams and ensure effective execution.
  • Identify the critical selling opportunities, proof points, and activation requirements needed to drive customer adoption and business growth.
  • Partner with Sales leadership to ensure commercialization strategies are practical, differentiated, and aligned with customer needs.

National Sales Narrative & Channel Customization

  • Lead the development of compelling national sales narratives that articulate the company’s growth story, category opportunity, portfolio strategy, and reasons for customers to partner with the business.
  • Synthesize inputs from Marketing, Insights, Category Management, Sales, Finance, Innovation, and other functions into a cohesive and compelling commercial story.
  • Translate the national narrative into tailored selling stories for different channels, customers, and selling occasions, maintaining consistency with the overarching brand and business strategy while addressing distinct customer needs and dynamics.
  • Partner with Sales leadership and account teams to continuously evolve the narrative based on customer feedback, market dynamics, and business performance.

National Sales Toolkit & Commercial Content

  • Own and maintain the national sales toolkit, serving as the central source of truth for sales messaging, selling stories, category insights, brand assets, product information, innovation materials, and supporting proof points.
  • Establish standards and governance for sales materials to ensure consistency, accuracy, quality, and ease of use.
  • Develop and maintain core sales presentations, one-pagers, sell sheets, talking points, customer narratives, FAQs, and other commercial materials.
  • Establish processes to regularly refresh sales materials based on new insights, business results, product changes, competitive activity, and evolving customer needs.
  • Ensure sales teams have the right materials available at the right time to support customer meetings, line reviews, selling cycles, and business planning.

jobs.title: ARQUITETO ESPECIALISTA EM SOFTWARE
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Nosso time é formado por excelentes profissionais da área da tecnologia.

Colaboração e comprometimento fazem parte do nosso dia-a-dia, quando desenvolvemos novas funcionalidades, construindo um produto robusto e escalável.

Fazendo parte de nossa equipe, seu trabalho irá impactar em milhares de usuários, de algumas das maiores empresas do país, que utilizam nossa solução diariamente.

Responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar na definição de arquitetura de novas soluções e manutenções das arquiteturas atuais.
  • Orientar os desenvolvedores quanto aos padrões de projetos adotados.
  • Apoiar na definição das tecnologias a serem utilizadas para determinado desenvolvimento.
  • Apoiar na integração (empacotamento) e merges (mesclas) de builds paralelamente desenvolvidos

Atribuições :

  • Princípios e práticas de desenvolvimento de software ágil, incluindo o Manifesto Ágil, Scrum, Extreme Programming (XP) e Kanban.
  • Análise de requisitos funcionais e não-funcionais.
  • Padrões de projeto (enterprise integration patterns, design patterns, SOA, microservices patterns).
  • Modelagem de dados relacional e banco de dados IBM/DB2.
  • Arquitetura de aplicações em três camadas, modelo MVC. Integração entre sistemas: Mensageria, JMS, WebSphere MQ, Web services, Barramento de serviços (WebSphere Message Broker), REST, EJB 3
  • Javascript, Angular JS ou superior e Bootstrap 3 ou superior, HTML 5, ECMAScript 5 e 6 ou superior, CSS 3.
  • User Experience (UX) e conceitos de usabilidade.
  • Interfaces responsivas e aplicação PWA.
  • Integração continua (continuous integration), test-driven development (TDD), acceptance testdriven development (ATDD), especificação por exemplo, refactoring, entrega contínua (continuous delivery).
  • Testes de software: teste de unidade, integração, sistema/funcional, aceitação/estória, carga, desempenho, vulnerabilidade, usabilidade, acessibilidade. Automatização de testes funcionais, de unidade e de carga com ferramentas de software. Testes de unidade em Java com a ferramenta JUnit 3 ou superior. Automatização de testes funcionais com a ferramenta Selenium Webdriver 2.4 ou superior e com Protractor. Testes de carga com JMeter 2 ou superior.
  • Programação Java para Web: JEE 6 ou superior, JSE 6 ou superior, JPA 2 e Apache Velocity e Spring.
  • Conhecimento dos modelos de gerenciamento de transações CMT e BMT.
  • Análise estática de código com a ferramenta SonarQube.
  • Construção de consultas a bancos de dados em linguagem SQL.
  • Conceitos de controle de versão de código-fonte.
  • IDE Eclipse .
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Linux e COBOL/CICS.
  • Conceitos e implementação de recursos de segurança de aplicações (OWASP, JAAS, LDAP, RACF) e soluções de SSO (Single Sign-On).
  • Experiência com sistemas de alta performance (milhares de transações por segundo) com grande volume de dados (milhões de transações diárias).
  • Conhecimento de nuvem pública e privada.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de solução baseado em API-REST e solução baseado em XML.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com uso de roteamento de mensagens no padrão ISO 8583 (versão IS08583: 1987).
  • Desenvolvimento em tecnologias da área financeira: J/XFS (CWA e FDI): CWA-13937:2000 e FDI 2.1.3b ou superior, integrando periféricos como PinPad criptográfico (cartão com chip padrão EMV e com tarja magnética, teclado pin e display), impressoras autenticadoras, scanner com leitura CMC7 e código de barras e smartcard.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com uso de criptografia.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento com uso de Certificação Digital e Assinatura Digital de documentos.
  • Programação de aplicações Java SWING.
  • Design de interfaces de programação de aplicações (APIs).
  • Design de aplicações baseadas em microserviços e containers.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lee Enterprises is seeking a Senior Product Marketing Manager to help the new products and advertising initiatives created by our Content Monetization team reach their full potential across our network of local news brands, through creative, sustained, organic promotion. Reporting to the Senior Director, Advertising Product, you'll own organic promotion across video, social, email, and our owned channels, partnering closely with our paid media and subscriptions teams. You'll partner directly with the Senior Director to shape our promotional strategy, bringing your own ideas to the table, and then bring it to life with real ownership of the work: creating the assets, executing campaigns end to end, and showing your impact through results. If you love turning a plan into results without needing someone looking over your shoulder, this role is for you.

What you'll do:

Bring new products to market

Develop creative assets and launch plans that help new products find their audience. Build always-on promotion that keeps products growing well beyond launch day. Own curated social and email promotion for these brands, plus additional organic channels.

Power new advertising products

Create marketing materials and promotional assets for new advertising products, equipping sales teams to sell them with confidence.

Execute our video strategy

Build and maintain the creative playbook that puts our video strategy into action, on and off platform. Coach editorial teams to bring video into their stories, create their own, and know when original video beats wire content.

Elevate social content

Track the layouts and themes that perform best on social media. Build new social layouts using our content automation tools. Help newsrooms grow their social brands and posts across every platform, guided by performance insights.

What you'll bring:

5+ years in product marketing, content marketing, digital marketing, or a similar role, ideally in media or publishing. A track record of independently executing promotional plans, from concept to results. Strong working knowledge of video best practices, including vertical and short-form video across platforms. Experience developing creative concepts and producing promotional assets, including social graphics, email, and short-form video. Hands-on experience managing social media across multiple platforms. Confidence using data to measure performance and refine your approach. Excellent writing, communication, and project management skills.

Helpful experience

Work in local media, publishing, or a related industry. Content and social automation tools. Video syndication or video monetization. B2B or advertising product marketing.

What success looks like New products and advertising initiatives drive revenue growth and strong adoption. Video inventory, views, and revenue grow, social reach and engagement expand, and newsrooms confidently use video and social best practices. Portfolio or work samples are optional, but we'd love to see what you've created.

jobs.title: Principal, Cybersecurity Incident Responder - Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Work Flexibility: Remote

The Principal Cybersecurity Incident Responder is a senior technical cybersecurity leader responsible for leading the response to significant and complex cybersecurity incidents. This role establishes technical priorities, drives investigations, and guides incidents through containment, eradication, and recovery.


You will apply broad cybersecurity expertise and deep, hands-on incident response experience to make timely, risk-based decisions in complex and rapidly evolving situations. During significant incidents, you will serve as the Technical Response Lead, partnering closely with Investigations, Detection Engineering, Security Engineering, Cyber Threat Intelligence (CTI), Threat Hunting, Forensics, Security Operations, and other cybersecurity specialists.

Outside of active incidents, you will strengthen response readiness by improving playbooks, exercises, telemetry, tooling, automation, and lessons-learned processes, including identifying responsible opportunities to leverage AI.


Preference will be given to candidates located in Eastern or Central time zones to support effective collaboration during core business hours.

Essential duties & responsibilities

  • Lead the technical response to significant and complex cybersecurity incidents from initial investigation through containment, eradication, and recovery.
  • Establish technical priorities, maintain momentum, and make timely, risk-based decisions when information is incomplete, conflicting, or rapidly changing.
  • Partner across Investigations, Detection Engineering, Security Engineering, CTI, Threat Hunting, Forensics, Security Operations, and other teams to determine incident scope and coordinate response actions.
  • Apply deep knowledge of attacker tactics, techniques, and procedures to incidents involving identity compromise, ransomware, malware, cloud compromise, lateral movement, data exfiltration, and other advanced threats.
  • Evaluate investigative findings, identify critical gaps, test hypotheses, and translate available evidence into effective containment, eradication, and recovery strategies.
  • Balance rapid containment with business impact, operational continuity, evidence preservation, and the need to fully understand incident scope.
  • Develop and continuously improve incident response playbooks, procedures, and technical capabilities based on real-world incidents, exercises, emerging threats, and lessons learned.
  • Design and facilitate technical tabletop exercises and simulations to validate response capabilities and identify improvement opportunities.
  • Identify telemetry, tooling, access, and visibility gaps and partner with technical teams to strengthen detection and response capabilities.
  • Leverage AI, automation, and orchestration where appropriate to accelerate investigation and response while maintaining appropriate human oversight.
  • Lead technical contributions to post-incident reviews and drive improvements across telemetry, detections, tooling, automation, procedures, and training.
  • Serve as a senior technical resource and mentor, strengthening incident response capabilities and decision-making across the cybersecurity organization.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, Information Security, or a related field, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • 8+ years of relevant cybersecurity experience across incident response, digital forensics, threat hunting, security operations, security engineering, or related disciplines.
  • Relevant industry certifications in incident response, digital forensics, security operations, cloud security, or related cybersecurity disciplines preferred.

Preferred Qualifications

In this role, you will shape global compensation, benefits and incentive programs while also leading People Operations, HR systems, payroll governance, workforce data and reporting. jobs.title: Director of School Success - East Region
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About GradGuard

As the leader in college tuition and renters insurance, GradGuard serves more than 1.7 million students across 1,900+ institutions.

Our national technology platform embeds innovative insurance protections into the enrollment processes of over 700 institutional partners, empowering schools to increase college completion rates and reduce the financial impact of preventable losses.

GradGuard supports College Life Protected, a social purpose entity that promotes research, professional development, and best practices that strengthen campus communities, families, society and the economic competitiveness of our nation.

GradGuard was recognized as one of the Top 50 Financial Technology Companies of 2025 by The Financial Technology Report, a RISE Internship Award winner, and a Phoenix Business Journal Best Places to Work finalist, GradGuard remains committed to innovation, excellence, and supporting students and families.

Hear from our students, families, and partners:GradGuard

About the role

You've spent time in higher education, maybe in housing, student affairs, or campus operations, and somewhere along the way you realized you're wired a little differently than most. You care deeply about students and the institutions that serve them, but you're also energized by goals, growth, and getting things done. You like building relationships that actually mean something. You get restless when there's no challenge in front of you.

If that sounds familiar, keep reading.

At GradGuard, we provide a critical safety net for college students and their families, protecting them from the unexpected so they can stay focused on what matters. We are looking for a Director of School Success for our East team. This is an individual contributor role, no direct reports, no management ladder. We use the "Director" title because of the level of ownership you will carry and the senior campus leaders you will work alongside. You will be the strategic account owner and primary relationship manager for a dedicated portfolio of university partners, and the results in that portfolio will be yours.

The ideal person for this role brings two things together. First, you have real, firsthand experience in higher education, you know how campuses work, how decisions get made, and what it actually takes to support students and families. Second, you know how to partner with institutions, consult on what will move the needle, identify opportunities to grow, and drive results. You do not need to be a perfect 50/50 split, but you need to genuinely bring both.

You will operate with a high degree of autonomy. That means setting your own strategy, owning your outcomes, and making decisions without waiting to be told what to do. At the same time, you will have a team behind you, marketing, product, and sales, who are invested in your success. Your campus credibility will open doors. Your drive will determine what happens next.

This is a chance to stop choosing between the work you care about and the career you want to build, and do both. We are looking for sincere professionals who embrace GradGuard’s mission which is to help schools educate and protect students from the risks of college life.

This is position is remote and open to candidates in most U.S. states, with the exception of: California, Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois...

jobs.title: Architecte IAM / Active Directory - full remote H/F
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group.

Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs.

C’est votre future équipe

Installée en plein cœur de Lille, à deux pas de la place de la République et de son magnifique Palais des Beaux-Arts, l’agence Consort Nord accompagne plus de 180 collaborateurs auprès d’une trentaine de clients, en assistance technique comme en engagement de résultats ! Par ailleurs, nous sommes reconnus centres de formation certifiés ITIL®, DevOps & ISTQB/Agilité.

Architecte IAM / Active DirectoryH/F

C’est votre mission

Vous êtes passionné·e par la cybersécurité, l’architecture des identités et la sécurisation des accès ? Ce poste est fait pour vous.

En tant qu’Architecte IAM / Active Directory, vous êtes responsable de la conception, de l’évolution et de la sécurisation des architectures de gestion des identités et des accès, ainsi que du renforcement de la sécurité et de la gouvernance de notre écosystème, dans des environnements hybrides et multi-domaines.

Contexte :

Nous recherchons un Architecte IAM / Active Directory pour concevoir, sécuriser et faire évoluer les infrastructures de gestion des identités et des accès. Le consultant interviendra sur des environnements complexes, avec des enjeux forts de cybersécurité, de conformité et de protection des accès sensibles.

Il sera notamment chargé de définir les architectures cibles, de renforcer la sécurité Active Directory et de garantir l'application des bonnes pratiques en matière de gestion des identités et des habilitations.

Missions principales :

  • Concevoir et faire évoluer les architectures Active Directory et IAM, notamment les environnements multi-domaines et hybrides.

  • Définir les stratégies d'authentification, d'autorisation et de gestion du cycle de vie des identités.

  • Renforcer la sécurité des environnements Active Directory : durcissement, GPO, gestion des privilèges et audit des permissions.

  • Participer à la sécurisation des comptes administrateurs et des comptes de service (MSA/gMSA).

  • Contribuer à la gestion des infrastructures PKI, des certificats et des mécanismes de fédération d'identités.

  • Automatiser les tâches d'administration et les contrôles de sécurité via PowerShell.

  • Participer aux projets de migration, de consolidation et de modernisation des infrastructures.

  • Rédiger la documentation technique et les dossiers d'architecture, et accompagner les équipes dans la mise en œuvre des solutions retenues.

Profil recherché

  • Expérience confirmée en architecture IAM et/ou Active Directory, idéalement dans des environnements complexes ou réglementés.

  • Solides compétences en Active Directory, IAM, PKI, PAM, LDAP et PowerShell.

  • Bonne connaissance des enjeux de cybersécurité, de gestion des accès à privilèges et de conformité.

  • Capacité à concevoir des architectures sécurisées, à analyser les risques et à proposer des solutions adaptées.

  • Autonomie, rigueur, esprit d'analyse et bonnes capacités de communication.

C’est votre parcours

Vous avez plus de 10ans d’expérience dans des environnements exigeants et similaires.

Localisation : 100 % télétravail.

Démarrage et durée : à définir.

C’est notre engagement

jobs.title: Commission-Based Recruiter – Multilingual Roles in Europe – Islamabad
jobs.descriptionHtml:
If you source for foreign clients every day, Europe is the same game, in your afternoon hours, paid per placement in euros. Open to recruiters based in Islamabad and across Pakistan.

Take a few minutes to read everything first. It's long on purpose: if this isn't you, no problem, and it saves us both time.

Who we are

BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. Many of these jobs come with relocation help, which makes them easier to sell to candidates.

We have around 60 open roles right now, in Dutch, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Polish, Turkish, the Nordic languages and more. Alongside those we have specialist roles, like compliance, legal and tech, that pay a lot more per placement.

You don't need to speak the candidates' languages. Every role needs English, and English is what we work in. What matters is that you know where to find people and how to get them excited about a job abroad.

Who we're looking for

People who are hungry, driven and excited about this opportunity, and who believe they can earn more on commission than they do now.

We don't care how many years you've been recruiting. Someone with 6 months of hunger can beat someone with 10 years of experience. We care about what you have personally delivered: how many placements, for what kind of roles, and how many a month.

You'll probably fit if:

  • You're a natural seller who finds people on your own, without leads or hand-holding.
  • You understand that every nationality is found differently. If one channel doesn't work for a market, you know where those people really are and go there.
  • You already have your own tools: LinkedIn, laptop, phone, and whatever else you use to recruit.
  • You want freedom: your own hours, your own place, your own methods, no boss.
  • You have real numbers: placements or sales you made yourself, and you know your monthly average.
  • You've done global or international recruitment, ideally for similar companies or the same kind of candidates: customer service, call centres, multilingual roles, relocation, tourism, hospitality.

This is NOT for you if

  • You'll blame others when a client pauses a role or a candidate drops out. That's part of recruitment.
  • Most of the people you can reach need a visa. Most of our roles require candidates who can already work in the EU, and we don't offer visa support on most jobs.
  • You need a fixed income soon. There is no salary, retainer or paid trial at the start.
  • You need us to pay for tools before you can work. We don't cover anything at the start.
  • You want something to try "when you have time".
  • You need someone to tell you what to do every day.

What you earn

  • Minimum €400 per placement. Most roles pay €400–750, and specialist roles up to €2,400.
  • You see the exact payout on every role before you work on it.
  • A placement counts once your candidate has started and the employer has paid us. Someone who accepts and then drops out is not a placement.
  • Payment usually comes 1–3 months after your candidate starts, depending on the employer. We pay by bank transfer or whatever works for you.
  • Money you've earned is always paid. We know many recruiters are afraid of not being paid. Think about it from our side: a recruiter who delivers is worth far more to us over time than any single placement. This whole system is built on trust, and we'd lose by breaking it.

If you deliver, we deliver back

Nothing comes up front. Everything below grows with your re...

Who we are BC Recruitment places people in jobs across Europe: multilingual customer service, sales and support roles with some of the biggest international employers, in cities like Athens, Lisbon, Porto, Braga and Sofia. jobs.title: Digital Marketing Specialist (Google Ads & Meta Ads)
jobs.descriptionHtml: At Bali Zoo, we’re passionate about connecting people with wildlife while inspiring conservation efforts across Indonesia. We’re expanding our digital media team and looking for a data-driven **Digital Marketing Specialist** who excels at managing performance campaign channels, specifically Google Ads and Meta Ads. In this role, you’ll take full ownership of running, optimizing, and scaling paid advertising strategy to drive ticket sales, increase guest engagement, and enhance our online visibility. **Key Responsibilities** * **Campaign Management:** Design, build, and optimize paid advertising campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, YouTube, Performance Max) and Meta Ads (Facebook & Instagram). * **Strategy & Budgeting:** Allocate advertising budgets effectively to maximize ROAS (Return on Ad Spend) and lower customer acquisition costs. * **A/B Testing & Creative Strategy:** Partner with our creative content team to test ad copy, visual assets, and landing page layouts for continuous conversion rate optimization. * **Analytics & Reporting:** Track key performance metrics, evaluate user behavior, and deliver clear weekly reports with actionable insights for management. * **Audience Targeting:** Refine target audience segments, build custom lookalikes, and implement retargeting strategies to reach both local and international travelers. **Requirements** * Proven experience managing high-performing Google Ads and Meta Ads campaigns (agency or tourism/hospitality background is a plus). * Strong analytical mindset with proficiency in Google Analytics (GA4), Meta Ads Manager, and pixel/event tracking implementation. * In-depth understanding of campaign structures, bid strategies, keyword research, and conversion tracking. * Good written and verbal English communication skills to craft compelling ad copy and collaborate effectively. * Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and a self-driven approach to testing new ad concepts. * On-site presence required at our office in Gianyar, Bali. **Why Join Us?** * Work in a unique, vibrant, and fun environment surrounded by nature and wildlife. * Collaborative culture where innovative ideas and testing new digital initiatives are encouraged. Work Location: In person

jobs.title: (Senior) AI Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Experten, die sich miteinander vernetzen, um als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen voranzutreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie.

 Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet dir die Türen zu anspruchsvollen Digitalisierungsprojekten mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum. Bei cbs arbeitest du in einem starken Team, übernimmst schnell Verantwortung und entwickelst dich fachlich wie persönlich weiter.

Als (Senior) AI Engineer (m/w/d) entwickelst du KI-gestützte Automatisierungslösungen, die produktiv in den Geschäftsprozessen unserer Kunden laufen und ihnen einen messbaren Wettbewerbsvorteil verschaffen - von der intelligenten Dokumentenverarbeitung bis hin zu agentischen Systemen, die eigenständig Prozessschritte übernehmen. Deine technologische Basis ist die SAP Business Technology Platform (BTP) / Business AI Platform in Kombination weiterer Cloud- und KI-Plattformen unserer Kunden. Das SAP-Zielsystem (S/4HANA oder ECC) musst du dafür noch nicht im Detail kennen - die nötige Tiefe bauen wir gemeinsam mit dir auf.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Du konzipierst und entwickelst KI-Lösungen, die manuelle Arbeit in Geschäftsprozessen gezielt automatisieren, und integrierst sie über SAP- und Non-SAP-APIs in die bestehende Systemlandschaft.

  • Du entwickelst mit Python (z. B. FastAPI, LangGraph) und Node.js/TypeScript (u. a. SAP CAP) und bewegst dich souverän in der jeweiligen Kundenlandschaft, ob SAP BTP, Hyperscaler oder spezialisierte KI-Plattformen, deren Rahmenbedingungen du bei der Architektur berücksichtigst und mitgestaltest.

  • Du verantwortest deine Lösungen von der Anforderungsaufnahme bis zum Go-Live, einschließlich Evaluierung, Monitoring und Weiterentwicklung im Betrieb.

  • Du leitest Kunden-Workshops, präsentierst Ergebnisse und vertrittst deine Architekturentscheidungen überzeugend gegenüber unseren Kunden.

  • Du bringst dich aktiv in unser Business-AI-Team ein und gestaltest unsere Methoden, Frameworks und internen Produkte mit.


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Sehr gute Python-Kenntnisse, insbesondere im Umfeld von LLM-Anbindung und Orchestrierung, sowie Erfahrung mit Node.js (JavaScript/TypeScript) und ein gutes Verständnis verteilter Anwendungen.

  • Praktische Erfahrung mit generativer KI aus Projekten, Forschung oder eigenen Vorhaben. Themen wie Tool Calling, Kontext-Management, strukturierte Ausgaben und Evaluierung sind dir aus der Anwendung vertraut, und du verstehst, wie sich daraus agentische Lösungen aufbauen lassen.

  • Die Fähigkeit, dich in einem dynamischen Technologiefeld sicher zu bewegen: Du entwickelst eigenständig tragfähige Lösungsansätze, wo etablierte Muster fehlen, bewertest neue Werkzeuge kritisch und teilst deine Erkenntnisse im Team.

  • Ein technisches Studium oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation mit nachweisbarer Praxiserfahrung.

  • Offenheit für SAP-Technologien und die Bereitschaft, dich in BTP- und ERP-Integrationsszenarien einzuarbeiten.

  • Ein Gespür für die Anforderungen regulierter Branchen, etwa Datenschutz und Datensouveränität, das du selbstverständlich in deine Lösungen einfließen lässt.

jobs.title: (Senior) SAP SmartRecruiters Consultant (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind die Berater der Weltmarktführer: Hochmotivierte Expertinnen und Experten, die als erfolgreiches Team digitale End-to-End-Geschäftsprozesslösungen vorantreiben. Gemeinsam stärken wir die Zukunft der beeindruckendsten Unternehmen der Welt aus Maschinen- und Anlagenbau, Automotive, Life Science, Pharma und Chemie, mit denen wir viel gemeinsam haben.

Unser ausgezeichneter Ruf bei Hidden Champions öffnet Dir die Türen für anspruchsvolle Projekte mit einzigartigen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten. Werde Teil einer der besten und verlässlichsten Beratungen und nutze vielfältige Entwicklungschancen. Als engagiertes Teammitglied kannst Du bei uns schnell Verantwortung übernehmen und über Dich hinauswachsen. Du triffst auf ein starkes Team, das zusammenhält und wirklich etwas bewegen will.

Ziel der Position

Als (Senior) SAP SmartRecruiters Consultant (m/w/d) gestaltest Du die Zukunft der digitalen Talent-Acquisition-Landschaft unserer Kunden. Du verbindest moderne HR-Technologien mit maßgeschneiderten Recruiting-Prozessen und machst Weltmarktführer zu Magneten für Top-Talente.

In dieser Rolle schaffst Du die Brücke zwischen klassischem SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting und innovativen SmartRecruiters-Lösungen, um nahtlose, begeisternde Candidate Journeys und effiziente Auswahlprozesse zu realisieren.

Was Dich erwartet

  • Anspruchsvolle Projektvielfalt: Konzeption, Design und globale Implementierung moderner Talent-Acquisition-Architekturen bei namhaften Kunden – weit über den Standard hinaus

  • Strategische & operative HR-Beratung: Ganzheitliche Beratung unserer Kunden bei der Transformation ihrer Recruiting-Prozesse sowie bei der Auswahl und Integration passender Best-of-Breed-Lösungen

  • Prozessuale End-to-End-Orchestrierung: Gestaltung nahtloser Schnittstellen zu angrenzenden HR-Modulen wie Onboarding, Employee Central, Learning sowie Growth & Portfolio

  • Individuelle Entwicklungspfade: Übernahme eigener Implementation Tracks oder gezielter Ausbau Deiner cross-modularen Expertise je nach Deinen persönlichen Stärken und Interessen

  • Echte Gestaltungschancen & Vertrauen: Ein starkes Expertenteam mit flachen Hierarchien, in dem Deine Ideen zählen und Du von Anfang an Verantwortung übernehmen kannst

  • Maximale Flexibilität: Eigenverantwortliche und hochflexible Arbeitsbedingungen – remote, hybrid und optimal auf Deine persönliche Work-Life-Balance abgestimmt


Was wir uns wünschen

  • Ausbildung & Fundament: Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium der (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Psychologie oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Fundierte Modul-Expertise: Langjährige Praxiserfahrung in der Beratung und Konzeption von SAP SuccessFactors Recruiting (idealerweise mit bestehender Zertifizierung)

  • Erfahrung mit SmartRecruiters: Erste praktische Erfahrungen mit SmartRecruiters sind von großem Vorteil

  • Ganzheitlicher Blick auf HR: Tiefes Prozessverständnis für die moderne Candidate Journey sowie die angrenzenden Schnittmengen im HR-Lifecycle (z. B. Onboarding, Talent Management, Core HR)

  • Beratungs- & Persönlichkeitskompetenz: Ausgeprägte Empathie, starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten und konzeptionelles Denken, um Kunden sicher durch komplexe Veränderungsprozesse zu führen

  • Sprachkenntnisse & Teamgeist: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse sowie echte Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team und an kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung

jobs.title: Chief Information Security Officer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Catalyst Capital is a profitable, bootstrapped holding company building a diversified financial services group: education, publishing, software, wealth and tax planning tools, investment products and proprietary trading technology. Funded entirely from its own operating cash. We have never taken outside capital.

The cash engine is Decentralized Masters, a DeFi education business that went from zero to 150+ people, 4,500+ paying members and roughly $48.6M of FY26 revenue at ~25% earnings before tax in four years. That engine funds everything else on this page.

Role summary

Catalyst Capital is hiring its first Chief Information Security Officer to own security across every brand in the group. You will set the strategy, build the program, and personally run the response when something goes wrong.

The job is two halves. Half is the core of a CISO's role: incident response, identity and access, vendor risk, phishing defense, policy and audit readiness, and the judgment calls only a person can own. The other half is making security AI-driven: mapping our full surface and building agentic systems that test, monitor and audit it with near-total coverage, so security keeps pace as more of the company runs on AI. This is a player-coach role: about half hands-on, leading a small team of engineers.

You report to Group leadership, brief the leadership team monthly, and are the person they trust to explain risk in plain language and make the call under pressure.

What you will own

Core security leadership (about half)

  • Security strategy and program. Own the security strategy, roadmap and budget across Decentralized Masters, Legacy, Inflection Club, Sentinelis and future brands. Report posture, top risks and trends to leadership every month, with a risk register leadership can act on.
  • Incident response. Own IR end to end: detection, triage, containment, eradication, recovery and the postmortem. Lead the room during a live incident and coordinate with legal counsel, forensics firms, insurers and regulators. Keep runbooks current and run tabletop exercises.
  • Cloud and identity security. Own identity and access across the group: SSO, MFA, least-privilege roles, admin redundancy and short-lived credentials. Set the AWS security baseline.
  • Third-party and vendor risk. Assess the security of every vendor and data provider we depend on, including their audits and attestations, and set the bar a vendor must clear before connecting to our systems or data.
  • Platform and customer account security. Set the standards for login protection and account-takeover defense on our platforms, and work with the engineering teams that own each platform to build them in.
  • Phishing and impersonation defense. Own email security, staff training and phishing simulations. Run brand protection: find and take down fake domains and accounts impersonating our brands and leaders.
  • Policy, compliance and trust. Write and enforce policies people actually follow. Prepare the company for SOC 2 or ISO 27001 with Legal & Compliance. Own the public security and trust story, including the trust page on our products.
  • Team leadership. Manage and develop our security engineers, decide what we build in-house versus outsource, and grow the team only where automation cannot do the job.
  • Member scam awareness. Supply the security content behind scam-awareness messaging to members, working with Community, Support and Marketing. Legal approves the wording.

AI-driven security (about half)

  • Full attack-surface map. Build and maintain a living inventory of everything we run: internal apps, cloud, code repos, and every SaaS tool and integration (CRM, telephony, community, payments, data providers). Know what connects to what, who has access, and what is logged.
  • Agentic security harness. Design and run AI-driven systems ...

jobs.title: Montageplaner (m/w/d) Versorgungstechnik (HKLS)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du arbeitest gerne genau, strukturiert und praxisnah? Du kennst dich mit HKLS-Materialien, Montageabläufen und technischen Details aus und möchtest Pläne erstellen, die auf der Baustelle wirklich funktionieren?

Dann bist du bei BIMEXPERTS genau richtig.

Für unseren Standort in Vilshofen suchen wir einen Montageplaner (m/w/d) im Bereich Versorgungstechnik (HKLS), der Materialverständnis, eine genaue Ausarbeitung mit einer ausführungsreifen Planung verbindet. Bei uns geht es nicht nur darum, Leitungen zu zeichnen, sondern durchdachte, umsetzbare und nachvollziehbare Montageunterlagen zu erstellen.

Aufgaben:

  • Du erstellst Montagepläne und Ausführungsunterlagen im Bereich HKLS in 2D und 3D.
  • Du arbeitest technische Vorgaben, Schemata, Grundrisse, Modelle und Planungsunterlagen in umsetzbare Montagepläne aus.
  • Du achtest auf Leitungsführungen, Einbausituationen, Kollisionspunkte, Revisionsmöglichkeiten und eine praxisgerechte Ausführung.
  • Du berücksichtigst Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formstücke, Armaturen, Dämmungen, Befestigungen, Brandschutzanforderungen und bauliche Gegebenheiten.
  • Du prüfst Planungsstände auf Plausibilität, Vollständigkeit und technische Umsetzbarkeit.
  • Du koordinierst dich persönlich, telefonisch oder online mit Projektbeteiligten und hältst die wesentlichen Ergebnisse nachvollziehbar fest.
  • Du dokumentierst offene Punkte, Änderungen und technische Entscheidungen nachvollziehbar, forderst notwendige Entscheidungen proaktiv ein und schaffst die Voraussetzungen, um selbstständig weiterarbeiten zu können.
  • Du arbeitest mit CAD-/BIM-Tools und hilfst mit, unsere digitalen Planungsprozesse weiterzuentwickeln.

Qualifikation:

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder mehrjährige Berufserfahrung im Bereich HKLS, Gebäudetechnik – idealerweise aus einem Installationsunternehmen, der Montage, Bauleitung oder Baustellenpraxis.
  • Du kommst aus der Ausführung und möchtest dich stärker in Richtung Technik, Planung und Montageplanung weiterentwickeln.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in der Montageplanung, Ausführungsplanung oder als Bauleiter im Bereich Heizung, Kälte, Lüftung und Sanitär.
  • Du bringst ein sehr gutes Verständnis für Normen, Produkte, Materialien, Rohrsysteme, Formteile, Befestigungen, Dämmungen, Armaturen und Montageabläufe mit.
  • Du kannst 2D Pläne lesen und Zusammenhänge verstehen und Details so ausarbeiten, dass sie ohne Rückfragen mit dem Plan auf der Baustelle baubar sind.
  • Du denkst nicht nur zeichnerisch, sondern auch baustellen-, montage- und ausführungsorientiert.
  • Du arbeitest genau, strukturiert, zuverlässig und mit hohem Qualitätsanspruch.
  • Du hast idealerweise Erfahrung mit AutoCAD, Revit, Plancal Nova oder vergleichbaren CAD-/BIM-Systemen.
  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf B2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits:

  • Anspruchsvolle HKLS-Projekte mit hoher technischer Tiefe, bei denen Genauigkeit zählt und es ausdrücklich erwünscht ist, Fehler, Unklarheiten und Verbesserungspotenziale aktiv anzusprechen.
  • Ein Aufgabenbereich, in dem Genauigkeit, Erfahrung und Materialverständnis wirklich zählen.

Enterprises, from the Fortune 500 to fast-growing startups, use our no-code platform to onboard, assess, and monitor their vendors, suppliers, and partners across risk, compliance, and ESG. We have processed over 10 million entities for 100,000+ users across 120+ countries, and are backed by Fin Capital, Vertex Ventures, and Point72 Ventures.

Don't see a role that fits? Apply here anyway. We grow fast, and new openings appear all the time - often before they're posted. If you're excited about Certa and believe you can make an impact, this is your front door. jobs.title: Enterprise Account Executive - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Join Sales at Ashby

Sales at Ashby is a unique opportunity to sell a product customers genuinely love during an AI-fueled market expansion. Over 5,000 companies rely on Ashby, including OpenAI, Bolt, Statista, Neura Robotics and Monday.com, and our business is durably growing faster than 100% year-over-year. We’re well funded, and on a path to profitability. That's exceptionally rare for a company at our scale, and puts us in the top 10% of benchmarks.

Nearly 1 in 3 of Ashby’s globally distributed team call Europe home! We’ve landed over 1000 customers in EMEA representing ~23% of our global revenue base, with well over 100 in the DACH region, clear evidence of strong product-market fit. We’re doubling down our investment in the region with in-market GTM, CS and Support resources. EU Data Residency and product localisation are committed and coming soon. We believe there is a meaningful opportunity to help modern teams move beyond legacy recruiting software.

Ashby replaces 3-5 tools in a consolidation & efficiency play that’s equally loved by recruiters and CFOs. We’re known as a clear AI-leader in the recruiting space. We are rapidly extending from a best-in-class recruiting product toward a multi-product platform, expanding upmarket, into new industries, and internationally. For sales reps, that means a large market full of legacy tools, and a product portfolio that creates room for both new business and expansion. This is a chance to participate in how a category-defining company wins in its next phase of growth.

We are equally intentional about how we build the business. We have established a remote-first, high-performing sales organization that rewards learning and accountability. We use data to set achievable quotas, and reward sustained impact with competitive compensation and meaningful upside. We prioritize coaching and career development, with AEs advancing to Enterprise & Leadership roles in just a few years — 38% of the team who have been here more than a year have been promoted or taken on a new role!

You will work with people who care about craft, customer outcomes, and winning together—without sacrificing the trust, autonomy, and balance required to do your best work over the long term. Don’t just take my word for it, see what the team has to say about working here.

About this Role

TA tools in the Enterprise represent a huge market opportunity, a $1B+ TAM, and the incumbents are legacy players. We are displacing a collection of tools (ATS, Sourcing & CRM, Scheduling, Analytics, Offers & Approvals) with a consolidated talent suite. This is a proven playbook that Workday used to win the HCM market as customers realize value in a multitude of ways.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
ZEAL Network SE is a leading international provider of online lottery products, operating for over 20 years with brands like LOTTO24 and Tipp24. As Germany’s largest digital lottery operator and a trusted partner of Spain’s ONCE, we are passionate about shaping the future of lottery experiences.

 

LOTTO24 is Germany’s leading online provider of state-licensed lottery products, offering customers convenient and secure access to popular games like LOTTO 6aus49, Eurojackpot, and GlücksSpirale. As a trusted partner of the state lotteries, LOTTO24 ensures that every ticket sold helps support charitable, social, and community projects across Germany. By combining ease of play, trusted security, and meaningful social contributions, LOTTO24 exemplifies ZEAL’s vision of making lottery participation more accessible while giving back to society.

The role:

As our Brand Manager, you bring our brand and marketing strategy to life through impactful consumer campaigns and creative initiatives. You translate strategic direction and campaign concepts into high-quality execution across relevant channels and customer touchpoints. Working closely with cross-functional teams, agencies, and external partners, you combine creativity, strong execution, and data-driven decision-making to strengthen our brand and contribute to measurable business impact.

Your tasks:

• Collaborate closely with Media, CRM, Creative and Product teams to ensure a consistent brand experience

• Execute integrated consumer campaigns across high-reach channels such as TV, online video and OOH

• Use consumer and market insights to inform campaign execution and creative decisions

• Monitor campaign KPIs and optimize activities based on data, results and learnings

• Align marketing initiatives with Product, Legal and Compliance requirements

• Manage campaign and production budgets within defined frameworks

• Analyze campaign performance and derive clear learnings for future activities

• Experience managing campaign or production budgets

• Experience with campaign analytics, reporting and marketing measurement

jobs.title: Vice President, Product Marketing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our mission: eliminating every barrier to mental health.

Spring Health is a global mental health company on a mission to eliminate every barrier to mental health. We're building a world where getting support is simple, personal, and built around the person, so care can continue through every job, move, health plan, and life stage.

Our AI-native platform helps us deliver personalized support across self-guided tools, coaching, therapy, medication management, and specialty care. With outcomes independently validated by JAMA Network Open and the Validation Institute, Spring Health reaches more than 170 million people worldwide through leading employers, health plans, and partners.

As an AI-native company, we believe technology should expand the reach, quality, and humanity of care. Every Spring Health team member is expected to use AI tools thoughtfully, apply human judgment to AI outputs, and keep building AI fluency in ways that support their role and our mission.

The Vice President of Product Marketing will play a pivotal role in our marketing strategy through the positioning and packaging of our products and services. They will play an integral part in shaping and executing our go-to-market strategy, driving product adoption, enabling our GTM teams, and ensuring our solutions meet the evolving needs of our customers, members and providers. This role requires a visionary leader with a deep passion for mental health, exceptional marketing acumen, and a proven track record of success in B2B environments. Our category is an increasingly competitive one and it will be your responsibility to ensure we bring differentiation to life in novel, and inspiring stories that solidify our position as the category leader.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Develop and execute a comprehensive product marketing strategy that aligns with the company's business objectives and growth targets.

  • Partner closely with the CxO and broader extended leadership team to position us for future horizons and new audiences in a way that builds brand credibility and opportunities.

  • Lead and develop a team of product marketers across positioning, enablement,competitive intelligence and market research, and operations to execute on our ambitious growth goals and innovation strategy.

  • Conduct thorough market research and competitive analysis to identify opportunities, trends, and potential threats in the mental health sector.

  • Define and communicate the unique value proposition of our products, ensuring clear and compelling messaging across all channels.

  • Lead the development and execution of go-to-market plans for new product launches, ensuring successful adoption and market penetration.

  • Work closely with product management, sales, customer success, and other departments to ensure alignment and drive cohesive marketing initiatives.

  • Leverage customer feedback, data analytics, and industry insights to inform product development and marketing strategies.

  • Oversee the creation of high-impact marketing materials, including sales collateral, case studies, whitepapers, and thought leadership content.

  • Provide the sales team with the tools, training, and resources they need to effectively sell and position our products.

  • Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the success of product marketing efforts and drive continuous improvement.

jobs.title: HR Generalist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We’re EngagedMD, a Patient Journey Management solution for specialty care that helps practices improve patient experience, reduce administrative burden, and convert more patients to care, faster.

We’re looking for an HR Generalist who can support our team members and help ensure our HR processes run smoothly. In this role, you’ll take ownership of key HR functions, including benefits administration, payroll support, employment law compliance, and employee relations. You’ll serve as a trusted resource for team members, helping navigate HR-related questions while ensuring our policies and processes are consistent, compliant, and effective. As part of a small, growing company, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact by improving our HR processes and helping create a positive team member experience.

This fully remote role reports to our Director of Operations, and candidates are required to reside in the United States. This role requires legal authorization to work in the United States. EngagedMD is unable to sponsor current H1B visa holders for this role.

What You'll Do

  • Serve as the primary HR point of contact for team members, answering questions and providing guidance on company policies and other employment-related matters

  • Administer employee benefits in partnership with brokers and vendors, including open enrollment, qualifying life events, and resolving benefits-related issues

  • Maintain accurate, confidential employee records in HR systems and assist the payroll team with payroll adjustments

  • Manage HR compliance with federal and state employment laws, unemployment insurance, workers' compensation, accommodation requests, and leave administration, involving legal counsel when appropriate and making informed recommendations to leadership

  • Stay current on federal and state employment laws and HR market trends

  • Coordinate state registrations for our fully-remote organization across multiple jurisdictions, using our existing systems and vendors

  • Review and update the employee handbook, HR policies, and internal documentation to ensure accuracy and compliance

  • Handle day-to-day employee relations matters, supporting team members and managers in addressing workplace concerns, documenting issues and resolutions, and escalating complex or sensitive matters as appropriate.

  • Support performance management, compensation reviews, and employee engagement initiatives, including surveys and feedback analysis

  • Identify opportunities to improve HR processes, streamline workflows, and enhance the overall team member experience

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years of experience in Human Resources, HR administration, or a related HR generalist role.

  • Hands-on experience administering employee benefits, supporting payroll processes, and managing employee relations.

  • Strong knowledge of federal and state employment laws, including ADA, FMLA, workers' compensation, and multi-state HR compliance requirements.

  • Experience supporting performance management processes, including performance reviews, talent assessments, and employee engagement initiatives.

jobs.title: Customer Success Manager (m/w/d) gesucht - 100% Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
ProviPanda ist die größte Sales-Job-Plattform im DACH-Raum. Wir verbinden über 45.000 geprüfte Vertriebler mit mehr als 1.000+ Unternehmen. Marken wie Deutsche Bank und Engel & Völkers vertrauen bereits auf uns.

Als Customer Success Manager bist du die zentrale Anlaufstelle für alles, was unsere über 200+ aktiven Kunden im Tagesgeschäft betrifft abseits von Sales.

Du triffst Entscheidungen, wenn unser Support nicht weiterweiß, kümmerst dich um Refundanfragen und Zahlungsthemen.

Aufgaben

Team Lead & Struktur aufbauen

  • Team-Lead-Funktion für Support & Success - du baust die Struktur, Prozesse und langfristig das Team dahinter auf
  • Aufbau von Onboarding-Strukturen für neue Support- und Success-Mitarbeiter
  • Erste/r Ansprechpartner/in und Hauptverantwortliche/r für alle Kunden-Themen im Unternehmen (außer Sales)
  • Übernahme der Kundenverantwortung in letzter Instanz, wenn Support oder Account Management nicht weiterkommen

Customer Experience

  • Ausbau der Customer Experience für unsere Unternehmenskunden
  • Aufbau und Pflege von Intercom-Automatisierungen und der gesamten Onboarding-Experience
  • Weiterentwicklung unseres Help Centers für Support- und Success Themen
  • Verantwortung für Newsletter-Strategie

Customer Success

  • Nr. 1 Ansprechperson zwischen Dev, Sales und Produkt für alles, was Kundenstimme und Feedback betrifft
  • Laufende Prozessoptimierung im Bereich Customer Relations
  • Enger Sparringpartner für unseren Account Manager bei allen Themen abseits von Upselling und Vertragsverlängerung
  • Tracking relevanter Success-KPIs (Churn, Retention, Customer Health)
  • Übernahme von Support/Success-Themen bei Enterprise-Kunden, wo mehr Tiefe und Erfahrung gefragt ist
  • Eigenständige Entscheidungen bei Refunds, Kulanzfällen und kritischen Zahlungsthemen (Stripe)
  • Regelmäßiges Reporting an den Geschäftsführer & Head of Sales

Qualifikation

  • Erfahrung im Customer Success Bereich in einem SaaS-Umfeld
  • Du kannst ein Team führen und übernimmst gerne Verantwortung
  • Du triffst schnelle, sichere Entscheidungen und stehst dazu
  • Technisches Verständnis - Du kennst Dich mit Tools wie Stripe, Intercom, Slack, Claude aus und kannst Dich in neue Systeme schnell zurecht finden
  • Ein gutes Gefühl dafür, wann man kulant ist und wann nicht
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, aber flexibel genug für den Startup-Alltag
  • Kommunikationsstärke über Abteilungen hinweg
  • Hands-On Mentalität Abteilungsübergreifend - Du hast Bock auf StartUp und Umsetzung
  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise, aber flexibel genug für den Startup-Alltag
  • Erfahrung im Aufbau von Strukturen und Prozessen, nicht nur im Ausführen bestehender

Benefits

  • Ein schnell wachsendes HR-Tech-Startup mit riesiger Vision wo Du einen Bereich noch maßgeblich mitgestalten & aufbauen kannst
  • Flache Hierarchien, hohe Verantwortung, echte Mitgestaltung
  • stark wachsender Bereich in dem Du eine zentrale Rolle spielst
  • Direkte, enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung
  • Remote-First-Setup
  • Überdurchschnittliches Gehalt
  • Leistungsbezogener Bonus
  • Modernes Apple Equipment

Wenn Du Bock hast auf eine große und klare Vision, ein StartUp Umfeld wo es schnell voran geht, selber stark zu wachsen und vorran zu kommen und auch bereit bist dafür richtig Gas zu geben, dann bist Du bei uns genau richtig.

jobs.title: Projektleiter (m/w/d) Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektro
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du kennst dich in der HKLS- oder Elektrotechnik aus, behältst auch bei komplexen Projekten den Überblick und möchtest mehr Verantwortung übernehmen? Du hast Freude daran, technische und wirtschaftliche Herausforderungen zu lösen, Menschen zu koordinieren und gemeinsam mit einem Team erfolgreiche Projekte umzusetzen?

Dann bist du bei BIMEXPERTS genau richtig.

Für unseren Standort in Vilshofen suchen wir einen Projektleiter (m/w/d) im Bereich Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektrotechnik, der technisches Know-how mit Organisationstalent, Eigeninitiative und Freude an der Zusammenarbeit verbindet. Egal, ob du bereits Projekte leitest oder aus der Fachplanung, Bauleitung oder technischen Projektkoordination kommst und den nächsten Schritt in Richtung Führungsverantwortung gehen möchtest: Bei uns hast du die Möglichkeit, Projekte eigenständig zu steuern, ein Team fachlich zu führen und dich persönlich wie fachlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Aufgaben

  • Du übernimmst die technische und organisatorische Verantwortung für spannende Projekte im Bereich HKLS oder Elektrotechnik.

  • Du koordinierst und führst dein Projektteam fachlich, verteilst Aufgaben, setzt Prioritäten und sorgst für eine strukturierte und erfolgreiche Projektabwicklung.

  • Du bist zentrale Ansprechperson für Kunden, Projektpartner und interne Teams und stellst eine klare, lösungsorientierte Kommunikation sicher.

Qualifikation

  • Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in mindestens einem dieser Fachbereiche mit – beispielsweise aus der Fachplanung, Ausführung, Bauleitung, Projektkoordination oder Projektabwicklung.

  • Du verfügst über ein gutes technisches Verständnis, kennst relevante Normen, Planungs- und Ausführungsabläufe und kannst technische Zusammenhänge sicher beurteilen.

  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch dann den Überblick, wenn mehrere Themen gleichzeitig koordiniert werden müssen.

  • Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung, triffst Entscheidungen und möchtest dein Team unterstützen, motivieren und gemeinsam gute Ergebnisse erreichen.

  • Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf C2-Niveau in Wort und Schrift.

Benefits

  • Anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Projekte im Bereich HKLS oder Elektrotechnik, bei denen du deine technische Erfahrung einbringen und echte Verantwortung übernehmen kannst.

  • Eine verantwortungsvolle Position mit Gestaltungsspielraum, eigenständigen Entscheidungen und der Möglichkeit, Projekte und Teams aktiv zu führen.

  • Kurze Entscheidungswege, direkte Kommunikation und eine enge Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Kollegen, Technik und Geschäftsführung.

  • Ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Eigeninitiative, lösungsorientiertes Denken und neue Ideen ausdrücklich willkommen sind.

Noch ein paar Worte zum Schluss

Wir suchen nicht einfach jemanden, der Projekte verwaltet, sondern eine Persönlichkeit, die Verantwortung übernehmen, technische Herausforderungen lösen und gemeinsam mit einem Team etwas bewegen möchte.

Du musst nicht bereits alles können oder jahrelang als Projektleiter gearbeitet haben. Viel wichtiger sind uns deine technische Erfahrung, dein Organisationstalent, deine Eigeninitiative und deine Motivation, dich weiterzuentwickeln und Führungsverantwortung zu übernehmen.

Wenn du Erfahrung in der Versorgungstechnik (HKLS) oder Elektrotechnik mitbringst, gerne mit Menschen arbeitest und Lust hast, Projekte aktiv zu gestalten, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung.

Ein klassisches Motivationsschreiben ist nicht zwingend erforderlich. Wir freuen uns jedoch, wenn du uns einen kurzen Einblick in deine Beweggründe und deine Motivation gibst.
