jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Impact

The Account Manager I helps communicate CivicPlus’s value proposition to drive new functionality and community engagement with existing clients. You’ll build lasting relationships with clients by teaching them how to maximize CivicPlus products—from current features to new module releases—while identifying opportunities for upsells and growth.

About CivicPlus

At CivicPlus, we strive to bring our company vision to life through innovation and collaboration. Supported by approachable leadership and transparent communication, we’re empowered to make an impact on local government and the residents they serve. Grow your career alongside great people, where authenticity is welcome, successes are celebrated, and potential is nurtured.

What You’ll Do

As an Account Manager I, you will:
  • Clearly and succinctly communicate the company’s value proposition over the phone and through email
  • Perform technical demonstrations of modules and new functionality to clients
  • Provide consulting with clients to promote best practices for websites and community engagement
  • Manage sales requests and new client setup processes
  • Complete communications with assigned clients within required timeframes
  • Respond to client correspondence in a timely manner

We know that excellent candidates come from diverse backgrounds. Even if you don’t meet 100% of the listed requirements, we encourage you to apply!
Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2–5 years of experience in a BDS/SDR or similar sales development role
  • Strong persuasive, analytical, and interpersonal skills
  • Strong and consistent phone presence with the ability to engage clients professionally

  • Demonstrated ability to prioritize multiple tasks and deadlines
  • AI-forward mindset with a demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, and work quality.

Compensation and Benefits

    • Potential Variable Pay: Based on set quotas.
    • The actual salary offer will carefully consider a wide range of factors, including your skills, qualifications, experience and is based on a 40-hour work week.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, Flexible Time Off, 401(k) plan, and more.

Our Hiring Process

You’ll join a people-focused business that is putting AI at the center of how manufacturers and distributors price, quote and manage incentives, with a real opportunity to accelerate your career in enterprise SaaS sales.

As a Senior Sales Development Representative, you will identify and engage our ideal customers using Vendavo’s target account profile. You will lead the first stage of the customer journey, starting conversations and building early relationships through outbound prospecting, targeted campaigns, events and coordinated marketing activity.

You will guide prospects through the early stages of the commercial lifecycle: discovering opportunities, qualifying interest and fit, and securing high-quality meetings for our Account Executives.   • Research the business issues affecting target accounts and profile key contacts before outreach.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the Job



Welcome to Ovation Healthcare!

At Ovation Healthcare we’ve been making local healthcare better for more than 40 years. Our mission is to strengthen independent community healthcare. We provide independent hospitals and health systems with the support, guidance and tech-enabled shared services needed to remain strong and viable. With a strong sense of purpose and commitment to operating excellence, we help rural healthcare providers fulfill their missions.

The Ovation Healthcare difference is the extraordinary combination of operations experience and consulting guidance that fulfills our mission of creating a sustainable future for healthcare organizations. Ovation Healthcare’s vision is to be a dynamic, integrated professional services company delivering innovative and executable solutions through experience and thought leadership, while valuing trust, respect, and customer focused behavior.


We’re looking for talented, motivated professionals with a desire to help independent hospitals thrive. Working with Ovation Healthcare, you will have the opportunity to collaborate with highly skilled subject matter specialists and operations executives, in a collegial atmosphere of professionalism and teamwork.


Ovation Healthcare’s corporate headquarters is located in Brentwood, TN. For more information, visit .


Summary:

The Clinical Informaticist I plays a critical role in analyzing and enhancing workflows, data collection, and reporting for clinical operations, specifically with the EHR software and other digital platforms used within the organization. Under close supervision, this role assists in the design, testing, and validation of electronic health record (EHR) systems and collaborates with clinical and technical teams to develop solutions that improve patient care and operational efficiency. The Clinical Informaticist I works closely with leadership to optimize workflows that enable efficient access to and retrieval of clinical data.

This position supports clinical end-users by streamlining and standardizing workflows while identifying new processes to enhance efficiency. The role requires understanding the specific needs of clinical staff and developing solutions that optimize patient care and user experiences in all settings. Additionally, the Clinical Informaticist I helps ensure the security of EMR system configurations and assists in testing and validating new software releases to ensure they meet the needs of end-users and patients.

The Clinical Informaticist I also works with leadership to develop, optimize, and implement workflows that support the efficient management of clinical data. This role ensures that the EMR system’s information is accurately managed, securely stored, and accessible to staff to improve patient care.


Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Workflow Analysis and Optimization: Support the evaluation, design, and enhancement of clinical workflows to improve operational efficiency and patient care.
  • EHR System Support: Assist in the design, testing, validation, and implementation of electronic health record (EHR) systems and updates under close supervision.
  • Collaboration with Clinical and Technical Teams: Work closely with clinical staff, technical teams, and leadership to identify needs and develop solutions that enhance user experience and clinical outcomes.
  • Data Management and Reporting: Contribute to the development and optimization of processes for accurate and secure collection, storage, and access to clinical data.
  • End-User Support and Training: Assist clinical end-users by identifying workflow improvement opportunities, standardizing processes, and supporting system navigation and adoption.

Job Summary

You are responsible for supporting project managers, teams, and leaders in the successful completion of projects within a fast-paced, high-tech environment. You will serve as a reference point for project manager queries and information, and advocate for best practices in project management. In addition to general administrative duties, you will be responsible for assisting in project tracking and monitoring, ensuring deadlines are met, and communicating project risks and opportunities.

You will handle financial queries, look for ways to increase project profitability, and reduce expenses where possible and will be accountable for ensuring that projects remain on track and communicating with stakeholders and clients to determine project objectives.

Reporting Structure

  • This job reports to the Engagement Manager

Job Objectives

  • Ensure project schedule adherence and deliver projects on time.

  • Manage project finances and deliver projects within budget.

  • Deliver high-quality project deliverables that meet or exceed customer expectations.

  • Provide support and assistance to project managers and teams in the effective use of project management practices and methodologies to ensure successful project delivery.

  • Monitor project schedules, track progress, and communicate risks and opportunities to stakeholders, while looking for ways to increase project profitability and reduce expenses.

General:

  • Act as the main point of contact for Project Managers, stakeholders, and team members to resolve any project-related issues.

  • Champion the use of project management methodologies and best practices across the organization.

  • Prepare high-level presentations and reports to update senior management on project progress, risks, and opportunities.

  • Delegate tasks and responsibilities to team members and ensure they are accountable for their deliverables.

  • Ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and within budget.

  • Identify and mitigate project risks and issues.

  • Organize and facilitate stakeholder meetings and follow up on action items.

  • Provide administrative support to the project team as needed.

  • Assist project coordinators to ensure successful project delivery.

Project Tracking and Monitoring

  • Track and monitor project schedules and progress against project plan.

  • Conduct regular meetings with project team members to ensure successful completion of project activities/tasks.

  • Work with Project Managers to identify and resolve project roadblocks and resource constraints.

  • Monitor project budgets and expenses to ensure projects are delivered within budget.

  • Ensure project documentation is maintained and up to date.

Financial

  • Ensure project financials are accurately tracked and reported.

  • Identify opportunities to increase project profitability and reduce expenses where possible.

  • Handle financial queries and provide regular updates to the project team and stakeholders.

  • Follow up on project invoices and payments.

Educational Qualification

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Project Management, Engineering, or a related field.

Licenses & Certifications

  • PMP certification is a plus

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

The Talent Acquisition Supervisor reports to the Director of Talent Acquisition and is responsible for leading a team of Talent Acquisition Associates, Specialists and Senior Specialists supporting high-volume hiring initiatives. This role oversees day-to-day operations, workforce planning, stakeholder management, team productivity, and recruiting performance to ensure hiring goals are achieved efficiently and effectively.

The Supervisor serves as the primary leader for class-based recruiting efforts, ensuring recruiting processes, candidate pipelines, and hiring events are executed successfully while maintaining exceptional candidate and stakeholder experiences.

Responsibilities

  • Own full cycle, fast paced, and high-quality talent acquisition process
  • Lead, coach, and develop Talent Acquisition team members through regular coaching and performance discussions
  • Provide daily guidance and support regarding recruiting strategies, candidate management, and stakeholder communication
  • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement
  • Monitor workload distribution and team capacity to maximize productivity and efficiency
  • Provide a warm, high touch, and superlative experience to candidates and hiring teams throughout the entirety of recruiting cycles
  • Lead meetings with stakeholders on hiring needs and progress
  • Collaborate with HR/Onboarding team to prepare onboarding and orientation plans for new hires and ensure plans are executed smoothly

  • The employee is expected to be punctual and ready to report to work on a consistent basis

Role Overview

Job Title: Accounting Manager

Employment Type: Full-Time (Canadian business hours)

Work Setup: Remote

Role Overview

Treantly is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented Accounting Manager to support a Canadian accounting firm serving owner-managed businesses and not-for-profit organizations.

In this role, you will manage a portfolio of clients, oversee accounting and tax engagements, review financial reports, and provide guidance to junior team members. The ideal candidate has a strong background in Canadian public accounting, excellent organizational skills, and the ability to manage multiple client engagements while maintaining high standards of accuracy and professionalism.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of clients, ensuring timely and accurate delivery of accounting and tax services.
  • Perform controller-level responsibilities for various clients, including financial reporting and accounting oversight.
  • Review bookkeeping records, compilation engagements, and tax returns prepared by team members.
  • Prepare compilation engagements, financial statements, and Canadian corporate tax returns.
  • Assist with review, audit, and consulting engagements as needed.
  • Prepare and review GST returns, T4 and T5 information returns, and personal income tax returns.
  • Oversee payroll processing and review payroll records for accuracy and compliance.
  • Build and maintain strong professional relationships with clients.
  • Mentor, train, and support junior accounting staff to ensure quality and efficiency.
  • Manage multiple projects, prioritize deadlines, and maintain accurate documentation.
  • Identify opportunities to improve accounting processes and implement efficient workflows.
  • Perform other accounting and administrative duties as assigned.

Requirements

  • CPA or CA designation is required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of public accounting experience, preferably with a small or mid-sized Canadian accounting firm.
  • Strong knowledge of Canadian accounting standards, taxation, and financial reporting requirements.
  • Experience preparing and reviewing Canadian corporate and personal tax returns.
  • Hands-on experience with compilation engagements, financial statements, and bookkeeping reviews.
  • Proficiency in Caseware, Profile, and Microsoft Office applications.
  • Familiarity with QuickBooks Online and Xero is preferred.
  • Experience overseeing payroll, GST filings, and T4/T5 information returns.
  • Previous experience supervising, mentoring, or reviewing the work of junior accountants is an advantage.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and problem-solving abilities.
  • Ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and consistently meet deadlines.
  • Comfortable learning new accounting software and adopting technology to improve efficiency.

Benefits

  • Opportunities for growth and advancement
  • Competitive compensation package, including Maxicare HMO

Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager of AMS Deal Desk to join our team. This is a hybrid or remote role, reporting to the Director of Deal Desk in the WW GTM Operations department. About Pragma & FirstLook

Pragma builds software that helps game studios create great games and lasting relationships with their players. FirstLook helps studios run playtests, understand their audiences, and build engaged player communities. Our work connects game developers, players, and creators, with the goal of helping great games find and grow their audiences.

You'll be joining a deeply experienced team who have scaled some of the largest games in the world, including League of Legends and Destiny 2. Our team also brings platform experience from Google, Twitch, Amazon, and Microsoft.

We are a Series B company backed by globally renowned technology investors, including Greylock, Insight Partners, and Upfront Ventures.

Location: Remote, based in Europe or North America

Coverage: Strategic accounts across North America and Europe, with APAC support during overlapping hours

Employment: Part-time hourly contract (up to 20 hours/week) to start, with a path to full time as the program grows

About the role
We’re building a managed services offering for FirstLook, and we’re looking for someone to lead it.

More and more studios see community management as a service they buy, not a role they hire for. Some just need their Discord set up. Others have FirstLook but not the bandwidth or skills to use it fully. Some lose a key person in the middle of a playtest. What they all want is someone who can come in and run it: their FirstLook setup, playtests, player comms, Discord, and sometimes their creator program.

You’ll start by doing this for a small number of studios, working embedded with their teams alongside our customer success and sales teams. As demand grows, you’ll turn the work into packages, templates, and playbooks we can offer studios of every size, from self-serve resources for small teams to fully managed support for publishers.

This role starts as a part-time contract. As the business grows, we expect it to become full time.

Run FirstLook and player operations for studios

  • Coordinate player recruitment with our team, using both our player network and paid acquisition campaigns.

Community management and moderation

  • Set up or restructure Discord servers, including roles, permissions, bots, onboarding, and guidelines.
  • Write moderation policies, escalation processes, and handbooks, and recruit, train, and support moderators.

Community health and crisis support

Creator programs

  • Help studios launch and run creator programs with FirstLook’s creator tools, including onboarding, outreach, and communications.

jobs.title: Product Analyst - Casino Integrations
jobs.descriptionHtml:
What are we building?

Hard Rock Digital is a fiercely focused team working to become the best online sportsbook, casino, and social gaming company in the world. We're building a deeply curious team with a passion for learning, operating, and building new products and technologies for millions of consumers. We're customer-obsessed — we care about each customer interaction, experience, behavior, and insight, and strive to ensure we're always acting authentically.

Rooted in the kindred spirits of Hard Rock and the Seminole Tribe of Florida, Hard Rock Digital taps a brand known the world over as the leader in gaming, entertainment, and hospitality. We're taking that foundation of success and bringing it to the digital space - ready to join us?

What’s the position?

We’re seeking a Product Analyst to join our Casino Product organization. In this role, you will support the Integrations team, which manages third-party casino suppliers. You will work closely with engineering, platform, compliance and external partners to support the delivery of new games, features and integrations that meet regulatory, technical and business requirements.

Additionally, you will support broader product development initiatives within the Casino portfolio including front-end UX enhancements, promotions tooling, and back-end platform improvements that serve internal stakeholders like Marketing, Customer Service, and Operations. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys being hands-on and wants to grow into broader product ownership over time.

You’ll operate at the intersection of technology, external partners, and internal stakeholders, helping ensure our casino platform delivers high-quality, reliable content at scale.

Key Responsibilities

  • Execute the product backlog for casino game provider integrations and related platform capabilities

  • Support the end-to-end onboarding of new casino game providers, from requirements gathering through launch and post-launch support

  • Gather and document integration requirements and acceptance criteria, working with engineering teams to clarify scope and support release planning

  • Prepare documentation and track progress for compliance, certification, and regulatory processes related to game content and integrations

  • Provide data, analysis, and insights to inform roadmap planning and prioritization

  • Build strong working relationships across product, engineering, platform, compliance, and operations

  • Support broader Casino product initiatives beyond integrations, including UX improvements, promotional features and platform enhancements

Requirements

What are we looking for?

  • 1–3 years of professional experience, with exposure to product or tech teams a plus

  • Exposure to third-party integrations or working with external partners such as game providers or vendors

  • Experience working in regulated environments

  • Ability to turn business and technical needs into clear user stories, acceptance criteria and documentation

  • Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to dig into data, spot trends and turn findings into clear product insights

  • Comfortable using AI in your everyday work and always looking for the next process to streamline or automate

  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, including experience working with internal and external stakeholders

  • Organized and detail-oriented, able to juggle multiple tasks and priorities

  • Eager to learn and grow into a product role, taking on more ownership over time

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Receptionist (Construction)

Position Type: Full-Time, Remote
Working Hours: U.S Business Hours

About the Role

We are looking for a confident, organized, and customer-focused Remote Receptionist to support a construction business focused on roofing and custom home services.

This is a highly phone-based role combining inbound lead response, outbound follow-up, cold calling, appointment booking, and call tracking. You’ll be one of the first points of contact for potential customers, helping turn inquiries into booked consultations while ensuring every interaction is properly documented.

What You’ll Own

Inbound Lead Response

  • Receive and handle calls from leads who have submitted forms through the company website.
  • Qualify their interest and understand their needs.
  • Move qualified leads toward a booked appointment with the appropriate team member.

Outbound Lead Follow-Up

  • Proactively call prospects who have expressed interest but have not yet converted.
  • Keep the pipeline warm through consistent follow-up.
  • Reduce drop-off between initial inquiry and consultation.

Cold Calling

  • Conduct structured outbound cold calling campaigns.
  • Generate new interest in roofing and custom home services.
  • Follow established scripts while adapting naturally to live conversations.

Appointment Booking

  • Schedule consultations and site visits accurately.
  • Coordinate availability with the appropriate team members.
  • Avoid double-bookings and missed opportunities.

Call Tracking & Notes

  • Log every call, outcome, and follow-up action clearly.
  • Keep lead records accurate and up to date.
  • Ensure the team always has a current view of where each lead stands.

Professional Brand Representation

  • Serve as the first voice many customers hear.
  • Communicate warmly, clearly, and professionally.
  • Speak confidently about the company's roofing and custom home offerings.

Required Experience & Skills

  • Proven experience in a receptionist, call center, customer service, or inside sales role with a significant phone-based component.
  • Experience handling both inbound and outbound calls confidently.
  • Ability to conduct cold calls without heavy supervision.
  • Strong spoken and written English fluency.
  • Clear pronunciation and strong active listening skills.
  • Ability to keep callers engaged and conversations on track.
  • Comfortable using scheduling or CRM tools to log calls and manage appointments.
  • Specific platform experience is a plus.
  • Reliable home office setup with stable internet, a quality headset, and a quiet calling environment.

What Makes You a Strong Fit

  • You remain calm and professional when calls become challenging.
  • You are comfortable handling rejection and staying consistent during cold calling.
  • You take ownership of lead follow-up rather than waiting to be reminded.
  • You proactively flag unusual or important customer situations to the internal team.
  • You are organized and consistently document every interaction.
  • You can work independently while maintaining close communication with the team.

What Success Looks Like

  • New website leads are contacted promptly and professionally.
  • Qualified prospects are effectively moved toward booked appointments.
  • Follow-up leads remain warm and receive consistent outreach.
  • Cold calling generates new conversations and interest.
  • Appointments are scheduled accurately without double-bookings or missed opportunities.
  • Every call and follow-up action is properly documented.

Le côté brillant de l'hypothèque

nesto est le chef de file du financement hypothécaire résidentiel numérique au Canada. Nous offrons aux Canadiens les taux les plus bas dès le départ, en toute transparence et sans négociation.

À propos de nous

Pionnier du financement hypothécaire en ligne au Canada, nesto transforme la façon dont les Canadiens financent leur propriété. Notre mission est d'offrir une expérience de financement immobilier positive, valorisante et transparente, simplifiée du début à la fin.

Les emprunteurs profitent de taux souvent plus avantageux que ceux offerts par les grandes banques, ainsi que d'une expérience hypothécaire exceptionnelle, simple et fluide, du début à la fin. Le tout est propulsé par une technologie d'intelligence artificielle de pointe.

Groupe Nesto

Reconnue au palmarès Fast 50 de Deloitte pendant trois années consécutives, l'entreprise continue de faire progresser le secteur grâce à l'innovation, à la technologie et à des solutions axées sur les clients.

jobs.title: CEO - AI Investing
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About BJAK

The original mission of BJAK is we believe people deserve smarter ways to plan, save and grow their money. This is the origin of our name.

Started in 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, its the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in the region — this includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our mission is help people get more from their money every day.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities from our offices and remotely, who truly enjoys their work. We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

About the Role

The CEO - AI Investing will build and own an AI-native consumer investing business. The role will use AI to help users understand markets, make better investment decisions and manage their portfolios.

What you will be doing

  • Define the AI Investing proposition, product roadmap and business model.

  • Build AI-native experiences across investment discovery, research, portfolio management and decision-making.

  • Develop how AI should analyse information, surface opportunities and support users throughout the investment journey.

  • Own P&L, assets, customers, engagement, revenue and unit economics.

  • Work deeply with product, engineering and AI teams to build and improve the product.

  • Build the core investing, product, technology and commercial teams.

  • Expand into additional investment products and markets.

What you will need

  • Deep experience in investing, wealthtech, consumer fintech or investment products.

  • Direct ownership of a meaningful investing product, business or P&L.

  • Strong understanding of investment products, markets and consumer investing behaviour.

  • Strong product judgement and understanding of how AI can improve investment research and decision-making.

  • Experience building and scaling consumer technology products.

  • Hands-on operating capability. Able to work directly through product, investment workflows, economics and customer behaviour.

Location

This is a remote role. We hire globally and work across multiple countries and time zones.

Candidates should be comfortable working effectively in a distributed, fast-moving international team and collaborating with colleagues across different locations.

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

At FloWater, we believe everyone deserves access to clean drinking water they can trust and love. So we set out to restore America’s drinking water and bring people back to the tap.

Since 2013, we have been transforming the way the world drinks water by turning ordinary tap into great tasting, purified, mineral enhanced water and delivering epic hydration experiences through our Refill Stations. Today, more than 12,000 Refill Stations across the United States hydrate millions of people every year inside some of the world’s biggest and coolest brands in fitness, hospitality, education, and beyond. We are not just another water company. We are building the most loved water brand in the country and redefining what people expect from drinking water.

We scale fast. We think big. We care deeply about taste, trust, and experience, and we hold a high bar for ourselves and each other. If you want to help rebuild trust in drinking water, work with iconic brands, and be part of a team that moves quickly and builds boldly, you are in the right place.

FloWater is committed to building an inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work. FloWater provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, pregnancy, veteran status, genetic information, disability, or any other protected status.

We strive to create a culture that celebrates our differences and supports diversity, creating an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.   • Accurately document customer interactions in Zendesk and update records in NetSuite
  • Coordinate with technicians and service providers to ensure timely issue resolution, including dispatching service requests when needed

  • Manage freight and logistics coordination, including working with 3PLC warehouses, LTL freight partners, and small-parcel shipments
  • Audit and validate data in NetSuite to ensure accuracy in reporting and customer records

jobs.title: Healthcare RCM Professionals: Interview on AI Integration Workflows
jobs.descriptionHtml:
What We're Researching

We're running a paid study on the integration and impact of artificial intelligence in healthcare billing and clinical workflows. As healthcare systems adopt new technologies, understanding the practical challenges of evaluating and deploying these models is critical. This research maps out how revenue cycle management processes are evolving with AI support.

How It Works

You will participate in a remote voice or video call to walk us through your current workflows. We will ask you to detail how your team evaluates new AI tools, implements them into existing clinical or billing systems, and measures their success. You will react to specific use cases and share the operational hurdles you face during integration. The conversation flows as a structured interview focused on your day-to-day administrative and technical challenges.

Who This Is For

We welcome revenue cycle management directors, healthcare billing managers, and clinical operations leaders. The ideal candidate has direct experience utilizing or evaluating AI models within a healthcare setting. We also welcome health informatics specialists and technical leads who oversee clinical workflow integrations.

What You'll Do

  • Walk us through your daily clinical or revenue cycle management workflows.

Mercor connects elite creative and technical talent with leading AI research labs. Headquartered in San Francisco, our investors include Benchmark, General Catalyst, Peter Thiel, Adam D'Angelo, Larry Summers, and Jack Dorsey.

Position: 3D Generalist: Modeling, Rigging & Animation (AI Evaluation)
Type:Contract
Compensation:$70–$120/hour
Location:Remote
Commitment:40 hours/week

Role Responsibilities

  • Guide research teams to close knowledge gaps and improve AI model performance in 3D modeling, texturing, rigging, and animation.
  • Design challenging, real-world 3D tasks and produce reference deliverables in formats such as .blend, .fbx, .glb, and .stl.
  • Evaluate AI-generated 3D assets and provide clear feedback on topology, UVs, materials, and animation loops.

  • Collaborate with other subject matter experts to ensure consistency and accuracy in training data.

  • Python scripting in Blender: experience with scripts or add-ons for production work.
  • Expertise in clean quad topology, UV unwrapping, and PBR metal-rough texturing.
  • Skeletal rigging and skinning with IK/FK controls and looping animation.
  • Fluency with formats: .blend, .fbx, .glb, .usd, .obj, and CAD formats.
  • Hands-on use of generative 3D and image tools.
  • Public portfolio or reel of shipped work on ArtStation, Sketchfab, or a personal site.
  • Ability to engage reliably for at least 40 hours/week.
  • Strong written communication skills.

Resources & Support

jobs.title: Analista de Business Inteligence
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência em Business Intelligence (BI), que tenha perfil analítico, visão de negócio e facilidade para transformar dados em informações relevantes para a tomada de decisão.

Você terá um papel importante na construção e evolução de dashboards, indicadores e análises que apoiem decisões estratégicas e contribuam para a melhoria contínua dos nossos produtos e soluções.

Para esse desafio, buscamos alguém com perfil hands-on, autonomia e pensamento crítico, que goste de investigar dados, identificar oportunidades e propor soluções.

Aqui, você terá a oportunidade de atuar próximo aos clientes e a diferentes áreas do negócio, colaborando com times multidisciplinares e transformando dados em insights que gerem impacto real nos resultados.


Como #GTeam, você vai:

  • Desenvolver relatórios e dashboards interativos que apresentem os dados de maneira clara e compreensível.
  • Realizar análises detalhadas dos dados para identificar tendências, padrões e riscos.
  • Coletar, organizar dados de diversas fontes internas e externas.
  • Assegurar a precisão, integridade e consistência dos dados.
  • Automatizar relatórios e processos de análise de dados.
  • Construir consultas em bancos de dados (SQL) para extração de informações.
  • Criar apresentações executivas com insights para público-alvo, quando necessário.
  • Participar da construção de modelos preditivos e análises avançadas.
  • Atuar como parceiro estratégico dos stakeholders, colaborando de forma próxima para entender suas necessidades e transformar essas demandas em soluções analíticas que apoiem decisões mais eficazes.
  • Contribuir com insights e recomendações de métricas e indicadores de forma clara e acessível para diversos públicos.
  • Identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos processos de negócios baseadas em dados.
  • Propor e implementar soluções para otimizar a eficiência operacional e estratégica do BI.
  • Apoiar as equipes internas sobre o uso de ferramentas de BI e interpretação de dados.

Para chamar essa vaga de sua, você precisa:

  • Experiência sólida em Business Intelligence (BI) e análise de dados.
  • Conhecimento avançado em Power BI e domínio de Power Query.
  • Experiência com modelagem de dados e construção de indicadores.
  • Conhecimento em SQL para consultas e extração de dados.
  • Vivência com automação de relatórios e processos analíticos.
  • Perfil analítico, pensamento crítico e capacidade de resolução de problemas.
  • Boa comunicação e facilidade para interagir com diferentes áreas e níveis da organização.
  • Visão de negócio e capacidade de transformar dados em insights para apoiar decisões.
  • Proatividade, autonomia e colaboração na construção de soluções.

Informações adicionais

  • 👶 Auxílio-creche: para filhos(as) de até 5 anos;
  • 🏡 Home-office com idas eventuais ao escritório, se necessário;
  • 💻 Auxílio home office: R$ 160,00 mensais;
  • 📚 Bolsa de estudos: incentivo para cursos de curta e longa duração e idiomas;
  • 🎂 Day off de aniversário: um dia para comemorar do seu jeito;
  • 💰 Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR);
  • ⏰ Horário flexível;
  • 💜 Ambiente colaborativo e descontraído: um espaço que valoriza a troca de ideias, a autonomia e a inovação, mesmo a distância.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Career Category

Marketing

Job Description


Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients


At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.


Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.


Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Experiential Peer to Peer Engagement and Amplification Obesity and Related Conditions - Senior Manager


The Senior Manager, Experiential Peer to Peer Engagement and Amplification brings the U.S. peer to peer strategy to life through engaging, customer centered experiences across the obesity portfolio. This role develops and executes innovative ways for healthcare professionals to learn from one another, then extends those moments through relevant digital and social content. The Senior Manager partners with commercial opinion leaders, Health Care Professional (HCP) Marketing, Omnichannel, Sales, Congress, Medical, Corporate Affairs, Advocacy, Strategic Account Managers, Patient Marketing, Global partners, and agencies to create connected experiences that meet customer needs and support commercial objectives.


This role will help move peer to peer engagement beyond one way presentations by creating active, experiential learning and extending trusted peer perspectives beyond the live moment.

  • Apply customer insights and adult learning principles to shape the format, environment, content, and interaction for each experience.
  • Build experiences that can flex across audiences and settings while maintaining clear learning objectives, a strong customer experience, and alignment with approved strategy.
  • Partner with the Congress Peer to Peer Engagement Senior Manager to integrate experiential concepts into congress plans and ensure a coordinated customer journey.

Role Type: Contract
Location: Remote

Opportunity Snapshot

Pay: $80–100/hour equivalent (approximately $640–800 per task)
Time per task: ~8 hours

Location: Fully remote

You’ll need: A public GitHub profile with substantial, verifiable contributions

  • Define objective success criteria — how someone would verify the task was completed correctly, not just plausibly.

  • Provide a working reference implementation.

  • Review tasks built by other contributors for technical accuracy and verifiability.

  • Flag tasks that turn out to be ambiguous or ungradable rather than submitting them.

  • Strong frontend engineering: React, TypeScript, or similar, with experience shipping complex interfaces and interactions.

  • Able to read, modify, debug and validate real application code.

  • Experience with UI, graphics, SVG, or Canvas work is especially valuable.

  • Product or UI designers with hands-on frontend implementation and public code contributions are also a fit.

  • Strong written English, and the ability to explain expected behavior and reproducible verification steps.

  • Prior data labeling, AI evaluation, or rubric-based review experience is a plus, not a requirement.

jobs.title: Money Laundering Reporting Officer - France
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Fiat Republic is a London-based remote-friendly fintech dedicated to bringing mainstream banking to the world of digital assets. Founded in 2021, the company has quickly established itself as a leading provider of banking and payment infrastructure for cryptocurrency companies.

Our Mission

Fiat Republic's mission is to bridge the gap between traditional finance and digital assets by providing cryptocurrency businesses with a single API to create bank accounts in multiple fiat currencies, access local bank payment rails, and manage FX and liquidity operations. We are a highly regulated business, with electronic money and money service business licenses in the UK, EU, US and Canada. We are also an issuer of MiCAR compliant stable-coins, with the distinction of being the first EMI in Europe with custody privileges. As such, we are perfectly placed to bridge the gap between tradFi and web3.

Our Platform

The Fiat Republic platform is built with a developer-first ethos, making it easy for crypto platforms to integrate with our services and start processing fiat payments. We also have a strong focus on AML, regulatory compliance, and security, ensuring that our clients can operate their fiat flows sustainably, safely and securely.

Our Team

Fiat Republic is a diverse team of outstanding individuals with a wide range of backgrounds and experiences. We are headquartered in London, with a presence in the Netherlands, Poland, Turkey and Canada. We are committed to providing our employees with a fun and thriving work environment, offering rapid skills development and the opportunity to learn about the payments and crypto industries.

Our Investors

Fiat Republic is backed by top-tier venture capital firms such as Speedinvest, Credo Ventures, Seedcamp, Fabric Ventures, Kraken Ventures, Arca, and Inovo Ventures. We are also alumni of the Softbank Emerge Accelerator program.

Our Impact

Fiat Republic is making a significant impact on the cryptocurrency industry. By providing crypto businesses with a simple and secure way to bank and process fiat payments, we are helping to drive the adoption of digital assets and making it easier for people to access the benefits of cryptocurrency.

Our Future

With the increasingly positive tailwinds in the cryptocurrency industry, Fiat Republic is poised for continued stellar growth. We are constantly expanding our platform and adding new features to meet the needs of our clients. We are also looking to expand our team and hire talented individuals who are passionate about banking, payments, cryptocurrency, and working in a fast-paced start-up environment.

Role Description

The role involves overseeing compliance with anti-money laundering regulations, monitoring financial transactions for suspicious activities, preparing and submitting regulatory reports, and ensuring all processes meet legal and internal policy requirements. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About The Team

Eventeny was founded on the belief that managing large-scale events with hundreds of exhibitors, vendors, sponsors, and volunteers should not be stressful and burdensome. Our mission is to remove event organizers from being the 5th most stressful job in the world. That's why we built Eventeny and continue to work every day on the biggest problems in the event industry. We don't just dream it, we build it. Today, Eventeny serves more than 35,000 large festivals and conventions worldwide.

Our customers come from all walks of life, and so do we. We hire great people from a wide variety of backgrounds, not just because it’s the right thing to do, but because it makes our company stronger. We don’t think we should have to advertise that we’re LGBTQIA+, neurodivergent, and disability friendly, or that we put our employees' mental and physical health before everything else, but we do, because it’s not the norm for most companies (yet!).

We’re a diverse, inclusive, and welcoming team of individuals who thrive in a fast-paced and ever-changing environment. Our team works closely together to brainstorm and improve our processes and the customer experience every single day. We prioritize our work based on what’s best for our customers, not what’s going to make us the most money.

If you share our values and our enthusiasm for events, you will find a home at Eventeny.

Eventeny is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Eventeny considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state, and local law. Eventeny is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at .

As a core member of the Growth team, you’ll serve as the first sales touchpoint for inbound and outbound leads to convert to sales opportunities.

You will be responsible for engaging high-intent prospects, qualifying opportunities, and converting inbound interest into booked meetings and pipeline. This role plays a critical part in maximizing speed-to-lead and capturing demand outside.

This role will also be responsible for high-volume and targeted outbound call-based prospecting to event organizers to generate new meetings

This is afull-time and quota-carrying position.

  • Book qualified meetings from both inbound and outbound sources and own a monthly meeting quota

37.5 hours per week, shifts between 9am to 5:30pm/ 9:30am to 6:00pm; 1 in 4 Saturdays OR Sundays

⭐️ About our Financial Crime & Fraud Team:

Our Mission in the Financial Crime & Fraud Collective is to earn and keep our customers’ trust, support Monzo’s safe growth, and contribute to building a safer society. Our Fraud Investigators are crucial to the success of this mission.

The Fraud Investigator role within our Pursue pillar facilitates and acts on vital communication between Monzo and other institutions; helping us to prevent the loss of funds to fraudsters both within Monzo and across the industry. This communication falls into three main categories:

  • Communication to other banks about potential fraudsters in their customer base
  • Communication from other banks about potential fraudsters in Monzo’s customer base
  • Communication to and from CIFAS about potential fraudsters in Monzo’s customer base
  • Communication with law enforcement about crime we discover as part of our investigations

🔑 Your day to day:

Fraud Investigators within our Pursue pillar work to a mixture of regulated and unregulated deadlines. Their role supports the quality of performance and knowledge across the pillar.

  • Investigating and actioning fraud reports received from other financial institutions
  • Probing for further evidence where needed
  • Using Monzo’s values to investigate claims with empathy and attention to detail
  • Investigating and reporting fraud to other banks when our customers have been a victim of fraud
  • Triaging and taking initial action on inbound communications from a range of institutions
  • Creating and actioning indemnities and defunds where needed
  • Reporting to CIFAS

  • Excellent English written & verbal communication skills
  • Previous experience in customer service or a related field
  • Ability to be persuasive and empathetic
  • Strong expertise in investigating, problem solving and decision making

  • Ability to work to deadlines
  • Values driven approach in line with Monzo’s core values

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for AIConversation Recording Contributors to join a Danish speech data collection project and help support the evaluation and development of the next generation of AI technologies.
Job Type: Freelance
Location: Work from home
Work Schedule:Flexible, task-based work (approximately 2–4 hours daily)
Project Duration: TBC
Start Date: Immediately
Rate: 22 USD/hour

Help Shape the Future of AI

This short project offers an opportunity to evaluate and improve speech recognition and conversational AI technologies by providing spontaneous speech collected from real-life situations.

How Your Recordings Will Be Used

The collected recordings, annotations, and related metadata will be used to evaluate the spontaneous speech capabilities of speech-enabled AI models. The compiled data may be reviewed for quality and incorporated into datasets used for research, development, testing, and improvement of AI systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Record or collect natural, spontaneous speech in accordance with the project guidelines.
  • Participate in or capture speech from approved real-life situations, such as workplace conversations or casual one-on-one discussions.
  • Complete individual or two-person conversational speech tasks, or participate in voice or voice-text interactions with an AI or machine-based system.
  • Annotate collected speech data according to the instructions provided.
  • Provide the required information and metadata related to each recording.

What We’re Looking For

  • Native-level fluency in Danish.
  • Authentic pronunciation and strong familiarity with the target language through everyday use.
  • Advanced level of English to understand written instructions.
  • Contributors must not imitate dialects or accents that are not their own.
  • Experience with speech recording or data annotation projects is an advantage, but not required.
  • Strong attention to detail when providing annotations and recording metadata.
  • Ability to follow detailed project and recording instructions.

Technical Requirements

  • Quiet room or recording space with minimal background noise.
  • Computer microphone or headset with microphone.
  • Reliable internet connection.
  • Ability to access and use an online recording platform.

What We Offer

  • Flexible, remote work.
  • Timely and reliable payments.
  • Opportunity to contribute to cutting-edge AI technology.
  • Access to future language and AI-related projects.
  • A flexible engagement ideal for gaining experience with AI data collection projects.

Vendor Type

When applying, please select the option that best describes your working status.

Are you a Freelancer or Private Individual?

A Freelancer is someone who has a business license and may have a VAT number or EIN for tax purposes. A VAT (Value Added Tax) number is a unique identifier assigned to a registered business in many countries; an EIN (Employer Identification Number) is a similar identifier used in the US. A Private Individual does not have a business license. If you aren’t sure, you are probably a private individual.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Accelerant

Accelerant is a data-driven risk exchange connecting underwriters of specialty insurance risk with risk capital providers. Accelerant was founded in 2018 by a group of longtime insurance industry executives and technology experts who shared a vision of rebuilding the way risk is exchanged – so that it works better, for everyone. The Accelerant risk exchange does business across more than 20 different countries and 250 specialty products, and we are proud that our insurers have been awarded an AM Best A- (Excellent) rating. For more information, please visit .

Accelerant is hiring a Director, Security Operations: a senior team lead who owns the work that calls for security judgment and will report directly to the Chief Information Security Officer (CISO). This is a senior, hands-on role: you set technical direction for the security operations team, stay close to the work, and act as the CISO’s trusted deputy for technical security and security operations, including changes in the threat landscape, vulnerabilities and incidents.

You are responsible for the strategic direction of our technical security operations, controls and processes. That includes assessing the security of mergers and acquisitions, owning the penetration test cycle, coordinating purple team exercises and SOC coordination, and acting as the technical expert for projects. You’ll have the autonomy to drive technical initiatives from concept to delivery.

Key responsibilities

The Director, Security Operations owns the high-judgment security work and is accountable for results in five areas.

M&A security

  • Lead security due diligence and post-close integration assessments as deal volume grows.
  • Build and maintain a repeatable integration playbook: assessment checklist, risk scoring, remediation plan and day-one controls.
  • Write clear risk narratives and recommendations for the CISO and deal teams.

Testing, detection and operations

  • Lead the penetration test cycle: scoping, triage, remediation tracking and reporting to leadership.
  • Own the SOC sync across Accelerant and Mission US/UK: shared priorities, escalation paths, handoffs and coverage gaps.
  • Own the detection platform strategy, including Microsoft Sentinel cost and ingestion, without losing detection coverage.

Incident response and control improvement

  • Act as incident response manager for technical incidents, leading the response from triage through to resolution.
  • Own the technical incident response playbooks and keep them current.
  • Lead lessons-learned reviews after incidents and recommend control changes, tracked through to completion.
  • Run control reviews and recommend improvements where gaps appear.
  • Act as the internal escalation point for the external SOC, advising on potential incidents that need more judgment.

Technical leadership and vendors

  • Build and lead the security engineering team: partner with the CISO to hire direct reports, then provide line management and technical direction, including assigning work, reviewing output and coaching.
  • Manage the security tooling and service vendors in this area, including the full vendor lifecycle: selection, renewals, performance and escalations.
  • Step into hands-on engineering and investigation work when the team needs it.

jobs.title: Director, Sales
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Pave Bank

Welcome to Pave Bank, where we’re not just redefining banking—we’re shaping the future of global institutional finance. Inspired by leading fintech innovators and powered by a technology-first approach, we deliver smarter, faster, and more accessible banking, treasury, FX, and digital asset solutions to sophisticated institutions worldwide.

With hubs in Singapore and Tbilisi, we combine the agility of a startup with the rigor and reliability of a regulated financial institution. Our mission is to simplify complex cross-border operations, enabling exchanges, funds, fintechs, and corporates to unlock growth and seize new opportunities.

Our culture thrives on collaboration, commercial ingenuity, and a passion for solving the toughest institutional challenges. Joining Pave Bank means shaping global banking solutions, closing transformative deals, and making a tangible impact in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Together, we’re paving the way for the next generation of institutional finance.

About the Role

The ideal candidate will be a high-calibre institutional sales professional responsible for driving Pave Bank’s institutional growth and contributing to commercial strategy. You will lead the full institutional sales lifecycle - originating and closing high-value opportunities, structuring complex multi-currency and digital asset solutions, and deepening relationships with exchanges, OTC desks, payment institutions, funds, fintechs, and corporates. Working closely with senior leadership, you will ensure institutional insights inform commercial priorities and collaborate with product, treasury, and engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions for sophisticated, high-volume clients. The role will also help lay the foundation for future team development as Pave Bank scales.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive institutional adoption of Pave Bank’s multi-currency banking, FX, settlement, digital asset, and treasury capabilities.

  • Lead and close complex, high-value institutional opportunities across exchanges, OTC desks, payment institutions, funds, and fintechs.

  • Structure multi-entity and cross-border solutions, including settlement, liquidity, and custody workflows.

  • Develop commercial proposals, pricing structures, and revenue models that support Pave Bank’s growth strategy.

  • Translate sophisticated institutional requirements into scalable banking and digital asset solutions in collaboration with product, treasury, and engineering teams.

  • Shape client strategy through market mapping, institutional insights, and expansion opportunities across key verticals.

  • Contribute to commercial playbooks, sales methodologies, and scalable processes as the bank grows.

  • Support development of junior talent and future team scale as the organisation expands.

Experience

  • 10 to 15 years of enterprise sales or institutional coverage in banking, payments, fintech, or digital assets.

  • Proven ability to originate and close complex, high-value institutional accounts.

  • Strong understanding of cross-border settlement, treasury flows, liquidity structures, custody frameworks, and digital asset operations.

  • Strong financial, commercial, and pricing skills.

  • Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, scaling banking environment.

jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Manager (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Finance & Accounting Manager (m/f/d)

Building a finance function from zero is rare — doing it at a fast-growing robotics AI company is rarer. Sereact is scaling internationally (Germany, US, Switzerland), and our Director Accounting is looking for a smart early hire to build our finance function together: processes, systems, and standards, from day one. You'll work directly with leadership and help take the group through its first statutory audit. Based on-site at our Stuttgart headquarters.

Who We Are

Sereact builds AI that lets robots sense, reason, and act in the real world — in warehouses and factories. Our mission is to redefine how physical work gets done, and we're looking for curious, bold people who want to make a real difference.

Overview

Working side by side with our Director Accounting, you'll help bring bookkeeping in-house, help shape our finance systems setup (including how we use Odoo alongside DATEV), and get us ready for our first statutory audit — working closely with the founders and our external tax and audit partners. We value people who work independently, take initiative, and build rather than wait for the perfect setup.

Your Responsibilities

  • Day-to-day accounting: Own the books (general and sub-ledgers) and gradually bring bookkeeping in-house from our external provider.

  • Payments & working capital: Run accounts payable, accounts receivable, and the payment process.

  • Closing & audit: Prepare monthly and quarterly closes under HGB and support the annual financial statements, including our first-ever statutory audit.

  • Systems: Help shape our finance systems and decide the target setup — whether Odoo replaces DATEV or runs first as a subledger alongside it.

  • Partners: Be the day-to-day counterpart to our tax advisors and auditors.

  • Process & automation: Build our finance processes and first automations hand in hand with our Director Accounting, including group-wide topics around our US and CH entities.

Qualifications

  • A degree (business, finance, or a related field) is preferred — but above all we're looking for smart, analytical people who learn fast. Solid HGB fundamentals and hands-on DATEV (or comparable) experience matter more to us than a specific certificate.

  • Experience with monthly and annual closes; IFRS knowledge is a plus.

  • A hands-on, builder mindset — you like building from scratch and don't wait for finished processes or a team. No need for a perfect résumé.

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and fast change and structure things yourself — pragmatic over perfectionist, but with a clear sense of when rigor matters (closing, audit).

  • Tool- and automation-savvy; you use modern tools and AI as a matter of course (Odoo or ERP experience is a plus).

  • Fluent German and good English.

Our Interview Plan

  1. Application: Apply via our careers page with your CV — a few lines on why this role interests you are welcome.

jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Product Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Product Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Everything you build is open source (MIT-licensed) and immediately visible. Langfuse has 35,000+ GitHub stars and our SDKs are downloaded more than a hundred million times per month. When you ship a new feature the community notices in GitHub issues, on X, and in our community channels.

Product engineers at Langfuse are the people who deliver new features end-to-end to our users. You own the product thinking from understanding the user problem to deciding what to build to shipping the solution.

You will also have direct exposure to how cutting-edge LLM applications are built. The users you serve are some of the best and most ambitious software engineers leveraging Langfuse to improve their applications. Deeply understanding the problems they solve will help you design the best possible product and along the way makes you an expert on LLM engineering yourself.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own features end-to-end: from talking to users, to writing the spec, to shipping the code and docs, to writing the changelog post with your name on it. To give you a sense: recent features a single engineer owned include the Langfuse for Agents release (new trace views, agent graphs, semantic span labels), the TypeScript SDK v4 rewrite on OpenTelemetry, and managing dashboards via API/CLI/MCP.

  • Work across the full stack: and we mean full. Our surface area is wide: React frontend, Next.js backend, ClickHouse analytics, Python and TypeScript SDKs, public docs, Terraform modules, and more. You'll touch whatever the feature needs. One week you might be writing a new ClickHouse query for cost analytics, the next you're designing an SDK API, the next you're building a new rust worker for faster data processing.

  • Talk to users constantly: jump on calls, respond in community channels, and route support requests. At Langfuse, support is how we build conviction about what to build next. Our handbook says it best: support by engineers is a core value proposition.

  • Write public documentation about the features you own. At Langfuse, docs are product.

  • Ship publicly during Launch Weeks: we've run four Launch Weeks so far, dropping a new feature every day for a week. Engineers present the features they built to the community.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Someone who has built features or even entire products from scratch end-to-end

jobs.title: Langfuse - Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Why Backend Engineering at Langfuse

Your work will have an outsized impact.

Langfuse ingests terabytes of AI tracing data per day. When a Fortune 50 company instruments their application with Langfuse, they hit the infrastructure you built. Everything you ship is open source and immediately visible.

The core of your role is making Langfuse fast and affordable at scale: owning the ingestion pipeline, optimizing ClickHouse data models and queries so dashboards load instantly, and building the backend abstractions that let product engineers ship data-heavy features without reinventing the plumbing each time.

You will also make sure Langfuse runs everywhere. You’ll operate Langfuse Cloud across multiple production environments, and make self-hosting effortless. You will support a single Docker Compose setup to enterprise-grade Helm chart deployment.

 

You won’t be solving these problems alone. Langfuse is now part of ClickHouse, which means the people who built the database you’re optimizing are one channel away. Few backend roles give you that kind of access to the internals of your core datastore.

 

You will grow at Langfuse by

  • Own and optimize our ingestion pipeline: Langfuse ingests massive volumes of tracing data through a pipeline that flows from our API to ClickHouse. You'll work on throughput, latency, reliability, and cost efficiency at every stage of this pipeline.

  • Make ClickHouse fast: our tracing data lives in ClickHouse. You'll design schemas, optimize merge strategies, tune batch inserts, write and review analytical queries that power dashboards and the UI. You'll become an expert on ClickHouse internals — and you'll have the ClickHouse database engineering team one channel away.

  • Build new infrastructure-heavy features: things like LLM-as-a-Judge (where we post-process large volumes of ingested data asynchronously), alerting at scale, client-code execution, or batch dataset operations. Build the foundation and, if you like, dip your toes into the frontend for those.

  • Test with real data in production: when evaluating a new ClickHouse schema, migration, or query optimization, you'll run load tests against production data to validate that changes actually improve things. We don't guess at performance. We prototype new table designs, run them in parallel on real traffic, and compare before committing.

  • Scale for what's next: we're growing fast and new product directions like complex long-running agent observability and real-time evaluation push the infrastructure in new ways. You'll be thinking ahead about what breaks at 10x scale.

 

Learn more about our infrastructure

  • From Zero to Scale: Langfuse's Infrastructure Evolution — deep dive into how we went from Postgres to ClickHouse

  • Max talking infrastructure at ClickHouse OpenHouse Amsterdam — recording of our CTO walking through the architecture

jobs.title: Langfuse - DevRel Engineer, Events & Community (EMEA)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Location and travel

You can be based in Europe; we're mainly remote and invite you to the Berlin office 3-5 days every two months.

We expect significant travel across the Europe, with occasional travel to other regions when the audience quality justifies it. The exact cadence will change with the event calendar, but you should expect travel to be a meaningful part of the job.

 

Why this role?

Langfuse has grown mostly through product-led, open-source adoption. We built a strong product, wrote useful docs and examples, stayed close to users, shipped in public, and helped developers understand how to build better AI applications.

However, many of the highest-signal moments happen in person: hallway conversations, workshops, meetups, dinners, conference demos, and technical talks.

We want someone who can own that motion end to end; put Langfuse in the right AI engineering rooms, make the product clear to technical audiences, and turn in-person conversations into durable marketing momentum.

The goal is not to do every event. The goal is to make the right events excellent, scalable, and measurable.

 

What you'll do

  • Represent Langfuse at conferences, meetups, workshops, customer events, partner events, and community gatherings across Europe

  • Run live demos and technical sessions on tracing, evals, prompt management, datasets, metrics, and related LLM engineering workflows.

  • Build and maintain field-ready material: demo flows, workshop runbooks, talk abstracts, event landing pages, follow-up emails, signup flows, and conference-in-a-box assets.

  • Organize Langfuse-hosted meetups, workshops, dinners, and smaller technical gatherings around the highest-quality audiences.

  • Partner with ClickHouse field marketing, sales, solutions, product marketing, and engineering teams where it helps Langfuse show up well.

  • Turn event learnings into useful artifacts: better messaging, better demos, better docs, better talks, better customer stories, and sharper product feedback.

 

What we're looking for

  • You have worked in DevRel, product marketing engineering, solutions engineering, field engineering, developer advocacy, or technical community roles.

  • You have spoken at developer conferences, meetups, workshops, webinars, or technical customer events.

  • You already create technical content, demos, videos, talks, open source projects, or educational material.

  • You should be excited to travel, give talks, run demos, host events, talk to developers and technical leaders, and bring what you learn back into the company.

  • You care about developer experience, open source, AI engineering, and the quality of the rooms you spend time in.

  • You are comfortable with ambiguity and can independently decide what to do before there is a mature playbook.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex concepts clearly and concisely.

A strong plus:

jobs.descriptionHtml:
NOTE: this role can be located anywhere ClickHouse has a hiring presence.

ClickHouse — Core Analytics Database

About the Role:
ClickHouse is looking for a Principal Database Performance Engineer to join the team behind our high-performance analytics database service.
In this role, you will drive performance and scalability improvements across the stack, taking on ambiguous, high-impact technical challenges most engineers never get to touch.
Our performance team owns the core of query execution - filters, aggregation, joins, and the index structures that make them fast.
We're looking for a sharp, passionate engineer who wants to own database performance end-to-end on a petabyte-scale cloud database, from initial analysis and implementation, through production rollout.

What you will do:
- Identify impactful performance and scalability opportunities in customer or benchmark workloads
- Architect and implement optimized database algorithms and data structures across core relational operators, indexes, query processing, memory management and scheduling
- Drive the performance roadmap for latency, throughput, memory efficiency and hardware utilization improvements
- Participate in the development of a complex, high-performance database system, including meticulous testing and safe production rollout
- Represent the company externally through presentations, blog posts, and community contributions
- Mentor and support junior engineers on the team

What You'll Bring
- 5+ years of experience in database performance engineering, distributed systems
- Master or PhD in databases or a related field
- Strong fluency in C++ and a background in performance-critical software or systems programming
- A track record of driving complex performance improvements end-to-end
- Deep understanding of computer science fundamentals, data structures, and algorithms
- Excellent communication and leadership skills, with a proactive, goal-driven mindset

Perks

  • Flexible work environment - ClickHouse is a globally distributed company and remote-friendly. We currently operate in over 25 countries.

  • Healthcare - Employer contributions towards your healthcare.

  • Equity in the company - Every new team member who joins our company receives stock options.

  • Time off - Flexible time off in the US, generous entitlement in other countries.

  • A USD$500 Home office setup if you’re a remote employee.

  • Global Gatherings – We believe in the power of in-person connection and offer opportunities to engage with colleagues at company-wide offsites.

Culture - We All Shape It

As part of a rapidly scaling start-up, you will be instrumental in shaping our culture.

Are you interested in finding out more about our culture? Learn more about our values here. Check out our blog posts or follow us on LinkedIn to find out more about what’s happening at ClickHouse.

Equal Opportunity & Privacy

Für unser Team in unseren neuen Büros im ecopark Emstek suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen Systemadministrator (m/w/d) als Support-Spezialist - unbefristet, in Vollzeit mit 39 Stunden und hybrid.

Deine Aufgaben

Als Support-Spezialist bist du die freundliche und kompetente Stimme von Deeken Technology für alle Anwender unserer Kunden. Du kümmerst dich um sämtliche IT-Support-Anliegen - und sorgst dafür, dass niemand mit seinem Problem allein bleibt.

- Du bist im First- und Second-Level-Support die erste Anlaufstelle: Du nimmst Anfragen telefonisch entgegen und löst sie nach Möglichkeit direkt im ersten Gespräch.

- Du bearbeitest schriftliche Anfragen per E-Mail über unsere Service-Plattform Hindeo.

- Du analysierst Probleme gemeinsam mit den Anwendern per Fernwartung und findest Lösungen.

- Bei Bedarf besprichst du Supportthemen in kurzen Teams-Meetings direkt mit unseren Kunden.

- Du gibst Anwendern Tipps, wie sie ihre Systeme besser und sicherer nutzen.

- Du stellst die Erreichbarkeit unseres Supports sicher, dokumentierst sauber in Hindeo und gibst komplexe Themen strukturiert an unsere Spezialisten weiter.

- Erkennst du beim Kunden Bedarf, übergibst du die Vertriebschance an unsere Kollegen im IT-Vertrieb.

Das bringst du mit

Verlässlichkeit ist uns extrem wichtig: Wenn du etwas zusagst, hältst du es ein. Dazu kommunizierst du klar und freundlich - am Telefon genauso wie schriftlich - und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Anliegen unserer Kunden.

- Eine abgeschlossene IT-Ausbildung, z. B. als Fachinformatiker für Systemintegration, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

- Erfahrung im IT-Support oder Service Desk, idealerweise in einem Systemhaus

- Ein gutes Grundverständnis in einem möglichst breiten Spektrum: Microsoft 365, Nextcloud, Terminalserver, Drucker, Smartphones, Tablets und Thin Clients

- Sicherer Umgang mit Fernwartungs-Tools und Ticketsystemen

- Freude am Kontakt mit Menschen, Geduld und eine lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise - auch wenn es mal hektisch wird, behältst du den Überblick

- Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt zu 100 Prozent, aber passt menschlich und fachlich im Kern? Dann bewirb dich trotzdem - wir sprechen lieber einmal mehr miteinander.

Warum Deeken Technology

- Dein eigener Firmenwagen: Nach der Probezeit stellen wir dir einen Firmenwagen zur Verfügung.

- Dein Fitnessstudio-Abo: Für deinen Ausgleich zum Job bekommst du von uns ein Fitnessabo.

- Dein perfekter Support-Arbeitsplatz: Cloud-Telefonie-Arbeitsplatz, mehrere Monitore, Firmenlaptop, Firmenhandy und modernste Ausstattung - alles, was du für einen reibungslosen Support brauchst.

- Software, die wir selbst bauen: Wir arbeiten mit Hindeo, unserer eigenen IT-Service-Plattform. In den letzten zwölf Monaten komplett neu entwickelt, gehört sie zu den modernsten Lösungen für Systemhäuser - und dein Feedback aus dem Support fließt direkt in die Weiterentwicklung ein.

- Sicherheit mit Anspruch: Als eines der wenigen IT-Unternehmen der Region sind wir nach ISO 27001 zertifiziert. Du arbeitest nach Standards, auf die du stolz sein kannst.

- Deine Perspektive: Im Support lernst du die gesamte IT-Landschaft ...
