jobs.title: Senior Customer Success Manager (German-speaking)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Are you a German-speaking Customer Success professional with a passion for learning and technology? Do you thrive on building strong customer relationships, spotting opportunities for growth, and helping customers succeed? Then the Senior Customer Success Manager role at Kahoot! might be just the right fit for you. Come join us in making learning awesome!

The Role

As a Senior Customer Success Manager, you will play a key role in helping medium to large enterprise customers succeed and getting the most out of our products. Acting as a trusted advisor, you will help customers achieve tangible business results with our products while identifying opportunities to strengthen relationships, drive retention, and grow accounts.

You will be part of our International Customer Success team, working with customers across one or more products in the Kahoot! Group's portfolio.

Fluency in German is essential for this role, as you will work closely with customers in DACH.

This role can be based in Copenhagen, Denmark; Oslo, Norway; or work remotely in Germany. You will report to the regional Manager, Customer Success.

Responsibilities

Portfolio Ownership and Customer Outcomes

  • Own a portfolio of mid-sized to large Enterprise customers and drive measurable progress towards their business objectives.
  • Manage the full customer lifecycle: handover from Sales, onboarding, adoption, value realisation, business reviews (QBRs/EBRs) and renewals (in collaboration with Account Management, where applicable).
  • Build and maintain success plans and account plans with clear, customer-agreed success metrics and ROI.

Strategic and Commercial Impact

  • Use strong business acumen and our MEDDIC-based methodology to run discovery, uncover customer pain points and their business impact, and map stakeholders, champions and decision-making processes.
  • Build multi-threaded relationships, including at executive-sponsor level.
  • Own or support renewals and retention targets (GRR/NRR), forecast renewals accurately, and identify expansion opportunities in partnership with Account Managers and Account Executives.

Risk and Health Management

  • Monitor customer health and product usage data to spot risks early, and lead mitigation and retention plans.
  • Act as the customer’s escalation point, coordinating with Support, Product and leadership to resolve critical issues.
  • Analyse customer churn and losses, and share key learnings.

Scaling and Enablement

  • Partner with Customer Education to deliver one-to-many programmes, including webinars, live training and help center content.
  • Support Sales and Events as a product expert and trusted advisor during customer calls and events.

Voice of the Customer and Advocacy

  • Bring structured customer feedback to Product, Sales and Customer Experience to shape our products and services.
  • Develop customer advocates through references, case studies and community engagement.

Leadership and operational excellence

  • Mentor and coach less experienced colleagues alongside your manager.
  • Help develop CS playbooks, processes and best practices.
  • Keep CRM data, account plans and forecasts accurate and up to date.

Requirements

  • Fluency in German and English, written and spoken.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of relevant experience in Customer Success, Account Management, Consulting, Sales, or from other similar roles.

QMH Consulting unterstützt Unternehmen aus Automotive, MedTech, Maschinenbau und Elektronik dabei, FMEA normkonform, auditfest und praxistauglich in ihre Prozesse zu integrieren.

Dafür suchen wir eine/-n FMEA-Moderator / Consultant (m/w/d), der/die Projekte methodensicher führt, Teams strukturiert durch die 7 Schritte leitet und Ergebnisse schafft, die Audits bestehen und im Alltag wirken.

Aufgaben

Aufgaben

  • Moderation von Design- und Prozess-FMEA nach AIAG/VDA in Entwicklungs- und Serienprojekten

  • Strukturierung und Durchführung der 7 Schritte inkl. Funktions-, Fehler-, Risiko- und Maßnahmenanalyse

  • Dokumentation in APIS, PLATO oder kundenspezifischen Tools; Pflege von Struktur- und Netzansichten

  • FMEA-Reviews: Plausibilitäts-, Vollständigkeits- und Wirksamkeitschecks; Ableitung von Verbesserungen

  • FMEA-Prozessaufbau: Rollen, Templates, Timings, Schnittstellen (APQP, Control Plan, SPC)

  • Training & Coaching von Fachabteilungen bis zur Moderatorenqualifikation

  • Vorbereitung auf Kunden-/Auditorenanforderungen (z. B. VDA 6.3) und Unterstützung bei Freigaben

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, Qualität, Produktion, Lieferanten und Projektleitung

Qualifikation

Qualifikation

  • Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation (z. B. Techniker:in/Meister:in)

  • Praxis in FMEA-Moderation (D-/P-FMEA) nach AIAG/VDA – idealerweise in Automotive oder regulierten Branchen

  • Sicherer Umgang mit APIS oder PLATO (alternativ schnelle Auffassungsgabe für neue Tools)

  • Erfahrung in Prozess-/Produktentwicklung, Qualität oder Produktion

  • Methodensicherheit, klare Kommunikation und stringente Moderation heterogener Teams

  • Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Reisebereitschaft für Workshops beim Kunden (nach Bedarf)

Benefits

Benefits

  • Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung und attraktive Zusatzleistungen

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 100 % Remote möglich, klare Prozesse

  • Unbefristeter Vertrag und strukturierte Einarbeitung

  • Projekte mit Substanz bei OEMs, Tier-1 und Mittelstand

  • Viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Prozessaufbau, Templates, Guidelines, Tool-Einführung

  • Kollegiales Team, flache Hierarchien und direkter Draht zur Geschäftsführung

Klingt passend? Dann bewirb dich direkt über den Button auf dieser Seite!
Wir freuen uns auf dich – mit Methodensicherheit, Pragmatismus und Spaß an wirksamer Qualität.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Role: Senior Design Engineer

Company: Deel

Location: United Kingdom, Israel, Portugal, Spain, Czech Republic, Poland, France, Switzerland, Hungary, Ireland, Sweden, Germany or Estonia

Job Type: Full-time

About Deel

Deel is the all-in-one payroll and HR platform for global teams. HRIS, payroll, compliance, benefits, performance and equipment management sit in one product. It supports every worker type in 150+ countries. In 2024, Deel paid $11.2 billion to workers in nearly 100 currencies and provided healthcare and benefits in 109 countries.

The company has a $17.3 billion valuation and reached $1 billion in ARR in just over five years. About 7,000 people work at Deel, across more than 100 countries and 74 languages. Customers rate it 4.83 on average, from 15,000 reviews on G2, Trustpilot, Capterra, Apple and Google.

Most teams use AI as a faster way for humans to build products. Deel wants to go further and build the system that lets AI build the products. Humans set the taste, the guardrails and the standards it works within.

That system is your product. You build what AI generates against: the design system and component architecture, the generation and agent workflows, the quality gates that keep output production-ready, and the feedback loops that keep it all visible to the team. You stay hands-on as a designer, because the quickest way to prove the system works is to ship real interfaces on top of it.

This is a senior individual contributor role in Product Design. You split your time between Figma and a code editor in roughly equal measure. You work directly with design leadership to drive AI adoption across the whole design organisation, and you sit in a cross-functional team with Engineering and Product.

What you are expected to do:

Build the system

  • Architect the design system, tokens and components as the substrate AI generates against.

  • Design prompt libraries, patterns and agent workflows that turn design intent into production-ready UI with minimal human assembly.

Prove it by designing

  • Stay a practising designer. Explore concepts quickly and design real interfaces.

  • Prototype in production front-end code. You are the first and toughest test of whether the system produces excellent, shippable work.

Own quality, guardrails and evals

  • Define production-readiness criteria for AI-generated UI.

  • Set design-to-code fidelity benchmarks, regression safeguards and evaluation methods that keep AI output honest. Speed must not cost craft.

Drive the AI workflow across the design org

  • Work with design leadership to maintain, evolve and roll out the AI-native workflow across the whole design organisation, not only your own work.

  • Treat it as an ongoing responsibility. Drive adoption, keep standards current as tools change, and embed the workflow across teams so it never depends on one person.

Work across functions

jobs.title: IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
IT & Cloud Manager (m/w/d)

Krumbach-Niederraunau, Bayern · Hybrid · Vollzeit, unbefristet

Über Everfield

Everfield übernimmt, entwickelt und skaliert europäische Softwareunternehmen aus vertikalen Märkten und Spezialnischen und gibt ihnen die Werkzeuge an die Hand, um den nächsten Schritt zu gehen. Unsere Mission: Ambitionen fördern, Wachstum vorantreiben und Chancen für Europas Software-Ökosystem eröffnen.

Die Unternehmen im Everfield-Ökosystem arbeiten dezentral: Sie behalten ihre Teams, Marken und Standorte und konzentrieren sich auf das, was sie am besten können – Produkte entwickeln und Kunden betreuen. Everfield unterstützt mit Talent Acquisition, HR und einem Expertenteam, das zu Finanz- und Operations-Themen berät. Seit der Gründung 2022 ist Everfield in neun Ländern vertreten, Tendenz steigend.

Über SoCom

Die SoCom Informationssysteme GmbH entwickelt mit rund 45 Mitarbeitenden TIKOS, die führende ERP-Lösung für gewerbliche Wäschereien und Textildienstleister. Mit rund 40 % Marktanteil in der DACH-Region und über 30 Jahren Erfahrung steuern Kunden mit TIKOS ihre gesamte Prozesskette, von der Wäscheannahme über RFID-Tracking bis zur Auslieferung. Seit Oktober 2026 gehört auch die Düchting Software & Consulting GmbH zur SoCom-Familie. SoCom ist Teil des Everfield-Ökosystems.

Über die Rolle

Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für unsere gesamte IT: die interne Infrastruktur, die Informationssicherheit und die SoCom Cloud, in der wir TIKOS für unsere Kunden betreiben. Viele dieser Leistungen haben wir bisher extern eingekauft. Jetzt holen wir das Know-how ins Haus – und du stellst die IT so auf, dass sie mit unserem Wachstum, der Integration neuer Unternehmensteile und steigenden regulatorischen Anforderungen Schritt hält.

Du bist Gestalter:in und Macher:in zugleich: Du entwickelst die IT-Strategie gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung und packst im Tagesgeschäft selbst mit an.

Deine Aufgaben

• IT-Verantwortung und Strategie: Du verantwortest die IT von SoCom ganzheitlich, entwickelst gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung eine IT-Roadmap und steuerst das IT-Budget für Hardware, Lizenzen, Cloud und Dienstleister.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
🎤 Why voize? Because we’re more than just a job!

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time - time to care, connect, and be present. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people.

Our vision is to change that by building AI companions that seamlessly take over digital workflows. We don't replace humans with technology - we amplify their impact.

Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. Today, 2,000+ facilities trust voize, and over 200,000 users rely on our AI companion to ease their daily workload.

As a dynamic team, we combine first-in-class technology with meaningful social impact. And now, we’re looking for you to join us on this mission!

💡 Your Mission: Delight customers, optimise processes!

As a Customer Infrastructure Engineer at voize, you own the full technical journey of our customers - from the first presales check to ongoing operations. You’re the primary technical point of contact, bridging voize and customer IT.   • Support technical scaling (e.g. growing user bases, infra changes)

  • Document setups and technical handoffs for smooth internal collaboration

  • Flag recurring issues and contribute to internal tools, docs, or processes

  • Expert Windows/Linux system administration and network configuration skills (firewalls, proxies, routing, MDMs, APIs)

  • Solid experience with virtualisation, Docker, web servers (Nginx, IIS), and load balancing

  • Excellent troubleshooting skills across APIs, browsers, infrastructure, and devices

  • Clear communicator with empathy for both technical and non-technical users

  • Proactive, self-directed, and skilled in documentation and technical handoffs

  • Experience with start-ups will help you thrive in this role

🌱 Growing together – what you can expect at voize

  • We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving healthcare professionals more time for real patient care

jobs.title: Senior ML Engineer - NLP (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🎤 Why voize?

At voize, we believe the greatest gift to frontline workers is time: time to care, connect and be present. Our AI helps care professionals turn spoken notes into structured documentation, so they can spend less time on administrative work and more time with people.

More than 200,000 care workers use voize. Join us to build technology that makes a difference in their daily work.

💡 Your mission

Build agents that nurses can trust: accurate, fast and safe enough for real-world care. You’ll combine hands-on ML with thoughtful engineering and rigorous evaluation, using production data and feedback to improve the product.

We’re hiring four ML engineers through one process. Depending on your strengths and interests, you’ll work on hospital documentation, US senior care, German care agents or the shared NLP platform. You’ll be part of the NLP chapter and work closely with product and engineering colleagues.

🚀 What you’ll do

  • Build and improve LLM agent workflows for nursing forms, assessments, care reports and care-plan suggestions, working on tools, context, state and prompts.

  • Own evaluation for your area: create benchmarks from production traces and synthetic scenarios, build regression tests and use results to inform what ships.

  • Investigate real-world failures, reproduce issues across the app, backend and models, and turn what you learn into fixes, tests and data-labeling tasks.

  • Train or adapt models where they outperform rented frontier models on quality, speed, cost or privacy—for example, for personal-data detection or smaller, faster models.

  • Make latency, cost and privacy part of your engineering decisions, from model routing and caching to protecting sensitive data.

  • Partner with product, engineering, data and customer-facing teams, and use feedback from care professionals to guide improvements.

🤝 What you bring

  • Experience training, evaluating and shipping ML or NLP models to production, and explaining the decisions and results behind your work.

  • Experience building evaluations for ML or LLM systems and using error analysis and regression tests to guide product decisions.

  • Hands-on experience with LLMs in production, including agents or tool use, structured outputs and context design.

  • Strong software engineering skills: you write tested, reviewable production code and can learn an unfamiliar language or framework.

  • An end-to-end approach to messy problems, sound judgment with sensitive data, and the ownership to work through ambiguity in a fast-paced product team.

  • Fluent English.

🛠️ Our stack

Our ML and evaluation tooling uses Python; our agent and app code uses Kotlin Multiplatform and JetBrains Koog. We use Claude through our inference service, alongside open and on-device models where they make sense. You don’t need to know our specific languages or frameworks before joining: depth and the ability to learn matter more than a keyword match.

🌱 What you can expect

  • Work on a product used by care professionals, with direct feedback and a clear social impact.

jobs.title: Head of Electronics & software
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

Head of Electronics & Software

Purpose

We are looking for a Head of Electronics & Software to lead and develop the engineering capability behind some of the most critical systems in our spacecraft.

This is a senior leadership role combining people leadership, engineering excellence, organisational development and technical breadth. You will lead a multidisciplinary organisation spanning:

  • Avionics, communications and electrical power systems

  • Flight software (FSW)

  • Guidance, navigation and control (GNC)

  • Electrical wiring and interconnection systems (EWIS), including harness engineering

  • Future projects and advanced electronics and software development

You will be responsible for ensuring our teams have the people, skills, processes, tools and engineering standards needed to deliver ambitious space programmes today, while building the capabilities we will need for the future.

This is not a role for someone looking to step away from engineering. We are looking for a leader who can engage credibly with highly technical teams, challenge constructively, develop strong technical leaders and help create an environment where exceptional engineering can happen.

Matrix Organisation

Our engineering teams work in a matrix organisation, combining strong functional leadership with project-based delivery.

As Head of Electronics & Software, you will lead the functional organisation, developing its people and capabilities while working closely with Project Managers, Project Chief Engineers, technical authorities and engineering Leads responsible for programme delivery.

You will:

  • Lead and develop Project Leads, discipline Leads, Principal Engineers and transversal engineering resources

  • Partner with project leadership to align capability, resources and priorities with programme needs

  • Help teams navigate competing priorities across projects

  • Ensure clear ownership and accountability between functional leadership and project execution

  • Build an organisation capable of supporting multiple programmes as the company grows

Success in this environment requires collaboration, influence and sound engineering judgement rather than centralising every technical decision.

Role Boundaries

This role owns the strength and effectiveness of the Electronics & Software organisation: its people, capability, engineering practices, tools, standards and functional budget.

You will create the environment in which our technical teams can perform at their best, providing mentoring, challenge and access to expertise while supporting technical and project leadership in making strong engineering decisions.

Project technical decisions and product technical authority remain within the relevant project and technical organisations. Your role is to ensure they are supported by a highly capable engineering organisation with the right expertise, methods and resources.

jobs.title: EMC/EMI Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

We are seeking an experienced and motivated EMC/EMI Engineer to join our team. The successful candidate will be responsible for developing design recommendations and establishing test policies related to Electromagnetic Compatibility (EMC) and Electromagnetic Interference (EMI) for our spacecraft applications. This role requires a thorough understanding of EMC/EMI principles, spacecraft systems, and industry standards to ensure the reliability and functionality of our spacecraft in harsh space environments.

Key Responsibilities:

  1. Design and Development:

    • Provide expert guidance on EMC/EMI design practices to ensure spacecraft systems meet all relevant standards and requirements.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate EMC/EMI considerations into the design phase of spacecraft systems and subsystems.

    • Review and analyze design documents, schematics, and layout plans to identify potential EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Testing and Validation:

    • Develop and implement comprehensive EMC/EMI test plans and procedures for spacecraft systems.

    • Conduct EMC/EMI testing, including pre-compliance and compliance testing.

    • Analyze test data, identify non-conformities, and recommend corrective actions to resolve EMC/EMI issues.

  1. Standards and technological watch:

    • Ensure all designs and test procedures comply with relevant EMC/EMI standards

    • Stay updated with the latest developments in EMC/EMI standards and incorporate them into design and testing processes.

  1. Documentation and Reporting:

    • Prepare detailed technical reports, test summaries, and design documentation related to EMC/EMI activities.

    • Maintain accurate records of all test results, design recommendations, and corrective actions.

  1. Collaboration and Support:

    • Work closely with system engineers, hardware designers, and other stakeholders to address EMC/EMI challenges throughout the product development lifecycle.

    • Provide technical support and training to engineering teams on EMC/EMI best practices and mitigation techniques.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics Engineering, or a related field.

jobs.title: AIT MGSE Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.


We want you as a talented AIT MGSE Engineer to help us in our mission by designing and delivering the MGSEs needed for the preparation of our next capsule.

Key Responsibilities

In your capacity as MAIT MGSE Engineer, your role will be continuously evolving, but day to day duties will include:

  • Work closely with Engineering and AIT colleagues to understand and refine the requirements/timelines for the different MGSEs that we will need for various assembly or testing activities.

  • Conceptualise, design (CAD including manufacturing drawings), procure and commission the MGSEs.

  • Confirm with mechanical analysis/hand calculations/proof tests that the design is compatible with the external loads.

  • Discuss with suppliers the MGSE designs for ease of manufacturing and with the most adequate processes.

  • Follow up the manufacturing/procurement with the suppliers (with the support of our supply chain team) and answer any technical questions/concerns ensuring timely delivery of all items.

  • Provide necessary instructions and support the assembly/commissioning/ implementation of these MGSEs.

What we would love to see from you

In the role of MAIT MGSE Engineer ideally, you will have the following:

  • Mechanical / Aerospace engineering degree or similar with focus on machine / structural design.

  • Minimum 2 years of experience in CAD design + drafting (using Siemens NX or similar) and FE analysis (using Hypermesh or similar).

  • Good understanding of machine design and different manufacturing processes (e.g. machining, welding, etc), design for manufacturing and GD&T.

  • Familiarity with standard margin calculation methodologies for various applications like beams, bolted joints, welds, etc.

  • Experience with design of test setups/jigs/fixtures and planning/execution of mechanical tests in-house would be a plus.

  • Good at documentation including design descriptions, assembly instructions, test reports, etc.

  • Creative with innovative ideas and technical problem solving/troubleshooting skills.

  • Basic hands-on experience with mechanical assembly and simple machining tools like drilling machine.

  • Previous experience in space AIT and MGSE design would be highly appreciated.

  • Good English communication skills (German would be a plus).

jobs.title: (Senior) Performance Marketing Manager (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Holidu is one of the world’s fastest-growing holiday rental technology companies. Our mission is to make booking and hosting holiday homes free of doubt and full of joy, by helping hosts generate more bookings with less work and helping guests find a holiday home they truly enjoy. Our team of 700 colleagues from 60+ nations shares a passion for tech, an ambition for constant improvement, and a relentless drive to bring the best experience to more than 40k holiday rental hosts and 4 million annual guests.

Your future team

You will be part of the Paid Search team, the growth engine of Holidu's Performance Marketing: we run Google Ads and Microsoft Ads across all Holidu domains and brands in Europe, on both sides of the marketplace - Guest (B2C, bookings) and Host (B2B, lead generation). We are a small, international and highly analytical team: value-based bidding at scale, our own bidding infrastructure, and data-driven in every decision. We work AI-first, and we are early: as marketers, we build our own analyses, automations and internal apps with LLM tooling (mainly Claude), together with our MarTech team. The team is led by Andreas, who has two decades of experience in digital marketing, and you will work closely with Rasmus, one of Holidu's Co-Founders.

What you will do

This role suits a proactive builder: strong numerical mindset, comfortable creating structure where none exists yet, at home in both strategy and hands-on execution.

  • Own large-scale Search Engine Advertising across multiple European markets (Google Ads and Microsoft Ads), from account structure to value-based bidding that grows efficiently

  • Challenge how we do paid search today: question our bidding logic, structures and processes, and bring perspectives we have not considered. With us, arguments and data weigh more than job titles

  • Co-build internal marketing apps with Claude Code and GitHub, as a marketer, not an engineer. We are first movers here: you will learn a skill almost nobody in the market has yet, and you will shape our tooling together with our MarTech team

  • Own your numbers end-to-end: find the improvement potential others walk past, run high-impact A/B tests across large budgets, decide with data, and turn results into playbooks instead of one-off learnings

  • Pilot what is next in paid search: AI Max, the first generation of LLM advertising (OpenAI/ChatGPT Ads), and AI-powered workflows from anomaly detection to statistical analysis

What you bring

  • A sharp, quantitative mindset and strong analytical thinking: you make decisions with data, spot what others miss, and can argue your case clearly

  • Ownership of business results: you think in outcomes, not processes, and build solutions rather than wait for instructions

  • Hands-on experience in paid search (Google Ads; Microsoft Ads as a plus): trajectory and depth of thinking matter more to us than years

  • Genuine curiosity about AI in marketing: you’ve already used AI tools to change how you work, not just to draft texts, and want to go deeper. No engineering background needed, curiosity is the requirement

  • Fluent English (our working language); any additional language is a plus

What we offer

  • Impact: Make a difference for hundreds of thousands of monthly users.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an experienced z/OS Mainframe Trainer to deliver an intensive Mainframe Academy designed to prepare the next generation of mainframe professionals for careers in complex enterprise IT environments.

The Academy covers essential IBM Mainframe technologies, with a strong focus on z/OS system programming, mainframe operations and enterprise infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities

  • Prepare and deliver structured, interactive and practice-oriented training sessions.

  • Teach core z/OS concepts and mainframe system programming.

  • Cover key topics such as z/OS architecture, JCL/JES, Data Management, SMP/E, IPL, CICS, DB2, IMS, MQ, System Automation and REXX.

  • Develop training materials, practical exercises and hands-on labs.

  • Mentor participants and support them throughout the programme.

  • Guide participants through a final practical project.


Required Experience and Skills

  • Extensive hands-on experience with IBM z/OS and Mainframe technologies.

  • Broad knowledge of mainframe technologies and enterprise environments.

  • Previous experience in technical training, workshops or mentoring.

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.

  • Ability to deliver engaging training sessions in English.

Program Details

  • Kick-off event: 11 January 2027 – on-site in Stockholm, Sweden

If you have extensive IBM z/OS experience and enjoy teaching and mentoring the next generation of Mainframe professionals, we would be delighted to hear from you.

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager BESS (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind ein mittelständisches Familienunternehmen mit 500 Mitarbeitenden an verschiedenen Standorten in Deutschland. Als Ingenieurs- und Beratungsdienstleister sind wir weltweit in Projekten tätig, welche die Energiewende vorantreiben, den Schutz der Umwelt fördern und zur Verbesserung unser aller Lebensqualität beitragen.

Als Senior Project Manager BESS /m/w/d) übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Batteriespeicherprojekte in Deutschland und begleiten diese von der Planung bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme. Zur Vertstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir engagierte Persönlichkeiten an verschiedenen Standorten deutschlandweit, die mir ihrer Expertise den Ausbau moderner Energiespeicherlösungen vorantreiben möchten.

Aufgaben, die motivieren:

  • Projektmanagement von BESS-Projekten (Battery Energy Storage Systems) mit Schwerpunkt auf dem deutschen Markt

  • Erfahrung mit den deutschen Genehmigungsanforderungen (z. B. BImSchG/BImSchV)

  • Unterstützung der Beschaffung sowie Leitung von Ausschreibungs- und Vergabeverfahren

  • Unterstützung während der Bau- und Inbetriebnahmephase

  • Koordination von Nachunternehmern sowie Sicherstellung von QA/QC (Qualitätssicherung und Qualitätskontrolle)

  • Unterstützung des Vertriebsteams bei der Akquise neuer Projekte

Qualifikationen, die überzeugen:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Erneuerbare Energien, Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung

  • 6–8 Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich elektrotechnischer Anlagen in Deutschland

  • Erfahrung in der Planung von Anlagen im Bereich der erneuerbaren Energien, Batteriespeichersystemen (BESS) oder anderen elektrotechnischen Anlagen in Deutschland

  • Deutsch-, und Englischkenntnisse auf C1 Niveau

jobs.title: Director, Commissioning, EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Director, Commissioning, EMEA

Role Summary

The Commissioning Director, EMEA will lead commissioning across STACK data centre projects, from early project engagement through testing, validation and final power and facilities handover. This role provides programme-level leadership for the planning, development and consistent execution of commissioning activities across mission-critical facilities, ensuring systems perform safely, reliably and in line with design intent and client requirements.

Working across engineering, construction, operations and external commissioning partners, you will set and maintain commissioning standards, oversee test strategies and documentation, and provide clear visibility of progress, risk and readiness across the EMEA portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

· Lead the development and execution of commissioning plans across STACK EMEA projects, including all commissioning levels through Integrated Systems Testing and handover.

· Develop, standardise and review commissioning documentation, including Functional Performance Tests, Factory Acceptance Tests, equipment start-up procedures, installation checklists, test protocols, scripts and methods.

· Ensure commissioning documentation and activities align with project design, specifications, Basis of Design and Owner’s Project Requirements.

· Provide programme-level oversight of multi-discipline pre-commissioning and commissioning activities across critical infrastructure construction and special projects.

· Coordinate with project teams, client engineers and technical stakeholders to assess issues identified during testing, determine criticality and drive appropriate resolution.

· Oversee QA/QC of pre-functional and functional test results, ensuring completeness, accuracy and appropriate interpretation of results.

· Provide commissioning input into project design, planning and schedules, identifying risks, dependencies and potential constraints early.

· Ensure commissioning activities comply with applicable safety, environmental, quality and technical standards, and actively support STACK safety programmes.

· Manage and coordinate commissioning agents and subcontractors on site, escalating issues or potential blockers that could affect project delivery.

· Track commissioning progress against key delivery milestones and provide programme reporting, metrics and data-driven insight to stakeholders.

· Partner with Procurement, Legal, Finance and other functions to develop effective cross-functional processes and resolve delivery gaps.

· Manage commissioning budgets and support effective commercial oversight of commissioning activities.

What You’ll Bring

· Demonstrable commissioning leadership experience within data centres or other mission-critical environments, with strong experience managing complex mechanical and electrical commissioning programmes.

· A qualification in Electrical, Mechanical, Computer Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent relevant experience.

· Strong technical knowledge of mechanical and electrical plant and services supporting ...

jobs.title: IT Operations Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an IT Operations Engineer to help build, operate, and secure the infrastructure that supports our rapidly growing company.

This is a broad role an early, hyper scaling startup. You will work across enterprise IT, server administration, hosting, DevOps, user support, and information security. The role combines hands-on technical operations with the opportunity to develop robust, well-managed IT environments for engineering, manufacturing, testing, and business operations.

We are looking for someone who understands that reliable IT is essential to a high-performance engineering organisation and that processes and platforms need to be scalable from initial implementation. You should be comfortable working across both Windows and Linux environments, troubleshooting directly, and improving systems rather than simply maintaining them.

About us

We’re a Germany-based rocketry startup currently in stealth mode, scaling up rapidly to meet the demand for high-performance, reliable, and scalable solid propulsion technologies for space and defense applications.

We are already launching ballistic rockets on a regular basis, have just crossed €10m in revenue for our first operating year and are applying our knowledge toward the development of an orbital rocket.

We are working hard to build something truly spectacular.

To thrive here you will need to be comfortable working at pace, with the autonomy to make decisions and execute on them quickly. If you’re excited by hard technical challenges and want a role where you will make a real difference each day to the future of the company, we may be the place for you.

At our company, job titles and career progression are earned, not determined by years of experience alone. They reflect the responsibility you take on and the dedication you bring to each project. If you’re ready to rise to the challenge, we’d love to hear from you.

Key responsibilities

  • Operate and improve IT infrastructure across servers, endpoints, identity systems, Microsoft 365, Exchange, Active Directory, and related services.

  • Manage Windows and Linux systems, including configuration, patching, backups, monitoring, troubleshooting, and lifecycle management.

  • Support hosting and DevOps activities, including deployments, automation, system reliability, and operational documentation.

  • Manage user access, permissions, devices, software, and IT support requests across the organisation.

  • Help design and maintain secure, segregated, and reliable IT environments for engineering, operations, and business functions.

  • Support IT processes including incident management, change control, asset management, configuration management, and security compliance.

What we are looking for

  • Experience in IT operations, IT support, systems administration, server management, DevOps, hosting, or a similar technical role.

  • Practical experience administering Microsoft environments, including Active Directory, Microsoft 365, Exchange, or comparable services.

jobs.title: Construction Project Manager, Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Mission

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear.

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.

Role Purpose

We are looking for an experienced Development/Construction Lead to manage clinic development projects across Germany. This role will oversee the full lifecycle of projects, from concept and planning through to operational delivery, ensuring projects are completed on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards. The role requires strong knowledge of the German construction environment, particularly building permits and local project processes.

What You'll Delivery in the First 6-12 Months

  • Lead clinic construction and development projects across Germany from concept through to operational handover.

  • Manage contractors, architects, and consultants while ensuring quality and timeline delivery.

  • Navigate German building permit processes and local regulatory requirements.

jobs.title: Account Executive, Southern Europe
jobs.descriptionHtml:
🏢 Who we are

A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone

We are a software company developing an open source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.

Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure. By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success. We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.

Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

✏️ What you will do

As Account Executive for Southern Europe, you'll build NetBird's business in France, Spain, Portugal, Italy and Greece, with France as your anchor market. Many teams in the region already run NetBird through our open source and self-serve products, and you'll turn that adoption into annual cloud and self-hosted enterprise contracts while opening new mid-market and enterprise accounts. You own the full cycle, from first touch to signed contract and expansion. You'll report to our Head of Sales and work closely with our Solutions Engineers, Marketing and Product.

You will:

  • Own the full sales cycle in Southern Europe: prospecting, discovery, demos with a Solutions Engineer, proposals, negotiation and close.

  • Turn open source and self-serve users into paying annual customers, using product usage signals to find the right accounts and the right moment.

  • Run outbound into mid-market and enterprise companies that want to replace legacy VPNs such as OpenVPN, Cisco AnyConnect, Fortinet or GlobalProtect.

  • Sell to technical buyers, from infrastructure and network engineers to security leads, with a clear story on open source, self-hosting and zero trust.

  • Build relationships with MSPs, integrators and resellers across the region.

  • Meet customers on site, at conferences and at meetups, and join the team in Berlin for regular offsites.

  • Keep your forecast and HubSpot data accurate, and bring regional product and pricing feedback back to the team.

  • Shape messaging for French-speaking markets with Marketing, including compliance and data sovereignty topics such as NIS2, GDPR and SecNumCloud.

This is a builder role: you'll be the first person dedicated to the region, with a lot of freedom in how you build it and room to grow as the team expands.

About CuspAI

CuspAI is the frontier AI company on a mission to solve the breakthrough materials needed to power human progress. While nature took billions of years to perfect molecules, we are harnessing AI to unlock trillion-dollar materials breakthroughs in months, not millennia. Our founding team is the most cited in the world, comprised of world-class researchers in AI, chemistry and engineering.

We are working on some of the hardest and most important challenges including energy, clean water, the future of compute, and carbon capture, and this is just the start of what our 'search engine' for next-generation materials will unlock.

We invite you to be part of a diverse, innovative team at the intersection of AI and materials science, working to create impactful partnerships that drive innovation, scalability, and industry collaboration. This work matters. Your work matters.

We’re on the cusp of the on-demand materials era. Join us.

The Role

Due to rapid growth, we are seeking a Technical Program Manager with an AI/ML background to join our team in Berlin. You will be a key driver of technical cohesion, bridging the gap between our research and the physical implementation of next-generation materials.

Your Impact

In this role you will be building and executing the program management framework that accelerates AI/ML frontier research and platform capability development, which is critical for translating scientific objectives into real-world, scalable materials breakthroughs.

As a member of our growing team of TPMs, you will work closely with our technical teams on internal initiatives and also manage high-stakes customer projects. Your main focus initially will be coordinating complex technical campaigns in frontier AI/ML research focused on developing novel materials, and over time you will likely get involved in establishing more sophisticated, scalable processes for model development lifecycles.

Program Leadership & Research Integration

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Patronus

Patronus entwickelt intelligente Notruf-Technologie, die Senior*innen mehr Sicherheit und Unabhängigkeit im Alltag gibt. Mehr als 25.000 Menschen verlassen sich bereits auf uns. Als Berliner Healthcare Start-up mit finanzstarken Investoren im Rücken wachsen wir schnell – und genau dieses Wachstum treibst du in deiner Rolle aktiv mit voran.

Als (Senior) Operations Manager – Abrechnung Pflegekassen Health Tech (w/m/x) wirst du Teil unseres Partner & Payments Management Teams (aktuell 5 Personen) und berichtest direkt an unsere Senior Team Lead Partner & Payments Management. Wenn Pflegekassen die Kosten für die Patronus-Uhr übernehmen, steckt dahinter ein komplexer Prozess: vom Antrag auf Kostenübernahme über die Bestätigung und die Abrechnung bis zum Zahlungseingang. Genau diesen geschäftskritischen Prozess verantwortest du – mit direktem Einfluss auf unseren Cashflow.

Was uns als Team ausmacht: Echte Ownership statt Abarbeiten, schnelle Umsetzung und offene Kommunikation. Wir sind ein bisschen nerdy, wenn es um saubere Prozesse und gute Daten geht – und mindestens genauso begeistert, wenn ein Problem endlich an der Wurzel gelöst ist.   • Du bringst mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Operations, Prozessmanagement, FinOps, Partnermanagement oder Abrechnungsmanagement mit, idealerweise im Healthcare- oder Tech-Umfeld.

  • Du bist proaktiv, übernimmst Ownership, erkennst Verbesserungspotenzial und packst operativ mit an. Dabei kommunizierst du klar und verbindlich – intern wie extern.

  • Du arbeitest analytisch und sehr genau, bist sicher in Google Sheets/Excel und nutzt AI-Tools wie Claude oder ChatGPT selbstverständlich im Arbeitsalltag.

  • Du sprichst Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau und Englisch mindestens auf B2-Niveau.

Plus:

  • Erfahrung mit Automatisierung und No-Code-Tools (z. B. Zapier, n8n) oder SQL-Grundkenntnisse

jobs.title: Senior Control Systems Engineer – Vehicle Dynamics & Abstraction (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Control Systems Engineer to lead the design and execution of robust control layers across a highly diverse fleet of autonomous vehicles. In this role, you will act as the critical boundary layer to the upper autonomy stack. As the industry transitions toward End-to-End driving models, your primary mandate is to ensure that high-level motion commands are executed sensibly and strictly safeguarded at the physical limits of the vehicle. 

Your designs will address complex, real-world scenarios rather than idealized environments. You will build control architectures that remain robust under severe, highly non-linear real-world conditions. This includes handling sudden tire slip, navigating challenging terrain such as mud, gravel, potholes, and dense vegetation, maintaining stability on steep inclines and side slopes, and delivering predictable tracking despite asymmetric system degradation, such as a damaged mechanics.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Control Architecture Abstraction: Maintain a standardized, platform-agnostic motion command interface that cleanly abstracts underlying mechanical complexity from the planning layers. 

  • Multivariable Control & Allocation: Design and deploy control laws to manage path tracking, velocity execution, and actuator saturation, incorporating data-driven control allocation to dynamically distribute effort across multiple actuators. 

  • System Identification & Modeling: Utilize data-driven system identification techniques to model unknown plant dynamics, latencies, and actuator responses. 

  • Pragmatic Simulation & Verification: Validate control loops rapidly. If filter design and linear/nonlinear analysis indicate a controller will behave, you are empowered to rely on lean, pragmatic subsystem simulations to iterate fast rather than being bottlenecked waiting for massive, full-system high-fidelity simulation runs.

  • Motion Safeguarding: Ensure that incoming motion commands are dynamically evaluated, bounded, and safeguarded against the physical realities and constraints of the vehicle chassis in real time.


What you bring to the team:

  • Experience: Proven professional experience developing and deploying real-time closed-loop control systems. 

  • Linear & Classical Control Design: Deep foundational command of classical control theory, including frequency-domain loop-shaping, stability margin analysis (Bode/Nyquist), and standard state-space design methods (LQR/pole-placement).

jobs.title: Senior Payload Integration Engineer - UGV Platforms  (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join Quantum-Systems and help bring autonomous ground systems into real-world operations. As Senior Payload Integration Engineer, you will own the payload integration across our UGV platforms: the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration of a wide range of mission payloads into our own Mandrill UGV and partner vehicle platforms. Your goal is a payload-agnostic platform with scalable, reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions, so we can adapt quickly to evolving mission needs without redesigning the vehicle for every new configuration. 

This is a senior individual contributor role with real ownership. You drive the integration architecture end to end, from interface definition through bring-up and commissioning to the point where the complete E/E system is proven to work on the vehicle. You will work at the intersection of vehicle hardware, autonomy and MOSAIC orchestration software, mechanical engineering, suppliers, and manufacturing. 


What is your Day to Day Mission:

Payload Integration Architecture and Ownership

  • Define and own the electrical, electronic, and mechanical integration concept for various payloads across our UGV platforms, ensuring scalable and reusable interfaces instead of one-off solutions. 

  • Design, specify, and validate payload interfaces: power supply, signal routing, communication interfaces, connectors, mounting concepts, cooling, grounding and shielding, and serviceability. 

  • Enable a payload-flexible vehicle platform that supports a wide range of customer-specific payloads (power profiles, environmental conditions, data interfaces) without major redesigns for every new configuration. 

  • Electrical, Electronic and mechanical Integration

  • Integrate payloads into the vehicle power, network, compute, and control architectures: schematics, harnessing, connectors, fusing, diagnostics, and interface documentation. 

  • Work with vehicle communication buses (CAN, automotive Ethernet) to bring payload data and control interfaces cleanly into the vehicle architecture. 

  • Own the health of the complete E/E system: systematic cross-domain troubleshooting across payload, harness, power, compute, and software. 

  • Drive payload mounting together with internal vehicle teams and external suppliers: brackets, packaging, accessibility, vibration robustness, environmental protection, maintainability, and manufacturability.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About the role:

You will join Quantum Systems’ Aircraft Domain, where we develop large airborne systems and bring them to operational readiness. At the heart of the domain is our multi-role aircraft programme, serving both civil and military applications. The Pulse P19, is our flagship product, with additional airborne system developments set to expand the domain’s product portfolio in the near future.

As a Front End Engineer, you will play a key role in our Aircraft Domain team, being responsible for building sleek, responsive, and user-friendly interfaces to enable real-time control and monitoring of our mission aircraft and their related systems.

While this role focuses on the development for the P19 and related aircraft, your work is conducted in close collaboration with the core development team, which drives the whole swarm robotics and sensor control distributed over multiple domains. Your work will directly contribute to the usability and efficiency of our cutting-edge robotics solutions.

What is your Day to Day Mission:

  • Design, develop, and optimize frontend applications for controlling and visualizing robotic swarms and sensor data.

  • Collaborate with backend engineers to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow between frontend and backend systems.

  • Build intuitive, performant, and responsive user interfaces using modern frontend frameworks such as React or comparable web component frameworks.

  • Work closely with UX/UI designers to translate designs into functional applications.

  • Ensure code quality, maintainability, and scalability through clean coding practices and code reviews.

  • Troubleshoot and optimize frontend performance for real-time applications.



What you bring to the team:

  • 5+ years of professional experience in frontend development.

  • Proficiency in TypeScript and web component frameworks.

  • Strong understanding of modern web development tools, concepts, and practices.

  • Basic knowledge of backend systems and API integration.

  • Experience with custom web-based rendering engines.

  • Familiarity with RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and data visualization tools.

  • Ability to write clean, efficient, and well-documented code.

  • Excellent problem-solving skills and a passion for building user-friendly applications.

  • Nice-to-Have:

    • Experience with robotics, sensor data visualization, or real-time control systems.

    • Knowledge of state management libraries (e.g., Redux, MobX) and frontend build tools.

    • Familiarity with backend technologies such as Node.js or similar.

    • Understanding of testing frameworks and tools for front-end development.

    • Passion for aviation systems and experience with piloting or flight simulation.

jobs.company: VitaForst International Management of Forest & Landscape e.K.
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Als Werkstudent unterstützt du die Geschäftsführung von VitaForst bei der Recherche, Vorbereitung und Organisation von Projekten, Ausschreibungen und strategischen Entwicklungen.

Ziel der Tätigkeit ist es, diese organisatorisch zu entlasten und gleichzeitig Einblicke in die praktische Projektentwicklung in den Bereichen Forstwirtschaft, Landschaftspflege und Gebäudebegrünung zu erhalten.

Recherche und Management von Ausschreibungen

Du beobachtest regelmäßig öffentliche Vergabeplattformen und identifizierst passende Ausschreibungen. Dazu zählen Aufgaben wie:

  • Recherche von Ausschreibungen über Vergabeportale
    (z. B. Vergabemarktplätze, Submissionsportale, KI-gestützte Ausschreibungssoftware),

  • Bewertung der Ausschreibungen auf Relevanz für VitaForst,

  • Dokumentation der Ausschreibungen,

  • Terminüberwachung von Angebotsfristen,

  • Strukturierung der Ausschreibungen in einem Projektboard.

Vorbereitung von Angeboten und Angebotsgrundlagen

Unterstützung der Geschäftsführung bei der Angebotsvorbereitung. Dazu zählen Aufgaben wie:


  • Zusammenstellung von Ausschreibungsunterlagen,

  • Vorbereitung von Angebotsanfragen an Partner und Lieferanten,

  • Erstellung einfacher Vorkalkulationen,

  • Strukturierung der Angebotsdaten,

  • Vorbereitung von Angebotsmappen.

Projektorganisation und Aufgabenmanagement

Organisation von Projekten und Aufgaben in digitalen Systemen. Dazu zählen Aufgaben wie:

  • Pflege und Strukturierung der internen Boards,

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer – SAP (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Qorelo

Almost every company running SAP faces the same task: the move to SAP S/4HANA. These programmes run for years, cost tens of millions, and regularly stall at the same point. Nobody fully understands the legacy landscape that has grown over decades.

That is where Qorelo comes in. We are building the AI platform for S/4HANA transformation. Qorelo reads code, processes, documentation and how the system is actually used, makes the existing landscape transparent, and delivers the fit-to-standard analysis in weeks instead of months. We take a clean core, target-architecture-first approach and carry it end to end across SAP Activate, from Discover to Realize. The knowledge stays with the customer afterwards, long after the system integrators have moved on.

We have raised $3.5M from HPI Ventures, the fund tied to the institute of SAP co-founder Hasso Plattner, along with other strong backers. We already work with Fortune 500 and DAX 40 companies, including Mercedes-Benz.


The role

As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you are Qorelo’s technical face at the customer. You run workshops and demos on the customer’s real SAP landscape, get Qorelo connected to their systems and tools, and make sure the platform delivers on their data and their processes. Then you bring what you learned back to our engineers.

You work directly with our engineering team and solution architects, report to Marino, our CTO, and spend a real share of your time with customers, both on site and remotely.

What you will own

  • SAP connectivity. RFC connections, technical users and authorisations. You make the connection work and explain it to Basis and security teams in their language.

  • Workshops and demos on real environments. You run on-site workshops of several hours and show Qorelo on the customer’s own SAP landscape, not a sandbox: their custom code, their processes, their data. You prepare together with sales and our solution architects, and you handle the technical questions in the room.

  • Integrations. You connect the customer’s tools to Qorelo through our existing integrations across the SAP, Atlassian, Microsoft and similar ecosystems, and make sure they work on the customer’s landscape.

  • The feedback loop. What you see at customers (where the product wins, where it falls short, what they asked for) comes back to engineering and product as clear, concrete feedback. You are the engineering team’s eyes and ears at the customer.

What you need

  • 5+ years in technical, customer-facing roles around SAP: technical SAP consultant, solutions or presales engineer, or an engineer who spent much of their time with customers.

  • Solid SAP technical understanding: you know how an SAP landscape fits together (ECC, S/4HANA), what RFC connections, technical users and authorisations are, and what a Basis team will ask you. You do not need to be an ABAP developer.

  • Enough technical depth to set up and troubleshoot a connection with the customer’s IT: credentials, firewalls, proxies, VPN, certificates.

  • Strong presence in the room: you can run a five-hour workshop with consultants, IT leads and process owners, demo live on their system, and k...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Sanity.io, we’re building the future of AI-powered Content Operations. Our AI Content Operating System gives teams the freedom to model, create, and automate content the way their business works, accelerating digital development and supercharging content operations efficiency. Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes-AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

Your team ensures that enterprise customers are successful and happy using Sanity. This means working closely with technical leaders at our customers to align their strategic goals with implementation details; facilitating brainstorming sessions between editors, designers, and developers; and helping developers make decisions for their unique business needs.

In this role, you will take ownership of your customer relationships and drive both internal and external conversations. You'll also have the opportunity to learn more and develop expertise on the people's side of technology.

Companies like PUMA, Carhartt WIP, Anthropic, Just Eat Takeaway, Spotify, HiPP, and Mercedes AMG are using Sanity to power and automate their content operations.

You're early in your sales career and you'd like a product you can actually get curious about. We're hiring a German-speaking SDR to open up conversations with the teams building the next wave of content and AI products in the DACH region.

SDRs are the front door to Sanity. You'll start the conversations that become pipeline, and because we're growing quickly, you'll also help decide how those conversations should go. No script handed down from three years ago.

  • Own your pipeline from day one
    You're not waiting for leads to land in your lap. You'll be out there, on the phone, in inboxes, sliding into LinkedIn DMs (professionally), starting real conversations with people who have real problems Sanity can solve. You find them, you qualify them, you build the pipeline.

jobs.title: Senior Talent Partner
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.


ABOUT THE ROLE

Our Senior Talent Partner has moved into the Head of People and Talent role, so we're looking for someone to take over day-to-day hiring processes for the whole company. We're growing across every team, and you'll be the person who makes sure each of them gets great people when they need them.

This is a full-cycle role first. You'll own searches end to end, from shaping the brief with a hiring manager to closing the offer. Roughly half your roles will be in engineering and half in other functions, so one week you're calibrating an engineering loop and the next you're hiring for sales or operations. A lot of the people we want aren't looking, so you'll find many of them yourself.

The other part of the job is building a talent community around WunderGraph. We're an open-source company with a real developer community, and hiring should draw on that. Events, content, memes, a community experiment that might not work: you'll have room to try things, and we'd rather you tried.

One thing this isn't - a sales role. We don't need someone to push candidates over the line. We need someone who tells our story honestly and specifically enough that the right people lean in and the wrong ones opt out early. That includes the less glamorous parts, like a small distributed team and meetings that stretch into your evening so we can work with the US.

TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to: Head of People and Talent

  • Collaborates closely with: every hiring manager across engineering and non-engineering teams, plus the CEO, COO, VP of Sales and our engineering principals on key hires

ROLE OBJECTIVES

Director of B2B Marketing & Communications

100% ﻿Remote

We are seeking a Director of B2B Marketing & Communications to lead our B2B brand, content, communications, and industry presence.

This is a hands-on marketing leadership role focused on how the company is positioned and perceived externally across the legal and financial services industries. This is not a traditional social media role. You will own the broader B2B marketing strategy and help build the company's visibility, credibility, and reputation with key industry decision-makers.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and execute the company's B2B marketing and communications strategy.
  • Own the company LinkedIn page, organic content strategy, and content calendar.
  • Develop thought leadership and LinkedIn content for company executives.
  • Turn case studies, company milestones, performance data, and industry insights into compelling content.
  • Manage website content, company updates, and other external communications.

  • Plan company-hosted industry events and targeted partner dinners.
  • Manage the PR agency relationship and coordinate media opportunities.
  • Identify and manage awards, rankings, speaking opportunities, and industry panels.

Example Projects

Experience in legal tech, legal marketing, performance marketing, lead generation, fintech, financial services, B2B SaaS, or agencies serving these industries is a strong plus.

Ideal Candidate Profile

jobs.title: Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Portugal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Redwood Finance Automation Engineer, Portugal

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 350 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will build what the solution design sets out. You will configure the close and reconciliation processes, build the integrations with the ERP and the systems around it, and carry each process through testing, go-live and early support.

What you will work on

Close processes built and configured end to end: task lists, dependencies, approvals and the automated steps between them. Automated account reconciliation, including matching rules and exception handling. Journal entry automation, from data preparation and validation through to posting in the ERP. Integration with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and other source systems, through standard connectors, file and API interfaces. Intercompany, accrual and reclassification steps automated alongside the close. Workflow logic in REL or JavaScript where the standard designer does not meet the requirement. Unit and integration testing, defect fixing, and support through user acceptance testing. Promotion between environments, cutover and hypercare. Technical documentation and handover to the support team.

jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wiser Solutions is hiring a Senior ML Engineer to help build our customer-facing AI platform and get the first features into customers' hands.

Our data runs at real scale: well over 100 million product and pricing records a day from retailers and marketplaces worldwide. The problems are concrete ones like product matching, classification, and attribute extraction. The right answer is often a mix of trained models, embeddings, retrieval, and LLMs, and cost per record matters as much as accuracy.

We want someone who uses AI first, moves fast, and would rather show a working prototype than a slide deck. You'll own ML systems end to end, from idea to experiment to production, and keep improving them once they're live. You don't need to be a data engineer. You need to be the person who turns a customer problem into a model that works.

What You Will Do

  • Take customer problems from idea to working prototype quickly, prove or kill an approach with data, and move what works into production

  • Train, fine-tune, and evaluate models for matching, classification, and extraction problems. This covers classical ML, embedding models, and LLMs, and you pick the simplest approach that meets the quality and cost bar

  • Design and ship RAG systems, embedding-based retrieval, and LLM-powered features on AWS

  • Own the full ML lifecycle: experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring, and retraining

  • Build evaluation that tells us whether something works: labeled golden sets, offline metrics (precision, recall), LLM-as-judge where it fits, and shadow or A/B testing before rollout

  • Monitor models in production for drift, output quality, latency, and cost per prediction, and fix what you find

  • 7+ years in ML engineering, applied data science, or AI engineering

  • A track record of shipping ML or AI systems to production and owning them after launch. You can walk us through the architecture, the tradeoffs, and the metrics that showed it worked

  • Hands-on experience training and evaluating models: feature engineering, experiment design, choosing metrics, handling class imbalance and noisy labels, and knowing when a model is good enough to ship

  • Hands-on experience building production applications with LLMs, including RAG, embeddings, and vector databases

  • Working knowledge of MLOps practices and tooling, such as MLflow, SageMaker Pipelines, Weights & Biases, or similar

  • Experience with AWS for ML workloads (SageMaker, Bedrock, Lambda, ECS/EKS, S3)

  • Strong Python and solid engineering habits: version control, testing, CI/CD, and code review

  • A habit of building quickly to learn: you'd rather test an idea in two days than debate it for two weeks

  • Daily use of AI coding assistants (Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or similar) and curiosity about new AI tools as they come out

Preferred:

  • Experience with LLM fine-tuning, and a clear sense of when to fine-tune versus prompt engineer versus train a smaller task-specific model

  • Experience keeping inference cost down at high volume through distillation, quantization, caching, or tiered model routing

  • Background in retail, e-commerce, or product data (catalog matching, taxonomy mapping, attribute extraction)

  • Experience with entity resolution or similarity search at scale

  • Comfort working with data pipelines and orchestration tools like Airflow (helpful, not required)

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Italy

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Italy. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote

About the Role

We are seeking experienced MBSE Engineers specializing in SysML v2 to contribute to an AI training and evaluation project. In this role, you will leverage your systems engineering expertise to support the development and evaluation of next-generation AI systems. Your work will help improve AI models' ability to understand, interpret, and generate accurate system models through high-quality, real-world engineering input.

Scope of Work

  1. Interpret and translate engineering requirements into accurate SysML v2 textual models, ensuring model fidelity and traceability.
  2. Develop reference solutions and exemplary system architectures in SysML v2 to establish benchmarks for AI evaluation tasks.
  3. Create, refine, and document evaluation rubrics to assess the quality and correctness of SysML v2 models generated by AI systems.
  4. Review, evaluate, and provide structured feedback on SysML v2 models, ensuring technical accuracy and compliance with modeling best practices.
  5. Analyze engineering requirements, Concept of Operations (ConOps), Interface Control Documents (ICDs), and architectural specifications to support modeling activities.
  6. Collaborate through written and verbal communication to clarify project deliverables and resolve technical ambiguities.

Requirements

jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Challenge:

Official publications must be accurate, readable, accessible, and ready for release under demanding timelines. What if you could use your desktop publishing and editing expertise to help the U.S. Coast Guard produce high-quality directives, forms, messages, and other mission-critical publications?

Build Your Career:

At JCTM we value knowledge, experience, integrity, and commitment. Joining our team means becoming part of an organization that empowers individuals, prioritizes ethical practices, and fosters a culture of collaboration and growth.

Challenging Projects:

As a Desktop Publisher Specialist with JCTM, you will support the production, editing, formatting, and finalization of Coast Guard publications in a high-volume environment. This role requires mastery of editing and layout tools, strong command of written English, experience applying templates and publication standards, and the ability to help deliver polished, compliant products across the publishing lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Desktop Publishing and Formatting: Prepare, edit, and format directives, forms, general messages, and other publication artifacts using approved templates, layouts, and standards.
  • Copyediting and Proofreading: Correct grammar, punctuation, usage, consistency, readability, and technical writing issues across draft and final publication products.
  • Line Editing Support: Improve sentence-level readability, clarity, tone, and structure for publication content, especially for general messages and other time-sensitive products.
  • Template Application and Standards Compliance: Ensure correct template usage, proper structure, formatting consistency, and alignment with Coast Guard correspondence and publishing requirements.
  • Section 508 and Plain Language Support: Apply accessible writing and basic remediation practices, including document cleanup, alternative text insertion, artifact tool usage, and identification of non-compliant content for correction or escalation.
  • Publication Processing Support: Assist with pre-publication final checks, version control, release-readiness reviews, and coordination with sponsors or team leads to resolve errors or missing components.
  • Library and Database Maintenance: Maintain accurate publication metadata, titles, coding, categorizations, and archive information to support reliable searchability and records integrity.
  • General Message Processing: Support regular business-hour processing, maintenance, and archiving of message products in accordance with required system formats and records processes.
  • Production Tracking: Keep publication status current in trackers and support reporting of edits, publications processed, remediation actions, and related production metrics.

State-of-the-Art Technology:

Expand your expertise by working with current versions of Microsoft Office 365, Adobe Acrobat Pro, Microsoft SharePoint, and connected collaboration and publishing systems in a virtual, cloud-enabled environment.

New Skills:

Work alongside experienced publishing and compliance professionals while building your expertise in government publishing workflows, accessibility support, records accuracy, metadata management, and publication lifecycle operations.

Room to Grow:

You will have opportunities to grow your career and contribute to JCTM’s strategic goals through increasingly complex publishing assignments, process improvement efforts, and broader support to enterprise publication management.

As a Sales Director at Earnix, you will play a critical role in driving new business growth within the Canadian insurance sector. You will be responsible for owning complex sales cycles end-to-end, developing executive-level relationships, and positioning Earnix’s intelligent decisioning solutions as transformational assets for Canadian insurers navigating digital and operational evolution. This role requires a strategic, highly motivated hunter with deep industry understanding and a relentless drive to win.

Own the full sales cycle from lead to close, driving pipeline generation, qualification, solution positioning, and deal negotiation using a structured MEDDPICC approach. 8+ years of proven, successful sales experience in the Canadian P&C Insurance space, ideally gained at a fast-growing startup or scale-up, demonstrating the ability to navigate complex organizations and close strategic deals in a high-growth, less-established environment.

A strong understanding of how Canadian insurers operate today, combined with deep knowledge of the digital transformation challenges and opportunities across the sector. You will use this knowledge to influence strategic discussions and guide prospects toward modern, analytics-driven decisioning.

Hands-on experience running deals through a MEDDPICC (or comparable) qualification methodology, with fluency in metrics, economic buyer identification, decision criteria/process mapping, pain identification, and champion building.

A passion for hunting and new business acquisition, consistently driving pipeline growth, identifying new revenue streams, and generating momentum in the competitive Canadian insurance market.

Experience operating within global, distributed teams, using collaboration tools and communication best practices to ensure cohesion and momentum across regions.

A highly motivated, results-oriented work style, committing to doing what it takes to win while upholding Earnix values and delivering a world-class customer experience.
