Their 2M+ customers love us because we provide a flexible way for them to make payments and give them an opportunity to improve their credit. Our 200+ Koalafi teammates enjoy inspiring and challenging work that accelerates their careers.

Interested in learning more about how we’re transforming the financing experience and joining our team?

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Financial Data Analyst to join our Finance team in a role that spans financial planning & analysis and capital markets. You will own core pieces of our forecasting and planning cycles, build portfolio- and merchant-level analytics that drive strategic decisions, and support the execution of our funding strategy and lender relationships. Reporting to the Director of FP&A and partnering day-to-day with the VP of FP&A and VP of Capital Markets, this role offers unique breadth for an analyst seat: forecasting & statistical modeling, unit economics, asset backed financing in one role.

Forecasting & Financial Planning

  • Support quarterly Outlook forecasts and the annual budget and plan, spanning originations, portfolio performance, and profitability
  • Build and maintain components of the corporate forecasting model, including portfolio performance analysis across payment behavior, delinquency roll rates, and charge-offs
  • Develop scenario and sensitivity analyses to support strategic decisions and stress-test liquidity positions
  • Analyze variances versus budget and outlook, translating drivers into clear narratives for senior leadership

Capital Markets

  • Support the VP of Capital Markets in managing Koalafi’s asset-backed debt facilities, including covenant compliance monitoring, borrowing base reporting, and analyses supporting draws and repayments
  • Help prepare investor and lender communications, portfolio analyses, and materials for investor meetings
  • Develop credit performance forecasts (e.g., delinquency, prepayment behavior) to inform funding strategy and capital planning
  • Research capital markets trends, funding innovations, and peer strategies

Business & Portfolio Analytics

  • Build merchant- and product-level unit economics and net cash flow analysis to inform pricing, growth, and capital allocation decisions
  • Leverage SQL and large operational datasets to build data models, dashboards (e.g., Tableau, Snowsight), and self-serve reporting
  • Support monthly financial review materials and ad-hoc analyses of executive questions
  • Monitor competitor and market performance and synthesize implications for the business

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Partner with Risk, Accounting, Sales, and Operations teams to align forecasts, metrics, and reporting logic
  • Improve internal processes, automate workflows, and leverage modern tooling (including AI) to increase the speed and accuracy of analysis

About You

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, Engineering, or a quantitative field
  • 2 - 5 years of experience in data/business analytics, FP&A, strategic finance, capital markets, investment banking, or financial services analytics
  • Expertise in writing SQL for data analysis, metric reporting/tracking, and creating datasets

jobs.title: Lead Learning Architect (HOME, PL)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

We are looking for a Lead Learning Architect to join our global Learning & Development organization. In this role, you will translate business and performance needs into effective learning strategies and high-level solution designs, helping create learning experiences that deliver measurable business impact.

You will partner closely with Talent Development, business stakeholders, and Instructional Design teams to take learning initiatives from initial needs analysis and solution architecture through development and evaluation. Working across a global organization, you will collaborate particularly with colleagues in North America and India and play an important role in keeping projects aligned and moving forward across regions and time zones.

This position is fully remote in Poland and follows standard Polish working hours, with some flexibility needed for occasional collaboration with North American colleagues.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Translate business, performance, and capability needs into learning strategies and high-level learning solution designs.
  • Conduct front-end analysis and needs assessments to identify performance gaps, learning requirements, and appropriate solutions.
  • Architect curricula and learning experiences grounded in adult learning principles and aligned with business objectives.
  • Partner with Talent Development, business stakeholders, and Instructional Design teams to guide learning solutions from concept through development.
  • Develop evaluation approaches using the Kirkpatrick model and leverage learner feedback, proficiency results, and performance metrics to measure effectiveness and inform improvements.
  • Collaborate across global teams, particularly in North America and India, to maintain alignment and facilitate smooth delivery across time zones.
  • Provide coaching and guidance to instructional designers and trainers to strengthen the quality and consistency of learning solutions.
  • Evaluate emerging learning technologies and multimedia approaches, including audio, video, and animation, to enhance digital and blended learning experiences.

What We Look For in a Candidate

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent education and relevant experience.
  • 6+ years of related professional experience.
  • Demonstrated experience translating business or performance needs into learning strategies, curricula, and solution designs.
  • Strong knowledge of adult learning theory, instructional design methodologies, and learning evaluation practices.
  • Experience designing solutions across multiple learning modalities, including instructor-led, eLearning, and simulation-based learning.
  • Proven program or project management experience, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Sr Performance Marketing Manager

You'll own daily channel execution, manage complex budgets, build creative testing roadmaps, and scale programs like PMax. You'll collaborate closely with the creative team, product, analytics, and regional growth teams to brief and build a steady pipeline of new creative assets and to ensure paid search plays a central role in our growth engine. This role is built for an all rounder, comfortable working hand in hand with creative partners and who's technical, data-driven, and always pushing for more efficient, scalable acquisition. We use AI extensively across media buying and creative to drive efficiency, and you'll help us take that further. If you've scaled ASA, UAC, or Google Search in fast-moving environments and are ready to build on a global stage-we'd love to talk. What you'll do

Own creative strategy, testing, and velocity across UAC and Performance Max (PMax), alongside Google Search and Apple Search Ads-for a portfolio of high-priority markets with real global scale. Manage channel structure, targeting, bidding, and pacing-balancing growth with CAC efficiency and LTV payback. Build and run a high-cadence creative testing program across UAC and PMax, working hand in hand with the creative team to brief and launch new concepts, formats, and asset variants every week, with clear hypotheses, success metrics, and fast scale-or-kill decisions-alongside keyword, bidding, ad copy, and landing page tests. Track testing velocity and learning rate-tests launched, time to significance, win rate, and creative refresh cadence-and document and share learnings across markets. Report on performance and trends across UAC, PMax, and ASA-developing clear creative-level insights and making strategic recommendations to improve results. Prepare detailed quarterly plans and forecasts-backed by channel expertise, data, and a bias for testing. Collaborate with product and CRO teams to improve conversion paths, app onboarding, and post-click performance. Work directly with platform reps (Google, Apple) to unlock beta access, resolve issues quickly, and stay on the cutting edge of campaign innovation. Partner with regional marketing teams to ensure your campaigns are aligned with local strategy, language, and customer insights. Bring efficiency metrics to the center-owning CAC, CPAs, ROAS, and marginal return analysis to guide smarter spend decisions. Use AI tools to drive efficiency across media buying and creative-from bid and budget optimization to asset generation and variant testing-and share what works with the wider team. Embed AI in your day-to-day management of campaigns to surface growth opportunities faster, and work with the creative team to use AI creative to scale asset production and testing. Stay sharp on search trends-from match-type changes to creative requirements, app promotion updates, and new campaign types.

5-8 years of hands-on experience in paid search, with deep expertise in Google Ads, ASA, and UAC. Hands-on experience running creative tests and scaling Performance Max is essential. jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Gruve

Gruve is an innovative software services startup dedicated to transforming enterprises to AI powerhouses. We specialize in cybersecurity, customer experience, cloud infrastructure, and advanced technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs). Our mission is to assist our customers in their business strategies utilizing their data to make more intelligent decisions. As a well-funded early-stage startup, Gruve offers a dynamic environment with strong customer and partner networks.

Position summary:

We are looking for a skilled L2 System Administrator to support enterprise backup and storage infrastructure. The role is responsible for backup administration, storage provisioning, incident resolution, capacity monitoring, backup failure troubleshooting, restore operations and infrastructure availability. The administrator will work closely with L1 operations, L3 SMEs, Server, Database, Virtualization and Application teams to ensure data protection, storage availability and SLA compliance.

Key Responsibilities:

Backup Operations

  • Provide L2 support for backup incidents, job failures, alerts and service requests.
  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise backup platforms such as Commvault, Veritas NetBackup, Veeam or equivalent tools.
  • Investigate failed backups, missed schedules, agent issues, connectivity failures and backup performance problems.
  • Monitor backup job status, success rates, retention compliance and backup capacity.
  • Execute approved restore and recovery requests for files, virtual machines and supported workloads.
  • Support backup policy configuration, schedule changes, client onboarding and agent management.
  • Validate backup completion and coordinate recovery testing and disaster recovery activities.
  • Escalate complex backup platform issues and data protection risks to L3 SMEs.

Storage Operations

  • Administer and troubleshoot enterprise storage platforms, including SAN, NAS and associated storage infrastructure.
  • Support storage provisioning, volume allocation, LUN mapping, zoning coordination and filesystem capacity activities as applicable.
  • Monitor storage utilization, capacity, performance, latency and hardware alerts.
  • Troubleshoot storage connectivity, path failures, mount issues and capacity-related incidents.
  • Coordinate with Server, VMware, Database and Network teams for storage-related issues.
  • Support storage expansion, migration, maintenance and approved configuration changes.
  • Monitor storage thresholds and identify capacity risks before they affect production services.

Operations & Service Management

  • Resolve incidents and service requests within defined SLAs.
  • Follow ITIL Incident, Problem, Change and Request Management processes.
  • Support major incident restoration, root-cause investigations and corrective actions.
  • Execute approved changes and validate service health after maintenance activities.
  • Maintain runbooks, operational documentation, incident records and shift handover notes.
  • Coordinate with L1/L3, Server, VMware, Database, Network, Security and Application teams.
  • Support backup compliance reporting, capacity reporting and continuous service improvement.
  • Ensure effective APAC–EMEA–NLAM follow-the-sun handovers.

Required Skills & Qualifications:

  • 3–6 years of experience in enterprise backup administration, storage operations and infrastructure production support
  • Hands-on experience in enterprise backup and/or storage operations.
  • Experience with backup platforms such as Commvault,...

jobs.title: Software Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Help Provide Voices – Join PRC‑Saltillo as a Software Engineer!

Remote position available – location in Wooster, Ohio not required

At PRC‑Saltillo, our mission is to provide voices to children and adults who are unable to communicate effectively with their natural voices. Through innovative hardware and software working seamlessly together, we empower individuals to live fuller, more independent lives. Our technology supports people with complex communication needs and opens doors to education, employment, and meaningful connection.

As a Software Engineer, you’ll be part of an agile, collaborative team building and enhancing the software that powers PRC‑Saltillo’s communication devices and internal support tools. Your work will directly contribute to giving individuals a voice—while solving interesting technical challenges and collaborating across Engineering, Product, and other departments.

Go to our website to apply:

Why You’ll Love Working Here

  • Mission‑Driven Impact: Use your engineering skills to create technology that truly changes lives.
  • Meaningful Technical Work: Design and improve software that enables communication and independence.
  • Collaborative Agile Team: Work closely with product managers and fellow engineers in a supportive, team‑focused environment.
  • Remote Flexibility:
    Contribute from anywhere—no requirement to live near Wooster, Ohio.
  • Continuous Improvement: Be part of a company that’s constantly evolving its technology and expanding who it can serve.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with product managers and other software engineers to turn ideas into working software for dedicated hardware and personal computers.
  • Design, implement, and document new software features and enhancements to existing products.
  • Investigate, troubleshoot, and resolve bugs in existing software.
  • Write clean, well‑documented, and maintainable code that follows established team coding standards.
  • Provide thoughtful, constructive code reviews to support quality and knowledge sharing across the team.

Education and Experience

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or equivalent education and experience.
  • At least three years of experience in:
  • Python, C++, or C# for PC applications and/or
  • Python, JavaScript, or C# for full‑stack web development
    (Relevant internships, co‑ops, or similar experience may be considered.)
  • Experience with software and product systems design, including object‑oriented design and MVC.

Required Skills/Abilities

  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Strong teamwork and communication skills.
  • Sound decision‑making and problem‑solving abilities.
  • High attention to detail and commitment to quality.
  • Enthusiasm for engineering solutions that support individuals with complex communication needs.
Salary: $85,000 - $106,000

Job Title: Mathematics Expert (MSc. or PhD)

Compensation: $80–$120 per hour
Location: Global — Fully Remote
Employment Type: Contractor
Workload: Approximately 15 hours per week
Schedule: Flexible, with the option to work on weekdays or weekends, subject to availability requirements.

Job Summary

We are seeking highly skilled Mathematics Experts to contribute to an AI training project focused on advanced mathematical problem-solving, computational mathematics, numerical methods, and Python programming.

The role involves creating, solving, reviewing, and validating mathematical tasks using computational and command-line-based workflows. Candidates will translate mathematical problems into executable procedures, implement algorithms, generate reproducible results, test special cases, and verify mathematical and numerical accuracy.

Key Responsibilities

  1. Solve and validate advanced mathematical and computational problems.
  2. Translate mathematical requirements into precise, executable workflows.
  3. Implement mathematical algorithms and workflows using Python and command-line tools.
  4. Automate calculations, numerical experiments, parameter sweeps, and result validation.
  5. Review computational outputs for mathematical correctness, numerical stability, and reproducibility.
  6. Use scientific computing tools and relevant libraries to support complex mathematical analysis.

Required Qualifications

  1. A master's degree or PhD in Mathematics, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Operations Research, Computational Science, Theoretical Computer Science, or a closely related quantitative field; or
  2. A bachelor's degree in Mathematics or a related quantitative field, along with at least 1–2 years of mathematics-focused professional or research experience at a leading company or institution.
  3. Strong expertise in at least one mathematical discipline, such as:
    • Applied mathematics and numerical analysis
    • Optimization and operations research
    • Probability and statistics
    • Discrete mathematics
    • Algebra and geometry
    • Mathematical modeling and dynamical systems
  4. Strong computational problem-solving and analytical skills.
  5. Ability to implement, test, and validate mathematical solutions using Python or equivalent computational tools.

Relevant Tools & Technologies

Experience with one or more of the following tools is beneficial:

  • Programming and scientific computing: Python, Julia, GNU Octave
  • Mathematical computation: SymPy, SageMath
  • Numerical analysis: NumPy, SciPy
  • Optimization: CVXPY and related optimization libraries
  • Data analysis and visualization: pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter
  • Statistical modeling and network analysis: statsmodels, NetworkX

Equivalent command-line-accessible mathematical software is also acceptable. No single library is mandatory.

Selection Process

  1. Application: Apply for the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. AI Interview: Complete an interview lasting approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Hiring Manager Review: Undergo a final review of your qualifications and expertise.

Compensation Structure

Poznaj Onwelo

Onwelo jest partnerem technologicznym, który dostarcza kompleksowe usługi, od strategii i architektury, przez wdrożenia, po utrzymanie, w obszarach transformacji cyfrowej, danych i automatyzacji. Nasz zespół liczy ponad 400 specjalistów z silnymi kompetencjami seniorskim, a na koncie mamy 300+ zrealizowanych projektów dla dużych organizacji w Polsce, Europie i USA. Działamy z kilku polskich miast oraz z biur w Niemczech, Szwajcarii i USA, łącząc lokalną obecność z globalnym zasięgiem.

O projekcie

Szukamy doświadczonego Senior Java Software Engineer, który wesprze nas w projektowaniu i rozwijaniu skalowalnych systemów backendowych opartych na mikroserwisach. Jeśli cenisz sobie jakość kodu, nowoczesne technologie i pracę w międzynarodowym środowisku – ta rola może być właśnie dla Ciebie.

Twoje zadania

  • Tworzenie mikroserwisów w języku Java 21

  • Przeprowadzanie przeglądów kodu i dbanie o zgodność z najlepszymi praktykami

  • Optymalizowanie wydajności i łatwości utrzymania rozproszonych usług

  • Tworzenie dokumentacji technicznej

  • Współpraca z zespołami produktowymi i technicznymi, dostarczając rozwiązania zorientowane na użytkownika

  • Uczestniczenie w pełnym cyklu tworzenia oprogramowania

Kogo szukamy

  • Masz praktyczne doświadczenie z Java 21

jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Some engineering teams reach a point where technical leadership and people leadership need to be owned separately. That’s the opportunity here.

We’re partnering an experienced a product-led software business to recruit an Engineering Manager, responsible for around 12 engineers working across multiple teams.

The Tech Leads own the technical direction. This role gives dedicated ownership to how engineers are managed, developed, challenged and supported as the team continues to grow.

Location & working arrangement

This is a fully remote role open to candidates based in the UK or Ireland.

There is also office space available in Belfast for anyone who prefers occasional in-person working.

What you’ll own

  • Regular 1:1s, coaching and clear feedback
  • Performance management, including difficult conversations when needed
  • Career development, progression and promotions
  • Engineering career frameworks and review processes
  • Hiring and onboarding
  • Team health, retention and remote culture
  • Helping shape how engineering management works as the organisation grows

You’ll work closely with the Head of Engineering and Tech Leads, but your focus will be firmly on the people side of engineering.

What they’re looking for

This isn’t a first move into management.

You’ll need:

  • Previous experience directly managing software engineers
  • Experience supporting engineers across more than one team or product area
  • A strong track record of developing engineers from mid-level through senior
  • Hands-on experience managing underperformance
  • Experience with progression, promotions and career frameworks
  • Experience hiring software engineers
  • Enough technical depth to read code, follow pull requests and understand the engineering context
  • The judgement to know when to get involved and when to leave technical decisions with the Tech Leads
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in a remote environment
  • Practical experience using AI tools in your own work

Ruby or Rails experience would be useful, but it isn’t essential.

The priority is someone who is genuinely strong at managing engineers while remaining technically credible.

Package

  • Negotiable salary reflecting your experience level
  • Private health insurance for you and your family
  • Company pension
  • 35 days’ annual leave including applicable public/statutory holidays
  • Learning and development support
  • Share options
  • Work-from-home budget

Next steps

If you’ve already led engineering teams and enjoy the people leadership side of engineering as much as the technical environment around it, we’d be keen to hear from you!

Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and we aim to move quickly where there is a strong match.

Equal opportunities

Enably is committed to fair, inclusive hiring and we work with clients who take the same approach seriously. We welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates of all backgrounds and are committed to ensuring a respectful and inclusive recruitment experience for everyone. If you need any reasonable adjustments during the process, please let us know.

jobs.title: YouTube Channel Manger
jobs.descriptionHtml:
The Company

Cineflix Media

Cineflix creates, produces, and distributes must-watch TV for global platforms, with operations in Montreal, Toronto, Vancouver, New York, Los Angeles, London, and Dublin. A leading international media company, the group includes top-ranking sales and acquisitions division, Cineflix Rights. With a catalogue of 7,600 hours of select programming across a wide range of genres and a collection of YouTube and FAST channels streaming 24/7, Cineflix is behind some of TV’s most popular and long-running shows.

The Services

The independent contractor will provide remote YouTube Channel management, optimisation and audience-development services from Brazil for Cineflix You Tube channels. The services will support the growth of those channels in reach and revenue through publishing, packaging, testing, community management and performance analysis.

The contractor will provide the services independently, using their own professional judgement and methods, in line with agreed channel plans, deliverables, quality standards and timelines.

Scope of Services and Deliverables

  • Publish and optimise content on designated YouTube channels, including metadata, thumbnails, playlists, scheduling, community engagement in line with agreed publishing plans.
  • Analyse audience profiles, channel performance and content gaps to identify practical opportunities for growth.
  • Define, test and evaluate content formats, volumes and publishing frequencies, including full episodes, compilations, clips, cutdowns, YouTube Shorts and other digital derivatives.
  • Recommend and apply optimisation for monetisation, search, discovery and audience retention using platform analytics and best-practice packaging.
  • Extract actionable insights from YouTube analytics and translate them into clear recommendations for programming, metadata and format testing.
  • Manage content pipelines of various content types.
  • Assist with resolving limited monetisation issues and claims plus updating video policies or sunsetting video.
  • Liaise with designated Cineflix contacts on publishing plans, approvals, feedback and delivery.

Required Professional Qualifications and Experience

  • Strong conversational written and spoken English.
  • Comfortable collaborating remotely with Cineflix contacts, using designated systems and agreed communication and delivery schedules.
  • Demonstrated professional experience managing YouTube channels.
  • Demonstrated professional knowledge of YouTube Studio, metadata optimisation, thumbnails, playlists, analytics, monetisation policies and community tools.
  • Comfortable using data to spot patterns, diagnose performance issues and recommend practical next steps.
  • Highly organised, detail-oriented and able to manage recurring publishing, optimisation and reporting workflows.
  • Strong editorial judgement and an understanding of how packaging, titles, thumbnails and formats affect audience behaviour.

Desired Experience

  • Written and spoken language skills in LATAM and European languages.
  • Experience working with factual, documentary, lifestyle, true crime, science, engineering, property or archive television content.
  • Experience running A/B tests or structured content tests across titles, thumbnails, formats or scheduling.
  • Interest in audience behaviour, YouTube trends and competitor channel analysis.

If you are interested in this independent contractor opportunity, please submit your resume and a brief summary of relevant channel management experience, including examples of channels you have managed, through the application link. No phone calls please. We thank all candidates for their interest, but only those invited to the next stage will be contacted....

jobs.title: Sales Manager/Director
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our client, Imper, is looking for reinforcement of their sales team, hence we are searching for the Manager/Director of Imper's Sales Function.

Location: Prague | Seniority level: Senior | Allocation: Full-time

About Imper:

The business works very well for us, we have a great sales team, we are fast-growing (currently the 21st fastest growing tech company in CEE according to Deloitte), profitable. We have a very fast sales process and immediate delivery.

Currently it is the time for us to be looking for an energetic leader who will help our business efforts and capitalize on previous experience in B2B business.

He/she will take responsibility for meeting the business goals and help us maintain the significant growth we have enjoyed in recent years .

We offer a job that you will enjoy, above-standard financial proposal, the opportunity to participate directly in the success of the company and, last but not least, self-realization without corporate games.

We are a technology company, profitable and growing!

Half of the team takes care of the product development part and the other half tends to its sales, marketing and client satisfaction.

We are creating web applications:

  • Leady - generates new clients for companies,
  • Merk - the largest database of Czech companies and
  • Monitora - a tool for monitoring and analysis of media.

We supply these applications to companies in both the Czech Republic and abroad, for a monthly fee. It works quite quickly, we currently have over 10,000 users and most of the banks or operators like HP, Canon, IKEA, Avast, Total, AVG, CzechInvest, Tatra, TPCA, Ogilvy and other over 2000 companies build their business, marketing or PR on our data.

Main tasks for the Sales Manager role:

  • Responsibility for leading the sales team
  • Scaling our business activities to new markets
  • Participation in company management and process creation
  • Active participation in the sales process and the company's sales team

Who are we looking for?

  • We expect an energetic leader who has successful experience in leading a larger sales team (15+ team members)
  • Common sense and empathy are important
  • An advantage is represented by the analytical thinking capabilities and experience with team management outside the Czech Republic.
  • Experience in business management
  • Drive and proactive attitude
  • Very good communication, organizational and presentation skills in Czech and English
  • Ability to create a friendly and informal atmosphere.

Why should you join us?

  • Development: What you can't do, we'll teach you. You don't have to worry about that. We will be happy to help.
  • Environment: Feel like home, in a smaller team (about 40 people, 1-2 dogs).
  • Freedom: You will have a free hand at work.
  • Project: Interesting and rewarding work.
  • Overlap: Our data helps to make the environment more transparent, to uncover corruption and clientelism. Also, we are proud to support several non-profits.
  • Freedom: Arrivals, departures, home office, sick days, leave - if everything works, we don't deal with it much.
  • Friends: You will be working in a nice group of people.
  • Money: Above-standard reward. We know that there are only a few people like you and we can appreciate it.
  • Culture: Admission to conferences, workshops, concerts, exhibitions for you and your friends or family.
  • Others: Super coffee, foosball, PC / Mac, free refreshments at our bar, offices in Smíchov, near the metro and other small pleasures.

jobs.title: Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Portugal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Redwood Finance Automation Solution Designer, Portugal

Contract: Duration being confirmed. Start: 15 November 2026. Location: Remote, for consultants based in Portugal. Day rate: EUR 450 a day. Language: English.

The programme

An established organisation is automating its finance operations on Redwood Finance Automation. The work covers the record-to-report cycle: the period-end close, account reconciliation, journal processing and the reporting that follows, all connected to the organisation's ERP.

You will own the solution design. You will work with the finance process owners to understand how the close runs today, decide what to automate and in what order, and set out a design the engineering team can build. You will then stay with that design through build, testing and go-live, and make the calls when what was designed meets what is real.

What you will work on

Current-state analysis of the record-to-report processes with controllers and finance operations leads. The target automation design across close, reconciliation, journals and intercompany, written up as the solution design. Decisions on what standard Redwood capability covers and where an extension is justified. The integration design with SAP S/4HANA or ECC and the other source systems. Balance sheet auto-certification rules, controls, approvals and audit trail designed into the solution, so the automated close stands up to audit. Guidance to the engineers through build, and review of what they deliver against the design. Test strategy and acceptance criteria with the finance users. A roadmap for the next waves of automation once the first processes are live.

What you bring

Solution design ownership on at least one live Redwood Finance Automation (RunMyFinance) implementation, where you ran the design workshops and wrote the design yourself. 8 or more years in finance transformation, finance systems or record-to-report process design. A working understanding of SAP FI/CO, or the Oracle equivalent, and how close and reconciliation data flows between the ERP and the automation layer. Experience running workshops with finance users and turning what they say into a design that can be built and tested. The standing to work with senior finance stakeholders and hold a design position when it is challenged.

Useful but not essential:

Hands-on build experience on Redwood, so you know what your design asks of the engineers. BlackLine, Trintech, or SAP Advanced Financial Closing. A finance qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or similar). Financial services or another regulated industry, including work under SOX or similar audit controls.

How to respond

Apply with your CV and your available start date. With it, add three lines on your most recent Redwood implementation: the finance processes in scope, the ERP it connected to, and which design decisions were yours.

About Yadimen

Yadimen Consulting Limited is an IT consulting company focused on financial services. For this programme we are putting experienced Redwood Finance Automation people in front of the client.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHY DEPT®?

We are pioneers at heart. What this means, is that we are always leaning forward, thinking of what we can create tomorrow that does not exist today. We were born digital and we are a new model of agency, with a deep skillset in tech and marketing. That’s why we hire curious, self-driven, talented people who never stop innovating.

Our culture is big enough to cope and small enough to care. Meaning, that with people across 20+ countries, we’re big enough to provide you with the best tools, global opportunities, and benefits that help you thrive. While acting small by investing in you, your growth, your team, and giving you the autonomy to solve our clients' problems, no matter where you are in the world.

ABOUT YOU

As an Account Manager, Programmatic, you will support the execution and optimization of programmatic campaigns within our retail vertical. You’ll work closely with Account Leads, Coordinators, and cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality work, drive performance, and ensure strong client satisfaction. You bring a mix of strategic thinking, operational excellence, and a proactive, solutions-oriented mindset.

DEPT is a remote-first organization. For this role, we’re looking for someone located in the Central, Pacific or Mountain time zone to align with team and client schedules.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to deliver client-first recommendations and programmatic best practices.
  • Manage day-to-day campaign execution, optimizations, pacing, and reporting.
  • Support the development and presentation of programmatic strategy to improve client performance.
  • Build and maintain strong client relationships through clear communication and timely updates.
  • Identify performance trends, troubleshoot issues, and apply data-driven insights.
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to Coordinators, helping them grow in their roles.
  • Contribute to a positive team culture by demonstrating our core values.
  • Bring forward new ideas, tools, and approaches to push innovation and improve workflow.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2+ years of programmatic media experience, ideally across CTV, Display, and Video; exposure to Native, Audio, or OOH is a plus.
  • Hands-on experience in retail marketplaces such as Amazon, Walmart, Target, or Best Buy.
  • Proficiency in major DSPs (TTD & DV360 preferred) and familiarity with Ad Servers.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Experience training or guiding junior team members is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced environment.

WHAT IMPRESSES US

  • Experience in supporting campaign management in Google Ads (GDA and YouTube) and/or Amazon DSP
  • Comfort with advanced functions in Excel and/or Google Sheets functions
  • Proactivity, creativity, and enthusiasm; demonstrating you’re eager to roll up your sleeves and be hands on, learn, and grow
  • An exceptional eye for detail
  • Love for working with numbers and uncovering trends

WHAT DO WE OFFER?

We are a collaborative, open-door, best-idea-wins environment that fosters personal and company growth and has fun doing it. Here is a snapshot of our benefits package:

  • Healthcare, Dental, and Vision coverage

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. jobs.descriptionHtml:
Anika Systems is seeking an experienced Senior API Engineer to develop, maintain, and enhance an enterprise Semantic Layer supporting data access, analytics, and AI-enabled applications for a federal client.

The successful candidate will be a hands-on Python backend engineer with strong experience designing and implementing secure, scalable APIs, integrating enterprise data sources, and supporting cloud-based services on AWS.

The role requires an understanding of data modeling, metadata, and semantic data integration, along with familiarity with emerging AI integration patterns, including LLMs, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and Model Context Protocol (MCP).

The Engineer will work collaboratively with data architects, AI engineers, and business stakeholders to ensure the Semantic Layer provides reliable, consistent, and governed access to enterprise information.

This position is 100% remote.

Candidates must be a U.S. Citizen with the ability to obtain and maintain a government suitability clearance.

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in data architecture, data engineering, or enterprise data management.
  • Experience developing and maintaining secure API’s within the AWS API Gateway.
  • Expertise in data modeling, data integration, metadata management, governance, and AWS-based data platforms.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Python, SQL, APIs, and serverless architectures.
  • Experience implementing LLMs, RAG solutions, AI agents, MCP integrations, and AI evaluation methodologies.
  • Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, semantic search, and enterprise knowledge retrieval.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience supporting federal agencies.
  • Experience with vector databases (e.g. pgvector).
  • AWS certifications in Data Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Machine Learning, or Generative AI.
  • Experience with Agile, DevSecOps, and CI/CD practices.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
GuidePoint Security provides trusted cybersecurity expertise, solutions and services that help organizations make better decisions and minimize risk. By taking a three-tiered, holistic approach for evaluating security posture and ecosystems, GuidePoint enables some of the nation’s top organizations, such as Fortune 500 companies and U.S. government agencies, to identify threats, optimize resources and integrate best-fit solutions that mitigate risk.

General Description

GuidePoint Security is seeking a Cloud Security Operations Analyst to support the day-to-day business and delivery operations of our Cloud Practice. This role helps keep pipeline and project information accurate, produces useful reporting, coordinates across teams, and supports consistent processes that help our consultants and sales partners deliver exceptional client experiences.

The analyst will work closely with Cloud Practice leadership, delivery teams, Account Executives, and business operations partners. Success in this role requires strong attention to detail, follow-through, comfort working with operational data, and the ability to identify issues and communicate them clearly. This is an individual contributor role focused on execution, analysis, and coordination rather than practice strategy, P&L ownership, or personnel management.

About the Cloud Practice

GuidePoint Security’s Cloud Practice helps clients strengthen security and improve outcomes across cloud platforms, SaaS environments, and automation and AI initiatives. The practice brings together specialists across Microsoft, AWS, Google Cloud, SaaS, and Automation & AI.

Our operations function supports the teams behind this work by improving visibility into opportunities, project delivery, resource needs, and client follow-up. We partner with practice leaders, consultants, sales teams, and other internal stakeholders to maintain reliable information and make routine work more consistent and effective.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Prepare recurring reports, dashboards, and trackers covering pipeline health, project activity, staffing, utilization, and other practice performance measures; highlight missing data, exceptions, and emerging trends.
  • Support resource planning and delivery forecasting by collecting availability, project timing, and demand inputs from practice leaders and delivery teams; flag potential conflicts or gaps for review.
  • Track stale or inactive opportunities, outstanding actions, and client follow-up activities.
  • Administer and summarize internal and client feedback surveys, identify actionable themes, and maintain trackers for improvement items and follow-through.
  • Support the Project-to-Partnership process by tracking project outcomes, follow-on opportunities, and engagement closeout actions in coordination with consultants and sales teams.
  • Maintain Cloud Practice operating procedures, shared documentation, templates, and reporting standards; identify practical ways to reduce manual effort and improve data quality.

Required Experience and Education

  • 5+ years of experience supporting business operations, project coordination, reporting, sales operations, or professional services delivery operations; applicable education or equivalent practical experience may be considered.
  • Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, including organizing data, maintaining trackers, and presenting clear, accurate summaries.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple priorities, meet deadlines, maintain detailed records, and communicate professionally with technical and nontechnical teams.
  • Comfort learning and using CRM, project tracking, collaboration, and reporting platforms.
  • Embraces emerging technologies, including AI tools, to work smarter, solve problems, and drive better business outcomes.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Career Category

Scientific

Job Description

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. We have proudly achieved certifications as Great Place to Work and Equidad MX. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.


Medical Advisor – Bone Health (CDMX)

What you will do

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Support development and execution of patient-focused medical strategies that maximize the value proposition of Amgen's therapies including annual strategic planning and goal setting, launch support and lifecycle management, in collaboration with Medical Product Lead and/or Medical TA Head, appropriate cross-functional teams and governance.
  • Contribute to cross functional stakeholder teams in shaping the healthcare ecosystem by enabling access to medicines through evidence generation, communication and education of medical and economic value.
  • Synthesize and integrate insights to deliver medical inputs into relevant cross-regional/functional strategies, including relevant brand strategy.
  • Foster and enhance collaboration and coordination across Medical.
  • Contribute to strategy development for scientific engagement across a broad range of stakeholders to strengthen external understanding of the unmet need and value of the product.
  • Lead/support relationships with external healthcare community, including interactions with opinion leaders, payers and societies for scientific exchange, where appropriate.
  • Develop/support and lead/support execution of the strategy for medical evidence generation that shapes our products and informs the practice of medicine ensuring key needs are met in alignment with global product medical and relevant brand strategy.
  • Foster Amgen‘s reputation as a science-based, innovative and patient-focused reliable partner.
  • Develop and/or contribute to execution of advocacy plans and strategies in partnership with internal stakeholders and lead relationships as appropriate.

jobs.title: Network Security Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

We are looking for an experienced Network Security Engineer to design, implement, monitor, and support enterprise security infrastructure across on-premises, cloud, and hybrid environments. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in next-generation firewalls, SIEM platforms, cloud security, Zero Trust architecture, and modern cybersecurity operations.

The role requires hands-on experience with technologies such as Fortinet, SonicWall, Palo Alto Networks, SIEM solutions, SASE, SD-WAN, endpoint security, and threat detection platforms.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, deploy, and manage enterprise network security solutions
  • Configure and administer Fortinet, SonicWall, and Palo Alto firewalls
  • Implement and maintain VPNs, IPS/IDS, web filtering, NAT, ACLs, and segmentation policies
  • Monitor security events using SIEM, XDR, and SOC monitoring platforms
  • Investigate security incidents, perform threat analysis, and support incident response activities
  • Manage firewall policies, security rules, and compliance controls
  • Implement Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) and identity-based security controls
  • Support cloud security initiatives across AWS, Azure, and hybrid infrastructure
  • Configure and support SD-WAN and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) solutions
  • Conduct vulnerability assessments and remediation activities
  • Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, and application teams to secure enterprise environments
  • Maintain security documentation, diagrams, SOPs, and audit records
  • Participate in on-call rotations and critical incident handling

Required Skills & Technologies

Firewall & Network Security

  • Fortinet FortiGate
  • SonicWall
  • Palo Alto Networks
  • Check Point (preferred)
  • Cisco Firepower / ASA
  • VPN Technologies (IPSec / SSL VPN)
  • IDS/IPS
  • Web Application Firewall (WAF)
  • NAC (Network Access Control)

Modern Security Technologies

  • Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA)
  • ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access)
  • SASE (Secure Access Service Edge)
  • SD-WAN Security
  • SSE (Security Service Edge)
  • CASB (Cloud Access Security Broker)
  • Micro-segmentation
  • Secure Remote Access Solutions

SIEM, SOC & Threat Detection

Experience with one or more:

  • Splunk
  • QRadar
  • Microsoft Sentinel
  • LogRhythm
  • ArcSight
  • Elastic SIEM

Knowledge of:

  • SOC operations
  • Threat hunting
  • Log correlation
  • MITRE ATT&CK framework
  • Incident response
  • Threat intelligence integration

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

  • AWS Security
  • Microsoft Azure Security
  • Hybrid cloud networking
  • Cloud firewall management
  • Security Groups / NSGs
  • Identity & Access Management (IAM)

Endpoint & Advanced Security

  • EDR/XDR platforms
  • CrowdStrike
  • Microsoft Defender
  • SentinelOne
  • Endpoint hardening
  • DLP (Data Loss Prevention)
  • Email security solutions

Networking Fundamentals

Strong understanding of:

  • TCP/IP
  • Routing & Switching
  • VLANs
  • BGP / OSPF
  • DNS / DHCP
  • Load Balancing
  • Network troubleshooting

Automation & Scripting (Preferred)

  • Python
  • PowerShell
  • Bash scripting
  • Security automation
  • SOAR platforms

Preferred Certifications

  • Fortinet NSE / FCP
  • Palo Alto PCNSA / PCNSE
  • CCNP Security
  • CISSP
  • CEH
  • CompTIA Security+
  • ...

jobs.title: QA- Test Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Overview

We are seeking an experienced Software QA & Testing Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in ensuring the delivery of high-quality software through robust manual and automated testing processes, as well as adopting modern testing tools including Artificial Intelligence (AI) for enhanced efficiency and accuracy. You will lead the testing efforts to identify and resolve issues, optimize performance, ensure cross-browser compatibility, and verify the scalability and resiliency of software capabilities under load.

As part of our commitment to innovation, your role will involve implementing AI-powered testing methodologies to improve coverage and identify issues proactively. If you have hands-on experience with automation, cross-browser testing, performance testing, and industry-leading tools (including AI-based solutions), this is the perfect opportunity for your career growth.

Key Responsibilities

1. Test Planning & Strategy

  • Collaborate with product managers, developers, and other stakeholders to understand requirements and define test objectives.
  • Develop and document comprehensive and efficient test plans, strategies, and exit criteria.
  • Ensure alignment with Agile frameworks for CI/CD processes to maintain quality standards throughout the software development lifecycle.

2. Manual Testing

  • Perform detailed manual testing on new features, functional flows, and regression cases.
  • Conduct comprehensive exploratory testing for edge-case scenarios to uncover potential issues early.
  • Ensure test data coverage for all features, workflows, integrations, and edge cases.

3. Automation Testing

  • Design, build, and maintain automation frameworks for both web and mobile applications using leading tools like Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, and/or similar.
  • Write efficient and reusable automated test scripts to conduct functional and end-to-end testing.
  • Work on integrating automated tests into CI/CD pipelines (e.g., using Jenkins, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline).

4. Cross-Browser & Device Testing

  • Perform cross-browser testing on modern browsers such as Chrome, Firefox, Safari, and Edge using tools like BrowserStack, Lambdatest, or CrossBrowserTesting.
  • Validate software compatibility across various operating systems and devices (desktop and mobile).

5. Performance Testing

  • Design and execute performance, scalability, and stress tests for high-traffic systems using tools like JMeter, LoadRunner, or Gatling.
  • Monitor application response time, throughput, and behavior under heavy load scenarios.
  • Analyze performance bottlenecks and provide optimization recommendations to development teams.

6. AI-Driven Testing

  • Utilize AI-powered test case generation tools like Testim, Applitools, or Tricentis Tosca to design smarter and faster test cases.
  • Work with AI-based tools for visual regression testing and intelligent defect identification.
  • Stay up to date on emerging trends in AI-driven QA solutions to enhance testing strategies.

7. Defect Reporting & Debugging

  • Identify, document, and track bugs and defects found during testing using bug-tracking tools such as JIRA, Trello, and Azure DevOps.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer EMEA
jobs.descriptionHtml:
WunderGraph is a fast-growing startup, our goal is to bring everybody together to build digital products end-to-end. From interface design to API implementation, we provide the platform to go from sketch to product in a category-defining collaborative experience. Our North Star is to take the friction out of bringing digital ideas to life, making room for your ideas and productivity.

Developers from some of the biggest companies in the world are using WunderGraph to design and streamline their API environments. We raised our Series A ($7.5 million USD) in March 2025, being backed by eBay, Karma Ventures, and Aspenwood Ventures.

The culture we are creating together is extremely important to us. Read here how we are Building the Company We Always Wanted to Work In.

We invite everyone that wants to join us to understand our Core Beliefs and if you want to make an impact, have your voice heard, and work in a no-BS organization where you can get stuff done, look no further and apply today so we can chat.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Product Designer at WunderGraph, you are the connection between what our users will find most helpful and what our engineers build. Considering the users also happen to be other developers, this becomes an interesting challenge to think about the Developer Experience as the User Experience. You combine sharp user insight, craft, and pragmatism to deliver experiences that are elegant, usable, and built to scale.

This is a wide-reaching role, as design roles at a startup should be. One week you might be running user interviews to shape a new feature; the next, refining our design system or designing a marketing landing page. You ground your work in evidence rather than assumption, partner closely with product and engineering, and turn what you learn about users into a clear, informed UX strategy that guides where we go next.


TEAM INTEGRATION

  • Reports to the VP of Product; is part of the Product team

  • Aligns closely with the CEO (Product) and Head of Customer Success (customer experience and business impact)

  • Collaborate within the Product team with the Delivery Lead and the Design Engineer

  • Collaborates cross-functionally with engineering, marketing, product, and customer success


ROLE OBJECTIVES

You are successful if you:

  • Take ownership of the complete design lifecycle, bridging the gap between initial discovery and final delivery for web and product interfaces.

  • Cultivate an evidence-based UX strategy that leverages user research and data to steer the product's evolution.

  • Oversee the growth of a unified and extensible design system that spans both our product and marketing efforts.

  • Convert user insights and organizational objectives into pragmatic, human-centric solutions engineered for long-term scalability.

  • Advocate for excellence in accessibility, responsiveness...

jobs.title: Internship
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Few people get to build a bank from scratch. Even fewer get to build one at a moment when banking itself is being reinvented.


The Dollar is the best product in the history of the world - there is infinite global demand. But international fintechs and banks are left with two unsatisfying options to choose from: Either build on legacy correspondent banks that are slow and unreliable, or interface with middleware providers that neither move nor hold the dollars directly, but instead rely on underlying legacy banks themselves. At Augustus, we collapse the stack by combining two things: A real, national bank charter (in organization), and Marble, our proprietary core banking system, built around intelligence, made of code.


We are a group of ex-founders, founding employees of unicorns, and people who dropped out of university because they believe this is an industry and career defining opportunity. We are backed with more than $200M from Peter Thiel's Valar Ventures, Tiger Global, Hummingbird, QED, Creandum, and the founders of Nubank, Ramp, Deel, Circle, Fluidstack, Fuse, and Etched.


We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

This is a 4-month program: 3 months in Berlin, 1 month in New York. You’ll join one of our tracks (CEO Office, Growth, Product, Ops or Talent) and own real work from day one. Like everyone at Augustus, you’ll run day-to-day work in parallel with one or two larger projects.


Recent projects run by interns:

  • Rebuilt our talent engine and cut time-to-fill from 82 days to 34.

  • Took a new product from first customer call to production launch.

  • Relaunched our CRM to drive data accuracy.

  • Built the sales case behind our largest deals.

Who Will Thrive At Augustus

We believe that throwing smart people with high agency at big problems produces the best outcomes. We’re building a modern correspondent bank, and we win by having a better team. The people who succeed here share the following traits:

  • American Dream: You’d rather shoot for gold than settle for mediocrity. You pick the harder goal and stay optimistic when the odds are against you. If it feels easy, we aimed too low.

  • Live Player: You don’t need permission. You rebuild what’s broken without being asked, challenge how things are done, and move before the perfect moment.

  • Ever to Excel: You can’t accept good enough and you take your work personally. When it matters, you do what it takes and keep raising the bar for yourself and your team.

  • Genuine: You play for the company, not your title or turf. Low ego, low drama, no politics. You say it straight, also upwards and always assume good intent.

This role is for you if:

  • You are low ego and ready to jump in where you are needed most.

  • You build your personal AI stack that optimizes your productivity and you treat new AI tools as defaults, not curiosities.

We are regulated in Europe and live with Euro and Stablecoin clearing today. Now, we are building the US team from the ground up, while continuing to grow rapidly in Europe.

The Role

We’re looking for three engineers to join each cohort of the Augustus Engineering Fellowship. You’ll spend 3–6 months in Berlin working on agentic projects with the team building our bank - the infrastructure connecting economies to the Western financial system.

We have a backlog of problems we want to solve, and you’re welcome to bring your own ideas. You might build background coding agents, work on the infrastructure they need to run reliably, or use agents to solve a problem in banking operations.

During the fellowship, you’ll own one project or several smaller ones. You’ll figure out what to build, make the technical decisions, and see it through to use. Our engineers will work with you, review your code, and help when you get stuck. You’ll have room to experiment, with a dedicated stipend covering unlimited AI token usage.

What we look for

You’re smart, work hard, and get things done without needing someone to map out steps for you. When you don’t understand something, you dig into it.

You don’t need years of experience. We’d like to see something you’ve built and hear how you approached it: what you did yourself, what was difficult, and what you’d do differently now.

We explicitly want to convert exceptional fellows into full time engineers. We look at the quality of your work, how independently you work, and how much agency you show paired with if you follow through.

Details

  • Three fellows per cohort, with two cohorts each year.

  • 3–6 months, in person in Berlin.

  • A dedicated stipend covering unlimited AI token usage for your work.

  • Full-time offer, if you perform.

What We Offer

  • Career Growth: You will be given more responsibility and pushed to grow faster than ever before.

Als Account Executive (m/w/d) – Steuerkanzleien gewinnst du die Steuerkanzleien in deiner Region für Pennylane – vom ersten Gespräch über die Demo bis zur Unterschrift, häufig persönlich vor Ort in der Kanzlei. Du bist Owner des Umsatzes in deiner Region und machst Pennylane dort zur bevorzugten Plattform für Kanzleien und ihre Mandanten.

jobs.title: Strategic Account Executive - Germany
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Saviynt's AI-powered identity platform manages and governs human and non-human access to all of an organization's applications, data, and business processes. Customers trust Saviynt to safeguard their digital assets, drive operational efficiency, and reduce compliance costs. Built for the AI age, Saviynt is today helping organizations safely accelerate their deployment and usage of AI. Saviynt is recognized as the leader in identity security, with solutions that protect and empower the world’s leading brands, Fortune 500 companies and government institutions. For more information, please visit www.saviynt.com.

Saviynt is looking for a professional, highly motivated, and energetic Strategic Account Executive  to drive regional sales for our disruptive IaaS Cloud Security, Access Governance & Privileged Access Mgmt. (PAM) solutions. The Strategic Account Executive will combine a good working knowledge of (IaaS & SaaS) Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM with prospecting and sales skills. You will ultimately be responsible for the entire enterprise sales cycle and meeting or exceeding territory quota. Strategic Account Executives are the primary interface to both Prospects and Customers and are responsible for actively driving and managing day-to-day prospecting and selling activity in the region. This activity includes opportunity Discovery, Demo, RFP/RFI, Evaluation & POC stages of the sales process, and working in conjunction with Sales Engineering & Product Management Teams to identify and close new deals.  This job is located remotely in Germany.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING
  • Effectively interact with Field Sales, Cloud Team, and Line of Business decision makers.
  • Learn and maintain knowledge of Saviynt’s solutions, focused on Cloud.
  • Security, Cloud Access Governance and PAM
  • Aggressively identify qualified sales opportunities across all assigned accounts.
  • Develop and leverage all lead sources (personal and partner contacts, inbound leads, events, and outbound prospecting) to generate a meaningful pipeline.
  • Maintain disciplined, detailed, and up-to-date records on Lead and opportunity activity in SFDC to ensure effective leadership development, proper team communication, and executive visibility.
  • Be diligent in timely follow-up and provide quality work products.
  • Attend and assist with corporate and field sales and marketing events.
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly revenue objectives.

    • WHAT YOU BRING
  • 7+ years sales experience in enterprise Identity, Cloud Security, or PAM Sales preferred
  • Possess a knowledge base of Cloud Identity Management, Cloud Privileged Access Management, and/or Cloud Security Governance technology.
  • Cloud Security domain knowledge helpful, including AWS, Azure, Google, IBM, Chef, and Puppet.
  • Strong cybersecurity territory contacts at VP, SVP, CxO levels
  • Successful history of working with Resellers, SI’s, and Advisories.
  • Strong Customer Service orientation, persistence, and ability to follow through.
  • Proven ability and skill to navigate through all levels of an enterprise organization to drive sales.
  • Professional, ambitious, determined, and results-oriented mindset.
  • Positive attitude, team-oriented, self-starter who can work alone and in a collaborative manner to achieve regional goals.
  • Strong written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.
  • Verifiable track record of results.
  • Travel will be required to appropriately manage your assigned territory.

jobs.title: (Senior) Solutions Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Be bold, think big and grow with us!
 

We are one of the fastest growing B2B scale-ups in Germany, creating real value for the engineering industry. With our software, we are setting a new standard in the spare parts business, enabling comprehensive market transparency for the first time. To achieve this, we challenge the status quo every day and support our employees in actively shaping their careers and pushing their own boundaries. Become part of a team that can't be stopped, that overcomes challenges together and celebrates success together.

Be part of our success story and join us as Senior Solutions Engineer (f/m/d)!

You will own the bridge between our customers’ business requirements and MP ONE’s commercial and technical capabilities, leading discovery, demos, and proof-of-value work that moves complex deals across the finish line.


Your Mission
  • Lead customer discovery, technical presentations, tailored demos, and proof-of-value engagements for MP ONE.
  • Collaborate with prospects to understand their business and pricing challenges, identify opportunities for value creation, and align MARKT-PILOT solutions with their objectives.
  • Partner with Sales to build and present compelling technical and business cases to executive stakeholders, clearly demonstrating how MARKT-PILOT drives revenue growth and strengthens competitive advantage.
  • Design and deliver personalized product demonstrations that address specific customer needs and showcase clear ROI and measurable business outcomes.
  • Plan, execute, and evaluate proof-of-value trials, ensuring a seamless process, well-defined success criteria, and actionable insights that validate impact.
  • Serve as the go-to expert on MP ONE’s solutions, integrations, and capabilities, translating technical features into tangible business results.
  • Support strategic sales cycles by providing hands-on technical guidance and proactively addressing challenges to keep deals moving forward.
  • Work closely with Product, Professional Services, and Customer Success to share field insights, shape product improvements, and inform roadmap priorities.

    • Your Skills
  • You bring at least five years of experience in technical sales, pre-sales or solutions engineering, ideally in B2B SaaS, manufacturing or data-driven industries.
  • You bring practical knowledge of pricing strategies, competitive analysis and ROI-driven business cases, ideally from a manufacturer or relevant pricing context. Pricing is core, aftermarket experience is not required, and you can contribute without learning pricing fundamentals from scratch.
  • You have led enterprise discovery, technical presentations, tailored demonstrations and proof-of-value or proof-of-concept engagements.
  • You explain complex technical concepts as clear business value for diverse audiences, including senior decision-makers, and build strong customer relationships.
  • You understand enterprise integrations such as ERP, CRM and APIs; familiarity with HubSpot and SaaS delivery models is a plus.
  • You collaborate effectively with Sales, Product, Professional Services and Customer Success, bringing curiosity, creativity, strong problem-solving skills and a proactive scale-up mindset. A relevant degree in engineering, business, computer science or a related field is a plus.
  • You are fluent in German and English.
  • You are willing to travel to customer locations and to the Stuttgart office as required.

    • Your Benefits
  • Our modern and open scale-up culture gives you the freedom to unleash your creativity within a dynamic and agile team. 💡

jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Development Manager to join our Hunt: Showdown team in our state-of-the-art Frankfurt studio. As Senior Development Manager, you will drive the delivery of one or more sub teams, ensuring alignment with Hunt: Showdown’s overall strategy and milestones.   • Demonstrated ability to identify risks and drive solutions proactively.
  • Experience with resource planning, scheduling, and task prioritization.

jobs.title: IT-Systemadministrator (m/w/d) Microsoft 365, Teilzeit oder Vollzeit
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Kigen IT-Systemhaus
Kigen IT-Systemhaus ist ein auf Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit spezialisiertes Unternehmen mit Standorten in Engstingen und Stuttgart. Wir betreuen Unternehmen von der Kanzlei bis zur Unternehmensgruppe und legen Wert auf saubere, sichere IT-Umgebungen. Bei uns gibt es kurze Wege, Vertrauen und echte Weiterentwicklung statt Konzernstrukturen.

Deine Aufgaben
Du bist fester technischer Ansprechpartner für unsere Kunden im Raum Stuttgart. Du bearbeitest Support-Anfragen im First und Second Level, richtest Arbeitsplätze, Drucker und Besprechungsräume ein und bist bei Bedarf auch vor Ort beim Kunden. Im laufenden Betrieb verwaltest du Benutzer, Geräte und Lizenzen in Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Intune, Exchange Online und Teams und unterstützt in hybriden Umgebungen mit Active Directory.

Das bringst du mit
Du hast eine Ausbildung als Fachinformatiker oder vergleichbare Praxiserfahrung und bereits im IT-Support oder in der Administration gearbeitet. Windows Clients und Active Directory sind dir vertraut, Erfahrung mit Microsoft 365 und Intune ist ein Plus. Du hast einen Führerschein und gehst ruhig und freundlich mit Kunden um. Du erfüllst nicht alles? Wenn du motiviert bist, dich einzuarbeiten, freuen wir uns trotzdem auf deine Bewerbung.

Deine ersten Monate
Du lernst unsere Kunden und deren Umgebungen kennen, übernimmst Schritt für Schritt den Support und arbeitest dabei eng mit dem Gründer zusammen. So bekommst du direkten Wissenstransfer, auch in Themen wie Security und Compliance.

Was wir bieten

  • Teilzeit (ab 20 Stunden) oder Vollzeit, ganz wie es zu dir passt

  • Remote-Arbeit, vor Ort nur bei Kundenterminen im Raum Stuttgart

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und moderne Ausstattung

  • Echte Lernkurve in Microsoft 365 und IT-Sicherheit

Vergütung
45.000 bis 55.000 € brutto jährlich bei Vollzeit, je nach Erfahrung. Bei Teilzeit anteilig.

jobs.title: Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. You will join our international Team Network Planning - Europe North & UK.

This position is part-time (20 hours per week), based in our Berlin office (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Perform data entry, tracking, and validation across tools (Excel, Planr, Salesforce, backend systems, etc.), including regular data updates and quality checks
  • Support preparation of presentations, reports, analyses, and maps
  • Support the team in network planning activities in order to open sales and adapt our offer to transportation demand
  • Take meeting notes, clean up content, and provide concise summaries
  • Support the analysis of our network with various datasets and reports in order to continuously improve our service
  • Prepare important documentation for the authorization of new bus lines
  • Provide operational support throughout the annual timeline

About You

  • Enrolled student or graduate in Transportation Planning, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Urban Planning, Geography, Tourism or similar
  • You're passionate about the transportation sector and show a keen interest in schedule and network planning
  • Strong analytical skills, readiness of mind and a goal-driven personality
  • Fluent in English, all other European languages are considered as a plus
  • Accurate work style as well as strong communication skills
  • Skilled user of the MS Office programs, especially Word and Excel

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

jobs.title: Senior CRO & Funnel Marketing Manager (m/w/d) · Remote
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Du hast schon Onlineshops zum Wachsen gebracht und suchst ein Umfeld, in dem du auf höchstem Niveau arbeiten kannst? Dann übernimm bei EVOLVE die Conversionrate-Optimierung und Funnelentwicklung von E-Commerce-Brands, von der ersten Analyse bis zum messbaren Ergebnis.

Über EVOLVE

Wir sind ein ganzheitlicher Wachstumspartner für E-Commerce-Brands im DACH-Raum. Jedes Jahr verwalten wir über 60 Millionen € Adspend und denken jedes Projekt von der Ad über den Funnel bis zur Marge. Unser Name ist Programm: Wir entwickeln uns, unsere Dienstleistung und unsere Kunden ständig weiter. Das spiegelt sich auch in unserer Mitarbeiterbewertung auf kununu mit 4,8 von 5 Sternen wider.

Haben wir dein Interesse geweckt? Dann schau dir an, was dich bei uns erwartet.

Das wirst du tun

Du bist verantwortlich für verkaufsstarke Shopseiten und Funnels, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Kunden den Markt outperformen.

  • Analyse: Du analysierst Shops, Landingpages und Funnels ganzheitlich und leitest daraus priorisierte Hypothesen und Maßnahmen ab

  • Positionierung: Du deckst die entscheidenden Hebel in der Customer Journey auf und entwickelst Positionierungen, die Marken klar vom Wettbewerb abheben

  • Konzeption: Du erstellst conversionstarke Shop- und Landingpage-Konzepte und steuerst die Umsetzung mit UX-Design und Copywriting

  • Kunden und Projekte: Du führst Kunden eigenständig durch den Optimierungsprozess und verantwortest Projekte bis zum messbaren Ergebnis

  • Trends: Du verfolgst die aktuellsten Trends im Brand- und Direct-Response-Marketing und bringst sie in unsere Methodik und Standards ein

Deine Rolle und deine Ressourcen: Du übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung für deine eigenen Projekte, stehst damit aber nicht allein: Unsere Experten für UX-Design, Copywriting und Performance Marketing setzen deine Konzepte mit dir um. Dich erwartet ein Team, das für Ergebnisse, Verlässlichkeit und kreative Exzellenz steht, mit flachen Hierarchien und einer offenen Feedbackkultur.

Das bringst du mit

  • Mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung in CRO, E-Commerce oder UX, idealerweise in einer Agentur oder einem Shop mit relevantem Traffic

  • Sicherer Umgang mit GA4, Hotjar/Clarity und A/B-Tests

jobs.title: Senior Media-Buyer – Vollzeit (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Wir sind eine der am schnellstwachsenden Digitalagenturen Hamburgs und suchen zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt neue Mitarbeiter/innen für den Bereich Online-Marketing und Media-Buying! Gemeinsam mit unserem Team betreust du eigenständig unsere Kundenprojekte und erstellst Online-Marketing-Kampagnen. Dabei trägst du aktiv zum Erfolg unserer Kunden bei und kannst täglich neue Erfolge feiern!

Was macht die Cordes Consulting GmbH genau?

Wir sind eine Werbeagentur, welche Handwerksunternehmen durch innovative Social-Media-Strategien dabei hilft, mehr Bewerbungen von Fachkräften aus der Region zu erhalten. Wir vermarkten also mittelständische Unternehmen als attraktive Arbeitgeber in den sozialen Netzwerken. Dazu suchen wir neue Media Buyer (m/w/d), um weitere Kundinnen und Kunden beim Aufbau ihrer Arbeitgebermarke zu unterstützen und deren META-Ads zu verwalten. 

Grundgehalt: Senior Media-Buyer (m/w/d): 5.900 € brutto im Monat.

Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten sind vorhanden.

Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.

Deine Aufgabengebiete (nach gründlicher Einarbeitung):

  • Steuerung und Verwaltung der Online-Marketing-Kampagnen im Meta-Ads-Manager

  • Erstellung von KPI-Reportings und Auswertungen für unsere Agenturkunden

  • Regelmäßige Feedback-Meetings mit unseren Kunden zur Auswertung der Reportings

  • Analyse der aktuellen Kampagnenergebnisse und Erarbeitung von Strategien zur Verbesserung der Kampagnenergebnisse

  • Umsetzung von strategischen Optimierungen unserer Werbekampagnen gemeinsam mit unserem Grafik- und Werbetexter-Team

  • Verantwortung und Sicherstellung der Kundenzufriedenheit von unseren Agenturkunden

  • Inhaltliche Fragen von Kunden zum Verlauf der Zusammenarbeit und zu Werbekampagnen beantworten (telefonisch und schriftlich)

  • E-Mail-Support für eingehende Anfragen von Bestandskunden leisten

  • Sicherstellung und Verbesserung der Kundenzufriedenheit


Das erwartet Dich bei uns: 

  • Eine gute Vergütung über dem Branchendurchschnitt.

  • Eine intensive und persönliche Einarbeitung, durch welche du an alle internen Prozesse und an die Arbeit mit unseren Kunden herangeführt wirst.

  • Hervorragende Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten: Über die nächsten Jahre werden wir weiter stark wachsen und expandieren und benötigen weitere Experten und Führungskräfte.

  • Einen tollen Firmenstandort in Hamburg Rotherbaum am Mittelweg mit Dachterrasse und moderner Ausstattung.

  • Eine tolle Arbeitsatmosphäre: Uns ist ein positives Umfeld wichtig. Denn nur wer gut gelaunt ist, kann andere Menschen begeistern. Der Umgang untereinander ist sehr kollegial und familiär. Wir ziehen alle am gleichen Strang.

  • Ein dynamisches Team mit hohen Zielen und ein motivierendes Arbeitsumfeld.

  • Einen sichereren Arbeitsplatz: Jede Person, die wir einstellen, soll langfristig mit uns wachsen. Das Ziel jeder Einstellung ist eine unbefristete Übernahme.

  • Eine erstklassige Büroausstattung: Wir arbeiten ausschließlich mit moderner Technik und Arbeitsausstattung.

  • Wir übernehmen die Kosten für dein Deutschlandticket oder einen Tiefgaragenstellplatz in unserem Bürogebäude

  • Cordes Consulting Gesundheitssystem: Profitiere von umfangreichen Gesundheitsleistungen...
