jobs.title: Founders Associate, Growth (Munich Office)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Dataleap

Dataleap is the agentic operating system for the enterprise: a coding agent for business users. With Dataleap, teams build, scale and manage agentic systems, where agents, apps and chat work as one connected system. Agents do the grunt work, and humans add judgment from their own cockpit.

We're backed by YC and angels like Aravind (Perplexity) and Rahul Vohra (Superhuman). Tens of thousands of our agents run at scale-ups and Fortune 500 companies. Revenue is doubling every month, and demand is bigger than we can handle.

The role

I'm Jan, Co-founder and CEO. I need a sharp generalist next to me to turn our biggest growth priorities into results. One week you're building the business case for an enterprise deal. The next, you're running an agent hackathon at a customer or testing a new segment.

What you'll do

  • Drive strategic projects. Work with the founders on top priorities, bringing research, analysis and clear recommendations to key decisions.

  • Make our customers win with Dataleap. Build alongside customers, prove the value with the first agents, and scale adoption, from hackathons to C-suite rollout strategy.

  • Shape our go-to-market. Explore segments, test growth plays, support enterprise deals, and sharpen how we tell the Dataleap story.

  • Connect customers and product. Turn customer insights into concrete feedback and help shape our product.

  • Run growth as an agentic system. Agentify your way out of the job.

  • Own projects end-to-end. Define the problem, bring the right people together, and drive it to a clear outcome.

You're a fit if

  • You're an ex-founder or have 1–3 years in a high-growth startup, VC or consulting.

  • You're an AI power user. Not "exploring AI": you live in it. You ship agents on weekends and have opinions on model routing, eval design, and where current systems break.

  • You're high agency with a high clock speed. You drive the agenda, prioritize ruthlessly, and communicate sharply and to the point.

  • You're low ego and high ownership. You'll do the unsexy work without flinching. You want to work hard and be deeply obsessed.

  • You're commercially sharp. Renewals, expansion and navigating many stakeholders are second nature.

  • You're great with people. You can walk into a room of executives and lead it, and customers and senior stakeholders trust you quickly.

  • You speak native German and fluent English, and you're based in Munich or ready to move here.

I'll index heavily on energy, values and slope.

Why join us

We're in a unique moment in time. For the next few years, enterprise agents will reshape how people work, and we're at the epicenter of that shift.

We're looking for the first 15 exceptional people to lead this change. You'll work side by side with the founders, own projects that mo...

Bereit für die Freiheit, komplett eigenständig zu arbeiten, aber mit der Power eines globalen Tech-Pioniers im Rücken?

jobs.title: Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Join SE3 Labs as Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer

Join our new Software Platform team and make the devices, networks and compute behind SE3's autonomy run reliably, so our engineers can focus on what they do best.

About SE3

SE3 Labs builds spatial intelligence and autonomy software for unmanned systems. We combine 3D computer vision, state estimation and AI to help autonomous platforms perceive their surroundings, know where they are and operate when GPS and other sensors become unreliable. Defence is a core application of our work today.

We are growing to a team of 100+ people. Join at a stage where you can shape our Software Platform team, help build the team and grow your responsibilities as the company expands.

Our founding team's research has received more than 90,000 citations. You will work closely with technical founders and engineers with deep experience in computer vision and autonomous systems, turning that research depth into systems that work in the field.

About the Role

As Senior Systems & Infrastructure Engineer, you'll be a founding member of our new Software Platform team and own everything infrastructure apart from cybersecurity: software distribution to our platforms, device provisioning, networks, our compute cluster and CI. You'll work on-site in Munich alongside our cybersecurity engineer and the CV, robotics and firmware teams, with occasional visits to our second site.

What You'll Work On

  • Over-the-Air Updates: Unify our separate update and software distribution setups for Jetson, NXP and other edge nodes into one reliable system for every platform.

  • Device Provisioning: Provision, configure and maintain Linux-based edge devices, workstations and ground systems, including ARM64 platforms.

  • Deployment Automation: Build reproducible container images, deployments, device configuration, release workflows and recovery procedures, with Bash and Python tooling.

  • Networks & Remote Access: Design and troubleshoot connectivity across networked and remote devices, including routing, SSH, VPNs, firewalls and constrained field links.

  • Compute Cluster & CI: Make our GPU compute and evaluation cluster and self-hosted CI runners reliable, so engineers can depend on them without manual recovery.

  • Monitoring & Documentation: Improve monitoring, service availability, security hygiene and operational documentation, working closely with our cybersecurity engineer.

  • Engineering Standards: Set the infrastructure standards our teams follow, and support firmware, robotics, CV and test teams in the lab and the field.

Your Profile

  • You take ownership across many areas at once and enjoy covering several roles in a small team, from planning a system to fixing it by hand.

  • You hold a degree in Computer Science or a closely related field.

Mittelständisch denken, weltweit agieren – unser Ansatz seit 1935. Als Kanzlei im Herzen von Hamburg mit ca. 20 Mitarbeitenden betreuen wir Unternehmen verschiedenster Größen und Branchen in den Bereichen Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung. Die Vielfalt unserer Projekte bietet nicht nur spannende Herausforderungen, sondern auch die Chance, sich sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich weiterzuentwickeln.

Dabei steht bei uns nicht nur die Arbeit im Fokus, sondern auch ein Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Sie sich wirklich wohlfühlen können. Bei Scheller & Partner legen wir großen Wert auf eine persönliche Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien, in der Teamgeist und Wertschätzung großgeschrieben werden.

  • Ein abgeschlossenes Studium der Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder eines vergleichbaren Studiengangs mit Schwerpunkt Steuern bzw. Wirtschaftsprüfung
  • Idealerweise erste Berufserfahrung im Bereich der Wirtschaftsprüfung
  • Eine stark ausgeprägte analytische Denkweise und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten

Benefits

  • Entwicklung und Unterstützung: zahlreiche Fort- und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, Unterstützung bei Berufsexamina und Spezialisierungen, ein persönlicher Mentor für die Einarbeitungszeit
  • Vielschichtige Tätigkeiten: abwechslungsreiche Aufgaben im Bereich der Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung für spannende Mandanten aus unterschiedlichen Branchen
  • Attraktive Vergütung: Umsatzbonus und variable Vergütungsmodelle
  • Gesundheit & Vorsorge: Betriebliche Krankenversicherung und Altersvorsorge mit 15 % Zuschuss
  • Flexibilität: Home-Office-Möglichkeiten und flexible Arbeitszeiten
  • Familienfreundlichkeit: Kindergartenzuschüsse für Eltern
  • Moderne Arbeitsumgebung: Helle Büros mit ergonomischen Arbeitsplätzen, höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen und zwei Bildschirmen
  • On top: Gutscheine, Fahrkostenerstattung und eine zentrale Lage mit perfekter Anbindung

jobs.title: Head of Growth / Sales Lead (all genders)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Über Zenon

Bei Zenon besetzen wir die Rollen, die über den Erfolg der größten Tech-Transformationen der kommenden Jahre entscheiden. Als Boutique für Executive Search im IT-Umfeld arbeiten wir für führende Tier-1-Unternehmen und ambitionierte Tech-Player, um die Menschen zu finden, die den Unterschied machen. In unserem kompakten Team in Hamburg gestaltest du als Head of Growth / Sales Lead den Ausbau unseres Geschäfts maßgeblich mit.

Mission

Du baust ein skalierbares Sales-Modell auf, das Zenon von einem stark personengetriebenen 360-Grad-Ansatz zu einer systematischen, datengetriebenen und spezialisierten Organisation entwickelt.

Operatives Business Development & Staffing Sales

  • Du übernimmst aktiv die Neukundenakquise und gewinnst eigenständig neue Recruiting- und Staffing-Mandate.

  • Du identifizierst potenzielle Kunden, analysierst deren Hiring-Bedarfe und entwickelst gezielte Akquisestrategien.

  • Du führst Kundenmeetings, präsentierst unsere Dienstleistungen und verantwortest Vertragsverhandlungen bis zum erfolgreichen Abschluss.

  • Du baust langfristige Beziehungen zu Hiring Managern, HR-Entscheidern und Führungskräften auf.

  • Du entwickelst bestehende Kundenbeziehungen weiter und identifizierst neue Umsatzpotenziale.

  • Du übernimmst persönlich Verantwortung für strategische Accounts und relevante Umsatz- und Wachstumsziele.

Sales Strategy & Growth

  • Du entwickelst und setzt unsere Sales- und Wachstumsstrategie um.

  • Du etablierst strukturierte Outbound-Prozesse und entwickelst neue Wege zur systematischen Kundengewinnung.

  • Du identifizierst neue Märkte, Branchen und Geschäftspotenziale für Zenon.

  • Du entwickelst skalierbare Sales-Prozesse, Playbooks und KPIs.

  • Du analysierst unsere Pipeline, Conversion Rates und Umsatzentwicklung und leitest daraus konkrete Maßnahmen ab.Das bringst du mit

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung im anspruchsvollen B2B-Vertrieb mit Enterprise-Kunden, idealerweise in der Personalberatung

  • Nachweisbarer Track-Record im eigenständigen Aufbau und Abschluss komplexer Deals

  • Erfahrung mit strukturierten Sales-Methoden und modernen Outbound-Ansätzen

  • Fähigkeit, kommerzielle Strukturen selbst aufzubauen statt nur bestehende Teams zu verwalten

  • Stark in Executive-Stakeholder-Management, Discovery, Verhandlung und Closing

  • Eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise mit Perspektive auf die Führung einer größeren Sales-Organisation

Das bieten wir

  • Für deinen Arbeitsweg und deine Mobilität stehen dir ein Firmenwagen, ein Fitnessabo sowie Optionen zur beruflichen Bildung und internen Mobilität zur Verfügung.

  • Profitiere von Mentoring, regelmäßigen Teamevents und Firmenfeiern sowie kostenlosen Getränken am Standort Hamburg.

  • Ausstattung wie ein Firmenlaptop und ein Firmenhandy gehören zu deiner täglichen Ausrüstung.

  • 30 Tage Urlaub

Why Zenon?

Wir bauen nicht einfach ein weiteres Recruiting-Unternehmen. Wir entwickeln eine Organisation, die durch Spezialisierung, Qualität und systematische Kundenentwicklung nachhaltig wächst.

Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Lust haben, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, Neues zu lernen und gemeinsam mit uns etwas aufzubauen.

Ready to grow with us? Let's talk.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Das, worauf es ankommt.

Wir stellen uns vor.

Gute Beratung basiert auf weit mehr als Zahlen, Daten und fachlichen Lösungen. Sie lebt von Vertrauen, Verlässlichkeit und der Art, wie Menschen zusammenarbeiten. Genau dieses Verständnis prägt aus unserer Sicht auch ein gutes Arbeitsverhältnis. Uns ist es wichtig, ein Umfeld zu schaffen, in dem man ankommen, sich wohlfühlen und stetig weiterentwickeln kann. Erfolge feiern wir gemeinsam, Herausforderungen meistern wir im Team. Wir sind MRDW, Mescheder Reese Dalkmann Wiebel, eine Kanzlei mit Sitz in Paderborn, 35 engagierten Persönlichkeiten und einem interdisziplinären Beratungsprofil aus Steuerberatung und Wirtschaftsprüfung.

Aufgaben

Ihre Stärken, Ihre Tätigkeiten.

Wirkungsfeld.

Als Wirtschaftsprüfer (m/w/d) haben Sie bei uns die Verantwortung, die Ihrer Position gerecht wird. Sie arbeiten eigenständig und können sich entsprechend Ihres Tätigkeitsfelds und Ihrer fachlichen Schwerpunkte kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln. Darüber hinaus haben Sie die Möglichkeit, sich Schritt für Schritt auch unternehmerisch in die Kanzlei einzubringen.

  • Vollumfängliche Verantwortung für Prüfungsmandate
  • Prüfung von Jahres- und Konzernabschlüssen
  • Durchführung von Due-Diligence-Prüfungen, IKS-Prüfungen und Unternehmensbewertungen
  • Mitwirkung bei innovativen Themen (z. B. bei der Weiterentwicklung digitaler Prozesse)

Qualifikation

Die Einstellung zählt.

Erwartungen.

Sie bringen fachliche Stärke, einen hohen Qualitätsanspruch sowie ein klares Verständnis für langfristige Mandantenbeziehungen mit. Wenn Sie sich außerdem in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfinden, dann passen wir gut zusammen.

  • Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Wirtschaftsprüferexamen und idealerweise bereits mehrjährige Erfahrung in der eigenständigen Betreuung von Prüfungsmandaten
  • Hohes Verantwortungsbewusstsein und eine verlässliche Arbeitsweise
  • Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office
  • Interesse an neuen Themen und digitalen Prozessen

Benefits

Wir bieten gerne mehr.

Arbeitgeberprofil.

Damit Sie Ihre Aufgaben zuverlässig und mit Freude erfüllen können, schaffen wir ein Arbeitsumfeld, das Ihnen sowohl fachlich als auch persönlich Raum gibt. Diese Punkte sind für uns daher selbstverständlich:

  • Menschliche und finanzielle Wertschätzung Ihrer Leistungen
  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten und die Möglichkeit zum Homeoffice
  • Austausch auf Augenhöhe und ein respektvolles Miteinander
  • Spannende, vielfältige Mandate, an denen Sie wachsen können, sowie Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten, die sich an Ihren individuellen Zielen orientieren
  • Ein Arbeitgeber, der sich kontinuierlich hinterfragt und auf die Bedürfnisse des Teams eingeht
  • Zusätzliche Vorteile, die das Leben angenehmer machen (wie bspw. ein verkürzter Freitag)
  • Zahlreiche Maßnahmen im Bereich der Nettolohnoptimierung

Zeit für etwas Neues.

Bewerbungsprozess.

Warum kompliziert, wenn es auch einfach geht? Bewerben Sie sich in wenigen Schritten über unser digitales Bewerbungsformular auf diese Stelle. So können wir mehr voneinander erfahren.

jobs.title: Werkstudent Kommunikationsdesign (gn)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Remmert entwickelt und baut automatisierte Lager- und Intralogistiksysteme für Langgüter, Blech und Werkstücke. Unsere Kunden sind Unternehmen aus der metallverarbeitenden Industrie in ganz Europa. Als familiengeführter Mittelständler mit internationalem Anspruch verbinden wir technische Präzision mit langfristigen Kundenbeziehungen.

Das Projekt:

Unsere Marke ist gewachsen, unsere Produkte und Zielgruppen auch. Jetzt wollen wir das Erscheinungsbild von Remmert gezielt weiterentwickeln. Es geht nicht um einen Neuanfang, sondern darum, das bestehende Corporate Design zu schärfen und zukunftsfähig zu machen. Als Werkstudent Kommunikationsdesign (gn) beschäftigst du dich an unserem Standort in Hüllhorst insbesondere mit diesen drei Ausprägungen:

  • Produkt-Branding: Erarbeitung klarer Gestaltungsregeln unserer Maschinen und Anlagen

  • Corporate Communication: die nach innen und außen gerichtete Unternehmenskommunikation in allen Facetten

Deine Aufgaben

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Unser Partner fertigt hochwertige Massivholzmöbel und pädagogischen Lernumgebungen für Horte, Kindergärten und Krippen. Das Unternehmen zeichnet sich durch eine Fertigung in Europa, kurze Lieferzeiten und eine Garantie von 15 Jahren aus.

Wir suchen Area Sales Manager (m/w/d) mit Wohnsitz in Baden-Württemberg oder Nordrhein-Westfalen.

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Leadgenerierung, Nachverfolgung von E-Mail-Kampagnen und Teilnahme an Messen/Kongressen.

  • Durchführung von Discovery Calls und Präsentationen beim Kunden vor Ort oder im Showroom.

  • Bedarfsanalyse und Dokumentation der Entscheidungsprozesse bei Kunden (Träger, Kommunen, Architekten).

  • Erfahrung in der Betreuung und Akquise von B2B-Kunden, in der Objekteinrichtung, der Möbelindustrie, dem Bildungssektor oder angrenzenden Branchen

  • Empathische Verhandlungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern

  • Teamplayer

  • Ein fürsorglicher, kreativer und kundenorientierter Vertriebsansatz

  • Sorgfältige und genaue Arbeitsweise

  • Wohnsitz im Vertriebsgebiet, Führerschein, Reisebereitschaft und sehr gute Selbstorganisation

  • Gute pCon Kenntnisse sind nice-to-have

  • Sehr gute Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse

jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari engineer senior yang ingin menjaga sistem yang digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen, serta menjadi gerbang terakhir untuk setiap perubahan pada inti sistem.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang komponen yang digunakan oleh seluruh tim produk: inti sistem, database bersama, infrastruktur, keamanan, dan pipeline rilis. Banyak tim kecil membangun dengan bantuan agent AI di atas sistem ini. Tugas Anda memastikan mereka tidak saling berbenturan dan setiap perubahan pada inti sistem melewati Anda dengan aman. Anda tidak terikat pada satu tim produk; Anda melayani semuanya. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Menjaga stabilitas, keamanan, dan performa inti sistem serta database bersama. * Menelaah dan menyetujui setiap perubahan pada inti sistem, termasuk perubahan hasil agent AI. * Menyusun standar teknis dan rulebook tertulis yang digunakan oleh seluruh tim. * Menangani gangguan produksi dan menyusun postmortem secara terbuka. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki pengalaman memegang sistem berskala besar yang tidak boleh berhenti beroperasi, termasuk menangani gangguan pada sistem tersebut. * Mampu menilai hasil agent pada sistem yang saling terhubung dan mengenali perubahan kecil yang dapat merusak modul lain. * Mampu menulis standar dan rulebook yang dibaca serta dipakai orang lain. * Tenang saat menghadapi gangguan dan jujur dalam menyusun postmortem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Mentoring satu per satu sebagai cara utama. Di sini, pengetahuan disebarkan melalui standar tertulis. * Menjadi yang paling cepat menulis kode. Agent yang menulis kode, Anda yang menjaga. * Penguasaan satu *stack* saja. Sistem kami terdiri dari lebih dari satu generasi teknologi. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Cerita sistem:** Ceritakan satu sistem yang pernah Anda jaga dan satu gangguan yang pernah Anda tangani. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus arsitektur:** Selesaikan permasalahan arsitektur nyata dengan bebas menggunakan tools AI. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi perubahan:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah perubahan hasil agent pada modul yang saling bergantung dan menemukan perubahan yang merusak modul lain. * **Wawancara dengan CTO:** Pembahasan mengenai cara Anda menyusun standar dan menjaga sistem. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. jobs.title: Lead Product Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: **POSITION SUMMARY** We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to drive product strategy, development, and growth for AccelByte's gaming technology platform. You'll own product decisions, not just the backlog. We are looking for a hands-on product leader who can actively identify customer problems, shape product direction, drive product discovery, and translate insights into impactful product initiatives. The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise with commercial acumen, particularly in SaaS pricing, monetization, and business model development, to maximize product value and business growth. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS / RESPONSIBILITIES** * Own and drive product strategy, vision, roadmap, and execution, ensuring alignment between customer needs, technical capabilities, and business objectives. * Lead product discovery by identifying customer pain points, validating opportunities, and translating customer insights into product requirements and actionable solutions. * Own product definition, prioritization, and decision-making. * Develop and refine SaaS pricing, packaging, and monetization strategies, including usage-based pricing and other revenue models, to support product adoption and sustainable business growth. * Identify opportunities to improve product value, customer adoption, retention, and revenue performance through data-driven product decisions. * Collaborate closely with Engineering, Design, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to deliver scalable product capabilities and successful product adoption. * Engage with customers and internal stakeholders to understand business needs, validate product direction, and communicate product value effectively. * Define product success metrics, monitor product performance, and use customer feedback and data to continuously improve product outcomes. * Provide product leadership and mentorship to other product team members, fostering strong product thinking, ownership, and execution. **QUALIFICATIONS / EXPERIENCE REQUIRED** * 7+ years of experience in Product Management, with demonstrated ownership of product strategy and successful product development. * Proven experience in B2B SaaS, platform products, or enterprise software, preferably involving developer-facing products, APIs, cloud services, or technical platforms. * Strong experience in SaaS pricing, monetization, packaging, or revenue model development, with demonstrated contribution to pricing strategy and commercial outcomes. * Proven ability to drive product discovery, define product requirements, prioritize initiatives, and translate customer problems into successful product solutions. * Strong business acumen and analytical skills, with the ability to evaluate product opportunities based on customer value, market potential, and business impact. * Experience working closely with Engineering teams on technical products, with the ability to understand technical trade-offs and communicate effectively with technical stakeholders.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Job Description Technical Project Manager Role Overview We are seeking a Technical Project Manager to lead complex, large-scale cloud migration, cloud deployment, application development and modernization programs in regulated-industry environments. The role combines disciplined project and program management with strong technical understanding of cloud platforms, software delivery, DevSecOps, security, governance and operational readiness. The successful candidate will manage initiatives from discovery and planning through solution design, application development, migration, testing, production deployment, cutover, stabilization and operational handover. jobs.title: Full-Stack SMPP Developer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **Full-Stack SMPP Developer** We are seeking a highly skilled and detail-oriented Full-Stack SMPP Developer to join our growing technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and optimizing robust SMS gateway solutions and full-stack web applications. You will bridge the gap between complex telecom protocols and modern web interfaces, ensuring seamless, high-volume, and reliable message routing. **Key Responsibilities** * SMPP Integration & Management: Implement, configure, and maintain SMPP (Short Message Peer-to-Peer) client/server connections (v3.4/v5.0) with various SMS Centers (SMSC) and telecom aggregators. * Full-Stack Development: Design, develop, and deploy scalable front-end and back-end applications that interface with our SMS gateway and core business systems. * System Optimization: Monitor and optimize database queries, API performance, and message queuing systems to handle high-throughput SMS traffic. * Troubleshooting & Support: Diagnose and resolve complex issues related to SMPP session drops, message delivery failures, and application bugs. * Collaboration: Work closely with product managers, QA engineers, and external telecom partners to deliver reliable communication solutions. * Code Quality: Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code while adhering to best practices in software development and version control (Git). **Mandatory Qualifications** * Education: Must be a College Graduate with a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or a closely related field. * SMPP Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of hands-on experience specifically working with the SMPP Protocol (e.g., handling SMSC connections, parsing PDUs, managing SMPP sessions, and troubleshooting delivery receipts). * Full-Stack Experience: Must have 1 to 2 years of professional experience in Full-Stack Development, demonstrating proficiency in both front-end and back-end technologies. **Technical Skills & Competencies** * Backend Technologies: Proficiency in languages commonly used for SMPP and backend services (e.g., Java, Python, Node.js, Go, or PHP). * Frontend Technologies: Experience with modern JavaScript frameworks (e.g., React, Angular, or Vue.js) and standard HTML/CSS. * SMPP Libraries: Familiarity with SMPP libraries such as Cloudhopper (Java), jSMPP, node-smpp, or Python's smpplib is highly advantageous. * Databases: Solid understanding of relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL) and/or NoSQL (MongoDB, Redis) databases. * APIs & Messaging: Strong knowledge of RESTful APIs, WebSockets, and message brokers/queues (e.g., RabbitMQ, Kafka, Redis). * Soft Skills: Strong analytical problem-solving skills, ability to work independently, and excellent communication skills. **Work Setup & Location Details** Hybrid Work Model (A mix of on-site and remote work, specific schedule to be discussed during the interview). On-Site Office: Ruko Citra 7, Jl. Peta Barat No.16 Blok A03, Desa/Kelurahan Kalideres, Kec. Kalideres, Kota Adm. Jakarta Barat, Provinsi DKI Jakarta 11840 **What We Offer** * Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses. * Comprehensive health and wellness benefits (HMO). * Government-mandated benefits * A collaborative and innovative work environment. * Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth in the telecom-tech space. Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * SMPP Protocol: 1 year (Required) * Full-Stack Development: 2 years (Required) Willingness to travel: * 50% (Required) Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Product Builder (Product Manager)
jobs.descriptionHtml: ### **Deskripsi Pekerjaan** **SEVIMA mencari Product Builder yang mampu membangun solusi secara langsung, bukan menulis spesifikasi lalu menunggu. Produk yang Anda bangun akan digunakan oleh jutaan mahasiswa dan dosen di lebih dari 1.200 institusi pendidikan tinggi di Indonesia.** ### **Lingkup Pekerjaan** Anda memegang satu modul dari awal hingga akhir: memahami permasalahan pengguna di kampus, menentukan bentuk fitur, membuat prototype yang dapat diklik dengan bantuan AI, mengujinya ke pengguna, lalu bekerja bersama seorang Product Engineer hingga fitur tersebut benar-benar digunakan. Anda tidak mengelola orang. Anda mengelola hasil. **Onsite - Surabaya** **Tanggung jawab utama:** * Mengumpulkan kebutuhan langsung dari pengguna dan menyusunnya menjadi dokumen kerja yang jelas, termasuk alur, UI/UX, dan *acceptance criteria*. * Membuat prototype yang berfungsi dengan bantuan AI dan melibatkan pengguna sejak tahap awal. * Memeriksa hasil kerja AI dan menentukan bagian yang perlu diperbaiki. * Memantau tingkat pemakaian fitur pascarilis sebagai ukuran keberhasilan. ### **Kualifikasi** * Memiliki rekam jejak membuat sesuatu yang digunakan oleh orang lain dan dapat menunjukkannya. * Mampu mengarahkan AI untuk membuat prototype serta mengenali bagian hasilnya yang keliru. * Mampu memprioritaskan, termasuk menolak fitur yang tidak perlu dibuat. * Bersedia berinteraksi langsung dengan pengguna, tidak hanya melalui laporan. * Memiliki pemahaman teknis yang cukup untuk berdiskusi dengan Product Engineer mengenai dampak sebuah fitur terhadap data dan sistem. ### **Yang Tidak Menjadi Syarat** * Sertifikasi Scrum atau pengalaman mengelola tim besar. * Kemampuan coding dari nol. * Jumlah tahun pengalaman. Kami menilai apa yang telah Anda bangun. ### **Tahapan Seleksi** * **Portofolio karya:** Lampirkan satu karya yang Anda buat dengan bantuan AI dan telah digunakan oleh pengguna, dalam bentuk tautan atau tangkapan layar. Seleksi awal tidak didasarkan pada CV. * **Studi kasus satu hari:** Ubah permasalahan nyata dari institusi pendidikan menjadi prototype yang dapat diklik. Sertakan catatan tentang instruksi yang diberikan kepada AI, hal yang diperiksa, dan hal yang ditolak. * **Sesi evaluasi hasil AI:** Selama 60 menit, Anda menelaah hasil AI yang memuat sejumlah kesalahan dan menjelaskan temuan Anda. * **Wawancara pengguna dan keputusan produk:** Pembahasan mengenai pengalaman Anda dengan pengguna nyata dan cara Anda mengambil keputusan. ### **Komitmen Kami** * Boleh gagal, wajib belajar dari kegagalan * 4 jam belajar tiap minggu, di jam kerja * Tools AI terbaik, bukan versi gratis * Cara kerjamu bisa jadi standar perusahaan * Dinilai dari hasil, bukan jam duduk ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Builder yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu mengarahkan agent, memeriksa hasilnya secara menyeluruh, dan bertanggung jawab atas aspek teknis produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. **Benefit Tambahan:** Mentoring langsung dari senior engineer berpengalaman. Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Catatan Penting** Di SEVIMA, penggunaan AI merupakan syarat kerja. Seluruh tahapan tes memperbolehkan penggunaan AI. Penilaian kami berfokus pada instruksi yang Anda berikan, hasil yang Anda periksa, dan keputusan yang Anda tolak. Fulltime Surabaya, Jawa Timur

jobs.title: Process Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml: **About AkzoNobel** Since 1792, we’ve been supplying the innovative paints and coatings that help to color people’s lives and protect what matters most. Our world class portfolio of brands – including Dulux, International, Sikkens and Interpon – is trusted by customers around the globe. We’re active in more than 150 countries and use our expertise to sustain and enhance the fabric of everyday life. Because we believe every surface is an opportunity. It’s what you’d expect from a pioneering and long-established paints company that’s dedicated to providing sustainable solutions and preserving the best of what we have today – while creating an even better tomorrow. Let’s paint the future together. For more information please visit www.akzonobel.com © 2026 Akzo Nobel N.V. All rights reserved. **Job Purpose** --------------- Drive process optimization and continuous improvement in coatings manufacturing to enhance product quality, operational efficiency, process reliability, and cost effectiveness through process engineering, Overall Equipment Effectiveness (OEE), Kaizen, troubleshooting, scale-up, and compliance with established standards, while ensuring Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE) requirements **Key Accountabilities** ------------------------ Develop and optimize coatings manufacturing processes, including pre-kitting of raw material, mixing, dispersion, grinding, let-down, and filling. Support process trials, commissioning, scale-up, and qualification of new products and equipment Monitor production performance, analyze process parameters, yields, cycle times, losses, and deviations, and identify improvement opportunities using production data and root cause analysis (RCA). Conduct production trials, evaluate process and equipment performance, validate process changes, and collaborate with Production, QC, Engineering, and RDI team on equipment upgrades and process modifications Establish standard operating procedures (SOP) practices including Work Instruction (WI), Standard Working Sheet (SWS), and One Point Lesson (OPL), optimize operating parameters, production sequences, and implement continuous improvement initiatives to improve throughput, quality, and resource utilization **Key Activities** ------------------ Evaluate alternative process parameters, production sequences, equipment capacities, and process scenarios to identify potential bottlenecks and optimize manufacturing performance. Improved process planning, reduced trial-and-error activities, and better-informed technical and operational decisions. Manage cost and time constraints. Evaluate process costs, cycle times, material losses, energy consumption, and resource requirements. Prioritize improvement projects based on business impact and implementation feasibility. Reduced manufacturing costs, improved cycle times, optimized resource utilization, and delivery of improvement projects within agreed timelines. Perform risk assessments. Identify and assess process, equipment, quality, and HSE risks associated with routine operations, process changes, new products, and equipment modifications. Define and follow up on appropriate mitigation actions. Reduced operational and process risks, improved process safety, and compliance with applicable HSE and quality standards. Provide process documentation and operating instructions. Develop and maintain process specifications, working instructions or operating procedures, process flow diagrams, parameter standards, troubleshooting guides, and change-control documentation. Train relevant personnel on revised processes and standards. Accurate and controlled process documentation, consistent operating practices, effective knowledge transfer, and sustained compliance with manufacturing standards. Apply HSE principles and implement workplace improvement projects. Implement Life-Saving Rules (LSR) and Golden Principles in daily operations, ensure proper use and maintenance of provided personal protective equipment (PPE)...

jobs.descriptionHtml: Requisition Number: 65469 Job Location: Jakarta, IDN Global Grade: Band 9 Work Type: Office Working Employment Type: Permanent Posting Start Date: 05/11/2026 Posting End Date: 26/11/2026 : **Job Summary** --------------- We are looking for a driven and customer-focused Business Acquisition Manager to grow our Priority Banking business by acquiring New-to-Bank (NTB) clients. In this role, you will focus on identifying and engaging prospective clients, developing new business opportunities, and converting qualified prospects into Priority Banking customers. You will work closely with Relationship Managers and other internal teams to build a strong acquisition pipeline while ensuring a high standard of customer experience, regulatory compliance, and responsible sales practices **The Role Responsibilities** ----------------------------- * Proactively source and acquire **New-to-Bank (NTB) Priority Banking customers** through a needs-based sales approach. * Deliver acquisition and sales targets by building a strong pipeline through prospecting, lead follow-up, telemarketing, referrals, and other business development activities. * Identify clients with strong **AUM potential** and facilitate their transition to the appropriate Priority Banking Relationship Manager channel. * Participate in client acquisition activities, including market outlook seminars, lifestyle events, client gatherings, and other promotional initiatives. * Build strong relationships with prospective clients, understand their financial needs, and identify opportunities to upgrade eligible existing customers to Priority Banking. * Maintain accurate sales activity reporting and collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders across Priority Banking, Wealth Management, Branch Operations, Marketing, and Compliance. * Ensure all acquisition and sales activities comply with **KYC, CDD, AML/TF, TCF, sanctions, regulatory requirements, and the Bank’s responsible sales standards** , including timely escalation of suspicious activities or conduct concerns. **Our Ideal Candidate** ----------------------- * At least 1 year experience in financial service industry (or sales and service in related industry) with demonstrated success in sales/service and acquisition * Strong interest and experience in sales, business development, customer acquisition, or relationship management, preferably within banking or financial services. * Proven ability to prospect for new clients, build relationships, and work towards challenging acquisition and sales targets. * Good understanding of retail banking and/or wealth management products, particularly products relevant to Priority Banking customers. * Strong communication, networking, jobs.descriptionHtml: ***User Research Lead - Data Lab Indonesia*** ***This is a hybrid position which requires 8 days per month in the office. You will be based in our office in WRI Indonesia, Jakarta. Existing work authorization is required at the time of application submission as WRI is unable to sponsor any visa work sponsorship for this position.*** **Program Overview** WRI Indonesia is an independent research organization that turns big ideas into action at the nexus of environment, economic opportunity, and human well-being. At WRI Indonesia, we aim to bring innovations in research and business approaches in order to create the enabling conditions for Indonesia to achieve robust economic growth while respecting environmental and social values. We seek to contribute to the accomplishment of ambitious sustainable development goals through working with leaders in public and private sectors, as well as collaborating with civil society organizations, in turning big ideas into action. Within our Food-Land-Water (FLW) Program, we envision critical ecosystems such as forests and peatland across Indonesia to be governed fairly and sustainably. We believe sustainable land use management is key for Indonesia to meet its climate goal, in line with keeping the global climate target below the 1.5 degree Celcius warming threshold, while providing sustainable livelihoods to forest-dependent communities and conserve biodiversity in the landscape. We intend to achieve this through safeguarding the remaining forest and peatland from deforestation, degradation, and fragmentation; maintaining forests and peatland quality through sound stewardship; and restoring degraded ecosystem to improve its productivity, conservation value, and ecosystem services. To achieve Indonesia’s climate goal while at the same time improving the livelihood of the communities and protecting biodiversity, we work together with partners to mainstream nature-based solutions (NbS) as an approach to address global climate challenge. We aim to achieve this through research, policy advocacy, and creation of a community of practice to develop new financing model for forest conservation, advocate regulatory framework that are conducive for NbS approach, and development of multi-stakeholder platform to amplify and accelerate NbS approach in Indonesia and Southeast Asia region. ***Data Lab Indonesia*** The Data Lab Unit aims to establish a leading hub for open-source data, code, and visualizations, fostering data democratization and collaboration among NGOs and development partners. By addressing critical challenges such as unsustainable data platform management strategies, technical inconsistencies, and high employee turnover, the unit will ensure the long-term sustainability and impact of WRI Indonesia's platforms. This initiative transforms grant-dependent outputs into powerful tools for driving positive change in climate resilience, social equity, and nature conservation across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Aligning with WRI's strategy, the Data Lab Unit promotes systemic, data-driven solutions, transitioning WRI's approach from isolated project delivery to broader systems change while enhancing institutional capabilities and addressing financial sustainability gaps to create scalable, impactful initiatives. **Job Highlight** The User Research Lead will support the Data Lab team in integrating design thinking with strategic objectives to advance Data Lab mission. Reporting to the Product and Engineering Manager, The User Research Lead will work closely with a dedicated team, including a Product Specialist, UI/UX Designer, and Visualization Designer. These collaborators will provide essential support, fostering a culture of teamwork and innovation. Based in Jakarta and tailored for teleworking, offering flexibility while requiring occasional travel to project sites or partner locations. The User Research Lead will be instrumental in creating user-centered tools and platforms that reflect WR...

We look for creative leaders who embody **honesty** in brand messaging and research, **empathy** for the audience’s journey and pain points, and the **agility** to adapt copy across dynamic multi-channel campaigns. engagement while maintaining consistency and quality standards. **What you’ll do (Responsibilities):** * Produce persuasive written materials for digital, print, and social media campaigns to enhance engagement from the target market, driven by **empathy** for audience preferences and needs. * Collect and obtain relevant information on market trends, target audiences, and competitors to support content development with high **honesty** and accuracy. * Lead ideation and development of creative concepts across campaigns (digital, print, video, and experiential) with the **agility** to adapt to fast-evolving trends while ensuring alignment with communication objectives, target market, and brand guidelines. * Proactively propose creative ideas and campaign directions to strengthen brand differentiation, demonstrating creative confidence and **agility**. * Collaborate with designers and other marketing teams on large- and small-scale marketing projects (e.g. email campaigns, programs, landing pages, etc.) in an atmosphere of mutual **empathy** and open teamwork. * Review, edit, and proofread content to ensure accuracy, clarity, grammatical correctness, and consistency in brand Lingkungan kerja kolaboratif & suportif. Program continuous learning & tech sharing. Competitive salary & benefits. Work-life balance dan budaya #BuildForImpact. ### **Program Onboarding** Setiap Product Engineer – Quality yang bergabung menjalani program onboarding intensif selama **4 bulan**. Program ini memastikan Anda mampu membangun pengujian otomatis, memeriksa hasil agent, dan menjaga kualitas produk secara mandiri. Program terdiri dari **tiga fase**. Setiap fase diakhiri dengan evaluasi, dan hanya peserta yang memenuhi standar yang dapat melanjutkan ke fase berikutnya. Tingkat kelulusan program ini sekitar **60%**. Pengembangan tidak berhenti setelah onboarding. Di SEVIMA, setiap karyawan dituntut untuk terus berkembang, dan standar kerja akan terus meningkat seiring waktu. ### **Catatan Penting** Posisi QA manual tidak kami buka. jobs.title: HR Generalist (m/w/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Für ein international aufgestelltes Unternehmen suchen wir eine offene und serviceorientierte Persönlichkeit, die als HR Generalist den Kontakt zu Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften aktiv gestaltet. Besonders wichtig ist, dass Du gerade zu Beginn regelmäßig vor Ort bist und eine gute Beziehung zu den Mitarbeitenden im Operations-Team aufbaust. Dafür sind vier Präsenztage pro Woche vorgesehen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei personalbezogenen Fragen.

  • Du übernimmst administrative HR-Aufgaben und unterstützt die vorbereitende Entgeltabrechnung in Abstimmung mit einem externen Payroll-Dienstleister.

  • Du koordinierst Dich bei HR-Prozessen und administrativen Aufgaben eng mit dem People-Operations-Team in den USA.

  • Du organisierst und führst den Orientation Day für neue Mitarbeitende durch.

  • Du kommunizierst mit Mitarbeitenden, Führungskräften, dem Admin-Team in den USA sowie deutschen Behörden, insbesondere Krankenkassen und Jobcentern.

  • Du wirkst bei Kündigungsgesprächen mit und erhältst dabei Anleitung durch eine erfahrene HR-Fachkraft.

  • Du erkennst, wann ein Thema an die zuständige Senior-HR-Fachkraft eskaliert werden sollte, und stimmst Dich dazu ab.

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast etwa drei bis sechs Jahre Berufserfahrung im HR-Bereich, idealerweise als HR Generalist.

  • Du kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch.

  • Du arbeitest serviceorientiert, organisiert und zuverlässig und hast Freude an administrativen HR-Aufgaben.

  • Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu und baust vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften auf.

  • Du arbeitest gern im internationalen Umfeld und stimmst Dich verbindlich mit Ansprechpartnern in den USA ab.

  • Du bist bereit, insbesondere in der Anfangszeit, regelmäßig vor Ort in Frankfurt am Main zu arbeiten; vier Präsenztage pro Woche sind vorgesehen.

Weitere Informationen

Bei Fragen steht Dir Sandra Heinrich unter der Rufnummer +49 179 3224223 gern zur Verfügung.

jobs.title: Werkstudentenstelle im Bereich Entwicklung – auch Praktikum oder Abschlussarbeit möglich
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Entwicklung ist dein Ding? Dann komm’ zu uns nach Düsseldorf!

Wir bei TWK entwickeln und produzieren im Wachstumsmarkt der Mess- und Automatisierungstechnik kundenspezifische Sensoren für den Anlagen- und Maschinenbau. Unsere stetig wachsende Sensorik-Palette bildet die Grundlage für technologische Innovationen bei unseren Kunden.

Mit über 60 Jahren Erfahrung in Entwicklung, Fertigung und Vertrieb treiben wir neue technologische Ansätze aktiv voran. Unsere Kunden verlassen sich auf qualitativ hochwertige und vor allem sichere Sensorik für unterschiedlichste Anforderungen.

Funktionale Sicherheit für Mensch und Maschine ist unser Anspruch – und zugleich unser Versprechen als langjähriger Hersteller von Qualitätssensorik. Möglich machen das über 150 engagierte Kolleg*innen, die mit Know-how und Teamgeist modernste Technologien und höchste Qualitätsstandards realisieren.

Werde Teil unseres Teams in der Sensorik-Entwicklung – einfach initiativ bewerben! Ob Praktikum, Werkstudententätigkeit oder für die Bachelor-/Masterarbeit: Wir freuen uns auf dich in Düsseldorf.

Aufgaben

Bei TWK gestaltest du Sensorik aktiv mit: praxisnah, hands-on und mit verlässlicher Betreuung.

Was wir bieten:

  • Betreuung: Engmaschige, fachliche Begleitung deiner Projekte
  • Labore & Ausstattung: EMV- und Elektroniklabor, präzise Messmittel, Prüfstände, Prototyping
  • Know-how: Moderne Sensortechnologien, hochpräzise Sensorik, Signalaufbereitung
  • Programmierung: Embedded C/C++, ARM/STM32, Feldbus/Industrial Ethernet
  • Impact: Deine Ergebnisse fließen in reale Produkte ein

Qualifikation

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer (Y Combinator Startup)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are CoCrafter (YC W24), a fast-growing Munich-based startup on a mission to fundamentally transform core processes in the construction industry.

The construction industry is the backbone of the German and European economy – yet it has largely been overlooked by digitalization. The result? Inefficient processes and significant untapped potential.

At CoCrafter, we are building the Operating System (OS) for subcontractor management and already serve numerous medium-sized construction companies and trade businesses across Germany.

We have raised €1.8 million from Y Combinator, 10x Founders, and other top-tier investors – and are ready to take the next big step in our growth journey.

Join our team and help us shape the future of the construction industry! 🚀

The Role

We are a small, high-performing engineering team that is growing rapidly. As a Senior Software Engineer (m/f/d), you will ensure that our system architecture and engineering processes scale alongside the business – from our early-stage startup setup to enterprise-level requirements.

At the same time, you will remain hands-on: You will actively contribute to feature development wherever needed and lead by example. You will work closely with our CTO and have real ownership and influence over our technical direction.

Responsibilities

  • Evolve our system architecture and optimize performance to handle 10x growth in load and meet enterprise requirements

  • Build and improve CI/CD pipelines, automated deployments, and a testing strategy that enables the team to ship quickly and reliably

  • Stay hands-on and develop features wherever the team needs support

  • Define technical standards for observability, security, and code quality

  • Help the team grow through code reviews, pair programming, Architecture Decision Records (ADRs), and mentoring

  • Prepare and document technical decisions, clearly outlining trade-offs and implications

Qualification

  • A degree in Computer Science or a related field

  • Experience guiding a product or system through a significant growth phase

  • You are a strong Senior Engineer who enjoys building features hands-on and delivering pragmatic solutions

  • Several years of backend engineering experience, ideally with TypeScript/Node.js (our stack: NestJS, PostgreSQL, Next.js, Docker, AWS)

  • Strong knowledge of databases, performance optimization, cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, and observability

  • You think in terms of trade-offs and take ownership beyond the scope of your individual tickets

  • Excellent German or English skills. German is a plus

Benefits

  • An outstanding network of founders, investors, and mentors to support your personal and professional growth

  • Competitive compensation, including equity (ESOP) – share in our success

  • 28 days of paid vacation per year to recharge

  • WellPass to help you stay active or unwind outside the office

  • Team events including bowling, mini golf, offsites, and regular feedback sessions

  • A beautiful office in the heart of Munich (Maxvorstadt)

Why You Should Join CoCrafter

  • Impact: In less than a year, we have built a product that has become essential to our customers. With your work, you will help redefine an entire industry

jobs.descriptionHtml:
Das Unternehmen

Die PETEC Verbindungstechnik GmbH ist ein mittelständisches, modernes Unternehmen mit Sitz im oberfränkischen Schlüsselfeld, das sich auf die Entwicklung und den Vertrieb chemisch-technischer Produkte spezialisiert hat. Mit über 30 Jahren Erfahrung bieten wir ein umfassendes Sortiment an Hochleistungs-Klebstoffen, Dichtmassen und Wartungsprodukten für professionelle Anwender in der Kfz-Branche, aber auch für Industrie, Handwerk und Haushalt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt in Voll- oder Teilzeit am Standort 96132 Schlüsselfeld/Wüstenbuch:

Mitarbeiter Marketing & Social Media (m/w/d)

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Bearbeitung von administrativen Aufgaben im Marketing, z.B. Beantworten von Händler-Anfragen und Aufbereiten von Präsentationsunterlagen

  • Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Beiträgen für Online und Print

  • Unterstützung bei Foto- und Videoproduktionen

  • Textsicherheit in Wort und Schrift

  • Interesse an digitalen Medien und Bereitschaft, sich in neue Tools einzuarbeiten

  • Erste Erfahrungen mit Tools wie WordPress oder Canva wünschenswert

  • Strukturierte Arbeitsweise und Auge fürs Detail

Was wir bieten:

  • eine abwechslungsreiche und kreative Tätigkeit in einem stetig wachsenden Unternehmen

  • angenehme Atmosphäre mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen

  • Faire Vergütung, Betriebsrente und attraktive Benefits

Anstellung bei BONAGO innerhalb der ValueNet Group

Unsere Mission

Wir als Belohnungsexperten arbeiten jeden Tag daran, erfolgreiche Innovationen für die Belohnung von Kunden und Mitarbeitern hervorzubringen. In Zusammenarbeit mit Marketing, Vertrieb, Service und Produktmanagement hören wir unseren Kunden gut zu, um ihnen die besten zielerfüllenden Lösungen bieten zu können.

Unser Herz schlägt für professionelle Motivationslösungen und jeder bei BONAGO – vom Gründer bis zum Praktikanten – ist mit Leidenschaft dabei. Sei doch auch ein Teil davon!

Du nimmst Briefings auf, schätzt Aufwände realistisch ein, priorisierst kurzfristige Anfragen eigenverantwortlich und pflegst Corporate-Design-Vorlagen und KI-Workflows weiter

Das bringst Du mit

  • Du hast eine Ausbildung oder ein Studium in Mediengestaltung oder Design oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Berufserfahrung in Agentur oder Inhouse-Marketing bilden dein Fundament, belegt durch ein Portfolio aus Print- und Digitalarbeiten

  • Generative KI gehört zu deinem Arbeitsalltag: Adobe Firefly in Photoshop und Illustrator sowie mindestens zwei externer Bildgeneratoren (z. B. Midjourney, Freepik AI). Präzise Prompts formulierst du ebenso sicher wie die Nachbearbeitung, sodass Ergebnisse in Qualität, Druckfähigkeit und Markenstil passen

jobs.title: Investment Analyst @ Direct Investments Team
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About b2venture

b2venture is one of Europe’s most experienced venture capital firms. Through our Direct Investments team, we invest alongside selected members of our community of entrepreneurs, executives and business angels in promising technology companies across stages.

We are looking for an Investment Analyst to support our team across investment analysis, investor engagement and transaction execution.

  • Team: b2venture Direct Investments Team

  • Start date: as soon as possible

  • Workplace: Berlin or Munich

Your role

  • Source and screen new investment opportunities

  • Research markets, technologies and business models

  • Prepare company analyses and investment materials and support due diligence

  • Build relationships with the members of b2venture’s angel investor community, understand their investment preferences, and communicate potential investment opportunities

  • Prepare investor conversations and maintain reliable company and investor data

  • Identify suitable matches between investment opportunities and our investor community

  • Support investor outreach and track interest, questions and commitments

  • Support syndication, closing and portfolio monitoring

  • Represent b2venture at selected founder, investor and technology events

You will initially own clearly defined workstreams and gradually take on broader responsibilities as your capabilities develop.

Your profile

  • Excellent academic track record

  • Initial relevant experience through internships or up to two years of professional experience

  • Strong analytical skills and genuine curiosity for technology and entrepreneurship

  • Independent thinking, attention to detail and a willingness to learn

  • Strong communication skills and enjoyment of working with founders and investors

  • Fluency in English and German

Experience with financial modelling, data analysis, coding, automation or AI tools is helpful but not required.

We do not expect you to have led transactions or built an extensive investor network. We are looking for initiative, sound judgement and the potential to grow.

What we offer

  • Hands-on exposure to investments, investor engagement and portfolio companies

  • Close collaboration with experienced investors, founders and business angels

  • An entrepreneurial environment with direct feedback and room to develop

  • A competitive salary and additional benefits

Please send us your CV via JOIN. Selected candidates will meet members of our Direct Investments team and complete a case study.

b2venture is committed to equal opportunities and welcomes different backgrounds and perspectives.

jobs.title: Commercial Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Zip

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.

Your Role

  • You’re a closer, trusted advisor, product consultant – you’re working with prospects day-in-day-out to deliver immense ROI in an efficient, value-based sales cycle

  • You’re a hunter – you’ll get a healthy supply of BDR leads and marketing opportunities, but you’ll prospect and tap into your network to knock down doors and blockers

  • You’re a product evangelist – you’ll solution Zip to meet the pain points today, but also with an eye toward our product of the future

  • You’re a builder – at a startup, you’re not just a team member, but you help build the team culture and bring your best practice to the org

You Will

  • Become a product expert – learning the Zip platform through and through, so that you’re demo ready

  • Become a procurement expert – learning the ins and outs of the procurement market, which is deeply ready for change and new solutions

  • Use cutting-edge sales intelligence and engagement solutions to prospect, manage deal cycles, and ultimately bring on new customers

  • Be adaptable and flexible – as part of an early-stage hyper growth company, we are rapidly growing out our process but we want to you to help shape our sales process

Qualifications

  • 2+ years of closing experience in technology SaaS sales

  • Self driven – you don’t need someone to motivate you to put in your best every day

  • You’d describe yourself as organized, efficient with your time, and excellent communicator

  • Experience using tools like Salesforce, Zoominfo, LinkedIn SalesNav, and Outreach

  • Willing to go the extra mile to make sure our customers, company, team, and yourself succeed

  • a Bachelor’s degree is required (specifically in Finance, Technology, or a related field or experiential equivalent)

Nice to Haves

  • Experience selling to procurement, finance, IT, legal 

Perks & Benefits

At Zip, we’re committed to providing our employees with everything they need to do their best work.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Hardware Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Our software decides every 15 minutes what a battery should do. You own the layer that makes it happen: our EMS, the interface between our optimizer and every battery we connect. Whether we build our own EMS or integrate existing ones is a call you'll help us make.

  • Own our EMS integration layer: one clean interface that connects any storage system (inverter, BMS, site controller) to our optimizer

  • Onboard new vendors over Modbus, MQTT and vendor APIs, so the next battery is a config, not a project

  • Commission systems on site until the battery follows the plan to the kW

  • Build our own edge box on standard hardware (think Raspberry Pi on a DIN rail)

You Will Have Fun If You Are

Builder with agency

  • Get-shit-done mentality: you'd rather drive to the site than wait for a support ticket

  • Solid Python and embedded Linux (networking, VPN, remote updates)

  • Industrial protocols: Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, REST

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
We are a growing SaaS start-up with an international team, operating on the intersection between two of the world's most fascinating industries - global shipping and global travel.

Over 90% of global trade depends on ships, and the shipping industry depends on the 2 million seafarers who operate them. What most people don't know is there's a complex, mission-critical travel operation going on 24/7 to bring seafarers to the ships where they're needed, when they're needed. That's called crew logistics, and without it, global trade wouldn't function.

But it's an operation often built on manual processes and legacy systems, meaning high-stress for operators, an unreliable experience for seafarers, and poor outcomes for the industry. That is until Tilla enters the scene.

Backed by strong investor support, with more than 10,000 crew changes executed in the platform each year across over 600 vessels globally, our platform is a game changer in crew logistics, streamlining collaboration between operators and seafarers, making crew operations more humane, efficient, and cost-effective.

Join us on the next chapter of our growth journey and tackle this overlooked yet critical global challenge: every crew change, optimized and digital.

Your mission

Build and maintain the Travel services that get seafarers onto the right flights, shipping well-tested features across our TypeScript stack as part of the Travel team. You'll start by taking pressure off the team by solving bugs, serving customer requests and leading investigations, and progress into owning Travel services of your own.

✈️ Keeping travel operations dependable / by resolving bugs and customer requests quickly and properly

  • Investigating and fixing bugs across the Travel services, reproducing each scenario before changing any code

  • Handling day-to-day technical requests from customers and colleagues, and explaining what went wrong in plain terms

  • Adding logging and metrics to what you build, and following runbooks when alerts fire

🧭 Unlocking the product roadmap / by shipping well-defined features end to end

  • Building features across the frontend (React, Next.js) and backend (NestJS, GraphQL, Prisma) in Linear sprints

  • Breaking work into clear steps, surfacing assumptions early, getting feedback on technical decisions and keeping progress and blockers visible

  • Writing unit and integration tests, and acting on code review feedback

📈 Building depth in a sensitive domain / by growing into ownership of Travel services

  • Learning how flight bookings, fares and travel aggregation work, and how they connect to crew changes

  • Taking ownership of a Travel service module over time, including its uptime, bug rates and resolution times

  • Sharing what you learn through clear pull request descriptions and team documentation


You should have

  • Experience: early-career professional experience as a software engineer, building web applications across both frontend and backend.

  • Experience: working knowledge of TypeScript and React, ...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

About The Role

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst, Lifecycle to own measurement and experimentation for how new customers activate and existing ones stay.The metrics are yours whatever the lever: CRM campaigns, promos and incentives, onboarding changes in the product, and a next best action layer that decides what each customer should see next. You decide what we test, how we test it and what we do with the answer. You also bring your own hypotheses on where the next win is.

 


What You'll Do

What you'll do

Join activation and retention initiatives before anything is built, whether they come from CRM, growth or product. Define the primary metric, check against historical data whether the effect is detectable at our volumes, and turn solution-shaped requests into problem-shaped ones.

Design and analyse experiments end to end: hypothesis, guardrails, audience split, MDE and power, stopping rule, and a readout that ends in ship, iterate or kill. 

Correct for channel and engagement bias (not everyone opens email, and open and click populations are self-selected). When a clean A/B is impossible, use causal inference: diff-in-diff, matching, synthetic control or geo designs.

Bring hypotheses of your own. Launch a few new experiments across onboarding and the customer lifecycle, and turn one-off wins into recurring segmented flows.

Build deliberately simple models: segmentation, propensity, churn and dormancy scoring. They feed audiences, personalisation and incentive targeting. Over time these come together into next best action: for a given customer, which offer, feature nudge or message to send next, through which channel, and whether to send anything at all. You own the logic and the measurement of whether it beats the current rules.

jobs.title: SEM Technician (f/m/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Your Role

As an SEM Technician (f/m/d), you will support tools and process qualifications and help investigate issues arising across our semiconductor process flow. Working closely with our Failure Analysis Engineer, Process Integration team and other engineering functions, you will perform Scanning Electron Microscopy (SEM) analysis and complementary characterization using techniques such as Energy-Dispersive X-ray Spectroscopy (EDX) and Focused Ion Beam (FIB).

Ideally you come with a first-hand experience working with SEM. You will initially work alongside our SEM experts to deepen your knowledge learn the tool’s operating principles, procedures and inspection requirements for our specific use cases. Through hands-on training and continuous knowledge transfer, you will build your skills in sample handling, imaging, measurement and troubleshooting; before gradually becoming an independent SEM user and taking greater ownership of the tool and the processes.

As the function develops, there may also be opportunities to operate additional defect-inspection tools and support defect analysis and yield improvement within our 300 mm manufacturing facility.

What You’ll Do

  • Prepare, handle and inspect a wide range of semiconductor samples according to defined analysis requirements

  • Perform accurate and reliable SEM analysis to support tool qualification, process qualification and root-cause investigations

  • Use complementary characterization techniques, including EDX and FIB, where required

  • Work closely with Failure Analysis, Process Integration and engineering teams to understand inspection requirements and communicate results effectively across functions

  • Maintain accurate records of incoming sample lots, expected outcomes, reporting deadlines and priorities

  • Perform daily, weekly and monthly tool-health checks, calibration and routine performance monitoring

  • Previous hands-on experience operating SEM systems

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Working Student (m/f/d)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Yepoda

Clean K-Beauty Innovation. No compromises.

Our mission is to bring Clean K-Beauty Innovations, from Korea straight to Europe, UK, and the US – without ever compromising on our values, quality, and sustainability. Our clean, mindfully produced skincare products are made with love in Korea, vegan, cruelty-free, and packed with the best natural and active ingredients.

Founded in 2020 by Sander Joonyoung van Bladel and Veronika Strotmann, Yepoda is a fast-growing beauty start-up based in the heart of Berlin. Our products are available across Europe and the US, since March 2025, in Sephora Europe & since August 2026 in Sephora US – online and in over 1200 stores. As a certified B Corp™, we are committed to building a business with purpose. With a team of over 120 brilliant individuals from around the world, we are actively shaping Yepoda’s story every day.

We are looking for Working Students to join our Performance Marketing team and get real, hands-on experience running paid campaigns across channels like Google, Meta, TikTok, and Youtube. You will support the team in setting up, monitoring, and optimising campaigns, work with live data and budgets from day one, and build practical skills in one of the most in-demand areas of e-commerce marketing.

Your tasks

  • Campaign Support: Assist in the setup, monitoring, and optimisation of marketing campaigns across our paid channels (Google, YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok)

  • KPI Analysis & Reporting: Support the ongoing analysis of campaign KPIs, prepare regular performance reports, and help the team adjust budgets for optimal performance

  • Creative Testing: Collaborate with our Graphic Design team to test and refine ad creatives, formats, and messaging, and keep track of which variations perform best

  • Ideas & Concepts: Contribute creative ideas and new concepts to improve campaign effectiveness, from fresh ad angles to social media trends worth testing

Your profile

  • You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Marketing, Media Management, Business, Economics, or a related field

  • You have a strong interest in performance or online marketing, whether that shows up through your coursework, a previous internship or working student role, or your own projects

  • You have strong analytical skills, great attention to detail, and enjoy turning campaign data into insights

  • You communicate clearly and in a structured way, and bring a hands-on attitude and a high level of initiative

  • You have a passion for beauty topics and a keen interest in social media trends (Instagram, TikTok, YouTube)

  • You are confident with Excel or Google Sheets; first experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, or TikTok Ads Manager is a bonus, and we're happy to bring the right person up to speed

What We Offer

  • Dynamic Environment: The opportunity to work in a start-up environment surrounded by a passionate and dedicated team.

jobs.title: Customer Success Team Lead (German-speaking)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Remote within EU time zones · Fluent German and English required

At Secfix, we're at the forefront of automating security compliance in Europe. We help companies get and stay ISO 27001, GDPR, TISAX, and SOC 2 fast and easy and reduce hundreds of hours of manual work.

Secfix is run by a 100% remote team with the exception of our DACH sales team, which is based in Munich. We're a high-performing team looking for passionate, execution-focused, owners to help us automate security and compliance for modern companies and become the European compliance automation leader.

We've raised our $12M Series A and are backed by top VCs, including Alstin Capital, Neosfer (Commerzbank), and Bayern Capital.

This is where careers are made!

About the Role

Our CSM team has grown to five Customer Success Managers, each running a book of customers through ISO 27001, SOC 2, TISAX, NIS 2 and DORA. As the team keeps growing, we're creating a dedicated Team Lead role: a manager who works alongside the CSMs every day and makes their coaching and development a priority!

What You'll Do

Lead the CSM team

  • Line-manage the CSMs: regular 1:1s, structured feedback, input to performance reviews and individual development plans

  • Own onboarding for new CSMs so they're productive on their first accounts fast

  • Allocate books and manage capacity across the team as customers and CSMs are added

  • Run a team health review covering at risk accounts, renewals and onboarding blockers

  • Own customer escalations within the CSM books

  • Own the CSM playbook and keep it current

  • Decide which CSM workflows to automate, and build the agents and automations with AI

Drive the team's upsell performance

  • Coach CSMs on spotting and running framework and service upsells within their books

  • Keep the team's upsell pipeline clean and be accountable for the team's upsell number

Run your own portfolio

  • Manage customers end to end: implementation, audit readiness, ongoing compliance, and upsell within those accounts

  • Stay close enough to the day-to-day work that your coaching is grounded in it

About You

This is a player-coach role where you'll be 60-70% hands-on operating with your own book of business, and 30-40% conducting management tasks. You'll be the line manager for all CSMs and run 1:1s, feedback loops, onboarding, and provide inputs to performance reviews and career development, while keeping a reduced portfolio of your own customers (because we don't think you can coach CSMs well on work you don't do).

  • You've managed or formally coached CSMs before for at least 1 year and want to keep doing it; this isn't a first step into management

  • 4+ years as a Customer Success Manager in B2B SaaS, ideally with mid-market or DACH Mittelstand customers

  • Fluent German and English as our CSM team works with customers in both

jobs.descriptionHtml:

When and where?: 📅 Thursday 19 November · 📍 Munich (office near Maxvorstadt)

Most companies make you wait weeks and sit through a gazillion interview rounds. We’d rather meet you in person, see you in action, and tell you on the day.

Secfix helps European companies get and stay security compliant. We’re a Series A startup growing fast, with hundreds customers across Europe. Our sales team is at the centre of that growth, and we’re hiring BDRs to join it.

🔥 Why this is a big opportunity

  • 📈 Real career growth: a clear path to Account Executive, with best-in-class training and coaching to get you there.

Places are limited. Apply now to book your spot. We’ll have a short call with you first to check it’s a good fit for both sides.

🌍 About Hopae

At Hopae, we're building the world's most trusted digital identity platform — private, secure, and built for real life. We believe identity should be in your control — not locked behind outdated systems or centralized gatekeepers.

Our product, Hopae Connect, lets businesses verify real people across borders through a single API — no need to build country-by-country integrations themselves. Our technology powers instant, privacy-first verification across fintech, credentials, supply chain, and gaming — for IDV providers, e-signature platforms, and enterprises who need identity to just work, everywhere.

Backed by top global investors, Hopae operates across Seoul, Paris, Luxembourg, and San Francisco, bringing together exceptional talent from over 10 nationalities. We move fast, think globally, and build products that define the future of identity.

  • Global DNA: Work with exceptional peers across Seoul, Paris, and San Francisco

What You Will Do

A signed contract is the start of a customer’s journey, not the finish line. On our Activation & Assurance team, you’ll help customers complete provider onboarding, understand how our product works, and validate their integration with real production testers.

Receive credentials and enter them accurately into the Hopae Console, following security procedures and checking the customer and environment.

  • Coordinate and run real-world tests. Once a customer has integrated our product, organize testing with real production testers. Agree on schedules, prepare test scenarios and instructions, guide testers through the user journey, and keep testing on track. Support recurring production checks using the team’s established procedures.

Enpal macht das möglich mit einer integrierten Gesamtlösung für dezentrale Energie – von Solaranlage und Batteriespeicher über Wallbox, Smart Meter bis zur Wärmepumpe. Herzstück ist unsere KI-gestützte Plattform Enpal.One+, die tausende Systeme intelligent vernetzt und Strombezug sowie -einspeisung effizient am Energiemarkt optimiert.

Bist Du bereit für Lösungen, die mehr als nur ein Versprechen sind und täglich echte Lebensqualität in tausende Haushalte bringen? Was du bei Enpal gestaltest, liefert morgen sauberen Strom und verändert nachhaltig, wie wir Energie nutzen.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du bist unser Fachexperte für Klimaanlagen und bringst deine praktische Erfahrung in den Aufbau des Bereichs ein

  • Du entwickelst einfache Standards und Abläufe für Installation, Inbetriebnahme und Qualität

  • Du hilfst dabei, neue Klimatechniker einzuarbeiten und fachlich weiterzuentwickeln

  • Du unterstützt bei neuen Kundenangeboten und stellst sicher, dass unsere Ideen technisch und auf der Baustelle funktionieren

  • Du bist Ansprechpartner für unsere externen Handwerkspartner und unterstützt bei technischen Fragen und schwierigen Fällen

  • Du übernimmst eigene Projekte und hilfst uns, den Bereich Klimatechnik weiter auszubauen

 

Dein Profil

  • Du kommst aus der Klimatechnik, Kälte-/Klimabranche oder dem SHK-Handwerk und kennst die Arbeit auf der Baustelle

  • Du hast eine abgeschlossene Ausbildung im SHK-Bereich oder eine vergleichbare technische Qualifikation. Ein Meistertitel ist ein Plus, aber kein Muss

  • Du kennst dich sehr gut mit Klimaanlagen, Installation und Inbetriebnahme aus

  • Du kannst dein Wissen gut an andere Handwerker weitergeben

  • Du arbeitest selbstständig, pragmatisch und packst gerne selbst mit an

  • Du hast Lust, einen neuen Bereich von Anfang an mit aufzubauen

  • Du kannst entweder am Standort Berlin oder Köln arbeiten

  • Die Sonne scheint auf der ganzen Welt - Bei Enpal arbeitest du mit einem hochmotivierten, diversen Team aus über 65 Nationalitäten.

  • Das ideale Setup für deinen Fokus - Wir sind überzeugt, dass exzellente Ergebnisse dort entstehen, wo die Bedingungen stimmen.
