jobs.title: SOC Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Description

We’re looking for a Tier 1 SOC Analyst to join our team and handle initial triage, monitoring, and investigation of security alerts across cloud and endpoint environments.

This is a client-facing role requiring strong English, excellent verbal communication skills, and the ability to clearly communicate findings and escalations. The position is intended for candidates with at least 1 year of hands-on SOC / Security Operations experience.

The role is based on morning shifts aligned with East Asia working hours.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor security alerts from SIEM, EDR, and cloud platforms
  • Perform initial triage and classification of alerts as true or false positives
  • Investigate suspicious activities across endpoints, identities, and cloud environments
  • Escalate confirmed incidents to Tier 2 / Incident Response teams with proper context
  • Analyze logs from multiple sources, including CloudTrail, Azure Activity Logs, OS logs, and other relevant security data sources
  • Document findings clearly in tickets and investigation reports
  • Follow existing playbooks and contribute to improving detection logic over time
  • Communicate clearly with internal teams and clients regarding alerts, findings, and escalations

Requirements

Required Qualifications:

  • 1+ years of experience in SOC / Security Operations
  • Hands-on experience with EDR tools such as CrowdStrike, SentinelOne, or Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
  • Familiarity with SIEM platforms such as Splunk, Microsoft Sentinel, QRadar, or similar
  • Understanding of networking basics, including IP, DNS, HTTP/S, ports, and related concepts
  • Basic knowledge of Linux and Windows operating systems
  • Ability to analyze logs and identify suspicious behavior
  • Fluent English, both written and spoken — mandatory
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, especially in client-facing situations

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or GCP
  • Knowledge of GCP / Google Cloud Platform — significant advantage
  • Ability to investigate cloud activity, including IAM, API calls, and resource changes
  • Understanding of identity-based attacks, such as token abuse and privilege escalation
  • Experience with scripting in Python or Bash

jobs.title: MuleSoft Integration Architect
jobs.descriptionHtml:
MuleSoft Integration Architect

Job Location: Remote (U.S.- based)

Travel Expectations: 0%

Job Classification:Temporary (W2T); Contractor (1099)

Join Centric Consulting – A Culture You’ll Love

At Centric Consulting, we've cultivated a unique approach to business. Our business is built on three fundamental principles: Enjoy the people you work with, have fun, and do great work. These principles define our consulting model and have crafted one of the most vibrant cultures in the consulting industry – celebrating individuals, collaboration, and lifelong friendships.

In this role, you will:

  • Lead the design, architecture, and implementation of enterprise integration solutions across a complex application ecosystem.
  • Establish scalable integration patterns, frameworks, and best practices to support long-term business and technology objectives.
  • Drive API-led connectivity initiatives using the MuleSoft Anypoint Platform, enabling secure, reusable, and high-performing integration services.
  • Partner with business stakeholders, enterprise architects, product teams, and developers to translate business requirements into effective integration solutions.
  • Define integration architecture standards, governance processes, and technical roadmaps that align with enterprise strategy.
  • Provide technical leadership throughout the full solution lifecycle, including architecture, design reviews, development guidance, testing, deployment, and production support.
  • Design and implement integrations across cloud, on-premises, SaaS, and third-party applications.
  • Ensure integration solutions meet security, scalability, reliability, performance, and compliance requirements.
  • Mentor developers and integration engineers by promoting engineering excellence, knowledge sharing, and adoption of best practices.
  • Evaluate emerging technologies, integration approaches, and architectural patterns to continuously improve the organization's integration capabilities.
  • Collaborate across technical and business teams to identify opportunities for process improvement, automation, and increased operational efficiency.
  • Support project planning, estimation, and delivery activities to ensure successful implementation of integration initiatives.
  • Work collaboratively with global teams while maintaining availability during U.S. business hours.

In this role, you will quickly resolve customer issues, process returns and complaints, and accurately document every interaction within our CRM system.   • Collecting and forwarding customer feedback to relevant departments.

  • Work alongside people who take initiative, speak openly, and challenge themselves to grow.
  • Improve your language skills through co-financed courses and internal speaking clubs.
  • Final benefits may vary depending on the location

jobs.title: Remote Call Center Representative
jobs.descriptionHtml:
POSITION OVERVIEW

MCI is one of the fastest-growing tech-enabled business services companies in the USA, with a strong call center footprint and operations that extend across multiple countries. We deliver Customer Experience (CX), Business Process Outsourcing (BPO), and Anything-as-a-Service (XaaS) cloud technology solutions across a wide range of industries, including healthcare, retail, government, education, telecom, technology e-commerce, and financial services. Our contact centers are powered by both on-site and remote agents, leveraging advanced technologies to enhance customer journeys, drive scalability and reduce costs.

At MCI we are committed to fostering an environment where professionals can build meaningful careers, access continuous learning and development opportunities and contribute to the success of a globally expanding, industry-leading organization.

We are hiring Remote Call Center Representatives to join our customer support team. This role is perfect for individuals who are passionate about helping others, enjoy working from home, and thrive in a fast-paced environment. You’ll be the first point of contact for our customers, providing exceptional service and support.

To be considered for this role, you must complete a full application on our company careers page, including all screening questions and a brief pre-employment test.

POSITION RESPONSIBILITIES

Key Responsibilities:

  • Answer inbound calls and respond to customer inquiries in a professional manner.
  • Resolve customer issues efficiently while maintaining a positive attitude.
  • Document all interactions accurately in the CRM system.
  • Follow communication scripts and standard operating procedures.
  • Escalate complex issues to the appropriate department when necessary.
  • Meet or exceed performance metrics including call quality, response time, and customer satisfaction.

CANDIDATE QUALIFICATIONS

WONDER IF YOU ARE A GOOD FIT FOR THIS POSITION?

All positive, and driven applicants are encouraged to apply. The Ideal candidates for this position are highly motivated and dedicated and should possess the below qualities:

  • Must be 18 years or older
  • High school diploma/GED
  • 1+ year of experience in a call center or customer service role.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to multitask and manage time effectively in a remote setting.
  • Proficient with computers and customer service software.
  • Reliable internet connection and a quiet home workspace.
  • Fluent in English and Spanish

COMPENSATION DETAILS

WANT AN EMPLOYER THAT VALUES YOUR CONTRIBUTION?

At MCI, we believe that your hard work deserves recognition and reward. Our compensation and benefits packages are designed to be competitive and to grow with you over time. Starting compensation is based on experience, and we offer a variety of benefits and incentives to support and reward our team members.

What You Can Expect from MCI:

We understand the importance of balance and support, which is why we offer a variety of benefits and incentives that go beyond a paycheck. Our team members enjoy:

  • Paid Time Off: Earn PTO and paid holidays to take the time you need.
  • Health Benefits: Full-time employees are eligible for supplemental health coverage through Blue Cross.
  • Life Insurance: Access life insurance options to safeguard your loved ones.
  • Supplemental Insurance: Accident and critical illness insurance
  • Career Growth: With a focus on internal promotions, employees enjoy significant advancement opportunities.
  • Paid Training: Learn new skills while earning a paycheck.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

We partner with our customers to achieve business objectives by using our proven customer-centric, value-driven business practices and service delivery methodologies.


As a Senior Consultant, ServiceNow specializing in Hardware Asset Management (HAM) and Software Asset Management (SAM), you will help deliver enterprise solutions that improve how organizations manage, track, and maintain their technology assets. You will collaborate with technical teams and stakeholders to develop scalable ServiceNow capabilities, streamline asset management processes, and strengthen integrations across enterprise systems. This role requires strong platform development expertise, technical problem-solving skills, and the ability to translate business needs into effective technical solutions.
Location: Remote
Clearance: Active Top Secret Required. TS/SCI Preferred.
In assuming this position, you will be a critical contributor to meeting Nuvitek's mission: To deliver innovative, cost-effective solutions and services that enable our customers to rapidly adapt to dynamic environments.

What you will do

  • Develop and enhance ServiceNow HAM and SAM capabilities to support enterprise hardware and software asset management throughout the asset lifecycle.
  • Design solutions that connect service catalog offerings, procurement requests, asset fulfillment, and entitlement management to provide a consistent experience for end users.
  • Configure and maintain asset management workflows that support hardware assignments, software provisioning, license allocation, renewals, and reclamation.
  • Improve asset visibility by developing solutions that allow stakeholders to identify available hardware, assigned equipment, software licenses, and associated ownership information.
  • Strengthen the relationship between the CMDB and asset management records to ensure configuration items accurately reflect deployed equipment and software.
  • Build and maintain integrations between ServiceNow and external inventory management tools to improve asset discovery, data accuracy, and reconciliation.
  • Develop automated processes to identify discrepancies between inventory sources, resolve conflicting asset information, and address incomplete or outdated records.

  • Implement workflow enhancements that ensure equipment information is properly documented and updated during incident resolution, service requests, and project activities.
  • Design and maintain integrations that synchronize asset information across enterprise platforms while supporting established data ownership and governance requirements.
  • Develop technical solutions using Flow Designer, business rules, client scripts, Script Includes, and other ServiceNow development capabilities.
  • Create and maintain API integrations using REST/SOAP services, IntegrationHub, MID Server, Import Sets, and Transform Maps.
  • Apply JavaScript and ServiceNow scripting capabilities to customize platform functionality and improve system performance.

Location: 100% Remote

Schedule: Monday – Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM EST

Compensation: $1,500 – $2,500 USD / month + Commissions

Language Requirement: Effective English + Strong Local Language Fluency

About the Role

We are seeking an entrepreneurial International B2B Business Development Manager to drive regional expansion by opening industrial accounts, presenting specialized technical solutions, and converting opportunities into recurring regional revenue.

In this role, you will lead end-to-end commercial growth within your assigned territory—targeting HVAC, industrial equipment, facilities, and mechanical sectors. This position is tailored for a technical sales "hunter" capable of building a durable customer ecosystem from the ground up.

Key Responsibilities

  • New Revenue Development: Prospect, cold-outreach, and open doors across industrial accounts to generate and convert coating-project opportunities into collected revenue.

  • Account Ownership & Recurring Sales: Maintain close contact post-sale, follow up on quotes, engage key decision-makers, and drive repeat orders and account expansion.

  • Ecosystem & Channel Building: Identify, qualify, and recruit regional distributors, resellers, certified-applicator candidates, and strategic partners.

  • Pipeline & Activity Discipline: Maintain consistent prospecting, meetings, opportunity reporting, forecasting, and routine communication with INFINIGUARD management.

  • Brand & Channel Protection: Apply approved pricing, claims, commercial terms, and materials to ensure brand value and channel alignment.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • B2B Technical Sales Experience: Preferred background in industrial markets, HVAC, mechanical equipment, protective coatings, construction, facility management, energy, OEMs, or technical distribution.

  • Hunter Mentality: Proven ability to proactively prospect, open new doors, and create opportunities rather than relying on inbound leads.

  • Relevant Industry Network (Strong Advantage): Established relationships with contractors, OEMs, distributors, engineering firms, facility owners/operators, or industrial buyers.

  • Technical Sales Aptitude: Ability to learn and credibly present a technical solution (INFINIGUARD provides technical support, training, documentation, and application expertise).

  • Language Proficiency: Effective communication in English to coordinate with INFINIGUARD management, combined with strong local-language and cultural fluency.

  • Equipment & Setup (Mandatory): Must possess your own reliable computer/laptop, high-speed internet, and headset for daily remote operations.

  • Travel Readiness: Willingness and capability to travel within the assigned market to meet customers, partners, and prospects in person.

  • High Integrity & Commercial Maturity: Strong ethics, pricing discipline, and a focus on long-term regional development over one-time sales.

jobs.title: Equity Research Analyst
jobs.descriptionHtml:
CFRA's global fundamental equity research team produces independent, actionable research trusted by institutional investors, wealth advisors, and regulators worldwide. We're growing that team and looking for an Equity Research Analyst who brings intellectual curiosity, strong analytical skills, and a passion for financial markets.
Our team is organized by sector and collaborates closely with CFRA's forensic accounting, policy/legal, and technical research groups to deliver comprehensive, differentiated insights. Analysts have access to a suite of proprietary tools, including fundamental dashboards, standardized DCF models, forensic accounting diagnostic reports, and technical signals.
In this role, you will conduct and publish fundamental equity research for a global client base spanning institutional investors, wealth advisors, insurance companies, regulators, and professional service firms. Your work will cover qualitative and quantitative analysis across valuation, financial performance, competitive positioning, quality of earnings, and free cash flow, resulting in stock rating recommendations, sector and industry outlooks, and in-depth thematic research.

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with the equity research team to produce and publish analysis on companies and industries
  • Provide Buy/Sell/Hold recommendations on a defined coverage universe
  • Publish stock reports, research notes, and in-depth actionable thematic and industry research
  • Build and maintain DCF models and comparable company analyses to determine whether a company's stock is overvalued or undervalued
  • Present findings through internal and external webinars and live events

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

  • 2+ years in equity research or a comparable financial role, ideally with exposure to the Industrials/Materials sector.
  • Bachelor’s degree required; CFA candidacy or MBA is a significant plus.
  • Strong equity valuation analysis and financial modeling skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal skills for publishing research and presenting findings.
  • High intellectual curiosity, attention to detail, and the ability to meet deadlines in a collaborative environment.

Benefits

  • 20 days of Vacation
  • 8 Sick Days
  • 1 paid volunteer day
  • 10-11 Holidays a year
  • Health, Dental, & Vision Insurance
  • Company-paid Life & Disability Insurance
  • Annual Performance Bonus
The base salary range for this position is $80,000 - $97,000. Compensation is determined by factors including experience, skills, and business needs. This role is also eligible for an annual performance bonus and a comprehensive benefits package.
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or status as a protected veteran.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is the discovery and conversion company. We reach tens of millions of people every month through our brands, including FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. We turn that attention into real outcomes for our partners, some of the world's leading companies.

Our mission: create predictable, high-value customer acquisition at scale by connecting discovery, intent, and performance across category-leading consumer brands in finance, travel, and entertainment.

We run profitable and bootstrapped, with a South Florida HQ and a remote-first team across 18 countries.

WHY JOIN US?

You own outcomes here, not tasks. We measure work by impact, not activity. The pace is real, and change is constant, so the people who do best turn change into opportunity instead of waiting for it to settle. Feedback runs direct and lands with respect. Ordinary people make themselves extraordinary at Launch Potato.

BASE SALARY: $175,000 to $200,000 per year, paid semi-monthly

YOUR ROLE

You'll build the models that decide which carrier each auto insurance shopper sees on our click wall. The goal is to send every user to the carrier most likely to convert them, so carriers see our traffic convert and raise their bids. You'll also own the buying models behind our media spend, which are held to ROAS.

Carrier conversion data (quotes, policies and acquisition cost) is now coming back to us, and you'll be the one who puts it to work in production. The hard part is the data. Outcomes land weeks or months after the click, many sessions are sparse, the same shoppers come back, and the market drifts. Our bids also decide which users we win, so the model shapes the data it learns from next.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You frame problems directly with the business, find your own data, build and validate the model, and stay with it through deployment and monitoring. An ML engineer works alongside you on the production side. Auto insurance takes most of your time to start, and scope broadens to other verticals over time.

We're remote first, and most of the company works East Coast hours.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

By day 60, you run our insurance marketplace media buying on your own.

By the end of your first year:

  • Click wall serving that matches each user to the right carrier
  • Carrier conversion data running in production models
  • Automated marketplace bidding taken from proof of concept to scale
  • A clear approach for repeat users and sparse sessions
  • Production models that hold up through drift and changing objectives
  • Output the business trusts and uses without rework

MUST HAVE

  • 5+ years of hands-on applied data science with measurable business impact
  • Your models drove paid media decisions: spend, bidding or ad serving. Attribution and reporting alone don't qualify.
  • You built what's on your resume and can explain it down to the loss function and architecture choice, neural network fundamentals included
  • You see how today's bids shape tomorrow's training data, and you've handled late labels, sparse features or drift
  • You own models end to end: you find your own data, build through deployment and monitoring, and bring a point of v...

Our client delivers specialised trauma-informed services, including regulated provision, supporting individuals with complex mental health needs within safe, structured environments.

The service is built on the belief that everyone is supportable with the right approach and deserves to live in a safe, caring, and empowering setting. Individuals are seen as more than their diagnosis or past experiences, with support focused on dignity, independence, and meaningful progress.

As a Support Worker within the Specialised Trauma Service, you will support individuals experiencing complex and enduring mental health needs, including personality disorders, trauma, PTSD, self-harm behaviours, bipolar disorder, eating disorders, and schizophrenia.

Description

TripleTen is an EdTech company that designs and runs tech career learning programs for the US and Latin American markets. We've been doing it for over five years, teaching complete beginners — people with no prior tech background — through cohort-based programs built on our own platform and curriculum, developed in partnership with Nebius AI. Our team is fully remote and globally distributed, and we serve a large, active student base across both regions.

We are looking for a Student Retention Specialist to support students in their learning journey and help them stay committed to their educational goals.

This role is responsible for driving student engagement, retention, and overall satisfaction by building meaningful relationships, identifying potential challenges, and providing proactive support. You will work closely with students to help them stay motivated, overcome obstacles, and successfully achieve their educational goals.

What you will do

  • Engage with students through retention-focused calls and chats, addressing refund and cancellation requests with empathy and professionalism.
  • Identify the underlying reasons behind student dissatisfaction and provide personalized solutions to improve their experience and commitment.
  • Manage renewal and recurring payment conversations, proactively reaching out to students before their current term ends to support extensions and continued enrollment.
  • Consistently meet or exceed weekly retention (save rate) and renewal performance goals.
  • Maintain accurate and detailed records of all student interactions within CRM systems.
  • Participate in call reviews, coaching sessions, and continuous development initiatives to enhance performance and student outcomes.

Requirements

  • 1+ years of experience in Retention, Customer Success, Sales, or another customer-facing role.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal, as you'll be supporting English-speaking students.
  • Strong empathy, active listening, and relationship-building skills, with a genuine desire to help others succeed.
  • Comfortable working in a target-driven environment and meeting performance goals.
  • Resilient, adaptable, and able to remain calm and solution-oriented during challenging conversations.
  • Experience using CRM platforms to manage customer interactions and maintain accurate records.

What we can offer you

  • Clear performance expectations, fast feedback loops, and full ownership of your work and results.
  • Join a mission-driven company helping thousands of people transform their careers through education and technology.
  • A fast-paced environment built on accountability, ownership, and impact—without unnecessary bureaucracy.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of working remotely with a high level of autonomy, trust, and minimal micromanagement.
  • Collaborate with talented professionals from diverse backgrounds across tech, ed-tech, and other industries.
  • Work with platforms like Notion, Miro, Google Workspace, and other digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
  • Your work will directly contribute to improving student retention, engagement, and long-term success.

Compensation & Schedule

  • Schedule: Monday to Friday.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
In a world of possibilities, pursue one with endless opportunities. Imagine Next!At Parsons, you can imagine a career where you thrive, work with exceptional people, and be yourself. Guided by our leadership vision of valuing people, embracing agility, and fostering growth, we cultivate an innovative culture that empowers you to achieve your full potential. Unleash your talent and redefine what’s possible.

Job Description:

Parsons is looking for an amazingly talented VP, Chief Audit Executive (CAE) to join our team!

POSITION OVERVIEW:

The CAE is responsible for the company’s Internal Audit function and audits of the company’s business. The CAE establishes a systematic, objective, and disciplined approach to evaluate and improve the effectiveness and efficiency of risk management, internal controls, compliance, governance, and operational processes. Leverages artificial intelligence, big data analytics and other technologies to make audits more effective, efficient, and agile. In addition, the CAE serves as the leader of the company’s Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX) Program Management Office (PMO), ensuring an integrated approach between internal audit activities, enterprise risk management, internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR), and regulatory compliance. The CAE oversees the planning, coordination, execution, and reporting of the SOX 404 compliance program across the enterprise. The CAE reports from a functional standpoint to the Chairperson of the Audit & Risk Committee of the company’s Board of Directors, and from an administrative standpoint to the Chief Financial Officer.


What You'll Be Doing:

  • Determines whether the company’s network of risk management, internal controls, and operational and governance processes is functioning such that: financial statements and managerial information are accurate, reliable, and timely.
  • Determines whether the company’s network of risk management, internal controls, and operational and governance processes is functioning effectively and provides oversight of the SOX PMO to support the design, documentation, testing, certification, and continuous improvement of internal controls over financial reporting (ICFR). jobs.descriptionHtml:
Overview

LMI is seeking an Atlassian Migration Engineer at the Level IV level to modernize enterprise Jira and Confluence environments and connect work management to development delivery pipelines for Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) modernization initiatives. This role combines technical migration execution, scripting, API integration, automation engineering, and validation to move complex workloads to Atlassian Cloud with reliable data and minimal disruption.

The Atlassian Migration Engineer will evaluate source environments, use approved migration tooling, reconcile users and permissions, transform incompatible data and configurations, and verify results through repeatable testing. The engineer will also implement Jira automations and integrations linking GitHub repositories, work items, builds, and deployment status, collaborating closely with cloud architects, administrators, and security and identity teams.

This is not a copy-and-move-only role. Success requires diagnosing legacy configuration constraints, selecting safe remediation approaches, proving that critical links and histories remain usable, and creating clear cutover and recovery evidence. The ideal candidate pairs strong troubleshooting and scripting skills with disciplined change control and attention to operational handover.

LMI is a new breed of digital solutions provider dedicated to accelerating government impact with innovation and speed. Investing in technology and prototypes ahead of need, LMI brings commercial-grade platforms and mission-ready AI to federal agencies at commercial speed.

Leveraging our mission-ready technology and solutions, proven expertise in federal deployment, and strategic relationships, we enhance outcomes for the government, efficiently and effectively. With a focus on agility and collaboration, LMI serves the defense, space, healthcare, and energy sectors—helping agencies navigate complexity and outpace change. Headquartered in Tysons, Virginia, LMI is committed to delivering impactful results that strengthen missions and drive lasting value.

Responsibilities

  • Inventory legacy Jira/Confluence projects, spaces, workflows, identities, marketplace apps, and integrations to assess migration readiness.

  • Resolve migration blockers with security, identity, architecture, and customer teams.
  • Develop migration runbooks, source-to-target mappings, data-quality checks, acceptance criteria, defect logs, and cutover or rollback checkpoints.

  • Use approved APIs and scripts for bulk corrections, automation, link repair, integration health checks, and reconciliation of post-migration issues.
  • Implement and verify GitHub-to-JCC issue links, smart commits where supported, and CI/CD build and deploy signals while protecting credentials and secrets.
  • Coordinate technical releases with change authorities and document repeatable procedures, integration ownership, monitoring, and maintenance responsibilities.

About EarthDaily Federal

EarthDaily Federal is a geospatial intelligence company at the intersection of space, AI, and national security. Our products power mission-critical insights for federal agencies and prime contractors across defense, intelligence, environmental monitoring, and disaster response.

About the Role

This is a hunter seat covering the combatant commands and the Department of War enterprise. You will build pipeline across COCOM and department-level customers, run early capture against operational and theater requirements, and carry a number in a fast-moving, mission-driven market.

What You'll Do

All employees, regardless of role or clearance status, are required to handle such information in strict accordance with applicable U.S. Government laws and regulations, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (32 CFR Part 117), company security policies, and the terms of any individual clearance or access authorization. Unauthorized access, handling, or disclosure of classified information or CUI is strictly prohibited and must be reported immediately to the Facility Security Officer.

As part of the award-winning Zenzero Group, recognised as a Top 8 Technology Company at the British Business Awards 2026, a Deloitte Best Managed Company, and featured in the Sunday Times Hundred in both 2025 and 2026, we're helping ambitious organisations strengthen their security posture in an increasingly complex digital world.

Our mission is simple: to make cyber security practical, proactive, and effective for mid-market businesses. From managed detection and response, security operations, and threat monitoring to governance, risk, compliance, and security consulting, we help organisations stay secure, resilient, and ready for what's next.

Demand for cyber security expertise has never been greater, and neither has our ambition. As a certified B Corp and Scale Up Award winner, we believe high growth and high standards go hand in hand. jobs.title: Senior ROR Product Technical Support Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: Senior ROR Product Technical Support Engineer
Location: Remote

Note: Candidates must be willing and comfortable to work night shifts.

Job Summary:
We are looking for a Senior Product Technical Support Engineer with strong hands-on debugging and problem-solving skills to support and troubleshoot a large-scale Ruby on Rails monolithic application. You will work across the application, database, integrations, and hosting layers to diagnose complex production issues and ensure a reliable customer experience.
Key Responsibilities:
· Troubleshoot complex production issues across Ruby on Rails, PostgreSQL, background jobs, APIs, and third-party integrations using logs, stack traces, database queries, and debugging tools.
· Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for production incidents and work closely with Engineering, Product, QA, and Customer Support teams to drive issues to resolution.
· Diagnose PostgreSQL issues including slow queries, data inconsistencies, database locks/deadlocks, connection issues, indexing, and data-related problems.
· Troubleshoot REST APIs, webhooks, authentication, data synchronization, and third-party integrations, including Stripe and AWS S3.
· Support and troubleshoot applications hosted on Heroku, including dynos, workers, deployments, configuration/environment variables, logs, build failures, and application performance.
· Investigate Stripe payment, subscription, refund, and webhook-related issues, including discrepancies between Stripe and application data.
· Analyze customer-reported issues, trace problems through the application and database layers, reproduce issues, and provide appropriate fixes or workarounds.
· Make small-to-medium code fixes, SQL queries, scripts, configuration changes, and production fixes where required.
· Monitor recurring production issues and proactively identify opportunities to improve application stability, performance, monitoring, and support processes.

LMI is seeking an Atlassian Solution Architect at the Senior level to design secure, scalable enterprise Atlassian Cloud environments supporting Department of Veterans Affairs (VA) technology modernization initiatives. jobs.descriptionHtml:
What's the Vibe?
Our founders started Creative Force with a single goal in mind: to build industry-leading software with really cool people.
As we’ve grown, we’ve stayed true to that vision. Our products are ushering in a new era of creative operations for some of the world’s largest brands and retailers.
And all along the way, hiring great people has remained a critical business priority...
...See, we have this crazy idea that effective collaboration is THE skill of the future and critical to our success. As a remote company with staff across the globe, we've seen firsthand how important it is for our teams to work well together.
And that's why we focus on hiring talented people who are also great to work with.
That means we don't always hire the people with the most experience. Some of us have PhDs. Others have spent multiple decades working at the top of our field. But we've also hired former tennis coaches, film students, photographers, hotel front desk workers, freelance travel agents, and fashion designers.
While our backgrounds are diverse, we all share a few important traits:
  • We love solving challenging problems.
  • We're passionate about the work we do.
  • And we're the kind of good humans who make you look forward to that morning coffee chat, who bring positive energy to every meeting, who go the extra mile to support one another, and who make work feel a little less like work.
But hey, there are lots of job posts out there that are cool and vibey and explain how unique their company culture is (look, a ping-pong table!). We know, we’ve seen them. Some might be truer than others. As for us, we think you’ll notice the good vibes the first time we chat.

What we offer YOU

  • A fast-growing, exciting, and fun scaleup environment — with multiple international Employer Awards — and not those awards you can pay for, but the kind of awards given based on Employee reviews. It just doesn’t get any better than that. 💜
  • A flat and transparent organizational structure — no bureaucratic red tape. Your ideas and initiatives will be heard and embraced!
  • True work-life balance — we see our team members as people, not numbers, and know that a balanced personal and professional life is critical to happiness and long-term fulfillment
  • A collaborative international environment with colleagues across Europe and USA
  • A growing Technical Success function with opportunities to influence processes, strategy, and customer experience
  • A vibrant work culture grounded in the belief that we’re better together
  • Company trips and events, and much more!

What’s the Role?

Still interested? Awesome. Here's the deal:

At Creative Force, we work with some of the world's biggest brands and retailers. Our customers operate at scale, move fast, and rely on our platform to power complex creative workflows across teams, regions, and markets.

And that's where you come in.

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager to become the trusted technical partner for our Enterprise customers throughout their entire journey with Creative Force.
You'll be involved from the very beginning — partnering with Sales during the pre-sales process to understand customer needs, design the right technical solutions, and help show how Creative Force can solve complex workflow challenges.

jobs.title: PDF Accessibility Specialist
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Job Title: PDF Accessibility Specialist (Freelance / Independent Contractor)

Hours: 5–20 hours per week (Flexible / Remote – Philippines Timezone Preferred)

Overview:

Promet Source is seeking an Independent PDF Accessibility Specialist to consult with our clients on PDF accessibility best practices and remediate documents to meet WCAG, Section 508, and PDF/UA standards. This role ensures that all PDF content is fully usable by individuals relying on assistive technologies, including screen readers.

Responsibilities:

  • Remediate PDFs for accessibility, including tagging, reading order, alternative text, headings, tables, forms, and bookmarks.
  • Test documents using screen readers (JAWS, NVDA, VoiceOver) and automated tools (Adobe Acrobat Accessibility Checker, PAC, CommonLook).
  • Convert scanned or image-based PDFs into accessible, searchable documents using OCR.
  • Review source files (Word, InDesign, PowerPoint) and recommend upstream accessibility fixes to streamline remediation.
  • Conduct accessibility audits and produce VPAT/ACR documentation as needed.
  • Track and prioritize remediation tasks across a document backlog while consistently meeting deadlines and quality standards.
  • Stay current on WCAG 2.1/2.2, Section 508, ADA, and PDF/UA requirements.

Qualifications:

  • Proven experience remediating PDFs for accessibility compliance.
  • In-depth working knowledge of WCAG 2.1/2.2 AA guidelines and Section 508 standards.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Acrobat Pro, AEM Designer (tagging, reading order, form design), and automated accessibility testing tools.
  • Practical familiarity with screen reader testing and assistive technology.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage a high-volume document workload.
  • IAAP certification (CPACC, WAS, or CPWA) is highly preferred.

Preferred Experience:

  • Remediating complex structures, including interactive forms, multi-page tables, charts, and multi-column layouts.
  • Working with source authoring tools (Microsoft Word, Adobe InDesign, PowerPoint) using accessible-by-design principles.

We are an equal opportunity organization. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Grupo QuintoAndar is the largest real estate ecosystem in Latin America, with brands and solutions across six countries.

Our purpose is to help people love where they live by making the housing journey simpler, from finding a home to managing life in it.

We’re also investing R$ 2 billion in technology and AI over the next two years, expanding our engineering capabilities and developing more conversational product experiences. To learn more about our story, visit:.

Location & Remote Work

Our technology team operates under a "remote-first" model, which means we work from home and can live anywhere in Brazil. We also offer the option of working from our São Paulo office. Furthermore, we offer the Work From Anywhere program, allowing you to work from any country for up to 90 days a year, ensuring you have the flexibility to do the best work of your career.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will be a core driver of our technical execution. Here, you won't just "maintain old systems" or "take tickets." We are an organization of builders guided by deep technical density. You will use our Leadership Principles, like Dive Deep and Make it Great, to solve high-impact distribution problems and build the systems of our next decade.

Omnidian, Inc. is a fast-growing Series C tech-enabled service company revolutionizing performance assurance for the distributed solar and energy storage industries. Omnidian is building a more sustainable future for the planet through our passionate teams, our innovative technology, and by creating an amazing customer experience. We are a certified B Corps, headquartered in Seattle, WA

The Job

Are you ready to make a meaningful impact in the solar industry? As a Customer Experience Specialist at Omnidian, you'll play a pivotal role in managing high-sentiment escalations and ensuring our customers receive a path to total system recovery. In this role, you will be the main point of contact for escalated customer escalations, helping them find a clear path to getting their solar systems back up and running. Combining deep technical solar expertise with empathetic communication. You will report to the Customer Experience Manager and act as a central hub, coordinating with internal teams to resolve routine friction and keep the planet’s energy assets performing at their best.

  • Risk Assessment: Identify situations with elevated legal, financial, or reputational risk and escalate appropriately while maintaining accurate, defensible documentation.

    • Technical Solar Expert

Why Apply to New Frontier Immigration Law

Join the New Frontier Immigration Law team and help change the lives of 1 million undocumented immigrants in the USA. Our mid-sized law firm in Phoenix, AZ is committed to humanitarian-based immigration and finding innovative solutions for seemingly impossible problems.

Are you ready to join one of the fastest-growing law firms in the US, where incredible opportunities await? Here, we don’t just offer a job: we provide an environment that challenges you to become the best version of yourself.

  • Learn more about New Frontier Immigration here.
  • Learn more about our CEO/Founder Hillary here.
  • Learn more about our Core Values here.

Role Objective

The Sales Attorney is a client-facing role that sits at the intersection of legal expertise and consultative sales. This position is responsible for conducting strategy sessions with prospective clients, assessing their immigration situation, and guiding qualified individuals toward retaining the firm's services. The ideal candidate is a licensed attorney in Mexico with a strong command of immigration law, a genuine empathy for the communities we serve, and a proven ability to close.

This is not a traditional legal practice role - it is a client-facing position where legal expertise and genuine human connection work together. Success in this role means helping people understand their options clearly, building trust from the very first conversation, and guiding qualified individuals toward the support they need - same day.

Responsibilities/Duties

  • Conduct strategy sessions as the primary daily activity (4–5 hours/day) - assess each client's immigration situation, explain available pathways, and present the firm's services with clarity and confidence.
  • Complete priming calls and proposal preparation before each strategy session to ensure readiness and maximize conversion.
  • Close contracts, collect payments, and book client onboarding appointments on the same day as hire - same-day close is the standard.
  • Execute timely follow-up calls on all pending and undecided clients from prior strategy sessions - no potential client is left without a follow-up.
  • Ensure complete and accurate handoff to the Legal team for every retained client - documentation, onboarding checklist, and case details transferred without gaps.
  • Maintain accurate records of all client interactions, session outcomes, and pipeline activity in the firm's CRM.
  • Meet and exceed individual session conversion targets and monthly retention goals.

Requirements

  • Licensed attorney in Mexico in good standing - required; Licenciatura en Derecho and Cédula Profesional required.
  • Bilingual in Spanish and English - native-level Spanish required; strong English communication skills essential for collaboration with US-based leadership.
  • Knowledge of immigration law - ability to assess client eligibility, explain case types, and identify viable pathways with confidence.
  • Demonstrated success in a sales or client conversion role - track record of meeting or exceeding quota in a performance-based environment.

jobs.descriptionHtml: Tentang Perusahaan PT Sinar Lampu Indonesia (Sanwa Group) Merupakan perusahaan yang bergerak di bidang Lampu Hias, Perusahaan melayani kebutuhan pelanggan baik untuk proyek maupun konsumen, serta berhubungan dengan berbagai pihak seperti kontraktor, developer, dan pelanggan potensial. Ini adalah posisi Sales di bidang desain interior dan renovasi, dengan fokus pada mencari pelanggan baru, menjaga hubungan dengan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta mengelola proyek di sektor perumahan, komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. **Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan :** 1. Mencari pelanggan baru, mempertahankan pelanggan yang sudah ada, serta melakukan follow-up terhadap proyek perumahan, lokasi komersial, dan perusahaan renovasi. 2. Mengunjungi lokasi proyek, melakukan pengukuran, mencatat kondisi ruangan dan pekerjaan, membuat penawaran harga (quotation), serta menangani pesanan. 3. Melayani pelanggan di showroom/pameran, memberikan pelayanan, serta mendampingi pelanggan untuk melihat sampel dan memilih produk. 4. Membuat laporan pekerjaan harian, termasuk follow-up pelanggan, kondisi lokasi proyek, pelanggan baru yang diperoleh, serta rencana pekerjaan untuk hari berikutnya. 6. Memiliki pengalaman 1–3 tahun di bidang sales, lebih disukai yang memiliki pengalaman di bidang interior. 3. Memahami penjualan B2B dan B2C serta memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik. 4. Bersedia bekerja secara mobile/outdoor (banyak bekerja di lapangan). 5. Bersedia lembur apabila diperlukan. 6. Jujur, disiplin, dan bertanggung jawab. Jenis Pekerjaan: Kontrak Lokasi Kerja: Tatap muka

Since our founding in 2012, we have expanded to eleven markets, processed billions of dollars in transactions, and built one of the most recognised consumer brands in the region. We move fast because the region demands it. Southeast Asia is young, mobile-first, and growing faster than almost anywhere else on earth. We are not transplanting a Western playbook — we are writing a new one, from scratch, for a market that does not look like anywhere else — and we are calling for people who want to be part of that. **About the Team** Information Security at Traveloka protects one of Southeast Asia's largest travel platforms — millions of travellers, their payments, and their trust across 11 markets. We are the team that lets hundreds of engineers ship fast without shipping risk: building secure-by-default infrastructure, hunting threats in real time, and setting the standards every product team is held to. As we scale and as AI becomes native to how we build, the attack surface grows and our work only gets more critical. Here you defend at genuine scale and own outcomes, not tickets. Whether you are hardening systems through security engineering or running detection and response in security operations, you will make decisions that move the whole company. If you want your security work to matter to real people across the region, you will fit right in. jobs.descriptionHtml: **CONVERSION RATE OPTIMIZATION (CRO) SPECIALIST - AI FIRST** **Company:** WowSuite **Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia **Type:** Full-time, Remote **Team:** CRO / Growth / Creative **THE ROLE** WowSuite is hiring a hands-on CRO Specialist to improve the commercial performance of ecommerce, lead-generation, subscription and telehealth funnels. We run Meta, Taboola and Outbrain style funnels, including presell pages, index pages, checkouts and upsells. Most of our traffic is paid and mobile. This is not a basic "button color" CRO role or a pure design role. You will use data, customer behavior, AI and experimentation to identify where funnels lose money, determine why, and decide what to test next. This is an AI-first role. AI should be part of your normal workflow for research, analytics, testing, QA and reporting. Copy and design skills are a strong bonus, but not the main requirement. **MAIN GOAL** Increase profitable revenue from the traffic we already have. Performance is measured by commercial results, not activity. **WHAT YOU WILL OWN** * Analyze the full funnel from traffic source through landing page, checkout, payment, upsells and retention. * Identify the highest-value conversion and economic constraints using data. * Build and prioritize a CRO testing backlog based on expected commercial impact. * Design and analyze structured A/B tests with clear hypotheses, primary metrics and guardrails. * Improve CVR, revenue per visitor/click, AOV, payment completion, upsell rate and profitability. * Segment performance by traffic source, campaign, device, geography and funnel path. * Use analytics, heatmaps, session recordings, reviews, support data and customer research to understand behavior. * Turn findings into specific test recommendations for offers, copy, UX, page structure, checkout, proof and payment flows. * Give clear briefs to designers, copywriters and developers and review execution against the CRO hypothesis. * Use AI for research, analysis, SQL/formulas, test ideas, variants and reporting. * QA tests across mobile, desktop, tracking, pricing, checkout and payment. * Clearly report what was tested, why, the result, economic impact, decision and next test. * Move winners live quickly. **REQUIRED SKILLS** You should be strong in: * CRO and full-funnel analysis. * Ecommerce, lead generation or digital growth. * A/B testing and structured experimentation. * Funnel and step-level conversion analysis. * CVR, revenue per visitor/click, AOV, CAC/CPA and commercial metrics. * Traffic, campaign, device and geography segmentation. * GA4, PostHog, OpenPanel or similar analytics tools. * Excel or Google Sheets. * Heatmaps and session recordings. * AI-assisted research, analytics and reporting. * Professional written and spoken English. SQL or AI-assisted SQL is a strong advantage. **BONUS SKILLS** * Copywriting and offer presentation. * Mobile-first UX and ecommerce design. * Figma or equivalent wireframing/design tools. * Creating wireframes, layouts and CRO mockups. **PREFERRED EXPERIENCE** * Direct-response ecommerce. * Meta, Taboola or Outbrain traffic. * Subscription or membership funnels. * Telehealth or health ecommerce. * Performance advertising. * Checkout and payment optimization. * High-volume A/B testing. **HOW WE WORK** * Profit before vanity metrics. * Funnel before page. * Diagnosis before ideas. * Proof before decoration. * Clarity before cleverness. * Trust before urgency. * Mobile first when traffic is mobile. * Every test requires a hypothesis, primary metric and guardrail. * Winners go live quickly. * Then we move to the next highest-value constraint. **WHO WILL DO WELL** We want someone who can move from analysis to execution without waiting for multiple teams. You should be able to read the numbers, identify the likely problem, research it, write a clear test brief, QA the implementation and determine whether the business result improved. If you can also write copy or sketch layouts, even better. **APPLI...

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Institution:** Raffles Jakarta Design Institute and Business School **Location:** Jakarta, Indonesia Raffles Institute Jakarta is seeking a versatile academic and industry practitioner to join our international faculty as a Part-Time Design Lecturer. This position is open to experts in Fashion Design, Interior Design, or Visual Communication Design to bridge the gap between academic theory and real-world industry demands through a hands-on, studio-oriented approach. **Key Responsibilities** * **Instructional Delivery:** Prepare and deliver engaging lectures and intensive studio sessions focused on advanced technical skills and digital software mastery. * **Student Mentorship:** Guide students intensively in translating concepts into industry-standard work, from initial idea exploration to final portfolio execution and exhibitions. * **Assessment & Feedback:** Evaluate student assignments, portfolios, and projects, providing constructive, industry-standard professional feedback. * **Industry Integration:** Facilitate real-world exposure in the classroom through design competitions, portfolio critique sessions, and live client projects. **Subject Focus (Candidates will teach based on their specific discipline):** * **Fashion Design:** Creative design (Fashion Drawing, Color Theory), technical production (Draping, Women’s Wear Drafting), digital applications (Gerber Technology, Clo3D, Adobe Creative Suite), or collection portfolio development. * **Interior Design:** Technical drafting (Advanced Revit, 3D CAD, AutoCAD, SketchUp), construction studies and materials, space planning principles, or residential/commercial project simulations. * **Visual Communication Design:** Typography and layout, visual identity systems, UI/UX and web design, packaging design, or motion graphics. **Required Qualifications** * **Education:** Minimum of a master’s degree in Fashion Design, Interior Design, Visual Communication Design, or a closely related discipline from an internationally recognized university. * **Experience:** At least 3 years of teaching experience at the tertiary (higher education) level, or a strong track record as a practitioner/senior designer in the creative industry. * **Language:** Fluent or excellent command of written and spoken English, as it is the primary medium of instruction. * **Technical Proficiency:** Advanced mastery of industry-standard software and tools relevant to the applicant's specific design discipline. **Application Process** Interested candidates are invited to submit their application package to the HR Department via email: hoesnifuad@rafflesindonesia.com. **Required Documents:** * Updated Curriculum Vitae (CV). * Brief Cover Letter detailing your teaching experience, industry background, and technical competencies. * jobs.title: Villa Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml: Location: Pecatu, Uluwatu - Bali Employment Type: Full Time About the Position: We are looking for a proactive, communicative, and hospitality-oriented Villa Sales, Reservation & Operations Officer to manage daily villa operations while supporting sales, reservations, OTA management, and guest relations. This position is suitable for someone who can work independently, is comfortable communicating with guests, and has a strong understanding of hospitality operations and online booking platforms. Key Responsibilities 1. OTA & Reservation Manage villa listings and reservations through OTA platforms such as Booking.com, Agoda, Airbnb, Expedia, etc. Monitor room availability, rates, promotions, and inventory. Respond to guest inquiries promptly and professionally. Handle booking confirmations, cancellations, modifications, and special requests. Maintain an accurate reservation calendar and prevent double bookings. Follow up with potential guests to convert inquiries into bookings. Prepare daily/weekly reservation reports. 2. Sales & Revenue Generate direct bookings through WhatsApp, Instagram, website, referrals, and other channels. Follow up leads and potential customers. Develop relationships with travel agents, tour operators, and local partners. Promote villa packages and special offers. Upsell additional services such as airport transfers, breakfast, BBQ, tours, transportation, etc. Achieve agreed monthly occupancy and revenue targets. Monitor competitor rates and market conditions. 3. Guest Relations & Concierge Communicate with guests before, during, and after their stay. Coordinate check-in and check-out arrangements. Assist guests with transportation, restaurant reservations, tours, activities, and other requests. Handle guest complaints professionally and coordinate solutions. Ensure guests receive a positive and personalized experience. Follow up on guest feedback and online reviews. 4. Villa Operations Conduct daily villa readiness and operational checks. Ensure the villa and public areas are clean, presentable, and guest-ready. Coordinate with Housekeeping, Maintenance, Garden, and Pool teams. Monitor amenities, linen, guest supplies, and operational inventory. Report maintenance issues and follow up on completion. Ensure operational standards are maintained. Assist management in implementing SOPs and improving guest experience. 5. Public Area Monitoring Monitor cleanliness and presentation of entrance, pool area, garden, terrace, parking area, and other public areas. Coordinate cleaning and maintenance requirements. Ensure all public areas are safe, clean, and ready for guests. Requirements Minimum education: SMA/SMK/Diploma in Hospitality, Tourism, Business, or related field. Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel, villa, resort, reservation, sales, or hospitality operations. Experience handling OTA platforms is preferred. Good knowledge of reservation processes and hospitality operations. Good communication skills in Bahasa Indonesia and English. Strong customer service and problem-solving skills. Comfortable using WhatsApp, email, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace, and basic Excel. Able to work independently with minimal supervision. Able to coordinate multiple operational tasks. Target-oriented and willing to work with sales targets. Well-groomed, professional, friendly, and service-oriented. Willing to work weekends, public holidays, and according to villa operational requirements. Having a valid driving license and own transportation is an advantage. Key Skills Must Have OTA management Reservation handling Guest communication Basic sales skills English communication Microsoft Office / Google Workspace Problem solving Operational coordination Preferred Booking.com / Agoda / Airbnb experience PMS experience Revenue management knowledge Travel agent/networking experience Social media and digital marketing knowledge Experience in villa operations Work Location: In person

Tanggung Jawab Utama * **Product Offering:** Memperkenalkan dan menawarkan produk perusahaan kepada calon pelanggan melalui pertemuan secara langsung maupun komunikasi melalui telepon. * **Customer Relationship Management:** Membangun dan menjaga hubungan baik dengan pelanggan untuk menciptakan kepercayaan serta loyalitas jangka panjang. * **Product Knowledge:** Menjelaskan informasi dan keunggulan produk secara jelas sesuai dengan kebutuhan calon pelanggan. * **Customer Handling:** Menangani pertanyaan, masukan, maupun keluhan pelanggan secara profesional serta memberikan solusi yang sesuai. * **Database Management:** Mengelola dan memperbarui database pelanggan secara berkala serta mencatat seluruh aktivitas yang berkaitan dengan pelanggan. * **Team Collaboration:** Berkolaborasi dengan tim Sales dan Marketing dalam menjalankan strategi penjualan serta mendukung pencapaian target perusahaan. * **Reporting & Evaluation:** Menyusun laporan aktivitas kerja dan berpartisipasi dalam evaluasi performa secara berkala. Kualifikasi * Minimal pendidikan **S1** dari jurusan Marketing, Manajemen, Bisnis, Komunikasi, atau bidang terkait. * **Fresh graduate dipersilakan melamar.** * Pengalaman di bidang Sales, Customer Service, atau pekerjaan lain yang berhubungan langsung dengan pelanggan menjadi nilai tambah. * Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi, negosiasi, dan presentasi yang baik. * Percaya diri, profesional, serta mampu membangun hubungan positif dengan individu dari berbagai latar belakang. * Memiliki motivasi kerja yang tinggi, proaktif, dan berorientasi pada target. * Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun berkolaborasi dalam tim. * Bersedia bekerja **full-time dengan sistem Work From Office (WFO) di Jakarta**. Benefit * **Gaji pokok yang kompetitif.** * **Insentif dan bonus berdasarkan performa.** * Jenjang karier yang jelas dan terstruktur. * Lingkungan kerja yang profesional, suportif, dan dinamis. * Kesempatan mengembangkan kemampuan komunikasi, penjualan, dan Business Development melalui pengalaman kerja secara langsung. Application Question(s): * Berapa usia anda saat ini? * Dimana domisili anda saat ini? * Apakah Anda memiliki pengalaman kerja di bidang Marketing, Sales, Telesales, atau Account Executive? * Berapa ekspektasi gaji yang Anda harapkan untuk posisi ini? * Jika lolos ke tahap berikutnya, kapan Anda tersedia untuk mengikuti proses interview? Work Location: In person

jobs.descriptionHtml: **Summary** ----------- The International Criminal Investigative Training Assistance Program (ICITAP) works with foreign governments to develop professional and transparent law enforcement institutions that protect human rights, combat corruption, and reduce the threat of transnational crime and terrorism. ICITAP supports both national security and foreign policy objectives. ICITAP works in close partnership with the U.S. Department of State, the U.S. Agency for International Development, and the Department of War. Learn more about this agency **This job is open to** ----------------------- ### **The public** U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S. ### **Veterans** Veterans of the U.S. Armed Forces or a spouse, widow, widower or parent of a veteran, who may be eligible for derived preference ### **Individuals with disabilities** Individuals who are eligible under Schedule A. ### **Clarification from the agency** Open to all U.S. Citizens, including Veterans, Individuals with Disabilities, and other individuals eligible for non-competitive appointment. **Duties** ---------- * Managing a police development project based in a foreign country, acting as an authoritative representative directing the delivery of training and technical assistance activities. * Reviewing, creating, and improving law enforcement policies and programs as they pertain to career development and training programs for police academies. * Developing methods and recommending implementation procedures for use in special training operations. * Advising the ICITAP director, deputy director, and assistant director for operations on all aspects of project development. * Reviewing current personnel and resource allocations among law enforcement agencies and programs and working closely with senior officials of the foreign government involved. * Serving as the ICITAP representative on embassy working groups and committees as directed by the Ambassador. **Requirements** ---------------- ### **Conditions of employment** * You must be a U.S. Citizen in order to qualify. * You must undergo a pre-employment security investigation. * You may be required to pass a State Department medical clearance. * You must sign a standards of conduct agreement for overseas service. * Selective Service registration is required, as applicable. * You must meet all qualification requirements by the closing date of this announcement. * A two-year trial period may be required. ### **Qualifications** To qualify at the GS-15 level, minimum qualification requires at least one year (52 weeks) of specialized experience equivalent to the GS-14 federal grade level. Examples of specialized experience include: supervisory and management (command level) experience in a civilian law enforcement organization to include managing people, resources, and budgets; delivery of police or criminal investigative training activities; and budgeting and operations. Preferred Qualifications: * Broad understanding and experience with foreign law enforcement institutions and should have extensive experience working in a developing country. * Experience in the area of civilian law enforcement community relations, community policing, and problem solving. * Past experience as a law enforcement trainer or police training academy commander. * Spoken fluency in a foreign language is desirable (written fluency is not required). ### **Additional information** **Post differential and/or hazard pay allowances may be applicable, depending upon the assigned geographic duty location.** The Criminal Division participates in the Electronic Employment Eligibility Verification Program (E-Verify). jobs.title: Key Account Executive - Greater Jakarta
jobs.descriptionHtml: Overview: Key Account Executive (KAE) / Regional Sales Executive is responsible for driving sales growth, expanding outlet coverage, and ensuring strong in-store execution across assigned territories and Modern Trade Independent (MTI) accounts.This role focuses on managing regional customer relationships, strengthening distributor collaboration, and delivering sales fundamentals through effective assortment, product availability, promotional execution, and store-level performance management.The position requires strong field execution, commercial acumen, and cross-functional collaboration to achieve revenue targets, improve distribution productivity, and ensure sustainable business growth. Responsibilities: * Deliver monthly and annual sales targets (NSV, volume, distribution) for assigned MTI territories. * Manage and monitor distributor performance, including coverage, stock availability, aging, and service levels. * Ensure effective execution of trade marketing programs, promotions, pricing updates, and visibility initiatives in MTI outlets. * Drive numeric and weighted distribution growth through new listings and portfolio expansion. * Monitor in-store execution standards, including planogram compliance, POSM placement, pricing integrity, and promotional setup. * Analyze territory sales performance and identify corrective actions to close gaps versus target. * Build strong working relationships with regional buyers, store owners, and distributor sales teams. * Provide regular performance updates and market insights to the GKAM MTI, including competitor activities and growth opportunities. Qualifications: * 3-5 years of experience in FMCG sales, preferably in Modern Trade or regional account management. * Experience working with distributors and managing sales territories. * Strong understanding of sales fundamentals, distribution metrics, and promotional execution. * Good negotiation and relationship-building skills at store and regional buyer level. * Analytical capability to interpret sales data and performance trends * Strong execution discipline and field management capability. * Ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams.- High mobility and willingness to travel across assigned cities.

This in turn, enriches the lives of hundreds of millions of people around the world. Our sales team, is in many ways, the face of Apple to our largest customers. We are here to help enterprise businesses transform the way people work— while growing top-line revenue for Apple. To realize this goal, we gain deep understandings of the businesses we manage—at all levels from tactical to strategic. We create a vision that can inspire customers to transform using Apple products. We collaborate closely with internal and external partners to create plans for solutions and new use cases, and then we help drive execution of the solution. Description - Advise on business, digital and workplace transformation solutions with strategic large customers together with our partners. - Develop account plans aligned with Enterprises’ and Government strategies, assess their progress and guide them on the journey of transformation, while growing and expanding adoption of the Apple platform and ecosystem. - Responsible for the creation, development and indirect orchestration of key industry sales plays within our customers. - Effectively execute joint account plans by cross-functionally partnering and Strategic partners, driving refresh, expansion and net new platform opportunities. - Identify and create new opportunities driving sales actions on refresh and net new platform opportunities. - Look to create lighthouse references which we can replicate and scale, leveraging success stories that can be told across industry. Minimum Qualifications * Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience. * 10 years of proven sales experience in Indonesia, preferably in capacity with background from IT Software/Services/Hardware * You have consultative selling experience in business transformation solutions for large enterprises. In your experience, you’ve balanced delivering on short-term goals, while creating sustainable value for customers, and demand for the future. Or you bring proven experience as an Account Executive for large Enterprises. * Demonstrated superior communication, relationship building, influencing in both English and Bahasa Indonesia Preferred Qualifications * Master’s degree or equivalent experience * You’re an expert at presenting and handling pressure. You simplify complex information and engage audiences. You empower others to learn and share your passion for the Apple story. When challenged, you share your deep knowledge of hardware, software, and services integration. * Apple prioritizes integrity, honesty, and accountability in all its products and business practices. You’re a trusted advisor who upholds Apple’s values and ensures its best interests are served. * You deeply understand customer needs, challenges, and concerns, enabling you to exceed customer expectations. You connect and influence the right people, both inside and outside Apple, to address unique customer and partner needs. As a go-to person with leadership, you’re comfortable in tough situations, settling disputes, negotiating, and making difficult decisions. jobs.descriptionText: <h2>About the role: What's in the Box</h2> <p>The Logistics Tribe builds the systems powering end-to-end delivery across North America, Europe and Australia/New Zealand: getting fresh ingredients into our facilities, giving customers the best delivery options the network can support, and tracking every box to the customer's door. Today it is a single engineering team - two staff engineers, a data engineer and seven mid-to-senior engineers - led by the Director of Engineering, owning that software and keeping it running in production. You will join as an Engineering Manager and take line management of the seven.</p> <p>The work is operations-heavy and business-critical, spread across different subdomains. You won't own a fixed backlog in one corner of the domain; the team's scope follows where the business pressure is. That is reflected in how we work: rather than one fixed squad, the team organises into small, project-focused pods that form and dissolve as projects start and finish. jobs.descriptionHtml:
sensmore is a Berlin/Potsdam-based robotics startup delivering production-proven automation for industries where the world’s raw materials are extracted, moved, and processed. Its automation system transforms heavy machines into intelligent, automated robots powered by Physical AI and vertically integrates them into the full production environment: from the machine and safety infrastructure to network infrastructure, site processes, and operational interfaces.

Co-developed with customers, sensmore is backed by Point Nine Capital, leading industry investors, the State of Brandenburg, and the European Union.

Responsibilities

Robot Operation & Safety Supervision:
Operate and supervise our autonomous machines during training and testing sessions, mainly remotely from the office and occasionally on site. Act as the safety supervisor, monitoring every run closely and stepping in when something doesn’t look right.

Readiness Checks & Documentation:
Complete pre-operation checklists to confirm each machine is safe and ready to run. Keep clear, accurate records of sessions, incidents and anomalies.

Technical Troubleshooting:
Monitor systems during operation, carry out first-line checks and collect the data our engineers need. Escalate issues with concise, well-structured reports.

Testing Support:
Help run test sessions, log results and feed your observations back to the engineering team to improve machine performance and test procedures.

What You Bring

  • Currently enrolled at a university

  • A valid driving licence, held for at least 2 years, and confidence behind the wheel (mandatory)

  • A responsible, safety-conscious approach to every task

  • Diligent, thorough and well organised, with a strong troubleshooting mindset

  • Technical understanding: you’re a PC power user

  • Flexibility on shift patterns, including evenings, fitting around your studies

Nice to have

  • Solid technical understanding: comfortable working in the terminal / Linux, ideally with experience of observability tools (e.g. Grafana, Prometheus)

  • Experience with heavy machinery or construction equipment

  • A deeper understanding of testing processes

  • Willingness to work night shifts

What We Offer:

  • Build physical AI for the world's largest off-highway machinery – making them intelligent, safe, and ready for every tough task

  • Join the pioneer in intelligent robotics backed by Point Nine & other Tier 1 investors

  • Combine cutting-edge robotics research in end-to-end learning & Vision Language Action Model with real-world heavy mobile equipment

  • Tailor your own career path, whether you like to become technical specialist or technical team lead

  • Experience a great team culture, beverages, and an amazing office environment


Benefits:

  • Attractive compensation package and stock...

jobs.descriptionHtml:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible. 🚀

At ClickUp, we’re building an AI-powered workspace that brings tasks, docs, chat, and AI-enabled workflows together so teams can spend less time switching tools and more time making progress. Our mission is to make the world more productive. Within Solutions Engineering & Customer Enablement, this role connects complex customer needs to practical product solutions, helping prospects and customers evaluate how ClickUp can support their workflows and business goals.

 

As a customer-facing technical partner to Sales and Success, you’ll lead discovery, shape solution strategy, and turn technical questions into clear next steps. You’ll help customers see what’s possible with ClickUp while keeping recommendations grounded in real workflows, integration needs, and adoption considerations.

 

Mission

 

Help prospects and customers understand how ClickUp can solve meaningful workflow and productivity challenges through strong technical discovery, practical solution design, and credible guidance throughout the buying journey.

 

What You’ll Accomplish

  • Partner with Sales and Success to lead technical discovery, deliver tailored demos, and show how ClickUp, integrations, and AI-enabled workflows map to customer needs.

  • Design and lead proof-of-value or proof-of-concept work so buyers can validate product fit, adoption potential, and business impact.

  • Translate stakeholder requirements into clear solution recommendations, including workflow design, reporting approaches, and lightweight technical architecture.

  • Support technical validation in live opportunities, including integration discussions, data migration considerations, security and process questions, and RFP responses.

  • Build custom reports, dashboards, and demo environments that reflect real customer use cases and make the platform concrete and credible.

  • Stay current on product capabilities and releases so you can explain solutions accurately and connect new features to customer needs.

  • Work with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product, and Engineering to remove blockers and improve the customer experience.

 

Required Qualifications

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role in software, such as pre-sales, solutions engineering, sales engineering, technical consulting, implementation, or a closely related path.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical discovery, live demos, and solution conversations with business and technical stakeholders.

  • Ability to turn ambiguous customer problems into structured recommendations, persuasive narratives, ...
